name: 解剖学・骨格筋の暗記｜起始停止ドリル
description:
鍼灸師・柔道整復師を目指す学生のための、筋肉の暗記アプリです。起始・停止・支配神経・作用を、解剖図と動くGIFで覚えられます。

■ フラッシュカード
アプリを開くとすぐに始まります。動きのGIFや解剖図を見て筋の名前を答え、「覚えた／忘れた」で振り分けます。一周したら、忘れた筋だけをまとめて解き直せます。

■ 表で覚える
筋群ごとの表で、隠れた語をタップしてめくります。易しい版（重要な語だけ）と難しい版（細かい語まで）を選べます。筋名をタップすると、その筋の図をすぐ確認できます。

■ テスト
「すぐ始める」で10問の4択テスト。出題範囲（体幹・上肢・下肢・頭頸部・苦手な筋）、答える項目（筋名・起始・停止・支配神経・作用）、出題形式（画像・GIF／一問一答／表から出題）も細かく選べます。間違えた筋は「復習」に集まります。

■ 筋肉一覧
89筋すべてに、筋肉図・起始（赤）と停止（青）の付着図・作用のGIFがあります。スワイプで切り替え、長押しで一覧表示できます。

■ 鍼灸・柔整の両方に対応
はり師・きゅう師、柔道整復師の養成校で使われる解剖学の教科書を参照しています。教科書によって表記が違う項目は、両方を並べて表示するか、どちらか一方に切り替えられます。

■ オフラインで使える
図とGIFはすべてアプリの中に入っているので、通信なしでサクサク動きます。

■ 料金
体幹の筋（胸部・腹部の筋、浅背筋）は無料。そのほかの筋は、アプリ内課金（買い切り）で開放できます。

制作：せいと

name: Manuales EjeMoto
description:
The manual you need, close at hand in your workshop.

Manuales EjeMoto brings a library of motorcycle documents and practical calculators into one app. Built for mechanics, students and riders who want to understand their motorcycle and look up information during maintenance.

App interface: Spanish. Document languages vary by model and reference.

FIND YOUR MAKE AND MODEL
Explore thousands of documents organized by manufacturer and motorcycle model. Search for a model, review the available manuals and filter by document type or language. Coverage, model year and language depend on each reference.

READ THE DETAILS
Open documents in the built-in reader. Zoom in, turn pages or jump to a specific page. Save manuals to favorites and revisit recent reading. With page memory enabled, pick up where you left off.

TOOLS FOR YOUR WORKSHOP
• Unit converter: torque, pressure, clearance and volume.
• Electrical calculator: Ohm's law and DC power.
• Valve shims: calculate a theoretical thickness from your measurements.
• Gearing: compare front and rear sprocket ratios.
• Two-stroke mix: calculate oil from fuel quantity and ratio.
• Displacement: calculate from bore, stroke and cylinder count.
• Inspection: keep a checklist and notes.

KEEP YOUR LOOKUPS ORGANIZED
Favorites, history, reading progress and notes are stored on your device, separately for each account. An internet connection and sign-in are required to access the library. Workshop tools are available without a subscription.

USE THE RIGHT INFORMATION FOR YOUR MOTORCYCLE
Always check the model, year and manual version. Calculators convert units or apply formulas; they do not prescribe a manufacturer's recommended torque, pressure or tolerances. Follow the specifications and safety instructions for your motorcycle.

Manuales EjeMoto is an independent service operated by FreeClick LLC. Brand and model names identify the corresponding vehicles and documents. They do not imply affiliation with or endorsement by their manufacturers.

Monthly and annual auto-renewable plans provide an ad-free experience across supported app channels using the same account. Your App Store displays the localized price before confirmation. Restore purchases and manage or cancel renewal through the store. Library reading and workshop tools remain available to free accounts.

name: nudgeeverse
description:
Need a nudge? Nudgeeverse connects you with kind strangers who've been there.

ASK FOR A NUDGE
Got an interview tomorrow? Can’t focus? Overthinking a text? Post a few words, pick what would help (kind words, ideas or advice), and real people reply.

GIVE A NUDGE
Swipe across and help someone else. A few honest words can turn someone's whole day around.

FEEL THE THANK-YOUS
When your words help, people can send a thank-you. You'll know you made a difference.

STRANGERS BECOME FRIENDS
Click with someone? Add them as a friend and keep the chat going with messages, photos and voice notes.

SAFE BY DESIGN
Report or hide any reply with a long-press, block people anytime, and every nudge closes when its timer ends and moves to your history.

NUDGEEVERSE PRO
Try Pro free for 7 days, then £3.99 a month or £29.99 a year.
- Message and add friends

name: Music Draw: Photo to Melody
description:
Turn drawings and photos into music. Draw a line, tap Play, and hear it become a melody. Start with a blank canvas, import a picture, or open a template to hear how it sounds.

DRAW AND PLAY
• Sketch freehand lines or fill individual squares in pixel mode. The playhead moves left to right, and marks higher on the canvas play higher notes.
• Use the pen, eraser, undo, and redo as you work. Pick a background color, choose a built-in image, or add your own photo.

TURN A PHOTO INTO MUSIC
• Choose an image from Photos or use the camera on a supported device. Crop the part you want and turn it into playable outlines.
• Adjust how much detail to keep. Select a stroke or circle a group to change its instrument or remove it. Switch to the manual editor to draw and erase by hand.

MAKE IT SOUND LIKE YOU
• Layer 13 instruments, including soft keys, marimba, bells, synth, guitar, strings, and saxophone.
• Change the key, scale, and tempo. Add bass, drums, or an arpeggio, then loop playback to hear your changes.

START WITH A TEMPLATE
• Browse axolotl, food, pixel art, and instrument templates. Search by name or save a favorite to find it again.
• Try Pixel Heart with marimba, add a few blocks at the end, and listen to the notes you just drew.

SAVE AND SHARE
• Save drawings on your device and reopen them to keep editing.
• Export WAV for listening, MIDI for editing in compatible music software, or MP4 to share the drawing and its sound together. Use the iOS share sheet to choose where the file goes.

SUPPORT
Questions or feedback? Email Huong Dang at dangthixuanhuongdn@gmail.com.

name: Duck Review: Catch Bugs
description:
Duck Review teaches you to review Python code the way a senior engineer does: by reading real snippets and finding the line that is wrong. It is the skill modern technical interviews test, and the one you use every day once AI writes part of your code.

Each exercise shows a short piece of Python and what goes wrong with it. Tap the line behind the problem, say what kind of issue it is, and get a clear explanation with the fix. No typing, no setup, a few minutes a day.

WHAT YOU PRACTICE
• Bugs: off-by-one errors, mutable default arguments, is vs ==, closures and late binding, modifying a list while iterating
• Security: eval, pickle, SQL built with f-strings
• AI hallucinations: invented imports and APIs that were never real
• Performance: hidden complexity, concatenation in loops, N+1 queries
• Readability: misleading names, magic numbers, comments that lie, swallowed exceptions

READY FOR MODERN INTERVIEWS
Technical interviews are changing. Beyond writing code from scratch, many now hand you a snippet, sometimes generated by AI, and ask what is wrong with it.
• Pick "Ace technical interviews" as your goal and your path starts with the classic traps interviewers love
• Practice explaining the issue: every answer names the line, the kind of problem and the fix
• Train under time pressure with the Daily: one attempt, against the clock
• Cover what a reviewer is expected to see: correctness, security, performance and readability

HOW IT WORKS
• A short placement test finds your level and skips what you already know
• A learning path of 10 units and more than 300 exercises, ordered around your goal: interviews, your job, or reviewing AI-generated code
• Personal practice brings back the mistakes you made and targets your weak spots
• The Daily: one snippet a day, the same for everyone, one attempt, against the clock. Share your result without spoilers
• Streaks, XP and an optional daily reminder to keep the habit

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

DUCK REVIEW PRO
The placement test is free. Continuing with the learning path, the Daily and personal practice requires a Duck Review Pro subscription, available weekly or annually.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://quentin-lauret.github.io/code-review/privacy/

name: DIBOSS - Patron Cockpit
description:
DIBOSS, isletme sahipleri ve yoneticiler icin tasarlanmis bir "Patron Cockpit" uygulamasidir. Muhasebe/ERP verilerinizden gunluk ozet panolar uretir; patron, karar icin gereken birkac rakami menulerde kaybolmadan tek ekranda gorur. Web paneliyle ayni verilere baglanir - ofiste masaustunde, sahada telefonda ayni tablo.

GENEL
- Gunun brifingi: bugunku ciro, acik tahsilat, nakit ve brut kar
- Donem secici ile gun/hafta/ay/yil kiyaslama
- Gecen yila gore (YoY) buyume

PARA
- Nakit akisi merkezi: banka bakiyeleri + gelecek 30 gun projeksiyon egrisi
- Likidite ve ilk negatif gun uyarisi
- Banka kredileri: toplam borc, doviz kirilimi, yaklasan taksitler
- Alacak/borc yaslandirma; gercek tahsilat/odeme akisi

SATIS
- FIFO bazli gercek karlilik (brut/net), urun bazli marj
- En karli urunler, urun dagilimi
- Fiyat erozyonu ve musteri segment analizi
- Hedef vs gerceklesen ciro takibi

TEDARIK
- Ithalat/yurtici alis dagilimi, maliyet seffafligi
- Satin alma sureci ve stok analizi

GUVENLIK VE ERISIM
- Rol bazli erisim: yonetici ve goruntuleyici
- Sadece okuma; uygulama muhasebe verinizi degistirmez
- Cok firmali yapi, sifreli baglanti

DIBOSS kurumsal bir uygulamadir; hesaplar isletmenizin yoneticisi tarafindan acilir. Denemek icin demo girisiyle ornek verili firmayi gezebilirsiniz.

name: Lexicalc: Calculator
description:
Lexicalc is a free, ad-free calculator with Basic, Scientific and Geometry modes, a random number generator, and number spelling in 20 languages. Work with large numbers and decimals, calculate powers, roots and logarithms, and use trigonometric functions with degree/radian controls.

Convert numbers to words to read and write large values or explore how numbers are expressed in another language. Switch between digits and spelled-out results at any time. No account, login or setup is required. Calculations, number spelling and random number generation work offline.

FEATURES
- Multilingual number spelling: display results in words across 20 languages
- Basic mode: everyday arithmetic, percentages and decimals
- Scientific mode: powers, square roots, logarithms, exponentials and factorials
- Geometry mode: sine, cosine, tangent and inverse trigonometric functions, with degrees or radians
- Random number generator: generate a number with the ? key
- Large-number support up to 10^66 - 1
- Up to 50 steps of undo history
- Long-press a result to copy the displayed text
- Light and dark themes
- No ads or subscriptions

LANGUAGES
Arabic, Chinese, Czech, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish.

OPTIONAL SUPPORTER PURCHASE
All calculator functions remain free. The optional one-time supporter purchase changes the small smile animation and displays a thank-you message. It does not unlock calculator features. Purchases and restoration use Apple's App Store and require store access.

ARTWORK CREDITS
Animated Noto Emoji by Google. Copyright Google. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). The animations are displayed at reduced sizes in the app.
Source: https://googlefonts.github.io/noto-emoji-files/
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The artwork is provided as-is without warranties under the license. Google does not sponsor or endorse Lexicalc.

name: Teacher Reminder
description:
Your classroom needs your attention. We'll remember the rest.

Teacher Reminder was made for the moments teachers get interrupted. A student needs you. Something comes up. Your attention shifts. Save a quick reminder before you forget, handle what needs your attention, and come back when you're ready.

WRITE IT DOWN FAST
A student needs you? Save what you were about to do in seconds, then get right back to teaching. Your own quick buttons — Call Parent, Print Copies, Student Note and more — are one tap away.

BE REMINDED AT THE RIGHT TIME
Choose when you want to be reminded — during prep, at lunch, after school, or at home. Turn on notifications and a nudge arrives at those moments, never while you're teaching.

NOTHING GETS FORGOTTEN
Didn't get to it today? Your reminder stays with you until you're ready to take care of it. Older reminders become easier to notice, so the things you've been meaning to do don't get lost in your list.

BUILT AROUND YOUR CLASSROOM
Your grade, your bell times, the things you do every morning. Two minutes at the start and it knows your day — then it never asks again.

SET RECURRING REMINDERS
Attendance, lunch count, classroom routines — set them once and Teacher Reminder brings them back every morning, ticked off in one tap.

PUT REMINDERS IN ORDER
Tap them one, two, three — nothing moves until you're done. Your own colors mark what you put first.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, email or sign-in. Everything you write stays on your phone and is never sent to us. When a reminder is about a call, it asks for the student's first name and last initial only.

SAVE A COPY
One file with your whole list and everything you've ticked off, to keep in Files, iCloud Drive or an email to yourself — and bring back on a new phone.

Made for K–5 teachers.

name: StitchSpan: Long Screenshots
description:
Keep the full story with StitchSpan. Combine overlapping screenshots, turn scrolling screen recordings into long images, and capture web pages. No account is required, and image processing happens on your device.

STITCH SCREENSHOTS
Import consecutive screenshots from Photos or Files. StitchSpan finds overlapping content and joins it into a long image. Review and adjust seams when needed.

TURN RECORDINGS INTO LONG IMAGES
Import a scrolling screen recording, trim its time range and analyze it. StitchSpan reduces duplicated content and fixed interface bars. Results depend on overlap, scrolling speed and animated content.

CAPTURE WEB PAGES
Open a web address or share a URL into StitchSpan to capture page content. Web browsing uses a temporary session.

CROP AND SHARE
Crop images and export JPEG for free. Save to Photos or Files, copy an image, or share through the system share sheet. Standard image splitting is included.

OPTIONAL PRO, ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Unlock lossless PNG, paginated PDF, advanced editing, solid redaction, mosaic, blur, text, drawing, arrows, watermarks, export presets and custom splitting. Pro is a non-consumable purchase, not a subscription. Eligible devices may see an introductory product during the first seven days of use; price and availability are shown by the App Store. Restore purchases from Settings or the paywall.

Review your result before sharing. Blur and mosaic do not guarantee that sensitive information cannot be recovered; use solid redaction when you need to cover content.

Terms: https://stitchspan.typcb.cn/en/terms/

name: Brina: Ski Cervinia & Zermatt
description:
Brina is a ski companion for the Matterhorn ski paradise: Breuil-Cervinia, Valtournenche and Zermatt, on both sides of the border.

• Live status: every lift and piste, open or closed, with queue times where the operator reports them and the state of the Italy–Switzerland connection with the last lifts back.
• Map: a winter map with every piste and lift, 3D terrain and satellite view, your position and which piste you are on. Downloads for use without signal.
• Route planner: from anywhere to anywhere, with stops of your own. Choose the hardest colour you want to ski, avoid drag lifts or flats, and see time, distance, descent and the elevation profile. Warns about lifts that close before you get there and the last connection home.
• Piste details and comparison: length, drop, average and steepest gradient, profiles of several pistes on top of each other.
• Ski day: records runs, lifts, distance, descent and top speed, even with the screen off, and warns you before the last lift home.
• Notifications: tap the bell on a lift or piste to hear when it opens or closes, even with the app closed.
• Weather, snow and webcams, including earlier pictures from the panorama cameras.

In English, Turkish, Italian and German. No account, no ads.

Brina is free. You can leave an optional one-off tip, or become a Brina Supporter for $2.99 a month (price may vary by country) for a supporter badge and three extra app icons. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it in your Apple account settings, at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://cervino-api.roll-exclusive.com/privacy

Brina is not an official app of the lift operators. Lift and piste states come from their public pages and can be late or wrong; signs and closures on the mountain always come first. Recording a ski day uses location in the background and more battery.

name: Hovora
description:
Never forget what your property needs.

Hovora keeps everything about the homes you own in one calm place: tasks, recurring maintenance, documents, expenses and reminders. It is built for owners who look after one to twenty properties themselves, whether that is a flat let to a tenant, a place abroad, or a few units gathered over the years.

EVERY PROPERTY, ONE LIST
See what is overdue, what is due soon and what is coming up across all your homes, sorted by what needs your attention.

SET IT ONCE, NEVER FORGET
Create recurring jobs like boiler servicing, smoke alarm checks or insurance renewals. Get push and email reminders on the due date or up to 14 days before. Each property keeps its own timezone, so reminders arrive on the right local morning.

EVERY REPAIR, START TO FINISH
Track maintenance jobs from open to completed, with category, priority, vendor and what each one cost. Add photos straight from your camera or library.

KNOW WHAT EACH HOME COSTS
Record expenses in each property's own currency and link them to the job and property they belong to.

LEASES AND RECEIPTS, ALWAYS AT HAND
Store leases, insurance policies, invoices and photos per property, in private storage only you can open.

SEE THE WHOLE PICTURE
Analytics show open and overdue tasks, maintenance status and spending at a glance.

PLANS
Hovora is free for one property, with tasks and email and push reminders. Upgrade in the app:
- Personal: up to 5 properties, recurring tasks, documents, maintenance and expenses
- Pro: up to 20 properties, everything in Personal, plus advanced analytics

Personal and Pro are auto-renewable subscriptions, billed monthly or yearly through your Apple Account. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings at any time.

Privacy: https://hovora.co/privacy
Terms of Use: https://hovora.co/terms

name: Lovebirdoku – Logic Puzzle
description:
Lovebirdoku is a cozy logic puzzle about lovebirds – and lovebirds always come in pairs.

HOW IT WORKS
• Each colored region gets exactly two birds
• Every bird sits right next to exactly one other bird – that's a pair
• Pairs never touch side by side (diagonal is fine)
• A pair may sit across a region border

Tap once to mark a cell with ×, tap again to place a bird. Swipe to mark many cells at once. Finished pairs get a little heart – and cells that can't hold a bird are crossed out for you.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• 300 levels from 5×5 to 9×9 – a gentle start, real brain teasers later
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution and can be solved without guessing
• A new Daily Puzzle every day: easy on Mondays, tricky on weekends – keep your streak alive and share your result
• Three hearts per level and a free hint when you're stuck
• Your progress is saved automatically
• Calm design, soft sounds, no time limit
• In 14 languages, no account needed

FAIR & PRIVATE
Free with ads: optional videos for extra hints or hearts and a short ad break after every third level. A one-time "Ad-free" purchase removes the ad breaks forever. Only non-personalized ads, no account needed.

Love logic puzzles like Sudoku, Norinori or Star Battle? Then give Lovebirdoku a try!

name: エレベーターシフター
description:
新ジャンル！ 超高層ビル運行制御シミュレーター。
あなたはビルのエレベーター管制官。押し寄せる人の流れを読んで「運転方式」を切り替え、1面60秒でできるだけ多くの人を運ぼう。

■ 遊び方
・朝のロビーに▲が押し寄せたら「出勤」、定時に▼が並んだら「退勤」、人が少ないときは「省エネ」。流れに合った方式を選ぶほど、エレベーターはスムーズに動きます。
・「ドア開閉 高速化」「上下移動 高速化」で輸送力アップ。ただし使いすぎると「停電の恐れあり！」→ 強制スローモードに。
・扉が開いているかごをタップで「閉」、閉まりかけのかごをタップで「開」。最後のひと押しで行列をさばこう。

■ スコアとピンチ
・上の階へ運ぶほど高得点。乗り換え階や最上階はボーナス。
・来客は2倍、役員は5倍、1回だけ現れる社長は10倍！
・待たせすぎると階段へ逃げられて大幅減点。スコアがマイナスになったら即「営業停止」！

■ どんどん増える運転方式
レベルをクリアするたびに新しい運転方式が解放されます。
到着予測・回転・順送り・最寄り・行先登録・2階建て・直通・ゾーン・乗換直通……全12種類を使いこなせ。

■ 3段階の難易度
各レベルは「来客少なめ」→「クイズ対応」→「キャパオーバー」の3ステージ。キャパオーバーを突破すると次のレベルへ。

■ リアルビルモード
全レベルを制覇すると、実在のビルをモデルにした「リアルビルモード」が解放。エレベーター2基の小さなビルの1日をさばききれるか？

■ プレイ後の分析レポート
待ち行列のグラフや、運転方式の切り替えのタイミングを振り返り、次のプレイに活かせます。

はじめての方も、1-1の操作ガイドがひとつずつ丁寧に案内します。

※ このアプリは無料で遊べます（広告あり）。アプリ内課金「広告を消す」で広告を非表示にできます。

name: 조선해왕
description:
조선해왕은 1550년 부산포에서 시작하는 항해·교역·해전 게임입니다.

3년 전 해금을 어기고 먼 바다로 나간 뒤 소식이 끊긴 아버지. 남은 것은 낡은 조운선 한 척과 약간의 빚뿐입니다. 부산포 면포를 사서 대마도에 팔며 첫 항해를 시작하세요.

■ 사서, 건너서, 비싸게 판다
항구마다 산지와 수요지가 다릅니다. 인삼·면포·비단·은·후추 등 교역품 20종의 시세를 장부에 모으고, 계절풍과 식량·물을 따져 이익이 남는 뱃길을 찾으세요.

■ 살아 있는 바다
조선·일본·명·류큐, 남만의 배까지 60여 함대가 저마다의 뱃길을 오갑니다. 안개 덮인 바다를 직접 밝히며 항구 20곳과 숨은 발견물 41곳을 찾아보세요.

■ 판옥선 선단과 해전
조운선에서 판옥선·세키부네·캐러벨까지. 최대 5척 선단을 꾸려 왜구와 맞서고, 배 옆구리를 적에게 돌려 일제 사격을 퍼부으세요. 검은 물길 깊은 곳에는 크라켄이 기다립니다.

■ 동료와 명성
선비, 셈쟁이, 요리사… 동료 다섯을 모아 6인 일행을 완성하세요. 교역·모험·해적, 어느 길로 가도 명성이 쌓입니다.

■ 한 번 구매로 전부
광고도 추가 결제도 없습니다. 모든 바다와 1장 이야기 끝까지 즐길 수 있습니다.

name: Can I Carry It? Grocery List
description:
Bought more than you can carry? Find out before you leave the store.
Can I Carry It? is a shopping list that adds up the weight and bulk of everything on your list and tells you whether you can get it home on foot or by bike.

WEIGHT AND BULK, FILLED IN FOR YOU
Around 300 everyday items, from milk and eggs to rice, bottled water and toilet paper, come with standard weights and sizes.
Add them and you instantly see something like "Weight 6.2 / 8.0 kg, Bulk 24 / 40 L".

OVER THE LIMIT? RICE NEXT TIME, WATER BY DELIVERY
Pick walking, biking or driving, and how you carry (one tote, a bag in each hand, a front basket and more).
When your list goes over, the app suggests a split with reasons: heavy items that keep well wait for next time, and anything too heavy on its own goes to delivery. Fresh food stays in today's bag.
If it would all fit on your bike, it tells you that too.

ADD BY VOICE
Say "2 milk, eggs and 5 pounds of rice" and each item lands on your list with the right quantity and size.
You can type several items at once as well.

FROM RECIPE TO SHOPPING LIST
Choose from about 100 dishes, from curry and stew to spaghetti bolognese, tacos and stir-fries. Change the servings and amounts follow, rounded up to the sizes stores sell.
Shared ingredients are combined, and pantry staples are listed separately.
For dishes not included, supported devices can ask on-device AI for ingredients, with nothing sent over the network. Save your own dishes to My Recipes.

TIME TO RESTOCK?
Items you've bought at least twice show up a month after your last purchase.
Set a different interval for each item, or turn reminders off for things you don't need nagging about. Optional notifications too.

WHEN, WHERE AND WHAT YOU BOUGHT
Mark items as bought to keep a record. In a store, your location is used to save the store automatically (change it or type one anytime).
See how much you carried this month, a monthly chart, and history by item or by store.

HANDY EXTRAS
- Sort by aisle
- Share your list as text
- A cooler bag reminder for chilled and frozen items
- One-tap adds for things you buy often
- Home Screen widget
- A reminder when you're near a saved store with items still to buy
- Siri and Shortcuts: "Add to Shopping List"

SOFT DESIGN, 9 COLORS
A gentle look with a faint pattern of groceries in the background. Choose from Sakura, Apricot, Lemon, Leaf, Mint, Sky, Lavender, Milk Tea and Cloud.

IPHONE AND IPAD
Sync with iCloud: make your list on iPad at home and check it on iPhone at the store.

ENGLISH AND JAPANESE, KG OR LB

PRICE
Free to use, with ads. Remove all ads with a one-time in-app purchase.

PLEASE NOTE
Weights, bulk and limits are estimates based on typical products. Carry only what's comfortable, and on a bike stay within your basket's maximum load.

PRIVACY
Your lists and history are stored only on your device and in your own iCloud. No account needed.
Location is used only to find the store you're in and is never sent to the developer.

name: RipCheck: Card Value Scanner
description:
Is that card worth anything? Point your camera at it and find out.

RipCheck is a TCG card scanner that shows marketplace prices in seconds, based on real sales data rather than AI guesses. Prices come from TCGplayer (USD) and Cardmarket (EUR) through the free public TCGdex API.

SCAN IN SECONDS
- Point the camera at a card. On-device text recognition reads the card name and collector number (like 020/189) and finds the exact card.
- See the market price in USD and EUR, plus the card image, set and number.
- Prefer typing? Manual search by card name is always free and unlimited.

PACK MODE: DID YOUR PACK PROFIT?
- Opening booster packs? Enter what you paid for the pack, then scan each card as you pull it.
- A running total shows the pack's value live, and tells you whether the pack profited or lost money.
- Built for pack openings, break nights and "was this box worth it?" debates.

TRACK YOUR COLLECTION
- Save cards with quantity and variant (normal, holo, reverse holo).
- See your total collection value at a glance.
- Sort your collection by value to find your best cards.
- Export to CSV with Pro.

HONEST AND PRIVATE
- Prices based on real TCGplayer and Cardmarket market data, not a guessing model.
- A genuinely free tier: 10 scans per day (camera or photo), unlimited manual search, and up to 30 cards in your collection.
- No account. No login. No ads. No tracking. No third-party SDKs.
- Your collection is stored only on your device. Camera frames are processed on-device and never uploaded.

RIPCHECK PRO
Upgrade for the full toolkit:
- Unlimited scans
- Unlimited collection size
- Pack Mode
- CSV export

Pro plans:
- Yearly: $34.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial
- Weekly: $4.99 per week (no trial)
Prices shown are for the US and may vary by region. You can see the full price in the app before you subscribe.

SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase (after the free trial for the yearly plan). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Restore Purchases is available in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://ripcheck-app.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://ripcheck-app.web.app/privacy

WORKS WITH POKÉMON TCG CARDS
RipCheck works with Pokémon TCG cards. Prices are informational estimates based on public marketplace data and may differ from what a card actually sells for, which depends on condition, grading and demand.

RipCheck is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc., TCGplayer or Cardmarket. All product names, trademarks and card images belong to their respective owners.

name: The Perfect Keyboard
description:
The Perfect Keyboard is a full keyboard for iPhone with your clipboard history built in. What you copied is one tap away while you type, and your clips stay on your iPhone.

CLIPBOARD HISTORY
• Tap the clipboard button at the top left of the keyboard to see what you copied.
• Tap a text clip to type it.
• After you copy something new, a "Paste copied text" button appears. Tap it to save the text and type it.
• Long-press a clip to pin, unpin or delete it. The trash button clears all unpinned clips.
• Remove unpinned clips automatically after 1 hour, 1 day or 7 days, or keep them.
• Passwords copied from password managers that mark them as private are never saved. You can also turn history off completely.

A FULL KEYBOARD
• Letters, numbers and symbols.
• Automatic capitals, and double-tap space to add a period.
• The return key matches the app you're typing in: Send, Search, Go and more.
• Key clicks, optional light haptics, and the globe key to switch keyboards.

BIG EMOJI STICKERS
• 96 stickers in 6 packs: Faces, Love, Hands, Animals, Party and Food.
• In the keyboard, tap the emoji button, tap a sticker, then long-press the text box and tap Paste. It arrives as a large image with a transparent background.
• In Messages, tap +, then More, then The Perfect Keyboard. Tap a sticker to send it, or drag it onto a message bubble.

STICKERS FROM YOUR PHOTOS (PRO)
• Pick a photo and the app cuts out the person, pet or object. This happens on your iPhone.
• Add a white border if you like, then save it.
• Send your photo stickers from the keyboard or in Messages.

THE APP
• Step-by-step setup.
• See, copy, pin and delete your clips.
• Add text with the Paste button, or add images from Photos.
• Choose when unpinned clips are removed, or turn history off.

FREE
• The full keyboard
• Clipboard history of your last 10 text clips
• The "Paste copied text" button
• All 96 emoji stickers, in the keyboard and in Messages
• Auto-remove settings

PRO: ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Keep up to 50 recent clips
• Pin clips so they stay until you unpin them
• Image clips
• Make stickers from your photos
• Send your photo stickers from the keyboard and in Messages
Pro is not a subscription. It works with Family Sharing, and you can restore it on a new iPhone with Restore Purchases in the app.

PRIVACY
The app has no account, no servers, no analytics, no ads and no third-party code. It does not use the internet. Your keystrokes are never recorded, stored or sent anywhere. Your clips and stickers are stored only on your iPhone.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Clipboard history, image clips, stickers and haptics need Allow Full Access. iOS requires it for these features. Typing works without it.
• iOS lets keyboards type text only, so images and stickers from the keyboard are pasted: tap one, then long-press the text box and tap Paste.
• A keyboard only runs while it's on screen. If you copy several things without opening it in between, only the last one is saved. The app's Paste button can add things directly.
• Password fields and some banking apps always switch to Apple's keyboard. This is an iOS rule for every third-party keyboard.
• If iOS asks "Allow Paste?", open the Settings app, find The Perfect Keyboard, tap Paste from Other Apps and choose Allow.

Requires iOS 17 or later.

Emoji sticker artwork: Noto Emoji by Google, used under the Apache License 2.0.

Questions or problems: hello@rhfardin.com

name: Twinz: Dual Account Browser
description:
Work account and personal account on the same service? Twinz opens every account in its own Space — each with its own login, cookies and site data. No more signing out and back in.

DUAL ACCOUNTS & MULTI LOGIN
• Create a Space for your favourite web services: chat, email, social, online shops and more
• Every Space has separate logins and storage — accounts never mix
• Keep two, three or more accounts of the same service open side by side

SEPARATE WITH PERSONAS
• Group Spaces into Work, Personal, Family or Business
• Persona colours and initials tell every account apart
• Filter home by persona and open the right account every time

PRIVATE AND LOCKED
• Lock Twinz, or just certain Spaces, with Face ID
• A backup Twin passcode that pauses after 5 wrong attempts
• Hide Spaces from home
• Set camera and microphone access per Space

UPDATES, SORTED
• Twinz checks your Spaces in the background and tells you how many messages are unread
• Download files and save images straight from a Space
• Widgets and Quick Actions to open a Space faster

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
A sidebar layout on iPad keeps every Space one tap away.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
Logins, cookies and page content are never sent to a Twinz server. Twinz only sends crash reports and diagnostics without personal data.

TWINZ PRO
Free: 3 Spaces. Twinz Pro unlocks unlimited Spaces, Face ID lock per Space and widgets. Choose monthly, yearly (with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and can be managed or cancelled in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://twinz.dwirandyh.dev/privacy

The Twinz interface is in Indonesian. Twinz is an independent app and is not affiliated with the services you open in it.

name: Odachinote
description:
Odachinote helps parents and children keep track of chores and allowance on one device.

Children report completed chores, and parents review and approve them. Approved rewards are kept separate from allowance that has actually been paid.

Features
• Add children and chores
• Report completed chores and approve or reject reports
• Track earned, paid, and unpaid rewards
• Record allowance, expenses, and cash balance
• Add things to save for and allocate money toward savings goals
• Review history and monthly totals
• Set a PIN for parent mode
• Save data on the device and create or restore JSON backups

Use it together to follow the process from a chore report to approval, payment, and savings.

name: Tomio: Your Library
description:
Tomio is a real library on your phone.

Add your books and they take their place on the shelves of a beautiful bookcase. Choose a theme, decorate your shelves, keep a reading diary and earn awards. Reading in English? Tap an unfamiliar word and see the translation instantly.

THEMES
• Tomio, Library, Winter Trail and Winged Warrior are built in
• More themes download free right in the app: Golden, Leather, The Exile, Dark Temptation, By Candlelight, Ink
• The bookcase, shelves and windows change with the theme

SHELF DECORATIONS
• Lanterns, flowers, plants and fairy-tale figures between your books
• Garlands under the shelves
• Your own decorations from your pictures

YOUR LIBRARY
• A bookcase with a showcase for your favorite books
• Covers, filters, search and a Read shelf by year
• Series: books of one series stand in order
• Paper books too — just photograph the cover
• Your own cover and spine
• Zoom into the shelves with two fingers

COMFORTABLE READING
• EPUB, FB2, PDF, TXT, DOCX, MOBI, AZW3, ODT, RTF
• Turn pages like a real book or scroll
• Justified text with neat hyphenation
• Font, size, page color and textured paper
• Bookmarks, quotes, table of contents

TRANSLATION FOR ENGLISH BOOKS
• Tap a word for translation and pronunciation
• Translate a phrase or a whole page
• Offline translation
• Your own vocabulary: saved words are highlighted in your books

READING DIARY
• A page for every book: dates, ratings, quotes, impressions
• A family tree of the book's characters
• Tracker, statistics and your whole year day by day
• Mood and Book of the Year
• Reading awards

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
Your books and notes stay on your device. No sign-up needed.

Available in English, Russian, Spanish, German, French and Italian.

Tomio does not sell books: you read your own files.

name: Workerbase - 회사 생활에 필요한 모든 것
description:
Workerbase는 회사의 근무와 업무를 한곳에서 연결하는 직원용 앱입니다. 회사에서 발급한 계정으로 로그인하고, 회사 설정과 내 권한에 맞는 기능을 이용하세요.

■ 오늘의 근무를 간편하게
출근·퇴근을 기록하고 휴게 시간을 관리하세요. 회사의 근무지 정책에 따라 위치를 확인하며, 근무 기록과 정정 요청도 앱에서 확인할 수 있습니다. 위치는 출퇴근 확인 등 필요한 동작에서 요청합니다.

■ 휴가와 신청, 결재를 한곳에서
휴가·재택근무·출장 등 필요한 신청을 작성하고 진행 상태를 확인하세요. 결재 권한이 있다면 요청을 검토하고 처리할 수 있습니다.

■ 회사의 업무와 문서를 연결
업무와 알림, 팀과 근무표, 회의 및 회사 문서를 확인하세요. 회사에서 사용하는 기능과 권한에 따라 증명서·계약·급여명세서 등 관련 메뉴도 제공됩니다.

■ 여러 회사에서도 내 계정으로
회사 이메일로 로그인한 후 이용할 회사를 선택할 수 있습니다. 회사별 자료와 접근 권한을 구분하여 제공합니다.

[이용 안내]
• Workerbase를 도입한 회사의 직원 계정이 필요합니다. 앱에서 개인 회원가입은 제공하지 않습니다.
• 이용 가능한 메뉴와 승인 권한은 회사 설정 및 사용자 권한에 따라 달라집니다.

• 일부 문서는 안전한 웹 화면에서 추가 로그인 후 열립니다.

서비스 안내: https://workerbase.biz
문의: contact@bvdev.co.kr

name: Calendread: Office Sayings
description:
Motivational quotes? We've had enough. Calendread is the tear-off calendar for everyone who already knows in the morning how the day is going to go.

A new calendar sheet is waiting for you every day. Tear it off – and read your very own prophecy for the workday. Gloriously sarcastic, guaranteed unmotivating and frighteningly true.

“You're irreplaceable. Nobody wants your job.”
“Follow your dreams. They don't know where they're going either.”
“Every day is a new chance. To miss it.”

• A new saying every day – 365 days, no repeats
• Monday sayings on Mondays, Friday sayings on Fridays, weekend sayings on weekends
• Tear off the sheet just like a real tear-off calendar
• Everyone gets the same saying today: perfect for the team chat

Free, offline, no ads, no account, no data collection. Just demotivation.

name: 10LogicQ – Daily Logic Puzzles
description:
10 puzzles. Every day. Logic made fun.

Play a five-minute logic challenge at your level, from picture patterns and odd-one-out to code locks, detective cases and river crossings. Miss a puzzle? Get a tip and try again, then see the answer explained step by step.

Everyone playing the same level gets the same daily puzzles, so families, classes and friends can play along and talk through their thinking. Want another round? Each level has its own daily 10.

No account. No ads. No subscriptions.

10 LEVELS, FROM STARTER TO GRANDMASTER
• Young thinkers: what comes next, odd one out, matching shadows, picture squares and balance scales, read aloud
• Growing thinkers: number patterns, fruit codes, clue puzzles, truth-tellers and fibbers, line-ups

FAIR PUZZLES
• Every clue puzzle is checked by the app to have exactly one answer

LEARN AS YOU GO
• A gentle tip after a miss, then one more try
• Tougher puzzles have an optional hint
• Tap to hear a puzzle read aloud
• A new set of 10 puzzles every day
• Study guides included with Levels 6–10

A HABIT, NOT HOMEWORK
• About five minutes a day
• A daily streak that never scolds: miss a day and it simply starts again
• Share your score as 10 little squares, without your name, age or level
• A cheer for every right answer

SAFE AND PRIVATE
• No tracking and no data collected: your progress stays on your device
• Any purchase is behind a grown-up check

FREE TO PLAY
Levels 1–5 are free every day. Levels 6–10 are free for 7 days; after that, Advanced Levels is a one-time purchase. Extra Practice is a separate one-time purchase that adds 10 more puzzles after the daily round, at any level you can play.

Made by I See, I Spell, I Learn, LLC, makers of 10MathQ, 10WordsQ, Picture Sight Words and Picture Homophones.

name: 60s Khoa học
description:
60s Khoa học giúp học sinh ôn bài bằng những lượt trắc nghiệm ngắn. Mỗi lượt chỉ khoảng một phút: trả lời câu hỏi, nghe giải thích ngay sau mỗi câu, rồi xem tổng kết.

name: A Day Remembered
description:
Slow down and keep the small things that made a day feel good.

A Day Remembered is a cozy, quiet place for a few words, a photo or a color. It is not a journal or a diary to keep up with: there are no blank pages, no daily entries and no streaks to protect. Come by when something small feels worth keeping, and take a little time for yourself.

A GENTLE ALTERNATIVE TO JOURNALING
• Keep a moment in seconds: a few words, one photo, one color
• No streaks, points or goals, and no guilt when you skip a day or a month
• A calm prompt each day, if you'd like somewhere to start

MOMENTS THAT COME BACK TO YOU
• Once you've kept 7 moments, one from your past is waiting for you each day
• Find another whenever you like, one at a time and never as a feed
• Like finding a note in an old coat pocket

SLOW, CALM AND YOURS
• Soft colors and an unhurried pace, made for a mindful pause
• Optional gentle reminders: every day, a few times a week or once a week
• Share a moment as a picture, only when you choose to

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up
• No ads and no tracking
• Your moments are stored on your device, and the app works offline

A small act of self-care and self-love: slow living, a moment of focus, memories and gratitude without the homework. You stay in control. You decide when to keep a moment, when to look back and what to share.

Good to know: because there is no cloud copy, your moments may be lost if you remove the app or lose your device.

name: AcoustiNode: Studio Acoustics
description:
AcoustiNode is a specialized architectural acoustics and studio room resonance engineering workbench designed for audio engineers, studio acoustic builders, studio architects, and mastering specialists.

Combining discrete 3D standing wave mathematical modeling, Bonello distribution criteria, Schroeder quadratic residue diffusion, and Sabine/Eyring reverberation equations, AcoustiNode gives you complete analytical insight into room boundary dimensions and acoustic materials.

KEY ENGINEERING WORKBENCHES:

1. 3D RAYLEIGH ROOM MODES
Calculate all axial, tangential, and oblique resonant modes up to 300 Hz using three-dimensional boundary wave equations. Inspect individual mode modal vectors (p, q, r), exact center frequencies, and relative energy attenuation (-3 dB for tangential, -6 dB for oblique).

2. BONELLO DISTRIBUTION SPECTRUM
Evaluate low-frequency room acoustics using the classical Bonello criterion across standardized 1/3 octave frequency bands (20 Hz to 315 Hz). Instantly identify non-monotonic modal density peaks and degenerate mode clusters that cause low-frequency acoustic coloration and boominess.

3. BOLT ACOUSTIC PROPORTION ENVELOPE
Check room dimensions against Bolt ratio envelopes and Louden/Sepmeyer empirical criteria. Optimize room length, width, and height ratios to achieve uniform modal distribution before physical construction.

4. 2D NODAL PRESSURE HEATMAP
Visualize indoor acoustic standing wave pressure fields at horizontal and vertical spatial slices. Locate pressure anti-nodes (maximum sound pressure) and null nodes (minimum sound pressure) to position studio subwoofers, monitor speakers, and the primary listening sweet spot.

5. SCHROEDER 1D QRD DIFFUSER WORKSHOP

Configure wall, ceiling, and floor boundary materials from a built-in absorption database. Calculate Sabine and Eyring reverberation curves against ITU-R BS.1116 and EBU Tech 3276 reference tolerance envelopes.

7. HELMHOLTZ RESONANT BASS TRAP TUNING
Calculate precise cavity volumes, port diameters, and neck lengths to tune targeted Helmholtz absorbers against dominant low-frequency resonant peaks.

8. OFFLINE STUDIO PROFILES & VECTOR PDF REPORTS
Save multiple acoustic room configurations locally. Export detailed vector architectural acoustic calculation specification sheets, summary printouts, and structured CSV / JSON datasets directly from the device.

name: Akari Challenge
description:
Place bulbs, light every cell, and mind the numbers. Akari is the classic logic puzzle, also known as Light Up, made for iPhone and iPad.

The rules take a minute to learn. Light travels in straight lines until a wall stops it. Two bulbs must never shine on each other. A numbered wall tells you exactly how many bulbs touch it. Light every white cell and the board is solved.

Every puzzle has exactly one solution, so it can always be solved by logic alone, without guessing.

A fresh Daily Challenge waits for you every day. Solve it to grow your streak, and see how many days in a row you can keep the lights on.

Play your way. Auto mode cycles a cell from empty to crossed out to bulb with a single tap, or switch to Bulb or Empty mode for precise control. The app remembers the mode you like.

Best times and stars are kept for every level, and your progress syncs automatically across your devices with iCloud. No accounts, no tracking.

description:
Algoo is a personal pain journal, kept by a little companion.

Find the hidden animals and race to finish before your opponent. Every discovery brings you one step closer to victory!

Join a public room or create a private room for friends. A friendly little match can turn into a wonderfully close race!

Fog can cloud your view, and the puzzle board can spin! Keep your cool, rethink your next move, and stay in the game.

name: Axolotl Dash

Chain hits, fill the frenzy bar and for a few seconds your points are doubled. And when they grab your last egg, time slows down to give you one more chance.

POWER-UPS
Shield, long dash, slow time, piercing dash, egg magnet and golden eggs.

From dawn to night, with minnow rushes and night heron raids.

Collect coins and unlock new axolotls: Wild, Golden and Alebrije.

Pixel art, music and sound made for the game. No internet needed, no sign-up.

name: Brief & Bezwaar
description:
Understand the letter. Then act on it.

A letter from the Belastingdienst (Tax Administration), the CJIB (fines) or your gemeente (municipality)? Brief & Bezwaar explains in plain words what it says, how long you have and what you can do. If you disagree, the app helps you write a proper objection in Dutch.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan the letter with your camera, or pick a photo or PDF. No letter to hand? Try a sample letter.
2. The app reads the text on your phone and hides your personal details: your BSN (citizen service number), your own account number, address, name, email and phone number. You see exactly what gets sent.
3. You get a plain explanation: who sent it, what it means, the amount, how to pay and what happens if you do nothing.
4. You see the deadline, together with the line in the letter where the date comes from.

IS THIS LETTER REAL?
The app compares the account number in the letter with the official account numbers of the Belastingdienst, the CJIB, DUO and others. It also checks web addresses and pressure tactics. You see "Looks genuine", "Be careful" or "Probably fake", with the reasons. This works offline too.

OBJECT IN TIME
For a bezwaar (formal objection) you usually have 6 weeks under Dutch administrative law (Awb). The app works out the last day, including when it falls on a weekend or public holiday. You confirm the date. With Plus you add it to your calendar and get reminders 7 and 2 days before.

WRITE THE LETTER (PLUS)
Answer a few short questions, in your own language if you like. The app turns them into a formal Dutch letter:
• bezwaarschrift (objection)
• beroep (appeal), for example against a traffic fine
• WOZ objection (property value), with a request for the valuation report
• betalingsregeling (payment plan)
• uitstel (extension to pay)
• pro-forma objection, when the deadline is almost up
A checklist shows whether everything the law asks for is in it: your name and address, the date, the decision you object to, your reasons and your signature. You save the letter as a PDF and send it yourself. The app never sends anything on your behalf.

A FILE PER AGENCY
Letters, drafts and deadlines per sender on one timeline. Everything stays on your phone.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Explanations in English, simple Dutch (B1), Persian (Farsi), Arabic and Turkish. Have the explanation read aloud. Light and dark mode.

PRIVACY
• Photos and PDFs stay on your phone.
• Only the masked text goes, encrypted, to our server at Cloudflare. Nothing is stored there or used to train AI.
• No account and no ads.
• Anonymous crash reports and usage statistics, never the content of your letters.
• "Delete everything" in Settings wipes it all from your phone.

FREE AND PLUS
Free: 2 explanations a month, the scam check and the deadline view.
Plus: unlimited explanations, every letter type as PDF, reminders and the full file. €4.99 a month or €39 a year. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Cancel any time in the store.

GOOD TO KNOW
Explanations and letters are written with the help of AI. This is not legal advice. Check amounts, dates and the letter itself before you send or pay anything. Explanations need an internet connection. Offline you still see the key facts and a standard explanation.

Brief & Bezwaar is made by HIOLO. It is not affiliated with the Belastingdienst, the CJIB or any government body.

name: Calculadora REBT sección cable
description:
Calculadora de sección de cable y caída de tensión según el REBT, para electricistas e instaladores. Pones la intensidad o la potencia y los metros, y te dice qué sección poner, cuánto cae la tensión y hasta qué longitud llegas. Cada resultado lleva su cita del reglamento: tabla, columna y fila.

Viene preparada para lo más habitual en vivienda: monofásico a 230 V, cobre, PVC, método B, cos φ 1 y caída máxima del 3 %. Solo cambias lo que sea distinto en tu obra, y el resultado sale mientras escribes.

GRATIS: SECCIÓN DE CABLE Y CAÍDA DE TENSIÓN

• Sección de cable. Con la intensidad o la potencia, la longitud y cómo va instalado el cable, en monofásico o trifásico (230/400 V), te da la sección mínima, su intensidad admisible con la cita de la tabla, la caída de tensión y el calibre máximo del PIA (el magnetotérmico) que la protege según la ITC-BT-22. También te dice por qué no valen las secciones más pequeñas.

• Caída de tensión. Con la sección y la longitud que tienes, te da la caída en voltios y en porcentaje y si cumple el límite de la ITC-BT-19 (apartado 2.2.2). Si no cumple, te dice la longitud máxima con esa sección y qué sección necesitas para esa longitud; con un toque abres ese cálculo con los datos puestos.

CON PRO

Se desbloquea con una compra dentro de la app y añade:

• Tabla rápida de longitud máxima por calibre. Para cada sección, su intensidad admisible y los metros máximos con cada calibre de 6 a 125 A, con el sistema, el método, el aislamiento y el límite de caída que elijas. Puedes dejar fijo un calibre junto a la columna de secciones.
• Derivación individual y línea general de alimentación (ITC-BT-15 e ITC-BT-14): límite de caída de cada caso (unifamiliar 1,5 %, contadores centralizados 1 %), sección mínima del reglamento y tubo.
• Punto de recarga de vehículo eléctrico (ITC-BT-52): esquema de instalación, sección del circuito, calibre del PIA cuando la ITC-BT-52 lo da en tabla (vivienda unifamiliar y circuitos colectivos trifásicos) y las protecciones que exige, con su cita.
• Factores de corrección por temperatura ambiente y por agrupamiento de circuitos.
• Intensidad admisible por sección: la columna entera para el método, el aislamiento y los conductores que elijas, con las notas de cada valor.
• Potencia e IGA: de potencia a intensidad, IGA mínimo, circuitos de la vivienda (ITC-BT-25) y previsión de cargas de un edificio (ITC-BT-10).
• Tubos: diámetro mínimo según cuántos conductores van y de qué sección (ITC-BT-21).
• Informe de mediciones: por instalación y circuito apuntas la resistencia de aislamiento, la continuidad del conductor de protección, la toma de tierra y el disparo de los diferenciales, y la app te dice si cada valor cumple su umbral del REBT, con su cita. Lo compartes en PDF. Es tu registro de mediciones; no sustituye al certificado de instalación.

DE DÓNDE SALE CADA NÚMERO

Así cita la app una intensidad admisible: «UNE-HD 60364-5-52, C.52.1 bis, col. 6a, 6 mm² → 36 A». Las tablas son las de la UNE-HD 60364-5-52:2022, obligatoria desde abril de 2025. En la caída de tensión, la cita es el apartado del REBT que fija el límite. La conductividad se toma a la temperatura máxima del aislamiento (48 con PVC, 44 con XLPE; Guía-BT-Anexo 2), que deja el cálculo del lado de la seguridad.

COPIAR Y COMPARTIR

Copiar deja el cálculo como texto (datos, resultado y cita) para pegarlo en un WhatsApp, en un presupuesto o en la memoria técnica de diseño. Compartir lo manda directamente.

¿Un resultado no te cuadra con la obra? Escríbenos a soporte@calculadorarebt.com con los datos que tecleaste.

AVISO

Es una ayuda de cálculo y no sustituye al Reglamento Electrotécnico para Baja Tensión (REBT) ni a sus instrucciones técnicas complementarias. Revisa el resultado antes de firmar: el boletín lo firmas tú.

name: Coffee: Caffeine Log
description:
A little record of every cup.

Coffee helps you log drinks and caffeine on iPhone and Mac. Keep track of coffee, tea, and other caffeinated drinks, see your daily intake and estimated caffeine remaining, and choose a companion to share your routine.

Log a drink
Choose from the drink catalog or enter a drink and its caffeine content yourself. Scan a label to create a draft, then check the details before saving.

See your day take shape
View daily intake, estimated caffeine remaining, and a caffeine curve. Use your chosen bedtime as a reference when reviewing your drinking routine.

Plan and remember
Set up drink plans and local reminders. Look back at your history and insights to explore your habits over time.

Add a companion
Choose a companion and theme, or create your own with multiple photos and messages. Remove photo backgrounds on your device and see today's summary in a widget. On Mac, you can also use a desktop companion and a menu bar entry.

Continue across your devices
The release build supports syncing records and selected preferences through your own iCloud account. No separate account is required. Label recognition runs on your device; original scan images are not uploaded to a developer-operated server.

Coffee is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice. Caffeine amounts, remaining levels, and timelines are estimates based on your records and a model. They are for personal reference and cannot determine a safe individual intake or guarantee sleep outcomes.

name: Colorlink: Flow Puzzle
description:
Colorlink is a line-linking puzzle with a twist. Like classic flow puzzles, you draw one line per colour and fill every cell. But each colour has three or more dots, and in most puzzles you don't know which two are the ends. Work it out and the board falls into place.

LINK EVERY DOT
• One line per colour, through all of its dots
• Lines can't cross or branch, and every cell gets filled
• Classic puzzles hide the ends: which dots start and finish each line?

LOTS OF WAYS TO PLAY
• A level path that teaches the rules one step at a time
• Free Play: Guided, Classic, Hex, Walls and Shapes, from Easy to Expert
• Hex boards with six ways out of every cell
• Walls that change the answer, and boards shaped like hearts, arrows and frames
• A daily puzzle, a weekly 9×9 and a monthly 10×10, with leaderboards

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Hints that explain the next step when you're stuck
• Four board styles, plus light and dark themes
• Colourblind letters on every dot
• Stats, streaks and achievements

Free to play with ads. The optional Puzzle Pack adds 200 more puzzles per difficulty (50 for Shapes), Remove Ads turns off all ads, and hint packs are available in the app.

name: ContentBrainy
description:
Content Brainy is your planner for social media content. Every idea becomes a Content Piece you take from filming through editing to posting — on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook.

PLAN

CAPTURE IDEAS INSTANTLY

name: Count Squares - Number Puzzle
description:
How many rectangles add up to the target number?
Count Squares is a number puzzle game: look at a grid of numbers, find every rectangle whose cells add up to the target, and submit how many there are.
The rule fits in one line, but the bigger the board, the harder your brain works.

[How to play]
· You get a grid of numbers and a target number
· Find every rectangle whose cells sum to the target. A single cell counts, and so does a long strip
· Rectangles that overlap are counted separately
· Enter the number of rectangles on the keypad and submit
· You have 3 chances and a time limit. Get the count right to clear the stage!

[Why you will enjoy it]
· 150 stages - from 3×3 starter boards up to tough 6×6 boards
· Zeros, negative numbers and empty cells turn the same rule into a whole new puzzle
· Daily Challenge - one new puzzle every day. Keep your streak going
· Three stars - solve without mistakes and quickly to earn more stars
· Drag to mark - outline the rectangles you have found so you do not lose track
· Hints - stuck? Reveal one rectangle you have not found yet
· Solution replay - after each stage, see every correct rectangle one by one
· Tutorial - learn the rule in moments, even if it is your first time

[Great for]
· Fans of number puzzles, math puzzles and logic puzzles
· Anyone looking for a brain training game that builds mental addition and focus
· A quick puzzle on your commute or during a break
· Playing together with kids to build number sense

[Features]
· Portrait mode, playable with one hand
· Available in English and Korean
· Contains ads, no in-app purchases

Wake up your brain with today's Count Squares!

name: CountDarts: Scorer & Training
description:
CountDarts does the maths so you can just play – steel tip or soft tip. Open the app, pick your players, throw. No account, no ads, no interruptions between legs.

X01 LIKE AT THE OCHE

name: Curio - 3D
description:
Curio turns your iPhone or iPad into a little display case. A polished object floats in the space inside the screen, and as you move your head it turns, just as a real object would, so you can look around it, over its top and down its sides.

• Head tracking with the front camera: move left, right, up or down, or lean in, and the object answers.
• Real reflections: mirror and glass surfaces show you and the room around you, live.
• Glass that bends light: see-through shapes refract the room, show their back edges and split bright edges into rainbow fringes.
• Six shapes: cube, pyramid, diamond, gem, sphere and ring.
• Four materials: smooth mirror, mirror facets, clear glass and cut glass.
• A floor that runs off to a distant horizon behind the screen, and a sheet of glass you can see your reflection in.
• Red/cyan 3D-glasses mode for true stereo depth.

Best on a folding iPhone opened like a little laptop: the object hangs in the air between the two halves. It also works flat on any iPhone or iPad.

Tilt and Touch modes let you look around without the camera.

name: Curio Nook
description:
A little order. A little wonder. Welcome to Curio Nook.

• QUIET BY DESIGN: No ads, no energy systems, no push notifications, and completely playable offline.

Curio Nook is designed as a peaceful, relaxing retreat for puzzle lovers of all ages.

name: Daily Roll: Photo Newspaper
description:
Your camera roll is full of news. Daily Roll prints it.

Every night, Daily Roll reads the photos you took today and Apple Intelligence writes a newspaper front page about your day: a screaming headline, a lead story, sidebars and breaking-news tickers, starring you. The croissant you broke in half becomes a war zone. Your cat becomes a world exclusive.

• A nightly edition, printed like a receipt from a pocket printer

Unlock every paper stock, restyle any edition, keep the whole archive and remove the watermark. Yearly (with a free week), monthly or lifetime.

Daily word game with a secret five-letter word locked in a dial: a new word puzzle every day in English, Portuguese (Brazil) and Spanish. Turn five 3D drums to any letters, press Try, and read what each drum tells you. No account, works offline.

A DIFFERENT KIND OF WORD PUZZLE
You may set any letters you like. Each drum answers with a bearing: a check mark when it is locked in, or one to three chevrons that say whether the secret letter sits earlier or later in the alphabet, and how far away it is. A theme clue (Animals, Food, Weather, Music and more) is shown from the start, so you can combine word sense with alphabet sense and crack the word in three or four tries. You get seven.

THREE LANGUAGES, ONE APP
Play in English, Portuguese (Brazil) or Spanish. Each language has its own hand-written list of everyday words and the screens switch with it. The Portuguese and Spanish screen texts are an early version, and feedback from native speakers is welcome at the support page.

WHAT YOU GET
- The daily word puzzle: the same for everyone, worked out on your device from the date. No connection needed.
- Endless practice dials when one a day is not enough.
- Streaks, win rate and a tries chart, kept on your device. No sign-in.
- Real-time 3D drums with momentum, detents and soft haptics.
- Share your result as text only: chevron levels and stars, never the letters, so nothing is spoiled.
- A gentle warm-up the first time you open the app.
- Colour modes (Classic, High contrast, Colour-safe): shapes such as the check, chevrons and lock always carry the meaning, never colour alone.

name: Dashlamp: OBD2 Car Scanner
description:
Check engine light just came on? Dashlamp tells you what it means in plain English.

Plug a Bluetooth LE or Wi-Fi ELM327 adapter into the OBD2 port under the steering wheel, tap Scan, and in under a minute you see:

- Every trouble code (DTC) from the engine and other modules: confirmed, pending and permanent
- What each code means, how urgent it is, whether you can keep driving and what to check first
- Emissions readiness: is the car ready for the smog check, and which monitor is still incomplete
- Battery voltage and the distance driven since codes were cleared (useful when buying a used car)
- Live gauges for engine speed, coolant, battery and speed

Clear codes after a repair and Dashlamp reminds you to scan again after a few days of driving, so you know the fix held. Every scan is saved per car, with what changed since last time.

No adapter yet? Try the demo car and see a full scan first.

- Freeze frame data: the engine conditions when the code was set
- PDF report to share with your mechanic
- All live sensors with 60 second charts
- More than one car

No account, no sign-up, no ads. Your scans stay on your phone.

Works with ELM327 compatible adapters (Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi). Classic Bluetooth adapters made for Android do not work with iPhone. Most cars sold in the US from model year 1996 support OBD2. Code explanations are general guidance, not a replacement for a professional mechanic. Only use the app while parked.

name: DayFlow: Countdown & Widgets
description:
DayFlow counts the days that really matter.

Vacation in 23 days? A project deadline in 41 working days? 100 days since you started a new habit? DayFlow gives you the right number – not just calendar days, but working days, days without public holidays or any rules you choose.

THREE WAYS TO COUNT
• Count down to a date or an exact time
• Count up from a start date
• Track progress between two dates

• Calendar days, working days or your own choice of weekdays
• Public holidays for Poland, Germany, France and the United States – Easter and other movable feasts included

• Add your own days off – single dates or dates that repeat every year
• Decide whether the target day itself counts
• See the full calculation and a day-by-day calendar, so you always know where the number comes from

MANY DISPLAY STYLES
Large number, number in a ring, progress bar, segmented bar, scale with dates, detailed (days, hours, minutes, seconds) or minimal. Every style is previewed live with your own data.

SMART REMINDERS
• On the start day, on the target day or a chosen number of days before

ORGANISED

• Search, sorting, list or grid layout

No account, no ads, no analytics. Your countdowns stay on your device.

Daystrong builds short home workouts around you: the space you have, the time you have and the moves your body would rather skip. Pick "no jumping" or "no floor" once and those moves never appear again, in any workout.

name: Delivery Days: Idle Tycoon
description:
Turn your grandpa's old garage into the biggest delivery company on the canyon road! Delivery Days is an idle tycoon game: sign restaurants, grow your scooter fleet and get every order there while it's hot.

SIGN 12 RESTAURANTS

description:

name: DepositGuard: Rental Checklist

DOCUMENT EVERY ROOM

COMPARE MOVE-IN AND MOVE-OUT
- See each item side by side
- Flags what got worse, and what was already damaged when you moved in
- Move-out shows your move-in photos so the angles match

KNOW YOUR DEADLINE
- Deposit rules for all 50 states and DC
- A countdown to your landlord's legal deadline, including business-day states and states where the clock starts with your forwarding address
- Reminders before and after the deadline

TRACK THE WHOLE TENANCY
- Repair requests with photos, status and days open
- A log of calls, texts, emails and promises from your landlord

DEPOSITGUARD LIFETIME (one-time purchase, no subscription)
- Professional PDF evidence reports for move-in and move-out
- Dispute packet: the amount owed, your state's rule and a dated timeline, followed by all your evidence
- A demand letter citing your state's deposit law

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photos stay on your iPhone until you choose to share them. Back up everything to one file whenever you want.

DepositGuard provides general information and templates, not legal advice. Rules change and some cities add their own. For your situation, contact a local legal aid office.

name: Depths of Finance
description:
Futures, options, FX, securitized products (MBS and CDOs) and credit default swaps. Learn how derivatives work, and the greed, fear and market madness behind them, by moving the numbers yourself.

Instead of memorizing terms, see for yourself why each product was created, how it got twisted, and how it breaks.

SIMULATORS
- Futures: hedging and margin calls. A farmer and a baker lock in a price; a speculator buys wheat futures with 1-25x leverage and faces a margin call: hold on, or cut the loss?
- Options: pennies, then the steamroller. Payoff charts for calls and puts, and 72 months of selling puts that win 9 times in 10 until one crash wipes them out.
- FX: the carry trade. An exporter fixes its rate with a forward; a retail trader collects daily swap points until a sudden yen surge forces a stop-out.
- Securitization and CDS: why bundling 100 risky mortgages turns 80% into AAA, and the 2005-2009 story of a CDS buyer and seller, quarter by quarter.

STORIES
- Every chapter opens with a plain-language summary
- The inner voices of four kinds of people: the real-world user, the speculator, the banker and the outsider who read the fine print

GLOSSARY
- About 60 terms explained simply: puts, margin calls, tranches, swap points and more
- Tap any dotted word in the text to see its meaning on the spot

CRISIS SURVIVAL QUIZ
- Start with ¥10 million and make decisions at 8 turning points. Your best result and titles are saved

ALSO
- Japanese, English, Korean and Traditional Chinese
- Haptic feedback at margin calls and crashes
- Works offline. No account, no ads, no purchases, no data collected

All numbers are simplified teaching models. Nothing here reproduces real markets or products, and nothing is investment advice.

name: Diagram Viewer Offline
description:
Diagram Viewer opens diagrams in the draw.io format — .drawio, .drawio.svg and .drawio.png files — on iPhone and iPad and shows them just like the desktop app does: same colors, fonts, shapes and connectors.

• Accurate rendering: powered by the open-source draw.io viewer with its shape libraries — AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cisco, BPMN, Kubernetes, networking and many more.
• Fully offline: your diagrams never leave the device, the app never goes online.
• Open files from the Files app, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, Proton Drive (including Shared with me), Mail and messengers via Share / Open in.
• Pinch to zoom, pan, fit to screen, switch pages of multi-page diagrams.
• Export a page to PDF (vector) or PNG.
• Recent diagrams with thumbnails, one tap away.
• Dark mode UI; diagrams keep their own colors.
• No diagram at hand? Open the built-in sample.

The app is a viewer only; editing is not supported.

draw.io is a trademark of JGraph Ltd. Diagram Viewer is an independent app and is not affiliated with JGraph Ltd.

name: Dicemas: Gift Dice Game
description:
Dicemas runs the Christmas gift dice game at your table.

Everyone brings a wrapped gift. In round 1 you take turns rolling: roll a six and you take a gift from the pile. When the pile is empty, round 2 starts: now a six lets you steal a gift from anyone, until the bell rings. Then everyone unwraps what they're holding.

• A big die to tap or shake, or play with your own dice
• The pile counts down for you, with undo
• Round 2 timer with a loud sleigh-bell finish
• What every number means, on screen for the whole table
• The screen stays on during the game

Dicemas Pro (one-time purchase, no subscription):
• Hidden timer: nobody knows when it ends, so nobody can wait for the last second
• Surprises: every few minutes the game shouts an order to the whole table
• Three more rule sets: Every number counts, Left and right, Total chaos
• Your own house rules for both rounds

Known as pakkeleg in Denmark, julklappsspelet in Sweden, pakkespill in Norway and the gift dice game in the Netherlands and Germany. No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: DIMORA - Ristrutturazioni
description:
DIMORA è l'app di Dimora S.r.l., impresa di ristrutturazioni di Torino: notizie e richiesta di preventivo per tutti, il gestionale per chi lavora con noi e per i nostri clienti.

PER TUTTI
• Notizie e approfondimenti sulle ristrutturazioni: costi, bonus, come scegliere l'impresa
• Richiesta di preventivo in pochi tocchi

PER IL PERSONALE E I COLLABORATORI
• Cantieri, cronoprogramma e attività del giorno
• Foto di cantiere, giornale dei lavori e ore direttamente dal telefono
• Preventivi, commesse e clienti per l'ufficio e i commerciali
• Notifiche per nuovi contatti, approvazioni e cambi di programma

PER I CLIENTI
• Avanzamento dei lavori e cronoprogramma
• Documenti da consultare e da firmare dal telefono
• Rate e pagamenti
• Richieste e assistenza

SICUREZZA
• Accesso con email, password e codice; poi con Face ID o impronta
• Ognuno vede solo i propri lavori
• Dati conservati in Europa, a Milano

FUNZIONA ANCHE SENZA RETE
Le ultime informazioni restano sul telefono e le modifiche partono quando torna la connessione.

Notizie e richiesta di preventivo sono aperte a tutti, senza account. L'accesso al gestionale («Accesso utenti») è riservato a chi lavora con Dimora e ai suoi clienti: dopo la registrazione Dimora conferma l'account.

name: Dotmori: Photo Dot Art
description:
Every dot makes a masterpiece.

Dotmori turns your photos into dot patterns you finish by hand. Tap the dots one by one and watch your picture appear. It's calm, creative and surprisingly satisfying.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a photo: a pet, a portrait, a trip, a sunset
• Crop and adjust it, and paint the areas that need more or less detail
• Choose a style and the number of dots, with a live before-and-after preview
• Fill in the dots and reveal the picture
• Save the finished artwork, watch the timelapse, and share it

STYLES
• Classic black & white stippling
• Halftone pop art in four-color print dots
• Color pointillism, inspired by Seurat
• Outline stippling that follows the contours
• Minimal dots
• Connect the Dots: a numbered line puzzle made from your photo

MADE FOR FOCUS
• Three difficulty levels, from big friendly guides to tiny precise dots
• Color-by-color mode with per-color progress
• Find remaining dots, undo and redo, zoom and pan, Apple Pencil support
• Auto-save: pick up where you left off

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos are converted on your device and never uploaded. No account needed.

PREMIUM
A one-time purchase unlocks color pointillism, outline stippling, up to 50,000 dots, special dot shapes, artist palettes, high-resolution PNG, and vector SVG and PDF export, including printable worksheets. No subscription. You can also unlock premium options for a single artwork by watching a short ad.

Available in English, Korean, Japanese, German and Spanish.

name: DualCam - Front & Back Camera
description:
Record your iPhone's front and back cameras at the same time — straight into one video.

What is in front of you and your reaction to it, in a single take. No second recording, no editing afterwards. Made for reviews, unboxings, live selling, travel and reaction videos.


■ Both cameras, one file

• Front and back are recorded together, with sound, and saved to your Photos library the moment you stop.
• Works on iPhone XS / XR and later.


■ Put yourself anywhere

• Drag the small frame — it snaps to a corner.
• Pinch to resize, or double-tap for Small, Medium or Large.
• Tap the small frame to swap which camera is in it.


■ Shoot easier

• Tap the picture to focus and set exposure right there.
• Pinch the picture to zoom that camera.
• Back-camera light for dark rooms and close-ups.
• 3 s or 10 s timer before recording starts.


■ Layouts

• Free: Picture in picture, Top / bottom.
• Pro: Side by side, Circle, Heart, Polaroid, Diagonal, Strip.


■ Every ratio, free

9:16, 3:4, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 — for stories, feeds and widescreen.


■ Looks

• Filters with live thumbnails, so you see each one on your own shot before you pick it. 6 free: Normal, Mono, Warm, Cool, Fade, Vivid. 15 more with Pro or a filter pack: Golden, Pastel, Emerald, Tungsten, Disposable, Chrome, Noir, Instant, Process, Transfer, Sepia, Vintage, Tonal, Dreamy, Pixel.
• Put a filter on both views or on just one (Big / Small, Top / Bottom, Left / Right) — free. Two different filters on the two views at once is Pro.
• Skin smoothing for the front camera: Light is free, Strong is Pro.
• Frame border: White or none for free; Black, Yellow, Blue, Red, Green or any color you pick with Pro.


■ Quality

HD 720p and Full HD 1080p at 30fps are free. 4K from the back camera, or 60fps at 1080p, come with Pro or the 4K & 60fps pack.


■ DualCam Pro — your choice

Try every Pro feature in the preview for free; recording with one needs Pro or the pack that covers it. Unlock it the way that suits you:

• Pro Yearly — everything in Pro, billed once a year (auto-renewing subscription).
• Pro Lifetime — everything in Pro, paid once.
• Single packs — paid once, one group each: Film Pack, Retro Pack, B&W Pack (filters); Cute Layouts, More Layouts; 4K & 60fps; Strong smoothing; Frame colors. Mixing two different filters is Pro only.

The free version adds a small DualCam mark in the corner of your videos; any purchase removes it.

Family Sharing works with every purchase. No ads, ever. Moving to a new iPhone? Tap Restore Purchases.


■ Private by design

• No account, no sign-up.
• No server, no analytics, no tracking, no third-party SDKs.
• Camera and microphone are processed on your iPhone. Videos go to your Photos library and nowhere else.
• The microphone is optional — without it, DualCam still records, just silently.


Requires iOS 17 or later and iPhone XS / XR or newer. iPhone only, portrait.


Subscription details: DualCam Pro Yearly is an auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically for one year at a time unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.
