name: Dungeon Jump
description:
Zindan lavla dolup taşıyor ve tek çıkış yolu yukarı.

Dungeon Jump, hızlı tempolu piksel sanatlı bir arcade tırmanma oyunudur. Çıkıntıdan çıkıntıya atlayın, canavarların arasından hızla geçin ve lav sizi yutmadan önce tırmanmaya devam edin. Her koşu farklıdır, her metre önemlidir.

ÖZGÜRLEŞİN VE TIRMANIN
Şövalyeniz zindan duvarları arasında zincirlenmiş olarak uyanır. İlk zıplamanızla zincirleri kırın ve tırmanmaya başlayın. Yıkılan çıkıntılar, gizlenen canavarlar ve yükselen lav, sizinle zirve arasında duruyor.

HIZLA İLERLEYİN, SAVAŞIN, KOMBO YAPIN
Düşmanlara doğru hızla ilerleyin, onları parçalayın ve bonus altın için vuruşlarınızı kombolara dönüştürün. İyileşmek için iksirleri alın, bir darbeden kurtulmak için kalkanları toplayın ve hareket etmeye devam edin: lav asla durmaz.

EFSANEVİ ŞÖVALYELERİN KİLİDİNİ AÇIN
Her şövalyenin kendine özgü bir görünümü, kendine özgü bir atlama izi ve benzersiz bir gücü vardır:
- Ejderha Şövalyesi: dev bir ejderha çağırın, doğrudan yukarı doğru sürün ve tüm zindanı ateşe verin.
- Zaman Şövalyesi: Zamanı 5 saniye geriye sarın, her hatayı sanki hiç olmamış gibi düzeltin.
- Gölge Şövalyesi: Bir gölge ninja olun ve yanınızda savaşacak iki gölge kopyanızı çağırın.
- Ruh Şövalyesi: Lavın içine düşüp bir hayalet olarak yeniden yükselin ve bir şans daha yakalayın.
- Vampir Şövalyesi, Kanatlı Şövalye ve daha fazlası, her birinin kendine özgü bir gücü var.

EV HAYVANLARI VE YÜKSELTMELER
Her koşuda altın toplayın ve dükkânda yeni şövalyeler, sadık evcil hayvanlar ve daha yükseğe tırmanmanıza yardımcı olacak kalkanlar için harcayın.

BİR KOŞU DAHA
Başlaması kolay, bırakması zor kısa ve yoğun koşular. En yüksek noktanızı geçin, yeni şövalyelerin kilidini açın ve ne kadar yükseğe tırmanabileceğinizi görün.

ÖZELLİKLER
- El yapımı piksel sanat ve akıcı oyun deneyimi
- Yatay oyun için tasarlanmış basit kontroller
- Özel güçlere ve atılma izlerine sahip benzersiz şövalyeler
- Evcil hayvanlar, kalkanlar, iksirler ve kombo ödülleri
- Yükselen lav, canavarlar ve kırılan çıkıntılarla sonsuz tırmanma
- 13 dilde mevcut

Lav sizi yakalamadan önce ne kadar yükseğe tırmanabilirsiniz?

name: EasyPDF Editor Pro
description:
EasyPDF Editor Pro brings document reading and practical PDF tools together on iPhone and iPad.

Import documents from Files or open files shared from another app. Read PDFs, resume your last page, keep bookmarks and add personal reading notes. View Office documents, plain text, RTF and HTML through a PDF preview; the original file remains separate. Preview layout can differ from the source document.

Mark up PDFs with highlights, drawings, shapes, text, notes and handwritten signatures. Fill forms, arrange pages, extract or merge pages, compress files and export supported formats. Browse ZIP and RAR archives and save selected contents to your library.

Professional tools include editing existing text and images, permanent redaction, PDF comparison and document checks. Review previews, findings and format limitations before saving. Automated checks do not certify full PDF/A or accessibility compliance.

Read and edit on your device. Save a separate copy, review its name, location, page count and size, then open or share it. Files you choose to share are handled by the selected app or provider.

The interface follows your device language, with English as the fallback. You can change the language in Settings. Flexible layouts support iPhone and iPad, including narrow windows and larger text.

Includes core reading, markup and basic PDF tools and may show ads. Professional tools can be unlocked for a tool session with a rewarded ad when one is available. Optional Premium removes ads and includes professional tools. Choose a monthly auto-renewing subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. The purchase screen shows the App Store price for the selected plan. Manage subscriptions through your Apple account.

Premium Monthly is a 1-month auto-renewing subscription that removes ads and provides access to all professional tools while active. Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation. It renews at the price shown in the app unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel at Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. Premium Lifetime provides the same benefits with one payment and does not renew.

name: Emplovia
description:
Emplovia is the app for your Emplovia account: everything important about your work, always with you.

TIME TRACKING
• Clock in and out, start and end breaks – with a live view of today's working hours
• Break reminders based on the rules of your working time model
• Add missing times if you forgot to clock in
• Booking overview as a monthly calendar with target, actual and balance

ABSENCES
• Request holiday and other absences – showing the working days
• Upload documents such as sick notes as a photo or PDF
• Keep track of your remaining holiday and the status of your requests

INBOX
• All notifications in one place, sorted by category
• Jump straight to the request, post or document

POSTS
• News from your company in the feed
• Comment, react with a like and write your own posts (depending on your permissions)

PEOPLE
• Find colleagues, with contact details, department, team and location

PROFILE AND DOCUMENTS
• View your personal details and – if your company allows it – change them
• View, share and download your documents
• Pay & salary: your compensation and payslips (with the corresponding add-on)

MORE FEATURES
• Record and submit expenses, photograph receipts (with the Travel Expenses add-on)
• Performance meetings and one-to-ones (with the Performance & Development add-on)

Available in six languages: German, English, Spanish, French, Italian and Dutch. Light and dark mode, just as you prefer.

IMPORTANT: To use the app, you need an Emplovia account from your employer. Accounts are created by your company – you cannot sign up in the app.

name: Entrepixel - Diario de juegos
description:
Entrepixel es tu diario de videojuegos. Registra lo que juegas, puntúa con estrellas, escribe opiniones y comparte tus listas con una comunidad de jugadores.

• Diario: lleva el registro de lo que estás jugando y de lo que ya terminaste.
• Opiniones: puntúa cada juego con estrellas y cuenta qué te pareció. Cada opinión tiene su propia página para compartir.
• Listas: crea listas de juegos, ordénalas a tu manera y compártelas.
• Perfil: tus juegos favoritos, lo que juegas ahora, tus opiniones y tus listas en un solo lugar.
• Amigos: sigue a otras personas y mira lo que puntúan y las listas que crean.
• Clubs: únete a clubs y conversa sobre tus juegos.
• Descubre: los juegos más populares de la semana y un catálogo con miles de títulos.
• Invita a tus amigos con tu enlace personal.

Puedes explorar sin cuenta o entrar con Apple, con Google o con tu correo. La comunidad está moderada: puedes reportar contenido y bloquear usuarios desde la app.

Entrepixel no está afiliado a los editores ni a los desarrolladores de los juegos que aparecen en el catálogo.

name: Euphoniumable: Euphonium
description:
Hold your phone, tilt it, and a euphonium sounds. Euphoniumable uses the sensors in your iPhone to recreate the feel of playing the euphonium.

■ Pick harmonics by tilting
Raise the far end of the phone for a higher harmonic and lower it for a lower one, much like finding a note with your lips. The phone vibrates as you approach the point where the note changes.

■ Four valves
The four valves on screen use the same fingerings as a real euphonium. Add the fourth valve to reach low notes that three valves cannot play.

■ Play by tilting or with your breath
The note sounds while the phone is level. Turn on Play with breath and it sounds only while you blow on the microphone. The microphone is used only to measure how hard you blow; nothing is recorded or sent.

■ See the note you are playing
The name of the sounding note is shown in concert pitch. Handy for checking fingerings, or for practicing where you cannot take out your instrument.

■ A warm low-brass sound
Every note has its own soft, full tone.

Enjoy the euphonium at home or on the go.

name: Event Planner by Monte Peony
description:
Every guest. Every hour. Every seat.

Weddings, birthdays, work events and everything in between. Event Planner keeps the guest list, the running order of the day and the seating plan in one place, so the table plan always matches who is actually coming.

PASTE THE LIST. THAT'S IT.
Copy names from a spreadsheet or a group chat and paste them in. Anyone who looks like a guest you already have is flagged before they're added, and each household keeps its dietary needs and notes beside its names.

GUESTS ANSWER FOR THEMSELVES
Email every household its invitation and private link, from you, and remind the ones who haven't replied in one go. They reply for each part of the day, choose their meals and name their plus-one, from any phone and without an account, and it all lands in your guest list.

THE WHOLE DAY, HOUR BY HOUR
Lay out the welcome, the drinks, dinner and dancing. Give each stage its own time, its own guest list and its own seating plan.

EVERY SEAT, TO SCALE
Draw the room with its tables, the dance floor and the bar, then tap a seat to place a guest, or let auto-seat fill the tables while keeping together the people who belong together, and apart the ones who don't.

PLAN IT WITH THE PEOPLE YOU TRUST
Invite your partner, your family or your planner as editors or viewers. Everyone works on the same event, the activity shows who changed what, and a seating plan can go back to any earlier version.

ALWAYS KNOW WHAT'S LEFT
Every event opens on a countdown and a short list of what still needs doing: guests without a seat, stages without a time, stages that overlap. A checklist, the budget and your vendors sit right beside it.

ON THE DAY
Check guests in at the door, and print or share the floor plan, place cards, escort cards, the caterer's sheet and the run of show.

PRICING
Your first event is free, with everything included. Every event after it uses one event credit, with no limits on guests, tables or timeline. Credits come in packs, never expire, and work in Event Planner on the web too. Guests never pay and never need an account.

Terms of Service: https://montepeony.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://montepeony.com/privacy-policy

name: EverydayColor: Color Helper
description:
A little more clarity about everyday colors.

EverydayColor helps you describe a color, compare two observations and remember useful labels for familiar things. Start with free color help, then choose Personal Plus when you want a larger, more organized library. No app account is required.

FREE COLOR HELP
• Live camera color estimates and photo inspection.
• Plain color names, readiness guidance, freeze and resume.
• Optional spoken results and accessibility settings.
• Labeled A/B comparison and saved-reference comparison.
• Unlimited saved observations and five named items.
• Item names, categories, favorites, notes and clearly recorded label sources.
• Readable text, CSV and complete library JSON exports.

REMEMBER WHAT YOU KNOW
Keep a label marked as a camera estimate, confirmed by you, confirmed by someone you trust or taken from a product label. New observations stay beside that label; they never silently replace what you confirmed. Search your library by name, label or category.

PERSONAL PLUS
• Unlimited named items.
• Editable groups with ordered membership.
• Reusable packing checklists with separate progress for each group.
• Saved combinations with your own notes and editable item order.
• Select items and apply category, favorite and group changes together.

Camera and photo identification, comparisons, speech, unlimited observations, basic item editing and all three export formats stay free. If Plus access ends, saved items, groups, combinations and checklist progress remain available to read, export and delete. New organization changes require Plus.

LOCAL AND CLEAR
Camera frames are processed on your iPhone and color records are stored locally. Source photos are not retained. Your library does not require a cloud wardrobe or an app account. Export records when you choose and delete them within the app.

UNDERSTAND THE READING
Camera observations estimate the light reaching the camera. Imported images describe their pixels. Lighting, reflections, patterns, camera processing and image edits can affect a reading. Readiness guidance is not a physical color-match guarantee. The app does not diagnose color vision or certify matches for safety-critical decisions.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Personal Plus is an auto-renewable subscription with equivalent monthly and annual options. US pricing is $2.99 per month or $19.99 per year. No free trial is included. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings. Restore purchases is available on the paywall and in Settings. The App Store shows the actual localized price and billing period before purchase. Initial availability is the United States. Previously purchased lifetime Personal Plus access is honored; a subscription is not required for those purchasers.

description:

name: FairKeep: Photo Cleanup
description:
FairKeep finds the near-copies, blurry frames, closed eyes, old screenshots and big videos in your photo library, and shows you which photo stays, and why, before anything goes.

HOW IT WORKS
• Swipe through your photos a month at a time, or see what you took on this day in earlier years. Right keeps, left marks it to delete.
• Nothing is marked until you choose. The smart tools show what they suggest, and one tap marks it all, or every photo in a section, to delete or to keep. If you'd rather start with the suggestions marked, there's a setting for that.
• Nothing is deleted until you tap Delete, on the To delete screen or at the foot of a smart tool. iOS asks you too, and deleted photos wait in Recently Deleted in the Photos app for 30 days.
• Every step can be undone until then.

THE SMART TOOLS
• Similar shots: frames of the same moment are grouped and the best one is picked. Beside each of the others you see why the keeper won: sharper, eyes open, face in focus, or the one you favourited. Tap "Keep this one instead" under any frame to make it the keeper.
• Bursts, blurry photos and closed eyes
• Screenshots and screen recordings
• Big videos, biggest first

If a blurry photo is the only one of its moment, FairKeep leaves it for you to decide.

description:

正しく測定した結果は履歴に残り、あとから測定根拠として外枠や内枠を確認できます。
結果は鑑定結果を保証するものではなく、参考値です。
スリーブやケースは外して、平坦な背景の上で撮影してください。
ホームと結果画面には広告を表示します。
初回3回は測定無料、以降は短い広告動画を再生すると3回測定が可能です。

name: Green Planet - 星を緑にする育成ゲーム
description:
灰色の星を、緑でおおいつくす育成ゲームです。

のりものに乗って球の星を走ると、通った土に苗が植わります。実ったら、もう一度通るだけで収穫。拠点に戻ればリーフ（お金）に変わります。操作は、画面をおさえて指をずらすだけです。

■ 拠点を育てる
拠点のレベルを上げると、新しい苗が作れるようになります。草、花、低木、果樹、そして星の樹へ。上の苗は、下の苗の上から植えかえられます。

■ 道具をそろえる
移植ごてから大型の機械まで、植える道具・集める道具・カゴ・のりもの・肥料を買いかえていくと、一度に植えられる広さも、走る速さも変わっていきます。

■ 星をまるごと見わたす
「全体」を押すと、星を指で回して裏側まで見わたせます。灰色だった星が少しずつ色づいていくのを、いつでも確かめられます。

■ おおい切ったら、つぎの星へ
星ぜんぶを最上位の苗でおおうと、その星に名前をつけて記録できます。つぎの星は、大きさも生態系もちがう候補から選べます。森の星、花の星、果実の星、きのこの星。星ごとに、育つ植物も実もちがいます。

■ じっくり遊べる
最初の星だけでも、たっぷり時間がかかります。少しずつ進めて、自分だけの星図を埋めていってください。

・ひとりで遊ぶゲームです。通信対戦やアカウント登録はありません
・進み具合は端末の中に保存されます
・音は出ません。画面の上に広告が表示されます

name: GRID GUESS - Bingo Logic Duel
description:
Bingo × deduction — a brand-new kind of puzzle game.
Forget puzzles you solve alone. GRID GUESS is a puzzle you play against someone, fighting over the same board.

■ Bingo × deduction?
Each player secretly places numbers from 0 to 5 on their own 4×4 grid. The board you battle on shows the sum of both grids (0–10). You know your own placement — but not your opponent's.
Pick a panel and call a number with a card from your hand. Hit, and the panel opens in your color for points. Miss, and you still learn whether the number is higher or lower.
Read the clues, work out your rival's placement, and complete a line where 3 or more panels are your color to win with a Bingo!

■ What makes it different: you play against someone
Most puzzles have one fixed answer you solve alone. In GRID GUESS, the answer changes every game depending on your opponent's placement.
・Panels your opponent opens become clues for you, too
・Stop their Bingo with a Block — or race to finish yours first
・Your misses ("higher / lower") are visible to your opponent, so where you call is part of the mind game
Enjoy the thrill of solving and the tension of outguessing your rival at the same time.

■ Tactics
・Hit a number and matching panels above, below, left and right open in a chain for big points
・Fuse two number cards into one bigger card
・Use 0 Open / 10 Open to reveal many panels at once
・Block a line to stop your rival's Bingo, and Unblock to clear your path
・Only the player who wins with a Bingo keeps that game's points. The highest total over 4 games wins the match

■ Two ways to play
[VS CPU]
Play solo anytime. The CPU reasons only from public information, calculating probabilities to play its best.
[Online]
Tap "Create room" and share the 4-digit room code with a friend. No account needed — start a match with someone far away in seconds. Close the app and you can rejoin the same room later.

■ Perfect for
・Fans of bingo, number puzzles and deduction games
・Anyone who wants more than a puzzle you solve alone
・Friends and family who want a quick battle of wits, one phone each
・Board game and card game lovers who enjoy reading their opponent

■ Notes
・Free to play. Ads are shown at the bottom of some screens and between games.
・Online play requires an internet connection.
・Available in English, Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese.

name: GSR Business Suite
description:
GSR Business Suite brings the information a small or medium business needs every day into one place, in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Chinese and Arabic.

MARKETS AND NEWS
• Reference exchange rates and a market overview
• Weather for your city
• Current news by country, from the publishers' own feeds

EU TENDERS
• Public tenders from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily), filtered by country, city and sector

BUSINESS COCKPIT
• Keep project, finance, production and admin records
• Agenda with one tap to add an entry to your phone calendar
• Encrypted backup (AES-GCM, your own password) to Files, and restore from the same file
• Your company records never leave your iPhone

TOOLS
• Calculator and unit converter

SUBSCRIPTION
New subscribers get a 3-day free trial. GSR Business Suite Premium is a single auto-renewing monthly subscription; the price is shown in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when the trial ends (or at confirmation if you are not eligible for the trial). The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Your records are never deleted when access ends.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.gsranalytix.com/en/privacy/

name: Guthaben-Checker NFC
description:
Prüfe das Guthaben deiner Mensa- bzw. Campuskarte in Sekunden – einfach die Karte an dein iPhone halten.

So funktioniert's: • „Karte scannen" tippen • Karte an die Oberseite des iPhones halten • Guthaben und letzte Buchung werden angezeigt

Funktionen: • Guthaben-Anzeige per NFC (für Karten mit MIFARE DESFire / InterCard-System) • Anzeige der letzten Buchung • Kartentyp und Kartennummer (UID) • Dezente Bestätigung mit Ton und Vibration • Keine Anmeldung, kein Konto, keine Datensammlung

Datenschutz: Die App liest ausschließlich lokal auf deinem iPhone. Es werden keine Daten gesammelt, gespeichert oder übertragen.

Hinweis: Dies ist eine INOFFIZIELLE App und steht in keiner Verbindung zu einem Studierendenwerk, einer Hochschule oder zu InterCard. Das Auslesen funktioniert nur bei Karten, deren Guthaben ohne Authentifizierung lesbar ist. Ob deine Karte unterstützt wird, siehst du sofort beim ersten Scan.

name: Gybstor
description:
Welcome! We look forward to providing you with a high-quality experience—we’re eager to hear your feedback.

Gybstor is a till, stock book and profit sheet for makers who sell at craft fairs, markets and pop-ups. Price what you make, ring up sales with one tap on the day, and see what each market really earned once the pitch fee, travel and materials are paid for.

RING IT UP ON MARKET DAY
Every product sits on a big tap grid. When something sells, tap it — choose cash or card — and the till bell rings, a price tag swings over to SOLD and the stock count drops by one. Made a mistake? Undo the last ring in a single tap. The grid works with no signal, so a field at the back of the showground is no problem.

KNOW YOUR NUMBERS
Each product keeps its materials cost, the minutes it takes to make, its price, a variant label (colour, size, scent) and how many you like to bring. Gybstor shows what every piece earns over materials and roughly what that comes to per hour of making.

EVERY MARKET, SUMMED UP
Add each fair or market with its date, pitch fee and travel. The market summary shows takings, materials used, costs and net profit, the cash and card split, your best sellers and their sell-through.

STOCK TO MAKE
The Stock page lists what has dropped below the number you like to bring, how many pieces to make and how much bench time that is before the next market. Tap "Made" when the new batch is ready and the shelf fills back up.

THE WHOLE SEASON
The Sales page keeps a running season total — takings, costs, net profit and average per market — plus an all-time best sellers table and a full ledger of every ring, where any sale can be voided and its item put back into stock.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with Apple or with email and password, or tap "Set up the stall first" to start as a guest straight away. A guest stall can later be saved to an account without losing a single sale. Your records sync to your private account and stay on the phone for use offline. Choose your currency: pound, euro, US, Canadian or Australian dollar.

PRIVATE AND YOURS
No adverts, no tracking, no analytics. Your records are visible only to you. You can delete your account and every product, market and sale at any time from the Cashbox page.

Made for potters, candle makers, knitters, printers, jewellers and everyone with a folding table and a float tin.

name: Hadif
description: Hadif is a family short-video app for Arabic-speaking Muslim families. Parents manage child profiles with PIN unlock, watch-time limits, and content filters. Clips are moderated before the public feed. Support: https://hadif.net

name: Halo: Gentle Habit Tracker
description:
Halo helps you keep track of your habits without the pressure. There is no streak counter and no red warnings. Missing a day resets nothing, and on a hard day doing a little still counts.

WHY HALO
• A little counts: every habit has a hard-day version. If a 20-minute walk doesn't happen, 5 minutes is fine.
• Tracking is completely free: add as many habits as you like. History, calendar, year view and reminders are free.
• One tap: tap the circle and you're done.

FEATURES
• Count it (8 glasses of water) or time it (25 minutes of focus)
• Live timer on the Lock Screen
• Flexible plans: certain days, a few times a week, or every few days
• Day off and vacation mode: nothing counts as missed when you're sick or away
• Reminders: tap "Done" right on the notification
• A short note for any day
• Week recap: take a minute on Sunday evening and make one decision
• Calendar, last 4 weeks and whole-year views
• Listen to your last 4 weeks: each day plays as a note
• Siri and Shortcuts
• iCloud backup: your data stays in your own iCloud, no account needed
• 12 languages

HALO PREMIUM
• Weekly tip: looks at your last 4 weeks and suggests one small step
• Smart suggestions: a smaller goal for a habit you struggle with, and the best reminder time
• What helps what: see which habit helps which
• Sharing: a video of your last 4 weeks, plus month and year recap cards
• More sounds: Kalimba, Marimba and Vibraphone

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your habits stay on your phone and in your own iCloud.

SUBSCRIPTION
Halo Premium is an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://halo-75cab.web.app/terms
Privacy: https://halo-75cab.web.app/privacy

name: Hamamböceği Lülülü
description:
Yerler cam kırığıyla dolu. Tek bir yanlış adım, tek bir çatırtı… ve o seni duyar.

Hamamböceği Lülülü, eski bir tımarhanede geçen bir korku ve kaçış oyunudur. Karanlık avlularda yere basmadan, yüksekte kalarak ilerle. Ses çıkarırsan deli böcek “lülülülü” diye koşarak gelir.

• Sessiz kal: yere basarsan duyar
• Zıpla: yüksekte kalarak yolunu bul
• Görevleri tamamla ve çıkışı aç
• Dikkat et: içeride yalnız değilsin

Kulaklıkla oynaman önerilir. Cesaretin varsa içeri gir.

name: Hana: Learn Japanese
description:
Hana teaches you Japanese from the very first letter to JLPT N1, on your iPad, at your pace.

It is a full course, not a deck of flashcards. Every lesson gives you one idea, shows it in real sentences, then has you try it. Every Japanese line is spoken aloud, and every sentence is broken into colour-coded parts so you can see how it is built.

WRITE IT
• Learn hiragana, katakana and 2,230 kanji with stroke order.
• Watch each stroke, trace it, copy it, then write it from memory, with your finger or Apple Pencil.
• Hana checks every stroke as you write.

LEARN IT
• More than 340 lessons from N5 to N1, plus a complete kana course.
• A grammar book with over 800 grammar points, each with examples.
• Polite, casual and business Japanese, so you learn how people really speak.
• 40 short stories, eight for each level: tap any word, listen, read along.

PLAY IT
• Fude Beat: write characters on the beat.
• Particle Pop: write the missing particle before the bells run out.

PRACTISE IT
• Timed practice tests in the style of each JLPT level.
• Talk with Hana and ask her questions. She thinks on your iPad, so nothing you say or write leaves it. (Needs an iPad with Apple Intelligence.)
• A notebook, printable practice sheets, a dictionary and a translator.

CALM BY DESIGN
• Short lessons, clear feedback, no streaks to lose and nothing nagging you.
• No account. No ads. No subscription.

FREE TO START
Kana and the first N5 lessons are free for as long as you like. One purchase unlocks everything else, for good.

Hana also includes a beginner Korean course with Hangul.

Hana is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the organisers of the JLPT.

name: Heatcanopy
description:
HeatCanopy is a pocket bench for urban heat. It takes one city block and answers in degrees: how much heat the surface stores, how the air and wind set the background, where the net radiation actually goes, how hot the walk is, and which cooling measures pay for themselves.

FIVE STAGES, ONE BLOCK

01 Surface Cover — impervious fraction, vegetation, water, albedo, building height, street width, sky view factor, wall area ratio, roof albedo, pavement type, soil moisture and irrigation. Returns urban heat island potential, storage index and a sealed-versus-green verdict.

02 Weather — air temperature, relative humidity, dew point, solar radiation, cloud cover, hour of day, wind speed and direction, roughness length and inversion state. Returns vapour pressure deficit, effective solar load and a mixing factor.

03 Energy Balance — net radiation, albedo, emissivity, surface and air temperature, Bowen ratio, storage fraction, plus anthropogenic, traffic and AC rejection heat. Splits the flux into sensible, latent and stored heat and reports the closure residual.

04 Temperature Field — transect length, measurement points, sensor height, park area and distance, canopy cover, building density, traffic flow, background air and dominant surface. Returns the island intensity along the route, the hot spot, the park cool island and the gradient in °C per km.

05 Mitigation — street trees per hectare, cool roof and green roof coverage, water features, shade cover, unit costs, treatment area, budget, target drop and maintenance load. Returns the cooling achieved, total cost, cost per degree and whether the budget binds before the target.

LIVE FEEDBACK, NOT A CALCULATOR

Every adjustment updates a 0–100 score, a verdict line, a schematic of the block, a chart of the governing quantity and a written recommendation with a benchmark to compare against. No "run" button, no waiting.

TAKE THE NUMBER WITH YOU

Export a one-page PDF field report — score, verdict, six metrics, the chart, the recommendation and the scope note — through the standard share sheet to Files, Mail or AirDrop.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD

Fully offline. No account, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics, no third-party SDKs. Nothing you type or adjust leaves the device.

SCOPE

HeatCanopy is a daytime steady-state screening tool. It is not a CFD solver, not a thermal comfort index and not a compliance or certification instrument. Use it to compare options on one block at one hour — confirm the survey hour, wind and albedo before publishing a cooling claim.

name: Hedgehog Hollows: Logic Puzzle
description:
Hedgehog Hollows is a calm daily logic puzzle for your phone. Solve one cozy woodland grid a day, learn a new trick with every hint, and play offline whenever you like.

THE RULE FITS IN ONE LINE
Wake one creature in every row, every column and every colored burrow. No two creatures may touch, not even at the corners. Every puzzle has exactly one answer and can be solved by pure logic. No guessing needed.

DAILY BURROW
A new puzzle every day, the same one for everyone in the world. Solve it, grow your streak, and share your result with a spoiler free grid. There are no ads in the Daily, ever.

THE ADVENTURE ROAD
An endless path of logic puzzles that grow from small 6 x 6 boards to 9 x 9. Meet a new creature at the end of every area. A harder board arrives every week for when you want a challenge.

HINTS THAT TEACH
Stuck? The hint first shows the area to look at, then explains the rule behind it, and only then points at the cell. Three gentle steps, so you learn the technique and get better at logic puzzles.

RACE A COMPUTER RIVAL
Want some friendly pressure? Race Sleepy Mole, Clever Fox or Wise Owl on the same puzzle. They are always clearly labeled as computer creatures, never fake players.

WAKE THE CREATURES
Every puzzle you solve wakes a woodland friend. Collect them all in your den.

MADE TO BE COMFORTABLE
- A short tutorial that teaches one rule at a time
- No timer pressure and free undo
- Light and dark mode
- Every burrow has a pattern as well as a color, so the grid works for color blind players
- Works fully offline, no account, no login
- Available in 53 languages

FAIR PRICING
Hedgehog Hollows is free to play. A light ad may appear in the Adventure Road after level 10, and never in the Daily. The optional Burrow Pass is a one time purchase that removes all ads and gives unlimited hints. No subscription, no coins, no lives.

If you enjoy sudoku, nonograms or other grid brain games, take a breath, pick a burrow, and wake the hedgehog.

name: Hemdert: Anonim Dertleşme
description:
Bazen sadece birinin dinlemesi yeter.

Hemdert, derdini kimseye kim olduğunu söylemeden yazabildiğin ve seni anlayan insanlarla dertleşebildiğin bir yer. Gerçek adın, telefon numaran, fotoğrafın istenmez. Bir takma ad ve kendi tasarladığın bir karakterle girersin.

DERDİNİ DÖK
İçinde tuttuğunu yaz. İstersen takma adınla, istersen tamamen gizli paylaş; gizli paylaşımda takma adın bile görünmez. Yazıp kimseye göstermek istemediklerin için Yaz ve Yak var: yazdığın cihazından çıkmaz.

DERTLEŞ
Derdine yorum yazanlardan biriyle birebir sohbet başlat ya da Dertleş kuyruğuna gir, konuşmak isteyen biriyle eşleş. Sana en çok iyi gelen yorumu "derman" olarak işaretle.

KİM HAKLI?
Gündelik hayattan vakalar: ev arkadaşı, iş, aile, ilişki. Oyunu kullan, çoğunluk ne demiş gör. Kendi vakanı da sorabilirsin.

GÜNÜN SORUSU VE KÜÇÜK SORULAR
Her gün yeni bir soru. Önce sen yanıtla, sonra başkalarının ne dediğini oku. Akışta tek dokunuşla yanıtlanan küçük sorular seni bekler.

GÜVENLİ BİR ORTAM
Küfür ve hakaret otomatik süzülür. Her içeriği şikâyet edebilir, istediğin kişiyi engelleyebilirsin. Kişisel bilgi paylaşımına izin verilmez. Zor bir an yaşıyorsan uygulama sana destek hatlarını gösterir.

GECE NÖBETİ
Uykunun kaçtığı saatlerde yalnız değilsin; gece yazanlar için ayrı bir köşe.

HEMDERT ARTI (isteğe bağlı)
Dert yazmak, okumak, yorum, sohbet ve Dertleş her zaman ücretsiz. Artı ile reklamsız kullanır, derdini öne çıkarır, haftada daha fazla gizli paylaşım yapar ve özel karakter parçalarına ulaşırsın. Abonelik otomatik yenilenir; istediğin zaman mağaza hesabından iptal edebilirsin.

Hemdert bir sağlık ya da terapi hizmeti değildir; acil durumda 112'yi ara.

18 yaş ve üzeri içindir.
Kullanım koşulları: https://hemdert.app/kosullar/
Gizlilik: https://hemdert.app/gizlilik/

name: Hirundo: Travel Stamps
description:
Meet Hirundo, a little barn swallow who stamps a passport book for every new country and city you reach.

STAMPS THAT HAPPEN ON THEIR OWN
Arrive somewhere new and Hirundo stamps it, even with the app closed. Capitals get a star, coastal cities a wave, mountain towns a peak. Come back and the stamp gains a date.

YOUR WHOLE TRAVEL STORY
Add the places you visited before with faded "remembered" stamps. Flip through your book country by country, see your world fill in on the map, and add a photo and a note to any stamp.

WORKS OFFLINE, STAYS PRIVATE
No account. No signal needed: every country and city is built in. Your book, photos and notes never leave your phone. Set a home area and Hirundo stays quiet near home.

SHARE THE BEST PARTS
Make a postcard of one stamp, a page of a country, or your year in stamps, and share it anywhere.

FREE TO START
Every country, 25 cities and 10 remembered trips are free. Keep Hirundo forever with one payment to stamp without limits. No subscription.

name: Hollow Halls
description:
You wake up in endless, empty halls. The lights hum. The carpet is damp. Somewhere in the dark is a door marked EXIT — and something is walking toward you.

It has no eyes. It hears you when you run, and it feels light pointed at it.

LISTEN
There is no music and nothing on screen to warn you. Only what you would really hear.
• Its footsteps start faint and far away, and grow louder as it comes closer.
• Through a wall they turn dull and muffled. With headphones you can tell left from right.
• Get close enough and you will hear it breathe.

MOVE QUIETLY
• Drag a little to sneak in silence.
• Push further to run. The harder you run, the louder your steps, and the farther they carry.
• Hold HIDE to switch your light off and stay perfectly still.

A DIM FLASHLIGHT
Your light starts dim. Turn it up to see farther, but a brighter light is easier for it to notice.

THREE PLACES, THEN DEEPER
• The Lobby: yellow wallpaper, damp carpet, wet footsteps.
• The Storeroom: bare concrete, and something being dragged.
• The Pipeworks: narrow pipes, metal gratings and steam that hides you.
• Endless: it keeps going down.
Every maze is new each time you play.

FIND A RECEIVER
Old radios lie around the halls. For a few seconds, one points toward the nearest one, and the static grows when you face it.

Built for one-handed play in portrait. Best with headphones.

REMOVE ADS + PERKS
One purchase removes the full-screen ads between levels, lets you Revive and use Sonar without watching an ad, and unlocks Camcorder Mode, a warm home-video look with a date stamp.

name: Horlama Dedektörü
description:
Horlama Dedektörü, telefonun mikrofonuyla geceyi dinler ve horlamayı yapay zekâyla tanır. Horlama algılandığında yumuşak bir pembe gürültü çalar: ses %1'den başlar, 20 saniyede %100'e yükselir. Horlama bittikten 30 saniye sonra, 10 saniyede kısılarak kapanır.

• Tek ekran, tek düğme: "Dinlemeyi Başlat"a bas, uyu. • Durumu bir bakışta gösteren halka: dinleme kapalı, dinleniyor, horlama algılandı ve pembe gürültü seviyesi. • Pembe gürültüyü açıp kapatabilir, hassasiyeti kendi odana göre ayarlayabilirsin. • Ekran kilitliyken de çalışır. • Gizlilik: ses yalnızca telefonunda işlenir. Hiçbir yere gönderilmez, kaydedilmez. Hesap ve reklam yoktur.

Tıbbi cihaz değildir; uyku apnesi gibi durumları teşhis edemez. Uyku sorunun varsa doktora başvur.

name: Hornable: French Horn
description:
Hold your phone, tilt it, and a French horn sounds. Hornable uses the sensors in your iPhone to recreate the feel of playing the horn.

■ Pick harmonics by tilting
Raise the far end of the phone for a higher harmonic and lower it for a lower one, much like finding a note with your lips. The phone vibrates as you approach the point where the note changes.

■ Three rotary levers
The three levers on screen use the same fingerings as a real horn.

■ Single and double horn
On the double horn, cover the rear camera with your thumb for the B-flat side and lift it for the F side, just like the thumb lever on a real instrument. The camera is used only to measure brightness; no image is saved or sent.

■ Concert and written pitch
See the note you are playing in both concert pitch and written pitch in F. Handy for checking fingerings, or for practicing where you cannot take out your instrument.

■ Real horn sound
Every note is a recording of a real horn.

No blowing needed. Enjoy the horn at home or on the go.

name: Huarong Gambit
description:
A small board. A legendary escape.

Huarong Gambit brings the officers of the Three Kingdoms to a Klotski sliding block puzzle. Slide blocks, open a path and guide your hero to the exit. Moving blocks uses rations, so make each move count.

SIX CHAPTERS, 47 STAGES
Follow Cao Cao, Zhao Yun, Guan Yu, Liu Bei and Huang Zhong through Huarong Pass, Changban, Red Cliffs, A Thousand Li Alone, Leap over the Tan Stream and Mount Dingjun. Mud, chains, spreading fire, gatekeepers, patrols and barricades bring new challenges.

A STRATAGEM FOR EVERY CRISIS
Use stratagems such as Straw Boats and Lure the Tiger. Ride horses with distinct abilities, wield treasures and call on advisors to overcome difficult positions.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION
Recruit officers with Merit and discover officers and illustrations in the Collection. Save rations and earn the Perfect rating.

FOUR LANGUAGES, OFFLINE PLAY
Choose English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese or Traditional Chinese. Play offline. No ads or account registration required.

TRY CHAPTER 1 FREE
The first 10 stages are free. A single purchase permanently unlocks all chapters. You can restore your purchase.

name: IELTS TOEFL Vocab: Lexiridge
description:
IELTS vocabulary and TOEFL vocabulary flashcards: learn 145 academic words with spaced repetition, four quiz types and a 3D word sky. Study for two minutes a day to build the academic English you need for reading, listening, writing and speaking. Works offline, no account.

LEARN
- Spaced-repetition flashcards with a card that flips in 3D, your own daily goal and a streak.
- Hear every word with your device's offline voices.
- 145 academic words in three "ridges", our own grouping for band 6, 7 and 8 targets (not an official list or score). Each word has a plain-English meaning, an example sentence, a common collocation and a synonym.
- Explanations and example translations in Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Hindi, Arabic and Simplified Chinese (machine-drafted and marked as such).

PRACTISE
- Quizzes in four styles: meaning, collocation, fill in the blank and synonym.
- Missed words come back for review automatically.
- A progress dashboard: last 7 days, mastery, quiz accuracy and best streak.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Your words become a real-time 3D constellation. Brighter stars are stronger memories, each colour is a topic, and lines join the words you know. Tap a star to see the word.

WORKS ANYWHERE
- No account, no sign-up, fully offline. iPhone and iPad layouts, A- and A+ text size on every screen.

FREE, WITH OPTIONS
Lexiridge is free with ads. Go ad-free with Lexiridge Premium (monthly, 7-day free trial) or a one-time Remove Ads purchase. Either one also lifts the daily limits on new words and quiz hints and keeps Ridge 8 open. IQ-Gym is a calm brain gym for your reasoning. Work through short sessions of puzzles and tests in the style of classic IQ assessments, learn the thinking behind each type, and watch your accuracy grow. No ads, no account, no internet needed.

SIX AREAS TO TRAIN
• Number Series: find the rule behind a run of numbers.
• Verbal Reasoning: analogies, odd one out and logic statements.
• Matrix Reasoning: complete a grid of figures by finding its rules.
• Spatial Reasoning: turn, flip, count and fold shapes in your head.
• Memory & Attention: sequence recall, Schulte table, Stroop and reverse recall.
• Processing Speed: size and code comparison, running arithmetic and dual n-back.
Every area has four levels, from easy warm-ups to expert puzzles with layered rules.

FIVE WAYS TO PLAY
• Levels: scored, timed sessions. Pick an area and a difficulty.
• Practice: the same puzzles without the clock. Each one starts with questions that show you how to think about it, and up to three hints, from gentle to specific.
• Targeted: five puzzles from the patterns you get wrong most, chosen from your own answers.
• Learn: 50 short lessons: the idea, a worked example and where it shows up in real life.
• Progress: your accuracy by area and level, and the patterns that need work.

A COACH THAT EXPLAINS, NOT JUST SCORES
Every answer comes with an explanation of the rule, and a wrong answer adds a tip for that kind of puzzle. Answers given with hints are kept out of your accuracy, so your progress stays honest.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• Endless generated number series, matrices and spatial puzzles, plus a hand-written verbal set.
• Dark and light themes, optional sound effects.
• Relaxed or untimed levels if you would rather think than race.
• Plays upright or sideways, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
• In English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Armenian, Japanese and Korean.
• Your progress stays on your device. Export it or reset it at any time.

IQ-Gym is for fun and self-training. It is not a clinical or medical tool, it is not an IQ test, and its scores are not an IQ measurement.

name: Lock & Break: Two-Thumb Darts
description:
[A 45-second thumb battle]
Lock & Break is a head-to-head game: move two cannons with both thumbs and shoot it out over five targets. Land 3 marks on a target to lock it. Every hit on a locked target scores. Whoever has more points when 45 seconds are up wins.

• Put a thumb in the control area at the bottom and the nearest cannon slides right above it. Cannons fire automatically
• Hit the red core for 3 marks, the green ring for 2, the outer ring for 1
• Hits charge your BREAK gauge. When it is full, push a cannon forward to fire a BREAK: pry open a target your opponent has locked and seize it for 3 seconds. Hit their cannon instead and both of their cannons stop for 3 seconds
• At 10, 20 and 30 seconds the board cards flip. Targets that match your hand score double or more
• The last 10 seconds are the Rush: fire rate x1.5. A comeback is always possible

[Pick your strategy]
• Go for high-scoring 20 and BULL, or for 17, which fills your BREAK gauge twice as fast?
• Use BREAK to steal their targets, or guard your own points?

• After each match, review the score swing and points over time in graphs
• Your skill is shown as a CPU level. Win streaks suggest the next level
• Choose between two characters: Coach Shime and the Rival

[New players welcome]

• Settings for volume (master, music, sound effects), vibration and reduced screen shake
• Available in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Korean

[Play with peace of mind]
• No account needed. Works offline
• Your records stay on this device only
• Free to download and play

name: Lovelock Diary with Lock
description:
Lovelock is a secret diary with something no other diary has: sealed pages. Write a letter to future you, seal it with wax and pick the day it opens. Until then nobody can read it, not even you.

SEALED PAGES: LETTERS TO FUTURE YOU
• Seal any page until a date: next month, next year, New Year's Day or any day you pick
• The page becomes an envelope with a wax seal and a countdown, and nothing of what you wrote shows anywhere

• For birthday letters, goals, a time capsule, or things you're not ready to read again yet

A DIARY ONLY YOU CAN OPEN
• 4-digit PIN with a heart padlock that opens when you unlock

PAGES THAT FEEL LIKE PAPER
• 12 papers: lined notebook, dotted, grid, gingham, hearts, sunset, mint, sky, kraft, old letter, night sky and plain cream

• Bold, italic and underline, plus 8 ink colours

MOOD CALENDAR
Pick how you feel when you write: amazing, happy, loved, calm, meh, tired, anxious, sad or angry. Your month fills up with mood faces, and you see your mood mix, pages, words and day streak at a glance.

WRITE EVERY DAY
• A new writing prompt every day
• Daily reminder at the time you choose
• Tags, pins and search across every page

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR IPHONE
No account, no server, no ads, no tracking. Your pages, photos and voice notes stay on your iPhone. Export as text, make a backup file and restore it on a new iPhone.

LOVELOCK PLUS
One payment, yours forever, no subscription: every paper and font, every sticker pack, secret pages and your diary as a PDF book. The Paper & font pack and the Sticker packs are also sold on their own.

Write your first letter to future you tonight

name: Maggie's Cookbook
description:
Every recipe you meant to make, in one beautiful cookbook.

Maggie's Cookbook turns the recipes you find into a cookbook you can cook from. Share a video or a link and it's written down for you: ingredients with amounts, the steps in order, and the timers inside them.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE
• Share from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, Facebook or any recipe website
• Scan up to four cookbook pages or recipe cards at once
• Import screenshots, or paste a recipe from Notes, a message or an email
• Or type your own, with a blank page that's quick to fill in
• Imports keep running in the background, so you can close the app and come back to a finished recipe

COOK FROM IT
• Every ingredient has its own hand-drawn watercolor illustration
• Scale any recipe up or down and the amounts follow
• Step timers ring like an alarm, even when your phone is on silent
• Nutrition per serving for most recipes, with a breakdown by ingredient
• Ask questions while you cook: swaps, what to make with what's left, how to get it ready ahead

KEEP IT ORGANIZED
• Search your cookbook by title or ingredient
• Sort recipes into your own collections and keep favorites
• Filter by meal, cuisine, diet, time and effort

PLAN AND SHOP
• Plan the week's meals on a calendar
• Add a recipe's ingredients to one shopping list in a tap, with repeats combined

DISCOVER
• Maggie's library is a growing shelf of recipes from home cooks and creators
• Fresh picks for the morning, midday and evening, shaped by what you save

FREE AND PRO
Recipes from websites with recipe cards and recipes you type are always free. Your first 5 imports from videos, scans, screenshots and pasted text are free, and so are your first 5 questions. name: MakaMaka Defense
description:
Goblins are marching down the road to your village gate. Five guardians stand with you: place them beside the path, upgrade them, and stop every wave before it reaches the wall.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Spend coins to place guardians on the spots beside the road. Tap a placed guardian to upgrade it, or sell it for 75% of the coins back and rebuild.
• Mix your line against each wave: the archer for fast goblins, the fire sage for crowds, the frost shaman to slow them, the thunder general for chain lightning, the tiger warrior to shove a whole line back.
• Tap trees and rocks: every guardian in range focuses on them, and they pay out coins when they break. Axe-marked trees open new placement spots.
• Three-star clears unlock a Hard version of each stage. Raise your guardians' grades to make Hard easier.
• Talismans for emergencies: Thunder strikes every goblin, Frost freezes them for 4 seconds, Gold doubles kill coins for 20 seconds.

CAMPAIGN
• Cross the lands of a Joseon-folklore world, meet each land's chief and learn their moves from the purple warning banner.
• Rebuild your village with lanterns and buildings, collect daily rewards, and take on Night Watch, an endless defense where you see how many waves you can hold.
• Seasonal festivals bring new skins and rewards.

The game is free to play with ads. Optional rewarded ads give extra rewards. In-app purchases: gold packs and a one-time no-ads bundle that removes ads for good and adds a starter bundle. Restore purchases is in the shop.

name: Mapamudo: Blank Maps & Quiz

Mapamudo is the tool for learning the maps that come up on exams: your country's map, the world, rivers, mountains, seas, the periodic table and the solar system.

YOUR COUNTRY FIRST

MY EXAM

name: Meow Escape: Cat Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Meow Escape: Cat Puzzle – a cute and colorful puzzle adventure where adorable cats need your help!

These playful cats are stuck in tricky arrangements, and only your clever moves can set them free. Look carefully, plan your strategy, and tap the cats in the right order to clear the board.

Easy to learn but challenging to master, Meow Escape brings you a delightful mix of relaxing gameplay and brain-teasing puzzles!

HOW TO PLAY

• Observe the cats and their escape directions.
• Tap the cats in the correct order.
• Avoid blocking their escape paths.
• Clear the board to complete each level.
• Use helpful hints when you get stuck.

GAME FEATURES

CUTE AND COLORFUL CATS

Meet adorable cats with bright colors, playful expressions, and charming animations. Enjoy a cheerful puzzle world full of lovable characters!

1,000+ FUN PUZZLE LEVELS

Explore over 1,000 levels with increasingly challenging layouts. Each puzzle offers a new opportunity to test your logic and problem-solving skills.

SIMPLE AND INTUITIVE CONTROLS

Just tap to play! Enjoy easy-to-understand controls while discovering clever ways to solve each puzzle.

CHALLENGING LOGIC PUZZLES

Think ahead and plan every move. Finding the right escape order is the key to completing tricky levels.

HELPFUL HINTS AND BOOSTERS

Stuck on a difficult puzzle? Use hints and the Freeze Time booster to help you overcome challenging situations.

DAILY REWARDS

Return to the game to collect daily rewards and continue your cat escape adventure.

CAT AVATARS AND ACHIEVEMENTS

Choose your favorite cat avatar, complete achievements, and track your progress as you play.

CHARMING CARTOON GRAPHICS

Enjoy colorful environments, adorable cat characters, smooth animations, and a playful visual style.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE MEOW ESCAPE

• Cute cats and charming animations
• Fun logic puzzles with simple controls
• Over 1,000 levels to explore
• Helpful hints and boosters
• Daily rewards and achievements
• Relaxing yet challenging gameplay

Whether you're a cat lover or a fan of clever puzzle games, Meow Escape: Cat Puzzle is a fun way to challenge your mind and enjoy an adorable adventure.

Can you find the perfect escape order and save every cat?

Download Meow Escape: Cat Puzzle and start your adventure today!

name: Merge Images: Overlay & Join

Merge Images puts photos together, right on your iPhone. Three modes cover the usual jobs:

• The result is saved at the full resolution of the base photo.

• Put photos in a row, a column or a grid collage.
• Crop to the smallest, shrink, enlarge or keep the original sizes.
• Spacing, rounded corners and any background color.

TEXT — captions and memes
• Write on the photo or on a colored band above, below or around it.

name: Milky Film: Wedding Photo Edit

Self-wedding shoots, engagement photos, date-day snaps.
Pick, tap, save.

Milky Film is a photo filter app made for wedding photos. Every look is tuned so skin stays clear and bright, grass and trees stay calm, and a white dress never turns into a blown-out patch.

• Pick up to 30 photos at once from your library
• Tap a look and set its strength from 0 to 100

name: Mochi: Intermittent Fasting
description:
※ This app is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any disease. It does not provide medical advice. Consult a healthcare professional before starting.

While you fast, Mochi the cat lives through it with you.
Mochi Fasting is an intermittent fasting timer you start with one tap, and it tells you when your fast is over. Mochi lives in the middle of the timer: full and lazing around, getting sleepy, fast asleep, then waking up at your goal time to say "Time to eat!". One look at Mochi tells you where you are in your fast.
No sign-up. No subscription.


■ IF YOU CAME HERE WONDERING

"I ate at 8pm. On 16:8, when can I eat again?"
-> Tap start and the end time appears on screen. No counting hours in your head.

"I keep losing track of how long it's been"
-> The time left shows in large digits, and you can also see it on a home screen widget and on your lock screen.

"Can I have this while fasting?"
-> Search 39 common questions like coffee, diet soda or supplements, and Mochi answers with yes, careful or no. The only rule is whether it has calories or sugar.


■ 1) INTERMITTENT FASTING TIMER

· Presets 12:12 · 14:10 · 16:8 · 18:6 · 20:4 · OMAD, plus custom hours
· A ring gauge and big numbers for time left and time elapsed
· Time keeps running even if you close the app


■ 2) A FASTING SCHEDULE BUILT AROUND YOUR MEALS

· Enter your usual meal times (weekdays and weekends) and get a gentle schedule
· Choose "Follow this schedule" and fasts start and finish on their own at the planned times. Forget to tap? It's still recorded
· Shift the suggested times 30 minutes earlier or later


■ 3) MOCHI THE CAT

· On day one Mochi is a baby that just hatched. Finish one fast and it grows into Mochi the cat
· Finishing fasts earns EXP and coins; feeding Mochi or drinking water during your eating window earns coins too, for treats and Mochi's things
· Stay away too long and Mochi gets a little sulky, but you never lose anything. A pat or a meal fixes it
· No punishments. Stopping early or breaking a streak costs nothing. Your weight is never scored
· Not into games? Turn it off in Settings and just use the timer


■ 4) IPHONE WIDGETS · LOCK SCREEN · MAC

· iPhone: home screen widgets count down the time left, and you can pat Mochi on the widget
· While fasting, the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island show Mochi and your progress (can be turned off)
· Mac: Mochi walks along your desktop, the menu bar shows the time left, and fasts sync with your iPhone through iCloud


■ 5) START SAFELY

· Start slowly at 12:12. Methods not recommended for beginners (20:4, OMAD) are clearly marked
· A health check comes first: pregnancy or breastfeeding, diabetes medication, eating disorders, underweight and more (your answers are not stored)
· Check warning signs like severe dizziness or a racing heart at any time, and stop right away


■ 6) FASTING LOG & STATS

· Completed and stopped fasts are saved to a calendar automatically
· Weekly and monthly completions, average fasting time, streaks
· Log water and weight (optional) in the same place


■ WHAT THIS APP DOESN'T DO

· It never tells you how much weight you'll lose
· It doesn't sell diet plans or supplements
· It doesn't nag you. Even when Mochi sulks, no notification calls you back
· It never asks you to sign up to see your records


■ PRICING

· Every feature is free. iPhone shows a banner ad at the bottom; Mac has no ads
· Collect Mochi's 194 things (coats, hats, toys, room furniture, moves) one by one with coins you earn in the app
· In a hurry? Buy rubies to get items right away (a one-time purchase, no subscription)
· Remove ads with a one-time purchase
· Tap to try each item on Mochi before you get it


■ PRIVACY

We run no server. Records are stored on your device and in your own iCloud, so they follow you across your iPhone and Mac. Health check answers are never stored. No account, no login.

Turn the Digital Crown and pour a just-right soda or fruit drink for your monster companions.

Monster Sip puts a tap, a cup and expressive monsters on Apple Watch. Turn the Crown to adjust the flow, release it to keep pouring, turn back to slow down and close the tap completely to serve.

FIVE DISTINCT CUPS

FIVE EXPRESSIVE COMPANIONS

name: Moonmark: AI Boyfriend Story
description:
Moonmark is a romance story game. Pick a love interest, play his story chapter by chapter, and shape it with your choices. Between chapters, text him: he knows what happened in the story, and he remembers what you tell him.

THREE ORIGINAL STORIES
• Kael: an exiled dragon-rider prince. Your orders: bring him in. A slow-burn, enemies-to-lovers fantasy over the mountains.

REAL CHAPTERS, REAL CHOICES
Each story is a 10-chapter arc, written and edited by our team, about five minutes per chapter. Your choices change how he sees you, and the story remembers them. Chapters 1 to 5 are out now, with new chapters every week.

TEXT HIM BETWEEN CHAPTERS
Chat with your character any time. He stays in character, knows where you are in the story, and nudges you toward the next chapter. Open "Remembers" to see, edit or delete what he knows about you.

HE TEXTS YOU FIRST (OPTIONAL)
Turn it on and he'll occasionally send a short message: at most once a day, daytime only. Turn it off any time in Settings.

FAIR, HONEST PRICING
• Chapter 1 of every story and 15 messages are free.
• Moonmark Premium (weekly, or yearly with a 3-day free trial) unlocks every chapter and lets you chat freely (up to 150 messages a day), plus 300 gems every month.

MADE FOR ADULTS, KEPT SAFE
Moonmark is for adults 18+ and stays SFW: romance up to a kiss. Characters are AI. You'll see a reminder when a chat starts and every few hours. name: Mulsari: Aquarium Fish Care
description:
Mulsari is a small aquarium that lives in your phone.

FISH THAT ACT LIKE FISH
Neon tetras school. Corydoras sift the sand and dart up for a breath of air. Clownfish settle into their anemone, and royal grammas swim upside down under the rock ledges. At night the lights go down and the fish sleep, while corals glow softly under the blue lamp.

A TANK THAT WORKS LIKE A TANK
A new tank takes three to four weeks to cycle, so add fish a few at a time. Overfeed and the water clouds; algae grows on the glass. Keep male and female guppies together, and about a month later there will be fry.

MADE TO BE LEFT ON
The screen stays on while charging. Turn the phone sideways for the wide view. Spend a 25- or 50-minute focus session with your fish, to the sound of water, bubbles and a very quiet score that softens at night.

MOMENTS WORTH KEEPING
First sightings go into your log, and at 100 days together a card arrives. Take photos of your tank to save and share.

No ads. No subscription. One tank and three species are free to enjoy for as long as you like; the Freshwater and Reef packs bring more friends home.

name: MX Suspension
description:
MX Suspension stores your riders' suspension settings – for every track, every fork and every shock absorber. In the pits you instantly know which setup worked in sand, mud or on hardpack.

SUSPENSION SETUPS
• Fork: air pressure or preload, fork height, low- and high-speed compression, rebound
• Shock: low- and high-speed compression and rebound, static and race sag
• Every setting belongs to a track; the track filter shows only what fits the current one
• Favorites: the best setup per rider and track always on top
• Add forks and shocks once and reuse them for any number of settings

MAINTENANCE
• Maintenance plans with tasks like oil service or seal checks, each with an interval in riding hours
• Usage time per fork and shock – just add hours after a training
• Due state at a glance: green, orange or red, right in the rider list
• Maintenance log for every task done
• Get started with an example template you can change freely

NFC TAGS ON FORKS AND SHOCKS
• Stick a tag on the component and write it once – done
• Hold your iPhone near the tag and the app opens the settings of exactly that component, even when it is closed

RIDERS, TEAMS AND NOTES
• Rider profile with race number, team, country, weight, height and level
• Notes with photos and voice memos, e.g. right after a moto
• Tasks for riders, tracks and components
• Teams with their own logo

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Sync through your private iCloud on iPhone, iPad and Mac
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Export all data as JSON files, including photos and voice memos

FREE AND PRO
Free: one rider, one team, all suspension setups, tracks and text notes.
MX Suspension Pro: unlimited riders and teams, photos and voice memos, tasks, NFC tags, maintenance plans with log, and data export.

name: MyEchoFaith: Bible Companion
description:
MyEchoFaith is a calm, beautiful home for your time in the Word — a Bible reader, an AI Scripture companion, a daily devotional, and a private prayer journal in one place.

READ THE BIBLE
Read three trusted translations — the World English Bible (WEB), King James Version (KJV), and American Standard Version (ASV) — with fast chapter navigation, bookmarks, and reading history. Tap any verse to save it.

ASK, AND GET CITED ANSWERS
Have a question about a passage, a theme, or how faith speaks to your life? The AI Bible Companion answers in plain language and grounds every response in Scripture, with verified citations you can tap through to read in full. Quotations stay separate from interpretation, and the companion is careful to present mainstream Christian understanding and note where faithful traditions differ.

A DAILY VERSE TO CENTER YOU

PRAY AND JOURNAL
Keep a private prayer list — mark prayers answered — and a spiritual journal to reflect freely. Everything syncs securely across web, iPhone, and iPad.

Your prayers, journal, and conversations are yours. We never sell your data.

FREE TO START
- Read all three translations, daily verse, bookmarks, and prayer & journaling

MYECHOFAITH PLUS
Go deeper with Plus:

name: Night Signal: Train Puzzles
description:
Take charge of a railway after dark. Tap a switch to change a route, then choose when each train leaves. Use the timetable to see where every train will go and when it will cross. When your plan is ready, send the trains out and watch it play out.

Play 12 puzzles free. A one-time Full Game purchase adds 100 puzzles across five chapters. Manage three trains, take detours, and hold trains at signals between crossings. Revisit any unlocked level.

No ads, accounts, or subscriptions.

name: No More Scroll
description:
Most of us don’t open these apps on purpose. You pick up your phone for one thing and somehow end up scrolling for half an hour.

No More Scroll won’t lock you out of anything. It just gives you a second to think before you open an app you said you wanted to use less. Take a breath, then decide. Sometimes you’ll still open it, and that’s fine. A lot of the time you won’t.

If you do end up scrolling, it’ll check in after a while and ask if you’re actually enjoying it. Over 90 days your daily limit goes down a little at a time, so you’re not trying to quit everything overnight.

You can also see which apps you skip, why you usually reach for your phone, and how your days are going. Miss a day and nothing resets. You just keep going.

There’s no account to make, no ads, and nothing gets sent anywhere. Your data stays on your phone, and your Screen Time info is only visible to you.

It’s free.

name: Noks – Family Budget
description:
Noks is the budget for the whole family. Import a bank statement and Noks sorts every expense on its own: groceries, bills, eating out, fuel, loans, subscriptions. No spreadsheets, no retyping – and your finances stay on your phone.

NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
You pay once in the App Store and Noks is yours. We don’t show ads, don’t sell data and don’t track you across apps.

THE WHOLE FAMILY’S MONEY IN ONE PLACE
• Every family member’s accounts and every company, at every bank, on one screen
• Balance, spent this month and how much you can spend per day until payday
• Search everything from Home: shops, groups, amounts, notes, subscriptions

STATEMENTS ARRIVE ON THEIR OWN
• Your own Noks address (your-name@noks.money): put it into online banking and statements arrive and import automatically
• Mail to your Noks address is locked with a key that exists only on your phone and deleted after import
• PDF and XML statements, plus Excel or CSV exports from any bank
• Or connect your own email with an app password, or share a file from Mail

SORTED AUTOMATICALLY
• Every item gets a group, a family member and personal or business
• Assign anything new once – Noks remembers it for future statements
• Each statement is checked against its closing balance

STATISTICS AND PLANNING
• Where the money goes: by group, month and family member
• Home and business finally separate
• Budgets per group with alerts at 80% and 100%
• Subscriptions found in your statements, reminders 7 and 3 days before each charge
• Payment calendar for 60 days and what’s left after payments
• Alerts for double charges, price rises and unusually large expenses
• Savings goals, ideas for saving, loan interest and early repayment

RECEIPTS AND WARRANTIES
• The camera reads the receipt; keep it as an expense or a warranty
• Reminder 30 days before a warranty expires; share as PDF

THE WHOLE FAMILY, EACH ON THEIR OWN PHONE
• Invite your household via iCloud: everyone imports their own statements, everyone sees the family’s money

5 LANGUAGES
English, Español, Français, Deutsch and Srpski. Currency follows your country: euro, dollar or dinar.

PRIVACY FIRST
• Statements, transactions and amounts are stored and processed only on your phone, encrypted
• Sign in with Apple or Google, lock with Face ID or a PIN
• Export to Excel (CSV) and PDF whenever you like; delete everything with one tap

Made by GoSimple.

name: Number Out: Jam Puzzle
description:
Every block has an arrow. Every number is a number of steps. Can you clear the board?

Number Out is a relaxing brain puzzle you can play in short sessions, with no ads and no timer pressure.

HOW TO PLAY

IQD and USD side by side, at the official and the market rate. In Arabic, Kurdish (Sorani) and English, fully right-to-left.

name: Our Puppy: 3D Dog Care Game
description:
Adopt a puppy, give it a name and look after it every day. Our Puppy is a calm 3D game for children aged 5 to 10 and their parents – no ads, no chat, and playable without an internet connection.

name: Party Roll
description:
Party Roll turns every guest's phone into a disposable camera for your event, and gathers every photo into one shared roll.

START A PARTY
Name your event, answer a few quick questions and Party Roll makes a QR code. Share it as an image or PDF, AirPrint an invitation, a poster or table cards, or send the link. Guests scan, type their name and start shooting. No accounts, no sign-up.

One big shutter button, with the power there when you want it: film looks, portrait mode, a self-timer, flash, front and back cameras, and on-device enhancement that fixes red-eye and balances tone before a photo is shared. Every photo is also saved to your own camera roll.

Choose how many shots each guest gets, whether guests see each other's photos, whether names are shown, an approval queue, a passcode, a guest limit, late uploads and how long the roll is kept. Change any answer during the event.

EVENT PACKS

SEE EVERY PHOTO
When the roll is ready, browse every guest's photos in a full-screen viewer or slideshow, by guest or just your own, and like your favourites.

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
Designed for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with a camera on one side and the live roll on the other when unfolded.

SAFE AND PRIVATE
No ads and no tracking. Photos are stored privately and deleted automatically 7, 14 or 30 days after the event. Anyone can report a photo or hide a guest, and organisers can remove any photo or guest.

FREE AND UNLIMITED
Joining a party, taking photos, uploading and viewing the roll are free. Party Roll Unlimited is a one-time purchase that lets you host as many parties as you like and save every guest's full-resolution photos, one at a time or the whole roll in one tap. It works with Family Sharing. No subscription.

Made in Australia by Code 1 Studios.

name: Paulo
description:
生活不在屏幕里。

它在一顿不看手机的晚饭里，在散步时忽然注意到的晚霞里，在朋友说话时你抬起头的那一眼里。我们并不是不知道这些，只是手指一滑，一个小时就过去了。

Paulo 不想教你自律，也不会责备你。它只做一件小事：在你刷够的时候轻轻拦一下，然后陪你把手机放下，回到眼前的生活里去。

【刷够了，就停一下】
选好容易让你停不下来的 App、类别或网站，设定每一轮能用多久（5–60 分钟，默认 15 分钟）。Paulo 通过 Apple 的「屏幕使用时间」累计所选内容的实际使用时长，用满了就显示系统遮罩。每轮额度不等于全天总额度；你可以随时在 Paulo 中关闭守护。

【想继续，先呼吸】
真的还想再用一会儿？先跟着做一次呼吸，再决定是否继续。当天续用次数增加时，呼吸缓冲和续用额度也会调整。选择「算了」，会记下一次放弃续用，小树旁开出一朵小花。

【你去生活，小树在长】
到点后选择休息，满 10 分钟可获得一根新枝；当天续用达到 3 次后，小树不再长新枝，休息时长仍计入树高。单次休息最多记录 2 小时。

从种子、幼苗到大树，每个月一棵新树，记下你在 Paulo 留下的选择。休息记录从你选择休息时开始计时，不代表这段时间手机完全未使用。

【一点点现实里才有的惊喜】
休息得久一些，松鼠、兔子、刺猬可能会来树下做客，猫头鹰只在夜里出现。春天的樱花、夏天的梧桐、秋天的枫树、冬天的雪松，各有当季才能遇见的样子。

【回头看，都是好好过的日子】
「我的森林」留住有记录月份的小树，「图鉴」展示树种、变种和访客的收集情况。未收集的格子会提示特点和遇见条件，随着实际记录逐步解锁。

【从了解自己开始】
「我的使用计划」查看系统提供的过去 7 个完整日、所选内容的使用报告。至少有 3 天有效数据且存在使用时长时，才给出每轮时长参考。数据不足时也可以自行选择计划；采用哪一档，由你确认。

「本周回顾」汇总最近 7 天在 Paulo 内的休息、放弃续用和再次续用记录，帮助你决定下一步。回顾不会自动修改规则。

【抬眼，就能看见小树】

支持小号和中号主屏幕小组件，查看本月小树与守护状态。完成呼吸并确认续用后，可通过锁屏实时活动和灵动岛查看本轮进度；到点、开始休息或关闭守护后，活动随之结束。显示与更新由系统管理。

【安静，而且尊重你】
· 无需注册 Paulo 账号；没有广告，也不进行广告跟踪
· 守护规则、使用计时与成长记录保存在本机，历史使用报告由系统扩展在本机处理
· 排行榜默认不加入；主动加入后，通过 iCloud 上传随机昵称、月份、树木统计与外观信息，不上传你选择的 App、网站或其使用明细
· 排行榜需要设备登录 iCloud；退出成功后删除本设备上传的榜单记录
· 通知为可选，用于休息完成和每周回顾提醒；关闭每周提醒不影响守护

我们希望你打开 Paulo 的时间越来越少，因为你正忙着过自己的生活。

把手机放下吧。外面天气不错，有人在等你。

——
Paulo 使用 Apple 的「屏幕使用时间」能力，需要你授权后才能工作。使用建议仅供参考，不构成健康或医疗建议。

name: PGPP® Membros
PhantomSniper: Elite Marksman
description:
One shot. One mission. No second chances.

PhantomSniper is a first-person precision shooting game from a fixed position. From the rooftops, the harbor cranes and the towers of the base, you watch, identify the right target and wait for the perfect moment. Cinematic scenery, radio calls from Command with voice and a slow-motion camera that follows the bullet to the target.

20 MISSIONS IN 3 AREAS
• City: rooftops at dawn, a market, a station in the rain, offices at night, an avenue with an armored convoy
• Harbor: cranes in the fog, containers, a warehouse, a windy breakwater, a boarding pier
• Base: the perimeter at night, a radio tower in a dust storm, a hangar, the airstrip, barracks and the command center
• Every mission has its own mechanic and its own 3-star challenge

MECHANICS THAT CHANGE EVERY MISSION
• Moving targets, a getaway vehicle and a boss trying to escape through three exits
• Protect an allied agent until extraction
• Hostage rescue against the clock
• Crosswind with reticle compensation and a rangefinder
• Thermal vision, glass that shatters on the first shot, a dog sniffing the yard
• Hidden marksmen hunting you: only the glint of a lens gives them away
• Civilians in the scene: pick the right target

REAL PRECISION
• Drag to aim across the whole scene and open the scope with real zoom
• Hold your breath to steady your aim
• Reloads, limited ammo and cover that stops the bullet
• Headshots are worth more; missed shots count against your stars

BULLET CAM
• The final shot becomes a movie moment: the camera chases the bullet to the impact
• Save a photo of your best shot and share it

5 RIFLES

• SR-9, a bigger caliber: more range, more kick and a report of its own
• VS-4 suppressed, for silent missions
• M-50, punches through glass and car bodies
• TX-7, with a thermal scope

DAILY CHALLENGE
• One mission a day with a special modifier: wind, night, fog or half the time
• Works offline

MADE FOR MOBILE
• Studio-recorded sounds, vibration when you fire and when you are hit
• Guided first mission, step by step
• Progress saved on your device, no account and no internet needed

Stylized violence, no blood. Free with ads, which never appear during a mission: only between missions and on the results screen. Rewarded videos are always optional: Help (one more shield and more time after a failed attempt) and unlocking new missions from mission 16 on. The one-time "Remove ads" purchase removes the ads between missions and the banner and unlocks those missions without videos. Your progress stays on your phone.

30+ FANCY TEXT STYLES

STICKERS AND DOODLES

THEMES AND KEY SOUNDS
• 22 themes, including patterned designs

MORE WAYS TO TYPE

Type Bangla the way you already type it. Phonetic input turns "amar nam" into আমার নাম as you go. Switch between Bangla and English without switching keyboards, and let the AI work in either language.

A REAL KEYBOARD FIRST

Pro Type is a complete keyboard before it is anything else: a familiar iPhone-style layout, light and dark themes, word suggestions, emoji with search, and clipboard history. The AI sits on the suggestion bar and stays out of the way until you want it.

A keyboard with Full Access can technically see what you type. This one does not keep any of it.

• Nothing is sent anywhere while you are simply typing.
• Text leaves your phone only when you tap an AI action yourself.

• No advertising, no tracking, no analytics SDK.

Full Access is needed for the AI actions, because they reach our server. Without it, Pro Type still works as a normal keyboard.

PLANS

PERSONALISATION, FOR PAID PLANS

Write your own guideline in your own words. "Always be polite." "Use more technical words." "Sound more confident." Everything the keyboard writes for you follows it.

WHO IT IS FOR

Students writing assignments and emails to teachers. Freelancers replying to clients in a second language. Anyone who writes all day in Bangla and English and wants the result to read well the first time.

Made in Bangladesh by Ahmed Apps.

name: Rapporteur: Quick Issues
description:
Rapporteur does one thing: it gets an issue into GitHub before you forget it. The keyboard is ready when the app opens. Type a title, tap Send, and the screen clears for the next issue.

QUICK
• The title field has the focus at launch. There is nothing to tap first.
• Add a description if you want one.
• Tap label chips to add labels. The chips have the colours of your labels on GitHub.
• After Send, the screen is empty again and ready for the next issue.

YOUR REPOSITORIES
• Choose your favourite repositories, public or private.
• Swipe left or right to change the repository.

WORKS OFFLINE

FOUR WAYS TO REACT

name: Redbeat: Heart Rate Camera
description:
Rest your fingertip on the camera and flash. In 30 seconds Redbeat shows your pulse in beats per minute, and only when the signal is steady.

Most pulse apps show a number no matter what. Redbeat does not. It checks that every heartbeat has the same shape, splits the 30 seconds into 10 second parts, and shows a result only when at least two parts agree. If your finger lifts or your hand moves, the clock pauses. If it cannot find a steady pulse, it says so and asks you to try again.

What you get, free:
- Unlimited measurements, no ads, no account
- Tag each reading: resting, just woke up, after exercise, after coffee, stressed
- Your week at a glance: average pulse and the change from last week, by context
- 14 days of history and a 7 day chart
- Optional morning reminder
- Save readings to Apple Health (write only, Redbeat never reads your Health data)

Redbeat Pro (one-time purchase, no subscription):
- Full history without the 14 day limit
- 30 and 90 day trends by context
- PDF report to share with your doctor
- CSV export

How accurate is it? Redbeat was tested on 3,888 finger recordings from the public BUT PPG dataset with a reference heart monitor. When it showed a number on a good recording, 98 out of 100 were within 5 BPM. The full details are in the Accuracy screen in the app. Your iPhone and fingertip are different from the dataset, so your results can differ.

Everything stays on your iPhone. Video is analysed on the phone and is never saved or sent anywhere.

Not a medical device. For wellness only. Redbeat does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Talk to a doctor about any health concern.

name: Rey del Ring: Luchador Climb
description:
Aim. Launch. Climb to the top of the ring!

Rey del Ring is a lucha libre platform game. You are El Relámpago, a young luchador on the road to the championship. Drag anywhere on the screen to aim, let go to launch, and land on the platforms above you. Reach the top of each mission and become the King of the Ring.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag to aim and set your power, then let go to jump.
• Land in the middle of a platform for a perfect landing and extra coins.
• A fall costs one chance and sends you back to the last checkpoint.
• Complete each mission's objectives to earn up to 3 crowns.

100 MISSIONS IN 10 CHAPTERS
From the neighborhood market to the Grand Arena, through the fair, the summit, the coast and the jungle. Then the Rematch Tour takes you across the rooftops, the canals of Xochimilco, the pyramids and the graveyard. Every chapter brings something new: moving, vanishing and crumbling platforms, conveyor belts, cannons, ice, traps, geysers, gusts of wind, ring ropes and rivals who try to knock you down.

6 BOSSES AND 4 REMATCHES
Face El Coloso, La Reina Catrina, El Rey del Ring, La Chispa, El Jaguar and La Leyenda. Dodge their attacks and land on them from above to win. Then beat four of them again in rematches, faster and tougher.

21 MASKS
Spend the coins you earn on new masks in the shop, and unlock special masks by beating bosses. Masks only change your look, never the game.

GAME CENTER
14 achievements and 2 leaderboards: crowns and missions won.

FOR EVERYONE
In 44 languages. Works offline, no account needed. VoiceOver labels, haptics and adjustable sound.

FREE TO PLAY
The game is free. When you lose your last chance, you can choose to watch a short ad for one more chance. An occasional ad may appear when you leave a won mission, never during play and never in your first missions. The Champion Pass, a single purchase with no subscription, removes those ads, opens every mission and includes the Champion Mask.

name: Ri School
description:
Ri School – Kết nối phụ huynh và nhà trường

Ri School là ứng dụng dành cho phụ huynh có con đang học tại các trường mầm non, tiểu học, THCS, THPT và trung tâm đào tạo dùng hệ thống quản lý Ri School. Mọi thông tin về việc học và sinh hoạt của con được cập nhật trực tiếp từ nhà trường, ngay trên điện thoại của bạn.
