Thực đơn: xem bữa ăn trong ngày nhà trường chuẩn bị cho con.
Học phí: xem các khoản phí, số tiền cần đóng và trạng thái thanh toán.
Sức khỏe: theo dõi chiều cao, cân nặng và thông tin sức khỏe của con.
Đón trẻ: đăng ký và quản lý người đưa đón.
Hoạt động và sự kiện: cập nhật các hoạt động, sự kiện, ngày lễ của trường.
Nhận xét và báo cáo: xem đánh giá, nhận xét học tập từ giáo viên.
Thông báo tức thì: nhận thông báo đẩy khi nhà trường gửi tin mới.
Nhiều con, nhiều trường: quản lý nhiều bé đang học ở các trường khác nhau trong cùng một tài khoản.

name: RoadCub: Driving Log
description:

• Time a drive, pause when needed, or add a past session.
• Track total hours, night driving and weather conditions.
• See progress toward Michigan or Pennsylvania practice goals.

name: Ronali servisas
description:

• open directions to the client, a supplier or a parcel locker
• see free jobs nearby and ask the office to assign them

The app interface is in Lithuanian.

name: Room Battle
description:
Room Battle turns the room you are in into a battlefield.

Scan the room with your iPhone, put a toy-sized tank or helicopter on the floor and take control. Real furniture is real cover: tanks disappear behind the sofa, and shells bounce off your actual walls.

BEST ON iPHONE PRO AND iPAD PRO
The Pro models have a LiDAR scanner (iPhone 12 Pro and later, iPad Pro from 2020), and that is where Room Battle is at its best. The whole room is scanned in 3D: tanks hide behind anything — a chair leg, a backpack, a pile of books — and shells hit exactly what you see. On other iPhones and iPads the game still works, using the walls and tables it detects.

SOLO PRACTICE — FREE
Hunt a bot around your room for as long as you like. You cannot be destroyed; the bot blows up after five hits and a new one rolls in.

TWO-PLAYER BATTLES
Two iPhones, one room, one shared battlefield. Both of you see the same machines in the same places. Three hits win the round. Only the player who creates the battle needs the one-time purchase — a friend joins for free.

TANKS AND HELICOPTERS
Drive a T-34-85, Tiger I, M4 Sherman or M1 Abrams — or take off in a helicopter and attack from above, while the tanks answer with machine-gun fire.

13 LANGUAGES
English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) and Thai. Switch at any time in the menu.

Solo practice shows an occasional ad between rounds. The Two-Player Battles purchase removes ads.

Both players need to be in the same room, on the same Wi-Fi or with Bluetooth on. Nothing is sent to a server.

Roomery designs the room you actually have. Start with a photo, a floor plan or a scan, say how far to change it, and get a design that fits: materials, colours, lighting and layout, with a photorealistic picture of the result.

DESIGN THE ROOM YOU HAVE
• Start from a room photo, an image or PDF floor plan, or a scan on iPhone and iPad models with LiDAR

• Redesign the whole room, or just one corner, alcove or wall

FURNISHED WITH PIECES THAT EXIST

MEASURE, PLAN AND WALK THROUGH

• Walk inside the room, paint the walls, change the floor and move furniture
• Plan a whole home, floor by floor

FREE TO START
Measuring, plans, scans and arranging furniture work on your device without an account. A free account adds your first design with its picture and a private library that syncs across your devices.

ROOMERY PRO
Roomery Pro adds up to 35 room designs and 100 new pictures or picture edits a week, whole-home plans, PDF and CSV exports, and store pickup and delivery checks. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings.

Designs and pictures are made with Google Gemini. Roomery asks before sending anything, and never sends your name or email address.

• Screenshots grouped by month, with Select All

name: Schstk
description:
Thank you for choosing us; your feedback helps us become even better.

That afternoon latte may still be with you at midnight. Schstk shows how much caffeine is active in your body right now, how much will be left when you go to bed, and the latest moment another cup still lets you sleep.

A LIVE CAFFEINE DIAL
Today opens on a big dial with the milligrams in your system at this minute, plus tiles for what you have poured today, the amount expected at bedtime and the time you will be sleep-ready. Tap any pour in the list to fix its size, strength or time, or delete it.

POUR IT, DONE
The Bar menu covers espresso, doppio, filter coffee, latte, cold brew, black and green tea, matcha, yerba mate, cola and energy drinks. Choose half a serving up to two, slide the time back if you drank it earlier, and tap Pour. A short summary tells you where you stand for tonight.

THE CURVE OF YOUR DAY
Curve draws your caffeine level from morning past bedtime, rising as each cup is absorbed and easing off with your chosen half-life. It shows gold while you are above your sleep line and teal once you are under it, with your peak, the bedtime amount and when you will be clear.

PLAN YOUR LAST CUP
Plan a cut-off lists every drink with the latest time it still fits before bed, taking into account everything you have already had. Pick the number of servings and see whether that evening espresso is fine, already too late or best skipped tonight.

YOUR OWN ORDERS
Save the drinks you actually buy as presets, with your own milligrams, millilitres and cup shape. Not sure where to begin? Add the starter examples with a single tap.

THE WEEK IN NUMBERS
Ledger puts each day's total next to your daily limit, compares this week's average with last week's, counts days over the limit and shows your most-poured drinks. Step back through earlier weeks any time.

SET IT UP YOUR WAY
Adjust the half-life (5 hours by default), bedtime, sleep line and daily limit in Barista. Pick the Roast, Matcha or Midnight Cola look, and switch sounds or haptics on or off.

SIGN IN HOW YOU LIKE
Create an account with email and password, use Sign in with Apple, or tap "Sip as guest" to begin right away. Guests can move everything to an email or Apple ID later via Barista > Save my data. Works offline and syncs when you reconnect.

PRIVATE FROM THE FIRST SIP
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Only your account can read your entries, and Barista > Delete account removes every pour, preset and setting along with the account.

PLEASE NOTE
Estimates come from a simple half-life model and typical published caffeine values. Everyone metabolises caffeine differently, so treat the numbers as general guidance, not medical advice.

name: Scientific Calculator 84 Ultra
description:

The model inside the app is the 84. It follows the way a US classroom graphing calculator works, including its menus, its order of operations, its ten displayed digits, its error messages and its memory, which is still there when you close the app and come back.

WHAT IS INSIDE
- Home screen with fractions, templates for fractions, roots, logs, sums, derivatives and integrals, history, Ans and entry recall
- Every menu, numbered the way you remember it: MATH, LIST, STAT, DISTR, MATRIX, VARS, CATALOG and the rest
- Graphing in function, parametric, polar and sequence modes, with the Y= editor, WINDOW, ZOOM, TRACE, CALC and DRAW
- Statistics: lists, regressions, tests, intervals, distributions and stat plots
- Variables and memory: A to Z, six lists, ten matrices, strings and graph databases
- Programming: write and run programs with the full command set
- Preloaded apps for finance, polynomial and simultaneous equation solving, conics, inequalities, transformations, probability simulation, the periodic table, science tools, a spreadsheet and geometry constructions
- Long-press an entry or an answer to copy it into your homework

BUILT FOR SPEED
A key press shows on the screen in the same frame. No lag, no half-second wait between your finger and the display.

FREE, AND ONE UPGRADE
Everything basic is free: the home screen, single-equation graphing with WINDOW, ZOOM, TRACE and the CALC tools, statistics, programming, DRAW, the other preloaded apps and the Graphite and Chalk skins.

Scientific Calculator 84 Ultra Pro adds graphing more than one equation at a time, TABLE, intersect, matrix math, complex numbers, the Numeric Solver, the polynomial and simultaneous equation solver app, the unit converter in science tools, the Lock In and Aura skins and the results animation. Pro is a one-time purchase, with no subscription, and you can restore it on any of your devices. The app only asks when you open something that is part of Pro. It never interrupts a calculation.

NO ADS, NO TRACKING, NO ACCOUNT
There are no ads, no tracking and no account. The app works offline. It collects no data. The only thing that talks to Apple is the purchase itself.

TELL US WHAT TO FIX
This is the first version. Found a wrong answer, a missing key or a bug, or want something added? Open Settings and tap Send Feedback. We read every message and reply.

Phones are not allowed in exams. Scientific Calculator 84 Ultra is for practice and homework.

name: Scouting Coordinator
description:
Six schedules, four gyms, one car, and a notebook you can't find. Scouting Coordinator is the calendar for the coach or recruiter who drives to watch.

PICK THE GAMES, THEN JUST GO
Follow the teams you care about and star the games you'll attend. Each one gets a leave-by time from your drive and arrive-early buffer, a "time to leave" reminder on your phone, and the forecast at tip-off. Games with no tip time yet are flagged so you check before you drive, and two starred games at the same time warn you.

LOG WHO YOU WATCHED WHILE IT'S FRESH
After the game, tap "I went": final score, game notes, and the players you watched with a line on what stood out. Names you already track are matched; new names become player records on that team. Every player card keeps number, position, class, height, your rating, and every game you've seen them.

KNOW WHO YOU STILL NEED TO SEE
A checklist of every team on your calendar, seen or not, with each team's next game. Roster checklists for the teams you coach or a recruiting board: paste the players one per line. Logging a game checks off both teams and every player you watched; tick a box by hand for anyone you saw at a camp or showcase.

THE WHOLE SEASON AT A GLANCE
A color per level: high school, middle school, college, club. Today, Week, Month and Agenda views, filtered by level or team with one tap.

BRING IN THE SCHEDULES
Import a school's calendar file from Eventlink, MaxPreps, rSchoolToday, TeamSnap or a league site. Estimate the drive from your home town with one tap. Add your list to your phone calendar, or share a player's notes or the week as text.

YOUR NOTES STAY ON YOUR PHONE
No account. Nothing uploaded. Back up to a file whenever you like.

Free for 14 days, then $4.99 a month. Cancel any time in the App Store. name: Sea12 Orchestrator
description:
Sea12 Orchestrator brings your Orchestrator dashboards to your iPhone and iPad.

Sign in with your Orchestrator account, choose your organization, and open any dashboard you have access to. These are the same dashboards and apps you use on the web, sized for your device.

• Every dashboard you can open on the web, in one list, with favorites and recently opened dashboards at the top
• Switch between organizations if you belong to more than one

name: Şerefe: Cocktail Guide
description:
The most fun way to make cocktails at home.

Tick the bottles in your cabinet and Şerefe shows the cocktails you can make right now, plus the ones that are just one ingredient away. Free, no ads, no account; no data is collected and it works offline.

MY BAR
Tick your spirits and ingredients once. Your "can make now" list builds itself, and you can see how many new recipes one more bottle would unlock.

160+ RECIPES
From classics to modern cocktails, from Turkish rakı drinks to mocktails. Every recipe has its own illustration, simple measures and a short story. Şerefe signatures: Midnight Berry, Berry Bloom, Pink Bloom, Midnight Moka and Green Apple Gin Sour.

STEP BY STEP
Short, clear steps, each with a small illustration of what to do. Step-by-step mode focuses the screen on one step at a time.

MEASURES YOUR WAY
ml, oz or tablespoons; choose how many you're serving and every amount scales. No shaker? It tells you what to use instead.

SWAPS AND VEGAN OPTIONS
Missing an ingredient? See what you can use instead, including vegan swaps like aquafaba for egg white and oat or almond milk for dairy.

TASTE AND STRENGTH FILTERS
Sour, sweet, fruity, refreshing, coffee… light or strong? Pick a taste and the list follows. Every recipe shows its approximate standard drinks.

PARTY MODE
A full-screen bar menu for your guests. Tell it how many people are coming and every measure adjusts.

BARTENDER'S GUIDE
Tools, techniques, ice, glasses, measures, homemade syrups and bar terms, plus what to use when you don't have the gear.

SHARE AND TAKE NOTES
Share any recipe as a beautiful image. Rate the drinks you make, keep notes and add your own recipes.

Dark mode. English and Turkish.

For ages 18 and over. Please drink responsibly and never drink and drive. Şerefe doesn't sell alcohol or promote any brand.

Privacy: https://serefe.app/gizlilik · Contact: merhaba@serefe.app

name: Sett: HYROX Coach
description:
Sett is a coach for HYROX and fitness racing: eight runs, eight stations, one finish time. Give it your last race and Brock, Sett's badger coach, finds where the minutes went, then builds the foundation that wins them back.

FIND WHERE YOUR RACE LEAKS
Type in your splits: eight runs, eight stations and the Roxzone. Sett compares each one with athletes who finish like you, shows what you lost and what you gained, and says why. "Your engine is ahead of your band. The minutes go on the wall balls, where your legs quit before your lungs."

THE MISSING BASE, FIRST
Sett places you on seven levels, from Foundation to Elite 15, and on a map of 89 skills in nine lanes: mobility, strength, endurance, engine, stations, racecraft, health, planning and know-how. It trains the foundation that costs you most, one focus at a time, and shows what it unlocks next.

A WEEK THAT FITS
Sessions planned around the days you train and your next race. Miss one and Sett re-plans the week instead of piling it on.

EVERY MOVE, DRAWN
29 race moves, from wall balls and sled pushes to front squats and lunges, drawn as they're done, with the cues that matter and an example video. Each session runs set by set, with your rest on a timer.

ON YOUR WRIST
Sett on Apple Watch runs today's session with your phone in your bag: every move drawn, a big Done for each set, a tap before your rest ends, and each session saved to Apple Health. Your iPhone logs it when you're done.

LOGGED IN ONE TAP
Did today's session your own way? Tick it off. A run, an erg or a race simulation instead? Pick it and go. Every session counts toward your week and your weeks in a row.

YOUR NEXT LEVEL
Exactly what it takes to move up: your finish time, your pacing, your weakest station, and how far you are from each.

BETTER WITH BUDY
Already training with Budy? Any Budy plan includes Sett. Your Sett sessions count in Budy, and your Budy workouts and streak show in Sett.

RACE THE LEADERBOARDS
Game Center leaderboards for sessions, weeks in a row and foundations passed.

SUBSCRIPTION
Setting up is free: your level and where your race leaked. Training with Sett needs Sett monthly, an auto-renewable subscription at $0.99 a month, or any Budy plan. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Sett is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by HYROX.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://budy.fit/privacy

name: Shadow Cast: Silhouettes
description:
A cat waits in the window. Can you make its shadow?

Drag pieces across a theatre workbench and watch their shadows move across the screen. Rotate each piece to fit the outline and slide the lamp to change where the light falls. Ask for a hint when you want a starting point.

Start with 12 free puzzles. Rebuild a sailboat, fit a bicycle frame between its wheels, or set the rooftops against a moonlit sky. The optional Full Game purchase adds 100 more silhouettes in four chapters.

Play offline after installing the game. A connection to the App Store is needed to buy or restore Full Game. Your progress stays on your device.

name: Sifflo: Code de la route 2026
description:
Prépare le code de la route à ton rythme. Sifflo te donne des séries de questions comme à l'examen théorique général (ETG), la correction de chaque réponse avec l'article du Code de la route, et des examens blancs de 40 questions où il faut 35 bonnes réponses pour réussir.

POUR RÉVISER
- Onze thèmes : priorités, signalisation, croisement et dépassement, arrêt et stationnement, tunnels et passages à niveau, premiers secours et plus.
- Une fiche de cours courte par thème, avec les articles cités.
- Les panneaux par famille : danger, interdiction, obligation, indication, intersection.
- Chaque question explique pourquoi une réponse est juste et pourquoi les autres sont fausses.

DANGERS DU JOUR
- Une scène, 15 secondes : touche les zones de la route où un danger peut surgir.
- Un petit entraînement quotidien pour garder l'œil vif.

EXAMENS BLANCS
- 40 questions, 35 bonnes réponses pour réussir, sans retour en arrière, comme le jour J.
- Les questions à plusieurs bonnes réponses sont notées sur la combinaison complète.
- Une estimation de ta préparation par thème, sans promesse de réussite.

TON RYTHME
- Décompte jusqu'à ta date d'examen et rappel quotidien si tu le souhaites.
- Les questions ratées reviennent au bon moment pour être retenues.
- Sifflo la marmotte change de tenue au fil de tes progrès.

SANS COMPTE, HORS LIGNE
- Pas d'inscription, pas de publicité, aucune donnée envoyée : ta progression reste sur ton iPhone.

SIFFLO GRATUIT ET SIFFLO PRO
- Gratuit : 15 questions par thème, 2 examens blancs, 1 scène de Dangers par jour, deux familles de panneaux.
- Sifflo Pro, un seul achat (pas d'abonnement) : toutes les questions, tous les examens blancs, toutes les scènes et tous les panneaux.

Sifflo est une application indépendante, non affiliée à l'administration, à la Sécurité routière ni à un organisme d'examen. Les questions sont rédigées à partir du Code de la route publié sur Légifrance.

name: Signal Studio
description:
Signal Studio is for small sellers who post stock every day.

Take photos of what arrived, type one price, and send. Signal Studio posts the batch to the channels you have connected, in order, each photo with its price.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Choose any number of photos from your library, or take them in the app.
• Type one price, with sizes if you like, for the whole batch.
• Choose which of your connected channels each batch goes to.
• Share photos straight from the Photos app with "Signal Studio".
• Close the app while photos upload: the batch posts when the last photo arrives.
• See exactly where each batch arrived, where it did not, and why. Retry the ones that failed without posting anything twice.
• Get a notification when a batch is posted or needs your attention.
• See today's posting status on your Home Screen with the widget.
• Unlock with Face ID or your passcode.

YOUR ACCOUNT
You sign in with your mobile number and a passcode. Channels are connected to your Signal Studio account once; the app then shows their status, lets you switch each one on or off, and lets you disconnect any of them at any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No advertising and no tracking. Your photos are sent only to the channels you choose, to post them on your own accounts. You can delete your account and everything in it from the app.

Posting with Signal Studio is free.

name: Simit Kule: Seagull Rage Climb
description:
A seagull. A simit on a string. Galata Tower, 100 meters up. What could go wrong? Everything.

Simit Kule is a hard, physics-based climbing game set in Istanbul. Fly the simit from Karaköy Pier to the flag on top of Galata Tower. There are no lives and no timer, just gravity, your wings and a city that wants you to fail.

HOW IT WORKS
• Hold the right side to lean right, the left side to lean left, both to climb
• Your wings get tired. Land somewhere to catch your breath
• The simit hangs from a string and swings with every move. Hit something hard and you drop it
• Progress only counts with the simit. Leave it behind and you are just a bird

ISTANBUL IS AGAINST YOU
• A pirate gull snatches your simit and drops it far below
• Grannies throw slippers from their windows
• Rooftop cats swipe at anything with feathers
• Live wires, slippery roof tiles and a bouncy awning
• Strong gusts around the tower

FALL, AND EVERYONE TALKS
Every big fall brings a new comment from the crowd. Over 100 lines of pure mockery. You will read "Gravity 1, you 0" more than once.

FIVE ZONES, ONE TOWER
Karaköy Pier → Galata Streets → Rooftops → The Tower → Balcony & Cone. The sky turns from day to sunset to night as you climb.

TEA HOUSES
Land at one of the 4 tea houses with your simit to unlock a return point. After a fall, go back with a short optional ad or with golden simits. Or climb back up the hard way.

DRESS UP YOUR BIRD
40 items: 10 birds, 10 hats, 10 accessories and 10 simits. A peacock in a fez? A penguin with a crown? Earn golden simits by playing, from daily gifts, 16 achievements and the 5 risky golden simits hidden on the map.

• Hand-drawn pixel art Istanbul and chiptune music
• Plays offline
• Optional in-app purchases and optional rewarded ads

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: SiteOne AI
description:
SiteOne AI is the site app for builders who already use LeadOne AI. Site engineers record the day's work floor by floor and flat by flat, and owners see how every tower is really moving.

Your company's admin adds you. Sign in with your work email and password, or with a 6-digit code sent to your email.

FOR SITE ENGINEERS
• Add today's work in a few taps: pick the tower, floor and flats, the activity and the new percentage.
• Mark work as in progress, completed or on hold, with the reason.
• Add before, during and after photos. Photos are made smaller on the phone before they are sent.
• Record materials used and the contractor on the job.
• Follow each slab through its steps, from shuttering and steel to the pour, with the pre-pour checks.
• No signal on site? Updates are saved on the phone and sent when the signal returns. Nothing is lost.
• Fix and resend anything that comes back, and edit or cancel an update within your company's time limit.

FOR OWNERS AND MANAGEMENT
• One overview of every project and tower: overall progress, what moved today and what is late or on hold.
• Delays and flats waiting, so you know where to push.
• Materials used, by day and by tower.
• Photos from site, with before and after side by side.
• The evening report of the day's work, to read in the app or share as a PDF.

FOR ADMINS
• Add your site team and choose who works on which tower.
• Set up activities and their weights, and enter the starting point of work already done.

ONE SET OF BUILDINGS
Towers, floors and flats come from your company's LeadOne AI inventory, so nobody types them twice. Site engineers never see leads, buyers or prices.

SiteOne AI needs a company account. It is switched on for a company by its LeadOne AI admin. If you do not have an account, ask your company's admin.

name: Skyline Empire: Contractor
description:
Kadıköy and Üsküdar, street by street, on one map that every player shares. You are a contractor here. You find an empty lot, sit down with its owner and offer flats instead of cash, then design the building and raise it floor by floor. When it is finished it stays on the map, with your company's name on it, for everyone else to see.

Other contractors want the same corners. Outbid them in evening tenders, climb from journeyman to holding company, join a club and race your rivals for the district.

No ads. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Slide Theremin
description:
Hold a finger on the screen and slide: up and down changes pitch, left and right changes volume. It glides continuously like a real theremin — no keys, no frets, no wrong notes.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
· Continuous pitch: stepless glide, closest to a real theremin.
· Scale mode: snaps to major, minor, pentatonic, blues or whole-tone, so you stay in tune.

A SOUND YOU CAN SHAPE
· Waveform: sine, triangle, sawtooth, square.
· Glide: from a hard jump to a 250 ms slide.
· Harmonics and reverb: add a little voice and space.
· Range and master volume adjust to how you play.

PLAY ALONG
Five built-in songs (Twinkle Twinkle, Ode to Joy, Happy Birthday, Canon, Frère Jacques). Tap Demo to hear it, then Play along — a target ring shows where your right hand goes and advances when you hold it steady.

RECORD A CLIP
Capture your performance as audio and share it, or listen back while you practise.

PRIVACY
· No account, no network, nothing uploaded.
· Microphone (optional): ultrasonic Doppler sensing of hand movement shapes volume and expression. Audio is analysed on-device only — never recorded, never sent.
· Clips contain the synth output only, not room sound.
· Hands-in-air mode uses the front camera on-device to locate your hands. No photos, nothing stored or uploaded.

name: Snap Net Worth
description:
Snap Net Worth shows your total net worth as a single number, adding up your assets in US dollars, euros, Peruvian soles, Mexican pesos, Brazilian reais, and Argentine, Chilean, Colombian and Uruguayan pesos.

Add your assets, take periodic "snapshots" of your net worth, and watch how it evolves over time — no account, no server. Everything stays on your own phone.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Add assets with just a name, an amount and a currency.
• See your total net worth converted to whichever currency you choose.
• Edit your exchange rates or refresh them with one tap from a public source.
• Reorder your assets by dragging them.
• Take periodic snapshots and see their history on an evolution chart.
• Compare each snapshot with the previous one and with the first one, in value and percentage.
• Add an optional note to each snapshot.
• Hide amounts on screen with one tap, for privacy.
• Lock the app with a 6-digit PIN and, if you want, Face ID.
• Use the app fully offline (except to refresh rates).
• Choose language (Spanish/English) and theme (light, dark or system).

YOUR DATA, ONLY YOURS
• No accounts, no servers, no cloud sync.
• Everything is stored only on your device.
• No ads, no tracking.

Snap Net Worth is free and has no ads.

Exchange rates are provided by ExchangeRate-API (exchangerate-api.com).

name: SocialDiet: Hide Reels, Shorts
description:
SocialDiet opens the social sites you already use — without the parts built to keep you scrolling.

Short-video feeds, Explore pages, sponsored posts and "suggested for you" are hidden on your iPhone before you see them. Your messages, the people you follow, search and your subscriptions stay where they are. A video a friend sends you still plays; the next one doesn't start by itself.

HOW IT WORKS
• Open Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, X, Reddit, Threads or Snapchat inside SocialDiet. Each one loads its own official mobile website in a secure web view.
• Sign in on the platform's own login page. SocialDiet never reads, stores or autofills your password.
• Choose what disappears, per app: short videos, Explore, ads and sponsored posts, suggested posts, stories.
• Use what you came for: messages, friends' posts, search.

WHAT YOU CAN HIDE
• Reels, Shorts, For You and Spotlight feeds
• Explore and trending pages
• Ads, sponsored and promoted posts
• Suggested posts and accounts
• Instagram: comments, and a Favorites-only home feed
• Messages-only mode (Instagram, X) and search-only mode (YouTube)

SET YOUR OWN LIMITS
• Daily time limits for each platform: when you reach yours, SocialDiet pauses the page and asks if you are done for today.

SEE YOUR OWN NUMBERS
• Time spent per platform today and over the last days, streaks and a 7-day plan — calculated from your own use, stored on your iPhone.
• Widgets for your Home Screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up.
• No tracking, analytics or advertising SDKs. No "Allow tracking?" prompt.
• Usage time and settings stay on your device. SocialDiet has no server that holds your history.

PRICING
• 3 days free with everything unlocked. No card, no account — nothing is charged automatically when the free days end.
• After that, SocialDiet Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, monthly or yearly. The price is shown in the App Store before you confirm.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.

GOOD TO KNOW
• What can be hidden depends on each platform's website and may change when the platform updates it.
• Snapchat's mobile website has no chat or sign-in; SocialDiet opens its public Discover and Spotlight pages.
• No app can change another app on iPhone. SocialDiet works on the platforms' websites; the filters and limits apply while you browse in SocialDiet.
• Requires iOS 18 or later.

SocialDiet is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, X, Reddit, Threads or Snapchat. All trademarks belong to their owners.

Terms of Use: https://socialdiet.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://socialdiet.app/privacy/

name: SooFrontier
description:
SooFrontier is your daily briefing on the AI frontier.

Every morning at 6:00 am Pacific, a crew of AI agents reads hundreds of new papers, model releases, products, company blogs, essays and posts from the people building AI. They file each story into its lane, a Skeptic agent flags hype, and they write a brief on what actually matters today.

- The Brief: a TL;DR and key takeaways for the day, plus the top signals across every lane. Listen to it read aloud.
- Research: SOTA papers, tech reports, demos and code, newest first.
- Productions: new models, products and services.
- Opinions: voices on X, essays and company blogs.
- Quick reads: a story's contributions, findings, limitations and potential opportunities at a glance.
- Q&A: ask anything about a story and get an answer from a model running on your device.
- Sources inside the app: read the original beside the story on iPad and Mac.
- Brainstorm: put a question to a panel of AI agents and watch them debate it, using your own API key or a model that runs on your device.

SooFrontier is free, with no accounts, no ads and no tracking. If it's useful to you, optional tips help keep the agents running.

This is an early release, and your feedback shapes what comes next.

name: Sorgsam
description:
Sorgsam begleitet dich, wenn du einen Angehörigen zu Hause pflegst. Die App hält fest, was du jeden Tag leistest, erinnert an Medikamente und Fristen und nimmt dir einen Teil der Bürokratie ab.

PFLEGETAGEBUCH FÜR DIE BEGUTACHTUNG
• Hilfe in Sekunden erfassen, sortiert nach den sechs Modulen der Begutachtung
• Countdown bis zum Termin mit dem Medizinischen Dienst
• Bericht für die Begutachtung auf Knopfdruck, mit Stunden pro Woche

MEDIKAMENTE UND MESSWERTE
• Medikamentenplan nach Schema morgens – mittags – abends – nachts
• Erinnerungen und Abhaken jeder Gabe
• Blutdruck, Blutzucker, Gewicht und mehr als Verlauf

BEHÖRDEN OHNE STRESS
• Musterbriefe an die Pflegekasse, vorausgefüllt mit deinen Daten: Antrag, Höherstufung, Widerspruch, Verhinderungspflege und mehr
• Fristen im Blick, z. B. Widerspruchsfrist und Beratungsbesuch
• Alle Leistungen und Beträge 2026 je Pflegegrad
• Checklisten für jede Phase, vom ersten Antrag bis zum Abschied

DOKUMENTE UND FAMILIE
• Bescheide und Gutachten scannen und ablegen
• Pflegeteam und wichtige Kontakte an einem Ort, Notrufnummern griffbereit

DEINE DATEN GEHÖREN DIR
Kein eigener Server, kein Tracking, keine Werbung. Alles liegt auf deinem iPhone und in deiner privaten iCloud.

SORGSAM PLUS
Kostenlos nutzbar: Tagebuch, Medikamente, Fristen und ausgewählte Briefe. Mit Plus bekommst du alle Musterbriefe, den Bericht zum Teilen, Messwerte und die Dokumentenablage. 4,99 € im Monat oder 39,99 € im Jahr, die ersten 14 Tage gratis. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch und ist jederzeit in den Einstellungen deines Apple-Accounts kündbar.

Sorgsam ist kein Medizinprodukt und ersetzt keine Rechts- oder Pflegeberatung.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Datenschutz: https://vrb657z68h-rgb.github.io/sorgsam-info/datenschutz.html

name: Spanish Flashcards: Lexiesta
description:
Spanish flashcards and vocabulary trainer for English speakers: learn Spanish words and phrases a few minutes a day with spaced repetition, example sentences, spoken audio and quizzes. Everything works offline, with no account and no sign-in. Open the app and you are studying in seconds.

SPANISH FLASHCARDS IN A REAL 3D DECK
Your cards sit in a lit, three-dimensional stack. Tap to flip a card, grade yourself Again, Good or Easy, and watch it fly off the deck. Your daily goal ring and streak keep the habit going.

SPACED REPETITION THAT FITS YOU
Every word moves along its own eight-step review ladder. Words you miss come back soon, words you know return after days, then weeks, then months.

ORIGINAL SPANISH VOCABULARY FOR TRAVEL, WORK AND DAILY LIFE
About 385 words and phrases, each with an example sentence, an English meaning and, where it matters, a note on Latin America versus Spain (coche or carro, billete or boleto, ordenador or computadora, vale or dale). Eight packs: Core words 1 and 2, Greetings, Travel, Food, Work and study, Health and Directions. Written for this app, not a copied word list.

FOUR WAYS TO PRACTISE
Meaning, translation, listening and typing quizzes. The typing quiz has a row of accent keys and tells you when you had the right word but missed an accent.

HEAR SPANISH PRONUNCIATION, OFFLINE
Tap the speaker to hear any word or sentence with your device's own Spanish voices, in a Latin American or Spain accent. No microphone and no speech recognition are used.

MADE TO BE READ
A- and A+ buttons on every screen scale the text up to double size, and the app also follows your system text size. Layouts built for iPhone and iPad.

FREE TO START, TWO WAYS TO GO AD-FREE
The first three packs are free, supported by ads that never appear during a review or quiz. Lexiesta Plus (monthly subscription, 7-day free trial, then renews monthly until cancelled) or a one-time Remove Ads purchase takes the ads away and opens every pack. You can also watch an optional short video to open a locked pack for 24 hours.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your progress stays on your device. The ad SDK may use device identifiers as disclosed in the privacy policy, and you choose whether to allow tracking.

Lexiesta is a study aid for learners and does not guarantee fluency or exam results.

Subscription details: payment is charged to your Apple account, and the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-lang-flashcards-es.html

name: Speaker Deck: Speech Cue Cards
description:
A cheat sheet that fits in your hand.

Speaker Deck turns your talk into a deck of short cue cards. Write one point per card, and on stage just swipe: the text is big enough to read at a glance, the screen never goes dark, and your phone gives a gentle buzz on every new card, so you know it turned without looking.

ON STAGE
• Full-screen cards with text that sizes itself to fit each point
• Turn cards with a swipe or a Bluetooth clicker. A stray tap does nothing
• A large "2 / 7" counter and a progress bar show where you are
• Talk timer. Double-tap for the controls, text size and a grid to jump to any card
• Dark or light stage, portrait or landscape lock

PREPARING
• Paste a ready-made text: each paragraph or list line becomes a card
• Quick input, drag to reorder, swipe a card away with Undo
• Full-screen editor with a preview of how the card will look on stage
• Duplicate a deck to keep different versions of a talk

PREMIUM: ONE PAYMENT FOREVER OR A MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION
• Unlimited cards (the free version allows up to 10 per deck)
• Talk timer with a goal. Your phone vibrates at halfway, shortly before the end and when time is up. Each signal feels different, so you can tell them apart without looking
• Time for each card: see where you linger on a point
• Rehearsal mode: run through the talk, get the time for every card and the total against your goal, then save the measured times to your cards in one tap
• Backup to a file: save all your decks and cards in one file and load them on another phone

No account and no ads. Your decks are stored on your phone.

Made for conference talks, lectures, meetups, toasts, sales pitches, school presentations and exam answers.

Premium is available as a one-time purchase or as a monthly subscription. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://neomer.github.io/speaker-deck-policy/privacy-policy-ios.txt

name: Spokane Runnerz
description:
Order from the vendors at your venue. Pick it up when it is ready, or have a runner bring it to your seat, or table.

Runnerz does not prepare the food, hold an alcohol license, or sell the alcohol. The vendor does.

name: SSH Terminal & SFTP Client
description:
A fast, private SSH client for iPhone and iPad. Connect to your Linux, Ubuntu, Raspberry Pi or any Unix server and get a real terminal: full color, every key you need, and tabs for every session.

REAL TERMINAL
• Full xterm-256color terminal: htop, vim, tmux, less and top work the way they do on your desktop
• Extra keys above the keyboard: Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, arrows, Home/End, PgUp/PgDn and F1–F12
• Sticky Ctrl and Alt: tap once for the next key, double-tap to lock
• Pinch to zoom, long-press to select, copy and paste
• Hardware keyboard support for iPad
• Reconnect with one tap when iOS drops the connection; your scrollback stays

HOSTS AND KEYS
• Save your servers with labels and colors, or quick connect with user@host:port
• Password, key, or both. Keyboard-interactive login for macOS and PAM servers
• Generate ed25519 and RSA keys on the device, and install the public key on a server with one tap
• Import existing OpenSSH, RSA and EC keys
• Import hosts from your ~/.ssh/config
• Host key verification with a clear warning if a server's key changes

PRO: FILES, TUNNELS AND MORE
• SFTP file browser: upload, download, rename, delete and change permissions, then open a terminal in that folder
• Port forwarding: local (-L), remote (-R) and dynamic SOCKS (-D) tunnels that start with the session
• Jump hosts (ProxyJump) to reach private servers through a bastion
• SSH agent forwarding for git and onward hops
• Snippets: save the commands you type every day and send them with one tap
• Several live sessions at once, in tabs
• One-time purchase. No subscription.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Passwords and private keys stay in the iOS Keychain and never leave your device
• No account, no sign-up, no cloud sync, no tracking
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID / passcode lock

LOOKS GOOD
• Six color themes: Default Dark, Solarized Dark and Light, Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox
• Six bundled monospace fonts, including JetBrains Mono Nerd Font, so Powerline, starship and oh-my-zsh prompts render correctly

Made for sysadmins, developers, DevOps engineers, students and homelab fans who need to reach a server from anywhere.

Terms of use (EULA): http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

name: Stamp – Ink Puzzle
description:
Stamp is a calm, original puzzle about ink and overlap.

Drag a plus-shaped stamp from an ink pot onto the board. Where inks overlap, they mix: yellow and blue make green, blue and red make purple. Your goal is to recreate the target pattern exactly, using only the stamps you're given.

• A puzzle mechanic you won't find anywhere else
• Starts gentle and keeps growing: boards up to 9×9 and more stamps as you go
• After level 71, master mode adds a new twist every 10 levels: fading targets, less time, holes in the board, white ink
• Every puzzle is freshly generated and always solvable
• Stuck? Take a hint. Earn free stars as you play
• Day and night themes, plus a color-blind mode with ink patterns
• Plays offline. No ads, no account, no tracking
• Available in 14 languages

name: StampShift: Time Converter
description:
StampShift turns timestamps into readable local times and back again — without mental arithmetic or a browser tab.

SECONDS OR MILLISECONDS, AUTOMATIC
Type a 10-digit value and it is read as seconds; type 13 digits and it is read as milliseconds. The result shows the local date and time for the zone you pick, plus Unix seconds, milliseconds and UTC in ISO 8601.

DATE TO TIMESTAMP
Switch to Date, type a local time such as 2026-11-11 21:04:00, and get both timestamp forms back. ISO 8601 input with Z or an offset is accepted too.

A BOARD OF CLOCKS
Pin the cities you work with in Zones. Every row shows that zone’s current local time and offset, updating while you watch. Swipe to remove a city.

MEASURE THE GAP
Difference takes two instants — timestamps or dates, mixed if you like — and returns the Calendar gap in days, hours and minutes, plus a running total.

KEEP WHAT YOU USED
The last 30 conversions are saved on the device. Tap one in History to reopen it in Convert.

YOURS TO ADJUST
Choose a 24-hour or 12-hour clock, one of three date formats, and a default time zone. Every screen follows immediately.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Conversions, zones and history stay on this device. Nothing you type is uploaded.

ONLINE DESTINATION
On a cold start the app reads one small configuration record and waits at most 2.5 seconds; if a valid destination is enabled, iOS may open it once. Status, Refresh and manual Open are in About. Missing, disabled or unreachable configuration leaves the app fully usable offline.

name: StayReplied: Team Inbox
seller_name: BYTES GLUE SOFTWARE SERVICES AND SOLUTIONS - FZCO
description:
Never leave a customer message unanswered. StayReplied brings your customer conversations into one shared inbox for your team, on your phone and on your computer.

This app brings StayReplied to your iPhone and iPad. Sign in with your StayReplied account and work in the same workspace, conversations and roles as on the web.

ONE INBOX FOR THE WHOLE TEAM
- Web chat on your website: add the chat box to your site, and every conversation arrives in the shared inbox.
- Assign conversations, leave internal notes and @mention a teammate.
- See who is replying, so two people never answer at once.
- Saved replies for the questions you answer every day.
- Snooze a conversation until the time you choose.
- Several brands in one workspace, each conversation kept with the brand the customer wrote to.

AI THAT STICKS TO WHAT YOU APPROVED
- Publish your FAQs, policies and price list. You review every version before the AI can use it.
- The AI answers or drafts only from your published knowledge, and shows which version it used. When two facts disagree, it stops and asks your team.
- It hands the conversation to a person when it is unsure, when money or a complaint is involved, or when the customer asks. Your teammate sees a short hand-off summary of the question and what was tried.
- Take over any conversation in one tap.
- You decide where the AI may answer on its own and where it only drafts. Set daily and monthly AI budgets, and the AI pauses at the limit.
- AI replies use the AI provider key your workspace connects.

TICKETS, QUOTES AND FOLLOW-UP
- Turn a chat into a ticket with a priority, an owner and a due time, and watch response times.
- Quotes are calculated from your approved price list. A payment screenshot is never counted as paid.
- Contacts with their consent records: a customer who sends STOP is not messaged again.
- A sales pipeline for every lead.

ARABIC AND ENGLISH
The app, the web chat and your replies work in both languages, right to left included.

MADE FOR BUSINESSES THAT LIVE ON CHAT
Restaurants and cafes, clinics, shops and online stores, salons, repair shops, agencies and trainers: answer opening hours, menus and product questions from what you approved, and send bookings, complaints and anything sensitive to a person.

YOUR CUSTOMERS' MESSAGES STAY YOURS
- Every workspace is isolated from every other.
- Two-step sign-in with an authenticator app, roles with clear permissions and a full audit history.
- Provider keys and secrets stay encrypted on the server and are never sent to your phone.
- Workspace data is stored in the European Union. We do not sell workspace data, use it for advertising or use it to train AI models.
- Delete your account or your workspace from Settings.
- No ads.

The app needs an internet connection.

HELP
Read the guides at stayreplied.com/docs, chat with us on WhatsApp, or write to support@stayreplied.com.

StayReplied is made by BytesGlue.

name: Steadlog: Custody Journal
description:
When parents are in a custody dispute, the small facts matter: who was late, which visit did not happen, which expense is still unpaid. Steadlog is a private journal for keeping those facts in order, so you are not trying to remember them months later.

LOG IT IN SECONDS
• Exchanges: on time or late, with the minutes counted for you
• Missed or denied visits
• Expenses, the share you are asking for, and whether it was paid back
• Messages, visits and notes, with date, time, place and details
• Add photos, such as a screenshot of a text or a receipt

A RECORD YOU CAN TRUST
• Every entry keeps the time it was first saved, and that time cannot be changed
• If you edit an entry, the earlier version is kept in its history
• Search, filter by type and browse by month

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• Everything stays on your iPhone: no server, no analytics, no ads
• Locks with Face ID or your passcode, and hides its content in the app switcher

STEADLOG PRO
• A PDF report for any period: summary, every entry in order, numbered photo attachments and an optional edit history
• CSV export
• Patterns: how often exchanges were late, average delay, missed or denied visits, expenses requested and unpaid
• Custody calendar: mark who had the children each day and see parenting time as a percentage
• Unlimited photos (free includes 10)
• A discreet app icon
Subscriptions:
• Yearly: $39.99 per year, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers
• Monthly: $5.99 per month
• Lifetime: $79.99, one-time purchase
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Steadlog organizes your own records. It is not legal advice, it is not a law firm, and no app can promise that a court will accept a document. Ask your lawyer how to use your records.

Terms of Use: https://steadlog.buzato.dev.br/terms
Privacy Policy: https://steadlog.buzato.dev.br/privacy

name: Steddy Crew
description:
Steddy Crew is the phone app for technicians whose business runs on Steddy.

Open it and today's jobs are there in order: who, where, what for and when. Tap to call the customer or get directions.

Each step is one tap. Accept the job, say you're on your way, start it, finish it. The office sees each step as it happens, so nobody has to ring you to ask.

Quote on the driveway. Build the quote from your service list, add a discount if you need one, then email it or have the customer sign on your phone.

Invoice before you leave. Add the work done and the parts you used, take a deposit or the final payment, and the invoice goes out.

Attach photos of the job and leave notes for the office.

Everything except taking payments and on-phone signing works without signal. Changes save on your phone and sync when you're back in range.

Location is recorded on the job steps only. Steddy Crew takes one approximate reading when you accept, head to, start or finish a job during work hours. Nothing runs in the background and nothing is tracked between jobs. You can turn it off in your phone settings.

You need a login from your employer. Steddy Crew is for businesses that run on Steddy (steddyhq.com). If yours isn't on Steddy yet, start there.

name: Stomplings: Block Puzzle
description:
A monster is waiting at the door, and it needs a room.

Stomplings is a block puzzle with a monster in it. Every round starts with the monster's room drawn on a 9x9 board, with glowing rings around its edges. Place your block pieces to cover every ring and keep the room itself empty. Then the monster hops in and stomps, and every block on the board bursts. A new room appears, and you build again.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drag pieces from your hand of three onto the board. Pieces don't rotate.
- Fill a row or column to clear it and make space.
- Cover every glowing ring around the room to call the monster in.
- Keep blocks out of the room itself.
- The monster waits only so many hands, counted under the board, so plan ahead.

ONE LONG RUN
- Each room is the next stage of one long run, and your score keeps climbing.
- The bar under your score chases this week's best, then your all-time best.
- A lost room costs one of your three hearts. When they are gone, an optional video can buy one second chance per run.

MEET THE MONSTERS
- Big monsters stomp down from the sky and pay out more coins.
- Monsters you win stand on your shelf.

WHEN A ROOM GOES WRONG
- Take back a piece, undo a hand, swap in a new hand or add three more hands.
- Each day your first save of a lost room is free. After that, pay with coins or an optional video.
- Earn coins by winning rooms, and double them with an optional video.

LEVELS
- Keep playing to open Levels, a second mode with rounds of its own.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Free to play, with optional in-app purchases.
- Contains ads: full-screen ads between rooms, a banner, and sometimes an ad when you open or return to the game. Reward videos are always your choice.
- The No forced ads purchase removes the full-screen, banner and opening ads. Reward videos stay.
- No account or sign-in needed.

name: Streakful: Habit & Brain Games
description:
Streakful is a habit tracker and ten quick brain games in one app. Check off your habits, then beat your best score.

BRAIN GAMES
Ten quick games, each a minute or two:
• Memory Match: flip cards to find the pairs, from simple icons up to multiplication.
• Quick Math: as many sums as you can in 30 seconds.
• Reaction Time: tap the instant the screen turns green.
• Reading Speed: read a short passage, then answer a question about it.
• Sequence Memory: repeat a growing pattern of tiles.
• Stroop Test: name the ink color, not the word.
• Bigger or Smaller: pick the bigger sum, fast.
• Word Scramble: unscramble as many words as you can in a minute.
• Odd One Out: spot the one emoji that's different.
• Number Memory: remember a number that grows a digit at a time.

Every day you get a fresh three-game workout. Your scores and personal bests for each game type are saved so you can see your game results over time.

HABITS
Add the habits you want to build, check them off each day, and watch your streaks grow. A 30-day grid shows your history at a glance.

STREAKS AND LEADERBOARDS
Play any game once a day to keep your Brain Training streak alive. Beat your personal bests, then see how you rank against other players on each game's leaderboard, under a name you choose; your email is never shown.

DAILY REMINDERS
Turn on a daily reminder at the time that suits you. It only comes on days you still have something left to do.

FREE AND PRO
Streakful is free to use with up to 3 habits and 9 game plays each day.
• Streakful Pro: unlimited habits, plus Streak Insurance to save a streak after a missed day, once a week. Monthly or yearly.
• Brain Pro: unlimited plays on every game, monthly or yearly.
• Streakful Bundle: both together, monthly.

Yearly plans start with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. The trial becomes a paid subscription when it ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before.

Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and you can cancel any time in Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends.

Terms of Use: https://streakful.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://streakful.app/privacy

name: Student Center LMS
description:
Student Center يجمع كورسات جامعتك على موبايلك.

اعثر على كورسات جامعتك وفرقتك الدراسية، وانضم إليها، وشاهد الدروس المسجلة التي أعدّها محاضروك — وكمّل من نفس النقطة اللي وقفت عندها.

الكورسات والدروس
• تصفّح الكورسات المتاحة لجامعتك وفرقتك الدراسية
• انضم للكورسات المجانية مباشرة، أو افتح الكورس بكود الوصول اللي معاك، أو اطلب الوصول من الإدارة
• شاهد الدروس مع استكمال المشاهدة والتحكم في السرعة والجودة
• تابع تقدّمك وكمّل المشاهدة من الشاشة الرئيسية
• افتح مرفقات الدروس زي ملفات PDF داخل التطبيق

المكتبة
• مواد المذاكرة والباقات في مكان واحد
• افتحها برصيد محفظتك — واشحن الرصيد بكارت شحن

خليك متابع
• إشعارات عند نشر دروس وإعلانات جديدة
• بحث في الكورسات والدروس والمحاضرين والمرفقات

مساعدة وقت ما تحتاجها
• تواصل مع الدعم من داخل التطبيق وتابع كل طلب
• اطلب حذف حسابك في أي وقت من الإعدادات

معمول للطلاب
• واجهة كاملة بالعربي والإنجليزي
• الوضع الفاتح والداكن
• دروسك محمية: كل حساب مربوط بجهازه والفيديوهات عليها علامة مائية شخصية

يلزم وجود حساب. يتم توفير الوصول للكورسات من فريق التدريس عن طريق الاشتراك المجاني أو أكواد الوصول أو موافقة الإدارة.

name: Sushi Maker: Idle Tycoon
description:
Build a conveyor sushi bar and take it around the world.

Start with one maki station in Tokyo. Upgrade it, open nigiri, miso soup, gyoza, ramen, tempura, bubble tea and omakase, hire chefs and watch the plates roll down the belt. When the bar outgrows the city, open the next one: 30 cities from Osaka to Reykjavik, each with its own twist.

NO ADS. EVER.
No banners and no videos to watch for a reward. No account, no ad tracking. The game works offline.

DECISIONS, NOT JUST TAPS
• Eight stations share one hall: expand it to lift the level cap and double your income.
• Chefs have different skills. Move them between stations to fit the city.
• Every city changes the rules: locals love one dish, the rent is high, the night is long or tourists crowd in.
• Ten perk picks over the whole tour. No bar gets them all, so yours is your own.

THE BAR EARNS WHILE YOU ARE AWAY
Close the game and the till keeps filling. Come back, collect, and spend it on the next step.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• Three daily quests with a choice of reward.
• A visit streak, achievements and a four-week season with a free reward track.
• Rush hour and special guests for those who like to play actively.

A FAIR SHOP
Crystals are earned by playing and can also be bought. Nothing is random: every purchase says exactly what you get. Purchases are optional.

VIP SUBSCRIPTION
VIP doubles all income, gives crystals every day, adds a chef place and lets the till hold 8 hours instead of 2. It is an auto-renewing subscription: weekly, monthly or yearly, and the yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://roseygrow.github.io/sushi-maker-site/privacy.html

name: Talewell: Family Stories
description:
Talewell helps you ask the questions you'll wish you had asked.

Sit down with your grandmother, your father, an old friend. Talewell gives you a good question, like "How did you meet?" or "What did your street look like when you were small?". Put the phone on the table and listen. Talewell records the story and writes it out on your iPhone, so you can read it, share it and keep it.

Visit by visit, the stories add up to a book: their life, in their own words.

• 144 warm, open questions in 12 chapters, from first memories to looking back
• Recording keeps going with the screen locked
• Written out on your iPhone with Apple's speech recognition, nothing uploaded
• Gentle interview tips while you record: what happened next? who was there?
• Add old photos to a story
• Share a story with the family, recording included
• A question every Sunday, if you like
• Save a copy of everything in one file

Free: one storyteller and the first three chapters, with unlimited recording.

Talewell Pro (one-time purchase, no subscription):
• The book: their stories with a cover, contents and photos, as a PDF to print or give
• All 144 questions: nine more chapters, from love and work to traditions and life lessons
• Everyone in the family: as many storytellers as you like
• Your own questions

Private by design: no account, no server, no ads, no tracking. The stories stay on your iPhone.

name: Tarecast: Weigh-In Tracker
description:
Put a cylinder or spool on a scale, enter the weight, and Tarecast subtracts the empty weight (tare), remembers each weigh-in and estimates when it will run out. No sensor, no account and no ads.

WHAT YOU CAN TRACK
- Propane and CO2 cylinders
- Filament spools
- Any custom container you weigh

HOW IT HELPS
- Tare math you can check: tap Show the math to see every number
- A run-out estimate from your recent weigh-ins since the last refill
- Refill and new-spool events that show how much a fill added compared with the listed capacity
- A low-level flag at a percentage you choose
- History with edit, delete and undo; pounds, kilograms, ounces or grams
- A chart of what remains over time
- Light and dark appearance

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your items and weigh-ins stay on your device. Tarecast has no account, no analytics and no ads.

TRY IT FREE
Tarecast starts with a 7-day free trial, one per customer, that begins when you tap Start. After the trial, a one-time unlock keeps adding items and weigh-ins. Your saved items and history always stay viewable. No subscription and no automatic charge. The App Store shows the price before you buy.

GOOD TO KNOW
Estimates depend on your scale and the tare you enter. For propane cylinders, use the TW stamped on yours; presets show a typical value only. Tarecast does not give advice about handling or storing gas cylinders.

name: Tarifo: Trucking Cost & Profit
description:
Is this job worth taking? Tarifo tells you in seconds.

Enter the distance and the price you were offered. Tarifo adds up what the job really costs you — fuel, tires and maintenance, insurance, tax, financing, your own pay, tolls and commission — and shows your profit, the lowest price you can accept and a suggested price.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO DRIVE FOR A LIVING
• Motorcycle and scooter couriers
• Vans and light trucks
• Trucks
• Tractor-trailers

WHAT YOU GET
• A clear answer for every job: take it, borderline, or leave it
• Type two places and Tarifo fills in the road distance, with a heavy-vehicle route for trucks
• Loaded and empty kilometres or miles counted separately, so the empty return is never forgotten
• Fixed costs spread over your working days: insurance, tax, depreciation, financing
• Extra cost lines per job: tolls, ferry, parking, meals, overnight stay, loading help, repairs
• Shift mode for couriers: your real net earnings per hour
• Saved jobs and a monthly summary of revenue, costs and profit
• A quote you can share with your customer
• Several vehicles, each with its own figures

WORKS WHERE YOU WORK
• Ready-made starting values for Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Bulgaria, Lithuania, Türkiye, the United Kingdom and the United States — or set up any other country yourself
• Kilometres or miles, litres or gallons, your own currency
• In the United States: trucking terms and an IFTA quarterly worksheet with CSV export
• 7 languages: English, German, Turkish, Polish, Romanian, Bulgarian, Lithuanian

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Your figures are stored on your device only and the calculator works without an internet connection. Only the optional distance lookup needs internet: it sends the two place names you type; your figures never leave your phone.

PRICE
All features are free for 7 days — no payment details needed. After that, calculations require a monthly or yearly subscription. Your saved jobs stay readable without a subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Tarifo gives estimates based on the figures you enter. It is not tax or accounting advice.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://dotcaseglobal.com/tarifo/terms/
Privacy: https://dotcaseglobal.com/tarifo/privacy/

name: Tête Libre
description:
Plusieurs enfants, plusieurs comptes, une notification pour chaque note : l'important se noie. Tête Libre remet de l'ordre et vous dit, d'un coup d'œil, où en est chaque enfant et ce qui mérite votre attention.

L'application se connecte à votre compte École Directe, avec vos propres identifiants, et rassemble toute votre famille sur un seul écran :

• L'évolution de chaque enfant : une courbe semaine après semaine, et la tendance des deux dernières semaines, en hausse, stable ou en baisse.
• Votre semaine en bref : ce qui a changé, les nouvelles notes, les absences et les retards, ce qui est à prévoir.
• Une seule chose à voir ce soir : l'application met en avant ce qui compte, au lieu de vous noyer sous les notifications.
• Plusieurs enfants ? Choisissez « Tous » ou un enfant, et passez d'une vue par matière à une vue par date.
• Vos alertes : une note sous le seuil que vous avez choisi, une absence, un devoir ou un document à signer.
• Les devoirs et les contrôles des jours à venir, et les messages de l'établissement.
• Les moyennes, par matière et par enfant, pondérées par les coefficients de l'établissement.

Vos données restent sur votre téléphone : les notes, les moyennes et les messages de vos enfants sont lus depuis École Directe et conservés sur votre iPhone, protégés par le chiffrement d'iOS. Pas de compte à créer chez nous, pas de publicité, pas de suivi de votre utilisation.

Essayez sans compte : « Découvrir avec une famille fictive » vous montre l'application avec des données fictives.

Tête Libre est une application indépendante. Elle n'est ni éditée, ni approuvée, ni affiliée à École Directe ni à la société Aplim.

name: TextForge: Text Cleaner
description:
TextForge is a small, fast text cleaner. Paste a list, choose the clean-up actions you need, and check the before and after before anything changes.

Ten actions:
• Remove blank lines
• Remove duplicates and keep the original order
• Sort A to Z or Z to A
• Make uppercase, lowercase, or capitalise each word
• Trim extra spaces
• Number the lines
• Reverse line order

Combine any actions into a chain. Actions run in the order you tap them, and a chain can be saved as a preset to reuse in one tap. The result page shows both versions: apply to the editor, copy the result, or undo the apply. Statistics count words, lines, characters and duplicates while you type. History keeps the last 20 inputs on the device.

Everything is processed on your device. No account, no sign-in, and your text is not uploaded.

On launch the app reads one small configuration record and waits at most 2.5 seconds. If an optional online destination is enabled with a valid address, iOS may open it once after the local interface appears. The destination can also be opened from About; if the record is missing, turned off, invalid, or unreachable, the app continues with local features.

name: The Gang's Vacation
description:
An open suitcase, flying pages and discoveries along the way. The Gang's Vacation is a platform adventure from DoGames — A Turma do Barulho, with dogs, Brazilian landscapes and a travel album to fill.

Choose Meg, Nita or Dom before each outing. Run, jump and explore 20 levels across four destinations: Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Salvador and the Amazon rainforest. Each dog has a different way to play: Meg's speed, Nita's brief glide and Dom's higher jump.

DISCOVER BRAZIL WITH THE GANG
• Explore Copacabana's promenade, ride a cable car and go hang gliding.
• Discover Minas's slopes and rooftops, mine lanterns and the Maria-Fumaça steam train.
• Climb through Salvador, cross the bay with a kite and find Bonfim ribbons.
• Explore the Amazon's rivers and treetops, swing on vines and cross the water on giant water lilies.

A JOURNEY TO EXPLORE
• Find three travel stamps in each level and collect postcards in the album.
• Pick up seashells, crystals, ribbons and seeds along the way.
• Revisit completed levels to find the discoveries you missed.
• If you stumble, Letty helps you return to the checkpoint without losing what you found.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Use the direction and jump buttons on the screen. Adjust text size, reduce motion and control music and sound effects separately. The adventure works offline, and progress is saved on your device.

The first level has no ads. After completing it, ads may appear on the map, in the album, on results from the second level and between levels, subject to age and privacy protections. Ads never interrupt gameplay. When available and eligible, an optional video offers 30 minutes without between-level ads; banners remain. Watching is never required to play.

Get your album ready and travel with the Gang.

OPTIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS
Connect to Game Center whenever you choose to share 11 adventure achievements. Connecting is optional: every level remains available without an account.

name: TickHalo: Floating Clock
description:
Keep time close with TickHalo.

A clear clock for your desk, a floating clock while you use other apps, and simple tools for focused work.

CLOCK, YOUR WAY
Choose a digital clock, switch between 12-hour and 24-hour time, and open a full-screen display. Preview additional clock faces, colors and typography before deciding what suits you.

TIME IN SIGHT
Start Picture in Picture for a floating clock. Use Live Activities on supported devices, and add clock, event or focus widgets to your Home Screen. System availability and background behavior vary by device and iOS.

FOCUS AND COUNT DOWN
Use a configurable focus-and-break cycle, a countdown or a stopwatch. Track your focus history and keep upcoming events nearby with optional local reminders.

FREE EVERYDAY TOOLS
Basic clock styles, floating display, Live Activities, basic widgets, timers, events and focus statistics are free.

OPTIONAL PRO, ONE PURCHASE
Pro unlocks selected clock faces, additional palettes, custom colors, typography, premium widget faces and Live Activity appearance options. It is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Eligible devices may see an introductory offer during their first seven days. Prices and availability are displayed by the App Store. Restore existing purchases from Settings or the Pro page.

No sign-in is required. Your timers, preferences and event records are stored locally on your device.

name: Ticki: Clock, Money & Math
description:
Ticki is a little bear who loves to learn – best of all together with your child. In three lovingly designed worlds, kids practice everyday math they really need: telling time, handling money and sharing fairly.

TELL TIME
Drag the hands, set hours and minutes and read the time: from o’clock and half past to quarter past and quarter to, all the way down to five minutes. The short orange hand shows the hours, the long green hand shows the minutes – easy to remember. In Explore mode kids can turn the hands freely.

SHOP
Pay the exact amount with play money, get to know pennies, nickels, dimes and quarters, trade bills for smaller ones and count back change. Tap coins and bills or drag them onto the counter.

TICKI’S CAFÉ
Share cookies fairly among plates, serve cups to guests at tables and discover counting by 2s, 5s and 10s. After every solution Ticki shows how to write the equation.

LEARNING THAT FEELS GOOD
• Ticki talks with a warm, natural voice: he reads tasks aloud, gives hints and cheers.
• On the first visit to each world, Ticki shows how it works in a short demo.
• Friendly feedback instead of red crosses – Ticki explains what is still missing.
• A star for every solved task, a painted sticker for every five stars.
• No time pressure, no point deductions. Everything can be tried out.
• Ticki blinks, hops with joy and giggles when you tap him.

FOR PARENTS
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.
• No data collection, no tracking. Works without internet.
• Stars, stickers and the (optional) first name stay on the device.
• A protected parent area with settings and progress.
• For iPhone, iPad and Mac – portrait and landscape.
• In the US the shop uses dollars and cents; in euro countries it uses euros.

Made for kids about 6 to 8 years old, especially kindergarten through second grade.

name: TileAtelierPro
description: TileAtelierPro on työpajasovellus mosaiikkitöiden suunnitteluun ja mitoitukseen. Sovellus laskee laattojen määrän, laattojaon, liiman ja saumausmassan sekä arvioidun työajan. Asetuksia voi tallentaa ja tekniset tiedot voi viedä. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla.

name: Tilt Temple: Marble Maze
description:
Tilt your phone and the whole temple tilts with it.

Roll a marble through floating ruins high above the clouds. Collect three gems, reach the golden gate, and try not to drop into the void. Every temple is a new world with a new trick to master.

EIGHT TEMPLES, 120 LEVELS
• Sun Court – sun-baked sandstone, ramps, ferries and switches
• Greenwood Bridges – pale stone bridges that crumble behind you
• Cinder Forge – basalt halls with magnet floors above a sea of lava
• Frost Sanctum – slippery ice and portals in the falling snow
• Tide Shrine – platforms that sink under the waves and rise again
• Star Spire – launch pads that throw you across the stars
• Neon Citadel – laser gates that flicker on and off
• Crown Palace – gold arms sweeping round marble pillars

REAL 3D PHYSICS
Your marble rolls, slides and bounces under real physics. Tilt gently to creep along a narrow ledge, or lean in and race the clock.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Tilt controls calibrated to however you hold your phone, or an on-screen stick
• Race your own ghost to beat your best time
• Checkpoints on longer levels
• Colour-blind markings, reduced motion and larger text options

MARBLES TO COLLECT
Earn new marbles with the gems you collect, or pick up animated premium marbles with their own trails.

Tilt Temple is free to play with optional ads. A one-off purchase removes ads, and premium marbles are optional extras. No account needed, and it plays offline.

name: Tilt Tide
description:
Steer a droplet to the drain. The maze stays put; the puzzle is the droplet’s state.

WATER, ICE AND VAPOUR
Cold freezes the droplet to ice, so it can skate and smash cracked walls. Heat melts it back to water, so it can slip through narrow gaps. Steam vents turn it to vapour that rises and floats over pits. Timed freeze and melt gates change the path while you play.

CAMPAIGN
A set of original mazes that teach each state in turn, from an open spillway to needle-eye gaps and the first vent of steam.

MAZE BUILDER
Paint your own maze, test it, and share a short Tilt Tide code. Friends can import the code and play your layout. Borders stay walls, and the code is checksummed so a typo does not become a broken maze.

DAILY MAZE
Every UTC day, everyone gets the same seeded maze. Keep a streak, and compare times on the optional Daily Game Center leaderboard. Your stars and streak also stay on the device if Game Center is off.

ADS
The game is free to play and may show adverts on the menu and level select, never mid-maze. An optional Remove Ads purchase turns those off. A rewarded hint is available if you want one.

Made by Thomas Upson in the UK.

name: TimanttiKarki
description: TimanttiKarki saataa timanttikorjaimen karjen, laikan, oikaisuvetojen ja tasapainon tarkkaan hiomapinnan puhdistukseen.

name: Tools & Equip
description:
Tools & Equip keeps track of your company's tools and equipment: what you have, where it is, who has it, and what needs service. Scan a label, move it, done.

SCAN AND MOVE
• Scan Tools & Equip QR labels, barcodes or serial tags with the camera, or type a tool number.
• Check tools out to people and jobs, and back in to the shop, yard or tool crib.
• Scan out / in: scan a whole truckload in a row and move it all at once.
• Scanning keeps working without a signal; moves wait on the phone and send when you are back online.

KNOW WHERE EVERYTHING IS
• One search box finds any tool by number, description, make, model, serial, location, job or holder.
• Location view: everything at each storage place, on each job and with each person.
• Tool pages with photos, details, history and comments.

REQUESTS AND RENTALS
• Field crews and project managers request tools for a job; the crib sees the request, marks it ready and says where to pick it up.
• Keep rented equipment on record by job, with on-hire and off-hire dates, so nothing stays on rent by accident.

SERVICE, WORK ORDERS AND AUDITS
• See service and inspections that are overdue, due soon or never recorded, and record them from the phone.
• Work orders for repairs, with meters and notes.
• Audit a location, job or kit by scanning what is there and see what is missing.

Works on iPhone and iPad, in landscape and portrait, and on any connection.

An account is needed. Your company's Tools & Equip account and its people, locations and jobs are set up at toolsandequip.com; then everyone signs in to the app with their work email and a 6-digit code.

name: Tottock
description:
「これいい」と思ったリンクを、1か所に。

YouTube、TikTok、X、Instagram、Pinterest、note、ニュースや記事。いろんなアプリで見つけたリンクを、サムネつきで保存して、自分のジャンルに分けられます。

■ 共有するだけで保存
ほかのアプリの共有ボタンから Tottock を選び、ジャンルを選んで保存。タイトルとサムネは自動で取ってきます。

■ サムネの壁で見返す
保存したリンクは、2列のサムネの壁に並びます。サムネが弱い記事や投稿は、大きな字のカードになります。

■ ジャンルは自分で作る
はじめから決まったジャンルはありません。自分の分け方で作り、長押しで並べかえ。カードの所を左右にめくって、ジャンルを切りかえられます。

■ さがす
すべてのジャンルから、タイトルやサイト名でさがせます。

■ この iPhone の中だけに保存
保存したリンクは、この iPhone の中だけにあります。アカウントの登録はいりません。

これから、PC のブラウザからの保存や、iPhone と PC の同期を足していく予定です。

name: Tramoia TV
description:
A Tramoia TV é o ecrã partilhado da tua mesa. Lê o QR da televisão na app Tramoia e confirma a sala com o comando.

Acompanha perguntas, participação, revelações, desafios de ação e classificação. Cada jogador responde no seu telemóvel; a TV não é um jogador nem controla a partida.

As fotografias aparecem apenas quando estão autorizadas para TV. Imagens em segredo ou sem consentimento ficam fora do ecrã partilhado. O anfitrião pode desligar a TV da sala a qualquer momento.

Precisas de uma sala Tramoia ativa, de três a oito jogadores nos seus telemóveis e de ligação à internet. Os aparelhos não precisam de estar na mesma rede Wi-Fi. A TV é opcional para jogar Tramoia. Ao reiniciar a app TV, emparelha novamente.

name: Trunkle: Flashcard Maker
description:
Trunkle turns your lecture slides into flashcards, right on your iPhone. No account, no upload, no ads.

Add a PDF, a few screenshots or a camera scan. Trunkle reads every slide and suggests cards: definitions, key points and fill in the blank. You keep the ones you want, fix any card in one tap, and add your own.

EVERY CARD SHOWS ITS SLIDE
- Flip a card and see the exact part of the slide it came from
- Scanned slides and photos work too: text is read on the device
- On supported devices, smart question cards are written on the device with Apple Intelligence

REVIEW AT THE RIGHT TIME
- Spaced repetition brings each card back right before you would forget it
- One Study now button for everything due today, across all your decks
- Set an exam date and see the countdown on every deck
- Cram a whole deck before the exam without changing your schedule
- Daily reminder at the time you choose, and a home screen widget

YOUR CARDS, YOUR WAY
- Write cards by hand, paste notes, or import a CSV
- Export any deck as a CSV you can import into Anki
- Search decks and cards, rename, edit and delete
- Works offline. Nothing leaves your device

TRUNKLE PRO, PAY ONCE
Reviewing, writing cards, CSV import and export and 3 slide imports are included for everyone. Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription:
- Unlimited slide imports from PDFs, photos, scans and pasted text
- Quiz mode: multiple choice questions made from your own cards

Privacy Policy: https://trunkle.sanghuynhxuan.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Truthiva: Body Reaction Lab
description:
When you talk, your body talks too.

Truthiva uses your phone camera to capture subtle changes in heartbeat and facial expression, compares them with your own calm baseline, and turns invisible body reactions into clear charts and plain-language explanations. Great as a party conversation game, a self-awareness exercise, or a hands-on way to explore psychophysiology.

SEE YOUR BODY REACT
• Camera heart rate: rPPG (POS algorithm) estimates your pulse from tiny skin-colour changes, with a live pulse waveform
• 76-point facial landmarks: a futuristic neon dot mesh tracks brow raises, frowns, lip-corner pulls and lip presses
• Reactivity index 0–100: compared with your own calm state. Green steady, yellow mild, red clear change

A LAB-STYLE FLOW
• Baseline: record a calm state first, with live hints like "move closer", "centre your face", "too dark"
• Questions: prepare them in advance or just tap "Next question"; rest countdowns keep reactions separate
• The baseline extends automatically when data are insufficient, with a clear "complete" signal

PROFESSIONAL REPORTS YOU CAN READ
• Plain-language summary: what changed in each question, how much, and how fast it settled
• Multi-channel timeline: heart rate, face, head motion and voice together
• Facial landmark cloud: baseline vs event apex side by side, showing even subtle movements
• Statistics inspired by psychophysiology research: effect sizes, confidence intervals, pre-question baselines, habituation
• Export polished PDF reports and CSV data

PRIVACY FIRST
• All analysis happens on your device. No images, audio or data are uploaded
• No recording and no face images stored; only encrypted numbers
• No account, no ads, no tracking
