Will you build a house for new arrivals, plant a linden tree to make life a little sweeter, or set some gold aside to repair the crystal?

Every patch of land counts. A windmill helps your settlement earn more gold, but it also adds to pollution. Trees clean the air and keep the islanders happy. How well your settlement is doing determines when you can tackle the next repair.

Air Island includes all three minigames. Each gives you a different resource for your settlement.

Air Island - Bubbles: Match bubbles to collect water.
Air Island - Arkaball: Bounce the ball and break the wall apart to collect bricks.
Air Island - Xonix: Fell trees to gather wood.

At the market, you can trade your surplus for supplies you need.

Each repair restores some of the Gravitator’s energy. As you make progress, you’ll unlock more things to build. Even after the crystal is fully restored, you can keep tending your island.

Air Island is a remake of SPB Air Islands, rebuilt from the ground up. The original came out in 2006 for Pocket PC devices running Windows Mobile. This remake pays tribute to the golden age of those handhelds and, above all, to the game that put a little world above the clouds in the palm of your hand. Some classics deserve to live again.

What are you waiting for?
Come save your island above the clouds!

name: Air Island - Arkaball
description:
Arkaball brings classic Arkanoid-style brick breaking to iPhone and iPad. The paddle is at the bottom, a brick wall is at the top, and the ball bounces between them. Slide the paddle with your finger to send the ball back into the wall. Let it slip past and you lose a life.

Some bricks break on the first hit. Others take a few more. When there’s just one brick left near the side, try catching the ball with the edge of your paddle to send it off at a sharper angle. Clear the wall and another one awaits. The game gets faster as you go.

You might remember Arkaball from the Pocket PC days. Back in 2006, it was one of three minigames in SPB Air Islands for Windows Mobile. Now you can play it on its own on iPhone and iPad. If you also play Air Island, turn on rewards to earn bricks to build your settlement above the clouds.

Up for one more wall?

name: Air Island - Bubbles
description:
In Bubbles, aim with your finger and lift it to shoot. Hit a group of two or more bubbles that match the color of yours and the whole group pops. Any bubbles left hanging without support fall with it.

In Puzzle mode, you have a limited number of shots to clear each pattern. Before you shoot, check which color is coming next. Sometimes it pays to leave a gap for your next shot. If you can’t reach a cluster directly, try bouncing your bubble off the wall. Choose your difficulty and pick up where you left off next time. The game saves your progress.

You might remember Bubbles from the Pocket PC days. Back in 2006, it was one of three minigames in SPB Air Islands for Windows Mobile. Now you can play it on its own on iPhone and iPad. If you also play Air Island, turn on rewards to stock up on water for your settlement above the clouds.

How many bubbles can you bring down with a single shot?

name: Air Island - Xonix
description:
In Xonix, you’re looking out over a forest clearing with twelve stumps. As soon as a tree springs up on one, another appears somewhere else. You have a minute to score points, and each tree disappears after a moment. Tap once to chop down a spruce or twice in quick succession for a linden.

Keep an eye on the whole clearing. While you’re tapping a linden for the second time, a spruce might already be peeking out a few stumps away. Watch out for bees, though. Hit one and you lose a life.

You might remember Xonix from the Pocket PC days. Back in 2006, it was one of three minigames in SPB Air Islands for Windows Mobile. Now you can play it on its own on iPhone and iPad. If you also play Air Island, turn on rewards to earn wood to build your settlement above the clouds.

One more round to beat your high score?

name: Aircraft Encyclopedia
description:
Every aircraft. One place.

Aircraft Encyclopedia brings 60 of the world's most important aircraft into one beautiful, easy-to-use guide: airliners, private jets and military aircraft, each with real photographs, checked specifications and the story behind it.

EXPLORE
• 60 aircraft across Commercial, Private and Military
• Real, credited photographs for every aircraft
• Range, seats, speed, engines, first flight and more, in kilometres or nautical miles
• Browse by manufacturer: Airbus, Boeing, Gulfstream, Bombardier, Embraer and others
• Save favourites to your own Hangar and add notes

EXPERIENCE
• Aircraft Size Studio: stand an aircraft beside a bus or a football pitch
• Aviation Time Machine: 20 milestones from 1903 to today
• Explain It My Way: every aircraft at three reading levels
• Aircraft Sound Lounge
• Compare any two aircraft side by side
• Fly mode: take a 3D aircraft over a real globe (for fun, not for training or navigation)

FOR YOU
Fresh aviation videos and podcast episodes, picked around the aircraft you look at, updated daily.

MAGAZINE AND EVENTS
Original stories from the Aircraft Encyclopedia editors, and a calendar of the world's biggest airshows with countdowns.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no adverts, no tracking. Your saved aircraft and notes stay on your phone. Works offline.

Built for aviation lovers, students, spotters and anyone who has ever looked up at a plane and wondered what it was.

name: Airelay WiFi File Transfer
description:
Move files from a computer to your iPhone or iPad using a web browser. Upload, organize, preview, and download files over the same Wi-Fi network, without an account or cloud service.

OPEN. PAIR. TRANSFER.
Keep Airelay open, enter the address shown in the app into another device's browser, and pair using the six-digit code. Codes change every 30 seconds, with a short grace period for entering the previous code. Paired browsers stay connected until sharing stops.

A PRACTICAL FILE EXPLORER
Create folders and nested folders. Drag files into folders in the app or browser, or use the Move command. Search, rename, select multiple items, and delete with confirmation. Each file can be up to 2 GB, subject to available storage.

PREVIEW AND SHARE
Preview supported images, videos, and documents in the browser. Use native Quick Look on iPhone and iPad, then open the Share menu to send files with AirDrop or other installed apps. Preview support depends on the file format and device.

YOUR APP STORAGE, CLEARLY SEPARATED
The web portal exposes only files received into Airelay's own storage. It cannot browse your photo library, external Files-provider documents, or another app's storage. Transfers stay on your local network; Airelay does not upload them to a cloud service. There are no accounts, ads, or analytics SDKs.

MAKE THE BROWSER YOUR OWN
Choose Auto, Light, Dark, Amber, or Green. Language and appearance preferences are saved on your iPhone or iPad. The app and portal support English, Russian, Italian, Ukrainian, French, Kazakh, and Spanish.

BEFORE YOU CONNECT
Keep Airelay open in the foreground and connect both devices to the same trusted Wi-Fi network. HTTP transfers are unencrypted. Anyone with a paired browser session can access received files while sharing is active. Turning sharing off, locking the device, or leaving the app stops sharing; completed files remain available in the app.

name: aiwaCore
description:
aiwaCore brings your team's business conversations and support work to iPhone and iPad. Sign in with your existing administrator-issued aiwaCore account to access the channels and tools assigned to you.

BUSINESS CONVERSATIONS
• View authorized WhatsApp channels and customer conversations.
• Reply with text, voice notes and supported attachments.
• Follow message delivery and read status.
• Keep work organized with conversation assignments, resolution and inbox controls, subject to your permissions.

TEAM WORKSPACE
• Access available business identity records and website inquiries.
• Manage staff and roles when your administrator permissions allow it.
• Work with your existing aiwaCore account across supported devices.

NOTIFICATIONS AND ACCOUNT CONTROLS
• Enable alerts for incoming WhatsApp messages.
• Open an authorized conversation directly from its message notification.
• Manage notification access in the app and device settings.
• Request account and associated personal-data deletion from Settings, with explicit consent and password confirmation. Requests are handled manually by the aiwaCore owner within one calendar month.

aiwaCore requires an existing authorized staff account. There is no public account registration in the app. Available channels and administrative features depend on your account permissions.

For help, visit https://aiwacore.web.app/legal/mobile-support.html.

name: Alhams: Prayer Times & Qibla
description:
Ramadan and Hijri Calendar for the Modern Muslim.

Alhams is a calm, simple companion for your daily prayers. Prayer times, the Qibla and the Hijri calendar are calculated on your iPhone, so it works offline. No ads, no account, no tracking. The name Alhams means "the whisper": a quiet reminder.

TODAY
- A sky that changes with the time of day, and a countdown to the next prayer.
- Today's date in the Gregorian and Hijri calendars.
- Mark each prayer as prayed.
- A verse of the day in Arabic and English, to read in context or share.

PRAYER TIMES
- Times for where you are, or for any city you choose.
- The calculation method is chosen for your region, or pick another. Standard or Hanafi Asr, and a rule for places far north or south.
- Adjust any time to match your masjid, and add its iqamah and Jumu'ah times.
- Check the times for the days ahead.
- Tap a prayer for a short guide to its rakat in the four Sunni schools.

REMINDERS
- A reminder when each prayer begins. Choose the prayers you want.
- Pick the sound: a gentle bell that changes with each prayer, one bell for every prayer, a soft chime, or no sound.
- An early reminder 10, 15 or 30 minutes before, if you like. Early and Ramadan reminders have their own gentle sounds.
- Send yourself a test reminder to hear how it sounds.
- Mark a prayer as prayed, or snooze for 10 minutes, from the notification.

QIBLA
- A compass that points to the Kaaba, with the direction and the distance.
- It follows the sky like the rest of the app, with a compass made to stand out by day, at golden hour, at dusk and at night.
- Help to calibrate the compass.
- Without location, a dial still shows the direction from your chosen city.

HIJRI CALENDAR
- A month view with Hijri dates, Ramadan, Eid and other observances, and notes from Islamic history.
- Tap a day to see its prayer times.
- Dates are calculated. If your masjid's date differs, shift them by a day or two.

RAMADAN
- Countdowns to suhoor and iftar, and a card for today's fast.
- Suhoor, imsak and iftar reminders.
- A warm Ramadan theme, which you can turn off.

APPEARANCE
- By default the sky on every tab follows the time of day where you are.
- Or choose Match iPhone (light or dark, as your iPhone is set), Light or Dark.

GIVE
- A private record of your zakat, sadaqah and zakat al-fitr, with totals for each Hijri and calendar year.
- Hide the amounts with one tap.
- Alhams takes no payments. It keeps a record of what you give elsewhere.

WIDGETS
- Your next prayer on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen. The large widget adds the verse of the day.

TRAVEL
- Save up to 10 places. When you travel, open Alhams when you arrive, and your times, reminders and widgets update.

YOUR PRIVACY
- Alhams collects no data. There is no account and no server.
- Your location is used only on your iPhone, and you can choose a city instead.
- Deleting the app deletes its data.

GOOD TO KNOW
Prayer times are calculated from your location and chosen method, so your masjid's timetable may differ by a few minutes. Hijri dates may differ from your masjid's by a day. Quran text: Tanzil Project. English translation: Talal Itani, ClearQuran. Alhams is in English and needs iOS 26 or later.

Questions or ideas? support@alhamsapp.com
Privacy policy: https://alhamsapp.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://alhamsapp.com/terms

name: ALink Remote
description:
ALink Remote is the controller for the ALink family. Connect to a device you own or that someone has chosen to share with you, and see its screen live.

REAL-TIME SCREEN
· Smooth, sharp video with HEVC and automatic quality that adapts to the network
· Choose quality and smoothness yourself, up to the shared device's limits
· Live connection status: round-trip latency, download and upload

TALK AND HELP
· Two-way intercom, or listen to the shared device's audio
· Send assistance messages that arrive as notifications
· Exchange files the other person has chosen to share

MULTIPLE DEVICES
· Keep several devices in one list and switch with a tap
· Pair by scanning a private invitation QR code — no account needed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
· Devices connect directly on your network with an encrypted, pre-shared key
· Optional access from anywhere with your own Tailscale account
· No ALink account, no ads, no tracking

Screen sharing always starts on the shared device, through Apple's system screen broadcast, and can be stopped there at any time. Use ALink Screen Share on the device you want to view.

name: ALink Screen Share
description:
ALink Screen Share lets someone you trust see your iPhone screen in ALink Remote, so they can guide you step by step.

SIMPLE
· Show a private invitation QR code; your helper scans it once
· Tap Start screen sharing and confirm the iOS system sheet
· Stop anytime from the red status indicator

TALK AND HELP
· Two-way intercom, off until you turn it on
· Assistance messages arrive as notifications; swipe to delete
· Share selected files with your helper, and receive files from them

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
· Your helper can only view — they cannot tap or type on your iPhone
· Encrypted direct connection on your network with a private key
· Optional access from anywhere with your own Tailscale account
· No ALink account, no ads, no tracking

Install ALink Remote on the helper's iPhone to view your screen. In the app this edition is shown as ALink Standard.

name: Almanac: On This Day History
description:
What happened on this day? Almanac puts one moment from history on your lock screen, every day, and tells its story in a minute when you tap it.

THE LOCK SCREEN, FIRST
Add the Almanac widget under the clock. Each day brings three events from different centuries; the widget shows one at a time and changes through the day. Tap it, and the story opens.

SHORT STORIES, CHECKED
Every entry is a short story written in our own words from Wikipedia's articles and checked against them, with links to the sources. Science, exploration, culture, sport, discovery and the turning points of politics: a mix from every part of the world.

A CALM PAGE
Almanac is designed like a printed almanac: paper and ink, clear type, no clutter. Swipe between days to read what happened yesterday or next week. Light and dark appearance.

A MORNING NOTE, IF YOU LIKE
Turn on the morning note to get the day's first entry as a quiet notification at the time you choose.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything is on your phone and works offline.

Widgets: lock screen (iOS 16 and later) and home screen.
Content is based on Wikipedia and shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: Alpha Companion
description:
Alpha Companion brings the photos from your Sony mirrorless camera to your iPhone, wirelessly and without a second thought. Turn the camera on: the app finds it, connects and imports the new photos, even with the screen locked.

AUTOMATIC IMPORT
• Connects as soon as the camera answers on its Wi-Fi, and reconnects if the signal drops
• Live progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Never the same photo twice
• USB cable for faster transfers and RAW files

GEOTAGGING
• Your iPhone sends its location to the camera over Bluetooth, and it is written into every photo
• Camera not linked? The app places the photos on your GPS track when importing
• Outing log: route and photos on the map, GPX export for Lightroom or Capture One

REMOTE AND TIMELAPSE
• Remote shutter, self-timer, long exposure and video
• Shoot button on the Lock Screen
• Intervalometer, then the timelapse is edited on your iPhone

SORTING AND ALBUMS
• Blurry shots spotted, the best frame of each burst highlighted
• One album per outing in Photos, named by day and place
• Stats: focal lengths, apertures, shutter speeds, ISO

No account, no ads, no data collected: everything stays on your iPhone. Available in English, French, German, Japanese, Dutch and Spanish.

COMPATIBLE CAMERAS
• Wi-Fi import and geotagging: α7 III, α7R III, α7R IV, α7C, α9, α9 II, α6100, α6400, α6500, α6600, ZV-E10, ZV-1, RX100 VI, RX100 VII, RX10 IV, RX0 II
• Same with system software older than version 2.00: α1, α7 IV, α7R V (3.00 for the α7S III)
• Wi-Fi import only: α7 II, α7R II, α7S II, α5100, α6000, α6300
• Bluetooth remote: the models in the first two lines, except the α6500, RX100 VI and RX10 IV
• Remote only: α7C II, α7CR, α9 III, α1 II, α6700, ZV-E10 II, ZV-E1, ZV-1 II, ZV-1F. They moved to Creators' App and no longer offer “Send to Smartphone”.
Details by model, and what we tested ourselves, are on the support page.

Alpha Companion is an independent app, not affiliated with Sony. Sony and Alpha are trademarks of Sony Group Corporation.

name: AnalogDAW Tune
description:
AnalogDAW Tune brings real-time vocal pitch correction to compatible AUv3 hosts on Mac, iPad and iPhone. Keep the movement in a lead vocal, snap to a scale for a stepped effect, or blend in an octave for a new texture.

CONTROL HOW THE VOCAL MOVES
Start with Natural for everyday correction, Gentle for a lighter touch, or Hard Tune for fast, stepped transitions. Adjust Retune Speed, Strength, Flex and Humanize to shape slides, vibrato and sustained notes. Read detected pitch, the selected target and correction in cents as the track plays.

CHOOSE WHICH NOTES TO TUNE
Set your key, scale, vocal range and A4 reference. Use the six-octave keyboard to add or remove a target in one register, leave a sung note uncorrected, or link edits across octaves.

SHIFT PITCH AND FORMANTS
Transpose a tuned vocal up or down an octave and adjust its formants independently. Use Shift Mix to blend the tuned and shifted voices, or choose Octave Double as a starting point.

WORK IN YOUR HOST OR AUDITION A FILE
Insert AnalogDAW Tune on an isolated lead vocal or another single-note source in an AUv3 effects host. It processes mono or stereo audio, exposes AU parameters for compatible host automation, and recalls its settings with the host project. The included app lets you open a local audio file and hear the effect without a host. Use your host to record or export processed audio.

Audio processing stays on your device. No account is required.

name: Anchoryn
description:
Anchorfall is an offline physics puzzle game set on open water.

You never steer the boat directly. Instead, throw an anchor, tune the chain length, and ride inertia, currents, and momentum to reach the dock.

How to play
• Tap the sea to throw an anchor
• Use the slider to change chain length while anchored
• Retract to release the chain and keep your speed
• Avoid rocks and barrels, latch onto buoys, and collect treasure chests

Features
• 100 handcrafted levels across 5 seas
• Pure physics puzzles — swing, slide, and plan every move
• 3-star challenges based on chests and action count
• Offline play — no account, no ads, no network required
• Sound, music, and vibration settings

From calm bays to whirlpool depths, every level asks the same question: where do you drop the anchor?

name: Animalandia: Kids Animal Games
description:
Animalandia is a world of animals made for little ones, from 2 to 5 years old.

A lion that roars, a giraffe that stretches its neck, a panda that goes fishing, a dinosaur with its eggs: 13 lovingly drawn, lively and funny animals in 13 habitats full of surprises to tap.

16 MINI GAMES
• Explore: tap the animals and their world and see what happens
• Feeding time: give the right food to the hungry animal
• Tower: stack the blocks while counting… then knock it all down!
• Puzzle: big pieces that snap into place like a magnet
• Fishing: tap a fish and it lands in the bucket
• Bubbles: pop the colourful bubbles and free the cubs
• Hide and seek: who's hiding behind the bush?
• Concert: tap the animal in the spotlight and sing on the beat
• And, unlocked with stars: Night, Net fishing, Footprints, Vet, Kitchen, Memory, Nature race and Noah's little train

MADE FOR CHILDREN
• Nothing to read: simple taps and drags
• No way to fail: a mistake just makes a friendly "boing"
• A little hand shows the gesture when needed
• The "?" button shows how every game is played
• Levels that grow slowly

LOTS OF REWARDS
Stars, a gift box at the end of every level, parties with balloons and fireworks, stickers and 32 toys to collect in the album.

FOR PARENTS
• No ads and no in-app purchases
• No data collected, no account
• Works offline
• Protected parents' area: sounds, music, voice, language
• 5 languages: English, Italian, French, Spanish, German
• Adapts to the device: smooth even on entry-level tablets

Real animal sounds and a cheerful tune for every game.

CREDITS
Animals, habitats and scenes are drawn in code from scratch for Animalandia. Objects: Microsoft Fluent Emoji (MIT licence). Font: Fredoka (SIL Open Font License). Animal sounds, effects and music: Freesound.org (Creative Commons 0). Voice: the device's text-to-speech. The full list is in the parents' area.

name: Aperture NVR
description:
Aperture is the app for Aperture, the network video recorder you run on your own hardware. Your video stays on your server; the app connects to it directly.

- Live view of every camera, including H.265 cameras, with picture-in-picture
- A timeline per camera: scroll back through recordings, with detections marked where they happened
- Events: people, vehicles, animals and packages detected by your server, filtered by type and camera
- Notifications with a snapshot, end-to-end encrypted (optional)
- Sign in with your Aperture account, or scan the pairing code from the web app
- Switches automatically between your home address and your remote address
- Face ID lock and a home-screen widget
- English and German

Aperture needs an Aperture server (version 1.4 or later). It doesn't work with other recorders or cloud cameras.

name: Apiary: A Home for Stingers
description:
Apiary is a cart machine for live events, built for the iPad.

Fill a honeycomb of buttons with walk-up songs, stingers and sound effects, run your background music from its own column, and play it all with one hand while you watch the stage.

BUTTONS THAT HIT ON CUE
• 10 pages of buttons, each with its own name, color or picture
• Set exact start and end points on a zoomable waveform
• Start at the hook: Apiary finds where a song kicks in and starts there with one tap
• Silence at the top of a song is trimmed automatically
• Fade in, fade when pressed again, fade at the end
• Buttons dim once played, so you always know what's been used
• The border of a playing button counts down the time left

BACKGROUND MUSIC THAT GETS OUT OF THE WAY
• A playlist column on every page, with a dropdown to switch playlists on the fly
• Tap any song to play it out of order
• Buttons and music take turns: a walk-up pauses the music, and starting the music fades the buttons
• Sound effects play over the top without stopping anything

BUILT FOR THE SHOW
• Works fully offline. No streaming, no account, no internet needed
• Load songs you own from your Music library, from Files, or a whole playlist onto buttons at once
• 24 built-in sound effects, made for Apiary
• Fade All, then Stop All, for when it has to stop now
• Auto-level keeps loud and quiet songs at the same volume
• Lock the screen against accidental edits

SHARE AND CONTROL
• Send a show to another iPad with the songs included, or as settings only, matched to that iPad's own library
• OSC trigger mode turns the grid into a control surface for lighting, video and other gear on your local network

SIX LOOKS
Honey, Wax, Cart Deck, Playout, Stage Tape and Signal.

Apiary is free, with no ads, no subscriptions and no data collection.

name: Apothecary Guild
description: Welcome to Apothecary Guild, a cozy workshop where every card becomes an ingredient. Discover nine poker-inspired recipes with different yields and brewing times. Balance copper kettles and aging shelves, choose quick sales or premium matured bottles, and fulfill changing customer requests. Purchase daily ingredients, invest in workshop upgrades and study your season ledger. Play at your own pace: time advances only when you close the day. Beautiful original botanical artwork, and System/Light/Dark appearance. Fully offline, no accounts, ads or in-app purchases. This is a production strategy game with no prizes

name: Apperia
description:
Apperia je systém na správu krátkodobých prenájmov – apartmánov a bytov na Booking.com, Airbnb aj s priamymi rezerváciami. Všetko, čo prenajímateľ potrebuje, má v jednej appke.

• Kalendár a rezervácie zo všetkých kanálov na jednom mieste
• Ceny a dostupnosť sa posielajú na Booking.com a Airbnb automaticky
• Správy hosťom z Bookingu, Airbnb, WhatsAppu, SMS aj e-mailu v jednom vlákne
• Online check-in a overenie totožnosti hosťa, PIN k dverám alebo keyboxu
• Upratovanie – rozpis pre upratovačky, stav bytov a fotky po upratovaní
• Faktúry hosťom, platby a prehľad tržieb
• Push notifikácie o nových rezerváciách a správach
• Prihlásenie cez Face ID

Appka je určená pre prenajímateľov a ich tím (upratovačky, správcovia). Na prihlásenie potrebujete účet v Apperii – viac na apperia.sk.

name: APRENDIZIA
description:
APRENDIZIA arma misiones de repaso a medida para cada alumno, a partir de lo que ve en la escuela.

• Misiones cortitas de matemática, lengua y otras materias, pensadas para su nivel y su año.
• Una familia puede subir fotos del cuaderno o de una prueba, y las próximas misiones se arman con esos temas.
• Un modo padres, protegido con clave, para ver cómo va y para manejar los datos.
• Voz para leer las consignas.

Hecha para chicos y chicas desde primaria. Gratis y sin publicidad.

Hoy APRENDIZIA se usa por invitación: para conectar la tablet hace falta un código que da su creador.

Privacidad: las actividades las arma una inteligencia artificial (Claude, de Anthropic). No le mandamos el nombre completo, el colegio ni los datos de contacto. La familia puede ver o borrar todos los datos desde la app.

Creada por Maximiliano Ariel Russo.

name: AR Bomb Squad
description:
Become the commander of an elite bomb squad, right in your own room.

AR Bomb Squad uses augmented reality to hide bombs in the space around you. Move your phone to search, line up the crosshair, and fire your disarming laser before time runs out.

HOW TO PLAY
• Look around with your phone to find the bombs.
• Aim the crosshair and tap anywhere to fire.
• Clear every bomb before the timer or your ammo runs out.
• Beat a stage to unlock the next one.

FEATURES
• 10 stages that get harder as you go: more bombs, less ammo, tighter timers
• Glowing tracer shots and a colour-coded HUD for bombs, bullets and time
• Heart-pounding countdown in the final seconds
• Progress saved on your device, so you can pick up where you left off
• No account needed

Requires an iPhone that supports ARKit. Play in a well-lit space with room to turn around, and stay aware of your surroundings.

name: AR City Hunt
description:
AR City Hunt maakt van een wandeling een echte speurtocht.

Op een kaart in middeleeuwse stijl zie je verstopte plekken in de buurt.
De app rekent een wandelroute voor je uit en geeft onderweg duidelijke aanwijzingen, zoals "over 250 m linksaf".
Sta je op de juiste plek, dan open je de camera en verschijnt daar een 3D-object in je echte omgeving.
Tik het aan om het te verzamelen en punten te scoren.
Bij elke vondst krijg je uitleg over de plek waar je staat.
Daarna wacht een klein spel in middeleeuwse stijl, goed voor extra bonuspunten.

Zo werkt het:

- Open de lijst met verstopte plekken en kies je doel.
- Volg de route op de kaart, stap voor stap.
- Kom binnen het aangegeven bereik van de plek.
- Open de camera en zoek het 3D-object in je omgeving.
- Tik het aan, verzamel je punten en lees het verhaal van de plek.

De eerste zoektocht loopt langs de bezienswaardigheden van Kruibeke en Bazel (Belgie).
Er komen regelmatig nieuwe zoektochten bij.

AR City Hunt heeft geen account nodig, toont geen advertenties en volgt je niet.

name: AR Tracing
description:
AR TRACING. IT TRACES. THAT'S THE APP.

Somewhere out there, a tracing app wants $9.99 a week. That's over $500 a year to look at a picture through your camera. For that money you could buy a very nice lamp, a stack of paper taller than you, and still have enough left over for a sandwich.

We made one that's free. Not "free for 3 days." Not "free with ads." Not "free if you share with 5 friends." Free. Like air. Or tracing paper, before someone tried to monetize it.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Take a photo or pick one from your library.
2. Remove the background with one tap. Turn it into an outline if you want clean lines.
3. Prop your phone up over a piece of paper, or tap Pin to Paper and let AR stick the image right onto the page.
4. Trace. Become an artist. Tell no one about the phone.

WHAT YOU GET
• Background removal, right on your iPhone
• Outline mode for crisp, traceable lines
• Flip, so you can trace mirrored (hello, transfers)
• Opacity slider to dial the image in over your paper
• Pinch, drag, and twist to size it exactly right
• Pin to Paper: AR lays the image flat on your page, so it stays put even when the phone moves
• Lock, so a stray finger can't nudge it mid-masterpiece
• Flashlight, for dim kitchens and dramatic artists
• Screen stays awake while you draw
• Your tracings, saved and ready for next time

WHAT YOU DON'T GET
• A subscription
• A "premium" tier
• Ads
• An account
• Push notifications begging you to come back
• A pop-up asking you to rate us 5 stars before you've drawn a single line
• Your data sent anywhere. Everything stays on your phone. We literally can't see it, and we don't want to.

WHO IT'S FOR
Kids. Parents. Muralists. Cake decorators. Tattoo artists sketching a stencil. Teachers. People who "can't draw." People who can draw but are tired. Anyone who has ever looked at a $9.99-a-week paywall and felt something die inside.

WHY IS IT FREE?
Because it's a tracing app. It puts a picture on top of your camera. We're not going to charge you rent for that.

No catch. We checked twice.

name: ArchiScan
description:
Faites le relevé complet d'un logement en quelques minutes : plan coté, surfaces Carrez, visite 3D et état des lieux signé, directement sur votre iPhone ou iPad.

POURQUOI ARCHISCAN
• Tout le dossier du bien dans une seule app : plan, surfaces, photos, état des lieux, devis
• Gratuit pour commencer, puis des formules moins chères que les outils professionnels habituels
• Essai gratuit de 14 jours sur chaque formule
• Aucun compte à créer, vos projets restent sur votre appareil

SCAN LIDAR EN DIRECT
• Le plan coté se dessine pendant que vous marchez dans la pièce
• Portes, fenêtres, radiateurs et équipements détectés automatiquement
• Plusieurs pièces et plusieurs étages, alignés tout seuls
• Sans LiDAR : dessinez les pièces au mètre ou au télémètre laser Bluetooth

SURFACES FIABLES
• Surface au sol, loi Carrez et surface habitable calculées pièce par pièce
• Zones de moins de 1,80 m et escaliers déduits automatiquement
• Attestation de superficie en PDF

SYNTHÈSE DU BIEN EN UN COUP D'ŒIL
• Graphiques des surfaces par pièce et par niveau
• Luminosité de chaque pièce
• Besoin de chauffage estimé, poste par poste
• Situation du bien sur la carte et itinéraire en un geste

ÉTAT DES LIEUX SIGNÉ À L'ÉCRAN
• Pré-rempli avec les pièces du plan
• État de chaque élément, commentaires et photos
• Relevés de compteurs et remise des clés
• Signature des deux parties au doigt ou à l'Apple Pencil
• État des lieux de sortie comparé automatiquement à l'entrée
• PDF prêt à envoyer

POUR PRÉPARER LES TRAVAUX
• Matériaux à acheter : pots de peinture, cartons de carrelage, parquet, plinthes, plaques de plâtre
• Métré et devis avec TVA
• Suivi des réserves avec photos et statuts
• Croquis à l'Apple Pencil sur le plan et sur les photos

PRÉSENTER ET PARTAGER
• Mode présentation client en plein écran
• Maquette 3D à faire pivoter
• Exports PDF à l'échelle, DXF, IFC, GLB, USDZ, OBJ et visite web
• Logo et coordonnées de votre agence sur les documents

ORGANISÉ
• Recherche par nom, client ou adresse
• Statuts Relevé, Devis, Chantier, Terminé
• Dossiers favoris épinglés en tête de liste

CONFIDENTIEL
Vos projets restent sur votre appareil et, si vous l'activez, dans votre propre iCloud Drive. Pas de compte, pas de serveur ArchiScan, pas de publicité, pas de suivi.

FORMULES
Découverte (gratuite) : 2 projets, plan 2D et 3D, PDF avec filigrane.
Plan, Pro et Expert : abonnements mensuels ou annuels avec 14 jours d'essai gratuit. Le paiement est débité sur votre compte Apple à la confirmation de l'achat, à la fin de l'essai. L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement sauf s'il est désactivé au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Gérez ou résiliez à tout moment dans les réglages de votre compte Apple.

Le scan nécessite un iPhone Pro ou un iPad Pro équipé du LiDAR. L'estimation thermique est indicative et ne remplace pas un DPE.

Conditions d'utilisation : contrat de licence standard d'Apple (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/)
Confidentialité : https://schmittutility.fr/confidentialite/
Assistance : https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/

name: Archivia Mail
description:
La casella è piena e non vuoi perdere nulla? Archivia Mail salva le tue email in PDF, con allegati e originali, in un archivio ordinato sul tuo dispositivo. Poi, solo dopo aver controllato che sia tutto al sicuro, libera spazio sul server.

COME FUNZIONA
1. Accedi con email e password: l'app trova da sola il server della tua casella.
2. Scegli quali email: tutte, solo le più vecchie (per esempio più di un anno) oppure un periodo preciso.
3. Tocca «Archivia in PDF»: ogni email diventa un PDF chiaro e leggibile con mittente, destinatari, data, oggetto e testo.
4. Quando vuoi, tocca «Libera spazio sul server»: l'app verifica l'archivio email per email e solo allora le sposta nel Cestino o le elimina.

UN ARCHIVIO ORDINATO
• Una cartella per ogni cartella della casella e una sottocartella per ogni mese
• Gli allegati salvati accanto ai PDF
• L'originale .eml di ogni messaggio, apribile con qualsiasi programma di posta
• Le PEC con il testo e gli allegati del messaggio incluso
• Se ripeti l'archiviazione, vengono salvate solo le email nuove

SICURA PER DAVVERO
• Nessuna email viene tolta dal server se non è nell'archivio con tutti i suoi file: se ne manca anche una, non si tocca niente
• Puoi scegliere di spostare le email nel Cestino invece di eliminarle
• La password non viene salvata e viaggia cifrata solo verso il server della tua posta
• Nessun account, nessuna pubblicità, nessun dato raccolto: le tue email restano tue

FUNZIONA CON
Aruba e Aruba PEC, Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo, Libero, Virgilio, TIM, Tiscali, Fastweb e quasi tutte le caselle che supportano IMAP, anche con un dominio personale.
Per Gmail e iCloud serve una «password per le app»: l'app spiega come crearla.
Non supportati: Outlook/Hotmail (Microsoft non permette l'accesso con password) e Proton Mail.

DOVE TROVI L'ARCHIVIO
• Mac: cartella Download › Archivio Mail
• iPhone e iPad: app File › Sul mio iPhone › Archivia Mail

Un solo acquisto vale per iPhone, iPad e Mac.

name: Aria Links
description:
Every day you post your business in a dozen places — a Facebook group here, your Instagram bio, a TikTok, a newsletter, a Google review card on the counter. Then somebody calls… and you have no idea which post did it.

Aria Links fixes that. Give every placement its own named link, and see exactly which post, page, bio, or email sent every click.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a place from the built-in directory of 129 places business owners actually post — Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, Yelp, your newsletter, and more — or make a link for anywhere else.
• Aria Links gives that placement its own short link on justaskaria.com (or on your own domain).
• Post it, print it, text it. Every tap is counted, and you see where it came from.

WHAT YOU SEE FOR EVERY CLICK
• The placement that sent it — no guesswork, no spreadsheets
• The country it came from, with a flag
• The device and browser — iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows
• Totals for all time, today, and the last 7 days, plus a country breakdown for each link

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR DATA
• Sign in with your phone number — no passwords to remember
• Bring your own domain and use it for your links
• A push notification when a link gets clicked (optional)
• Delete your account and everything in it, right from Settings

Aria Links is built by Just Ask Aria for home-based and small business owners who market themselves and want to know what's actually working. Post everywhere. Measure what matters.

name: ark.legacy
description:
ark.legacy helps you prepare what your loved ones will need to know and do after your death: your logins, accounts, documents and instructions.

Ariane, your guide, asks a few questions about your life, your devices, your logins and your papers. As you talk, she prepares draft entries for you to review.

WHAT YOU PREPARE
• Entries that answer three questions: what it is, how to access it, what to do.
• A protected field for passwords, typed on the keyboard and never sent to an AI.
• Voice messages and screen recordings, encrypted like your entries.
• One envelope per loved one, with the entries that concern them, in the order to follow.

ENCRYPTED ON YOUR DEVICE
• Everything is encrypted on the device before it is sent. The server cannot read your entries.
• The iPhone Secure Enclave or the Android Keystore protects the key. It opens with Face ID, fingerprint or passcode.
• A recovery kit, kept away from the device, reopens your file on another device. Without it, nobody can reopen it, not even us.
• Your file locks after five minutes of inactivity.

THE HANDOVER
A loved one reports the death. You are notified and can cancel during a waiting period. ark.swiss then checks the death certificate. Each loved one receives only their own envelope.

FIND YOUR TRACES
With your consent, Find looks for public pages linked to your name, usernames and town. You confirm what is yours and turn it into an entry.

AI, YOUR CHOICE
Sovereign mode by default: Qwen, hosted in Switzerland by Infomaniak. Performance mode: Anthropic’s Claude Haiku. Your entries and passwords are never sent to an AI.

In English, French, Italian and German. Offline, your entries stay available.

ark.legacy is developed by ark.swiss Sàrl, in Switzerland.

name: Arrow Logic: Mind Master
description:
Every board is a knot. Find the one arrow that can leave, tap it, and watch the knot come undone.

Arrow Logic is a calm, clever puzzle about reading a board before you touch it. Each arrow shoots straight out of its head — if anything stands in the way, it can't move. Clear them in the right order and the board empties. Tap the wrong one and the board locks up until you undo your thinking.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap an arrow to fire it along its own direction.
• Blocked arrows stay put — you have to find the one that is actually free.
• Some boards hide black holes that swallow arrows and change the whole route.
• Golden arrows chain through several arrows at once when you line them up right.
• Clear the whole board to win. Hints and free revives keep you moving.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 22,000+ main levels, unlocked in order, from gentle warm-ups to Expert and Master.
• 600+ daily challenge levels and a rotating set of Fun levels.
• A daily streak that lights up as you play, plus long-running achievement tracks:
  Level Legend, Perfect Play, Unstoppable and Challenge Trophies.
• Difficulty labels (Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert, Master) so you know what you're walking into.
• Five languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
• Dark mode, optional guide lines, sound and vibration toggles.

BUILT TO RESPECT YOU
• 100% offline. Progress is saved on your device only.
• No ads, no energy timers, no lives you have to wait for, no purchases.
• Hints and revives are free. There is nothing to buy.
• Small install, instant start, plays with one thumb.

Take your time. Look first, then move. The path opens as you go.

name: Assembly: Mechanical Puzzle
description:
Assembly is an adult, quiet, precision 3D mechanical puzzle.

Build: rebuild each machined shape from its cut pieces. Pick a piece, turn it, and place it where it fits.

KEY FEATURES
• Build mode: rebuild machined shapes from their cut pieces. A piece goes in only where it fits.
• Shapes: blocks, prisms, pyramids, cylinders, cones, frustums and wedges.
• Formula sheet: rotate each shape and read its dimensions, angles, volume and surface formulas.
• Fair and solvable: an offline solver proves every level has a solution. Stuck? Undo and try another order.
• Easy, Medium or Hard: every level has a countdown. Each difficulty keeps its own results and unlocks.
• Global board: sign in with Apple, join with a name and compete on your best total per difficulty. Delete your board data any time.
• Intro: each rule is shown with a short demo.
• Pick up where you left off: the level list opens at your last cleared level.
• Hints show the next move. Undo is free and unlimited.
• Par and Perfect marks, with per-level stats. "What you can improve" picks the levels with the most score to gain.
• Over 250 levels, from first steps to large assemblies.
• Nine material sets, including Titanium, Blued Steel, Ebonite and Verdigris.
• Sound effects and haptics. Each can be turned off.
• Color themes in light or dark, and 20 languages.
• Back up your progress to a file and restore it later.

Industrial look: brushed steel, brass and black oxide.

Cut. Fit. Assemble.

name: AstroLens
description:
The universe, one discovery at a time. AstroLens AI is your personal observatory, encyclopedia and night-sky journal.

INTERACTIVE SKY MAP
• More than 8,000 real stars from the Yale Bright Star Catalogue
• Pan, pinch to zoom and tap any star for details
• Constellation lines, planets, the Moon and deep-sky objects
• See your local sky with horizon and compass points, or explore the full sky
• Move through time to see how tonight's sky changes
• Works offline

EXPLORE THE UNIVERSE
• A library of planets, stars, galaxies, nebulae, black holes, comets, moons and missions
• Detailed planet pages with real measurements
• Compare planets with clear charts
• Space photography from NASA missions, with full credits

LEARN THE CONSTELLATIONS
• Twelve in-depth constellation guides with real star positions and IAU boundaries
• Connect the stars, identify patterns and track your progress
• Quizzes across seven topics and three levels

TONIGHT'S SKY
• Moon phase, illumination, age and moonrise
• A calendar of meteor showers, eclipses, oppositions, conjunctions, equinoxes and solstices, all calculated on your iPhone
• See when it's dark and which planets should be up
• Optional reminders and live cloud forecast

YOUR OBSERVATION JOURNAL
• Record what you saw, when, where and with what, and add your photos
• Charts of your activity, streaks and favourite objects

AI ASTRONOMY TUTOR (OPTIONAL)
• Clear answers from simple to advanced, with follow-up questions
• Concept explorer and structured reports you can save as PDF
• Focused on astronomy, and careful about facts
AI runs only when you ask. Your location, journal and photos are never sent.

YOURS, ON YOUR IPHONE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Night-vision red mode
• Library, sky map, quizzes and journal work offline

Images come from NASA and partner agencies and are credited in the app. NASA does not endorse this app.

name: Atramentum Writer
description:
Atramentum is a free writing app for novels and short stories. No account, no subscription, no ads. Your writing stays on your devices.

WRITE
• Chapters and scenes, rearranged by dragging
• A calm writing surface, focus mode and a mode with nothing but the white page
• Every change is saved immediately, with versions of each scene and a trash folder
• Footnotes, comments, images and tables

PLAN
• Character and location sheets with your own fields; Atramentum recognises who appears in a scene
• Corkboard with notes, sketches, groups and connections
• Timeline in story time, flashbacks are detected
• Character network: relationships at any point in the story
• Outline as a table or scene cards, colour labels and keywords

REVISE
• Style analysis: readability, long sentences, repetitions, filler words
• Spelling check of the whole manuscript, on the Mac also grammar
• Compare versions, word by word
• Have your text read aloud, with the current word highlighted
• Open a second scene or a character sheet beside your text

PUBLISH
• PDF as a standard manuscript or reading copy, Word, e-book (EPUB), Markdown and plain text
• Title page, dedication, imprint and page size as you like
• Import from Word, Scrivener, Markdown and plain text

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Atramentum is available for Mac, iPhone, iPad, Windows, Linux and Android. Sync through a folder in your own cloud service (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive …), with no account on our side.

In English, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese.

Atramentum is still young. Wishes and bug reports are welcome.

name: Au passage : lieux à voir
description:
Vous avez noté une librairie, un musée, une adresse recommandée par un ami… et vous êtes passé devant trois fois sans y penser. Au passage s'en souvient pour vous.

Enregistrez les lieux que vous voulez voir. Quand vous passez à proximité, votre iPhone vous le signale, même si l'app est fermée.

DES LISTES À VOTRE FAÇON
• Créez autant de listes que vous voulez et nommez-les librement : Culture, Démarches, Shopping, Week-end à Lyon…
• Choisissez la liste du moment : c'est elle qui s'affiche sur la carte et elle seule qui vous alerte. Vous restez concentré sur la balade du jour.
• Renommez ou supprimez une liste à tout moment.

AJOUTER UN LIEU EN QUELQUES SECONDES
• Collez une adresse, donnez-lui un nom si vous voulez : c'est ajouté.
• Recherchez une adresse, un commerce ou un monument.
• Pointez un endroit sur la carte, ou enregistrez l'endroit où vous êtes.
• Importez une liste entière : texte collé, fichier CSV, JSON ou GPX.

DES ALERTES UTILES, PAS ENVAHISSANTES
• Une notification quand vous entrez dans le rayon d'un lieu, réglable lieu par lieu.
• Plusieurs lieux proches en même temps ? Une seule notification, qui les classe du plus proche au plus lointain.
• Un délai minimum entre deux alertes pour un même lieu.
• Marquez un lieu comme visité d'un geste : il ne vous alertera plus.

UNE CARTE CLAIRE
• Épingles rouges pour les lieux à voir, vertes pour les lieux visités.
• Distance à chaque lieu, itinéraire à pied ou en voiture tracé directement sur la carte de l'app.

VOS DONNÉES RESTENT CHEZ VOUS
• Pas de compte à créer, pas de publicité, aucun suivi.
• Vos lieux et votre position restent sur votre iPhone. Rien n'est envoyé à nos serveurs : nous n'en avons pas.
• Exportez vos lieux quand vous voulez (CSV, JSON, GPX).

À SAVOIR
• Pour être prévenu quand l'app est fermée, autorisez la localisation « Toujours ». L'app s'appuie sur la surveillance de zones d'iOS, conçue pour ménager la batterie.
• iOS surveille au plus 20 zones à la fois par app. Avec une liste de plus de 20 lieux, Au passage surveille en permanence les 20 plus proches de vous.
• Selon iOS, l'alerte peut arriver quelques dizaines de secondes à quelques minutes après l'entrée dans la zone.

Un exemple de trois listes sur Paris est proposé au premier lancement pour découvrir l'app ; il se supprime depuis la gestion des listes.

name: Audio Craft: Trim & Convert
description:
Audio Craft brings four essential audio tools together in one clean, fast app. Everything runs on your iPhone with a built-in FFmpeg engine, so your files are never uploaded anywhere.

AUDIO TRIMMER
• Pick the exact part you need on a visual range slider.
• Fine-tune the start and end in 0.1 and 0.5-second steps.
• Preview the selection before you save.

AUDIO CONVERTER
• Convert between MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG, WAV and FLAC.
• Choose the bitrate (128 to 320 kbps) and sample rate (22.05, 44.1 or 48 kHz).
• See the original and new file size side by side.

AUDIO MERGER
• Join several audio files into a single track.
• Drag to set the order and preview each file.
• Save the result in the format you choose.

VIDEO TO AUDIO
• Save the soundtrack of a video (MP4, MOV, MKV and more) as an audio file.
• Pick videos straight from your photo library.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• 100% on-device processing: no cloud, no account, no tracking.
• No ads.
• Finished files are saved to the Files app (On My iPhone › Audio Craft) and can be shared with one tap.

Pick audio from the Files app, iCloud Drive or any connected storage, set your default format and quality once, and get to work.

name: Audrel
description:
Turn conversations, ideas and recordings into notes you can return to.

RECORD AND REVISIT
Capture audio with your iPhone or iPad microphone, or receive recordings from Apple Watch. Read the transcript, search your records, and return to important moments. Organize content as a summary, meeting notes, study notes, an interview or an action list. Export text and notes when you need to share them.

RECORD FROM YOUR WRIST
Start a recording on Apple Watch without keeping your iPhone nearby. Browse and play recent recordings on your watch. Audio transfers to the paired iPhone when connectivity and the system allow; transcription and notes are handled on iPhone. Watch audio is retained for seven days, including recordings that have not synced. Copies already saved on iPhone are unaffected.

CHOOSE HOW CONTENT IS PROCESSED
Apple speech recognition and text models are the defaults. Availability depends on your device, language, region and installed resources. Cloud AI is optional, uses your own provider credentials, and requires separate permission for text, audio and voice processing. Provider accounts, connectivity and charges may apply.

YOUR OWN STORAGE
Records are stored locally. You can optionally connect your own Google Drive or Synology NAS and enable sync; audio sync is a separate choice. Cloud files are readable and are not end-to-end encrypted. No Audrel account is required to record locally.

Requires iOS / iPadOS 26 or later; the companion requires watchOS 26 or later. iPhone and iPad record the microphone, not audio from other apps. Recognition and generated notes may contain errors: check important details against the recording.

name: Aurelyph
description: Compare ancient accounts of Persephone, Orpheus and the flood. Create a study, add sources and passages, then arrange events and record how each text describes them. Connect figures and symbols to your notes, and save or share a research sheet. A story in five chapters offers short activities based on cited texts. Your research is stored on your device.

name: Auriva Owner
description:
For café owners and managers. Auriva Owner is your personal phone app for running the business from anywhere — it is not the counter till (that is Auriva OS POS, used by your staff on the counter tablets).

• Today's sales, bills, covers and average bill, compared with last week.
• Alerts for low stock, voids, refunds and counter tablets that stop syncing.
• Reports by day, week and month, with GST summaries.
• Tasks and approvals for your team.
• For one-person cafés without a counter tablet, the owner can also take an order from the phone.

Auriva Owner needs an Auriva OS café account. Register your café at aurivaworld.com.

name: Auto More
description:
Auto More is a business workspace for taking orders (B2B and storefront), managing products and inventory, and creating GST invoices, credit notes, and receipts — in one place.

Sign in with your company account to place and track orders, check stock, run day-to-day accounts work, and keep your team aligned. The iOS app opens your Auto More workspace at automore.app. It is not a general web browser: only that trusted workspace runs inside the app; other links open in Safari. Where needed, the app also uses native device features such as LAN receipt printing.

Already used on the web and on Google Play; this iOS app brings the same Auto More workspace to iPhone.Auto More is an all-in-one business management tool designed to simplify operations for restaurants, cafes, bars, and other businesses. Whether you're handling B2B or B2C transactions, Auto More provides a robust platform to manage every aspect of your business seamlessly.

Key Features:

• Order Management: Intuitive ordering with customizations, cart management, SMS order previews, image management, and billing options.

• Product Management: Main categories, franchise-specific products, tax details, and unit conversions.

• Order History: Track B2B and B2C transaction history.

• Accounting: Generate invoices from orders; invoice and credit note history; tax management; GSTR-1 reporting and GST summaries.

• Tools: Label Maker, Bill Design Studio, notifications (email/SMS), and job sheets.

• D2C ordering: Real-time order previews and management for your ordering app.

• Profile & store management: Business details and device binding.

Sign in with your Auto More business account. On iPhone, Auto More also supports Bluetooth and LAN receipt printing, plus microphone audio notes for orders.

This app requires an Auto More company account.Auto More is an all-in-one business management tool designed to simplify operations for restaurants, cafes, bars, and other businesses. Whether you're handling B2B or B2C transactions, Auto More provides a robust platform to manage every aspect of your business seamlessly.

name: Autodemolizione Roma Nord
description:
L'app ufficiale di Autodemolizione Roma Nord, centro di demolizione auto e vendita ricambi usati a Rignano Flaminio (Roma).

RICAMBI USATI
Sfoglia il catalogo dei ricambi disponibili, cerca per marca, modello e categoria e contattaci subito per il pezzo che ti serve. Non lo trovi? Scrivici: lo cerchiamo noi.

ROTTAMA LA TUA AUTO
Invia la richiesta di rottamazione in pochi passaggi: dati del veicolo, documenti, foto e i tuoi contatti. Ti richiamiamo noi per organizzare tutto. Nell'app trovi anche le informazioni sul fermo amministrativo.

PROMO
Scopri le offerte e i codici sconto attivi.

GALLERIA
Guarda le foto del nostro centro e delle lavorazioni.

CONTATTI
Chiamaci, scrivici su WhatsApp o via email e raggiungici con Google Maps.

Azienda certificata ISO 9001 e ISO 14001.
Orari: lunedì–venerdì 8:30–13:00 e 14:00–17:30.

name: Autoruf24
description:
Mit Autoruf24 planen und buchen Sie Ihren Flughafentransfer direkt auf dem Smartphone.

Geben Sie Ihre Abholadresse, Ihr Reiseziel und den gewünschten Termin ein. Ergänzen Sie die Anzahl der Fahrgäste, Gepäck und benötigte Kindersitze. Den Gesamtpreis sehen Sie vor der Buchung. Eine Rückfahrt können Sie gleich mitplanen.

Autoruf24 ist Ihr Fahrdienst aus Aichtal für Stuttgart und die Region. Verfügbare Strecken, Leistungen und Zahlungsarten werden im Buchungsablauf angezeigt. Für individuelle Anfragen erreichen Sie unser Team über die angegebenen Kontaktmöglichkeiten.

Freigeschaltete Fahrer und Partner nutzen einen eigenen Bereich für ihre Aufträge. Fahrer können ihren Online-Status ändern, Fahrten bearbeiten und erhaltene Zahlungen bestätigen. Kartenzahlungen werden am separaten Terminal durchgeführt; der Fahrer erfasst anschließend den tatsächlich bezahlten Gesamtbetrag einschließlich Trinkgeld in der App.

Die App ist kostenlos. Gebuchte Beförderungsleistungen sind kostenpflichtig.

name: Averted
description:
Remember every night under the stars.

Averted is a logbook for amateur astronomers. Record your observing nights, the sky conditions and everything you find, work through the Messier list, and keep your night vision intact with a red-light interface.

LOG EVERY NIGHT • Start a night and note your site, sky darkness (Bortle scale), seeing, transparency and equipment. • Log each sighting with the time, magnification, how well it showed (glimpsed, seen or in detail) and your notes. • Add field photos of your site, the sky or an eyepiece sketch (optional). • Your night is saved as you go, so nothing is lost if you close the app outside.

YOUR LOGBOOK • See lifetime totals: nights, hours outside, and how many of the 110 Messier objects you’ve logged. • Sky charts show Messier progress and the kinds of objects you’ve found. If you haven’t logged a night yet, the kind chart shows the mix of objects in the Messier catalogue.

KNOW WHAT TO LOOK FOR • See tonight’s Moon phase, how much of it is lit, and what that means for faint galaxies and nebulae. • Get suggestions for tonight’s sky, matched to the season, your equipment and how dark your site is. • Northern or southern hemisphere: seasons are labelled for where you observe.

THE MESSIER LIST All 110 Messier objects plus the Moon and planets, with type, constellation, approximate magnitude and best season. Filter by season or what you still have to find, pull down to update your checklist, and watch it fill up.

NIGHT VISION AND DARK ADAPTATION Switch the whole app to dim red with one tap. A 30-minute dark-adaptation timer tracks how your eyes are adjusting.

NIGHT SOUNDS Crickets, tree frogs, a distant owl, wind in the pines, a campfire and a lake shore, all synthesized on your iPhone. Choose a scene or mix your own, and set them to fade out. They keep playing with the screen locked.

INTRO FILM “Your First Night Under the Stars” is a short film with five tips for new observers. Cast it to an Apple TV or AirPlay TV.

STAR PARTY Observing with friends? Host a Star Party and read out the three-letter room code. Everyone on the same Wi-Fi sees which object to find and taps “Found it”, so you can see who has it. Send a “Look up!” alert for a meteor or satellite.

SHARE YOUR NIGHTS Share an observing report with your notes and photos.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account or login. No ads, no analytics. Your nights, sightings and photos stay on your iPhone.

name: Awale Tour
description:
Discover awale, a traditional African strategy board game. Sow seeds around a carved board, plan your captures and try to collect 25 seeds to win.

Play solo at three difficulty levels or share one device for a two-player match. Learn with Imany, watch the rules and practice with guided exercises. A daily challenge offers the same starting position to everyone on that day.

Choose from seven animated destinations, including Pink Lake, the Namib Desert and Victoria Falls. Follow your match history, collect a stamp for your first solo win in each destination, and explore achievements and leaderboards with Game Center.

name: AXON Precision
description:
AXON Precision puts the quick calculations you need at the machine and the quality bench in your pocket. Enter two or three values and read the result in big numbers, without hunting for it.

CUTTING AND POWER Spindle speed, feed rate, net power and torque for milling and turning. Recommended cutting speed range by material, tool life and cost.

THREADS AND TAPS Tap drill size, pitch and thread depth for metric coarse, metric fine and pipe (BSP) threads.

LIMITS AND FITS ISO 286 limit sizes: enter hole and shaft tolerances and see whether the fit is clearance, interference or transition. Type the diameter you measured to get the verdict (in tolerance / near limit / reworkable / scrap) and the size change needed to reach the target (offset correction). The loosest and tightest conditions are drawn against the zero line.

G AND M CODES A searchable reference with the meaning, parameters and examples of each code.

GD&T Geometric tolerancing symbols, a feature control frame builder and position tolerance (including bonus) calculation.

SURFACE ROUGHNESS Theoretical Ra from feed and nose radius.

UNIT CONVERTER Inch, fractional inch (5/16, 1 3/8), SFM, IPM, hp, lbf·ft, psi, °F and more: type a value, see it converted for the chosen pair, with every unit of the category listed below.

TABLES Reference tables so you don't have to search the web: fractional inch to mm, metric coarse/fine and pipe threads, IT tolerances, preferred fits, surface roughness classes, density and thermal expansion, material equivalents, bolt clearance holes, socket head cap screw and nut dimensions, bolt property classes, stress area and proof load, UNC/UNF inch threads, parallel key dimensions, ball bearing dimensions, cutting speed ranges. Filter with search.

QUICK SPEED Enter diameter and cutting speed and see spindle speed and table feed instantly.

FEATURES • Save calculations by name; see favorite tools on the home screen and continue where you left off with one tap • Long-press a result to copy or share it • Turkish and English • Light and dark appearance • No internet needed; works fully offline • No account, ads or tracking; no personal data is collected • Big numbers and a floating navigation bar for one-handed use

IMPORTANT NOTE Results are for information and preliminary estimates. Real values vary with part, tool, material and machine. Before any quality, safety or production decision, verify results against the relevant standard, catalog and machine manual.

name: BadmintonBu.com - Scoreboard
description:
Badminton match records, a court finder and a practice planner in one app. Tap the side that won each point and the score keeps itself; choose Analysis mode to record where every shot was played, then watch the match back as an animated replay. Find places to play near you on the court map, read reviews and keep your favorites. Sign in with Google or Apple to plan practice with the people you play with and share match records with them.
No need to film the match: record it right there while it is played. Use it as your badminton scoreboard and score sheet, too.

■ Just tap the side that won the point
- One tap per point: Tap the winning side's panel to add a point. Big numbers you can read from outside the court.
- The serve and change of ends, shown for you: In singles and doubles alike, it shows who serves and from which side, in the order the rules say. When players change ends, the screen turns around too.
- Mistakes are easy to fix: Use “Undo”, or delete a point from the rally log. The score and the serve are all worked out again.
- Choose the format: 21, 15 or 11 points; best of 3 games or a single game. Deuce and the point cap are handled automatically.

■ Record where every shot was played
- Tap the court: Just tap where each shot was played, in order. The serve goes in by itself.
- Double-tap where it lands: Double-tap where the shuttle came down to end the rally: in or out follows from the spot, and a net is a double tap on the net band. Who gets the point follows from the side that hit last.
- Fix it afterwards: After the rally, switch between winner and out in one tap, or fix each shot's player and kind with the edit button. A two-finger tap takes back the last tap.

■ Watch the match again as an animated replay
- Moving avatars: Each hitter's avatar runs to where the shot was played, so doubles rotations show too.
- The shuttle's flight: Arcs with height, a trail and a shadow, and an effect where a winner lands.
- Commentary: “Smash!”, “Winner!” and more tell the rally in words, in all 7 languages.

■ Fast doubles? Score with two phones
- Invite a helper: The scorer taps “Invite a helper” on the match screen. A QR code and a 6-character code appear.
- Tap your own half: The helper's screen puts their half nearest. Tap where shots were played and where the shuttle landed on your side.
- The scorer adds points: Points come from the scorer's buttons. A slow connection never shifts the score, and late taps still join their rally.

■ Connect with members and share your records
- Saved to the cloud: Once you sign in, matches are saved to the cloud too. See the same records on a new phone or on your computer.
- Invite members: Just send an invite link or QR code. When they open it and sign in, you become each other's members.
- Head-to-head and shared records: Pick a member as a player and the match appears in their records too. See how you do against each member, and as partners.

■ Plan practice and find a place to play
- Plan practice: Add a title, time and place, and pick who to invite. You can also invite someone straight from their member page.
- Reply in one tap: Going, Maybe or Can't go. The plan shows at a glance who's coming.
- Add to your calendar: Add plans straight to Google Calendar or the calendar on your iPhone.

■ Great for
- Keeping score at matches and practice instead of a paper score sheet
- Umpiring or running the scoreboard with the serve order shown for you
- Recording shots and rallies to analyze and review your matches
- Sharing practice plans and head-to-head records with the people you play with

■ Use it in 7 languages
Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Korean, Thai, Indonesian

■ Price
Free, no ads

Members and practice plans need a Google or Apple sign-in. Your name and avatar are visible to other signed-in users.
The court map works without signing in.

name: BarberDotApp
description:
barber. is the easiest way to book a haircut at your local barbershop.

Find your shop, choose a service and the barber you trust, then pick from every open time. No phone calls, no back and forth. You get a confirmation straight away.

BOOK IN A MINUTE
• Open a shop from its booking link, or find it in the barber. directory
• See real prices and how long each service takes
• Pick your barber and see every time they are free
• Pay a deposit or in full by card when the shop asks for it, securely through Stripe

MANAGE YOUR BOOKINGS
• Every booking you make on your phone is saved under My bookings
• Change the time or cancel in a tap, right up to the shop's cut-off
• Online payments are refunded automatically when you cancel in time
• Sign in to see every booking made with your email, at any shop

FOR BARBERSHOPS
Shop owners, managers and barbers sign in to see the day at a glance: who is in the chair, what they booked and their notes. Approve new bookings, mark visits done or as a no-show, and cancel when plans change. Barbers see their own chair; owners and managers see the whole shop.

Running a shop? Set up your booking page, team, services and payments at getbarber.app.

name: Basic Video Player
description:
Basic Video Player is a simple, predictable offline video and audio player designed for autistic children and toddlers, with parents and caregivers managing the files.

IMPORTANT: No videos or music are included. Parents copy their own media to the device using a computer and a cable.

Three large controls stay on screen: back 10 seconds, play/pause, and forward 10 seconds. Tap the video to play or pause, swipe to another file, or use the clapperboard button to open the media library. The library includes a simple mute switch. Each file loops when it ends.

There are no ads, accounts, purchases, recommendations, or online content feeds. Playback works offline. Help, privacy information, and contact details are available in the app; outbound support and privacy links are reserved for parents behind an adult check.

To add media on a Mac, connect and unlock your iPhone or iPad, select it in Finder, click the Files tab, and drag your files into Basic Video Player. On Windows, use the Apple Devices app and choose Files > Basic Video Player. Delete files using the same computer view. The app notices added and removed files automatically.

Supports common video containers (.mp4, .mov, .m4v, .3gp, .3g2) and audio files (.mp3, .m4a, .aac, .wav, .aiff), subject to the device’s codec support. MP4 files with H.264 video and AAC audio are recommended. Unsupported or damaged files show an error so you can choose another file.

Media stays in the app’s local storage and is not added to Photos. Works on iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape. Copy only media you have the right to use.

name: BasicERP
description:
BasicERP, işletmenizin ön muhasebe, stok, satış ve finans işlerini tek yerde toplayan bulut tabanlı ERP yazılımıdır. Bu uygulama, firmanızın mevcut BasicERP hesabına telefonunuzdan güvenle erişmeniz içindir.

Neler yapabilirsiniz?
• Cari hesaplar: müşteri ve tedarikçi bakiyeleri, ekstre, vadesi geçen alacaklar
• Satış ve alış: teklif, sipariş, irsaliye ve faturaları görüntüleme ve oluşturma; PDF olarak paylaşma
• Stok: stok kartları, depo miktarları, barkod okutarak ürün bulma
• Stok sayımı: telefon kamerasıyla barkod okutarak depo sayımı, fark ve onay
• Kasa ve banka: hesap bakiyeleri, tahsilat ve ödemeler
• Saha satış: günün ziyaretleri, yol tarifi, sipariş ve tahsilat
• Takvim ve hatırlatmalar: görev ve randevu hatırlatmaları telefonunuza bildirim olarak gelir
• Raporlar: satış, KDV, resmî faturalar ve vergi özeti
• Face ID / parmak izi ile hızlı ve güvenli giriş
• Tutarları gizle: yanınızda biri varken ekrandaki rakamları tek dokunuşla kapatın

Uygulamayı kullanmak için firmanızın BasicERP hesabı gerekir; kullanıcınızı firmanızın yöneticisi açar.

name: Battery Enlighta
description:
Battery Enlighta gives every battery pack a digital passport: where it was made, what's inside, and everything that has happened to it since.

SCAN A BATTERY
Point the camera at the QR label on a battery to open its passport. Anyone can see the public passport; companies with access see the restricted details.

FOR BATTERY MAKERS
• Issue India's Battery Pack Aadhaar numbers (BPAN) and EU battery passports in batches, with QR labels ready to print
• Print labels or share files straight from your phone
• Import production from SAP or any ERP
• Register EU passports with the European Commission's DPP Registry and prepare the customs pack for your importer
• Passports in English, German, French, Italian and Spanish

FOR THE WHOLE LIFE OF A BATTERY
• Vehicle makers record fitment; service centres record health reports and repairs
• RTO officers and authorities check any vehicle by registration number or VIN
• Recyclers and second-life operators see dismantling details once the maker approves

BUILT FOR COMPLIANCE
• Follows EU Regulation 2023/1542 and India's draft Battery Pack Aadhaar guideline
• Single sign-on with Microsoft, Google or Okta, and two-factor login
• A tamper-evident audit log of every change

Battery Enlighta is for businesses and authorities. Create your company account at batteryenlighta.com; anyone can scan a battery without an account.

name: Bead Counter: Count Beads
description:
Bead Counter counts the tiny beads in front of your camera, instantly and privately.

Point your iPhone at beads on a dark surface and Bead Counter shows a live count as you hold it steady, with a dot drawn on every bead it finds so you can check the result at a glance. Set a goal count and it tells you how many more you need.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Place small light objects in a single layer on a dark surface, inside the on-screen guide box.
2. Hold the phone steady. The count updates live as it focuses.
3. Optionally set a goal to see how many beads you still need.

MADE FOR SMALL, ROUND THINGS
Bead Counter works on the little beads inside extended release capsules, craft beads, seeds, pearls, and other small light objects on a contrasting background.

FREE 3D-PRINTABLE HELPERS
Download a free STL for a small container and bead filler at desertdev.co/apps/beadcounter.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. Nothing is recorded, collected, or sent anywhere. There is no account, no analytics, and no tracking.

IMPORTANT
Bead Counter is a counting tool. It is not medical advice and does not calculate or recommend doses. Always confirm any medication change with your pharmacist or doctor.

Made by Desert Dev.

name: Beadlock
description:
BeadLock, parlak boncuklardan oluşan parçaları tahtaya yerleştirip tek bir boşluk bile bırakmadan doldurduğun bir mantık bulmacası.

Kuralı basit, çözmesi zor: Her seviyede tahtaya bazı parçalar sabitlenmiş gelir. Kalan parçaları döndür, çevir ve doğru yere oturt. Tahta tamamen dolduğunda seviye biter.

DÜNYAYI GEZEREK ÇÖZ
Türkiye'den başlayan yolculuk Maldivler, Finlandiya, Fransa, Kanada, Japonya, Yunanistan, Güney Kore, Mısır, İsviçre, İzlanda ve ABD'ye uzanıyor. Her yeni ülke kendi manzarası, renkleri ve daha zorlu bulmacalarıyla geliyor. Her bölümün sonunda pasaportuna yeni bir damga vurulur.

ÖZELLİKLER
• Adım adım zorlaşan 500 seviye
• 12 ülke, 12 farklı atmosfer
• Günlük Bulmaca: Her gün herkese aynı tahta
• Zamanlayıcılı mod: Süreye karşı yarış
• Serbest mod: Süre yok, rahatça çöz
• Takıldığında ipucu
• Dokun-döndür, sürükle-bırak: Tek elle rahat oynanış
• İnternet olmadan da oynanabilir
• iPhone ve iPad ekranlarına uyumlu

Kısa molalar için ideal, uzun oturumlar için bağımlılık yapıcı. Beynini çalıştır, tahtayı kilitle!

BeadLock ücretsizdir.

Kupa Labs tarafından geliştirilmiştir.

name: Become: Daily Affirmations
description:
Become is a calm daily practice for the life you want to grow into: affirmations, your own voice, a vision board and soothing sound, all in a few minutes a day.

HEAR IT IN YOUR OWN VOICE
Record your affirmations in your own voice, then listen back whenever you need a reset. Your recording stays on your iPhone. Become never uploads it.

THE 369 RITUAL
Write your affirmation 3 times in the morning, 6 in the afternoon and 9 at night for 21 days, and track every session.

A VISION BOARD THAT'S YOURS
Pin photos from your library or camera, add sticky notes and stickers, draw with the pencil, then save or share your board.

SOUND TO SETTLE YOUR MIND
Put on headphones and play calming frequency music. It keeps playing with your screen locked, and after the first play it works offline.

SMALL STEPS, EVERY DAY
Log a gratitude, build your streak, celebrate milestones, and choose gentle reminders at the time that suits you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Everything you create stays on your device.

Become is a wellness app for reflection and relaxation. It is not medical advice or treatment.

Terms: https://become.tropicinnovation.com/terms
Privacy: https://become.tropicinnovation.com/privacy

We're always improving Become and would love to hear from you. Found a bug or have an idea for a new feature? Email us at support@tropicinnovation.com

name: Better Mood Coffee Lab
description:
Prepara café paso a paso. Elige tu método, ajusta los gramos y sigue el temporizador con la cantidad de agua de cada vertido.

• Explora V60, AeroPress, prensa francesa, Chemex, Kalita Wave, moka, espresso y cold brew.
• Crea tus recetas, registra cómo quedó la taza y repite tus preparaciones favoritas.
• Aprende a catar café y compara dos preparaciones cambiando una sola variable.
• Consulta el paso y el tiempo en la pantalla bloqueada en dispositivos compatibles.

Puedes preparar y catar sin cuenta. Inicia sesión si quieres sincronizar las recetas que elijas.

name: Bia Arka
seller_name: EURILER MARKETING DIGITAL E TREINAMENTOS LTDA
description:
A Bia atende e vende no WhatsApp do seu negócio. Este app é para quem já assinou.

No celular você vê se a Bia está no ar, quem precisa de você, lê a conversa e responde. Pode assumir a conversa ou devolver para a Bia, e compartilhar um resumo sem o telefone. Sem internet, a última lista que o aparelho guardou continua na tela.

A Bia responde com a conta de inteligência artificial que você conectou (ChatGPT ou Claude). Antes de abrir as conversas, o app explica isso. A Arka não vende esses dados e não usa o conteúdo para anúncio nem para treinar modelo de IA.

A assinatura é feita fora do app. Para assinar ou mudar de plano, escreva para suporte@arka.education.

name: Binôme – Muscu & Suivi
description:
Binôme, c'est le partenaire de salle qui retient tout pour toi : tes séances, tes charges, ta nutrition et tes progrès.

COMPOSE TES SÉANCES
• Choisis les muscles du jour (pecs, dos, jambes…) : Binôme propose les exercices selon ton matériel : salle, maison ou poids du corps.
• Même semaine chaque semaine, ou rotation type PPL, haut/bas du corps.
• Ajoute, remplace ou supprime les exercices comme tu veux.

PENDANT LA SÉANCE
• Mode séance série par série : charge, répétitions, une case à cocher.
• Tu vois ce que tu as fait la dernière fois, pour savoir exactement quoi battre.
• Top set + back-off, séries dégressives, unilatéral, supersets.
• Chronomètre de repos automatique ou manuel.

TES CHARGES PROGRESSENT
• Progression automatique : quand tu atteins le haut de la fourchette, Binôme te propose la charge suivante.
• Ou progression manuelle si tu préfères décider toi-même.

NUTRITION
• Calories et macros calculées selon ton profil et ton objectif : sèche, prise de muscle, maintien.
• Scan du code-barres des aliments.
• Objectif recalculé toutes les deux semaines selon l'évolution de ton poids.

PROGRÈS
• Records, volume, séances : à la semaine, au mois, à l'année.
• Courbe de poids avec moyenne sur 7 jours, mensurations et photos.
• Bilan du dimanche pour faire le point sur ta semaine.

AU QUOTIDIEN
• Habitudes : eau, pas, protéines, sommeil, entraînement, avec un score de discipline.
• Rappels pour boire, bouger, manger tes protéines et ne pas rater ta séance.
• Widget pour l'écran d'accueil, avec un bouton « +250 ml » qui marche sans ouvrir l'app.
• Synchronisation avec Apple Santé : pas, sommeil, poids, eau et calories dépensées.

TES DONNÉES RESTENT CHEZ TOI
Pas de compte obligatoire, pas de publicité : tout est enregistré sur ton iPhone. Tu peux exporter une sauvegarde à tout moment.

Binôme ne remplace pas l'avis d'un médecin ou d'un professionnel de santé. Calculs indicatifs pour adultes.

name: BioEnigma
description:
Test your Biology knowledge! BioEnigma is a hangman game with 1,200 questions, from the cell to how the human body works, from metabolism to plants.

• Four categories: Cell Biology, Physiology, Biochemistry and Botany.
• Three levels: Easy, Visual (each question comes with a picture — tap to enlarge) and Hard.
• The monkey's banana jar empties over time and with every wrong letter. If the bananas run out, the question is over!
• Guessing the letters in order puts bananas back in the jar; the more bananas left, the more points you score.
• Rounds of 10 questions and your best scores for each category and level.
• In Portuguese, English and Spanish. Works offline.

For high school, university entrance exam preparation and early undergraduate courses.

Successor of BioTest (2013). Free, no ads, no sign-up and no data collection. Developed by the Educational Technology Laboratory (LTE) of the Institute of Biology at Unicamp (Brazil). Also available in the browser at www.lte.ib.unicamp.br/softwares.

name: Birding365
description:
Welcome to Birding365 — your ultimate companion for birding tours, wildlife photography expeditions, and guided eco-travel adventures across top bio-diverse destinations.
