Whether you are a seasoned ornithologist, a wildlife photographer, or a nature enthusiast, Birding365 helps you explore curated expeditions led by experienced naturalists and birding guides.
• EXPLORE GUIDED EXPEDITIONS
Browse detailed wildlife and bird watching tours across premier birding hotspots. View detailed day-by-day itineraries, target species, and expedition highlights.
• TRIP REPORTS & EXIF PHOTOGRAPHY
Explore comprehensive post-expedition trip reports. Discover species sightings, habitat notes, and photography tips captured directly on the field.
• HASSLE-FREE TOUR RESERVATIONS
Reserve your seat on upcoming tours with ease. Review inclusion details, sanctuary permits, accommodation info, and expedition dates directly within the app.
• INSTANT EXPEDITION ANNOUNCEMENTS
Stay updated with push notifications on newly announced tours, seasonal wildlife departures, and exclusive birding trips.
• DIRECT NATURALIST SUPPORT
Connect directly with our team of expert guides and expedition leaders to plan customized private tours and birding safaris.
Join Birding365 and embark on your next unforgettable wildlife journey!

name: Birlik Team: Keçid balları
description:
Birlik Team brings everything an Azerbaijani university applicant needs into one app: admission scores, programme choice, universities, news and online practice exams.

ADMISSION SCORES
• Passing scores of every programme for recent years
• Search by group, sector, university and city
• See which programmes fit your score at a glance

PROGRAMME CHOICE
• Build and save your own programme plan
• Send the plan to a teacher or mentor for review

UNIVERSITIES
• University pages, programmes and news

ONLINE PRACTICE EXAMS
• Take exams prepared by teachers right in the app
• See your result and mistakes instantly
• Create your own exam: a tool that finds the questions in a PDF, and a printable booklet

NEWS AND NOTIFICATIONS
• Important exam and admission news
• Notifications about new exams and results

Birlik Team is free and has no ads.

name: BKHMCT SKILL
description:
BKHMCT Skill Development App is the official mobile learning management platform for faculty, teachers, and instructors of BKHMCT.

Key Features:
• Student Attendance: Take quick class attendance, track roll calls, and view monthly presence statistics.
• Timetable & Lectures: View scheduled teaching sessions, lecture timings, and academic calendars.
• Classroom Moments: Capture and upload photos and video reports of workshop activities and student practicals.
• Assignments & Quizzes: Review student submissions, assign coursework, and publish quiz evaluations.
• Syllabus & Notes: Share lecture notes, reference study materials, and subject syllabi with students.
• Leave & Feedback: Submit faculty feedback and access institutional notices on the go.

name: Blast Off: Rocket Defender
description:
Defend your launch site in BLAST OFF, a bright, fast arcade shooter for iPhone and iPad!

Fly 20 missions across the Solar System and beyond. Start at the launch site, then head through low Earth orbit, the Moon, Mars, the asteroid belt, Jupiter, Saturn's rings, the Neptune storm and the Crab Nebula. Finish by taking on the giant alien mothership.

Tap anywhere to fire a rocket right there, or hold and drag to aim with rapid fire. Satellites, ringed planets, wobbly UFOs, diving comets and tumbling space junk streak across the sky. Hit the mission goal before three get past!

• 20 missions, each with its own world, targets and challenge
• Earn up to 3 stars per mission and unlock the next one on the mission map
• Rocket upgrades: twin launch, triple launch and a heavy super-rocket with a shockwave blast
• A sleek launch tower with a reusable booster that flies back and lands before every mission
• Blue-flame rockets with grid fins, rolling launch smoke, fireworks and big explosions
• Epic boss fight against the alien mothership
• New foes: splitting rocks, zig-zag drones and armoured satellites
• Grab power-ups: extra life, rapid fire and a protective shield
• A living sky: shooting stars, comets, a drifting astronaut, a space whale, auroras, volcano plumes and more
• Top 10 high-score table with your initials, plus Game Center leaderboards
• Animated How to Play guide
• One-tap controls. Keyboard supported on iPad
• Original space soundtrack and sound effects
• Works upright or sideways, on every iPhone and iPad
• No ads, no tracking, no sign-up needed. Just play

Can you clear all 20 missions with 3 stars?

name: Blocked: Online Wall Battle
description:
Be the first to move your pawn to the opposite edge.
But it is not just a walk. On each turn you either "move one step" or "place one wall" to block your rivals' paths. A wall forces a rival to take a detour, but walls are limited, and if you place too many you will run out.

FOUR PLAYERS AT ONCE
Besides 2-player matches, there are 4-player matches. Everyone starts from a different side, and each player's goal is the opposite edge. Who do you block, and who is blocking you? Online, against the computer, or on one shared device, you can play with 4.

ONLINE MATCH
- Choose 1v1 or 4 players
- Your rating moves with each result and your rank rises (Bronze to Master). The ranking shows the top 100
- If the wait is long, named computer players join so the match can start (about 15 seconds)
- Rematch right after a game
- No sign-up or login. Just pick a nickname
- Report an inappropriate nickname from the result screen or the ranking, and block a player you do not want to meet again

PLAY VS CPU
- 2-player or 4-player matches
- Three levels: Rookie, Regular, Elite. Start with Rookie if you are new

PASS AND PLAY
- Pass one device around for 2 to 4 players

RULES
- The board is 9x9. A wall is 2 squares long and sits in the groove between squares, vertical or horizontal
- Walls per player: 10 in 2-player matches, 5 in 4-player matches
- You can only place a wall if every player still has at least one path to their goal (spots that are not allowed show in red)
- When pawns face each other, you can jump over
- First to reach the goal edge wins. In 4-player matches the game ends when 1st place is decided, and the others are ranked by steps left to their goal
- Online turn time is 20 seconds per move. If it runs out, the shortest step is played for you

MORE
- Japanese and English
- Works on iPhone and iPad
- No ads and no purchases (version 1.0)

Terms of Use: https://reg-ulus.com/apps/kabe-battle/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://reg-ulus.com/apps/kabe-battle/en/privacy

name: Blocus – Jeu
description:
Pose tes pièces, avance par les coins et bloque tes adversaires : un jeu de stratégie qu'on comprend en une minute et qu'on maîtrise en un an.

SANS PUBLICITÉ. SANS ACHAT. SANS COMPTE À CRÉER.
• Tout le jeu est gratuit et complet, dès la première minute.
• Aucune publicité ne vient interrompre tes parties.
• Aucune donnée n'est collectée.

LA RÈGLE, EN UNE PHRASE
Chaque nouvelle pièce doit toucher les tiennes par un coin, jamais par un côté. Celui qui occupe le plus de cases gagne.

JOUE COMME TU VEUX
• Contre l'ordinateur, avec 4 niveaux : Facile, Moyen, Difficile et Expert.
• En famille sur un seul iPad ou iPhone, jusqu'à 4 joueurs.
• En ligne avec Game Center : en direct, ou chacun son tour sur plusieurs jours.
• Invite tes amis Game Center en deux touchers.

TROIS MODES + UN DÉFI CHAQUE JOUR
• Duo : le face-à-face rapide, environ 10 minutes.
• Classique : la grande bataille à 4 couleurs.
• Trio : à 3 joueurs, avec une couleur neutre que vous jouez à tour de rôle pour vous bloquer.
• Défi du jour : un nouveau puzzle chaque jour, le même pour tout le monde.

TU NE TE TROMPES JAMAIS DE RÈGLE
• Des points verts montrent où ta pièce peut se fixer.
• L'aperçu devient vert ou rouge avant de poser.
• Les pièces impossibles à placer sont grisées.
• Un indice quand tu bloques, et un bouton Annuler quand tu te trompes.
• Un tutoriel jouable en trois étapes.

PROGRESSE À TON RYTHME
• Revis chaque partie coup par coup, avec la courbe des scores.
• Demande « Pourquoi ? » pour comprendre les coups de l'ordinateur.
• Statistiques détaillées : victoires, records, séries.
• Classements et succès Game Center.

PENSÉ POUR L'IPAD, PARFAIT SUR IPHONE
• Glisser-déposer précis avec aimantation, rotation en pivotant, retournement.
• Raccourcis clavier, trackpad et Apple Pencil.
• Tes parties sont enregistrées automatiquement : tu reprends exactement où tu t'étais arrêté.

ACCESSIBLE À TOUS
• Mode daltonien avec motifs sur les pièces.
• VoiceOver et pose de pièce par liste de positions.
• Grands caractères et mode sombre.

Blocus est un jeu original, entièrement en français.
Une question ? https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/

name: BlueSignal Cloud
description:
BlueSignal Cloud is the app for homeowners, installers and DIYers.

Watch WQM-1 water quality, atmospheric water (AWG) output and site power in one place. See what needs attention, commission a new unit from your phone, and watch its first reading arrive.

WATER QUALITY
Each WQM-1 reads pH, TDS, turbidity and temperature every minute. The dashboard leads with anything that needs a look: a unit that went offline, a probe that stopped reporting, a reading past the limit you set.

ALERTS
Each alert shows the site, the unit, what happened and when it started. Acknowledge it, resolve it or dismiss it. BlueSignal emails you when a unit goes offline.

AWG AND POWER
See atmospheric water output and electrical load next to the water readings for each site.

WEATHER
Watches, warnings and the forecast from the National Weather Service for each site, in the National Weather Service's own words. You can choose those by email.

SITES AND COMMISSIONING
Group units by site. Commission a WQM-1 from your phone and track it from install to its first reading.

SHARE A VIEW-ONLY LINK
Send family or a neighbor a link to a site's readings. Nobody needs an account to open it, and nothing on it can be changed.

NO UNIT YET?
Sign in and tap View sample data to explore a sample fleet first.

Your account, your data: export it or delete your account any time from Settings.

BlueSignal XYZ designs, sells and installs water systems. Licensed trades do the regulated electrical and plumbing work under their own licenses.

name: Board Archive: Score Keeper
description:
Board Archive keeps score at your board game table.

SCORE SHEETS
• Create a game with 2–8 players
• Enter scores round by round; totals and ranks update instantly
• Choose whether the highest or lowest score wins
• Every game is saved on your device
• Player stats: games, wins, win rate and average rank

RIICHI MAHJONG SCORING
• Set starting points, return points and uma
• Record ron, tsumo and draws; points are calculated from han and fu
• Dealer, honba and riichi sticks are tracked automatically
• Noten payments for exhaustive draws
• Final uma/oka settlement

WAITS
• Tap in a 13-tile hand and see which tiles complete it
• Covers standard hands, seven pairs and thirteen orphans
• Also works with 10, 7, 4 or 1 tiles after calls

YAKU LIST
• Riichi mahjong yaku with han values, closed-only rules and short explanations
• Search by name

No ads, no account and no internet connection needed. Your records stay on your device.

name: Boekschrift
description:
A notebook for every book.

Boekschrift keeps your reading notes together, ready to revisit as a story unfolds or a new idea takes shape. Create a notebook for a novel, a work of non-fiction or an audiobook, then capture what matters to you.

YOUR OWN WAY TO READ
Organise notes into Thoughts, Characters, Places, Timeline, Themes & ideas, Quotes and Questions. Use whichever sections fit your book. Record page numbers, chapters or audiobook timestamps to find a passage again.

CONNECT AND REVISIT
Link related notes within a book, mark favourites and search across your bookshelf or inside a notebook. Put events in your chosen story order and keep track of reading status and page progress.

YOUR NOTEBOOKS, YOUR DATA
Books and notes are stored locally on your device. All core features work offline. Export your complete collection as XML, including connections, favourites, progress and language settings. Choose where to keep the file and restore a backup after reviewing and confirming replacement of the current library.

ONE PURCHASE
One purchase gives you lasting access to every feature. Choose English or Nederlands; your language choice is remembered. We collect no user data.

Save a backup before removing the app or changing devices. Exported files are readable, so choose a private destination.

name: BondMD
description:
BondMD is a dating app for healthcare professionals looking for a serious relationship or marriage.

Doctors, nurses, dentists, pharmacists, physician assistants and other clinicians all know what it's like to date around night shifts, call schedules and years of training. BondMD is a place to meet people who already get it.

VERIFIED MEMBERS ONLY
Every member's professional credentials are checked by our team before they can browse or match, so you know the person you're talking to is who they say they are.

MATCHES THAT FIT YOUR LIFE
Tell us what matters to you: age, location, faith and how practicing you are, family plans, lifestyle and work-life balance. BondMD shows you the people who fit, ranked by how well you match each other.

LIKE, MATCH, TALK
Like the profiles that interest you. When the feeling is mutual, it's a match and the conversation can begin.

SAFETY BUILT IN
Block or report anyone from their profile or your chat. Our team reviews every report. Read our safety tips any time from your profile.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CONTROL
Sign in with email, Apple or Google, unlock with Face ID, choose which notifications you get, and delete your account from the app whenever you want.

BondMD is for adults 18 and over.

Terms of Service: https://bondmd.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bondmd.app/privacy

name: Bonsoir Dubai
description:
Bonsoir is Dubai's after-work club. One evening, one guest list. You come alone after the office and you leave with new names in your phone.

EVENINGS BY INVITATION
See the next evenings, request your invitation and get an answer from the team. The guest list is reviewed so every evening has a good mix of people.

YOUR PASS, IN THE APP
Once you are confirmed, your personal pass is in the app. Show it at the door, it is scanned in a second. The venue is shared with confirmed guests before the evening.

MEMBERS YOU ACTUALLY MEET
Create your profile: what you do, what you are looking for, what you can help with. See who is coming, and find the people you met afterwards. You choose whether your profile is visible to other members.

PLACES THAT TREAT MEMBERS WELL
Businesses run by members share a promo code or a gift reserved for Bonsoir members. Watch their short presentation video and claim the offer in one tap.

THE PHOTOS OF EVERY EVENING
Find yourself in the gallery after each evening and download your photos in full quality.

LEVELS
Come often and move up: Guest, Regular, Ambassador, Host, Maison.

Bonsoir is free. You sign in with a code sent to your email, no password. Members must be 18 or older.

Questions: marketing@bonsoirdubai.com

name: Bookupy
description:
Bookupy is the booking app for small businesses. Give clients your own booking link and they can book online any time, while you run your day from your phone.

FOR BUSINESS OWNERS
• Your bookings at a glance: see today and the days ahead, with the client, service, time and team member for each one
• Instant alerts on your phone for new bookings, cancellations and reschedules
• Clients book themselves 24/7 from your booking link: no calls, no back and forth
• Automatic confirmations and reminders cut no-shows
• Works for barbers, hair and beauty salons, trades and other appointment-based businesses
• Delete your account at any time from the Account tab

FOR YOUR CLIENTS
• Book from your link in a few taps, with no account needed
• Get a confirmation and reminders the day before and on the day
• Change or cancel from the link in their confirmation

Already use Bookupy for your business? Sign in with your Bookupy account.

name: Bot Room
description:
Your people. Their bots. One room.

Botroom is a playful shared office where everyone brings their own AI. Open a room for a project, invite your crew, connect your bots, and watch people and bots get it done together. Botroom works the same on your phone as on your desk.

TALK TO PEOPLE AND BOTS IN THE SAME CHAT
@ a teammate or @ a bot. It's the same conversation. Ask one bot for subject lines, ask another what people are saying this week, and let your teammate pick the winner. Nobody copies and pastes between tabs.

BOTS DO THE WORK. YOU TAP YES.
Before a bot sends, posts or spends, it drops a sticky note in the room and waits. Say yes, tweak it, or tell it to hold. One tap, from the car or between meetings.

EVERYTHING THE ROOM MADE, PINNED IN ONE PLACE
Drafts, research and to-dos land on the room's desk with who made them. No digging through chat history to find the good version.

HUDDLE UP WITH YOUR CREW
See who's in a room and jump on a video or voice call in one tap, right from the chat.

BRING THE AI YOU ALREADY USE
Connect the AI assistants and agents you already pay for. Each one joins your rooms as a teammate, with its owner's name on it, so everyone knows whose bot is talking.

STAY IN THE LOOP ON THE GO
Push notifications tell you when someone mentions you, a bot needs a thumbs-up, or a huddle starts. Create rooms, invite people and manage who's in each one, right from your phone.

MADE FOR SMALL TEAMS WITH BIG TO-DO LISTS
- Real estate teams: agents, lenders, processors and their bots in one room per deal
- Marketing crews: bots draft the emails and research the angle while people choose the winners
- Content studios: script, thumbnail and caption bots working one brief
- Agencies: invite clients into one workspace with your team and your bots
- Solo operators: one person, a whole crew of bots

HOW IT WORKS
1. Connect your bots
2. Build a room for a project
3. Invite your crew

Circles are people. Squares are bots. Everyone's in the same room.

Questions? Email botty@botroom.io. We read every message.

Terms: https://app.botroom.io/terms
Privacy: https://app.botroom.io/privacy

name: BoxTrail Move
description:
Organize a move one box at a time. Give each box a unique number, room and label, then record its contents, quantities and notes. Search by box number or item name to find what you need.

Check items as you pack, seal a finished box, and mark it unpacked when you arrive. Reopen a box whenever plans change, and view every box by packing stage.

Create and share a QR label for each box. Its code contains only a local box identifier and number, never the contents list. Export a CSV moving manifest or save and restore a JSON backup. No account is required; your records stay on your device.

name: BrassOrchard
description:
Tiny springs. Turning branches. One very happy harvest bell.

Welcome to Brass Orchard, a three-dimensional clockwork garden where little mechanical fruits wait above lettered baskets. Choose a collar, turn the toothed crank, and watch your movement travel through the branches. When every fruit finds its landing ribbon, ring the bell and bring the harvest home.

TEND A LIVING MECHANISM
Linked gears carry your turns into the canopy. Crossed gears turn their children the other way. Copper clutches let you borrow one quiet tooth, while Windfall shutters ask you to listen for an open basket.

LOOK AROUND THE TREE
Orbit the orchard to inspect rear collars and hidden landings. Pinch closer, follow the dotted ribbons, and match fruit to basket by letter as well as color.

A FRESH LITTLE HARVEST
Choose from three orchard families and gather three trees per ticket. Constructively generated puzzles have verified winding routes. Finish a harvest to grow fresh tickets, or grow another set whenever you like.

KEEP YOUR OWN CABINET
Earn brass polish through careful turns, collect tender stamps, and keep your harvest receipts on this device. No timer penalty. No currency. Unwind and helpful Nudges are always available.

Original music-box tines, ratchet ticks, gentle tactile feedback, procedural 3D artwork, a hands-on first lesson, and a full Field Guide make the grove a welcoming place to tinker.

No account, ads, purchases, subscriptions, tracking, chat, or player-entered text. Your current tree, receipts, and settings stay locally on your device.

name: Breeze Push
description:
A build finishes. A job needs attention. Your automation has something to say. Breeze Push brings those updates to your iPhone with a private webhook link.

Send a notification from a terminal, server, GitHub Actions workflow or Apple Shortcut. Compose a message in the app, see its preview, and copy a request you can use in your own script.

• Make a message yours with a title, group, link, image and sound.
• Keep notifications together in grouped, searchable history.
• Copy useful text or open a link from a received message.
• Use the hosted Breeze service or add your own compatible server.
• Reset your webhook link from the app when you need a new one.

No account signup is required. Designed for iOS 26 and later, with a native interface and Liquid Glass.

Your webhook link lets its holder send to your device, so keep it private. Delivery depends on connectivity, Apple Push Notification service and your notification settings. Critical Alerts are not currently available.

name: Brewed Coffee App
description:
Brewed is a coffee journal for people who brew at home — pour over, AeroPress, espresso, French press, moka pot or South Indian filter.

LOG EVERY CUP
Record dose, water, temperature, grind and each pour as you brew, then rate the cup when you taste it: an overall score, flavor notes from the coffee flavor wheel, and optional detailed scores.

KNOW YOUR BEANS
Keep a library of the bags you buy. Brewed tracks how much is left, when each bag is at its best after roasting, and lets you freeze portions and pick them up where they left off. Scan the bag with your camera and Brewed fills in the roaster, origin, process and roast date for you.

JUST SAY IT
Tell Brewed what you brewed or how it tasted, and it fills in the form.

DIAL IN
Not tasting right? Dial-In looks at the brew and suggests what to change first. Planning a new coffee? It builds a starting recipe for your bean and brewer.

SEE WHAT WORKS
Analytics shows your taste profile, your best methods and roasters, and whether fresher beans really score higher for you.

ALSO
Recipes you can reuse and scale, gear and setups that pre-fill the form, side-by-side cupping, reminders to taste your brew or use a bag before it fades, share cards for Instagram and WhatsApp, and themes and fonts to make it yours.

No ads. Your data is yours, and you can delete your account from the app at any time.

name: Bricomesure
description:
Posez, mesurez et calculez juste, avec un seul outil dans la poche : votre iPhone ou votre iPad.

Bricomesure réunit 8 outils de mesure précis, reliés à des calculatrices qui vous disent exactement quoi acheter. Pas de publicité, pas d'abonnement, pas de compte.

POURQUOI ELLE EST DIFFÉRENTE
• 8 outils dans une seule app, au lieu d'en installer plusieurs
• De la mesure au résultat : une surface mesurée devient une quantité de peinture, de carrelage ou de parquet
• Gratuite, avec un seul achat facultatif « Pro » à vie, sans abonnement
• Aucune publicité, aucune donnée collectée, fonctionne hors connexion
• Précision affichée honnêtement, outil par outil

NIVEAU À BULLE
• À plat (bulle ronde) ou sur la tranche (fiole), bascule automatique
• Angle au dixième de degré et pente en %
• Valeur figée d'un geste, zéro relatif
• Vibration quand c'est de niveau : mesurez sans regarder l'écran
• Pro : calibrage par retournement, angle ou pente cible (ex. 2 % pour une douche), radar sonore

MÈTRE EN RÉALITÉ AUGMENTÉE
• Distances point à point, avec le LiDAR sur les appareils compatibles
• Pro : chemins, contours avec surface, rectangles en 3 points, hauteurs
• Photo de la mesure enregistrée avec les cotes

ET AUSSI
• Rapporteur avec la caméra ou en inclinomètre
• Détecteur de métaux pour repérer vis, clous et tuyaux acier
• Règle à l'échelle réelle, calibrable avec une carte bancaire
• Sonomètre en décibels avec historique des 30 dernières secondes
• Lampe à intensité réglable
• Boussole avec nord géographique

CALCULATRICES
• Peinture : litres et pots nécessaires, portes et fenêtres déduites
• Carrelage : carreaux, boîtes, colle et joint
• Parquet : paquets, sous-couche et plinthes
• Papier peint : rouleaux et lés
• Convertisseur d'unités (cm, pouces, pieds, m², pente…)

HISTORIQUE ET EXPORT
• Toutes vos mesures avec nom, note et photo
• Recherche et filtres par type
• Export PDF et CSV, sauvegarde et import

VOS DONNÉES RESTENT CHEZ VOUS
Aucun compte, aucun traçage. Vos mesures restent sur votre appareil. La caméra et le micro ne servent qu'en direct, rien n'est envoyé.

UN SEUL ACHAT, POUR TOUJOURS
Les outils essentiels sont gratuits. Le rapporteur, le détecteur et le sonomètre s'essaient 3 fois gratuitement. Pro débloque tout, à vie, avec le Partage familial.

Disponible en 10 langues, optimisée pour iPhone et iPad, compatible VoiceOver et Dynamic Type.

Mesures indicatives, non certifiées. Le détecteur repère les métaux ferreux à quelques centimètres : coupez toujours le courant avant de percer.

Assistance : https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/
Confidentialité : https://schmittutility.fr/confidentialite/

name: Briqen MI
description:
Thousands of posts. One that matters. Briqen finds it, and tells you why it worked.

Briqen reads public Instagram and YouTube posts, measures each one against its own channel, and explains what made the winners stand out: the hook, the format, the pacing, and the moment people leaned in.

ASK BRIQEN
Chat with a research assistant that answers in plain words, grounded in real posts, with charts and the sources to check. Ask what's rising in your niche, why a competitor's reel took off, or what to post this week. Talk instead of typing if you like.

BREAK DOWN ANY POST
Open a post and get its verdict first: whether it beat its channel, where attention peaked, and how well it loops. Then read the full breakdown of the hook, the structure, and the comments.

LEARN FROM WHAT WORKS
Search opening lines from posts that performed, by category, and see the hook formats rising right now: questions, number-led openers, before and after, POV, myth-busting, story opens, and more. Pin the best to boards you share.

DISCOVER YOUR NICHE
See trending posts, breakout creators, and what your audience is talking about, filtered to your niche.

PLAN AND MAKE
Turn an idea into a brief, a script, and a video edit, organised by campaign. Keep a calendar of what goes out and when, with reminders before each post.

YOUR NUMBERS, PRIVATELY
Connect your Instagram to see reach, saves, shares, and watch time on every post. Only you see them.

Start free with daily credits, no card needed. Sign in with your email.

Briqen is made by Briqen AI Private Limited in Mumbai.

name: Buber Driver
description:
Buber Driver is the app for approved Buber Taxi drivers.

• Go online with one tap and receive ride requests nearby.
• Ride notifications: offers arrive even when your phone is locked.
• Trip overview: pickup, destination, fare and trip status in one place.
• Driver sign-up: apply with your documents right in the app.

While you are online, the app shares your location in the background so the dispatcher can offer you the nearest rides. Sharing stops when you go offline. Continued use of GPS in the background can decrease battery life.

name: BXPMPE
description:
Thanks for downloading and trying it out—your support is our motivation, and your feedback shows us the way forward.

A promise without a due date is a wish. Vowrail puts every vow on a quiet rail so you can see what is overdue, due today, coming this week, or already kept.

HOW A VOW WORKS
• Tie a vow in three short steps: The Word (what you promised), The Rail (due date, who, weight), The Seal (save).
• Weight is the honor pressure — light, medium or heavy — so the next card on the rail is never a surprise.
• Open a vow to keep it or leave it open. Kept vows fold into your honor streak; open ones stay on the rail until you decide.
• Pin the ones that matter. Search later by promise or who-tag when the rail grows.

HONOR
• Keep rate, open load and kept count at a glance.
• By Who breakdown, activity heatmap and an Honor Lens for period keep rate and daily open load.
• Export or share an honor summary when you want a stamp of how the week went.

PACE
• Open Caps limit how many vows you leave hanging in a month.
• Honor Aims set keep targets with deadlines; log keeps as you go.
• Alerts kick in near the cap so the rail does not quietly overload.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no tracking. Vows stay on your iPhone. Optional local backup, CSV export and wipe. Clear the sample pack when you are ready — your own vows stay.

BXPMPE (Vowrail) is a personal promise and honor tool. It is not a calendar, messenger or legal contract service.

name: CA & Co. Digital
description:
CA & Co. Digital is the private client app for people who work with Christian Anderson & Co. Digital. Everything about your project is in your pocket.

HOME See what you owe, what you have paid and your reward points at a glance, with shortcuts to what needs your attention.

INVOICES Browse every invoice, check what is due and what is paid, and pay online through a secure checkout. You get a receipt as soon as the payment goes through.

CONTRACTS Follow your active contract, its value, what has been paid and how many milestones are complete. Open the contract document any time.

MESSAGES Chat directly with our team. Send photos and documents, and get a notification when we reply.

SUPPORT Open a support ticket for website changes, billing questions or design requests, attach a file, and follow the replies until it is resolved.

REWARDS Earn points on every paid invoice and see your member card and what you can redeem.

SECURE Sign in with your client email and password, and turn on Face ID for quick, private access.

This app is for existing clients. Your login is created by our team. Need access? Email info@christian-anderson.com.

name: Cachicamo App - PoS
description:
Cachicamo App - PoS es el punto de venta de Cachicamo App para negocios en Venezuela.

Con tu cuenta de Cachicamo App puedes:
• Facturar desde el iPhone o el iPad con tus productos, precios e impuestos.
• Conectar tu impresora fiscal por la red local de tu negocio (The Factory, PNP, Quantum, Rigazsa y AEG).
• Emitir en forma libre, sin impresora fiscal.
• Consultar los documentos emitidos con su estado, buscar por cliente, cédula, RIF o número, y descargar el PDF.
• Ver los cierres Z de tu máquina fiscal.
• Atender mesas y enviar comandas a la cocina.

Vincular el equipo es sencillo: genera un código de 8 dígitos en tu cuenta de Cachicamo App y escríbelo en la app.

¿Aún no tienes cuenta? Regístrate gratis desde la app y pruébala.

name: Cadence – Project Planner
description:
Cadence is a programme planner for people who run real delivery. Design a plan in a keyboard-first Gantt editor, and a scheduling engine recalculates float, the critical path and the forecast finish the moment you change anything. Then run the project from the same place: costs, gates, risks, agile delivery and governance.

• Plan: Gantt editor, outline to WBS, high-level and detailed plans, a WBS grid, dependencies, critical path, working calendars, four link types with lags, auto-schedule and resource levelling
• Versions: keep the published plan and design changes in drafts; baselines, compare and change control
• Initiate: charter with a sign-off trail, stakeholders, benefits, lessons learned
• Cost: day rates, actuals, cost by period, cost to complete, a financial report and an estimate calculator
• Delivery: stage gates, handoffs, artifacts, quality, and agile backlog, board and sprint planning
• Risk: RAID log, risk and float, and a Monte Carlo forecast of the finish date
• Governance: RACI, procurement and statements of work, project close and a full activity log
• Overview: dashboard, my work, alerts, a portfolio across projects, and reports as HTML, PDF and PowerPoint
• Import and export Microsoft Project XML; password-protected project files
• iCloud sync between your own Mac, iPad and iPhone, with Handoff
• Made for iPhone Duo: folded, a full planner in your pocket; unfold it for the sidebar, the plan and its details side by side, like on an iPad
• An MCP server on the Mac, so an AI assistant can read and update the plan

A sample project fills every screen so you can explore before you plan your own.

Your plans are stored on your devices, encrypted. No account, no tracking.

name: CadMath: Mental Math Runner
description:
Math is the way forward. In CadMath you run down a busy city street, and every gate asks a question. Steer into the right answer and keep going. Pick the wrong one and it costs a life.

QUICK MATH, FAST FEET
Every question takes a few seconds of mental math, so the challenge comes from the running: the pace picks up as you level up, the road gets busier, and the wrong answers are the ones people really get wrong.

NINE LEVELS FOR EVERY AGE
1 Warm-up: adding and taking away to 10
2 Jog: to 20
3 Run: to 100, plus easy times tables
4 Stride: two-digit sums and times tables to 12
5 Sprint: round tens
6 Dash: round hundreds
7 Turbo: all four operations, faster
8 Blaze: percents, fractions and squares
9 Lightning: everything, at top speed

At Blaze and Lightning, crosswalks give you a moment to think: the runner stops while people cross, with the question already on screen.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Jump barriers, switch lanes and ride on top of cars
• Stars, streaks and badges for every run
• Earn coins and spend them on runners, hats, hair and trails
• No ads, no accounts, and nothing to buy with real money

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
CadMath collects no personal information from children. Your progress stays on your device.

Made by Cadency.

name: Camera 4K Pro
description:
Camera 4K Pro puts full manual control of your iPhone camera on one clean screen.

SHOOT 4K VIDEO
Record in 4K, 1080p or 720p at 24, 25, 30 or 60 fps (depending on your iPhone). Choose efficient HEVC for smaller files or H.264 for maximum compatibility, turn video stabilization on or off, record with or without sound and use the flashlight as a video light. A live counter shows how many minutes of video still fit on your iPhone with the current settings.

FULL MANUAL CONTROLS
• ISO and shutter speed (from 1/8000 s) for precise exposure
• White balance in Kelvin (2500–9000 K)
• Manual focus by lens position
• Exposure compensation (EV)
• One tap returns everything to auto
A live readout always shows the ISO, shutter speed, white balance and focus the camera is using, with your manual values highlighted.

COMPOSE BETTER
• Rule of thirds, golden ratio and square 1:1 grids
• Horizon level that turns yellow when your phone is straight
• Tap to focus, long-press to lock focus and exposure (AE/AF lock)
• Ultra wide, wide and telephoto lens buttons plus pinch to zoom (available lenses depend on your iPhone)
• 3 s and 10 s self-timer

PHOTOS YOUR WAY
Take full-resolution photos as HEIF or JPEG with the flash off, on auto or on. Photos and videos are saved straight to your photo library, and you can review and share the last shot without leaving the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Camera 4K Pro collects no data; everything you capture stays on your device.

name: Camvo: Retro Camcorder & VHS
description:
Camvo turns your iPhone into an old camcorder or a Super 8 film camera. The look is made live from the camera, frame by frame, so what you see in the viewfinder is what you get, not a faded filter laid on top.

FOUR LOOKS, EVERY ONE INCLUDED
• VHS '89: soft colour, tape noise, tracking lines and the REC and timecode on screen.
• Super 8: film grain, dust, a gently weaving gate and 18 frames a second.
• Hi8 '95: the sharper tape of the mid-90s family camcorder.
• Tape '04: the clean, bright look of a 2000s digital camcorder.
Swipe across the viewfinder or tap a tape label to switch looks.

DIALS LIKE THE REAL THING
• Tracking and film wear, from clean to well-worn.
• White balance: Auto, Daylight or Tungsten, the warm and blue casts old cameras gave.
• Full frame or 4:3 for VHS.
• A date stamp with any day from 1950 to 2099, in your own date format.
• Tape sound and projector hum, heard when you play or share the clip.
• Hide all the text on screen with one tap.

FILM NOW, DECIDE LATER
Camvo keeps a clean copy of each clip, so you can change its look, date or dials after filming. Turn it off in Settings to save space.

YOUR OLD VIDEOS TOO
Give any video or photo from Photos the look. You can keep filming while it works.

A HOME MOVIE IN ONE TAP
Pick a few clips and join them into one movie, with a moment of tape snow between each.

MADE FOR NOW
Turn the phone sideways for a sideways clip (with Rotation Lock off). Photos as well as video. Save or share in the best quality, the most compatible format or a smaller file for messages.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. What you film stays on your iPhone unless you save or share it. Camvo sends only anonymous crash reports and anonymous counts of what's used, never pictures, sound or places.

name: Capital Courier
description:
Deliver packages across America and learn every state capital along the way!

Capital Courier is a playful geography game for kids, families, students and anyone who wants to finally remember the 50 U.S. states and their capitals. Guide your little snail courier across the map, answer capital questions, and claim every state.

HOW TO PLAY
- Pick a starting state and answer its capital question to begin.
- Choose your next destination from the states bordering the one you are in.
- Pick the right capital from four choices to deliver your package and claim the state.
- A wrong answer costs your turn, but the delivery is still waiting for you to try again.
- Earn coins for each delivery and spend them to hop back to states you already own.
- Watch the turn clock, and plan a long route across the country.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT
- Learn all 50 states and capitals by playing, not by memorizing a list.
- Smart answer choices: the correct capital appears with the state's famous cities and another state's capital, so you really have to know it.
- Special links connect Washington to Alaska and California to Hawaii, so even the far-away states join the journey.
- A colorful map shows every state you own and the route your snail has traveled.
- Your ten best runs are saved on your device. Beat your record for more states, more coins and the longest route.
- A final results screen shows your states, coins, longest route, time and accuracy.

GREAT FOR
- Kids learning U.S. geography at home or in the classroom
- Family game time and quiet travel time
- Students reviewing the capitals before a test

NO ADS. NO ACCOUNTS. NO DATA COLLECTED.
Capital Courier works on iPhone and iPad. Single Play needs no sign-in and no internet connection to play.

Ready to deliver? Start your journey and see how fast you can claim all 50 states!

name: Car Spa VIP
description:
Car Spa VIP is the official app of Car Spa VIP, the steam car wash in Karbala and Nasiriyah, Iraq.

Become a member and wash your car as often as your package allows, at either branch.

What you can do
• See the packages and choose the one that fits your car
• Register your car and activate your membership at the branch
• Book your wash time and skip the queue
• Track how many washes you have used and how many are left
• Get a reminder one hour before your appointment
• Share your referral code and earn a free wash when a friend joins
• Buy a membership as a gift for family or friends
• See member benefits and discounts from our partners
• Relax in our waiting room and café while we take care of your car

Steam cleaning uses very little water, is gentle on paint and reaches every corner inside and out.

Payment is made at the branch. Sign in with your phone number, a code is sent on WhatsApp or SMS.

Karbala branch: open daily 11:00 to 24:00
Nasiriyah branch: open daily 12:00 to 24:00

name: Car Spotter: RDC
description:
Every December, cars start wearing antlers. Car Spotter turns spotting them into a friendly competition.

TAP TO LOG
See a car with reindeer antlers? Tap the big button and it counts. Made a mistake? Undo it within a minute.

A LIVE LEADERBOARD
Create a private group and share its invite code with family and friends, wherever they live. Everyone's tally updates in real time, with a podium for the top three and a running gap to the leader.

FEED AND MAP
Watch each sighting roll in as it happens, and see where they were spotted on a map. Pins are rounded to about a kilometer and are always optional.

ALERTS
Get a notification when someone in your group spots one, or takes the lead.

KIDS CAN PLAY TOO
Add kid profiles and log for them from your phone. Share a profile with another parent using a one-time code so both of you add to the same score.

QUICK ADD ANYWHERE
Log a sighting from a Home Screen or Lock Screen widget, Control Center, or by asking Siri, without opening the app.

NEW SEASON EVERY YEAR
The group's creator can start a fresh season, name it, and everyone begins again at zero.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No account to create: pick a nickname and an avatar and you're in. Your sightings are visible only to people in your groups, and you can delete everything from Settings at any time.

name: CarbonSafetyDors
description:
Energy use begins at the building shell and continues at every hot water tap.
CarbonSafetyDors brings ten building and water-heating calculators into one workspace.

BUILDING ENVELOPE | SUN, ROOF & WALLS
Explore Window Solar Gain Energy for sunlight entering through glazing.
Review Roof Insulation Thermal Resistance for a selected roof assembly.
Examine Wall Thermal Bridging Loss where heat can bypass insulation.
Estimate Infiltration Air Energy Loss from air exchange assumptions.
Keep solar gains and heat losses distinct in your review.

HOT WATER | DEMAND & EFFICIENCY
Study Domestic Hot Water Energy Intensity for a chosen usage case.
Examine Water Heater Efficiency using its dedicated method.
Calculate Electric Water Heating Load from the values you enter.
Review Gas Water Heating Load as a separate heating scenario.
Consider energy demand without treating it as a utility-meter reading.

RENEWABLE SUPPORT | SUN & GROUND
Explore Solar Water Heating Contribution to a modeled demand.
Review Ground Source Heat Pump Energy for its own system assumptions.
Keep renewable contribution separate from total heating demand.

TEN QUESTIONS, CLEARER ANSWERS
Select a calculator and enter the quantities requested on screen.
Inspect its derived result and revise inputs to study another case.
Distinguish insulation resistance from measured building performance.
Treat energy savings and losses as estimates, not guaranteed outcomes.
Use the results for efficiency study and preliminary technical review.
Confirm site conditions and applicable requirements before making decisions.
CarbonSafetyDors makes building energy questions easier to examine.

name: CardGameFriday
description:
Welcome to Card Game Friday (星期五撲克派對) - the local multiplayer card table designed for 2 to 4 friends sitting together!

No physical deck of playing cards? No problem! Card Game Friday lets 2 to 4 players connect their iPhones over Local Wi-Fi / Peer-to-Peer Bluetooth to deal 13 unique cards per player, play in real time, and track cumulative scores across rounds with instant English (EN) and Traditional Chinese (繁中) switching.

[ 2 CLASSIC HONG KONG CARD GAMES ]

1. Big 2 (鋤大D):
- Full-screen horizontal layout displaying all 13 cards clearly in a single row with zero left-to-right scrolling.
- Authentic Hong Kong rules and hand rankings: Single, 1 Pair, 3 Cards, Straight, Flush, Full House, 4 of a Kind, and Royal/Straight Flush (Suit order from lowest to highest: Diamonds, Clubs, Hearts, Spades).
- Smart Turn Indicators: Full-edge curved screen glow and gentle haptic vibration when it is your turn to play.
- Automatic "LAST CARD!" Alert: Immediately warns the table when any player is down to their final card.
- Classic 1x / 2x / 3x Penalty Scoring: 1 to 9 cards left = 1x, 10 to 12 cards = 2x Double (炒雙), all 13 cards = 3x Triple (炒三).

2. 13 Cards / 3-5-5 Showdown (十三張):
- Arrange your 13 cards into Top (3 cards), Middle (5 cards), and Bottom (5 cards) using our intuitive stepping box layout or 1-tap Auto-Fill!
- Built-in Foul Guard (防倒水檢查): Automatically ensures Bottom 5 is stronger than Middle 5, and Middle 5 is stronger than Top 3 before locking in Ready.
- Exciting Bonus Multipliers: Earn 7 points for a Royal/Straight Flush or 5 points for 4 of a Kind in the Middle row, 5 points for a Royal/Straight Flush or 4 points for 4 of a Kind in the Bottom row, and 3 points for 3 Cards in the Top row!
- Detailed Head-to-Head Breakdown: View positive (green) and negative (red) points for every row and opponent after each game.

[ TABLE SECURITY AND PARTY FEATURES ]
- Host Security Approval: The Host confirms and approves each player before they join the room.
- Winner Shuffles Next Round: The top winner of each round gets the honor of triggering the 5-second animated deck shuffle for the next game!
- Live Score and Safe Exit: Check cumulative standings anytime mid-game, and use the Slide-to-End security bar to lock in final session results.

---

歡迎來到《星期五撲克派對 Card Game Friday》- 專為 2 至 4 位朋友聚會打造的本地連線撲克對戰平台！

出門聚會唔記得帶啤牌？只需打開《星期五撲克派對》，2 至 4 位朋友即可透過本地網絡或藍牙即時連線開枱，每人隨機派發 13 張獨立手牌，支援一鍵切換「繁體中文 / 英文」及自動計算每局累積獎分！

[ 二大經典香港撲克玩法 ]

1. 鋤大D (Big 2)：
- 橫向全屏單行顯示全部 13 張手牌，無需左右滑動，一目了然。
- 地道香港規則（花色由小至大：階磚、梅花、紅心、葵扇），支援單張、一對、三條、順子、同花、夫佬、四條及同花順。
- 輪到你出牌時設有柔和全屏邊緣發光提示及輕微震動；當有玩家剩最後一張牌時自動發出「最後一張 (LAST CARD)」警報！
- 自動計算 1至9張一倍、10至12張「炒雙 (2倍)」及13張「炒三 (3倍)」積分。

2. 十三張 (13 Cards / 3-5-5)：
- 階梯式「頭道(3張)、中道(5張)、尾道(5張)」排陣介面，支援一鍵自動排牌及「防倒水」自動檢查。
- 支援特別牌型加分（中道同花順 7 分、四條 5 分、夫佬 2 分；尾道同花順 5 分、四條 4 分；頭道三條 3 分）。
- 每局結束後清晰列出頭、中、尾三道正負得分明細（贏顯示綠色加分、輸顯示紅色扣分）。
- 贏家洗牌儀式：每局最高分贏家可專享「洗牌並開始下一局」按鈕，觸發 5 秒動態洗牌特效！

name: CarMate - مصاريف وصيانة
description:
CarMate رفيقك لتنظيم مصاريف سيارتك ومتابعة صيانتها، بواجهة عربية واضحة وسهلة.

• سجّل تعبئات البنزين والمبلغ والليترات وقراءة العداد، وتابع الاستهلاك عند توفر تعبئات وقراءات كافية.
• تابع تغيير الزيت والفلاتر والإطارات والبطارية والغسيل وباقي المصاريف.
• أنشئ تذكيرات صيانة بالتاريخ أو العداد، مع تكرار حسب الأشهر أو المسافة.
• عند إتمام الصيانة، سجّل تكلفتها وتفاصيل الزيت والقطعة والورشة والضمان، وحدد الموعد التالي.
• أضف أكثر من سيارة مع سجل مستقل لكل سيارة.
• اعرض إجمالي المصاريف وتقارير شهرية وسنوية، وصدّر تقارير PDF عربية.
• ابحث في السجلات وفلترها حسب الفئة والفترة.
• احفظ نسخة احتياطية لكل سياراتك واستعدها من ملف JSON.

لا يحتاج التطبيق إلى حساب، ولا يحتوي على إعلانات أو تتبع إعلاني. تبقى بياناتك محلياً على جهازك، ويمكنك تصديرها باختيارك. الحفظ إلى مزود سحابي يتم يدوياً من نافذة الملفات إذا كان متاحاً.

تذكيرات التاريخ تحتاج إلى إذن الإشعارات، وقد تتأثر بإعدادات الجهاز. متابعة مواعيد الكيلومترات تحتاج إلى تحديث قراءة العداد يدوياً. تغيير رمز العملة لا يحوّل قيمة المصاريف.

name: Carol Nightstand
description:
Carol Nightstand turns your iPhone or iPad into a calm, beautiful bedside clock.

Big, easy-to-read numbers in seven color themes and a choice of typefaces. Local weather at a glance. The morning headlines. Sleep sounds to drift off to: white, pink and brown noise, rain, ocean and fan.

Real alarms, not just a screen. Alarms are system alarms, so they ring with the screen locked, with the app closed, and through silent mode and Focus. Set different alarms for different days, choose a snooze length, and wake to a shuffled playlist from your Apple Music library.

The screen dims for the night and stays awake while your device charges, so the time is always there when you glance over.

No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. Wake-up music requires an Apple Music subscription.

name: Carrot Out
description:
Pick a carrot. Make room for the next one.

Look through the layered glass boards and tap the carrots you can reach. Collect matching colors in bottles and plan your moves before the spare slots fill up.

After each level, take your collected carrots back to the home screen. Press and hold to send them into a pixel picture, filling it a little at a time and adding new recipes to your collection.

Carrot Out includes 16 language options, including English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

name: Cast On
description:
Cast On is for the moment the person who will wear the piece is standing with you and the swatch is still in your hand.

Count the stitches and the rows over 4 inches. Write the width and the length of the piece in inches, and the name of the piece. The 4 inches do not change. This iPhone divides the counts by 4, multiplies by the width and the length, and rounds half up to a cast on and the rows to knit.

The piece stays on this iPhone. There is no account, no network, no sample swatch, and no file to send. Inches are used in every region. The cast on is arithmetic from the counts you type. It is not a body measurement, not a brand size chart, and it does not replace a pattern.

name: Casual Cricket
description:
Casual Cricket is the scorebook and the fines book for social cricket, in one app.

FINES IN TWO TAPS
Tap a player, tap the offence. Or press the microphone and say "Dave, dropped catch". More than thirty fines are built in, from golden ducks to turning up late, and you can add your own.

ONE LINK FOR THE WHOLE TEAM
Share a link to the group chat and everyone can record fines and follow the match. Only the person who runs the team sets anything up. Nobody else needs an account.

SCORE EVERY BALL
Set up the match on one screen, then score with big buttons for runs, extras and wickets. Strike rotation, overs, run rate, target and scorecards are worked out for you. Set your own rules: overs, balls per over, and what a wide is worth.

MATCH STATS
Top scorers, best bowling, catches, strike rates and economy, worked out from the scorebook. Ducks, wides, sixes conceded, fifties and hat-tricks can be fined automatically.

LIVE FOR EVERYONE
The score and the fines table update on every phone within seconds.

SETTLE UP AT STUMPS
Run the ceremony: each culprit is revealed in turn with their charges, read aloud if you like. Copy the results into the team chat.

YOUR TEAM, YOUR RULES
Choose your colours and logo, decide what each fine is worth and what the unit is called, and keep a season table across every match.

BUILT FOR THE BOUNDARY
Poor signal at the ground? Keep going. Entries are saved on your phone and sent when the signal returns.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No adverts, no tracking, no player accounts. Team admins can finish a match, remove entries and delete everything at any time.

Made by Nova Insight, who design and build apps and websites for clubs and businesses: novainsight.ke

name: Catch Island: Fishing Log & ID
description:
Catch Island is an aquarium you fill with photos of fish you caught yourself.

Add a photo, we identify the species, and your fish swims in 3D around your island, in the sea or in freshwater, sized to its real length.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add a photo of your catch and we suggest the species. Shoot it on a measuring board and we read the length too.
• Your fish swims around your island. Sea and freshwater fish live in their own waters.
• Collect shells to decorate your island, visit friends' islands and climb the rankings.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Catch log: species, length, weight, time, place, rig and notes.
• Choose who sees the place for every catch: Public, Only me or Don't record. Exact coordinates are never shown to others.
• Field guide: every species you catch fills your sea and freshwater guide.
• Rankings: biggest fish per species, catch of the month, field guide and neighbor rankings. Length rankings only include measured catches.
• Friends: visit friends' islands, feed their fish and nudge their owners.
• Decorations: from stone cairns to treasure chests, items of every rarity.

SPECIES WE IDENTIFY
74 species commonly caught in the seas and fresh waters of Korea and Japan. If your fish isn't listed, type its name.

START WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Start right away. To open the same island on other devices, link Google, Apple, LINE or Kakao.

Adding fish, your catch log, field guide, rankings, friends and basic decorations are all free.

name: Catch Paula!
description:
Paula the little mouse loves playing hide-and-seek!
Her friends begin a big search to find Paula, who always wanders off to faraway places.

【Game Description】
This is a 4-player game. Players are divided into Paula and her three friends.
Paula is invisible to her friends, so use skills and items to find her.
The friends win by catching Paula (moving onto the same tile).
Paula wins by surviving for 24 rounds.

Each tile on the map is connected by paths. On their turn, each player can take one of the following actions:
・Move
・Use a skill (consumes SP)
・End turn
Every round, an item appears on a random tile that has no players on it. The friends can pick up items. Picked-up items are used immediately.

【Other Useful Information】
You can place a pin by pressing and holding a tile on the map. You can share information such as where you want to go or where you think Paula is. You can also give instructions to your teammates, such as where to go or where to use a skill. Be sure to make use of this feature!

name: CavoraAI
description:
CavoraAI is the work platform by Cavora Partners for businesses. Specialised agents take on recurring work in sales, finance, HR, legal, IT security, quality, service and many other areas. With the app you stay on top of your organisation wherever you are.

WHAT YOU DO WITH THE APP
• Work with agents: ask questions, assign tasks, review results
• The orchestrator plans, brings in the right specialist agents and checks the result
• Dictate instead of typing, also for long texts and meetings
• Clear your inbox: approvals, questions from agents and open items in one place
• View and share files, reports, quotes and presentations
• Get notified as soon as a task is done or an approval is waiting
• Keep track of workflows and tasks

SECURE SIGN-IN
Passkey with Face ID or Touch ID, two-factor sign-in or your organisation's single sign-on.

FOR ORGANISATIONS
CavoraAI is built for businesses. Your organisation sets up accounts, roles and permissions; the app uses the same account as the web app at ai.cavorapartners.com. Agents only work with the knowledge and connections your organisation allows, and every step stays traceable in the audit log.

DATA IN SWITZERLAND
Conversations, files and knowledge are stored in Zurich.

Requires a CavoraAI account set up by your organisation.

name: CCOS Board Meetings
description:
CCOS is the app for board and committee members of organizations that use the CCOS platform by Mahsumah Company.

With the app you can:
• Follow your upcoming and past meetings, with the live meeting shown at the top.
• Open a meeting: its agenda items and attached files.
• Vote on the items open for voting and see your vote.
• Join the video meeting in one tap, with audio and video inside the app.
• Get instant alerts: meeting invitations, meeting start, voting opened, minutes ready, and reminders before a meeting.
• Jump straight in from a long press on the app icon: next meeting, meetings, notifications.
• Delete your account from inside the app at any time.

Security and privacy:
• Sign-in with two-step verification.
• Your organization's data is stored in Saudi Arabia.
• We never sell your data or use it for advertising.

The app is for members of organizations registered in CCOS. Your organization's admin adds you and sends your invitation.

name: CDL Yard: Backing Practice
description:
Practice the hardest part of the CDL skills test before you ever touch a real truck.

CDL Yard puts a tractor-trailer in a practice yard on your phone. Steer with your thumb, watch the trailer answer, and learn why turning the wheel right sends the trailer tail left. Then do it again until it is second nature.

SIX TEST DRILLS
• Forward Stop
• Straight Back
• Forward Offset
• Reverse Offset
• Wide Dock
• Alley Dock

SIX MORE FROM THE JOB
• Parallel Park
• Serpentine
• Drop and Hook
• Tight Dock
• Truck Stop at Night
• Right Turn

BEFORE YOU ROLL
• Air Brake Test: run the six in-cab checks in order and call each one good or out of service
• Pre-Trip Inspection: walk the rig stop by stop and flag every defect

PLAY ANY DRILL, ANY TIME
Everything is open from the first tap. Follow the order of the real test or jump straight to the drill you need. Every run is scored out of 10,000 for safety, positioning and efficiency, with bronze, silver and gold medals, and your results tell you the one thing to fix next.

LEARN THE CONTROLS IN A MINUTE
A short lesson shows you steering, reverse and the brake, then lets you back up for the first time with nothing to get wrong.

STUCK? TAP THE ?
Coach Dot's help sits behind the question mark. It lights up when you are struggling, tells you what to do right now, and can show you: Watch Dot do it, and she drives the drill for you.

DAILY DISPATCH
One new dock job every day, the same for every driver. Pass it to keep your streak.

FOUR CAMERA VIEWS
See the whole yard from above, look out the driver window, sit in the seat with both mirrors, or get out and look, just like the real test allows.

TEST DAY
Run the core exercises back to back with no coach and no resets, and see whether you would pass.

PERMIT PRACTICE TESTS
230 questions for the California Class A knowledge tests: General Knowledge, Air Brakes and Combination Vehicles. Every answer is explained and tied to its handbook section, and a drill mode brings back the questions you missed.

TEST READINESS
One number that combines your permit test scores, your drill medals and Test day, with the next thing to work on.

WORKS OFFLINE. NO ACCOUNT NEEDED.
Your progress is saved on your phone. If you want it on another device, save it with your email and a 6-digit code.

CDL Yard is a practice game. Its dimensions, physics and scoring are its own. It is not an official CDL test and does not replace instruction and practice in a real vehicle.

name: CGiBest
description:
The trading day at a glance: ticker tape, session clock, benchmark ETFs, sector heatmap, top movers, and the Treasury yield curve.

Dive into a stock or ETF. 1D–5Y line and candlestick charts with MAs, MACD, RSI, earnings and dividend markers, extended-hours trades, earnings vs. estimates, and analyst targets.

Market calendar, filtered your way. Track upcoming earnings, dividends, splits, and IPOs—or view just your watchlist.

Watch your price levels. Pin them on charts, sort them by proximity in the Levels tab alongside 52-week ranges and MAs, and see a flag when a watchlist stock nears one.

For informational purposes only; not investment, financial, or trading advice.

name: ChaChing Chores
description:
ChaChing Chores turns household jobs into a simple family allowance system.

PARENTS • Post chores with due dates, urgency, and optional pay • Reward speed: pay more if it's done early, less (or nothing) if it's late, or let the job expire • Repeat chores daily, weekly, or monthly • Approve finished work, or send it back with a note • See what each kid is owed, add bonuses, and tap "Mark paid out" when you hand over the cash

KIDS • Browse open jobs and claim the ones you want • Watch the clock: see exactly when the pay drops • Tap "I'm done!" and get notified when it's approved • Watch your balance grow, with the full history

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY • Everyone uses their own iPhone, and everything stays in sync • Parents sign in with Apple. Kids join with a code from a parent, with no account needed • Notifications for new jobs, finished chores, approvals, and payouts • No ads, no tracking, nothing sold

The money in ChaChing Chores is a record of allowance you owe, not real payments. You hand over the cash, and the app keeps everyone honest.

name: Charge and Go Mobility
description:
Charge and GO rende la ricarica della tua auto elettrica semplice e immediata.

Trova le stazioni di ricarica più vicine, verifica disponibilità e prezzi in tempo reale, raggiungi la colonnina e gestisci la tua sessione direttamente dall'app.

Con Charge and GO puoi ricaricare in modo semplice sia quando sei in viaggio sia a casa, collegando e gestendo anche la tua wallbox domestica.

Funzionalità principali:
• Trova le stazioni di ricarica e filtra quelle più adatte alle tue esigenze.
• Consulta disponibilità, potenza e prezzi in tempo reale.
• Raggiungi facilmente la colonnina tramite il sistema di navigazione.
• Avvia e gestisci la ricarica dall'app, tramite QR code o RFID.
• Gestisci pagamenti, storico e fatture direttamente dall'app.
• Collega la tua wallbox domestica e gestisci anche la ricarica di casa.

Tutto ciò che ti serve per gestire la ricarica del tuo veicolo elettrico, in un'unica app.

Charge and GO. Trova. Ricarica. Riparti.

name: Checkmate: Coin Chess
description:
Chess where you buy your own pieces: you get coins, pick your pieces with them, set them up and checkmate the king.

HOW IT WORKS
• Buy pieces: pawn 1, knight and bishop 3, rook 5, queen 9 coins.
• Set up: drag your pieces onto your starting squares. You can see where your opponent stands.
• Checkmate: then it's normal chess until a king is checkmated.

CHAPTERS: 11 QUIRKY OPPONENTS
• From Intern Ian via Hedge Harry and Royal Rita to the grandmaster Granny Gwen.
• Every opponent has a quirk: only knights, only the queen, a wall of pawns, a fixed order of moves …
• Three stars each: checkmate, win in few moves, spend little.

DUEL THE COMPUTER
• 9 levels from Novice (600 Elo) to Grandmaster (2650 Elo).
• You take turns placing pieces, 15 coins each. Whoever places last moves second.
• Your Elo rises and falls with every game. Record, Elo history and results against every level at a glance.
• Optional blitz clock: 3+2, 5+0 or 1+1.

SURVIVAL
• Wave after wave against ever stronger opponents.
• Your surviving pieces come along to the next wave, and so do unspent coins.
• One checkmate ends the run. How far can you get?

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
• No sign-up, no ads, no in-app purchases, no data collection.
• Works fully offline, the chess computer runs on your device.
• Your progress stays on your device. A game in progress continues after a restart.
• For iPhone and iPad, in English and German.

name: Chhaap
description:
Chhaap helps merchants run their loyalty checkout from iPhone.

Sign in with your existing Chhaap merchant account, open Scan and use the iPhone camera to read a customer’s loyalty QR card. Record eligible visits, check loyalty progress and redeem available rewards through the same Chhaap account your business already uses.

With Chhaap for iPhone, you can:
• Open the camera directly from the Scan tab.
• Scan customer loyalty cards using the rear camera and flashlight.
• Look up customers and check their loyalty progress.
• Record visits and redeem eligible rewards.
• Review activity for your business.
• Work with your existing staff and location permissions.

Chhaap is a merchant app. Customers continue to use their Chhaap loyalty cards through the web or supported Wallet passes.

An existing Chhaap merchant account and an internet connection are required. Camera access is used to scan loyalty QR cards; photos and videos are not saved by the scanner.

name: Chord Charts Pro
description:
Chord Charts Pro keeps your songs ready for rehearsal and for the stage, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

YOUR SONGS
• Chord charts in ChordPro, OnSong or plain text, and sheet music as PDF
• Transpose to any key and set a capo; every chord follows at once
• Read chords as letters, in German notation (H and B), as Nashville numbers, Roman numerals or solfège
• Chord diagrams for guitar, piano, ukulele, mandolin, banjo and bass, also for left-handed players
• Write down the order of the parts once and jump to any of them

SETLISTS
• Put songs into sets; each set remembers its own keys and capos
• Share a set as a single file, with its songs and sheet music
• Back up the whole library into one file

ON STAGE
• Pages or one long scrolling sheet, with autoscroll
• Turn pages with a tap, a swipe, a keyboard or a Bluetooth pedal
• A metronome you can hear, or only see as a light along the top edge
• Play a backing track along with the song
• Tuner and pitch pipe built in
• Show the lyrics or the chart on a second screen

NOTES
• Write on charts and PDFs with Apple Pencil
• Stick typed notes to a line; they stay with it when you transpose or change the text size

WITH YOUR BAND
• One device leads, the others follow to the same song and page
• MIDI: send commands when a song opens, call up songs from a controller, and keep delays and drum machines in time with MIDI clock

YOURS
• Your songs are plain files in a folder you choose, for example in iCloud Drive
• No account, no subscription, no ads
• The app collects no data

Three songs in the public domain are included, so you can try everything right away.

name: Chroma Bounce: Color Jump
description:
Welcome to Chroma Bounce: Color Jump — the ultimate high-speed neon arcade platformer that tests your reflexes, timing, and precision!

Leap from platform to platform, ride dynamic bouncy springs, and match colors to unleash massive combo score multipliers. Climb your way through 30 handcrafted adventure levels or push your skills to the absolute limit in the high-stakes Endless Arcade mode!

 GAME FEATURES


• 30 HANDCRAFTED ADVENTURE STAGES
Conquer 4 distinct chapters filled with dynamic hazards! Dodge deadly spikes, navigate crumbling platforms, bounce on turbo springs, and reach the summit finish line.

• 3-STAR MASTERY & STAR COINS
Each stage challenges you to collect 3 elusive golden Star Coins placed along the climb. Can you achieve a perfect 3-star rating across all 30 stages?

• REAL-TIME 1v1 MULTIPLAYER DUELS
Go head-to-head against friends or rival jumpers worldwide powered by Apple Game Center! Race simultaneously on identical courses, dodge hazards, and out-climb your opponent in thrilling real-time matches.

• SOLO PRACTICE & BOT DUELS
No internet? No problem! Challenge our adaptive AI Bot opponent anytime, anywhere to sharpen your jumps and reflexes.

• PRIVATE ROOM DUELS
Create a private room code and invite your friends for exclusive high-speed jump battles.

• ENDLESS ARCADE SURVIVAL
How high can you ascend? Climb infinitely as the screen scrolls, chain color-matching combos for multiplier bonuses, and secure your spot on the Global Leaderboards!

• RESPONSIVE FLUID CONTROLS
Designed from the ground up for iOS with ultra-smooth touch and drag mechanics. Fully optimized for 120Hz ProMotion displays and Dynamic Island.

• PURE ARCADE FUN — 100% FREE
No aggressive ads, no pay-to-win barriers, and zero data tracking. Just pure, addictive neon arcade gameplay.

HOW TO PLAY:

1. Drag or tap left and right to steer your bouncing chroma ball.
2. Land safely on platforms — all solid platforms keep you alive!
3. Match your ball’s color to the platform for massive combo multipliers.
4. Watch out for red hazard spikes and fragile crumbling steps.
5. Collect all 3 Star Coins and reach the checkered Finish Line!

Download Chroma Bounce: Color Jump today and start your neon ascent!

name: Cilog2
description: Cilog2 es la app para conductores y mensajeros de las empresas de transporte y logística que usan Cilog. Lleva en el bolsillo los despachos asignados y registra cada entrega en el momento, con la evidencia que pide tu empresa.

name: Circuit Lab Simulator
description:
Circuit Lab Simulator is a hands-on analog and digital electronics lab that fits in your pocket. Place real parts on a touch canvas, wire their pins together, run a time-domain simulation and read the result on a built-in dual-channel oscilloscope. No account, no ads, no network required.

PLACE AND WIRE REAL PARTS
- 33 components: DC and AC sources, resistors, capacitors, inductors, transformers, crystals, diodes, LEDs, NPN transistors, NMOS and PMOS transistors, op-amps, comparators, D flip-flops, SPST and SPDT switches, relays, fuses, buzzers, connectors, ground, voltmeters, ammeters, an oscilloscope, and NOT, BUF, AND, NAND, OR, NOR, XOR and XNOR gates.
- Drag a part from the Parts list onto the canvas, then drag pins to draw wires that snap to the grid. Move a part and its wires move with it, pinch to zoom, and undo any step.

SIX AC WAVEFORMS
- The AC source generates sine, square, triangle, sawtooth, pulse and noise, with adjustable amplitude, frequency, DC offset, starting phase and duty cycle.

SIMULATE
- Choose the total run time and time step, then run a time-domain (transient) analysis. Every value is solved on your device with an on-device calculation engine; no external service is used.
- Save a circuit as a file and open it again later.

WATCH IT ON A DUAL-CHANNEL SCOPE
- CH1 and CH2 are drawn in separate colors, with per-channel volts/div and an English-labeled voltage and time axis.
- Switch the scope between the oscilloscope and any voltmeter or ammeter, and open X-Y mode for clear Lissajous figures with adjustable X and Y ranges.
- Swipe the scope down to hide it; tap the centered thumbnail to bring it back.
- Voltmeters and ammeters use a classic dial with a moving needle and show a reading only once they are wired into a circuit.

TEN READY-MADE EXAMPLES
Voltage divider, RC charging, half-wave and bridge rectifiers, an LED with current limiter, a common-emitter amplifier, a MOSFET switch, a non-inverting op-amp amp, a comparator and an AND gate: ten circuits you can open, modify and re-run.

BUILT FOR TOUCH, BUILT FOR FOCUS
- Five interface languages: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Hindi.
- Works entirely offline; circuits stay on your device.
- No in-app purchases, no subscription, no analytics, no advertising, no account.

For students checking a textbook circuit, teachers demonstrating on a projector, and anyone who wants to see how a circuit behaves before soldering it.

name: CircuitPulse: Electronics Lab
description:
CircuitPulse is an offline-first professional electronics engineering suite and circuit laboratory designed for electrical engineers, technicians, roboticists, students, and makers.

Quickly decode component markings, compute precision circuit parameters, and access pinout references right on your workbench with zero internet required.

1. COMPONENT DECODERS
• 4, 5 and 6 Band Resistor Color Codes:
  - Bi-Directional: Select color bands to find resistance OR type an Ohm value (e.g. 4.7k) to visualize band colors automatically.
  - Tolerance (%) and temperature coefficient (PPM/K) calculation.
  - Automatic nearest standard E12 and E24 value matching.
• SMD Resistor Decoder:
  - 3-Digit EIA codes (e.g., 103 = 10 kΩ)
  - 4-Digit precision codes (e.g., 4702 = 47 kΩ)
  - EIA-96 high precision standard (e.g., 01C = 10 kΩ ±1%)
  - Decimal "R" markings (e.g., 4R7 = 4.7 Ω) and zero-ohm jumpers.
• Capacitor Code Converter:
  - Converts 3-digit ceramic and film capacitor codes into pF, nF, and µF.
  - Includes tolerance letter codes (J: ±5%, K: ±10%, M: ±20%) and voltage ratings (1H: 50V, 2A: 100V).
• SMD Electrolytic Capacitor Decoder:
  - Aluminum V-Chip and tantalum chip markings, EIA voltage letter codes (A: 10V, C: 16V, E: 25V, V: 35V).
  - Polarity guide: the black arc on V-Chips is MINUS (-), the band on tantalum is PLUS (+).
• Inductor Color Codes:
  - 4-band axial inductor inductance (µH) and tolerance.
• SMD Transistor Code:
  - Look up SOT-23 transistor, MOSFET and diode marking codes (e.g. 1AM = MMBT3904, J3Y = S8050, 702 = 2N7002).
  - Pinout diagram (B/E/C, G/S/D, A/K), NPN/PNP/MOSFET type and Vceo/Ic ratings.
  - Search by part name (e.g. 3904) and see every part that shares a code.

2. CIRCUIT CALCULATORS
• Ohm's Law & Power Wheel (V, I, R, P):
  - Enter any two values to instantly calculate the other two with step-by-step formulas.
• LED Series Resistor Calculator:
  - Source voltage, forward voltage, and operating current.
  - Presets for Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, White, and UV LEDs.
  - Power dissipation (mW/W) and recommended standard E12 resistor wattage.
• Voltage Divider:
  - Direct calculation of output voltage and division ratio.
  - Target Voltage Mode: Enter your desired Vout to discover the best standard E12/E24 resistor pairs with the lowest error percentage!
• NE555 Timer (Astable Mode):
  - Square-wave frequency (Hz/kHz), period, high/low times, and duty cycle.
• Series & Parallel Equivalents:
  - Calculate equivalent values for dynamic lists of resistors, capacitors, and inductors.
• RC & RL Filter Cut-Off Frequency:
  - Passive low-pass and high-pass -3dB cut-off frequency (fc).

3. PINOUT & REFERENCE LIBRARY
• Microcontrollers:
  - Arduino Uno R3, Arduino Nano
  - ESP32 NodeMCU DevKit V1 (30-Pin)
  - Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040)
• Visual Connector Diagrams (with pin numbers and names):
  - USB Type-A (USB 2.0 & USB 3.0, socket and plug view)
  - USB Type-C (24-Pin Reversible & Power Delivery)
  - Micro-USB & Mini-USB (5-Pin, socket and plug view)
  - 3.5mm Audio Jack (TRS Stereo & TRRS CTIA/OMTP)
• Standard Resistor Tables:
  - E6, E12, E24, and E96 series decades.

PRIVACY & PERFORMANCE
• 100% Offline: Works anywhere without internet.
• Zero Permissions: Never collects private data.
• Instant Language Toggle: Seamlessly switch between English and Turkish.
• Dark & Light Themes: OLED-friendly dark theme or a daylight-readable light theme; follows your system setting.

name: Clasha
description:
CLASHA — fight predictions with friends

Fight night hits different when something's on the line: pride, not money. CLASHA is a private prediction league for combat sports. Call every bout on the card, get scored automatically, and finally settle who in your group actually knows the sport.

No odds. No cash. Just Elo. Every pick is scored the same for everyone: • +100 for the correct winner • −50 for the wrong one • +50 extra for the exact method • +50 extra for the exact round

Perfect calls pay big. Pure bravado doesn't.

Cards all week Follow UFC, PFL, ONE Championship, RAF wrestling, Rizin and Cage Warriors. Full cards load with every bout, weight class and start time, so you can lock in picks from the opening prelim to the main event.

Private groups, real bragging rights Create a group, share the invite code, and keep a season-long leaderboard with your crew. Public groups are there too if you want a bigger pond.

Every pick on record Your profile tracks Elo, winner accuracy, exact methods, exact rounds and pending picks, plus your full prediction history. Receipts for every argument.

Never miss a result Follow fighters and get alerts when they're booked on a new card and when their bout ends. Badges unlock across Elo, accuracy and community milestones as you climb.

Built for fight nights Dark, fast, mobile-first design — lock a whole card in a couple of minutes.

No betting, no odds, no money changing hands. CLASHA is scored on knowledge alone.

name: Cleo PM
description:
Cleo is a workspace for people who run client work and projects. Whatever lands on your phone, an email, meeting notes, a message, a photo of a whiteboard, goes into Cleo and comes out as tasks with due dates and calendar entries you can tick off.

TODAY
• Your daily checklist, what's overdue, what's due today and what's coming up, on one screen.

TASKS
• Every task grouped by when it's due. Search, filter by status or by client and project, swipe to finish.
• Open a task to change its date, priority, checklist and notes.

CAPTURE
• Paste, type, dictate or attach anything. Cleo reads it and suggests the tasks and calendar entries inside it. Tick the ones you want and they're added.
• Share to Cleo from Mail, Safari, Photos, Files and other apps.

ASK CLEO
• Ask in plain words: "What's due this week?", "What's overdue for Northline?", "Move the audit to Friday."
• Cleo answers from your own workspace and proposes changes as cards. Nothing changes until you confirm.

CALENDAR
• A month view and a day agenda with your entries and due dates, including repeating ones.

AND THE REST OF CLEO
• Dashboards, clients and projects, drafts, reports and settings open inside the app, already signed in.

Cleo for iPhone works with your Cleo account from cleopm.com. Log in with your email and password or with Sign in with Apple.

name: CLICK-VOIP INTERCOM
description:
CLICK-VOIP INTERCOM é o aplicativo de interfone e vídeo porteiro da CERTOCLICK. Atenda pelo celular as chamadas do porteiro eletrônico, do facial ou da portaria do seu condomínio, empresa ou residência, com áudio e vídeo, de onde estiver.

Principais recursos:
• Chamadas de voz e vídeo pelo seu ramal SIP CERTOCLICK.
• Imagem do porteiro na tela de chamada.
• Abertura de portas e portões durante a chamada (fechaduras por DTMF), com um toque.
• Câmeras auxiliares (RTSP) para ver a entrada antes e durante o atendimento.
• Acesso rápido às portarias e câmeras cadastradas.
• Ganho de áudio para ouvir bem em locais barulhentos.
• Histórico inteligente de ligações e acionamentos.
• Agenda de ramais SIP e modo Não perturbe.
• Ativação simples: leia o QR code da área do cliente ou digite a chave de 16 dígitos.

O uso do aplicativo exige um ramal ClickVoIP ativo, contratado com o GRUPO CERTOCLICK. Ainda não tem? Contrate em br.certoclick.com.br/clickvoipintercom.

As chamadas não são gravadas no servidor. Gravações, quando feitas, ficam apenas no seu aparelho.

name: Clinician Timer
description:
This app syncs two devices (either one can be iOS or iPadOS) together: one acts as Timekeeper and the other acts as Display. When the app is open on both devices, the Timekeeper sets and controls the time, and shares it wirelessly with the Display. Updates to the Display's time (Pause, +/− 1 minute, Reset) can be sent as long as a connection is maintained between the two devices.

Useful when one person is responsible for keeping and communicating time for a presenter, clinician, etc.

name: Club Shack
description:
Club Shack  |  Be There.

Keeping up with your clubs shouldn't take time.

Club Shack helps students stay connected to the clubs they're interested in.

Follow your favorite clubs and see their upcoming events and announcements without constantly checking different platforms.

Set reminders for events you're interested in to get notifications about them.

Add events to your preferred calendar.

Explore student clubs, browse upcoming events, and find activities that match your interests.

Whether you're following a club you've been part of for years or discovering a new community, Club Shack makes staying involved easier.

name: Codemax® QuoteHero
description:
QuoteHero is the sales system Codemax staff use every day, now on your phone.

START YOUR DAY FROM ONE LIST
New leads, follow-ups due today and quotations waiting on you are on the home screen, for the country you are working in.

APPROVE FROM ANYWHERE
Every quotation waiting on your approval, with how long it has waited and why it came to you. Open one to see every line and every price, with each discount flagged, then approve it or send it back with a reason.

CALL NEW LEADS FIRST
