Leads you have not contacted yet sit at the top, then today's next steps, then everything else. Swipe a lead to call, and log what happened as soon as you hang up.

SCAN A NAMECARD
Photograph a card you were handed. QuoteHero reads it, marks any field it is unsure of, and once you have checked each one it becomes your lead.

KNOW WHERE EVERY QUOTE STANDS
See whether a quotation is sent or signed and how many days the customer has left to sign. When the deal is won, photograph the signed pages and record it on the spot.

KNOW THE MOMENT IT NEEDS YOU
Notifications when an approval is waiting on you, a lead is assigned to you, or a customer signs. Choose which ones you get.

SIGN IN ONCE
Sign in with your Codemax account, then come back with Face ID or your fingerprint.

QuoteHero is for Codemax employees in Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines and Indonesia. You need an invitation from Codemax to sign in. There is no public sign-up.

name: ComeBac League
description:
L'application officielle de la ComeBac League, le grand championnat scolaire de football.

Suivez toute l'actualité de votre équipe favorite :
• Résultats et scores des matchs en direct
• Classement général et statistiques détaillées des équipes et buteurs
• Calendrier des prochaines journées et compositions
• Résumés vidéos et replays exclusifs
• Billetterie officielle pour assister aux matchs au stade (Life Sports Club, Le Caire) avec intégration Apple Wallet
• Notifications en temps réel lors des temps forts

name: Comunvia
description:
Comunvia es la app de tu comunidad de propietarios. Si tu administrador de fincas trabaja con Comunvia, aquí tienes todo lo de tu comunidad en un solo sitio, sin llamadas ni papeles.

• Comunica una incidencia en segundos, con foto, y sigue su estado hasta que se resuelve.
• Consulta tus recibos: qué está pagado y qué queda pendiente.
• Convocatorias y actas de las juntas, y votaciones desde el móvil.
• Documentos de la comunidad siempre a mano: actas, presupuestos, certificados.
• Reserva zonas comunes (pista, piscina, sala) con el calendario de la comunidad.
• Tablón de anuncios y chat con los vecinos, con moderación.
• Avisos en el móvil: comunicados del tablón, convocatorias de junta, votaciones abiertas y novedades de tus incidencias.
• Protege la app con Face ID si lo prefieres.

SI ERES PRESIDENTE
Sigue las incidencias de la comunidad, publica avisos en el tablón, convoca juntas y abre votaciones.

CÓMO EMPEZAR
Tu administrador te da de alta y recibes tus datos de acceso. Si tu comunidad aún no usa Comunvia, pide información en comunvia.com.

Comunvia es un servicio de Soluciones para Hogares y Negocios S.L.

name: ConfirmaCitas Business
description:
ConfirmaCitas Business es la app para los centros que ya trabajan con ConfirmaCitas: fisioterapia, estética, peluquería y cualquier negocio que viva de su agenda. Entra con el mismo email que usas en el panel web y un código que te mandamos, sin contraseña.

TU DÍA DE UN VISTAZO
• Cuántas citas te quedan hoy y cuántas tienes mañana.
• Las confirmadas, los recordatorios enviados y los huecos libres.
• Las próximas citas del día, con el cliente, el servicio y la hora.

TODA LA AGENDA
• Vista de lista, rejilla por profesional o por cabina, y semana entera.
• Pasa de un día a otro con un toque y vuelve a hoy cuando quieras.

CADA CITA, RESUELTA DESDE EL MÓVIL
• Confirma una cita o márcala como «No vino», con la opción de deshacer al momento.
• Cancélala o bórrala, siempre con una confirmación antes.
• Muévela a otro hueco libre eligiendo el día y la hora.
• Llama al cliente o escríbele por WhatsApp desde la propia cita.

CITAS NUEVAS EN SEGUNDOS
• Elige el cliente, o créalo ahí mismo, el servicio y uno de los huecos libres.

TUS CLIENTES
• Búscalos por nombre, teléfono o email y abre su ficha con sus citas próximas y pasadas.
• Apunta notas y preferencias, edita sus datos y marca a los VIP.

AVISOS
• Reservas, cancelaciones, cambios y confirmaciones en la pestaña Avisos.
• Si quieres, también como notificaciones en este móvil.

VARIOS CENTROS
• Si trabajas en más de un centro, cambias de uno a otro desde Más.

Lo que se configura una vez, como el equipo, los servicios y los horarios, sigue en el panel web de ConfirmaCitas. Necesitas una cuenta de ConfirmaCitas: si aún no la tienes, la crea tu centro desde la web.

name: Cosmic Home
description:
Cosmic Home makes the times tables lightning fast. Answer in under 2.5 seconds and a gold lightning bolt zaps the asteroid.

FLY, SHRINK, COME HOME
• Outer Space: 11 worlds, from Moon Base to Universe's End. Tap the right answer before each asteroid reaches your ship.
• Inner Space: shrink down and ride through the body for 8 more worlds, with silly giant germs as bosses.
• Home Ground: come home for one busy Saturday of errands. 8 calm worlds where boxes roll by on a belt and you type each answer on a number pad.
• Each of the 27 main worlds has four missions: times, divide, mixed, and a boss round.
• Seven secret places are hidden along the way.

YOUR PET
Pick one of three pets. It hatches from an egg, grows as you clear worlds, learns new moves, and rides along in your ship.

THE SHOP
Earn stardust from missions and spend it on toys and auras for your pet, and new ships, parts, paint and trails for your ship. Nothing costs real money.

MADE TO MAKE FACTS STICK
• All 78 facts from 1 × 1 to 12 × 12, times and divide, in every main world.
• Facts that are missed or slow come back more often.
• In Outer Space and Inner Space, the right answer shows for a moment after a miss.
• At Home Ground, the Mastery Garden grows a bloom for every fact you have made fast.
• The Cosmic Arcade opens after Outer Space: Endless, and Boss Rush with 5 boss fights in a row.

FOR GROWN-UPS
• A grown-up area behind a PIN you make yourself. Its 12 by 12 grid shows every fact; tap one to see how fast it is answered.
• iCloud: each iPhone or iPad keeps a copy of its game in iCloud. Put the app back on, or on a new device with the same Apple Account, and the game comes back by itself.
• Vibration on iPhone, with its own on and off switch.
• The silent switch quiets the game, and your own music keeps playing.
• Works offline.

No ads. No purchases. No accounts. No data collected.

name: Crack Gauge
description:
Crack Gauge keeps monthly readings from tell-tales and width points on one wall.

Put the gauges on a photo of the wall. On each visit, drag the crosshair to the mark you see, or type the numbers. A width point uses the width card.

The wall then says whether the crack is still opening, which side has slipped down, and where the widest point sits on the BRE 251 scale.

Walls, gauges, readings, and photos stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This picture is not a structural survey.

name: Croquis Log - 人体クロッキー練習
description:
Croquis Log（クロッキーログ）は、ポーズ資料を見ながら時間を区切って人を描く、iPad 向けのクロッキー練習アプリです。1 枚 30 秒から 5 分まで、決めた枚数を止まらずに描き進めます。描いた絵と練習した時間は自動で残り、続けてきた日をカレンダーで振り返れます。

■ 練習の流れ
・1 枚の時間（30 秒、1 分、2 分、5 分）と枚数を選んで始めます
・時間が来ると絵を保存して、次のポーズへ進みます
・ポーズとポーズの間に、休みを入れられます
・残り 10 秒になると画面の縁が光り、予告音が鳴ります。音は設定で切れます
・終わったら、描いた絵と資料を並べたり重ねたりして見比べられます

■ 資料
・全身のポーズ資料 2,611 枚から選べます。16 枚はアプリに入っていて、インターネットにつながっていなくても使えます。ほかの資料は、使うときにインターネットから読み込みます
・資料は画面の左か右に置き、大きさを 3 段階から選べます
・白黒、ぼかし、左右反転で、資料の見え方を変えられます
・気に入った資料を、リストにまとめられます
・ほかのアプリでコピーした画像を貼り付けて、資料に加えられます
・資料の人形の絵は AI で生成しています

■ 描く道具
・ペン、鉛筆、マーカー、消しゴム
・Apple Pencil の筆圧で、線の太さが変わります
・レイヤー、取り消し、やり直し
・タイマーを使わずに、白紙に描くこともできます
・描いた絵は、ギャラリーから開いて PNG に書き出せます

■ 続ける
・1 日の目標を、分か枚数で決められます
・練習した日と時間を、カレンダーで振り返れます
・続けて練習した日数を数えます
・毎日決まった時刻に、リマインダーの通知を出せます

■ ご注意
・iPad 専用のアプリです
・画面は日本語だけです
・アカウントは要りません。絵と練習の記録は iPad の中に保存し、ほかの端末とは同期しません。アプリを削除すると、絵と記録も消えます

name: CrowdCue: Practice Live
seller_name: GPT LLM ORAGLE Ltd. Liability Co.
description:
Big stage energy. Just for you.

CrowdCue is a private place to practice speaking, tell a story, or rehearse your next big idea with a fictional audience.

MAKE THE STAGE YOURS
Choose a topic and a simulated audience size, from 100 to 100,000. Pick Hype, Curious, or Coach for encouragement, questions, or speaking prompts. Every viewer, like, and comment is simulated. There is no real livestream and nobody is watching you.

LET THE CROWD RESPOND
Optional AI replies respond to the words you send. Type a message or use your device’s speech recognition in English. AI replies are clearly labeled and can be reported from inside the app. Scripted practice prompts remain available when AI is off or unavailable.

RECORD AND REFLECT
Use the private camera preview, switch cameras, and record up to five minutes of video with sound. End your session to replay or share your recording. Add a short reflection and revisit your last 30 sessions, saved on your device.

YOU CHOOSE WHAT LEAVES YOUR DEVICE
Camera preview and recordings are never uploaded to CrowdCue. AI is off by default; enabling it sends your topic and submitted words to our server for reply generation. Optional voice recognition uses your device provider and may process audio online. Reported AI replies are retained for up to 30 days for review. Read the privacy policy for details.

FREE TO PRACTICE
No account, advertising, subscriptions, in-app purchases, or paid features. AI availability depends on server capacity and connectivity. Camera and microphone access are optional; text practice works without them.

CrowdCue is a simulation and entertainment app, not a real broadcasting service or a source of professional advice. AI replies can be inaccurate. Do not share sensitive information. Speech recognition availability varies by device. Recording and speech input operate separately.

name: CueBridge: Duo Teleprompter
description:
CueBridge bridges director and talent on iPhone Duo with a dedicated dual-screen teleprompter and camera monitor—plus full single-screen support on standard iPhone and iPad.

EYE-CONTACT COVER TELEPROMPTER ON iPHONE DUO
• Run your rear-camera viewfinder, audio headroom VU meter, AE/AF lock, and live script deck on the 7.6-inch inner display while your presenter reads crisp high-contrast lines on the 5.4-inch cover screen right next to the 48 MP lens.
• Calibrate cover lens edge offset (top, bottom, leading, or trailing) and optional beam-splitter text mirroring so eye line stays locked on glass.
• Single tap on the cover gently pauses or resumes scroll while every essential control stays accessible on the inner display.

SOLO VLOGGER TABLETOP & BREATHING PRE-ROLL
• Rest iPhone Duo open at 95°–130° to switch automatically to the inner ultra-wide camera above the crease—pushing text and framing safely clear of camera occlusions while placing oversized Record, Play/Pause, Section Skip, and Best Take favorite pads cleanly below the 40 pt fold band.
• Start any take with a calming 3-second Breathing Rhythm pre-roll (or toggle instant record in Studio Settings).

SCRIPT MARKUP, ON-DEVICE VOICE FOLLOW & LOCAL TAKE VAULT
• Write with color-coded `[pause]`, `[pause 2s]`, `[es]`, `*emphasis*`, and `§ Section` markers with instant WPM pacing and remaining time estimates.
• Enable optional 100% on-device Speech Recognition to advance lines as you speak, or use crisp timed scroll & Reduce Motion step mode.
• Review recorded takes side-by-side in Book posture, star your Best Take, save to Photos, or share locally via the system share sheet.
• Close iPhone Duo to edit script drafts one-handed and resume on the exact line when you unfold.

100% PRIVATE & OFFLINE
Zero accounts, zero analytics, zero cloud uploads. Scripts, recordings, speech recognition, and takes never leave your device.

name: CueDrift: Offline Teleprompter
description:
Prepare your words and rehearse at your own pace. CueDrift is an offline teleprompter reader for speakers, teachers and creators who use a separate camera or simply want to practice a talk.

Your script desk
• Write and edit up to 50,000 characters per script.
• Import UTF-8 plain text from Files (up to 250 KB); export plain text.
• Keep each script’s font, speed, side margin, countdown, mirror setting, reader appearance and reading position.

Rehearse without losing your place
• Full-screen reader with 20–80 pt type and adjustable spacing through side margins.
• Scroll at 5–180 points per second; pause, restart or set a position manually.
• Start after a 0–10 second countdown.
• Flip only the script horizontally for a mirror rig.
• Choose a paragraph for an approximate character-based jump.
• Keep the screen awake while the reader is visible; leaving the app pauses scrolling and saves the current position.

Clear scope
This is a rehearsal reader. It does not record video or audio, follow speech, float over other apps, control a remote, or drive an external display. A speed in points/second is not a speech-rate measurement. Paragraph jumps are approximate. Word counts split on whitespace and do not estimate Chinese reading time.

Local and private
No account, advertising, analytics, tracking, developer server, subscription or in-app purchase. Paid download includes all current features. English and Simplified Chinese follow system language. Native iPhone and iPad layout, light/dark appearance and Dynamic Type. Export a complete JSON backup; restore validates and previews before confirming full-library replacement, retaining a pre-restore sandbox copy. Maximum 100 saved records and 10 MB backups. Files you intentionally export follow your chosen provider’s policy.

name: CullMaster Pro Mobile
description:
CMP Mobile is the culling remote for CullMaster Pro on your Mac, built for photographers who shoot RAW.

Your Mac does the heavy lifting. Your phone gets every photo with every face and eye cropped at 100%, so you can check focus and catch blinks without zooming. Swipe up to flag, swipe down to unflag, swipe sideways for the next photo. Every mark lands in CullMaster Pro, and in Lightroom Classic, the moment you make it.

CULL FROM ANYWHERE
• Cull from the couch, the car or the plane.
• Download a shoot to your phone and cull with no connection at all. Your marks sync when you're back.
• Reach your Mac from away through Tailscale (optional).

BUILT FOR SPEED
• Faces and eyes at 100% beside every photo.
• Tap for true 1:1 pixels straight from the RAW.
• Hold an arrow to scrub through a shoot as fast as your phone can show it.
• Thumbnail strip, grid view and multi-select.
• Stars, plus filters by flag, stars, color label and camera.
• See your Lightroom edit with Edited Preview.
• A cull timer that runs with CullMaster Pro's.
• Share any photo at full size or phone size.

MADE FOR THE IPHONE DUO
Photo and faces side by side on the open screen, every pane resizable, and every layout remembered for each way you hold the phone. Works on any iPhone with iOS 26.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
CMP Mobile talks only to CullMaster Pro on your own Mac. No accounts, no analytics, nothing sent to us.

REQUIREMENTS
CullMaster Pro on a Mac (cullmaster.pro). CMP Mobile culls RAW shoots: the faces come from CullMaster Pro reading your RAW files. Full-size sharing uses the JPEG your camera embeds in each RAW; with some cameras (for example Sony and Fujifilm) that is smaller than full resolution.

No Mac at hand? Tap Try it without a Mac to cull a sample shoot.

name: CutPilot by Discount Moulding
description:
CutPilot is Discount Moulding's in-house app for the jamb saw in our own door shops. It is not for the public: it only does something on a Discount Moulding shop network, where it drives our CutPilot automated saw stop.

At the saw, the operator taps the door size being framed, confirms, and the saw's carriage moves to the exact length for the head jamb or head door stop. The app shows the carriage sliding along a tape measure and says when it is in position. It also cuts leg door stops, leg jambs and any custom length.

- Door sizes: single and double doors, full and square or prefit, with or without an astragal.
- Calibrate: measure the dado with a caliper, check the length against your own tape, and set the door stop thickness. The saw remembers it for every iPad.
- English and Spanish.
- One iPad drives the saw at a time.

Without a CutPilot saw on the network, the app offers a demo where the carriage only moves on screen.

name: CZL Mail
description:
CZL Mail is a native email client built for the JMAP protocol. It works with any JMAP-capable mail server, such as Stalwart. Email, calendars, contacts, cloud files and notes live in one app, and your data travels only between your device and your own server. We never see or store it.

EMAIL
• Real-time push sync, new mail arrives instantly
• Multiple accounts and shared mailboxes, with a unified inbox
• Conversations, flags, pinning, labels, archive and junk training
• Full-text search: local cache first, then your entire mailbox on the server
• Rich-text compose, signatures, auto-saved drafts and scheduled sending
• Remote images blocked by default; messages render in a sandbox for privacy and security
• One-tap unsubscribe, calendar invitations and read receipts

CALENDAR & TASKS
• Month, day and agenda views, recurring events and alerts
• Import .ics files; multiple calendars with colors

CONTACTS & FILES
• JMAP contacts with recipient autocomplete
• Browse, upload and download files stored on your mail server

NOTES
• Local-first Markdown notes stored in your own mail server's file storage
• Live preview, source and reading modes; task lists and tables
• Write offline and sync later; conflicts are shown side by side, never overwritten

SIGN-IN
• Server address + email + app password, or OAuth / single sign-on
• Credentials are kept in the system Keychain

Note: CZL Mail requires an account on a JMAP mail server. Mailboxes that only offer IMAP/POP3 are not supported.

name: CZL 图床
description:
CZL 图床（img.czl.net）的官方 iOS 客户端，在手机上管理你的图片与相册。

上传
从系统相册多选或直接拍照上传，可选择目标相册、储存策略与自动删除时间；切换页面时上传不中断，完成后一键复制全部链接。

图库
方形网格浏览所有图片，双指捏合切换列数；支持按文件名搜索与排序。选择模式下点按或横向滑动连续多选，批量复制链接、移到相册或删除。

查看
全屏左右滑动切图，捏合或双击缩放，下拉关闭。可复制原图链接或 Markdown、通过系统分享发送，或保存到“照片”。

相册与分享
新建、编辑、删除相册；为图片或整个相册创建分享链接，可设置提取码与有效期。

账号
使用 CZL 图床账号密码或 CZL 账号登录，登录凭证保存在系统钥匙串。需要已有 CZL 图床账号，可在 img.czl.net 注册。

name: Dahu Support
description:
Dahu Support est l'application de suivi du service après-vente de Dahu-Concept, agence web à Gap (Hautes-Alpes). Elle est réservée aux clients sous contrat de maintenance.

• Créez un ticket pour le site concerné : sujet, description, photos ou PDF en pièce jointe.
• Suivez l'état de chaque demande : Nouveau, En cours, En attente de votre réponse, Résolu, Fermé.
• Échangez avec l'équipe Dahu-Concept dans un fil de discussion clair.
• Recevez une notification dès qu'une réponse arrive.
• Filtrez vos tickets par statut, tirez pour rafraîchir.

Sans publicité, sans suivi. Vos échanges ne servent qu'à traiter vos demandes.

name: Daily Virtue
description:
Daily Virtue gives you one virtue to hold to each day: Patience, Courage, Honesty, Restraint, Kindness, and nine more. The list is yours to rewrite. Each virtue comes round about once a fortnight, so none of them fades from view.

SEE IT EVERY TIME YOU WAKE YOUR PHONE
Put Daily Virtue on your Lock Screen, and today's virtue and its question are there every time you pick up your phone: before you open a message, answer a call, or start scrolling. It's a reminder at the moments you need one, without opening the app.

Every morning a single quiet notification tells you the day's virtue, with one sentence about what it means and a question to ask yourself when it counts.

When a moment tests it, write it down:
• What happened
• How you handled it
• How well you held to it, from 1 to 5
• Anything else worth keeping

Over time you get a plain record of what you actually did, not what you meant to do.

HISTORY
Look back by day, or by virtue. The "By virtue" view puts the virtues you find hardest at the top, using nothing but the average of your own ratings.

MAKE IT YOURS
Edit any of the fourteen definitions and prompts, add your own virtues, reorder them, or pause any you want to leave out of the draw. Choose when the morning notification arrives, or turn it off.

WIDGETS
Lock Screen widgets show the virtue and its question, or the virtue with a ring that fills as the day goes by. A Home Screen widget shows today's virtue and how you have rated yourself so far.

A MIRROR, NOT A COACH
No streaks. No badges. No points. No advice. No account to create. The app never connects to the internet: no analytics, no tracking, no ads. Everything you write stays on your iPhone, and you can export all of it as a file whenever you like.

name: Dang - Podcast Player
description:
Dang is a podcast player made for Kurdish, Arabic and English listeners.

Find shows you love, follow the hosts you trust and pick up every episode right where you left off.

EXPLORE
Browse shows by category or search by title and host. Discover new Kurdish and Arabic podcasts alongside the best in English.

SUBSCRIBE
Follow your favorite shows and get every new episode in one feed, grouped by today, this week and earlier.

LISTEN YOUR WAY
A beautiful full-screen player with background playback and lock-screen controls. Your progress is saved, so you can continue listening anytime.

DOWNLOAD FOR OFFLINE
Save episodes to your device and listen without a connection. Played downloads are cleaned up automatically to free space.

MADE FOR YOUR LANGUAGE
The whole app speaks Kurdish (Sorani), Arabic and English, with full right-to-left support.

Sign in with Apple or Google to keep your subscriptions and progress in sync.

Questions or feedback? Write to support@dang.dilshad.net.

name: Darro: Ring Puzzles
description:
Darro is a quiet mechanical puzzle about finding alignment. Rotate concentric rings until every gap faces the brass marker and a single beam reaches the centre.

Seventy-two campaign dials unfold across six chapters. Later mechanisms link neighbouring rings, reverse their direction or return an inner ring to the outside, so every turn has to be planned. A daily dial gives you a fresh puzzle from the local date, and free play lets you choose the ring count and mechanism.

Keep what matters: a journal of recent attempts, bookmarks, a seven-day activity view, streaks, milestones and a chapter keepsake for every sequence you finish.

Studio adds photo dials, a six-second unlock sound and offline dial codes. Completed dials can be kept as scorecards, saved to Photos or shared through the system sheet.

Your puzzles and Studio creations stay on your iPhone unless you choose to share them.

name: Davamo: Shared To-Do List
description:
Whose turn is it? Davamo always knows.

Davamo is a shared to-do list for two, three or four people, laid out as a tennis court. Everyone has their own court. Every task is a ball. If it's in your court, it's yours. Flick it over the net and it's theirs.

No more "I thought you were doing it."

HOW IT PLAYS

• Add a task. It lands in your court.
• Flick it over the net to hand it off. It moves on their screen at the same moment.
• It comes back when it's your turn again.
• Done? Pull it back, hold, and let go. Smash. Confetti.

That's the whole game. No points, no streaks, no guilt. Just a clear answer to "who has this?" and a small moment of joy each time something gets done.

MADE FOR SMALL CREWS

• Couples running a home together: the bins, the groceries, the thing that needs returning
• Roommates and families splitting chores without the group-chat nagging
• Two friends planning a trip, a wedding or a move
• A freelancer and a client, or two co-founders, passing work back and forth

EVERY TASK HOLDS WHAT IT NEEDS

• Chat: talk about the task on the task, not three apps away
• Notes for the details
• Links, shown with their title and picture
• Photos and PDFs
• Approvals: list the options and mark each one yes or no (switch it on in the board's settings)
• An emoji and a colour, so you can read your court at a glance

STARTS IN SECONDS

• No sign-up for your first board. Name it, pick 2, 3 or 4 players, and play.
• Invite people with a link. They join with just a name, and the link opens in any browser too.
• Sign in with Apple or Google when you want more boards, and to keep them on every device.
• Want it closed? Make a board private and invite people by email.

THE DETAILS

• Notifications when a task lands in your court or someone replies on one of yours
• List view, for days you'd rather read than play
• Light and dark mode, your own accent colour and background
• Haptics and sound in every flick
• Finished tasks wait in the archive, one tap from coming back

FREE, AND QUIET ABOUT IT

No ads. No subscriptions. No tracking. Delete your account and your data whenever you like, right in the app.

The name is "davai" plus "vamo": "let's go" in two languages.

Questions or ideas? support@davamo.app

name: Daybook: Tasks & Notes
description:
Daybook puts today's tasks and your notes on one calm page.
TODAY, AT A GLANCE
• Today's tasks fold into a single line, or open into a full list with one tap
• Reminders, repeats (daily, weekdays, weekly, monthly), priority, steps and a note on every task
• Unfinished tasks carry over to tomorrow, so nothing slips
• A morning summary of what's ahead
• Hold any task to move it to tomorrow, set a reminder or change its priority
NOTES THAT KEEP UP
• Headings, quotes, lists, checklists, bold, highlights — on a whole paragraph or just the words you select
• Links to web pages and to your other notes
• Dictate instead of typing
• Notebooks for Journal, Ideas and Lists, plus #tags
• Version history and a Trash, so you can always go back
SKETCH AND MARK UP
• Draw with pen, highlighter, arrows and shapes on plain, lined, grid or dotted paper
• Draw right on a photo — the original stays underneath, so you can change it later
• Sketches stay editable: open one again and keep going
• Apple Pencil pressure on iPad
PHOTOS, YOUR WAY
• Crop and rotate, add a caption, give it a gentle tilt
• Full width or small, left, centred or right
• Scan paper pages and record voice memos into a note
WIDGETS
• Today ring, next task, quick capture, pinned and recent notes, and a large Today + notes widget
• Tick tasks right from the home screen
• Lock screen widgets for what's next
SHARE ANYTHING
• Send a note as text, a clean image of the page, a PDF or Markdown
• Hold a note for quick actions: pin, share, duplicate, delete
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything stays on your device. No account, no sign-up, no tracking
• Lock individual notes or the whole app with Face ID
• Back up to a file and export everything any time
MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
• iPad: sidebar, note list and editor side by side, with keyboard shortcuts
• Foldables: two pages when open, a writing desk when half-folded
• Light and dark mode, accent colours and alternate app icons
Daybook is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

name: DayFence
description:
Plan dates using the working week you actually follow. DayFence counts working days between two dates or finds a date a chosen number of working days away.

Create your own calendar with any combination of weekdays. Add specific working or non-working dates with a reason, so a one-off opening or closure takes priority over the weekly pattern.

COUNT A RANGE
Choose whether each endpoint counts. The result includes a daily audit showing which dates counted, which were skipped and why.

FIND A TARGET DATE
Move forward or backward by working days, with an explicit choice about the anchor date. A zero offset returns the anchor unchanged. If a target cannot be found within the scan limit, DayFence tells you instead of giving a partial answer.

KEEP THE RULES WITH THE RESULT
Save an independent snapshot of the calendar, inputs and full audit. Later calendar edits do not rewrite old results. Search saved calculations and export the complete report as PDF or CSV.

YOUR LOCAL LIBRARY
Create JSON backups, restore a validated backup or erase the local library. No account, subscription, advertising or permissions are required. Device backups may include app data; files you choose to share remain separate copies.

DayFence uses dates and rules you enter. It does not supply official public holidays or legal deadline advice. Dates are supported from 1900 through 2200; count ranges and offset searches are limited to 3660 calendar days.

name: DDMail
description:
DDMail — почтовый клиент для сервера ddmail и любых ящиков IMAP/SMTP. Письма собраны в беседы: переписка с человеком или группой — одна лента, как в мессенджере, а не плоский список писем.

• Беседы вместо писем: ответы, вложения и история переписки — в одной ленте.
• Папки диалогов с правилами по адресу получателя и домену собеседника — те же, что в настольной версии.
• Цвет беседы по адресу, на который пришло письмо: рабочее и личное видно сразу.
• Несколько учётных записей: сервер ddmail и обычные ящики IMAP/SMTP с автонастройкой.
• Картинки из писем не загружаются без вашего разрешения.
• Спам — в отдельной скрытой папке, без уведомлений.
• Календарь с неделей, месяцем и годом, напоминания о встречах, задачи и контакты; внешние календари и адресные книги по CalDAV/CardDAV.
• iPhone, iPad и Mac: на большом экране список и беседа рядом.

Для учётной записи ddmail нужен сервер ddmail. Пароль учётной записи ddmail на устройстве не хранится — только токен сессии в Связке ключей. Приложение не содержит рекламы, аналитики и трекеров.

name: Dentamora: Dental Anatomy 3D
description:
Explore all 32 permanent teeth in interactive 3D with Dentamora. Rotate and zoom each tooth, inspect its crown and roots, and use the FDI dental chart to move through the permanent dentition.

Study tooth names, positions, classifications, and typical exterior morphology. Dentamora presents educational anatomy alongside each tooth so you can connect what you see in 3D with the structures you are learning.

Practice with focused quizzes covering tooth identification, FDI numbering, classification, and morphology. Answer feedback helps you review each question, and completed quiz sessions are saved locally on your device.

What you can do:

• Explore 32 permanent teeth in 3D.
• Rotate, zoom, and switch between useful tooth views.
• Study typical crown and root morphology.
• Practice identifying teeth and FDI numbers.
• Review quiz answers and local learning progress.
• Study with bundled tooth models when offline.

Dentamora is designed for dental students and other learners. Its 3D models are educational exterior references; anatomical features vary between individual teeth. Dentamora is not a clinical diagnostic tool. Model sources and attributions are available in the app.

name: Départements
description:
Le 13, c'est les Bouches-du-Rhône ; mais le 48 ? Et la préfecture du Cantal ? Départements répond en un geste.

Choisissez un département par son numéro, son nom, sa préfecture ou sa région : la carte de France s'allume aussitôt sur le bon département, et sa région se colore autour.

TOUT EST RELIÉ
Chaque élément est cliquable et mène au même département : la carte, le numéro, le nom, la préfecture, la région. Touchez un département sur la carte, et les roues se placent d'elles-mêmes.

LES 96 DÉPARTEMENTS DE MÉTROPOLE
De l'Ain au Val-d'Oise, Corse comprise, avec leur numéro, leur préfecture et leur région.

DE JOUR COMME DE NUIT
Thème clair, sombre ou automatique, selon les réglages de votre appareil.

POUR QUI ?
Pour réviser sa géographie, pour retrouver l'origine d'une plaque d'immatriculation, ou simplement par curiosité.

RESPECT DE VOTRE VIE PRIVÉE
Aucune donnée collectée, aucune autorisation demandée. La carte est intégrée à l'app, qui fonctionne sans connexion. Pas de compte, pas de publicité, pas de suivi.

name: Ders Ajandam: Özel Ders
description:
Ders Ajandam, özel ders veren öğretmenler ve koçlar için defter görünümlü bir ajanda. Derslerini, ödemelerini ve giderlerini aynı yerde tutar; ay sonunda elinde ne kalacağını senin yerine hesaplar.

PROGRAMINI BİR KEZ YAZ
• Dersi eklerken "her hafta" seç; sonraki haftalar kendiliğinden dolar.
• Programın değişkense haftanın sayfasını tek dokunuşla sonraki haftalara kopyala.
• Tek bir haftayı değiştirmek ya da silmek diğer haftaları bozmaz.

ÖDEMELERİ TAKİP ET
• Ders ödendiğinde tek dokunuşla işaretle; tahsilat ödemenin alındığı aya yazılır.
• Gelmeyen öğrenci ya da iptal olan ders defterde kalır ama gelire sayılmaz.
• "Tahsil edilecekler" listesi yapılmış ama ödenmemiş dersleri gösterir.

KASAN AY SONUNU HESAPLAR
• Tahsil edilen, bekleyen, giderler ve ay sonu tahmini.
• Aylık gelir hedefi, öğrenci bazında döküm, her ay tekrarlayan giderler.
• Yıllık grafik: ay ay tahsilat ve gider.
• Aylık raporu PDF ya da CSV (Excel) olarak paylaş.

DEFTER GİBİ
• Noktalı kâğıt, el yazısı başlıklar, mevsime göre renk değiştiren yapraklar.
• Haftalık sayfa, aylık takvim, gün sayfası ve notlar.
• İstediğinde fiyatları tek dokunuşla gizle.

GÜNÜN HER ANINDA
• Ana ekran ve kilit ekranı widget'ı: sıradaki ders ve günün programı.
• Dersten önce hatırlatma bildirimi.
• İstersen derslerin Apple Takvim'de ayrı bir takvimde görünür; ücretler yazılmaz.
• İstersen iCloud ile iPhone'ların arasında eşitlenir.

GİZLİLİK
Hesap açman gerekmez. Reklam, takip ve analiz yok. Kayıtların telefonunda, istersen kendi iCloud hesabında durur.

name: Detent
description:
Detent keeps your two-factor authentication codes, and enters them for you.

AUTOFILL
Turn on Detent in Settings › General › AutoFill & Passwords. When a site or app asks for a verification code, tap the field and pick the account once. From then on Detent offers that account's code above the keyboard on that site, ready in one tap.

ADD ACCOUNTS YOUR WAY
• Scan a 2FA setup QR code with the camera
• Choose a photo or screenshot of one
• Paste an otpauth:// link or type the secret key

LIVE CODES
Every account shows its current code and a countdown ring. Tap to copy; the code leaves the clipboard on its own after two minutes.

SITES
Each account remembers the sites it signs in to, so AutoFill suggests the right one. Swipe on an account to see or change them.

WORKS WITH YOUR MAC
Detent for Mac lives in the menu bar, finds QR codes anywhere on screen, and has a command line tool and Chrome extension. Turn on Sync with iCloud Keychain there and the same accounts appear on your iPhone and iPad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your secrets are stored in iCloud Keychain, end-to-end encrypted by Apple. Detent has no servers, no accounts, no analytics and no ads, and it never connects to the internet.

Detent supports time-based (TOTP) codes.

name: DewBear-Hydrated, Earn Rewards
seller_name: Shanghai Mifu Information Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
Stay hydrated and make every sip count with DewBear, your daily water tracker and hydration habit companion.

Whether you want to drink more water or keep a better record of your daily water intake, DewBear makes it easy to log your drinks, follow your progress, and stay motivated with rewards.

WATER TRACKER & DRINK LOG
Record water, milk, coffee, tea, juice, and other beverages. Keep your daily drink log together and see your hydration progress throughout the day.

DAILY HYDRATION GOALS
Work toward your daily water goal with a clear progress display. Turn small, consistent actions into a daily hydration habit.

HYDRATION STATISTICS
Review your water intake by day, week, month, or year. Look back at your drink history and understand your routine over time.

BADGES & DAILY REWARDS
Complete eligible hydration goals and activities to collect badges and earn in-app coins. Celebrate your progress as you build your habit.

A LITTLE FUN BETWEEN SIPS
Play Water Drop Rush and catch falling drinks for a chance to earn bonus coins. Enjoy three free plays each day, with additional opportunities available through eligible activities.

Start your daily hydration routine with DewBear. Log your next drink and take one small step toward a more consistent habit.

Rewards and redemption options are subject to availability and eligibility.

name: DH-PHONGTHUY: Thước Lỗ Ban
description:
DH-PHONGTHUY là bộ công cụ phong thủy gọn trong một ứng dụng, dành cho người đang xây, sửa nhà, đóng đồ gỗ hay chọn ngày làm việc lớn. Chỉ cần nhập ngày sinh, mọi kết quả được tính riêng theo tuổi của bạn.

THƯỚC LỖ BAN – ĐO BẰNG CAMERA
• Đo kích thước cửa, cổng, giường, bàn, tủ, bếp, bàn thờ ngay bằng camera iPhone (chính xác hơn trên iPhone có LiDAR)
• Hiện ngay cung ĐỎ (tốt) hay ĐEN (xấu) và ý nghĩa từng cung

LA BÀN HƯỚNG NHÀ THEO TUỔI
• Biết ngay hướng TỐT/XẤU theo tuổi: Sinh khí, Diên niên, Thiên y, Phục vị…
• Hiển thị độ, hướng và sơn hướng trực quan

NGÀY ĐẸP & NGÀY CÚNG
• Lịch ngày đẹp theo tuổi, xem giờ tốt từng ngày
• Lịch cúng cả năm: Ông Công Ông Táo, Tất niên, Giao thừa, Rằm, mùng Một…

TUỔI LÀM NHÀ
• Kiểm tra Kim Lâu, Hoang Ốc từng năm
• Gợi ý những năm đẹp để làm nhà

HỢP TUỔI
• Xem hợp tuổi vợ chồng, làm ăn, xông đất
• Gợi ý năm sinh hợp với bạn

MÀU SẮC HỢP MỆNH
• Màu tốt nhất, màu dùng được, màu nên tránh – áp dụng cho sơn nhà, nội thất, xe

• Miễn phí, không quảng cáo, không cần tài khoản
• Chạy không cần mạng; thông tin chỉ lưu trên máy bạn

Lưu ý: nội dung phong thủy dựa theo quan niệm dân gian truyền thống, mang tính tham khảo.

name: Dhru Store
description:
Dhru Store helps owners and approved staff manage everyday operations for participating Dhru Dash businesses.

Work through New, Preparing or Picking, Ready, Delivering and History queues. Review quantities, customer notes, payment status and delivery windows, then accept or reject an order, check packing and move it to the next stage. Scheduled delivery windows stay visible.

Assign available riders before collection. Arrange assigned deliveries into daily routes, review stop order and load, and reconcile completed routes. The separate Dhru Rider app handles pickup, delivery confirmation and rider location sharing.

Search products and variants and switch availability without changing stock quantities. Switch between businesses you have access to, pause or resume new orders when permitted, and choose device notifications and foreground sound reminders.

Access follows your existing business role and permissions. Some actions, including stock adjustments, replacements, refunds and staff management, use the web dashboard. Internet access is required to sign in and confirm operational changes.

This app is for existing Dhru Dash business accounts. Your business administrator provides access; there is no customer signup or in-app purchase flow. Features and service availability depend on the participating business.

name: Diceaura
description:
Diceaura is a dice parlor with three tables and one shared purse of sparks.

Lantern Gambit asks you to build a pot and bank it before two Shade faces snuff the cup. Sky Chart walks eight constellations in order. Hold dice, spend two rerolls, and keep the sky you rolled. Echo Duel is a race of tricks against a house player that keeps a favored face.

Twelve Lanterns opens in order. Each lantern has its own demand, and the spark reward is paid once. A daily card sets the line and a kind aura until midnight. The dice chest unlocks new sets that change the rules, not just the look of the dice.

Play as a guest on this device, or sign in to keep your parlor, journal, and unlocked dice.

name: Dig Dad Dig
description:
Join Milo on an underground adventure to find his dad. Dodge hazards, steer through dangerous tunnels, and use your drill’s abilities to keep moving.

Explore a story campaign across six worlds, uncover the mystery of the Heart Engine, and take on a free run to beat your best distance. Customize the camera view and zoom to play your way.

name: Dinjägarexamen
description:
Dinjägarexamen är Sveriges mest omfattande app för jägarexamen sett till mängden studiematerial. Med över 3000 provfrågor, 3000 flashcards, 200 lektioner och 2500 bilder och filmer får du ett brett stöd inför teoriprovet.

Innehållet följer de kunskapsområden som ingår i jägarexamens teoriprov och hjälper dig att lära dig mer om jakt, vilt och natur genom övningar, dueller, steg-för-steg-lektioner i Jaktresan, jämförelsebilder, filmer, provfrågor och flashcards.

Följ dina framsteg, se vilka områden du behöver repetera och bygg kunskap steg för steg inför teoriprovet. Appen passar både dig som precis börjat plugga och dig som vill repetera inför provet.

Funktioner:
• 3000+ teori- och provfrågor för jägarexamen
• 200+ lektioner i Jaktresan – steg för steg
• 3000 flashcards
• 2500+ bilder och filmer
• Liveduell och Duellen – spela mot vänner och andra
• Statistik över resultat och framsteg
• Repetition av svåra frågor
• Tydlig översikt över vad du behöver träna mer på
• Mobilanpassad upplevelse för smidigt plugg var du än är

Plugga när det passar dig – hemma, på bussen eller mellan lektioner. Dinjägarexamen hjälper dig att hålla koll på din utveckling och göra pluggandet mer fokuserat.

Engångsköp. Ingen prenumeration. Ingen reklam.

Viktigt att veta
Dinjägarexamen är en fristående studieapp från Kompetenspunkten AB. Appen företräder inte Naturvårdsverket, Polisen eller någon annan myndighet och är inte det officiella teoriprovet. Provfrågorna är våra egna övningsfrågor.

Officiella källor
• Teoriprovet för jägarexamen (Naturvårdsverket): https://www.naturvardsverket.se/amnesomraden/jakt-och-vilt/for-jagare/teoriprov-jagarexamen/
• Jaktlagen (1987:259): https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-och-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/jaktlag-1987259_sfs-1987-259/
• Jaktförordningen (1987:905): https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-och-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/jaktforordning-1987905_sfs-1987-905/
• Vapenlagen (2026:408): https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-och-lagar/dokument/svensk-forfattningssamling/vapenlag-2026408_sfs-2026-408/

name: Dino Clock
description:
Dino Clock is the time clock for employees of Dino Equipment & Outdoors.

Clock in when you get to the store and clock out when you leave. One tap, no paper, no badge.

How it works:
- Log in with your cell number and a 4 digit PIN. Your manager sets you up.
- Tap Clock In at the start of your day and Clock Out at the end.
- The clock checks that you are at the store only at the moment you tap. It never tracks you in the background.
- No need to clock out for lunch. One hour comes out of any day of 5 hours or more.
- See your hours for today, this week and last week.
- Check last week's hours on Monday and ask for a fix if something is wrong. Your manager approves it.

Dino Clock is only for Dino Equipment & Outdoors employees. You need a login from your manager to use it.

name: Dishrally
description:
Dishrally is a potluck and party planner for the host. Set the date, invite the crowd, lay out the dishes the table needs, and see at a glance who is bringing what — and where the gaps are — before anyone turns up with a third potato salad.

PLAN THE PARTY
Give your party a name, a date and time from the calendar plate, a place and an optional theme. The Party plate counts down the days with a little pot whose lid lifts and rattles, and shows the numbers that matter: people coming, servings claimed and dish gaps left.

GUESTS AND RSVPS
Add everyone you invite and track each answer: invited, coming, maybe or can't make it. Tap a guest's RSVP pill to change it on the spot. Note plus-ones and dietary needs such as vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free or nut allergies, so the menu works for the whole table. The RSVP summary tells you how many seats are confirmed and how many there could be.

THE DISH BOARD
Organise the menu into starters, mains, sides, desserts and drinks. Each slot says how many it serves and who is bringing it; open slots stay dashed until somebody claims them. Per-course bars compare servings with your confirmed headcount, so you know whether there is enough for everyone.

WHO BRINGS WHAT
One screen lists every guest with their dishes, the slots still open and the friends who haven't picked anything yet. Share it as plain text to any chat, or copy it.

INVITES AND THE HOST CHECKLIST
Turn your party into a friendly plain-text invite and share it however you like. Keep the host jobs — chairs, ice, labels, serving spoons — on a checklist you tick off as the oven warms.

PAST PARTIES
Finished parties move to Past parties, with every dish and the friend who brought it, so next year's Friendsgiving starts from memory, not guesswork.

NAVIGATION
A lazy susan sits at the bottom of the screen with four dishes: Party, Guests, Dishes and Pantry. Spin it or tap a dish to bring that section to the front.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with email, Sign in with Apple or Continue with Google — or tap "Plan as a guest" and start right away. Guests can later save their parties to an account from the Pantry without losing anything. Everything works offline and syncs when you are back online. You can delete your account and all of its data at any time from the Pantry.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your parties are stored privately in your own account. No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Nothing is sent to your guests unless you share it yourself.

name: DJ Duo: Two Deck Mixer
description:
DJ Duo turns your phone into a two-deck DJ controller. Pick records, beatmatch, scratch, cut with the EQ and record your set, with nothing to plug in.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Half-fold it like a laptop: waveforms and your record crate on the top screen, the controller on the bottom. Lay it flat and sideways and the whole screen becomes the controller, jog wheels and mixer edge to edge. Close it and the cover screen keeps the set going: the record that is playing, the time left and the next record in your bag. Before the gig, the same small screen walks you through preparing a set. On any other iPhone, turn it sideways for the full controller.

BEHIND THE DECKS
• Jog wheels that feel like vinyl: scratch with your finger, motor start, record brake
• SYNC and beat grid: tempo and phase lock, cues that land on the beat
• Eight hot cues per deck, loops from ¼ to 16 beats
• Three-band isolator with kill, filter and beat echo on every channel
• Sampler with eight original one-shots that follow the channel fader
• Headphone cue: the next record in your ear, the set in the room
• Record your set: the master mix is saved as AAC, ready to share
• Hold a mixer knob to bring it up big and turn it with two fingers

YOUR MUSIC
Play your own audio files, or browse and stream tracks from Audius, the open music platform. Put records in your bag and drag them onto a deck mid-set. Three demo records written for DJ Duo are waiting in the crate.

One purchase. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads, no account.

name: DJ Mike Melice
description: Plan your event with DJ Mike Melice. Sign in with the client login provided after booking to view your upcoming event, complete your wedding planning form, choose special songs, manage music requests, and make a payment.

name: Dog & Cat Names
description:
catdognames helps you name your new dog or cat with names real owners actually chose. Over 20,000 names come from public pet licensing and animal shelter records in the US and Canada.

DOG OR CAT, GIRL OR BOY
Tell the app who you are naming and it shows the names that fit: girl, boy or both, for dogs or cats. Change your choice at any time.

HOW POPULAR IS A NAME?
Every name shows its rank, how many pets share it ("about 1 in 400 dogs"), whether it is rising or falling, and the girl and boy split where records list sex. A name can be a dog name and a cat name; see both.

BROWSE YOUR WAY
Most popular lists, styles such as Cute, Funny, Food, Nature or Mythology, names by first letter, and a random pick when you want a surprise. "Sounds like" suggests names that sound similar.

HEAR IT FIRST
Tap Listen to hear a name with your phone's own voice before you say it at the dog park.

MY LIST
Save names with one tap. Your list stays on your phone and works offline. No account needed.

DECIDE TOGETHER (OPTIONAL)
Sign in with Apple, Google or email to keep your list on every device and to share a list with family. Everyone can add names and vote; the favourites rise to the top.

YOUR PRIVACY
We never publish owners' names, addresses or zip codes. The names come from open data published by cities and counties. You can delete your account and its data in Settings at any time.

name: Dolma Kalem Uyumlu
description:
Dolma Kalem Uyumlu, yazmayı, okumayı ve düşünmeyi sevenlerin buluştuğu Türkçe bir topluluktur. Kalem, mürekkep ve kağıt üzerine deneyimlerini paylaşır, soru sorar, yazılar okur ve aynı ilgiyi taşıyan kişilerle tanışırsın.

Uygulamada neler var?

• Gönderiler: Yazını ve fotoğraflarını akışta paylaş, diğer üyelerin paylaşımlarını beğen, yorumla, kaydet.

• Sorular: Aklına takılanı sor, bildiklerini cevapla.
• Başlıklar: Bir konu aç ya da açılmış konulara girdi yaz.
• Gruplar: Aynı ilgiyi paylaşan üyelerle grup sohbetlerinde buluş.
• Mesajlar: Diğer üyelerle birebir yazış.

Topluluk kuralları ve güvenlik

• Uygunsuz bulduğun içerik, mesaj ya da hesabı uygulama içinden bildirebilirsin. Bildirimler yöneticiler tarafından incelenir.
• İstemediğin kişileri engelleyebilirsin.
• Hesabını uygulama içinden silebilir, verilerinin kopyasını talep edebilirsin.

Uygulamayı kullanmak için üye olman gerekir.

Gizlilik politikası: https://www.dolmakalemuyumlu.com/gizlilik

name: Domino Nights
description:
Domino Nights is dominoes the way it is played at a table on a warm night: four players, two partners, the click of the tiles and a little teasing.

Play your way
• Practice against computer players, on your own, with no connection needed.
• Play an online match one against one, for play-money points. When nobody is free to play, a computer player takes the seat so you never wait long.
• Open a private table, share its code or link, and play with your friends. The seats nobody takes are played by the computer.

The real game
• Double-six (0 to 6) and double-nine (0 to 9).
• Four players in two pairs, or two players head to head.
• Play to 100, 150 or 200.
• Take from the pile or pass when no tile fits, as your table prefers.

Made to feel right
• Tap a tile to play it, or drag it to the end you want.
• Pick from the pile by turning over the tile you choose.
• Computer players who talk while they play, in English and in Spanish.
• Three looks for the table, each with its own tiles and music.
• Quick messages to the table: hello, good luck, nice one, good game.

Points and rankings
Every player starts with 1,000 points. An online match puts 100 on the table and the winner takes it. Points are play money: they cannot be bought, cashed out or sent to another player. Your stats and the leaderboard show how you are doing.

No account needed
Start playing as a guest in one tap. Create an account with a username, email and password when you want to keep your points on another phone or play at a friends' table. You can delete your account at any time from your profile.

The game is in English and Spanish.

name: Doodle Dino Park
description:
Draw a dinosaur with your finger, open the gates, and watch it come alive in your own park.

DRAW
• Trace one of 141 real species, or draw anything you like
• An easy mode for young children, more tools for older ones
• Every drawing becomes a living dino with its own strengths, moods and things to say

PLAY
• Feed, pet and grow your dinos, hatch eggs and collect legends
• Choose a relaxed park, or an adventure park where you chase off shadow dinos at night and face the bosses
• Arena duels, army battles for two players on one iPad, and party games
• Explore the Wild Lands, catch wild dinos, and shape your park with terrain, weather and decorations

TOGETHER
• Open your park to friends with a room code, over Game Center
• Friends talk with ready-made phrases. There is no open chat

GOOD TO KNOW
• Works without an internet connection
• No ads, no purchases, no accounts
• Your park backs up to your own iCloud
• Game Center achievements
• English, Français, 简体中文, 繁體中文
• Play with touch, Apple Pencil or a game controller

name: Doorhang
seller_name: HOANG HAI VN TRADING COMPANY LIMITED
description:
Hang what you must not forget on the doorknob — then lift once before you leave.

Keys. Phone. Badge. Wallet. The same scramble at the door every morning. Doorhang turns each leave scene into a hook with tags you check off, latch when you’re ready, and learn from when you rush out early.

HOW A LEAVE WORKS
• Pick a hook for the scene: work commute, gym bag, weekend trip, school run — or build your own from a template.
• Tags are the things to bring. Mark the must-haves as critical.
• On Leave, unchecked tags stay on top. Tap Critical focus (shield) to clear the noise and see only the must-haves first.
• When every tag is checked, Latch & leave. The hook lifts; the leave is on the record.
• In a rush? Force exit and Doorhang logs near misses so you know what slipped.

INSIGHTS THAT STICK
• A zero-miss streak for clean latch-outs.
• Most near-missed tags, recent leaves, and a shareable leave report.
• Manual near-miss notes when you remember something after you’ve already gone.

YOUR HOOKS
• Add, rename, archive, or reorder hooks. Edit tags, critical flags, and weekday suggestions.
• Set a default leave hook and optional local reminders before you head out.

LOOK AND FEEL
Cool morning hallway, slate door silhouette, antique brass latch — a hanging checklist, not another generic to-do list. A Home Screen widget shows latch progress and critical tags left.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No tracking. No cloud upload. Hooks, tags, checkouts, and near misses stay on your device. Clear all data in Settings anytime.

Doorhang is a personal leave-home checklist. It is not a location tracker or medical device.

name: Dot The Scale
description:
Dot is the companion app for the Dot pocket Bluetooth food scale. Put food on the scale, see the weight on your phone, and save it with a name in one tap.

https://getdotscale.com

LIVE WEIGHT
• Connects to your Dot over Bluetooth in seconds
• Shows the weight in big, clear numbers, to a tenth of a gram
• Updates about six times a second as you add or remove food
• Tare with one tap to zero out a bowl or plate

RECORD WHAT YOU WEIGH
• Tap Record to freeze the reading
• Type the food, or tap one of your recent foods
• Saved with the date and time, instantly

YOUR FOOD TIMELINE
• Every recording in one scrolling timeline, newest first
• Grouped by day: Today, Yesterday and the dates before
• See the time, the food and the weight at a glance
• Tap any entry to fix the name, weight or time
• Swipe to delete, with a tap to confirm

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• Your recordings stay on your iPhone
• No ads, no tracking, no data collected

Dot requires a Dot Bluetooth food scale.

name: Dr Bahar NeuroVibe
description:
Make space for calm, clarity and a little joy with Dr Bahar NeuroVibe.

Discover a thoughtfully designed collection of 14 audio experiences, including 10 quick two-minute sessions. Choose a listening experience that suits your moment, put on your headphones and enjoy a peaceful break in your day.

WHAT YOU'LL FIND

- 10 short, two-minute listening sessions
- Audio experiences for relaxation, rest, focus and uplifting moments
- A beautiful, easy-to-use audio player
- An elegant interface available in English, Arabic and Russian
- A simple way to make mindful listening part of your everyday routine

YOUR MOMENT. YOUR SOUND.

Whether you want to unwind, take a short break or enjoy an uplifting audio experience, Dr Bahar NeuroVibe brings your listening collection together in one place.

For the intended listening experience, use headphones with the correct left and right channels at a low, comfortable volume. Do not listen while driving or during activities requiring your full attention.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

Dr Bahar NeuroVibe is intended for general wellness, relaxation and personal listening. It is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical or mental health condition. It does not replace professional medical advice or treatment.

name: DR-Technics

De app van DR-Technics voor het eigen team.

- Wat vandaag moet gebeuren, in volgorde van belang
