name: Drain Simulator: Flood Cleanup
description:
Grab your rake and get the water moving. Drain Simulator: Flood Cleanup is a first-person drainage and cleanup simulation where you clear blocked drains and send floodwater on its way.

Pull wet leaves off grates, shovel away mud and put a pump robot to work. Every opening you clear changes how the water flows, and you can watch it find its way out.

FOUR FLOODED JOBS
- Flooded Street: a tutorial street with puddles, two intersections and a spraying fire hydrant.
- Rail Underpass: waist-deep water under the bridge, a car stuck in it, both ramps to clear.
- Underground Garage: the ramp's trench drain is clogged and the water is pouring down into the garage.
- Farm After the Rain: the storm turned the farm into a reservoir. Dig out the culvert with an excavator, cut through the grass ridge and pump the low spots dry.

CALM, HANDS-ON WORK
No combat. Take the job, clear the blockage and restore the flow at your own pace. Your progress inside the longer jobs is saved on your device. No ads, no in-app purchases.

Play in English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español, Português, 简体中文 or 繁體中文.

name: DrapeRecast
description:
Your old curtains still have cloth in them. DrapeRecast works out how many new windows that cloth can cover, and it writes a cut list a workroom can follow.

Hang the new windows on one rod. Each drop is a different width and length, like the windows themselves. Tap one to see the cover you want, the cover the cloth can give, and whether the fullness still holds. A hatched gap means you are short, and it says by how many centimetres.

How a job goes

Measure the old curtains. Give each one a code, a width, a length, and the way the grain runs. Draw the faded patches and the old pinholes, or type the width of an edge you cannot use. Where two marks overlap, the cloth is deducted once. Lock a hem you want to keep. Any piece that keeps it has to sit on that finished edge, and the list shows where along the hem you took it.

Add the new windows. The opening, the width you need to cover, and the flat width of the cloth stay separate. Choose a single draw or a pair, how many drops, and the fullness. Set the side hems, the top turn, the bottom hem, and the seam allowance on each side of a join.

Lay the pieces on the old cloth. The sheet has a ruler. Defects are hatched. A locked hem is its own line. Drag a piece, or type its position when a finger is the wrong tool. The sheet tells you if a piece runs off the cloth, overlaps another, sits on a stain, fights the grain, or leaves a locked hem. Turn the grain only when you say that is allowed.

Stand at the fit chart and turn the fullness. You see the cover this layout gives now, the flat cloth you still need, and the highest fullness these pieces can hold. On a pair, the shorter side sets the limit. A short drop is reported on its own, next to the fullness, so a wide surplus cannot hide it.

Compare two ways to spend the length. Keep Original Hem holds onto the finished bottom. Unpick & Recut uses the length you measured after the stitches came out, then spends what the new hems need. The same windows sit side by side: width, height, what is short, how many seams, and what cloth is left.

Share the cut list. Each piece names the old curtain, the window, the cut size, the grain, where it sits on the cloth, the allowance on every edge, and whether the original hem stays. Pieces that are ready are separate from pieces that still overlap, sit on a defect, or have not been placed. Cut to the numbers. The drawing is only a guide.

The measuring, the layout, and the list stay on this device. Save the job, duplicate it for the next room, and pick it up again after a restart.

name: Dreameans
description:
Dreameansは、起きた瞬間に夢を残すための夢日記です。

夢は、起きて数分で消えてしまいます。Dreameansは開いてすぐ録音ボタンを押すだけ。声で話せば、そのまま夢の記録になります。もちろん文字で書くこともできます。

■ 声で記録
マイクボタンを押して話すだけ。端末上の音声認識で文字になります。ベッドの中で、目を閉じたままでも記録できます。

■ モチーフでたどる
「空を飛んだ」「歯が抜ける」「昔の家」——夢に出てきたモチーフで、過去の夢をたどれます。自分がよく見る夢の傾向が見えてきます。

■ 夢カレンダー
記録した日がカレンダーに残ります。夢を見た日のリズムが一目で分かります。

■ プライバシーは端末の中に
アカウント登録は不要です。夢の記録はすべてあなたのiPhoneの中だけに保存され、外部に送信されることはありません。公開範囲の設定も、夢ごとに選べます。

昨夜の夢を、忘れる前に。

name: Dual Audio
description:
Together, with your own soundtrack.

Dual Audio lets two people share one pair of stereo headphones while listening to different local audio or video files from one device. One player goes to the left channel; the other goes to the right. Each person uses one earbud.

YOUR SIDE, YOUR SOUND
Choose a separate file for each listener. Adjust volume, pause, seek and repeat independently, or use the shared controls to start both players together. Swap the left and right assignments without choosing your files again.

AUDIO AND VIDEO
Combine two audio files, an audio file and a video, or two videos. Watch local video in the app and open it full screen. Import compatible files through the system Files picker.

MADE FOR TIME TOGETHER
On a flight, on a train or relaxing at home: stay side by side without agreeing on the same track. Files already downloaded to your device can play without an internet connection.

SIMPLE TO START
1. Connect one pair of stereo headphones.
2. Choose a local file for each player.
3. Give each person one earbud and press play.

No account is required. The app remembers your selected files and playback preferences when those files remain accessible. Usage analytics and crash reporting can be turned off in the app's information screen.

IMPORTANT
Dual Audio plays compatible, unprotected local files. It does not stream from websites, download online videos or play subscription-service content. This is not a feature for connecting two pairs of headphones. Channel separation requires stereo output; system Mono Audio or other audio-processing settings can affect the result. Cloud files may need to finish downloading before playback.

Support: supportdualaudio@gmail.com

name: Duckgle: Korean for K-pop Fans
description:
Duckgle teaches you the Korean that K-pop fans actually want to say, one short lesson at a time.

Every lesson takes about 5 minutes and focuses on one expression, such as 보고 싶어 (I miss you), 사랑해 (I love you) or 기다릴게 (I'll wait for you).

HOW A LESSON WORKS
- Listen: hear the phrase in Korean, with romanization if you need it
- Understand: learn what it really means and when to use the casual or polite form
- Build: put a real sentence together, tile by tile
- Speak: record yourself saying it and play it back
- Remix: use the same pattern for everyday Korean
- Use: finish a sentence on your own

WRITE YOUR FIRST FAN LETTER
Every lesson unlocks a sentence for your fan letter. Pick the ones you like, listen to the whole letter and copy it to send.

KEEP WHAT YOU LEARN
- My phrases keeps every expression you have finished
- Review brings back the ones you missed
- Your progress and streak are saved to your account, so you can continue on another device

120 LESSONS TO START
Feelings, praise, concerts, everyday basics, travel, food and shopping, and fan comments. All lesson content is original Duckgle content.

PRIVACY
Voice recordings stay on your device and are never uploaded. No ads and no tracking.
You can delete your Duckgle data at any time from Home > Delete my data.

Questions or feedback: info@predict.kr

name: Duneweave
description:
Duneweave on pulmapeli, jossa siirrät hiekkaa kentän altaiden välillä.

Jokaisella altaalla on nykyinen korkeus ja tavoitekorkeus. Kun siirrät hiekkaa altaasta toiseen, hiekan kokonaismäärä pysyy samana. Taso on suoritettu, kun jokainen allas on tavoitekorkeudessaan.

Kenttä koostuu altaista ja niitä yhdistävistä reiteistä. Reitti voi olla kaksisuuntainen tai yksisuuntainen. Joillakin reiteillä voi siirtää vain tietyn kokoisen erän, ja siirrolla voi olla energiaa kuluttava hinta.

Peli sisältää 36 tasoa kuudessa luvussa. Luvut lisäävät vähitellen uusia sääntöjä: reittien suunnat, altaiden kapasiteetti, väliasemat ja siirtojen energiakustannus. Uusi taso avautuu, kun edellinen taso on suoritettu.

Jokaisen suorituksen jälkeen peli laskee käytetyn energian. Pienempi energiamäärä antaa enemmän tähtiä. Jokaisella tasolla on kolme tähtitasoa.

Pelissä on kolme vihjetasoa. Ensimmäinen korostaa aluetta, jota kannattaa käsitellä ensin. Toinen näyttää yhden mahdollisen seuraavan siirron. Kolmas näyttää koko reitin.

Siirrot voi perua yksi kerrallaan ja kentän voi palauttaa alkutilaan. Harjoittelutilassa voi rakentaa oman kentän ja kokeilla sitä ilman vaikutusta edistymiseen.

Pelissä on myös käsikirja, joka esittelee säännöt esimerkkikentillä, leirialue, johon voi sijoittaa koristeita, sekä saavutukset.

Asetuksista voi säätää äänet, värinäpalautteen, liikkeen vähentämisen, suuremman tekstin, värisokeille tarkoitetut symbolit ja reittien kontrastin.

name: Duo Aquarium: Calm Fish Tank
description:
Unfold a quieter world with Duo Aquarium, a virtual fish tank for small rituals and slower moments.

Create a freshwater garden or a little saltwater escape. Choose your fish and plants, adjust the lighting, and watch your aquarium settle into its own gentle rhythm.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose from 12 fish species across freshwater and saltwater habitats.
• Add flowing plants and choose a riverbed, stone garden, or open sand.
• Save three aquarium arrangements on your device.

SET A SOFTER MOOD
• Start with Daylight, Warm sunset, Cool lagoon, or Moonlit night.
• Adjust brightness and color temperature independently.
• Slow the movement, turn off bubbles and particles, or enable extra gentle motion.
• Listen to optional underwater ambience.

ENJOY THE LITTLE RITUALS
• Serve flakes, sinking pellets, or brine shrimp.
• Watch fish chase individual pieces and take visible bites.
• Rub the glass with your finger to clear simulated algae, or use Quick clean.

TAKE A MOMENT
• Fill the display with your aquarium in relaxation mode.
• Set a 2, 5, 10, 15, or 30-minute relaxation timer.
• Share an aquarium snapshot using the system share sheet.
• Enjoy adaptive portrait and landscape layouts on iPhone and iPad.

PAY ONCE. SETTLE IN.
All included fish, plants, food, and lighting are available with your app purchase. No advertisements, subscriptions, or consumable purchases.

YOUR WORLD STAYS YOURS
No account or developer analytics. Your aquarium is saved locally. The aquarium, artwork, generated sound, help, and legal documents are bundled for offline use. Optional support email and external links require an internet connection.

Duo Aquarium is an entertainment experience for relaxation, not medical care or guidance for keeping real animals.

Privacy: https://herbdev.com/duo-aquarium/privacy.html
Terms: https://herbdev.com/duo-aquarium/terms.html

name: Duo Boost: Better Web & Video
description:
Duo Boost gets more out of iPhone Duo in Safari: pages that fit every screen, better video and fewer annoyances, whether the phone is open, folded or half-folded.

WIDER PAGES
- Unfolded: sites show their full tablet layout instead of a stretched phone page.
- Folded: pages run edge to edge under Safari's side strip, with links and buttons kept clear of it.
- Text size per site and per screen, switching as you fold.

BETTER VIDEO
- Tabletop mode: half-fold the phone on a table and the video fills the top half, with big controls on the bottom half.
- Video Assistant: picture in picture, 10-second skips and playback speed on any video.
- Plain video player: Safari's own video controls where a site hides them, with picture in picture, AirPlay and full screen.

FEWER ANNOYANCES
- Hides "open in app" banners, sheets and buttons.
- Removes tracking tags from links and skips redirect pages.
- Lets you copy and paste where a site blocks it.
- Map links open in Apple Maps.
- Optional: hide cookie and newsletter pop-ups, stop video autoplay, keep links in the same tab.

Every feature has its own switch, and you can pause Duo Boost on any site.
No account, no tracking, nothing collected.

Most fixes work on any iPhone. Wide pages and tabletop video need iPhone Duo.

Designed and tested by an independent developer, written with help from AI coding tools.
Includes DuoWide by hyungchulc (MIT License).

name: Duo Camcorder
description:
Duo Camcorder turns your iPhone into a 90s camcorder.

RECORD WITH BOTH CAMERAS
Turn on Dual Camera to film the scene and yourself at the same time, picture-in-picture or split screen. Tap the small picture to swap them.

THE CAMCORDER LOOK
• A flip-out LCD with STBY/REC, running timecode and battery readout
• Glowing dot-matrix date and time stamped right into your video
• VHS effect: tape color, scanlines and color bleed
• POWER ZOOM rocker and big chunky REC and FLIP CAMERA keys

PLAY YOUR TAPES
Every video in your library becomes a tape. Play them back on a virtual VCR with faded color, tape noise and a rolling tracking band, with PLAY, REW, FF and STOP.

SHARE THE VINTAGE VERSION
Press SHARE to send any tape with the VCR look baked in.

MADE FOR FOLDING IPHONES
On iPhone Duo, the inside is your control deck and LCD, and the cover screen becomes the outside of the camcorder, with a live REC light so the people you're filming know you're rolling. Close it and keep recording.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your videos go straight to your Photos library and never leave your phone unless you share them.

name: DuoNote: Handwriting Diary
description:
DuoNote is your one handwritten diary.
Flip the cover and the page you were writing opens right where you left it. Grab the corner of the paper and it turns like a real book.

■ A diary only you can read
• What you write leaves this device only after it's encrypted here (end-to-end encryption). Not even the DuoNote server can read it
• Sign in with Apple and your encrypted diary is backed up to the cloud automatically
• Switch to a new device, sign in with the same Apple ID, and your diary comes back on its own (iCloud Keychain carries the key; if iCloud Keychain is off, enter your recovery key once)
• No AI features. Your diary is never sent to any third party, AI services included
• Prefer not to sign in? Everything works on this device alone
• Export as PDF and print

■ Made for iPhone Duo
• Folded, the outer display is your diary's cover. Swipe left to start writing, or swipe up for a quick note.
• Unfolded, the inner display opens a two-page spread like a leather diary. Stickers, photos and ink flow across the center fold.
• On any other iPhone you write one full-screen page at a time (you can also turn on a two-page spread in landscape in Settings).

■ Write, draw and decorate
• Pen, highlighter, eraser and lasso; pause before lifting to snap a clean shape
• Apple Pencil palm rejection, and while you use the Pencil your finger turns pages
• On lined paper, text starts at the line and the line you're on glows softly
• Auto Pen: Apple Pencil handwriting turns into typed text (Text tool › Input)
• Your handwriting is searchable too (recognized on the device only)
• Stickers, photos, camera, document scanning and PDF import

■ Organize with color index tabs
• Give each category (Journal, Work, Study…) its own paper (lined, grid, dotted, blank, Cornell, to-do or music staff) and tab color
• Tap a tab to jump to that category's latest page
• Calendar tab: a monthly planner with each month on a two-page spread

■ Quick notes
• Swipe up on the cover to jot on a yellow sticky note; saved notes go to your Quick Notes board

■ 17 covers
• 12 illustrated covers and 5 classic leather covers

No ads. No tracking.

name: DuoPod: Pocket Music Player
description:
DuoPod turns the cover screen of your iPhone Duo into a pocket music player. Turn the wheel with your thumb, feel a click at every step, press the centre to play. Small screen, one hand, no fuss.

MADE FOR ONE THUMB
• Turn the wheel to move through playlists, artists, albums and songs
• Spin fast and it jumps a letter at a time
• Hold previous or next to wind through a song
• On Now Playing the wheel is your volume; hold the centre and the cover fills the screen
• A hold switch and a volume strip on the side of the case, on the left or the right as you like

YOUR MUSIC, ONE LIBRARY
• Your Apple Music library: playlists, albums and songs, ready to play
• Your own files: MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF or FLAC from Files, or drag them in from a Mac
• Recently added, Most played, Shuffle and Up next
• Search with the wheel, no keyboard: spin to a letter and press
• Picks up where you left off

MAKE IT YOURS
• Ten cases: brushed silver, champagne, blue, pink, green and graphite metal, two flower prints, night and cream
• Two screens: a warm paper LCD or Stage, lit by the cover that's playing
• Covers that tilt and stand in a row, with reflections

SHARE WHAT'S PLAYING
Press the camera engraved in the corner: a shutter flash, and the song you're on becomes a picture sized for your Story.

FOR THE POCKET AND THE NIGHT
Pocket mode for using it without looking, a clock screen when you put it down, a sleep timer for bedtime.

Three sample songs come with the app, so you can start right away.

Pay once. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads, no account, no tracking.

name: Duploos
description:
Organize the field day in a digital site notebook. With Duploos, engineers, site foremen and construction teams record what happened, follow the schedule and gather everything in the Daily Work Report (RDO, Relatório Diário de Obra).

Projects and clients are set up in Duploos for Mac. On iPhone or iPad, the team looks up the project and logs the work in the field. The app is available in Brazilian Portuguese.

RECORDS
• Take photos or attach images from your library. Each record is linked to the project, with description, time and author.

SITE DIARY
• See the day's timeline with records, weather and status.
• Find daily reports by list or calendar, with search and status filter.
• Generate the diary PDF to share.

FLOOR PLANS
• Place record pins on the floor plan to show where each activity or issue was logged.

ROOM SURVEY
• Scan rooms on LiDAR-equipped iPhones and iPads, or type in the measurements.
• Adjust doors and walls, rotate and fit the plan, and remove overlapping walls.
• Convert the survey into a 2D and 3D project.

EXECUTION AND GANTT
• See the weekly list with planned and executed quantities per day.
• Browse the Gantt chart by Day, Week, Month and Year.
• Open an activity to check stage, team, planned, actual, progress, status and planned dates.

FOR YOUR TEAM
• See the current project, the client logo, the date, the weather and the latest records on Home.
• Access multiple projects and companies in one account, with owner, administrator, engineer and viewer roles.
• Use light and dark themes, with automatic sync.

YOUR PRIVACY
• No ads and no tracking.
• Delete your account inside the app: Profile → Delete my account.

Questions? privacy@duploos.com

name: DX Repair
description:
Your connection to the DX Repair bench—and useful tools for your station.

DX Repair brings amateur radio and electronics service, private repair updates, parts inquiries and a practical ham radio toolbox together on your iPhone.

FOLLOW YOUR REPAIR
Add the full private status link from your DX Repair email to view your equipment, current repair status and customer updates. Choose optional notifications for status changes, customer updates and estimates sent for approval. Private links are saved securely on your iPhone.

START A REPAIR REQUEST
Tell DX Repair about your equipment and symptoms using the repair-request form. Coordinate service and shipping with the shop before sending equipment. No payment is collected when you submit a booking request.

BROWSE PARTS
Explore product photos and descriptions, search the catalog and ask about availability or quantities. The Store supports inquiries; it does not show public prices or provide in-app checkout.

TOOLS FOR THE SHACK AND BENCH
Use eight offline calculators: SWR & Power, Coax Loss, Antenna Length, Wavelength, Ohm’s Law, Resistor Colors, SMD Decoder and Watts ↔ dBm. Choose a tool from the dropdown, enter your values and calculate. Online formula references are available.

PRACTICE CW
Train with the DX Repair CW Challenge. Listen to Morse characters, choose an answer and build your accuracy and streak. Your practice scores and settings stay on your device.

No separate app account is required. Repair tracking requires a valid private link issued by DX Repair. Estimates use their original emailed approval links; invoices and payment links are provided by email. Notifications are optional and require permission and an active repair link. Repair status, booking, inquiries and the Store need internet access.

DX Repair LLC • Greenfield, Ohio • Amateur radio & electronics repair.

name: E31 Driver
description:
E31 Driver is the mobile companion for professional drivers working with transportation companies that use the Eagle31 platform.

The app keeps drivers connected with their dispatch office and provides quick access to the information and tools needed throughout the workday.

With E31 Driver, drivers can:

• View current and upcoming assigned loads
• Access pickup and delivery information
• Review load details and instructions
• Upload bills of lading and delivery documents
• Submit expense receipts
• Access truck, trailer, and equipment documents
• View driver statements and payment information
• Share location with the transportation company's dispatch office while on duty
• Keep dispatch informed throughout load operations

Location services may be used while the driver is on duty, including when the app is running in the background, to help the transportation company's dispatch office monitor fleet operations and assigned loads.

E31 Driver requires an account provided by a transportation company using Eagle31. Drivers cannot create an independent account directly from the app.

E31 Driver is developed and operated by Elect Service LLC.

name: Earwind
description:
Earwind - A Little Breeze. A Beautiful Bloom.

Welcome to Earwind: Pip's Bloom Routes, a charming puzzle adventure where every gentle breeze brings the meadow closer to blooming.

Meet Pip, an adorable little rabbit with a wonderful mission: help tiny floating seeds find their way to empty flowerbeds and fill a peaceful garden with colourful blossoms.

With a cozy storybook atmosphere, soft pastel landscapes, and thoughtful puzzles, Earwind offers a delightful escape into a world of simple joys.

GUIDE THE BREEZE, GROW THE BLOOMS

Each puzzle begins with seeds waiting to find their perfect home. Choose the direction of the breeze, watch the seeds travel across the meadow, and guide them toward the flowerbeds.

Plan your moves carefully, navigate around natural obstacles, and discover the satisfying moment when a seed reaches its destination and a flower begins to bloom.

A PEACEFUL PUZZLE EXPERIENCE

Earwind combines approachable controls with thoughtful challenges. Every puzzle invites you to observe the meadow, consider your next move, and find a lovely path forward.

Whether you're discovering the basics or improving your puzzle-solving skills, each successful bloom brings a little moment of happiness.

DISCOVER PIP'S COZY WORLD

- Charming Breeze Puzzles: Guide floating seeds toward flowerbeds using directional breezes.
- Adorable Rabbit Companion: Join Pip on a gentle journey through a colorful meadow.
- Beautiful Storybook Artwork: Enjoy warm pastel colors, soft landscapes, and delightful garden details.
- Thoughtful Challenges: Plan routes around rocks, hedges, and other meadow obstacles.
- Growing Garden: Celebrate your progress as flowers bring new life to Pip's world.
- Flower Journal: Enjoy a collection that celebrates your blooming discoveries.
- Puzzle History: Look back on your completed challenges and personal progress.
- Personal Statistics: Explore your achievements and puzzle-solving journey.
- Easy-to-Learn Gameplay: Get started with a friendly interactive tutorial.

SMALL MOMENTS, LOVELY REWARDS

There's something special about watching a tiny seed become a beautiful flower.

Every puzzle in Earwind is designed around that simple feeling of discovery, progress, and reward. Take your time, explore different approaches, and enjoy the satisfaction of helping the meadow flourish.

YOUR MEADOW IS WAITING

A little rabbit, a wandering seed, and a world ready to bloom.

Step into Earwind and help Pip create a garden filled with beautiful moments.

Let every breeze bring a new bloom.

name: Easy Tarot: Learn the Cards
description:
Easy Tarot is the elegant way to truly learn tarot, not just look up meanings.

Built around the classic 1909 deck illustrated by Pamela Colman Smith, Easy Tarot takes you from first steps to confident readings.

LEARN
• Flip through all 78 cards: upright and reversed keywords and meanings
• "In the picture" notes explain what each image shows and why it matters
• Numbers, court cards, suits and elements made simple

PRACTISE
• Ten-question rounds: name the card from its picture, card to meaning, meaning to card, spot the picture, upright or reversed
• Smart repetition: cards you miss come back more often until you master them
• Track your progress across every suit

READ
• Draw one-card or three-card spreads (Past · Present · Future, Situation · Challenge · Advice, and more)
• Write your own interpretation, then compare it with a guided reading that highlights patterns: suits, numbers, repeated symbols, light and dark
• Save readings to your private journal

SYMBOLS
• A visual guide to colours, forms, landscapes, animals, plants and objects
• See every symbol in real cards, then test yourself

THOUGHTFUL BY DESIGN
• Card of the day with a reflection prompt
• Works fully offline
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress and journal stay on your device.

Easy Tarot is designed for learning, reflection and entertainment. It does not predict the future and is not a substitute for professional advice.

name: eBenDeepPulses
description:
Sukella hiljaiseen mereen, jossa jokainen ääniaalto voi herättää valasmaiseman kellon.

Asettele lähettimiä, peilejä, säteenjakajia ja viivesolmuja tarkalle ruudukolle. Sovita taajuus, vaihe ja rytmi yhteen, käynnistä äänipulssi ja seuraa, kuinka säde kaartuu, haarautuu ja aktivoi päätelaitteita.

Rakenna aluksesi satamassa, tutki uusia moduuleja ja suuntaa yhä syvemmille reiteille. Jokainen sukellus tarjoaa oman tiiviin äänipulmapelinsä, jossa selkeät ennakkonäkymät, tarkat energiakiintiöt ja haastavat pomovastukset vaativat huolellista ajoitusta.

Ajattele äänen kautta. Ohjaa kaikua. Tuo kellon sointi takaisin kotiin.

name: Echo: Speed & Connectivity
description:
Echo answers two questions about your connection: where you connect from, and how fast the world answers.

LATENCY
Tap the gauge and Echo times real requests to the services you use every day, plus a set of global ones.
• Standard run (3 samples per service) or Detailed run (10 samples)
• Median latency and jitter for each service, with the initial connection (DNS, TCP, TLS) shown separately
• Everyday uses: a plain verdict for gaming, video calls, streaming, AI tools and developer tools
• Local favorites follow your region, or pick another region to see how its services respond
• Compare a run with an earlier one to see what changed
• Tokyo reference: an hourly measurement from a server in Tokyo, so you can tell a slow service from a slow connection
• Tap any service for a closer 10-sample test

EXITS
See how websites see you. Echo asks several independent checkpoints which public IP they observe, then groups the answers by network.
• City and network operator for each exit
• Direct and exits, IPv4 and IPv6
• Split routing: know when different sites see you coming from different places

TOOLS
• Speed test: download, upload, and latency both idle and under load
• DNS test: find the fastest resolver for your network
• IPv6 test: a score out of 10 for your network's IPv6 support
• Traceroute: every hop to a destination, drawn on a map
• CDN radar: which CDN node is serving you
• Network diagnosis: find where the slowdown starts
• Global Ping: ping a host from 18 locations
• Reachability check: see if others can reach your server
• Domain X-ray: DNS records, mail setup and registration

HISTORY AND SHARING
• Past runs are kept on your device
• Share a result as an image. Your IP address is left out.

name: EdT365 Footballers: Stats
description:
Note: EdT365 Footballers is an independent app by Edtech365 Solutions Vietnam. It is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by any player, club, FIFA, the Ballon d'Or organisers (France Football), the Vietnam Football Federation (VFF) or any other federation. Player and competition names are used only to describe factual information. The app contains no player photos and no club logos.

Data sources (complete list)
• Wikipedia, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0: https://www.wikipedia.org
• Wikidata, licensed CC0: https://www.wikidata.org
• RSSSF (V-League records for some Vietnamese players): https://www.rsssf.org
• Archived VFF pages on the Internet Archive: https://web.archive.org
Every player page in the app links to the exact source articles, and every manually added season cites its own source. The data was compiled at release time (dataset 2026.11, up to 15 November 2026) and cross-checked between sources.

EdT365 Footballers lets you look up the playing statistics, trophies and Ballon d'Or rankings of famous footballers and compare any two of them with clear charts. Free, no ads, no account, and it works fully offline.

387 players
• About 200 all-time legends: Pelé, Maradona, Di Stéfano, Cruyff, Beckenbauer, Puskás, Zidane… Filter the Legends group and sort by generation.
• Everyone ranked in the Ballon d'Or top 30 over the last 20 years (2006–2026; the 2010–2015 FIFA editions list 23).
• Sort by all-time Ballon d'Or wins (since 1956), era, goals, trophies or name; filter by year to see that year's top 30.
• 5 Vietnamese players: Lê Huỳnh Đức, Lê Công Vinh, Nguyễn Quang Hải, Phạm Văn Quyến and Nguyễn Hồng Sơn.
• Search works without diacritics.

Player profiles
• Total appearances and goals for clubs and the national team.
• Goals per season chart; tap a bar for details.
• Season-by-season club table, with loan spells marked.
• Ballon d'Or placing for every year: top 3 since 1956, top 30 since 2006.
• Team and individual honours; runner-up and third places are listed separately and not counted as titles.
• Share a player's profile as an image.

Compare two players
• Appearances, goals, goals per game, best season, major titles and Ballon d'Or side by side.
• Filter by All / Club / National team.
• Cumulative goals by age, for a fair comparison across generations.
• Share the comparison as an image.

English and Vietnamese
• Switch language inside the app (Sources tab); it follows your phone's language by default.

Transparent method
• Appearances and goals: first-team club matches in all official competitions plus the senior national team. Youth, reserve and club friendly matches are excluded.
• For some Vietnamese players from the 1990s–2000s, public club records are incomplete. The app shows the seasons that have a source, marks them as "partial career", and leaves them out of totals and comparisons.

Feedback and data corrections: support@edtech365.vn (please include a source).
Privacy policy: https://edtech365.vn/cau-thu/privacy

name: EdT365 Vietnamese Proverbs
description:
EdT365 Vietnamese Proverbs is a pocket anthology of Vietnamese literature: folk verse (ca dao), proverbs (tục ngữ), idioms (thành ngữ) and great poems to read, understand and remember. Compiled by Edtech365, free, with no ads and no account, and it works fully offline.

TODAY
- A folk verse or proverb, an idiom and a poem picked for every day.
- A reading streak to keep a few-minutes-a-day habit.

A TREASURY OF SAYINGS
- Browse by folk verse, proverbs and idioms, and by topic: family, love, work, homeland, weather and farming, virtue, learning, life lessons, humour and more.
- Search without Vietnamese accents: "an qua nho" finds "Ăn quả nhớ kẻ trồng cây".
- Every saying comes with a Vietnamese explanation, an English gloss, notes on old words, a usage example, regional variants and related idioms with the same or opposite meaning.

POETRY THAT READS LIKE A BOOK
- Classical Vietnamese poetry, the New Poetry movement, playful verse in the Bút Tre style, poems from the Chinese classic novels (Three Kingdoms, Water Margin, Journey to the West, Dream of the Red Chamber) and classical poems quoted in wuxia novels.
- Poems written in Classical Chinese show the original characters, the Sino-Vietnamese reading, a literal translation and a verse translation; toggle each layer on or off.
- Poet, dates, source work and chapter, poetic form, background, a short commentary and the sources the text was checked against.
- Elegant serif typography, adjustable text size and a calm dark mode.

PRACTICE WITH SHORT GAMES
- Match the two halves of a saying.
- Fill in the missing word.
- Guess the meaning.
- Find idioms with the same or opposite meaning.
- "Who wrote it?": read two lines and name the poet.
Each round is 10 questions with an explanation after every answer.

NOTEBOOK AND REVIEW
- Save your favorite sayings and poems.
- Anything you miss goes into a spaced review schedule (1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 days) so it sticks.

BEAUTIFUL SHARING
- Share a saying or a poem as an elegant quote card image.

RESPECT FOR COPYRIGHT
Folk sayings are anonymous folk literature, and poems by authors who died more than 50 years ago are in the public domain. Bút Tre poems and other works still under copyright are only quoted for introduction and commentary, with the author credited and no commercial purpose. Every poem carries a clear origin label. name: Emaki: Story Language Series
description:
Learn English by living inside a story.

Emaki is a small-town mystery told shot by shot along one long, hand-drawn scroll. You arrive at a boarding school on a Monday in April. On the station platform a woman in a grey coat leaves an old notebook behind, written thirty years ago by two students who signed themselves N. and T. Hana wants it for the school paper, which will be shut down unless it prints a real story by Saturday's festival. Theo thinks it is private. Both are right.

You don't drill flashcards. You listen to the people you meet, and when it's your turn you answer them by tapping a reply or saying it aloud. The story moves on when you do.

SEASON 1 · THE NOTEBOOK
Eight chapters across your first week at school: the station, the dorm, the lost property office, your first class, the canteen, the club fair, the night before the festival, and the festival itself. Every chapter is everyday English you'll actually use: asking the way, borrowing things, filling in a form, introducing yourself, interviewing someone, saying sorry.

MADE FOR LEARNING
• Every line is voiced, so you hear the English as well as read it
• Play at Beginner (A1–A2), Intermediate (B1–B2) or Advanced (C1): the words, the pace and how long each line stays up change with you, or just Watch it as a film
• When a line is about something, the camera cuts to it, and its word goes into your notebook with an example
• Your notebook keeps the clues, the people you've met and the questions you didn't ask yet
• Speak your reply aloud, or tap it: your choice
• Load your own subtitle file to see a translation under each line

NO STRINGS
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking
• Plays offline once installed
• Free

Who is N.? Walk on and find out.

name: Emberwick
description:
One tiny keeper. A whole castle waiting for light.

Welcome to Emberwick, a cozy 3D puzzle game about a cheerful red lantern keeper and the little fireflies that light his moonlit home.

Turn wooden bridges between floating islands, match their golden tips, and build a road to the castle. Gather every firefly along the way, then send the keeper on a charming homeward journey.

LOOK AROUND THE LANTERN ROAD
Drag to orbit the real 3D islands and pinch to look closer. Moonstep bridges rise between terraces, so matching heights matters as much as matching directions.

DISCOVER NEW BRIDGE RULES
Explore 48 trails across six castle wings. Learn winding corners, sloped crossings, paired echo gears and shutters that open with firefly glow. Every trail is constructed with a complete solution.

MAKE THE CASTLE SHINE
Earn glow from first homecomings and improved grades. Plant it in garden lanterns, terrace windows, the echo bell and the crown light. Watch your castle brighten as you play.

KEEP A LITTLE MOONLIT COLLECTION
Welcome six firefly species, explore an interactive bridge almanac, and revisit your local footprint ledger. A date-seeded Moon Ticket brings another trail from your own device's calendar.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
No timer. Free hints, unlimited undo and free rekindling keep every puzzle welcoming. Choose a trace lens, adjust sound and haptics, or settle into gentler motion.

Turn a little bridge. Bring a little glow home.

name: Endure: Christian Discipline
description:
Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ. (2 Timothy 2:3)

Endure is a daily discipline for Christians who want to train body and soul as one. No noise, no cheerleading. A dark, quiet place to kneel, pray, and hold the line.
 grace. It quotes the Proverbs word for word from the King James Bible and points you to the right prayer for the moment.

Counsel remembers what you share (your fights, your goals, your wins) so every conversation picks up where you left off. Your memories stay on your iPhone, and you can review or delete them anytime.

PRAYERS
Ancient prayers from Augustine, Thomas à Kempis, Lancelot Andrewes and Jeremy Taylor, read aloud over a low frequency. Plus Post-Training Focus: a 10-minute guided cool-down that turns the end of every workout into an offering.

MEDITATE
Christian meditation is not emptying the mind. It is filling it with the Word. Choose a session, hold to lock in, and stay with one verse and the sound of Gregorian chant until the time is done.

SCRIPTURE ON YOUR SCREEN
A Home Screen and Lock Screen widget with a new verse every day.

BUILT FOR THE NARROW WAY
Onboarding asks what you are fighting and when you will keep watch, then asks for an oath: seven days. Your answers stay on your phone. No account. No ads. No tracking.

Counsel is an AI guide, not a pastor, doctor, or therapist. If you are in danger, contact emergency services or, in the US, call or text 988.

name: Engaid Market
description:
Engaid Market est l'application des commerçants qui tiennent leur boutique avec Engaid Market : gestion du magasin et boutique en ligne partagent le même stock.

POUR LA VENTE

Le catalogue avec photos, prix et quantités. Les commandes aux fournisseurs, les réceptions et le coût de revient avec les frais de transport et de douane. Les mouvements de stock, un par un.

CHACUN SON RÔLE
Gérant, vendeur, magasinier, caissier : chaque employé n'ouvre que les écrans de son travail. Rien ne s'efface : une vente annulée reste visible, avec son motif et son auteur.

Pour équiper votre commerce : info@softengaidagro-sn.com

name: Engine Simulator 3D: Torqo
description:
Start an engine, rev it, shift it and tune it. Every sound in Torqo is computed live from physics, so no two revs sound the same.

17 ENGINES IN 3D
Inline-4, crossplane and flatplane V8, twin-turbo inline-6, turbo-diesel truck six, V10, V12, flat-4 boxer, flat-6, inline-5 turbo, twin-rotor rotary, V-twin cruiser, superbike four, flathead V8, a 9-cylinder radial aircraft engine, an afterburning jet and a dual-motor EV. Spin them around, zoom in and switch on X-ray to watch pistons, valves and combustion move with the sound.

SOUND MADE BY PHYSICS
Each cylinder fires a pressure pulse into a real exhaust layout: headers, collectors, cat, muffler and tailpipe. Firing order, pipe lengths and cam timing shape the note, just like on a real engine. Hear it from behind the car, the driver seat, the engine bay, the front or a measurement mic.

TUNE IT AND HEAR IT CHANGE
Swap the exhaust for a sport system or a straight pipe, fit long tube headers, a race cam with a choppy idle, a bigger turbo or a supercharger. Pick flutter or blow-off, a hard cut or bouncing limiter, pops and crackles and your rev limit. Save two tunes per engine and flip between A and B.

REAL SHIFTING
H-pattern manual, sequential or automatic. Work the clutch yourself and stall it, or let stall guard, launch assist or full auto help. Big targets, so you never miss a gear.

DRAG STRIP
Quarter mile and 0 to 100 km/h (0 to 60 mph) with start lights, launch control, splits and trap speed. Race a pro driver in the exact same car or chase your own best, then share your time slip.

COCKPIT PROCEDURES
Start the radial with magnetos, fuel pump and primer. Light the jet with master, engine start and the thrust lever, then push into reheat. Drive the EV with regen levels.

ENGINE LAB
Cylinder pressure, spark timing and exhaust waves, live, for anyone who wants to see why it sounds the way it does.

SHARE A CLIP
Record a 15 second clip of your engine with its sound and post it anywhere.

No account and no ads. Haptics follow the engine. Works offline.

Privacy Policy: https://clefy-frontend.vercel.app/torqo/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Englizi: AI English Tutor

A REPORT AFTER EVERY LESSON

PRACTISE YOUR OWN MISTAKES
- Practice cards made from the mistakes you really made
- Writing practice with corrections and a rewrite
- Progress, streaks and badges to keep you going

One account works on the iPhone app and the website, so your progress follows you.

name: Even Take
description:

name: EvidenceVault.Space
description:
EvidenceVault.Space is an application for cyber security professionals. The problem is solves is securely storing, sharing, and keeping track of files and evidence collected during a pen test or security incident. 

For a limited time only, Evidence Vault will be free of charge. Once the promotional period ends it will be a one time cost of 2$. 

Pen testers will find the collaboration functionality especially useful. Evidence Vault stores selected files in a password protected encrypted database. This database file can be stored anywhere in the files app or Finder. Meaning you can place it on a network share for example allows you and others to access the evidence at the same time. 

One particular issue security professionals run into is keeping track of when evidence was interacted with or manipulated. This often takes the form of a chain of custody spreadsheet. This is very manual and error prone, and failing to keep the document updated can jeopardize your investigation. Evidence Vault solves this by keeping an automatic chain of custody document. It records the file hashes and every time someone interacts with the evidence. The chain of custody document can be exported as a csv, and if you export an individual file it comes bundled with a scoped chain of custody spreadsheet for that specific file. So basically, this app takes care of the paperwork. 

Evidence Vault is built to be functional and easy to use while maintaining a consistent and native feeling user interface. There is an optional theme that brands the app in the developer’s colors. 

This app is developed and made available by Sooner Secure, a nonprofit in Oklahoma advancing security in all aspects of human life. The app will be made open source in the coming days so anyone can audit the source code or make improvements. Learn more about Sooner Secure at https://soonersecure.org

name: EXIF Viewer & Metadata Remover

Every photo you take can carry more than you see: the exact place it was taken, the date and time, your camera and sometimes even your name. EXIF Viewer & Metadata Remover shows all of it, removes what you don't want to share and lets you edit the rest, right on your iPhone or iPad.

VIEW EXIF DATA
• Every detail in one place: EXIF, TIFF, GPS, IPTC, XMP and maker notes
• Works with HEIC, JPEG, PNG, RAW, Live Photos and videos
• Privacy X-Ray rates each photo Safe, Revealing or Exposing and explains why
• Compare two photos side by side

REMOVE METADATA AND LOCATION

• Lossless cleaning when possible, verified by re-reading the file
• Batch clean many photos at once and get a clear summary

EDIT PHOTO DATE, TIME AND LOCATION
• Change the date and time, including the time zone
• Shift the time of a whole batch when the camera clock was wrong
• Set a new location on the map, by place search or with coordinates
• Edit camera, lens, author, copyright, caption, keywords and rating

CLEAN & SHARE FROM ANY APP
• Share extension: strip GPS data from a photo in any app and share it right away

• Shortcuts and Siri actions for your own automations

LIBRARY INSIGHTS
• Your most used cameras and lenses

• Photos per year and a map of all your geotagged photos

EXPORT

YOUR PRIVACY
There is no account to create, and your photos are processed on your device. Removing the location and personal details before you share helps protect your privacy.

Made for iPhone and iPad.

name: Exploding Volcanoes

name: EZ EV Battery
description:
Your EV's battery is the biggest service it will ever need. EZ EV Battery shows you every replacement pack that fits your car — with range, health, warranty and estimated price side by side — so you can decide with confidence.

Pick your car and the Showroom instantly lists compatible packs: original equipment, refurbished and upgrade options. Each card shows an estimated real-world range adjusted for battery health, so you know what an 88%-health refurbished pack really delivers.

COMPATIBILITY, MADE SIMPLE
Choose your make, model and year and see only the batteries that fit. Tap one for the full picture: capacity, chemistry, weight, charge times, warranty miles and a range breakdown that explains exactly how the estimate is calculated.

COMPARE SIDE BY SIDE

ESTIMATED PRICES, WITH ALERTS

SAVE YOUR SHORTLIST
Keep cars, batteries and comparisons in your Garage, and track price alerts in one place.

A few things to know: EZ EV Battery has no accounts and collects no data — everything stays on your device. Prices, sellers and ratings are sample estimates for illustration only, not live listings; always confirm a final quote with a certified EV battery installer.

Download EZ EV Battery and take the guesswork out of your EV's biggest repair.

name: FabiPlay: Educational Games
description:
Fabi Play is a set of movement games for children aged 3 to 12. They play with their whole body: jumping, crouching and stretching up to catch the stars. No controllers and nothing to wear.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

On the TV
No console: just a phone and a TV, if the TV has a web browser. Open play.fabiplay.app in the TV’s browser (or on a computer connected to the TV), scan the QR code with the app and stand the phone near the TV, facing the children: the phone is the camera. The phone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi. With an Apple TV you can also use AirPlay. Apps for smart TVs are not available yet.

“Play here”
No TV? Stand the phone upright, or the tablet sideways, and take a step back: the same device is both the camera and the screen.

MORE THAN 30 GAMES, BY AGE

For each child you choose a name, an age band (3–5, 6–8 or 9–12) and a character: the games for that band are suggested, and many games change their rules with age. Up to 4 children play together (many games are for 1 or 2).

• Numbers: Jump on the number, Balloon sums, Even jump, odd clap, Count and jump, Times tables on the run
• Letters and words: Letter bubbles, Giant letters, Flying words
• Shapes and colours: Shape dance, The colour wall, The bridge of shapes, Colour balloons
• Movement, rhythm and calm: Star shower, Run, Fabi!, Ice statues, Space hide-and-seek, Fabi says, Steps to the beat, Penalties, Around the world, The calm warrior and many more

Each game lasts a few minutes.

THE CAMERA AND YOUR DATA

• The device itself turns the picture into body points (head, arms, legs). Games receive movements, never images.
• The video is never recorded and never reaches us.
• With the TV, the TV can show the room like a mirror, with the game on top: the video goes from the phone to the TV over your home Wi-Fi only. A grown-up can turn it off in the parents’ area.
• The children’s names, ages and characters stay on the phone. We never ask for a date of birth.
• No account, no ads, no in-app purchases.

GROWN-UPS IN CHARGE

The parents’ area and every link that leads out of the app are behind a grown-ups’ check. From the phone you can pause or change game at any time: to stop, press Pause.

BEFORE YOU PLAY

Clear some space around the children, away from furniture, corners and stairs, and put the phone and the TV where they can’t fall. A grown-up should be nearby.

Help and questions: https://fabiplay.app/support

name: Family Menu – Dinner Ratings
