name: FarangFind
description:
Search in English. Find it in Thai.

FarangFind helps English speakers shop in Thailand. Type or say what you want, and the app suggests the Thai search words that sellers actually use in their listings. Tap once to search Shopee Thailand or Lazada Thailand with the phrase.

Searching in English on Thai marketplaces often misses the right listings. Word-for-word translation is not much better, because Thai sellers use their own shopping vocabulary, loanwords and product names. FarangFind bridges that gap.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Describe the item. Try a brand and a product, like "Dyson V12 replacement filter", or a plain description like "kids mop".
2. Get ranked Thai suggestions. Each one comes with a short English explanation, so you know what you are searching for.
3. Tap Shopee or Lazada on any suggestion to open that marketplace's Thailand search with the Thai phrase.
4. Not quite right? Refine with a short follow-up such as "Not a toy" or "Washable", and the suggestions update.

FEATURES
- Thai keyword suggestions with plain-English explanations
- Separate Shopee and Lazada buttons on every suggestion, so you can compare the same search on both
- Brand names, model numbers, sizes and compatibility details are kept in the search
- Voice input: tap Use voice and speak. Your words appear as text in the search box so you can edit them before searching. Speech is transcribed on your iPhone and audio is never uploaded
- Refine a search with a follow-up instead of starting over
- More suggestions on request, and a copy button for any Thai phrase
- History of your recent searches, saved on your iPhone and available offline
- Choice of AI model in Settings
- Free to use, with no account and no sign-in

PRIVACY
- No account, name, email, location or advertising ID
- Your search text is sent to an AI provider (Anthropic by default, or OpenAI if you choose it in Settings) through our server to write the Thai keywords. The app tells you before your first search
- Search text is kept for up to 30 days, then deleted. You can delete your server data any time in Settings
- Voice is transcribed on your iPhone. Audio never leaves your device
- No ads, no tracking across other apps or websites

GOOD TO KNOW
- FarangFind suggests search words. It does not show product listings, compare prices, check authenticity or place orders
- English interface and English input. Suggestions are for Shopee Thailand and Lazada Thailand
- Results come from AI and can be imperfect. Check listings before you buy

FarangFind is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Shopee, Lazada, Anthropic or OpenAI. Shopee and Lazada are trademarks of their respective owners.

Questions or feedback? Visit https://farangfind.netlify.app/support

name: Favorbook
seller_name: HOANG HAI VN TRADING COMPANY LIMITED
description:
A quiet private ledger for favors you still mean to return.

Who watched the cat. Who covered your standup. Who helped move the bookshelf. Kindness slips through the week until you forget who owes whom. Favorbook keeps those threads on one page — not money, not a CRM, just memory with a seal.

HOW THE LEDGER WORKS
• Add a nameplate for each person: neighbor, colleague, friend, or family, with an optional note.
• Log an entry: I owe, They owe, or Even. Give it a title, a weight (light, medium, heavy), and optionally a return-by date.
• Unsealed “I owe” entries become a red thread on Folio so open debts stay visible.
• When you return the favor, Seal the entry. The stamp lands, the thread shortens, and the ledger stays honest.
• Almanac lists favors with return dates so you can plan a thank-you before it goes stale.

INSIGHT AT A GLANCE
• Red thread count, favors others still owe you, and a simple give ↔ take balance.
• Most exchanged nameplates and a clean streak of days without overdue returns.
• Export a plain-text ledger from Insight or Settings whenever you want a backup you control.

LOOK AND FEEL
Cool archival paper, inkstone charcoal, and a vermillion seal — more private book than spreadsheet. A Home Screen widget keeps open threads and the next due favor nearby.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No Contacts access. No analytics, ads, or cloud sync. Optional local reminders stay on your device. Clear everything in Settings, or uninstall to remove local files.

Favorbook is a personal favor memory tool. It is not a payments app, debt collector, or social network.

name: Fenceside
description:
Fenceside is your neighborhood, on the fence line — a community built for the people who actually live where you live.

TRADES — the local classifieds, organized by your area:
• Jobs: local openings and gigs
• Buy & Sell: pre-loved finds from people nearby
• Housing: rooms, rentals and housemates
• Cars, Real Estate and Business listings

COMMUNITY — talk with your country, browse the world:
• Free Talk, Investing, Food & Habits, Humor and Meetups
• Your home country by default — every other country one tap away
• Post, comment and vote under a nickname. Your real name never shows.

DIRECTORY — find local businesses, from restaurants to law firms, listed by the owners themselves.

Free to use. Pick your area, claim your nickname, and post yours.

name: Ferrovia - Treni in diretta
description:
Ferrovia è un'app che permette di informarsi su orari treni e stazioni con un design tipico della subway newyorkese: nero, chiaro, leggibile a colpo d'occhio. 
Partenze, arrivi, binari e ritardi in tempo reale, per ogni stazione.

IL TABELLONE, IN TASCA
Cerca una stazione o apri quella più vicina: partenze e arrivi si aggiornano da soli ogni 30 secondi. L'orario ufficiale è sempre quello grande, lo stesso dei monitor in stazione; sotto, l'orario aggiornato e il ritardo in giallo, oppure il conto alla rovescia: «tra 2:15».

IL BINARIO, PRIMA DEL MONITOR
Un quadrato pieno quando il binario è confermato, solo il contorno quando è previsto, giallo quando è cambiato. La vista Binari mette ogni binario in fila, con i treni dei prossimi minuti al loro posto.

OGNI SOLUZIONE SU UN SOLO ORARIO
Da una stazione all'altra, a qualunque giorno e ora: le soluzioni sono disegnate una sotto l'altra sullo stesso asse del tempo, con treni, cambi, durata e prezzo. Filtri per soli diretti, soli regionali o sole Frecce.

IL TRENO, MINUTO PER MINUTO
Il ritardo, tra quali stazioni si trova adesso, dove è stato visto l'ultima volta e da quanto. Tutte le fermate con gli orari, e la mappa del percorso. Se un treno non dà notizie da più di un quarto d'ora, Ferrovia te lo dice.

SALVA IL VIAGGIO
Salva un viaggio intero, con tutti i suoi cambi, o un singolo treno: li ritrovi in Salvati, con i ritardi in tempo reale.

FATTO CON CURA
• Ogni treno con il suo simbolo e il suo colore: Regionale, Intercity, Frecciarossa e le linee suburbane S di Milano.
• Il giallo vuol dire che qualcosa è cambiato, il rosso che un treno è soppresso. Nient'altro è colorato.
• Tema chiaro e scuro, che segue il telefono o lo scegli tu.
• La ricerca delle stazioni funziona sul telefono, anche senza rete.
• Nessun account, nessuna pubblicità.

Ferrovia è un'app indipendente e non è affiliata a RFI, Trenitalia o ad altre imprese ferroviarie. I dati vengono dai servizi pubblici di ViaggiaTreno (RFI) e Trenitalia: in caso di dubbio fanno fede gli annunci e i monitor in stazione. I prezzi sono indicativi; i biglietti si acquistano dai canali dell'impresa ferroviaria.

name: FidePlan
description:
FidePlan, fide üreten işletmeler için geliştirilmiş üretim planlama ve işletme yönetimi uygulamasıdır. Sipariş, ekim, sera, sevkiyat, stok ve cari hesap süreçlerini tek bir yerde toplar; ofiste de serada da aynı veriyle çalışmanızı sağlar.

SAHADA ÇALIŞIN
• Parti etiketlerindeki QR kodu telefon kamerasıyla okutun; partinin aşamasını, adedini ve geçmişini anında görün.
• Fire, saha sayımı, aşama ilerletme ve kalite kontrolünü seranın içinden kaydedin.
• Parti günlüğüne fotoğraf ekleyin, hastalık ve zararlı gözlemlerini fotoğraflı kaydedin.
• Bağlantı koptuğunda da çalışın: saha işlemleri cihazda güvenle bekler, internet gelince kendiliğinden gönderilir.

ANLIK BİLDİRİMLER
• Yeni sipariş, onay, tahsilat, sevke hazır parti, kalite reddi, iklim alarmı ve teslimat gibi olaylardan haberdar olun.
• Hangi olaylarda bildirim alacağınızı kendiniz seçin.

ÜRETİM PLANLAMA
• Teslim tarihinden geriye ekim planı, aşılı üretimde anaç ve kalem tarihleri.
• Sera ve masa doluluğu, tarih bazlı kapasite kontrolü, otomatik masa önerisi.
• Çimlenme oranı, aşı takvimi, parti maliyeti ve kârlılık.

SATIŞ VE SEVKİYAT
• Sipariş, teklif ve onay akışı, müşteri risk limiti.
• Yükleme planı, irsaliye ve teslimatçı ekranı: teslim alanın imzası, fotoğrafı ve konumu.
• Müşterilere sipariş takip bağlantısı.

STOK VE FİNANS
• Tohum, viyol, ilaç ve gübre stoğu; lot ve son kullanma takibi.
• Satın alma siparişi ve mal kabul.
• Cari hesap, tahsilat, çek/senet portföyü.

FidePlan Türkçe dahil 16 dilde kullanılabilir. Uygulamayı kullanmak için işletmenize tanımlanmış bir FidePlan hesabı gerekir. Bilgi ve demo için: info@fideplan.com

name: Fieldbrief Aviation Weather
description:
See the weather at your airport, from the runway to cruise altitude. Enter an ICAO or FAA identifier, including smaller U.S. fields such as Goose Creek (28A). When the airport has no observation or terminal forecast, Fieldbrief shows the nearby reporting station and how far away it is.

• Surface — Read the METAR, flight category, visibility, ceilings, and temperature and dew point in Celsius and Fahrenheit.
• Runway winds — Compare headwind, tailwind and crosswind components for listed U.S. runway ends. Open the numbered runway diagram to see the airplane on approach and an orange arrow pointing downwind.
• Forecast — Scan the TAF in your device’s local time, or open the original report.
• Winds aloft — Explore forecast winds and temperatures by altitude and forecast hour. Each profile identifies its model station, distance and valid time.
• Hazards and charts — Check advisory polygons, nearby pilot reports and Weather Prediction Center surface analysis charts.

Save frequently used airports and choose Light, Midnight or Graphite, or follow your iPhone’s appearance. Weather requires internet access. Coverage and update times vary by product. Runway wind estimates describe the reported wind and do not establish which runway is active. For a complete route briefing, use the Flight Service link in the app.

name: Figetr
description:
A small, quiet moment of play.

Figetr fills your screen with glassy bubbles. Tap to pop them, enjoy a soft water sound and a little haptic feedback, or switch either off and keep things quiet. There are no levels to beat or deadlines to chase.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose from eleven coordinated color moods, from warm Sage and Peach Fizz to Midnight and Aurora.
• Set the pace from slow and spacious to lively.
• Pause new bubbles whenever you like. The bubbles already on screen stay ready to pop.
• Keep a running pop count, or reset it for a fresh start.

MADE FOR IPHONE
• Works offline.
• No account, advertising, or analytics.
• Your color choice, pace, feedback settings, and pop count stay in the app’s local storage.
• Supports VoiceOver labels, larger text, increased contrast, and Reduce Motion.

Pay once for the app. No subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Sound respects Silent Mode and mixes with other audio. Haptic feedback requires a supported iPhone.

Questions or feedback? Contact jjmacjr92@gmail.com.

name: Fileraft: Wifi File Transfer
description:
Move files directly between your iPhone or iPad and a computer on the same Wi-Fi network. Fileraft needs no account, cloud storage or desktop app.

Start sharing on your device, open the displayed address in a computer browser, and enter the six-digit pairing code. The last digit connects automatically when the code is correct.

• Send and receive photos, videos, documents, archives and other files.
• Keep original file contents without automatic format conversion.
• Follow real transferred bytes, speed and estimated time remaining.
• Upload multiple files, cancel, retry and resume when the session permits.
• Preview supported photos, audio and video on your device.
• Rename, share and manage files stored locally on your iPhone or iPad.
• Download selected files as a ZIP archive.
• Use English or Turkish, with an automatic device-language default.

Transfers are direct between paired devices on your local network; files are not uploaded to Fileraft servers or a cloud transfer service.

name: Fips, sammel die Flips!
description:
Fips, der kleine Drache vom Elldus Resort in Oberwiesenthal, hat Hunger – auf Erdnussflips!

Lauf mit Fips durch die Landschaft am Fichtelberg, spring über Bäume und Felsen, duck dich unter Schneebällen weg und sammle so viele Flips, wie du kannst. Je länger du durchhältst, desto schneller wird es.

• Einfache Steuerung: Tippen zum Springen (zweimal für den Doppelsprung), unten rechts oder nach unten wischen zum Ducken
• Drei Power-ups: Boost mit Flip-Magnet, Fliegen und Schutzschild
• Plattformen mit Extra-Flips für mutige Doppelspringer
• Unterwegs entdeckst du das Resort, den Spielplatz, die Spielscheune, den Rutschenturm und den Ponyhof
• Winter- und Frühlingslandschaft – je nach Jahreszeit
• Bestenliste für die ganze Familie auf dem Gerät
• Ohne Werbung, ohne In-App-Käufe, ohne Internet spielbar

Viel Spaß wünscht das Elldus Resort!

name: FirmenwagenKompass
description:
Paying with the company fuel card means the terminal asks for the odometer – and that number is in the car, not in your head. FirmenwagenKompass solves exactly that. Lean, no account, no clutter.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Before refuelling: pick the vehicle, type in the odometer.
2. At the terminal: the odometer is shown huge on screen – exactly as you type it in. The screen stays on.
3. After paying: enter the amount and the price or total. Two values are enough; the app calculates the third.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN, TOO
While an entry is open, FirmenwagenKompass shows the odometer as a Live Activity on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island. Take out your phone, read, type – no unlocking.

PHOTO OF DASHBOARD AND RECEIPT
Photograph the dashboard and the odometer is filled in. Photograph the fuel receipt and amount, price, total, station and date are taken over – you check and save. Text recognition runs entirely on your device; photos are not uploaded. The receipt photo stays with the entry as proof.

COMBUSTION, ELECTRIC AND PLUG-IN HYBRID
Refuelling, public charging and home charging are logged separately. Home charging is shown with kWh and cost – handy for getting home electricity reimbursed for your company car. The app remembers your home electricity price.

STATISTICS
• Distance driven, costs and cost per km
• Consumption in l/100 km (full-tank method) and kWh/100 km
• Kilometres and costs per month, cumulative costs, consumption per fill-up
• Period: this year, 12 months or all time

FOR YOUR EXPENSES
Export as CSV for your fleet manager or accounting.

SEVERAL VEHICLES
Add vehicles by licence plate and switch between them. New company car? Archive the old one – its data is kept.

COMPANY LOGO
If you like, FirmenwagenKompass shows your company's logo in the app and on the terminal screen.

PRIVACY
All vehicles, entries, receipt photos and the company logo stay on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: FitoraOne
description:
FitoraOne je aplikacija za članove fitnes centara koji koriste Fitora sistem.

VAŠA ČLANARINA
U svakom trenutku vidite koja vam je članarina aktivna, do kada važi i koliko dana je preostalo — bez pitanja na recepciji.

DIGITALNA KARTICA
Barkod vaše članske kartice je uvijek u telefonu.

DOLAZAK U CENTAR
Pri dolasku skenirajte QR kod na recepciji i prijava je gotova.

GRUPNI TRENINZI
Raspored termina po danima, prijava na trening i otkazivanje iz aplikacije.

HISTORIJA
Pregled svih dolazaka po kalendaru i svih uplata na jednom mjestu.

SVIJETLA I TAMNA TEMA
Aplikacija prati temu telefona.

Za korištenje aplikacije potrebno je da ste član fitnes centra koji koristi Fitora sistem. Nalog vam otvara centar: prijavite se brojem kartice i lozinkom ili skenirajte aktivacijski QR kod s recepcije. Aplikacija ne služi za samostalnu registraciju.

FitoraOne ne prikuplja lokaciju, ne pristupa kontaktima i ne koristi alate za praćenje. Kamera se koristi isključivo za skeniranje QR koda i snimci se ne pohranjuju.

name: FitoraOne Owner
description:
FitoraOne Owner je aplikacija za vlasnike fitnes centara koji koriste Fitora sistem.

DANAS
Ukupan prihod dana, uplate, kasa, rashodi i saldo, broj ulazaka i različitih članova — uz poređenje s jučer i istim danom prošle sedmice.

PROMET
Saldo za izabrani period, prihod po danu i uplate po vrsti članarine.

POSJETE
Ulasci po danu i po satu, prosjek po danu i podjela po vrsti članarine.

ČLANARINE ISTIČU
Članovi kojima članarina ističe u narednih 3, 7, 14 ili 30 dana, s brojem telefona — da ih na vrijeme pozovete.

SVIJETLA I TAMNA TEMA
Sistemska, svijetla ili tamna tema po izboru.

Za korištenje je potreban Fitora sistem u vašem centru. Aplikacija se aktivira jednokratnim kodom koji izdaje IT Craft, a prijava je korisničkim imenom i lozinkom iz recepcije, uz dozvolu za Owner aplikaciju.

name: fleem
description:
fleem transforme ton iPhone en appareil argentique. Choisis ta pellicule, déclenche : la photo sort directement développée, avec le caractère d'une véritable pellicule argentique.

fleem part de l'image la plus brute que ton iPhone puisse fournir (ProRAW sur les modèles Pro) et la développe comme en laboratoire. Réponse des couleurs, hautes lumières qui saturent en douceur, grain qui vit dans les ombres, halos autour des lumières.

QUATRE PELLICULES
• Noctura 400 : le flash direct d'un jetable en pleine nuit. Fonds noirs, rouges qui claquent.
• Cinéa 800T : une pellicule de cinéma pour la lumière des lampes. Halos orangés, verts profonds.
• Memoria 200 : la pellicule retrouvée au fond d'un tiroir. Délavée, chaude, nostalgique.
• Riviera 200 : l'été sur la côte. Peaux dorées, mer turquoise, ciel crème.

L'APPAREIL
• Aperçu en direct de la pellicule dans le viseur
• Grain réglable : aucun, fin, moyen, fort
• Vrai flash de l'iPhone, retardateur 3, 5 ou 10 secondes
• Fiche de chaque pellicule avec un avant/après
• Galerie de la séance, partage en un geste
• Photos enregistrées dans un album fleem de l'app Photos

Tes photos restent sur ton téléphone : fleem ne collecte aucune donnée.

name: FloorPulse
description:
FloorPulse is the operator portal for restaurant and bakery groups that run on Toast. Sign in with your FloorPulse account and every store you connected is on one screen.

What you can do in the app:

- See today at every store: sales so far, orders, labor as a share of sales, who is on the clock, overtime, breaks and comps.
- Open Data for any period: net sales, average check, guests, labor cost, losses, menu items and staff, store by store or together, against the period before.
- Ask Cupcake: type a question such as "how did last week go against the week before" and get a short answer with a table or a chart, drawn from your own stores.
- Run daily checklists: opening, mid shift and closing tasks per store, with who marked each one done and when.
- Follow manager watches: send a message to the watches on the floor and see which ones received and opened it.
- Read the nightly report and choose who gets it.
- Track supplier prices from invoice photos and PDFs.
- Send documents for signature and see who signed.

Built for tablets as well as phones, so the store tablet can stay on the dashboard all day, in portrait or landscape.

A FloorPulse account is required. New groups sign up at floorpulse.com and connect Toast in a few minutes.

name: FoldFinder: Spot Differences
description:
A spot-the-difference game made for the foldable iPhone.

Unfold your phone and the two halves become two photos: the original on one side, a changed copy on the other. Tap what changed.

SOLO • Play in book mode or laptop mode — the photos fill both halves either way. • Tip the top screen below 60° to peek at a hint (it costs 10 seconds). • Fold it shut to pause. Pinch to zoom both photos together for the tiny details. • Earn up to 3 stars per puzzle, and see exactly what changed after each find.

DAILY PUZZLE • A new puzzle every day for everyone. • Build a streak, then share your result — a spoiler-free card with your time and how your game went.

FACE-OFF • Lay the phone flat between two players. Hare vs Tortoise, same photos, one clock. • First to find most of the changes wins. Wrong taps lock you out for longer and longer.

36 HAND-MADE SCENES Japan, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Vietnam, Korea, China, Europe, the USA, the ocean and a cartoon pack for kids — at Easy and Hard levels. Hard puzzles hide item swaps, mirrored objects and subtle shades.

No ads. No accounts. Nothing collected.

name: Foldfuse: Fold & Merge Puzzle
description:
Foldfuse is a calm but clever puzzle game where paper folding meets number merging.

A sheet of squared paper lies on your desk. Grab an edge and fold it over: equal numbers that land on each other fuse into a bigger one. Reach the target number within a limited number of folds. Sounds easy, until grey stones, paper clips, holes and chain reactions join in.

FEATURES
• 60 handmade puzzles across 4 notebooks, each notebook with a new twist
• Every level is checked by a solver, so every sheet has a solution
• Daily Fold: a fresh puzzle every day, with streaks
• 1 to 3 stars per level: can you find the shortest solution?
• Hint, Scissors and Wild power-ups for when you're stuck
• Undo any fold, no timers, no rush
• Handmade paper-craft look, relaxing music and haptic feedback
• Plays offline; your progress stays on your device
• No account, no sign-up
• English and Turkish

HOW TO PLAY
Drag any edge of the sheet across a crease. While you lift the flap, Foldfuse previews which numbers will fuse, so you can think before you commit. Plan a few folds ahead, use as few folds as possible and collect all the stars.

name: Folio Vault
description:
Folio is a calm, fast notebook for your iPhone that keeps every note as a plain Markdown file — no account, no cloud lock-in, no tracking.

NOTEBOOK-STYLE PAGES
Nest pages inside pages to organize projects, trips, recipes and research the way you think.

KANBAN BOARDS
Plan work on boards — long-press a card to move it between lists. Boards are saved as Markdown too, compatible with the Obsidian Kanban format.

A REAL MARKDOWN EDITOR
Headings, checklists, tables, code blocks, math, links between notes and #tags — with a beautiful reading view.

DAILY NOTES & CALENDAR
Jump to today, browse past days, and see your notes on a calendar.

FAST SEARCH
Find any page, line or tag instantly.

YOUR FILES, YOUR DEVICE
Notes live in the Files app as ordinary .md files. Open folders from anywhere on your device, including Obsidian vaults.

OPTIONAL MAC SYNC
Have Folio on your Mac? Pair once and your notes sync directly over your own Wi-Fi network — nothing passes through a server.

Adjustable text size, margins and line wrapping make long writing sessions comfortable.

name: ForkOff: Cook-off Voting
description:
Turn your next cook-off into a night to remember.

ForkOff runs a food competition from your phone. Create a competition, add the dishes and photos, and invite everyone with a link or QR code. Guests vote in the app or in their browser, no account needed.

CHOOSE HOW TO VOTE
Score taste, looks and creativity with your own criteria, give an overall score from 1 to 10, rank your top 3, or just pick a favorite. Cooks take their own dish off their ballot, and only complete ballots count.

KEEP THE SURPRISE
Turn on blind tasting to hide the cooks until the reveal. Follow the live count, close voting, and step through the podium together.

EVERY COMPETITION ITS OWN
Each competition has its own guests, cooks and co-hosts. Invite a co-host to help run one night, share the results with a link, and come back to every past winner. Pick Prize ribbon, Game show night or Fresh kitchen to set the mood.

Free, with no sign-in, subscriptions or in-app purchases. An internet connection is needed to host and vote.

name: FrameTally
description:
FrameTally is a tool designed for film photography enthusiasts to document and archive their work. From loading a roll of film to shooting frame-by-frame, developing, and scanning, it helps you keep track of the settings and stories behind every single shot.

【Manage Every Roll of Film】
Record details such as film stock, format, ISO, camera, and the date the roll was loaded. Track the status of each roll—from shooting and unloading to developing and archiving—so you can easily monitor the progress of multiple rolls.

【Capture Details for Every Frame】
Log shutter speed, aperture, lens, focal length, and exposure compensation, along with the time, location, and personal notes. You can also add reference photos, tags, and bracketing plans to help you revisit your creative process later.

【Exposure Calculation Assistance】
Calculate exposure combinations based on your current settings, determine filter compensation, and view available options using custom camera profiles. Save your calculations to review or analyze your process later.

【Organize Your Developing Workflow】
Create custom developing steps and presets. Use a step-by-step timer to track actual temperatures, agitation intervals, and completion status, building a detailed log for every roll you develop.

【Link Scans to Shooting Records】
Import scanned images and link them to specific film frames. Add ratings, tags, or tasks for re-scanning; manage multiple scan versions for a single frame, ensuring your final images are always connected to your original shooting notes.

【Export and Backup】
Create custom contact sheet layouts and export them as PDFs or images. Export your shooting and developing logs as PDFs or CSV files for easy organization and sharing. The app also supports full backups—including your records and original image files—with a restore function.

Ensure that every time you press the shutter, you leave behind a record worth looking back on.

name: FreeTour: free walking tours
seller_name: AMS Tecnologia em Comercio e Servicos Ltda.
description:
FreeTour brings together free walking tours in 120 cities across 43 countries, with free booking on partner sites. At the end of the tour, you tip the guide what you think is fair.

What the app does for you on the trip:

• My day: save the tour you booked, with date, time and meeting point. Everything stays on your device and works offline, with an offline map of the meeting point.
• Reminder: a notification before the tour, with the place where the guide meets the group.
• Near me: free tours sorted by distance from where you are. Your location never leaves your device.
• Tips and spending: what people usually tip in each country and a simple log of your trip spending.

To choose your tour:

• Free tours with rating, duration, guide language and meeting point.
• Tours with a guide in your language come first; when there are none, tours in other languages are clearly marked.
• Paid tours also worth it, with prices from, in your phone's currency.
• App in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French and Italian.

No account, no login and no ads.

name: FREQOUT: Applied Violence
description:
Eight wave physicists walk into a lab. One walks out.

FREQOUT is a side-view party brawler for 1 to 8 players, humans and bots in any mix. Jump on a head and it's over. Land two ability hits and it's over too. Every fighter bends a different kind of wave:

- Soundman: a shockwave ring that shoves rivals off ledges
- Sparkman: launches straight up on a trail of lightning
- Boneman: x-ray phases through walls and floors
- Catman: a quantum decoy, and the real cat is only decided when you hit one
- Radioman: a jamming pulse that swaps everyone's left and right
- Gravityman: a gravity well that drags the whole room in
- Lightman: a blinding flash
- Quakeman: a ground pound that pops everyone into the air

Play your way
- Local: one screen, controllers and touch, any number of computer players
- LAN: host on a phone or PC and play over the same Wi-Fi or a hotspot, no internet needed
- Online: create a room, share the 4-letter code, and play across phone, PC and browser

Four labs to brawl in: Wave Lab, Tesla Hall, Cryo Vault and Seismic Mine.

No accounts. Pick a nickname and go.

Side effects include chickens.

name: Frontier Lab Tycoon
description:
Build AGI to benefit all of humanity. Also, please subscribe to Pro.

Frontier Lab Tycoon is a pixel-art management sim and a loving satire of the AI race. Start in a dorm room with a borrowed GPU and a big idea, then grow into a frontier lab with a gigawatt datacenter, an army of researchers and, eventually, robot employees that improve themselves.

TRAIN AND SHIP MODELS
Pick a modality and a use case, balance pre-training, post-training and launch prep, then watch the release ceremony and read the reviews. Find the combos that work, chase the trends, and climb the arena leaderboard against rival labs.

RUN THE LAB
Hire quirky researchers and engineers, buy GPUs, move to bigger offices, take contracts, raise funding rounds, go public, and try not to get diluted out of your own company.

SURVIVE THE CHAOS
Model escapes, hacks, regulators, lawsuits, AI winters, GPU shortages, board coups and rivals who ship the day before you. Every decision has trade-offs between hype, safety and cash.

CHASE AGI, THEN KEEP GOING
Research 39 technologies, ship AGI, deploy AI employees, start the recursive self-improvement loop and build your way to megaprojects across endless eras. The game never ends: new paradigms keep arriving.

FEATURES
- A pixel-art office that grows with your lab
- Chiptune music and sound effects
- 97 tiered achievements and prestige "Pivots" with permanent perks
- Plays fully offline
- Optional Sign in with Apple or Google for cloud saves and global leaderboards
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no loot boxes

Frontier Lab Tycoon is satire. All labs, people and models are fictional.

name: fTracker - Race Tracker
description:
fTracker - Race Tracker is the race weekend companion for Grand Prix fans: the full season calendar with every session converted to your local time, so you never have to do timezone maths again.

• NEXT RACE, FRONT AND CENTRE — a live "lights out" countdown, every session time (practice, qualifying, sprint and race), and the championship top 3, the moment you open the app.
• EVERY CIRCUIT, PROPERLY — real track outlines with sector colours, lap records and circuit facts, a 3D map of the circuit, recent winners at each track, and a race-day weather forecast.
• STANDINGS THAT STAY CURRENT — drivers' and constructors' championships with team colours, a podium view, and full driver profiles with career stats and season results.
• NEWS WITHOUT THE NOISE — headlines from official and major motorsport sources, with a filter for your favourite driver.
• WIDGETS — medium and large home-screen widgets with the countdown, session times, top-5 standings and the circuit outline in sector colours.
• YOUR DRIVER, YOUR APP — pick a favourite driver and the app highlights their news and results. Light, dark and OLED appearance modes included.

Calendars cover the 2026 and 2027 seasons. All times are shown in your timezone, with track-local time one tap away.

This is an unofficial fan app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Formula 1, the FIA, or any team or driver. F1, FORMULA ONE, FORMULA 1, FIA FORMULA ONE WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP, GRAND PRIX and related marks are trade marks of Formula One Licensing B.V. Race data is provided by the Jolpica API; weather by Apple Weather.

name: Fusionaut
description:
Fusionaut is a merge puzzle game set in space. Tap a generator, drop items onto your ship's deck, and merge matching pairs into something bigger: space dust becomes a pebble, a pebble becomes an asteroid, and a bolt ends up as a rocket.

MERGE AND DISCOVER
Each generator starts its own chain: telescopes, rockets, planets, space suits, rovers and satellites. Every merge moves an item one step up its chain, and new generators unlock as you level up.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
The first time you make an item, a Star Log card tells you a real fact about it. Answer space quiz questions to earn bonus Fuel.

RUN MISSION CONTROL
The crew radios in orders. Send the items they ask for to earn Mission Credits, XP and Stardust.

BUILD YOUR BASE
Spend Mission Credits on base tasks, from raising the antenna mast to planting the first seeds, then move on to the next base. Combine finished items in the Assembly Bay for bigger builds and bigger rewards.

COLLECT REWARDS
Open Supply Drops, earn Mission Patches for your achievements, and keep a daily streak going.

FREE, WITH NOTHING TO BUY
No ads. No in-app purchases. Everything is earned by playing.

PLAYS OFFLINE, COLLECTS NOTHING
The whole game lives on your device. There are no accounts and no tracking, and Fusionaut does not collect any data.

name: Game Garden: Mini Games
description:
Game Garden gathers fifteen games first made between 2012 and 2026, restored from their original projects, finished and polished for today's phones, tablets and computers. Every game is open from the first launch: nothing to unlock, no ads, no purchases.

THE GAMES
• Digital Slider Puzzle: the classic number slider, from a quick 3×3 to big boards.
• Three Kingdoms Sliding Blocks Puzzle: help Cao Cao escape along Huarong Road.
• Tangram: build each shape with seven pieces.
• Jigsaw Puzzle: snap the pieces into a picture, or turn one of your own photos into a puzzle.
• Find Differences: compare two pictures and find what changed.
• Building Blocks Puzzle: fill the wooden box with blocks.
• Ferrule Pillar Puzzle: thread the blocks onto the pillars.
• Mushroom Nail Puzzle: make pictures with colorful pegs.
• Pixel Coloring Board: color pixel pictures by number.
• Penguin Go Home: tap left or right to drop through the gaps.
• Virtual Writing Brush: write Chinese characters with an ink brush.
• Steal Egg: push the egg home before time runs out.
• Birds Ninja: slice the birds, spare the goose, dodge the bombs.
• Camera Flying Bird: fly the duck by moving your face. The camera picture never leaves your device.
• Rad Ball: guide Blue through 36 rooms to rescue Red.

GROW YOUR GARDEN
Clearing levels, earning stars and beating your records earn coins, and a gift waits every day. Spend the coins on sixteen plants and watch your garden fill with flowers. Coins are earned by playing only; they are never sold.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• For players of every age: big buttons, clear goals, gentle sounds.
• A play-time reminder and a reduce-motion option, behind a parental gate.
• Plays offline. No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collected.
• One download for iPhone, iPad and Mac; each game turns the screen the way it plays best.
• In English and Simplified Chinese.

More games will keep joining the garden.

name: Game Timer ±
description:
GAME TIMER ±: MAKE TIME PART OF THE GAME

Game Timer ± is a stopwatch and countdown app for games and activities where penalties and bonuses change the time. It lets the game master, host or activity leader adjust minutes instantly while keeping the game time clearly visible.

Use it for home escape rooms, timed board games, treasure hunts, team challenges, quizzes and classroom activities. Whether a correct answer earns extra time, a hint carries a penalty or a challenge changes the time available, apply your own rules with a single tap.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Stopwatch: start at 00:00:00 and measure the time taken. Penalties add minutes to the result; bonuses subtract them.
• Countdown: choose a starting duration and track the time remaining. Penalties remove minutes; bonuses give players extra time.

INSTANT ADJUSTMENTS
Add or subtract 1, 2, 5 or 10 minutes using direct buttons, while the timer is running or paused. Time never falls below zero. You decide when each adjustment applies, according to the rules of your activity.

DESIGNED TO BE CLEAR AND EASY TO USE
• Seven-segment digital clock in HH:mm:ss format.
• A clean, dark interface in landscape and portrait.
• Start and pause whenever the activity needs a break.
• Confirmation before resetting, to protect against accidental taps.
• Eight interface colours: cyan, green, blue, purple, pink, orange, yellow and white.
• Spanish, English, French and German, following a supported phone language by default.
• The screen stays awake while a timer is running in the foreground.

Works offline with no account required. Colour and language preferences are saved on your device. Games are saved on the device so you can recover them when reopening the app.

PROTECT YOUR GAME
• Undo the last adjustment without losing elapsed time.
• Recover your game when reopening the app, including time spent away if a timer was running.
• Lock the controls and press and hold the lock to unlock them.
• Hear an alert when the countdown finishes. Allow notifications and sounds for alerts with the phone locked or the app closed. Alerts respect device silent mode, volume and Focus settings.

You set the rules. Game Timer ± keeps the time.

name: GardenPal – Plant Care Circle
description:
GardenPal helps you grow food at home — and makes sure a forgotten watering doesn't quietly end the season.

Start with a guide, follow the calendar, and let reminders keep the routine. If a task still isn't done, GardenPal nudges the family or helpers you invited — and whoever does the job taps Done, with their name on it.

STEP-BY-STEP GUIDES
- 10 beginner-friendly foods: blueberry, scallion, mint, lettuce, radish, potato, basil, strawberry, cherry tomato, and sweet pepper
- Every guide has photos, the basics up front (sun, water, harvest time, lifespan), numbered steps in plain language, and a "laziness rating" so you know what you're signing up for
- Photo stages show what the plant should look like as it grows
- A growth log keeps your own dated photos of each plant

A CALENDAR FOR ONE REAL PLACE
The planting calendar is built for Clifton, Virginia (USDA Zone 7a/7b), week by week, month by month — frost-date based windows, not single days. GardenPal says this on its face: if you live somewhere much colder or warmer, shift the windows by a week or two.

REMINDERS THAT ESCALATE — POLITELY
- Each plant gets a care plan: watering, transplanting, and harvest tasks appear on your Today list
- Miss the due time? GardenPal first reminds you (the wait is yours to set — 2 hours by default)
- Still not done? It pushes the helpers in your garden circle (6 hours after the due time by default, also adjustable)
- A helper can tap "I did it" — the completion is recorded with their name, so nobody has to guess whether the plants were watered

YOUR GARDEN CIRCLE
Invite family, a housesitter, or anyone who helps, by email. Helpers can work tasks; viewers can follow along and see the growth log. Going away? Pause (vacation) mode stands the whole ladder down, and the circle can see the pause — a quiet week reads as a planned quiet week.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your garden is shared only with the people you invite — nobody else. No ads, no data sale, no tracking. Delete your account any time in Settings, and everything goes with it.

FREE
This version of GardenPal is free and complete — guides, calendar, reminders, escalation, and the garden circle all work, and nothing in it can be bought today.

GardenPal is a growing guide and reminder tool, not an expert service: watering intervals are starting points you can adjust, harvest windows are estimates, and GardenPal does not diagnose plant diseases or pests and cannot guarantee any plant's survival or yield. GardenPal contains no AI features.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://notsotechnical.github.io/gardenpal-legal/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://notsotechnical.github.io/gardenpal-legal/privacy.html

name: Gaura dB: sonómetro y RTA
description:
Gaura dB convierte tu teléfono o iPad en un sonómetro con analizador de espectro (RTA). Sirve para saber qué tan fuerte suena tu sala y en qué frecuencias sobra o falta sonido.

QUÉ MIDE
• Nivel en dB con ponderación A (dBA) o C (dBC).
• Respuesta lenta (1 s) o rápida (125 ms), como un sonómetro.
• Máximo y promedio (Leq) desde que empiezas a medir.
• RTA en bandas de 1/3 de octava, de 63 Hz a 16 kHz.

HECHO CON CUIDADO
• Usa el micrófono en modo medición: sin control automático de ganancia ni reducción de ruido.
• Ponderaciones A y C con las curvas de la norma IEC 61672.
• El audio se analiza en el teléfono: no se graba ni se envía.

SIN VUELTAS
• Gratis, sin cuentas y sin publicidad de terceros.
• Funciona sin conexión.
• En iPhone y iPad.

UN AVISO HONESTO
El micrófono de un teléfono no es un micrófono de medición, así que los valores son aproximados. Sirven para comparar y darte una idea; no para un informe oficial.

¿QUIERES MEDIR TU SALA COMPLETA?
Gaura para Mac usa un micrófono de medición, mide la sala caminando y te dice qué mover en el ecualizador, paso a paso. Conócela en gaura.app.

name: Gentle Routine
description:
Gentle Routine is for adults who already have a professionally assessed practice arrangement. It does not choose your plan — it helps you follow the one you have.

• Enter your own steps and timing, in your own words
• A calm timer that pauses when you pause and waits for you when a step reaches its set time — the next step never starts automatically
• Partial sessions are recorded honestly: finish early, skip a step, or stop anytime
• Optional notes for comfort, sensations, and interruption reasons, kept editable for your next appointment
• Review by date and plan version; export a PDF summary and raw JSON records to share with whomever you choose
• Optional daily reminder with neutral text; silent, and off by default
• English and Simplified Chinese

Privacy by design: your plans, notes, and records stay in the app on your device. There is no account, no analytics, no advertising, and no network upload. Records are excluded from device backups, so exporting before switching devices is recommended.

Gentle Routine records timer time only. It does not verify actions, assess outcomes, or suggest changes to your plan. Always follow the guidance of your own healthcare professional.

name: Gentle Tilt
description:
Gentle Tilt is a marble game about a small, steady lean.

Tilt the phone and the ball runs. Hold a gentle angle, watch the marble, and let gravity bring it along the deck. Brake for the corner and slow down to finish.

Play 22 levels: ten each in Dawn and Rise, plus Air time and Afterglow in Fold. Finish a level to unlock the next, collect checkpoint sparks, and return to your latest checkpoint after a fall. There is no forced countdown.

Chase a faster personal best and earn Bronze, Silver and Gold medals. Choose tilt or touch steering, with optional rolling sound and haptics.

Browse previews of future sections in the miniature Marble Workshop. Preview sections are not playable in this release.

Find your balance.

name: Gerizim Mail
description:
Gerizim Mail is an email app for people who use their own domain: addresses like you@yourname.com.

Add every mailbox you own and read them all in one place. There is no fee per mailbox and no limit on how many you add.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Add a mailbox with just your email address and password. The app finds the server settings for you.
• See every inbox on one Home screen, with unread counts.
• Send from any of your addresses, with its own name and signature.
• Attach photos, files, or scan a paper document with the camera.
• Send to many people at once with contact groups, and import contacts from a file.
• Swipe to delete, star, archive, mark as VIP, search, and select many at once.
• Read your inbox with no internet: recent mail is kept on the phone.
• Write in Urdu and other right-to-left languages.
• Lock the app with Face ID or your passcode.
• Light and dark mode.

YOUR MAIL STAYS YOURS
• Mail travels straight between your phone and your own mail server. It never passes through our servers.
• Mailbox passwords are kept only on your phone.
• Your Gerizim account (Google or Apple sign-in) remembers only your list of mailboxes, so a new phone is quick to set up.
• No adverts and no tracking.

WORKS WITH YOUR HOST
Gerizim Mail uses standard IMAP and SMTP, so it works with the email that comes with most web hosting and domain providers.

name: GetTakeaway Driver
description:
GetTakeaway Driver App is the delivery app for drivers of takeaways and restaurants that use GetTakeaway for their online ordering and TouchPOS till.

Your restaurant gives you a username and password. Sign in with the restaurant's web address and you're ready to drive.

SEE EVERY DELIVERY
• New deliveries appear the moment they're ordered online or put through the till
• An alert on your phone, even when it's locked, so you never miss one
• Claim a delivery with one tap so other drivers know it's yours

GET THERE FASTER
• One tap opens directions to the customer's address
• Call the customer straight from the delivery card
• See the order total and whether it's cash or card before you set off

AT THE DOOR
• Customer paying by card instead of cash? Switch the payment in the app
• Add a tip so it's recorded for you
• Mark the delivery done and it updates at the restaurant straight away

YOUR SHIFT
• Go Online when you start and Offline when you finish
• While you're Online the restaurant sees you on its live map, so it knows who's free
• Your deliveries, cash, card and tips for the day, all in one place

name: Gia phả nhà mình
description:
Gia phả nhà mình giúp cả nhà cùng ghi lại cây họ hàng và không quên những ngày quan trọng.

CÂY GIA PHẢ LẤY BẠN LÀM TRUNG TÂM
Ông bà, cha mẹ, anh chị em, con cháu xếp quanh bạn. Chạm một người để thêm người thân bên cạnh. Xem riêng bên nội, bên ngoại.

NGÀY GIỖ THEO LỊCH ÂM
Lịch hiện cả ngày âm trong từng ô. Ngày giỗ tự tính sang dương lịch mỗi năm, kể cả tháng nhuận và tháng thiếu. Sinh nhật, tất niên, họp họ cũng ghi được.

NHẮC TRƯỚC VÀ WIDGET
Chọn nhắc trước 1, 3 hay 7 ngày để kịp thu xếp về quê. Đặt widget ra màn hình chính để luôn thấy ngày sắp tới.

CẢ HỌ CÙNG GHI
Gửi mã họ cho người thân. Người trong họ duyệt người mới, mỗi người sửa nhánh của mình.

RIÊNG TƯ THẬT SỰ
Tên, ngày tháng và quan hệ trong họ được mã hoá ngay trên máy trước khi gửi đi. Máy chủ chỉ giữ dữ liệu đã mã hoá, không đọc được. Không quảng cáo, không theo dõi.

Đăng nhập bằng Apple. Lúc tạo họ, app cấp một mã khôi phục để lấy lại dữ liệu khi đổi máy.

name: Gift Elf
description:
Trouvez le bon cadeau pour chacun en 30 secondes et gardez votre budget sous contrôle, de Noël à tous les anniversaires.

Indiquez l'âge, les passions et le budget d'un proche : Gift Elf vous propose aussitôt 5 idées sur mesure, avec un prix estimé et la raison pour laquelle elles lui plairont. Gardez celles que vous aimez d'un simple geste, elles rejoignent votre liste.

POURQUOI GIFT ELF
• 5 idées personnalisées en quelques secondes, plus de page blanche
• Un budget qui tombe juste, par personne et pour toute l'occasion
• Chaque cadeau suivi jusqu'au bout : idée, acheté, emballé, offert
• Des rappels avant la date limite de commande et le jour de livraison
• Toute l'année : anniversaires, fête des mères, fête des pères, Saint-Valentin
• Sans compte, sans publicité, vos données restent sur votre appareil

DES IDÉES QUI VOUS RESSEMBLENT
• Créées directement sur votre iPhone ou iPad par Apple Intelligence, sur les appareils compatibles
• Sur les autres appareils, Gift Elf choisit parmi sa sélection d'idées intégrée : vous avez toujours 5 propositions
• Affinez en un geste : plus original, moins cher, fait main, expérience
• Chaque idée a un prix estimé dans votre devise

UN BUDGET CLAIR
• Anneau « reste à dépenser » visible dès l'ouverture
• Barres par personne qui passent à l'orange puis au rouge avant le dépassement
• Répartition des dépenses par étape
• Widget « Reste à dépenser » sur l'écran d'accueil et l'écran verrouillé

DE L'IDÉE AU PAQUET CADEAU
• Tableau en colonnes avec glisser-déposer sur iPad
• Balayage rapide sur iPhone pour passer à l'étape suivante
• Prix payé, boutique, lien et date de livraison pour chaque cadeau
• Petite fête quand tous les cadeaux sont offerts

TOUTE L'ANNÉE, SANS OUBLI
• Compte à rebours jusqu'à la prochaine occasion
• Dates de la fête des mères et des pères adaptées à votre pays
• Historique des cadeaux offerts et alerte si vous risquez d'offrir deux fois la même chose

PARTAGEZ EN FAMILLE
• Une jolie carte « Ma liste » à envoyer, montants masqués par défaut
• Une liste d'idées en texte pour vous coordonner

VOTRE VIE PRIVÉE D'ABORD
Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucun traceur. Les informations sur vos proches restent sur votre appareil.

GRATUIT OU PRO
Gratuit : jusqu'à 5 proches pour Noël, budgets, suivi, rappels, widget, partage et un premier tirage d'idées offert.
Gift Elf Pro : proches illimités, idées illimitées avec affinage, toutes les occasions de l'année et l'historique des cadeaux. Abonnement mensuel ou annuel (essai gratuit de 7 jours sur l'annuel), ou achat unique à vie.

L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement sauf annulation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Gérez-le ou annulez-le à tout moment dans les réglages de votre compte App Store.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Confidentialité : https://schmittutility.fr/confidentialite/
Assistance : https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/

name: Gino Runners
description:
רצים עם גינו היא האפליקציה של חברי קבוצת הריצה.

• התוכנית השבועית – המאמן בונה לכל מתאמן תוכנית אימונים, והיא מחכה לך באפליקציה.
• דיווח בצילום – מצלמים את מסך השעון אחרי הריצה, והאפליקציה קוראת את הנתונים לבד ונותנת ציון.
• הקבוצה – רואים מי רץ השבוע, מגיבים ומעודדים.
• תזכורות – התראה בערב לפני אימון, ועדכון כשמישהו מהקבוצה מדווח.
• עובדת גם בלי אינטרנט – התוכנית והדיווחים האחרונים זמינים תמיד.

האפליקציה מיועדת לחברי הקבוצה. ההצטרפות מאושרת על ידי המאמן.

name: Glass Icons
description:
Glass Icons lets you create Home Screen icons that blend seamlessly into your iPhone wallpaper.

Pick any slot on your Home Screen or Dock, match your wallpaper cutout, and export pixel-accurate icons ready for Apple Shortcuts.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose your iPhone model and icon size (Regular or Large) during setup, or verify alignment against a Home Screen screenshot.
2. Import your wallpaper from Photos, Files, or the clipboard.
3. Select any Home Screen or Dock position and optionally layer a transparent PNG icon on top.
4. Fine-tune frosted glass blur, icon scale, and drop shadow per icon.
5. Save individual icons or your entire layout to Photos and add them to your Home Screen using Apple Shortcuts.

FEATURES
• Preset grid layouts for modern iPhone models, plus manual alignment sliders
• Supports both standard and Large (label-free) Home Screen icons
• Configurable Dock layout (1–4 icons)
• Frosted glass blur, PNG scaling, and shadow controls saved per slot
• Import wallpapers and transparent PNGs from Photos, Files, or clipboard
• Full-screen icon preview and batch save to Photos
• 100% on-device processing — no accounts, analytics, or tracking

name: Gleich
description:
Gleich zeigt dir beim Öffnen sofort, was an der Haltestelle in deiner Nähe abfährt. Keine Eingabe, kein Menü – nur Linie, Richtung und Minuten bis zur Abfahrt.

• Abfahrten in der Nähe, überall in Deutschland, mit Echtzeit, wo die Verkehrsunternehmen sie liefern
• Verspätungen in Rot, Abfahrten, die du zu Fuß kaum noch schaffst, blass
• Nach links wischen: weitere Haltestellen mit Linien, die es an der nächsten nicht gibt – mit echter Gehzeit
• Nach rechts wischen: Netzpläne deines Verkehrsverbunds, auch ohne Netz
• „Wohin?“: die nächsten Verbindungen von hier, gemerkte Orte wie „Zuhause“ ganz oben
• Widgets für Home- und Sperrbildschirm

Gleich braucht kein Konto, zeigt keine Werbung und sammelt keine Daten. Für die Haltestellensuche geht nur der ungefähre Standort an die freien Fahrplandienste Transitous und VBB.

name: GLINTLINE: Window Puzzles
description:
An umbrella can be right in front of you and still be impossible to see from the sidewalk. In GLINTLINE, that difference is the puzzle.

Arrange objects in illuminated 3D shop windows. Move a folded umbrella, turn a spiral-bound journal, or make room for a glowing lantern. Tap a visitor to see the display from their exact viewpoint and learn which object caught their eye.

As you explore Prism Row, Switchyard, and Afterglow, look for new ways to shape what visitors see. Slide a screen, adjust a shelf, work with curtains, or change the light when the display gives you those tools. Undo an experiment, reset the arrangement, or ask for a hint whenever you need one.

Run the display when your arrangement is ready. A solved puzzle plays a short story and earns a keepsake you can revisit in your collection.

GLINTLINE is a single-player puzzle game for iPhone and iPad that plays offline. Options include larger text, reduced motion, and separate music and sound controls.

name: Glublog: Dive Logbook
description:
Glublog is a social dive logbook. Take a photo of your dive computer or your paper logbook and Glublog suggests the dive details for you to check and publish.

• Every dive is a card: depth, time, gas, the dive site on the map, your buddies and what you saw.
• Species collection: mark the species you saw, with reference photos, and earn bronze, silver and gold badges.
• Destinations and special species around the world, from the Mediterranean to the Pacific.
• Activities: group the dives of a trip or a season and share them as an image.
• Challenges with friends and official challenges.
• Follow other divers, like and comment on their dives.
• Signatures: dive center staff can sign your dives from the app.
• Verified experience: share a private link or QR code with your dives, hours and the centers that signed them.
• Import your logbook from other apps (UDDF and Subsurface).
• Works offline: everything is saved on your phone first and syncs when you have coverage.
• Export your logbook to CSV and UDDF whenever you want.
• You choose who sees each dive: public, followers or private.

Glublog is a logbook, not a dive computer or a planning tool.

name: GNOP Duo
description:
GNOP Duo is a fast paddle duel made for two people sharing one screen.

Put the phone between you. Each player takes one end and moves a paddle with a finger. First to seven wins.

• FACE TO FACE — on a foldable iPhone the fold is the net, and each half is yours.
• DROP IN, DROP OUT — every side is played by the machine until someone touches it. Play alone, or let a friend join mid-match.
• SPIN — move your paddle as you hit and the ball curves.
• POWER-UPS — big paddle, double ball and speed ball appear in the middle. The last player to hit the ball gets them.
• FOLD TO CHANGE THE GAME — fold the phone slightly for the turbo net: the ball speeds up every time it crosses. Fold it like a laptop for wall mode and chase your best rally.
• Works on every iPhone and iPad, in any orientation.

• WORLD RANKING — longest rally, wins against the machine and wall-mode best, worldwide (Game Center).

No ads. No sign-up. We collect no data.

name: Goes dry
description:
Goes dry shows which taps lose water when you close a valve in a small building.

The main is the source. A valve lets water pass when it is open. A tap runs only when every valve on a path from the main is open. Close Kitchen, and the cold taps go dry. The hose and the hot tap keep running.

Tap a dry tap. The page names the closed valve and the path the water would have taken.

The building stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This picture is not a plumbing plan.

name: Goodxo Delivery Partner
description:
Goodxo Delivery Partner - Ride, Deliver & Earn More!

Welcome to Goodxo Delivery Partner, your trusted platform to earn money by delivering orders and providing reliable delivery services. Join Goodxo as a Delivery Partner and unlock earning opportunities by delivering orders across multiple business segments.

Whether you want to deliver food, groceries, vegetables, medicines, fashion products, parcels, or other items, Goodxo brings multiple delivery opportunities together in one platform.

Ride more, deliver more, and earn more with Goodxo!

MULTIPLE DELIVERY SEGMENTS

Work across different business segments and accept delivery opportunities according to your availability. Deliver food, groceries, vegetables, medicines, fashion products, and more through a single delivery partner app.

PARCEL DELIVERY OPPORTUNITIES

Earn by delivering parcels and other items from one location to another. Take advantage of parcel delivery opportunities and make your rides more productive.

RIDE AND EARN

Turn your riding skills into an earning opportunity. Complete delivery orders, make your rides worthwhile, and earn through delivery assignments.

MORE ORDERS, MORE EARNING OPPORTUNITIES

Get access to delivery requests from different segments. Complete more orders and increase your earning potential through your delivery work.

EASY ORDER MANAGEMENT

Manage your delivery assignments conveniently through the Goodxo Delivery Partner App. View order details, pickup locations, delivery addresses, and other important information to complete deliveries smoothly.

PICKUP AND DELIVERY DETAILS

Get the necessary information for collecting orders from vendors and delivering them to customers. Follow the order instructions and complete each delivery professionally.

DELIVER ORDERS ON TIME

Provide a reliable delivery experience by completing assigned orders efficiently. Help customers receive their orders safely and on time.

GROW WITH GOODXO

name: Goodxo Vendor
description:
