name: Gravity Gem Vault
description:
Turn the vault. Let the gems fall. Break the seals to free the relic.

Gravity Gem Vault is a spatial match-three puzzle played inside a 4 × 4 × 4 vault. Choose which face becomes the floor and watch the gems settle. Three or more matching gems in a straight line clear along any of the three axes. A falling gem can start another match. Break all the gold-rimmed seals to finish the puzzle.

LOOK INSIDE THE VAULT
Drag to change your view, pinch to zoom, or inspect a slice of the board. Looking around costs no moves. Every tilt uses one move, and you can undo, restart, or use one hint per attempt.

EXPLORE FOUR CHAPTERS
Solve 24 puzzles and collect relics including an ammonite, a sundial, and a feather key. You can rotate each unlocked relic in the collection.

How to Play is available from the home and pause menus. Choose English or Chinese in Settings. Progress is saved on your device.

name: Greenlight: Around to talk
description:
Around to talk? Give the green light.

Greenlight is the simplest way to let the people you care about know you're free to talk right now. Tap Go green, pick how long, and your favorites get a heads-up. They can call you while your light is on. No scheduling, no back-and-forth.

HOW IT WORKS
• Go green for 15, 30 or 60 minutes when you have time to talk, like on a walk or the drive home.
• Your favorites hear about it: a notification on Greenlight, or a text if they don't have the app yet.
• They call you right then, in the app or by phone.
• When your people go green, you'll see who's free right now on your home screen.

MADE FOR YOUR CLOSEST PEOPLE
• Pick at least three favorites when you start. They hear by default every time you go green.
• Everyone else in your contacts is one tap away to call or add.
• See who you told and when you last spoke.
• Add a short note, like "Walking the dog, call me."

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your contacts stay on your iPhone. Numbers are scrambled before checking who's on Greenlight.
• Only the people you choose ever hear from you.
• Anyone can reply STOP to stop the texts.

Greenlight works best when your people have it too, but they don't have to. Go green and they'll still get a text.

name: GroomHarbor
description:
# GroomHarbor — Mobile Pet Grooming Manager

**Your mobile grooming business, beautifully organized.**

GroomHarbor is a business management companion designed for independent mobile pet groomers and small grooming businesses.

Manage your customers, pets, appointments, routes, expenses, and business records from one convenient workspace.

With its welcoming coastal design and practical business tools, GroomHarbor helps you spend less time organizing paperwork and more time caring for pets.

**APPOINTMENTS & SCHEDULING**

Create grooming appointments, select services, record agreed prices, update visit details, and manage your daily schedule.

Use the interactive calendar to review scheduled visits and plan your workday.

**CUSTOMERS & PET PROFILES**

Organize customer contact information, service addresses, pet profiles, grooming notes, and visit history.

Keep important details accessible when preparing for each appointment.

**MAPS & ROUTES**

View appointment locations on a map, explore suggested stop orders, and open driving directions.

Record business mileage to help organize your travel records.

**PAYMENTS & BUSINESS RECORDS**

Track customer balances and manually record payments received through external methods.

Create service statements and export PDF business documents.

GroomHarbor does not process card payments or independently verify external transactions.

**BUSINESS MANAGEMENT**

Keep your grooming operation organized with tools for:

- Business profiles, services, and pricing
- Expense tracking
- Mileage records
- Supplies and replenishment
- Appointment reminders and follow-ups
- Business and tax-related reports
- Encrypted data backup and recovery

**DESIGNED FOR MOBILE GROOMERS**

Enjoy an approachable interface featuring coastal artwork, clear navigation, and practical tools for everyday business management.

**ONE PURCHASE. NO RECURRING APP SUBSCRIPTION.**

GroomHarbor is designed to help independent groomers manage their business without a recurring app subscription.

Third-party payment services, if used separately, may charge their own fees.

Bring your grooming business together with GroomHarbor.

name: GS6 Works Tracker
description:
GS6 Works Tracker is a workforce and job management application designed to help GS6 Developments manage construction, maintenance and property improvement projects efficiently.

The app provides a central platform for staff to access their daily schedules, manage assigned tasks, record completed work and stay informed about project progress.

Key Features

Staff Scheduling
View daily work schedules, assigned jobs and project locations in one convenient place.

Job Management
Access job information, track assigned tasks and keep work organised across multiple properties and projects.

Work Progress Tracking
Mark tasks as completed, record completion dates and times, and track outstanding work.

Purchasing and Order Numbers
Generate unique purchase order references linked to individual jobs and staff members, helping maintain accurate purchasing records.

Project Organisation
Keep project information, job allocations and work schedules together in one central system.

Management Tools
Authorised managers can coordinate staff, organise workloads and oversee ongoing projects.

GS6 Works Tracker is designed for authorised GS6 Developments staff and management. A valid account is required to access the application.

Built to support efficient communication, accountability and day-to-day operations across the GS6 Developments team.

name: GTA 6 - The Unofficial Guide
description:
Your fan-made companion for the most anticipated open-world game of the year.

GUIDES
• Missables, strangers and random events, skills, properties, shops, hobbies, challenges, secrets and a trophy roadmap
• A “Start Here” checklist for your first hours in Leonida
• Spoiler-safe by default: story details stay hidden until you reach them

MAP
• A clean, Apple Maps-style map of Leonida with highways and route numbers
• Every confirmed place pinned; filter by category and search by name
• Mark places as visited and see the missions at each one
• Smooth, native pinch-to-zoom and pan

MISSIONS & 100% TRACKER
• Track missions and objectives chapter by chapter
• One ring that adds up missions, places, collectibles and challenges
• Share your progress as an image

CHARACTERS & RADIO
• Every confirmed character, with your own notes and favorites
• All six announced radio stations with their hosts, the songs previewed so far, the soundtrack album and the score
• 30-second previews and links to listen on Apple Music

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo — folded or open
• Light and Dark Mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver
• Seven app icons to choose from

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Favorites, notes, your own screenshots and progress stay on your device
• Free content updates; everything works offline once downloaded

GTA 6 - The Unofficial Guide is a fan-made app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored or approved by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto is a trademark of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.

Privacy Policy: https://intrapixel.com/gta6guide/privacy

name: GTA 6 Buddy: Cheats & Map
description:
GTA 6 Buddy is the pocket companion for Grand Theft Auto VI players: cheat codes with big, readable controller buttons, a map you can mark up, a guide to everything Rockstar has confirmed, checklists, widgets and a launch countdown. It works offline and has no ads, no account and no subscriptions.

CHEATS
• Every code as a button sequence for PlayStation, Xbox or PC
• Large pad view you can read from the couch, with read-aloud
• Search, categories and favourites
• Print a cheat sheet or share a code with a friend
• The complete, verified GTA V list is included today (36 cheats)
• GTA VI codes are added only after they have been verified on a retail copy of the game. No guesses, no fakes.

MAP
• Our own drawn map of Leonida's six regions
• Add your own pins and notes
• Region details link straight into the guide

GUIDE
• Launch facts, characters, regions and radio stations, each with its source
• One search across cheats, guide and map

CHECKLISTS
• Tick items off and watch your progress
• Launch-day checklist included

WIDGETS AND EXTRAS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: countdown, pinned cheat, progress
• Original wallpapers, including one built from your saved cheats
• Optional alerts for launch day and for the first verified codes

MADE TO BE USED WHILE YOU PLAY
• Works without an internet connection
• New codes and corrections arrive automatically
• Designed for iPhone and iPad
• No ads, no tracking, no sign-in

GTA 6 Buddy is an unofficial fan-made app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto is a trademark of its owner. All artwork in the app is original.

name: Guessaday
description:
A trainer for calculating the day of the week of any given date.

Guessaday shows a random date and asks you which day of the week it falls on. Tap your answer and the app tells you whether you were right, and optionally how long you needed.

Features:
• Choose the range of dates: this month, this year, the last 100 years, the 20th or 21st century, the whole Gregorian era, or your own start and end date.
• Stopwatch for each guess.
• "Short date display": the date disappears after a configurable delay, so you have to memorize it first.
• Statistics per date range: accuracy, times and streaks.
• Optional practice reminders: a few random dates a day as notifications, with "Reveal" and "Practice" buttons. Off by default.
• Dates and weekday names follow your device language; the app is available in 23 languages.
• Works fully offline. No ads, no tracking, no account.

If you want to learn how to calculate the weekday in your head, visit the developer's website: https://firsching.ch/guessaday

Guessaday is developed by Moritz Firsching and is free software (GPL-3.0).

name: Gvacars
description:
Gvacars est l’application mobile des professionnels de l’atelier automobile. Créez et suivez vos fiches de réparation, anticipez les prochains services de vos clients et organisez le planning de l’atelier, directement depuis votre iPhone.

FICHES DE RÉPARATION
• Créez une fiche en quelques secondes : client, véhicule, kilométrage, dates et main d’œuvre
• Retrouvez instantanément une fiche par référence, plaque, marque ou créateur
• Ajoutez les services effectués à partir de préréglages, avec prix unitaire et total
• Joignez des photos pour documenter chaque intervention
• Mesurez le temps de travail avec le chronomètre intégré (démarrer, pause, terminer)
• Prévisualisez et partagez la fiche en PDF

SUIVI DES PROCHAINS SERVICES
• Visualisez les véhicules dont le prochain service approche, par date ou par kilométrage
• Codes couleur selon l’urgence : moins d’une semaine, deux semaines ou un mois
• Repérez immédiatement les services en retard
• Rappels automatiques par e-mail envoyés aux responsables de votre choix

CALENDRIER DE L’ATELIER
• Toutes les fiches dans un calendrier clair
• Vue par mois, par semaine ou en liste
• Retour à aujourd’hui en un geste

NOTIFICATIONS
• Soyez averti en temps réel des nouvelles fiches et des services à venir
• Choisissez précisément les notifications que vous souhaitez recevoir

PENSÉE POUR VOTRE ÉQUIPE
• Accès selon le rôle et les autorisations de chaque utilisateur
• Thème clair, sombre ou automatique
• Disponible en français et en anglais
• Connexion sécurisée

Gvacars est destinée aux garages et ateliers partenaires. Un compte professionnel fourni par votre atelier est nécessaire pour se connecter.

name: H6NOTAS: Ideias e Listas
description:
O H6NOTAS é o jeito mais bonito e simples de guardar ideias, listas e anotações. Escreva à vontade: tudo é salvo sozinho enquanto você digita, mesmo offline, e sincroniza entre iPhone, Android e Web quando a internet volta.

ESCREVA DO SEU JEITO
• Títulos, listas, sublistas, checklists, citações, destaques, código e tabelas
• Negrito, itálico, sublinhado, riscado e marca-texto
• Links ilimitados (Google Drive, sites, vídeos) com cartões de pré-visualização
• Modelos prontos: reunião, projeto, diário, estudos, compras e planejamento semanal

ORGANIZE SEM ESFORÇO
• Pastas e subpastas em até 5 níveis, com cores e ícones
• #tags viram categorias automaticamente
• Veja suas notas em cartões, quadrados, lista ou Kanban
• Fixar, favoritar, arquivar e lixeira com 30 dias para recuperar

LEMBRETES INTELIGENTES
• Escreva “amanhã às 9h” ou “sexta à tarde” e o H6NOTAS cria o lembrete
• Captura rápida e nota do dia

COMPARTILHE COM AMIGOS
• Convide pelo e-mail ou @ e edite notas e pastas juntos
• Aviso quando alguém atualiza uma nota compartilhada

PRIVACIDADE E SEGURANÇA
• Bloqueie notas e pastas com senha ou Face ID
• Bloqueie o app inteiro com Face ID

SEMPRE À MÃO
• Widgets para a tela inicial e a tela bloqueada, inclusive checklist interativa
• Siri e Atalhos: “Criar nota no H6NOTAS”
• Conecte ao Claude e ao ChatGPT para criar e buscar notas conversando
• Modo claro e escuro

Sua jornada também conta: acompanhe quantas notas você criou, seu nível de organização e suas conquistas.

name: Halal Scroll: Quran & Sunnah
description:
Replace mindless social media doom-scrolling with moments of stillness, remembrance, and sacred knowledge.

Halal Scroll transforms your daily screen time into a serene, tactile vertical feed of over 14,600 canonical passages from the Noble Quran, Sahih Hadith, and Prophetic Duas—designed for reflection (Tadabbur), understanding, and daily practice.

THREE WAYS TO READ & REFLECT
• For You: A balanced daily stream of Quranic Ayat, 40 Hadith Nawawi, and Prophetic supplications.
• Sequential Mode: Read Surah by Surah through all 114 Surahs of the Quran or follow curated Hadith and Dua collections with automatic progress saving.
• Moods & Themes: Find guidance for the exact moment you are in—Anxious, Seeking Forgiveness (Tawbah), Grateful (Shukr), Hardship & Sabr, Tawakkul, Rizq, Family, and more.

DEEP STUDY & ARABIC WORD EXPLORER
• Tap any highlighted Arabic word to hear pronunciation and explore its Trilateral Root and literal meaning.
• Open the Deep Study sheet on any card for concise Summary, Word-by-Word breakdown, Tafsir context, Sunnah insights, and an Actionable Practice tracker with personal reflection notes and streaks.

AUTHENTIC RECITATION & TYPOGRAPHY
• Listen to verse recitations from renowned Qaris (Mishary Rashid Alafasy, Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary, and AbdulBaset AbdulSamad).
• Switch effortlessly between Uthmani (KFGQPC / Madinah) and IndoPak Nastaleeq scripts.
• Choose between The Clear Quran (Dr. Mustafa Khattab) and Sahih International translations, with optional phonetic transliteration.
• Adjust reading font size (80%–150%) to suit your comfort.

DESIGNED FOR CALM & PRIVACY
• Automatically matches your iPhone's Light and Dark appearance, or choose from four handcrafted Sanctuary palettes: Midnight Sanctuary, Andalusian Parchment, Fajr Dawn, and Maghrib Dusk.
• Organize saved passages in custom Bookmark Folders and export beautiful cards in the Share Studio.
• No ads, no tracking, and no account required—your bookmarks, reflections, and preferences stay private on your device.

name: Halden by Rendel
seller_name: NEON APPS TEKNOLOJI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Halden is a sample clothing store with Rendel inside, so you can try Rendel the way your own customers would.

Ask in your own words. Rendel answers with a page you can act on: products in your size and budget, where your order is, a return started in a couple of taps.

Let it do the job. Once you say yes, it places the order with the saved card, applies a discount code or books a fitting room at a Halden studio. Nothing is charged: Halden is a demo, and its card, orders and studios are made up.

See the team's side. Open the demo's console on your computer, change what the assistant says or which actions it can take, and watch this phone follow. The app gives you a link to send to your computer.

Already trying Rendel on demo.rendel.ai? Scan the code in your demo console to bring the same demo to your phone.

Rendel is a Mobile and Web SDK that adds this assistant to an app. Learn more at rendel.ai.

name: Hamburger Hill
description:
Every hill costs men. Take it anyway.

Fight through the fictional country of Granovia in a single-player military shooter with digitized soldiers, explosive battles and a campaign that carries on between firefights.

Hit the beach, jump from a transport plane, ride in by helicopter or push up the river. Move with your squad, use cover and bring the right weapon for the job.

Choose a side on the campaign map, plan your next operation, then fight it on the ground. Or jump straight into Quick Play and learn the controls on the tutorial course.

- Three playable factions: Granovia, U.S.A. and W.A.R.L.O.R.D.Z.
- Campaign play and standalone quick battles.
- Landscape touch controls made for phones.
- Offline play with saves stored on your device.
- One purchase, with no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Contains strong language, blood and dismemberment.

name: Handver
description: Handver is a study bench for naming poker hands and reading table decisions. Compose five cards and learn the hand. Choose fold, call, or raise on a street, then write down why. Your notes stay in a ledger. Handver does not run a cash game and has nothing to cash out.

name: Happy Markdown: Notes
description:
Write Markdown with your files kept in iCloud, ready to open on your Mac as well.

■ What you see is what you get
The page renders as you type: math, diagrams, tables, code blocks and task lists, all live.

■ Math and diagrams
LaTeX inline and block formulas, plus Mermaid diagrams: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts
from a few lines of text.

■ Music notation
ABC notation and numbered notation can be written directly in the document and are rendered in the
editor.

■ Export and print
HTML, Word, PowerPoint and PDF, delivered through the system share sheet. The PDF is paginated at
A4 with fixed margins and can be printed directly.

■ iCloud workspace
The workspace is a folder named after this app in the Files app; edits sync through iCloud to your
other devices. Files opened from other apps with "Open in Happy Markdown" are copied into the
workspace first, leaving the original untouched.

■ Editing aids
Outline, find and replace, and search across the whole workspace. Deleted files go to Recently
Deleted and are kept for 30 days.

■ Read aloud
The open document is read sentence by sentence, starting at the cursor, with the text highlighted as
it goes. Pause, resume or stop at any time; playback continues with the screen locked or while using
another app. Voice and rate are set in Settings.

■ Six languages
简体中文, 繁體中文, English, 日本語, 한국어, Español.

No data is collected. No third-party analytics, no ads.

name: Harness
description:
Harness 让你在 iPhone 上直接使用电脑里的 DeepSeek Harness——代码、文件和会话都留在你自己的电脑上，手机只负责连接和操作。

【完整工作区，随身携带】
通过同一 Wi-Fi 或 Tailscale 连接电脑上的 Harness 服务，网页端的工作区、会话和工具能力原样保留。电脑上正在进行的任务，拿起手机就能继续。

【原生连接管理】
· 保存多个 Harness 连接，添加备注、随时切换
· 连接前分别测试端口和网页响应
· 连接地址与备注保存在系统钥匙串
· 每个连接使用独立的网站数据，互不影响

【原生外观与语言】
· 浅色、深色、跟随系统三种外观，与 Harness 双向同步
· 支持简体中文、繁体中文、英语、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语和俄语
· 全屏网页体验，保留系统安全区域，没有多余工具栏

【使用前准备】
在电脑上安装并启动 DeepSeek Harness，然后粘贴带令牌的完整启动链接。详细步骤见 App 内的“同一 Wi-Fi”和“Tailscale”指南。

数据只在 iPhone 和你自己的电脑之间传输，不经过开发者服务器。本应用不收集个人信息，不含广告和统计 SDK。

name: Haven PDF: Private PDF Editor
description:
Haven PDF is a complete PDF editor that never uploads your files.

Everything — editing, merging, splitting, compressing, signing, filling forms, permanent redaction, and OCR — runs directly on your iPhone or iPad. Not "deleted after an hour" on someone's server: never sent at all. Turn on Airplane Mode and every PDF tool keeps working.

EVERYDAY PDF TOOLS
• Edit existing PDF text, add text boxes, images, shapes, stamps, QR codes, and highlights
• Merge multiple PDFs, split ranges, reorder, rotate, crop, and delete pages
• Compress to an exact target size (100 KB … 2 MB) with PDF X-Ray size breakdown
• Sign with a drawn, typed, or image signature; fill AcroForms and add quick check, cross, and date marks
• True permanent redaction — covered text and PII are stripped from the PDF stream, not just painted over
• OCR scanned documents into searchable PDFs in 30+ languages
• Convert Word (.docx) ↔ PDF, JPG/PNG/WebP ↔ PDF, PDF → Markdown (.md) / CSV / text
• Scan & straighten: turn a camera photo of paper into a clean, perspective-corrected PDF
• Create blank, lined, 5mm grid, dot-grid, and Cornell note PDFs
• Password-protect (AES-256) or unlock PDFs, add watermarks, page numbers, and Bates numbering

MADE FOR iOS & iPadOS
• Open PDFs in place directly from the Files app, Mail, Safari, or Share Sheet
• Export back to Files, iCloud Drive, Share Sheet, or AirPrint
• Dark mode and full localization in 15 languages

Free. No account, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and no page limits.

name: HawaDrop
description:
HawaDrop sends photos and files straight to someone standing near you.

No account. No sign-up. Nothing is uploaded to the internet, and no copy of your file is ever stored on a server, because there is no server. Your phone connects directly to theirs, the same way AirDrop does, and the file goes across that link and nowhere else.

Open the app and you will see the names of people nearby who also have it open. Tap one, choose what to send, and they decide whether to accept. Nothing leaves your phone until they say yes.

WHY IT IS DIFFERENT

- No code to read out. You pick a person by name from a list. Nothing has to be typed, spoken or compared.
- Works with no signal. Cafes, car parks, basements, aeroplanes. HawaDrop does not need Wi-Fi or mobile data.
- Any file, any size. Photos, videos, documents, archives. Files stream from disk, so a large video does not have to fit in memory.
- You are only visible while the app is open and on screen. Close it and you disappear from everyone's list.

PRIVACY

HawaDrop collects nothing. There are no accounts, no analytics, no advertising identifiers and no third-party tracking. The only things stored are the name you chose, the people you have blocked, and the files you accepted. All of it stays on your phone and all of it is removed when you delete the app.

SAFETY

Press and hold anyone in the list to block or report them. Blocking is immediate and permanent until you undo it: they vanish from your list and cannot send you anything, even if they change their name. There is zero tolerance for abusive behaviour or objectionable content.

Received files are saved to the HawaDrop folder in the Files app, where you can open, move or delete them like anything else.

name: Hbcpt
description:
Welcome! We look forward to accompanying you on your journey—please feel free to share your valuable suggestions.

Hbcpt keeps every expiring document in your household in one tidy place, so a lapsed passport or forgotten visa never catches you out. Track passports, driving licences, ID cards, visas, residence permits, insurance policies, vehicle registration and memberships for yourself and the people you look after.

You enter the details by hand. There are no scans and no photos of your papers. Hbcpt does the counting for you: how many days are left, the day each renewal window opens, and what every past renewal cost.

KNOW WHAT IS DUE FIRST
Upcoming lists every document by days remaining. Lapsed items, documents already inside their renewal window and those still valid are grouped apart, each with a coloured status band, and the top of the desk is stamped with the next "Renew by" or "Valid until" date. Show the next 90 days, the next 12 months or everything at once.

A FILE CARD FOR EACH DOCUMENT
Record the kind, holder, number, issuer, issue date and expiry. Numbers can be masked so only the last three characters show. Choose how far ahead renewal should begin, such as six months for a passport or a month for a policy, and the card tells you exactly when that day comes.

STEP-BY-STEP RENEWALS
Each document kind starts with a practical checklist covering photos, forms, fees and appointments. Tick items as you go, add your own steps and drop any you do not need.

REMINDERS ON YOUR TERMS
Choose alerts 180, 90, 60, 30, 14, 7 or 1 day before a document expires, delivered in the morning, at noon or in the evening. They are local notifications on your iPhone and stay off until you turn them on.

THE WHOLE FAMILY IN ONE DRAWER
Add a partner, children, parents or anyone whose papers you manage, then filter the drawer by person.

A RECORD OF EVERY RENEWAL
Log each renewal with its date, cost and currency. The document moves to its new expiry, its checklist resets for next time, and the log shows this year's spending and how early you tend to renew.

A FRESH, CLEAR LOOK
Warm white paper, bold slab headings and a new deep red and garnet palette, with a column of rubber stamps on the right edge to switch between Upcoming, Documents, Renewals and the Bureau.

SIGN IN OR JUST START
Create an account with email and password, or tap "Look around the bureau" to begin as a guest straight away. A guest can move their files to an email account later and keep everything. The app works offline and syncs when you reconnect.

PRIVATE AND IN YOUR CONTROL
Your files belong to your account only. No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Delete your account and every document at any time from the Bureau page.

Hbcpt tracks the dates you enter. Always confirm renewal rules and deadlines with the issuing authority.

name: HeapWeave
description: Please feel free to share your thoughts on the interface, workflows, or your overall experience. Your genuine, firsthand experience is more valuable than any preconceived notions. We will carefully read, organize, and summarize your feedback, using it to guide our future improvements. While we cannot guarantee immediate changes in every instance, we will do our best to ensure that sound suggestions are addressed.

name: Hedra - Puzzle 3D relajante
description:
Respira. Mira tres dibujos. Imagina la pieza.

Hedra es un puzzle para ir despacio. Cada pieza se esconde detrás de tres vistas (planta, alzado y perfil) y solo existe de verdad cuando la imaginas. Trazo a trazo la dibujas sobre la cuadrícula… y cuando la última línea encaja, el dibujo cobra volumen y se queda ahí, girando entre tus dedos.

Ese momento es todo el juego. Y nunca cansa.

UN RATO SOLO PARA TI
Sin cronómetro. Sin puntuación. Sin anuncios que te interrumpan. Solo colores suaves que cambian con cada puzzle, una música que nunca suena igual dos veces y el pequeño placer de ver cómo algo plano se vuelve sólido.

FÁCIL DE EMPEZAR, DIFÍCIL DE SOLTAR
No hay nada que leer: un dedo fantasma te enseña el primer trazo y, a partir de ahí, todo se entiende solo. Empiezas con piezas pequeñas de 3×3 y, casi sin darte cuenta, acabas descifrando estructuras de 6×6 que al principio parecían imposibles.

LO QUE TE ESPERA
• Puzzles sin fin: cada pieza nace en el momento en que la pides.
• Cuatro niveles que se abren a medida que tu mirada se afina.
• Un puzzle diario, el mismo para todo el mundo. ¿Cuántos días aguanta tu racha?
• Tu vitrina: cada pieza resuelta se guarda, con su color, para volver a girarla cuando quieras.
• Tres pistas al día, para cuando una arista se resiste.
• Funciona sin conexión, sin cuentas y sin recoger ningún dato.
• En español, inglés, portugués, francés, alemán e italiano.

PARA QUIÉN ES
Para quien disfruta de los rompecabezas tranquilos, el dibujo técnico o la geometría. Y para quien solo busca diez minutos de calma y concentración al final del día.

Tres vistas. Una pieza. Todo el tiempo del mundo.

name: Heliora
description:
Heliora is een puzzel met een geschilderd oogstrad en tien symbolen: vruchten, kustvondsten, bel en knoop.

Vijf kusten wachten op je, elk met zes bestellingen. Voor je draait kies je Honing, Bries of Klank, of laat je het rad zonder houding draaien. Verzamel wat de bestelling vraagt voordat je beurten op zijn.

Na elke beurt in een opdracht volgt een korte controlevraag over de cijfers op het scherm. Goed antwoord: extra punten.

Oefenen heeft geen einde. De dagelijkse bestelling is één per dag. Relikwieën en zegels helpen bij latere rondes. Het album vult zich met symbolen die gevallen zijn.

Een rustige eilandstijl, heldere regels in het schrift, sterren als je sluit binnen de grens. Gratis. Geen advertenties, geen account.

name: Helioveil
description:
Helioveil is a local astronomy companion for outdoor observation and learning. From latitude, longitude, and time, it simulates a horizontal sundial shadow and shows solar altitude, azimuth, and the day’s path across the sky.

Dial
Watch the gnomon shadow for now or a scrubbed hour on a stone-toned plate. Optional hour rays and compass heading help align on-screen shadow with the real world.

Orbit
Follow how altitude and azimuth change through the day, and see how shadow bearing and sun bearing move together.

Places
Pick a city or custom coordinates, or use your current location while in use—switch sites whenever you like.

Notes
Capture a remark and thumbnail for a moment of light, useful for balconies, camps, and travel logs.

Lore
Short explainers on standard time vs true solar time and the geometry behind the dial.

Tune
Set gnomon height, compass, and display options. Everything stays in on-device Documents—no accounts, no uploads, no ad tracking.

For anyone who loves sundials, light and shadow, field orientation, and basic astronomy—celestial geometry, made tangible.
