name: HerSpace – Your Journal
description:
HerSpace is a softer place to come back to yourself. It keeps your notes, diary, plans, and little pieces of life on this iPhone. There is no account, no cloud, and nothing you write is uploaded.

YOUR DAY
Home greets you by name and time of day. See your streak, habits, water, and open to-dos, then check in with a mood. A diary card asks how the day felt, and a joy jar holds the good moments so you can pull one later.

SELFIE DIARY
Take a photo or choose one you already have. Add a mood and a few words. Look back over the week, your entries, and a mood board. The pictures stay on this phone.

MYSTERY BOX
Write a wish, seal it, and choose the day it opens. It stays hidden until then, whether that is New Year or a date you pick.

NOTES
Capture a thought, a checklist, or a longer page. Pin what matters, mark favourites, use folders and templates, and search when you need it again. Speak a note and fix the line before you save. Scan a page into a PDF you can search on the device.

SPACES
One calm list for each part of your life.
• Write: journal and notes
• Diary: entries and moods
• Plan: planner, to-do, habits, and a focus timer
• Care: cycle, health, self-care, and a beauty shelf
• Life: money, dreams, important dates, a wishlist, and memory boards
• Private: a vault for notes you want kept apart

Cycle logs, doses, and self-care notes are personal records you keep for yourself. They are not medical advice, a diagnosis, or a prediction you should rely on for treatment.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
HerSpace does not have a server. Notes, photos, and recordings are encrypted on this iPhone. Lock the app with a password, and use Face ID if you turn it on. A backup is a file you create and keep yourself, sealed with a password you choose. Delete the on-device account from Settings when you want it gone. There is no remote copy to erase.

Made for an ordinary day, not a perfect one.

name: Hidook: afaceri din diasporă
description:
Hidook adună într-un singur loc afacerile, restaurantele și evenimentele moldovenilor din diasporă. Găsești un contabil, un transportator, o firmă de catering sau un restaurant cu gust de acasă, vorbești cu ei în română și îi contactezi direct din aplicație.

Caută după serviciu și oraș
Scrii ce ai nevoie, de la „contabil” la „transport colete”, și vezi afacerile care lucrează în orașul tău sau online, oriunde în țară. Le poți filtra după domeniu: servicii, IT și marketing, comerț, sănătate, restaurante.

Totul pe hartă
Harta arată afacerile, restaurantele și evenimentele din jurul tău. Dacă îi dai voie, aplicația folosește locația doar pe telefon, ca să-ți arate ce e aproape.

Contactezi direct
Pe pagina fiecărei afaceri ai telefonul, WhatsApp-ul, emailul și site-ul, serviciile și zona în care lucrează. Afacerile marcate „Verificat” au fost confirmate de echipa Hidook.

Restaurante și evenimente
Restaurante cu gust de acasă și evenimentele comunității: concerte, spectacole și întâlniri, cu data și locul lor.

Descoperă
Oportunități de colaborare, joburi la afacerile din comunitate, granturi și împrumuturi pentru afacerile mici, firme din Moldova care exportă și articole care te ajută să-ți pornești sau să-ți crești afacerea.

Salvate
Păstrezi afacerile, restaurantele și evenimentele care te interesează și le găsești imediat.

Patru țări
Regatul Unit, Statele Unite, Uniunea Europeană și Canada. Schimbi țara oricând din aplicație.

Ai o afacere în diasporă?
Listarea e gratuită. Intri cu un cod primit pe email, fără parolă, vezi cererile de ofertă și răspunzi la ele, urmărești câți oameni îți văd fișa și îți actualizezi datele și joburile. Primești notificare când îți răspunde cineva.

Întrebări sau sugestii: contact@hidook.co.uk

name: HireSkillz: Tutors & Workers
description:
HireSkillz is the easiest way to hire verified tutors and skilled workers in Bangladesh.

Families and companies use HireSkillz to find:
• Tutors: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, English & IELTS, Bangla, Programming and more, for SSC, HSC, O/A Level and university admission
• Skilled workers: electricians, AC repair, plumbing, home cleaning, drivers, web developers, graphic designers and more

HOW IT WORKS
1. Search and filter pros by category, city, online or in person, hourly rate and verified badge.
2. Check real reviews, experience and rates on every profile.
3. Send a booking request, or post a job and let pros apply.
4. Chat with the pro inside the booking.
5. Pay into escrow. The pro is paid only after you mark the job complete.
6. Leave a review to help others choose.

FOR TUTORS AND WORKERS
• Create a free profile with your skills, experience and hourly rate
• Get booking requests and apply to new jobs
• Track bookings and earnings on your dashboard

SAFE AND SIMPLE
• Sign in with Apple or Google, or with email
• Verified pros and honest reviews
• Escrow-protected payments
• Delete your account any time from your profile

Website: https://hireskillz.com
Support: support@hireskillz.com

name: Hiyori Camera
description:
Pick a film, press the shutter, keep today.

Hiyori Camera brings the joy of shooting film to your phone: choose your film first, then take your time. The colors you see in the viewfinder are exactly what you get.

8 ORIGINAL FILMS
Warm Portrait, Fresh Days, Street Memory, Vivid Scenery, Retro Years, Instant Days, Classic B&W and Fine B&W. Every look was made by Hiyori Camera, and each one tells you what it's great for — no settings to learn.

FILM CANISTER PICKER
Swipe through the canisters. The one in the middle is today's film.

COMPARE
Can't decide? The viewfinder splits into nine tiles so you can see all 8 films on the scene in front of you. Tap one to load it.

REAL FILM TEXTURE
Grain, vignetting and halation, plus optional light leaks and a date stamp. Every photo comes out with a paper border, like a fresh print.

PRINT AND DEVELOP
Press the shutter and watch your photo feed out with a motor whirr, then slowly develop.

RETRO BODY
A leather-textured body, brushed-silver top plate and a satisfying shutter button.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up, no internet, no ads, no data collected. Your photos stay on your phone.

Available in English, Japanese, Korean, and Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

name: HobbyPoster
description:
HobbyPoster, arkadaşlarla tek telefonda oynanan bir anime imposter oyunu. Herkes aynı kelimeyi görür; imposter ise kelimeyi bilmez, yalnızca küçük bir ipucu alır. Telefonu sırayla verin, herkes kartına gizlice baksın. Sonra kelimeyi tek kelimeyle anlatın, imposter'a çaktırmayın ve oylamayla aranızdaki blöfçüyü bulun.

Neler var?
• 3 ile 12 kişi arası, tek telefon yeter.
• İnternet ya da hesap gerekmez.
• 160'tan fazla anime ve karakter kelimesi.
• İmposter sayısı, ipucu, tartışma süresi ve oylama ayarları.
• Rastgele ilk konuşan ve saat yönünde sıra.

Premium
• Sınırsız oyun: günde 2 oyun sınırı kalkar.
• 5 kategori daha: Romantik komedi, İsekai, Spor, Gerilim ve Efsaneler.
• Gizli ajan modu: imposter benzer ama farklı bir kelime alır, kendisi de bilmez.
• Film ve dizi paketleri geldiğinde onlar da dahil.

Kullanım koşulları: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Gizlilik politikası: https://bugra-filik.github.io/hobbyposter/gizlilik/

name: Holy Bible పరిశుద్ధ గ్రంథము
description:
పరిశుద్ధ గ్రంథము — తెలుగు బైబిలు

పూర్తి తెలుగు బైబిలును (66 గ్రంథాలు) చదవండి, వినండి, దేవుని వాక్యంతో ప్రతిరోజు నడవండి. ఇంటర్నెట్ లేకుండానే పనిచేస్తుంది.

• చదవడం: అందమైన తెలుగు అక్షరాలు, అక్షరాల పరిమాణం, రాత్రి మోడ్, ఎరుపు అక్షరాల్లో యేసు మాటలు, English (KJV) తో పక్కపక్కనే.
• వినడం: ఫోన్ తెలుగు స్వరంలో అధ్యాయం మొత్తం వినండి — వేగం, స్వరం, నిద్ర టైమర్.
• వెతకడం: తెలుగులో, English లో, లేదా "prema" లాంటి English అక్షరాలతో తెలుగు పదాలు. "యోహాను 3:16" అని టైప్ చేస్తే అదే వచనానికి వెళ్తుంది.
• నేటి వాక్యం: ప్రతిరోజు ఒక వాక్యం, ఉదయం సాయంత్రం గుర్తు చేయడం.
• ప్రార్థనలు: వారంలోని రోజుకు, పండుగకు (మంచి శుక్రవారం, ఈస్టర్, క్రిస్మస్…) తగిన ఉదయ రాత్రి ప్రార్థనలు; సందర్భానికి తగిన ప్రార్థనలు; మీ ప్రార్థన పుస్తకం.
• ప్రసంగాలు: అంశం ఎంచుకొని ప్రసంగం సిద్ధం చేయండి; సిద్ధమైన ప్రసంగ ప్రణాళికలు.
• బైబిలు వ్యక్తులు: 84 మంది జీవితం, బలాలు, బలహీనతలు, పాఠాలు.
• పఠన ప్రణాళికలు: సంవత్సరంలో బైబిలు, 90 రోజుల్లో క్రొత్త నిబంధన, ఇంకా.
• నా బైబిల్: బుక్‌మార్క్‌లు, హైలైట్‌లు, నోట్స్, పఠన చరిత్ర, బ్యాకప్.
• దగ్గరలోని చర్చిలు: మీ చుట్టూ ఉన్న చర్చిలు, దూరం, దారి.
• యాప్ మీరు ఆపిన చోటే మళ్ళీ తెరుచుకుంటుంది.

The complete Telugu Bible with English (KJV) side by side — read, listen, search in Telugu or English, a daily verse, morning and night prayers for each day and church festival, a sermon builder, profiles of 84 Bible people, reading plans, bookmarks, highlights and notes, and nearby churches. Works offline. No ads, no sign-up.

Privacy Policy URL (App Privacy page): https://nareshpodi-dev.github.io/telugu-holy-bible/privacy.html

name: HomeLedger
description:
Keep a practical care record for your household equipment.

• Save device names, rooms, model details and consumable specifications.
• Set maintenance intervals and review upcoming dates.
• Record completed work with dates, notes and costs.
• Review service history and undo the last entry added.
• Export an equipment CSV or JSON backup; restore compatible backups.
• Enable optional local notifications for the next 60 due devices.

Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Core records work offline. Intervals are reminders you choose. Follow manufacturer instructions and qualified servicing advice.

name: Hook & Haul
description:
Hook & Haul is a one-tap arcade fishing game. Your pirate ship floats at the top of the screen, the hook swings on its chain like a pendulum, and you tap to drop it at just the right moment.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Each dive lasts 60 seconds. Tap the water to drop the hook, catch something, and it reels back to the ship.
• Every creature shows its ticket value. Minnows are quick and cheap; swordfish, golden koi and treasure chests are worth far more.
• Hit a fish dead centre for a PERFECT bonus.
• Land catches in a row to build a combo of up to ×3. A miss or a jellyfish sting resets it.
• Fill the Tide Meter to set off Golden Tide: ten seconds of double tickets.
• Pop a pearl bubble for five extra seconds. The last ten seconds are a feeding frenzy.

WATCH OUT
• Jellyfish stun your hook.
• Sharks are worth a lot, but they fight the line and can cut it.
• In Kraken Deep, hook the Kraken twice to beat it for a big bonus.

THREE POWER-UPS PER DIVE
• Wide Net: your next drop catches up to three.
• Freeze Tide: every fish stops for five seconds.
• Loot Magnet: fish drift towards your hook.

FIVE COVES TO UNLOCK
Shallow Reef, Sunken Galleon, Shark Alley, Kraken Deep and Golden Tide. Each has its own sky, water colours, speed and mix of creatures. Beat a cove's target to earn up to three stars and open the next one.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• A daily tide changes the rules: calmer water, faster fish, richer reefs or a wilder swing.
• Three daily challenges pay out bonus doubloons.
• Keep a day streak going.

HIRE A CREW
Spend the doubloons you earn on four crew members. Each one gives a permanent perk, such as faster reeling, longer dives or more golden koi.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
• No ads, no sign-in and no in-app purchases. Tickets and doubloons are game points only and have no real-world value.
• Your progress is saved on your device. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
• All artwork is original and drawn in the game itself.
• Sound effects can be muted from the home screen.

name: Hourslab
description:
Hourslab turns your day into a strip you can hold. Hours run left to right across the screen like a ruler, and your plans are coloured blocks you drag into place. Turn your iPhone sideways and the whole day fits in view.

PLAN ON A STRIP, NOT A LIST
Every hour sits on a horizontal ruler with quarter-hour ticks. Tap any open time to drop a block there, or tap + for the next free slot. Drag a block to move it, pull the edges of a selected block to make it longer or shorter, and let go: it snaps cleanly to the nearest 15 minutes. Overlapping plans stack into their own lanes, so nothing hides behind anything else. A coral now-line walks through today so you always know where you are.

AN UNSCHEDULED TRAY
Not everything has a time yet. Park tasks in the tray with a category and how long they need, then carry one onto the strip by its grip when a gap opens, or send it to the next free slot in one tap. Changed your mind about a block? Drag it back into the tray.

REPEATS AND TEMPLATES
Make any block repeat on chosen weekdays: standups on weekdays, the gym on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Lift a single occurrence off one day without touching the series. Save a day you liked as a template, or build one from scratch, and stamp a whole day's shape onto any date in one move: a deep-work Monday, a meeting-heavy Tuesday, a light Friday.

REVIEW YOUR WEEK
Mark blocks done as you go. Review adds up planned against done for the week, per category and per day, with your hit rate and busiest day, so you can see where the hours really went.

YOUR CATEGORIES
Focus, Meetings, Admin, Breaks and Personal are ready to use. Rename them, add your own, and give each a colour and a drawn mark.

OPTIONAL START ALERTS
Turn on block start alerts and Hourslab sends a local notification as each block begins. With the app open you'll hear a short rising chime instead.

MADE TO FEEL CALM
Three themes (Fresh Paper, Night Owl and Sage Day), soft sound effects and light haptics, each with its own switch. Reduce Motion is respected.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Start straight away with "Plan today first", with no sign-up needed. Create an account with email and password or Sign in with Apple to sync your plans, and keep a guest planner any time from Bench with "Keep my plans". Everything works offline and syncs when you're back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your plans are stored in your own account and are never shared. You can delete your account and every plan inside the app, from Bench.

name: HouseStage Vision
description:
Stand inside your new home before the furniture arrives.

HouseStage Vision opens the home you bought through 126 Design and puts you in its rooms at real size on Apple Vision Pro.

• Open the private link from your closing card or your designer
• See every room of your home with its real dimensions
• Step into a room at true scale, fully immersive or blended with your surroundings
• See where each piece of your design proposal sits, shown as a labeled volume at its real size
• Move from room to room to check walkways, clearances and proportions

Use it together with HouseStage on iPhone, where you review the proposal, message your designer and follow deliveries.

HouseStage is by invitation. You need the private link from your 126 Design closing card or your designer. A sample home is included so you can try it first.

name: Huiting: Meeting Notes
description:
Huiting is a meeting recorder for Mandarin Chinese. The interface is in Simplified Chinese only.

• Live text while recording: see what's being said and bookmark the current sentence with one tap. Recording continues when the screen is locked.
• On-device transcription with Apple's built-in speech recognition. Your audio never leaves your iPhone.
• AI minutes powered by DeepSeek, with a free monthly allowance and no sign-up: overview, decisions, to-dos, open questions, risks and discussion points. Tap the play button after any point to read and replay the exact words it came from.
• Glossary for names and product terms, with visible, traceable corrections.

Please note:
• Interface and speech recognition support Simplified Chinese only. Requires iOS 26 or later.
• No account or sign-up. AI minutes include a free monthly allowance.
• When you generate minutes, the transcript (not the audio) is forwarded to DeepSeek by Huiting's service, which does not store it. The app explains this and asks for consent before the first time; you can choose to be asked every time. DeepSeek stores data in China under its own privacy policy.
• No accounts, ads or analytics.
• Inform participants before recording and follow local law.

name: Hullforge
description:
Build a ship. Boost it. Watch it fight.

Hullforge is a space autobattler where the fight is won before it starts. Forge your ship on a grid, pick modules that make each other stronger, then send it into a fast, explosive battle against bots or the fleets of other players.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start with a tiny hull and grow it cell by cell
• Spend gold in the shop on lasers, missile launchers, kinetic guns, plasma cannons and shield generators
• Place boosters next to your weapons: autoloaders, belt feeds, focusing lenses and plasma tanks power up the weapons they touch
• Refresh the shop for 1 coin when you are hunting for the perfect module
• Drag modules and hull cells around to fine-tune your build between rounds
• Battles play out automatically. Win 10 of them before you run out of lives

SYNERGY IS EVERYTHING
Two lenses beside a laser, a belt feed beside a kinetic gun, a tank beside a plasma cannon: stack them and a simple ship turns into a monster. Armor plates cover your weak spots, shield generators soak up the first hits, and where you place the core decides how long your ship survives.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• New Run: face smart bots on Easy, Normal or Hard. Works fully offline
• Online: face ships built by other players. No matchmaking queue and no waiting, their builds are ready when you are, and a bot steps in if nothing fits

FAST AND SPECTACULAR
• Piercing beams, missile salvos, plasma blasts, shield breaks and chain-reaction explosions
• Every battle is over in under a minute. If time runs out, the ship with the healthier hull wins
• Music and sound effects with their own on/off switches

YOUR CALLSIGN
Fly under a generated callsign like "Omega Corsair 47", or show your Game Center nickname. Callsigns appear in the language of whoever is looking at them.

name: Hush: Relax Sounds
description:
Hush is a quiet place to build your own background sound.

Pick a few sounds and mix them: rain, ocean, wind, brown noise, pink noise, white noise, birdsong, city life, a neighborhood afternoon or a beach day. Set each one's volume, then shape the whole mix with two sliders. Tone runs from muffled to bright. Texture runs from smooth to grainy.

Color follows sound. Every sound brings its own palette, and the screen blends them as you mix. Rain and ocean turn it dark and cool, birdsong turns it light and green.

Start from a preset when you don't want to choose: Rainy night, Deep focus, Sea breeze, Soft static, Morning walk, Seaside, Street corner or Open window.

Fall asleep to it. Set a sleep timer and the sound fades out slowly. Hush keeps playing with the screen locked, and you can pause it from the lock screen or your headphones.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your mix stays on your phone and is there when you come back.

name: HydroBrim
description:
Log a drink in one tap and watch the glass fill up.

HydroBrim is a simple, private way to keep track of how much you drink. Tap "Pint of water" or "Coffee" and it's logged. The glass on the Today screen fills towards your daily goal, showing water and coffee separately so you can see at a glance how you're doing.

ONE-TAP PRESETS
• Pint and half pint of water
• Coffee and large coffee
• Can of cola and pint of milk
• Any other drink with a custom amount

A GOAL THAT FITS YOU
Set your own daily goal, or let HydroBrim suggest one from your weight and height. Read them from Apple Health or type them in, then choose a goal of 30, 32.5 or 35 ml per kg. Every drink counts towards the goal.

HISTORY
See the last 7 or 30 days as a chart, split by drink, with your daily average and how many days you reached your goal. Each day ends at your local midnight, even when you travel.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in
• No analytics, tracking or advertising
• Works anywhere, including in airplane mode
• Export your whole log as a CSV file at any time

OPTIONAL HOME SERVER
If you like to keep your own data at home, you can run the free HydroBrim server on a computer on your home network. HydroBrim then keeps a copy of your log there whenever your iPhone is on your home Wi-Fi. It's entirely optional: the app works fully without it. Setup guide: smftech.co.uk/hydrobrim/server

HydroBrim gives general guidance only and isn't medical advice.

name: I-5 Buddy
description:
I-5 Buddy is a talking guide for the long drive on Interstate 5 in California. Start it before you pull out, and it tells you about what you're passing: the orchards and farm towns, the mountains and rivers, the history, and the odd little stories most people drive right by.

Set it up before you drive. Narration is hands-free; leave the screen to passengers.

HOW IT WORKS
Tap Start GPS before you pull out. Before each landmark you hear a soft chime and a heads-up that says how far away it is and where to look: "In about 2 miles, on your right..." Want the longer story? A passenger can tap Tell me more.

Not on the road yet? Tap Demo drive on the first screen. I-5 Buddy pretends to drive for you, so you can hear how it works from the couch.

ALL 797 MILES, MEXICO TO OREGON
• 375 landmarks, each with its story and a source you can check, most with a photo
• The landscape as it changes, with notes for the time of year, big climbs and the halfway point
• Three levels of chattiness, from Big stuff to Story time
• "What's on my left?" and "What's on my right?" for curious passengers
• Gas, EV charging, food, lodging and rest areas coming up
• Pick where you're headed and see the miles, time and landmarks to go

LIVE ROAD INFO (OPTIONAL)
Turn it on for crashes and closures ahead from the California Highway Patrol and Caltrans, National Weather Service forecasts and warnings, chain controls, freeway sign messages and live Caltrans cameras. When a crash or closure is about 10 miles ahead, I-5 Buddy tells you once. It's off until you turn it on, and it needs a connection.

ROAD AHEAD AND MAPS
• Road ahead: a chart of the hills in front of you, with the climb, the top and the steepest grade
• A map of the whole road with every landmark, camera and rest area
• A 3D terrain map that follows your ride, with a Fly the road preview of the next 30 miles (needs a connection)

FOR THE PASSENGERS
• Passport: a stamp for every landmark you pass, plus regions, badges and a trip log
• Pick your ride: eight illustrated vehicles in eight colors, with a badge and a nickname
• Road bingo, road trivia, and I spy challenges for passengers
• Share a landmark, or the app, with a friend

WORKS WHERE THE SIGNAL DOESN'T
The stories, photos and road data come with the app, so narration keeps going through dead zones.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. No ads and no tracking. Your location is used on your iPhone, only while the app is open, to find your place on I-5. Your exact position isn't saved or sent to us. Your trips, stamps and settings stay on your phone.

GOOD TO KNOW
• I-5 Buddy covers Interstate 5 in California only.
• Keep the app open on screen during the drive. A car charger helps on long trips.
• It's a guide to what's around you, not turn-by-turn navigation.
• I-5 Buddy is independent and not affiliated with Caltrans, the CHP or the National Weather Service.

Made by Dominares in San Diego. We read every message: tap Send feedback in Settings, or write to support@dominares.org.

name: Iberis
description:
IBERIS — Your World of Cinema.

Discover films, series and short films in one cinematic streaming experience. Find your next favorite story, explore a growing catalogue and enjoy entertainment designed around you.

DISCOVER MORE
Explore movies, series and short films across different genres. Browse recommendations, discover new stories and save your favorites to My List.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Continue watching your favorite titles without losing your place. Enjoy a personalized home screen that keeps your entertainment close.

YOUR PROFILES, YOUR EXPERIENCE
Create individual viewing profiles, organize your watchlist and enjoy a personalized experience for different members of your household.

WATCH IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Choose your preferred app language and customize subtitle and audio preferences where supported by the content.

WATCH TOGETHER
Movie nights are better together. Create a private viewing room, invite friends using a link or invitation code, and experience synchronized playback with up to eight viewers on eligible titles.

DISCOVER FILMMAKERS
Explore the creative people behind the stories. Discover filmmaker credits, learn about independent creators and explore IBERIS Creator Studio, where filmmakers can prepare their work for review.

BUILT FOR CINEMA LOVERS
Enjoy a dark, cinematic interface, intuitive navigation and a personalized streaming experience designed for discovering great stories.

Whether you're discovering a new film, continuing a favorite series or sharing a movie night with friends, IBERIS brings the experience together.

Welcome to IBERIS.

Content availability, audio languages and subtitles may vary by title and region. Account registration and an eligible membership may be required to watch content.

name: IGCReplay
description: IGCReplay is full fledged Vision Pro app that takes the user through a 3D model of a recorded glider flight. The app replays any standard IGC file and includes realistic terrain. In addition, the user has access to important statistics for the flight.

name: Ignite Intelligence
description:
Ignite Intelligence is the training and testing platform from Ignite Athletics, built around one goal: understanding what drives your athletic performance and improving it.

Every athlete is fast, powerful, or strong in their own proportions. The things holding you back are specific to you. Ignite measures them, shows them to you plainly, and builds the plan to turn your weaknesses into strengths.

TEST
• Film your jumps, sprints, and throws with your phone and get measured results
• Guided capture for countermovement jump, broad jump, sprint splits, change of direction, and more
• Every result saved with honest confidence labels, so you always know how much to trust a number

KNOW
• Your Intelligence profile: personal bests, trends, and benchmarks against other Ignite athletes
• See your profile across jump, speed, strength, and change of direction, and find the specific deficits that matter most for you

TRAIN
• Follow the program your coach built, targeted at what your testing revealed
• Log sets, reps, and loads as you go; your history builds automatically
• Retest, see the change, and let the next block target what is still lagging

Ignite Intelligence accounts are set up through your coach or training program. Built in Saskatoon by Ignite Athletics. Measure everything. Assume nothing.

name: illerle: Türkiye Harita Oyunu
description:
Memleketini bilirsin. Peki oraya nereden gidilir?

illerle, Türkiye haritası üzerinde oynanan bir rota bulmacasıdır. Sana iki il verilir: aradaki yolu, komşu illerden geçerek sen kurarsın. Bazen bir il de yasaklanır, onu dolaşman gerekir.

NASIL OYNANIR
• Aradaki illerden birini yaz.
• Renk sana yön verir: yeşil yoldasın, turuncu biraz saptın, kırmızı çok uzaktasın.
• En kısa yolu bulursan rota kusursuz biter.

HER GÜN YENİ ROTA
Günün rotası herkese aynıdır ve gece yarısı yenilenir. Kaç tahminde bulduğunu arkadaşlarınla paylaş, günlük sıralamada yerini gör, serini bozma.

DOYMAYANA SINIRSIZ OYUN
Günün rotası bitince sınırsız rota seni bekler. Edirne'den Kars'a, Sinop'tan Hatay'a, 81 ilin hepsi sırada.

NELER VAR
• Günlük rota ve geçmiş günlerin takvimi
• Sınırsız oyun
• Günlük ve tüm zamanlar sıralaması
• Arkadaşına meydan okuma
• Takıldığında üç ipucu: ülke sınırı, sıradaki ilin şekli, anahtar kelime
• Hesap açmak yok, reklam yok

Hangi il hangi ile komşu? Kendi memleketinin komşularını sayabilir misin? Oyna, haritayı ezberine al.

name: Inclusive Color
description:
This application allows you to simulate how different types of color vision appear.

You can apply various color vision filters to the camera feed or the entire screen and view the results in real time. You can also apply similar filters to videos and images.

This application includes the following features:
・Various color vision filters
・Real-time display and recording of the camera feed
・Real-time display and recording of the entire screen
・Filter level adjustment
・Color filters
・Color vision filters
・Exporting filtered videos and images

name: Inheritance Feud
description:
Your grandfather left behind a 15-million-lira estate. Now everyone wants a share.

The family has gathered in the old house. Every relative has a claim, a secret, or a reason to make a deal. And just because someone trusts you, it doesn’t mean they’ll back your claim.

You have three moves a day for seven days. Talk to seven characters, stake claims on five assets, weigh counteroffers, and search the house for evidence. Keep a discovery to yourself, confront a relative in private, or put it on the table for everyone to hear.

Six family scenarios change who wants what. Your decisions lead to one of six endings. Play in Turkish or English, pick up where you left off, and compare the outcomes of completed games in your history.

name: Inklet Descent
description:
Inklet Descent is a 3D horror survival game. Ride the elevator down into Inkwell Studios, floor by floor, and step out into a real 3D studio you walk through in first person.

On each floor, find the Reel Machines and solve their puzzles — stop the needle in the zone, and from Floor 2, repeat the machines' light patterns from memory. But you're not alone down there: the Inkblots, ink-corrupted toons with glowing red eyes, patrol the rooms and chase you on sight. A botched puzzle screeches and calls them straight to you. Manage your 3 hearts and your stamina, finish the floor's machines, and get back to the elevator before they get you.

Every visit opens with "The Story So Far," a short animated cutscene about how a spilled ink pot created the first Inkblot — then the splash screen, the loading screen, and the 3D lobby. Three more cutscenes wait inside the game: earn them by starting Floor 1, riding down to Floor 2, and being spotted by an Inkblot for the first time, then replay any of them anytime from the lobby's Cutscenes gallery.

Choose from 5 unlockable Inklets — Pip, Mabel, Sprocket, Bubbles and Zippy — each with their own stats and a special ability: dash, heal, machine overclock, shield, or speed boost. Earn Reels on every run to spend in the elevator shop on bandages, choco bars and smoke bombs. Every 4th floor is a blackout floor — bring your nerve and your flashlight.

Play as a guest instantly, or sign in free to save your unlocks in the cloud. Your Inklet Descent account is yours for this game only — each of our games has its own separate sign-in. Full sound effects and a spooky music-box loop, with a mute toggle in settings. The game is landscape-only — turn your phone sideways.

Powered by PostMePlex · Created by Semidiepie

name: Instant Memo - Photo Notes
description:
Ever kept a photo but forgot why you took it?
With Instant Memo, save the memory along with the photo.

A cafe you loved, a dish you want to eat again, a work site you can't afford to forget. Snap a photo and memo it right away to keep your thoughts from that moment.

• Snap, then memo right away
Write a note the moment you take a photo, and capture the details a photo alone can't hold.

• Busy? Just say it
No time to type? Take a photo and speak. Your voice turns into text for a quick memo.

• Organize neatly with folders
Work, daily life, favorite restaurants, travel. Sort your photo memos into folders by topic.

• Keep them separate from your gallery
Collect work photos and places to remember inside the app. Save any photo to your Photos library when you need it.

• Save and keep shooting
Finish your memo and go straight to the next shot. Keep the flow going even when you have many photos to record.

From the moment you snap to the moment you remember.
Instant Memo.

name: Interactive Periodic Table
description:
Periodic Table & Compound Explorer is a complete, offline chemistry reference built for students, technicians, and anyone who needs fast, reliable element data without an internet connection.

ALL 118 ELEMENTS
Every element on the periodic table, with data reconciled against PubChem — atomic structure, physical and chemical properties, isotopes, and real-world uses. Tap any element for a full breakdown, or use Compare mode to see two elements side by side.

COMPOUND EXPLORER
Look up common compounds and reactions, understand how elements combine, and explore the chemistry behind everyday materials.

HAZARD & SAFETY REFERENCE
An estimated NFPA-704-style hazard diamond for each element gives you an at-a-glance read on flammability, health, and reactivity risk. An interactive storage-compatibility checker helps you understand which materials should never be stored together — ideal for lab work, hazmat handling, or safety training.

FIELD IDENTIFICATION
Quick-reference tools for identifying unknown materials and elements in the field, built with real-world technicians and responders in mind.

LEARNING TOOLS

Flashcards with spaced-repetition study mode to help facts actually stick
Built-in quizzes to test your knowledge
A “Basics” section covering core chemistry concepts, from atomic structure to periodic trends
Visual trend charts for electronegativity, atomic radius, ionization energy, and more

BUILT FOR EVERYONE FROM HIGH SCHOOL TO PROFESSIONAL USE
Whether you’re a student prepping for a chemistry exam, an educator building a lesson, or a professional who needs a dependable field reference, this app scales with you.

100% OFFLINE, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
No internet connection required. No login, no tracking, no ads interrupting your reference lookups. Your data, your device.

CUSTOMIZABLE
Light and dark themes, adjustable text size, and CSV/JSON export so you can take your data wherever you need it.

Whether you’re studying for an exam, working a hazmat shift, or just curious about the elements that make up everything around you, Periodic Table & Compound Explorer puts the entire periodic table — and the safety knowledge that goes with it — in your pocket.

name: Interlinear Bible: Lamp & Path
description:
Lamp & Path is a Bible for reading slowly and studying closely, with an interlinear view of every verse. Four English translations, the cross references between their verses and the Hebrew and Greek words behind them are all on your device. There is no account to create, nothing to download later and no advertising.

READ
• Berean Standard Bible, King James Version, World English Bible and American Standard Version.
• Set like a printed reader's Bible: paragraphs, poetry in lines, section headings, the words of Jesus in red, the translators' italics in the King James.
• Or one verse per line, if you prefer.
• Four themes (Paper, Sepia, Dusk and Night), six typefaces, adjustable size and line spacing.
• Swipe sideways to turn the chapter.

STUDY ANY VERSE
Tap a verse and choose Study.
• Links: cross references in order of relevance, from a set of more than 340,000, drawn as arcs across the whole Bible.
• Words: the verse word by word, as in an interlinear Bible. Every Hebrew, Aramaic or Greek word with its transliteration and the way the Berean Standard Bible translates it. Tap a word for its Strong's dictionary entry and a concordance of the verses where it appears.
• Compare: the verse in all four translations.
• Notes: your own note, next to the translators' footnotes.

SEARCH
• Full-text search that understands word forms: "love" also finds "loved" and "loving".
• Put a phrase in quotes to find it word for word.
• Type a reference such as "jn 3:16" or "ps 23" to go straight there.
• Type a Strong's number such as G26 to open the dictionary.

KEEP WHAT YOU FIND
• Highlight in five colours, write notes, save bookmarks.
• Share a verse as a picture in four styles, or as text.

READ EVERY DAY
• A verse for each day.
• Seven reading plans, from the Gospel of John in three weeks to the whole Bible in a year.
• A reading streak to keep you going.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone or iPad. Lamp & Path has no account, no analytics and no advertising, and it works without a connection.

On iPhones with Apple Intelligence (iOS 26 or later) you can also ask a question about a verse. The answer is written on the device from the passage, its cross references and its original words. Nothing is sent anywhere.

SOURCES
Berean Standard Bible and Berean Interlinear data: public domain (berean.bible). King James Version, World English Bible and American Standard Version: public domain, prepared by eBible.org; Crown rights apply to the King James Version in the United Kingdom, and "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org. Cross references: OpenBible.info, CC BY. Strong's dictionaries: Open Scriptures, CC BY-SA.

name: Isbricka: Mahjong Solitaire 3D
description:
Isbricka is mahjong solitaire carved in ice.

Tap two free tiles with the same picture and they crack, shatter and fall away. Clear every tile to finish the deal. The tiles stand as a small tower on a turntable: swipe to turn it and find the pairs on the far side.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: tap two matching free tiles.
• Rack: take one tile at a time to a rack of four; when its partner joins it, both shatter.

THE TILES
A Nordic set made for this game: a Dala horse, lingonberries, an elk, a spruce, the northern lights, a red cottage, a longship and more. Choose how they look: carved and inked, painted in Swedish folk art, or as naturalist plates. Every picture stays large, clear and upright however you turn the tower.

YOUR PHOTOS
Put your own photos on the tiles: pick the ones you like, or let the game choose new ones from your library for every deal. Your photos stay on your device and are never sent anywhere.

MADE TO RELAX
• Every deal can be solved. Always.
• Hint, undo and shuffle are free and unlimited.
• No timer, no lives, no waiting. When no pair is left, shuffle and carry on.
• Free tiles glow softly, so you never hunt for what can be tapped.
• Quick matches build a combo.
• Three sizes: 36, 72 or 144 tiles.

DAILY DEAL
One new deal every day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going, see your month in the calendar, and copy your result to share it.

FOR EVERY SCREEN
iPhone, iPhone Duo folded or open, iPad and Mac, upright or on its side.

NOTHING ELSE
No ads. No purchases. No account. Nothing about you is collected, and the game works offline.

Isbricka is made by Luminbrane in Stockholm.

name: J-17 Poly Synth
description:
BORN IN 1984, RAISED IN THE FIELD

One page of faders makes the sound: source, filter, amp — four voices,
one envelope each, 1984 rules. But the oscillator is yours now: splice a
sound you caught in the world and the keys play it as the voice. The
pattern catches your notes so the sound stays live under your hands, and
everything you play lands on a rolling tape you can rewind, slice and
keep.

WHO IT IS FOR
Players, producers and writers who want one synth they can learn with
their hands, and sounds nobody else has.

THE PANEL
LFO; DCO with pulse, saw, sub and noise; a stepped HPF; the resonant VCF
with envelope and key follow; one ADSR; VCA; and a chorus thick enough to
swim in. Every voice drifts a little on its own — the vintage is built
in, not a switch. Factory patches to stand on; yours save by name and
travel as files.

THE SPLICE
Import any recording — a voice memo, a door hinge, a street — or point
the phone at a sound and the mic records straight onto the bench. Snag
the stretch between IN and OUT and splice it onto the panel. The app
listens first: it hears the recording's pitch and tunes the keyboard to
it, takes its attack into the envelope, loops it if it sustains. Then
the splice's own voice: WOW is tape wander, GRIT is the old-sampler
crush, WANDER sends the loop walking through the recording. The whole
panel still applies on top.

THE KEYS
Thirteen keys upright, twenty-five sideways. Velocity from where you
strike the key. HOLD, an arpeggiator, GLIDE, POLY or SOLO, and TILT —
lean the phone back and the filter opens. KEY lights a scale on the
keybed; LISTEN hears the key of what is playing in the room. It
suggests; it never locks. External MIDI keyboards bring their own
velocity.

THE PATTERN
A roll above the keys: tap to place a note, drag for level and length,
eight slots, and LINK plays the filled ones in order as a song. REC
counts you in and catches what you play.

THE TAPE
Always rolling. Rewind, set IN and OUT, and EXPORT writes everything it
knows — the WAV, the notes as MIDI, the patch beside it.

ALSO AN AUDIO UNIT
J-17 installs as an AUv3 instrument, splices included, in GarageBand,
Logic or AUM.

Takes and patches live in Files and in your own iCloud. Nothing is
uploaded. There is no account.

name: Jaka To Piosenka? Zgadnij hit
description:
Zgadnij piosenkę po pierwszych taktach i zagraj o 50 000 zł w finale!

„Jaka To Piosenka?” to quiz muzyczny i teleturniej w Twoim telefonie. Światła, scena, buzzer i ponad 550 przebojów: polskie hity i światowe klasyki od lat 60. do dziś. Słuchasz, naciskasz WIEM! i wybierasz tytuł, zanim zrobi to rywal.

CZTERY RUNDY JAK W PRAWDZIWYM TELETURNIEJU
• Runda 1 · Pierwsze takty – kto pierwszy naciśnie WIEM!, ten zgaduje.
• Runda 2 · Wybór kategorii – tablica z kategoriami i kwotami: polskie przeboje, zagraniczne hity, lata 80., 90., 2000…
• Runda 3 · Licytacja – w ilu nutach zgadniesz piosenkę? Licytuj odważnie, ale pomyłka kosztuje.
• Finał – siedem piosenek w 60 sekund i drabinka wygranych aż do 50 000 zł.

GRAJ ZE ZNAJOMYMI ALBO Z AI
• Od 1 do 3 graczy na jednym telefonie – idealna gra muzyczna na imprezę.
• Przeciwnicy AI na trzech poziomach: Łatwy, Średni i Trudny.
• Grasz sam? Zmierz się z AI albo zagraj solo.

QUIZ MUZYCZNY NA KAŻDY GUST
• Ponad 550 piosenek: ponad 200 polskich przebojów i ponad 340 zagranicznych hitów.
• Wybierz polskie, zagraniczne albo wszystkie piosenki.
• Wybierz dekady: lata 60., 70., 80., 90., 2000 i 2010.

CODZIENNE WYZWANIE
• Każdego dnia nowe wyzwanie: pięć piosenek z jednej dekady i podwójne punkty doświadczenia za komplet.
• Zdobywaj poziomy, bij swój rekord i sprawdź ranking najlepszych wyników.

DLACZEGO WARTO
• Prawdziwe fragmenty piosenek, nie syntezator.
• Szybkie rozgrywki – jedna gra trwa kilka minut.
• Bez zakładania konta i bez logowania.
• Gra w całości po polsku.

Kwoty w grze to wirtualne punkty – nie da się ich wypłacić ani kupić. Gra zawiera reklamy.

Lubisz zgadywać tytuły w radiu? Znasz każdy refren na pamięć? Zgadnij piosenkę szybciej niż znajomi, naciśnij WIEM! i udowodnij to w muzycznym teleturnieju „Jaka To Piosenka?”.

name: Japanese IT Cert Study
description:
Japanese IT Cert Study helps you study the IT Passport (IP), Information Security Management (SG), Fundamental Information Technology Engineer (FE) and Applied Information Technology Engineer (AP) exams by area. Instead of solving past papers, you understand the concepts that were actually tested, in Japanese, and check them with a translation.

• Four exams, studied by syllabus area: we analyzed 684 public questions across the categories of the IPA syllabi. Each area shows how it is tested and how many questions come from each year.
• 258 concept cards: each explains a concept that appeared in past questions and describes how it is tested and highlights answer choices that are easy to confuse (exam points). Calculation questions include the steps. Related questions are listed by year and number, with links to the official past-paper PDFs.
• All concepts: search the concepts of all four exams in one place and filter by exam and area.
• 500 IT terms: readings, explanations in Japanese, Korean and English, and related terms.
• Translation and reading aids: choose hidden, show on tap or always show for translations, and turn on Korean-script pronunciation or romaji under the Japanese text. The display language follows your device by default.
• The app saves which concepts you have marked as understood, along with your bookmarks and progress, on your device. No account or server is needed. The app works offline and has no ads.

Notice: this is an unofficial study app, not affiliated with the Information-technology Promotion Agency, Japan (IPA), and it does not guarantee a pass. Copyright of the past questions belongs to IPA; the app does not include question text or images and refers to questions only by year and number. Concept explanations and translations are original work by the operator. See About in the app for sources and terms.

name: Jelly Block Jive
description:
Welcome to the gel observatory. The specimens on the bench do not jump, roll, or teleport. They move the way gel actually moves, and every calibration is done with your hands.

Jelly Block Jive is not a sliding-block puzzle. Each experiment is a small piece of soft-body physics you can feel.

SHEAR WALK — THE STRIDING BENCH
A two-layer block stands on ceramic tiles. One finger pins the base. A second finger bends the top. Let go of the base and the stored bend becomes a step. The distance depends on how far you sheared, not on a jump button. Slick tiles slip, fragile plates crack, sinking tiles give way, and moving bridges ask you to time the stride.

GEL WRINKLES — THE SHAPING TABLE
The ground itself is a sheet of gel, and a small cargo cube rests on it. Pinch a ridge to push the cube downhill. Spread a valley to catch it. Rest a finger on a wrinkle and it stays; lift the finger and the gel relaxes. A budget limits how much you can reshape, and sensitive bands tear if you force them.

GEL EXCHANGE — THE TWO-CHAMBER PRESS
Mint on one side, coral on the other, a membrane between them. Drag along the membrane to open a gap. Press a chamber and the pressure drives the cubes away from your finger. Starred cubes must cross. Locked cubes must stay. Open the gap too wide and the membrane strains.

A COMPLETE BENCH
• 36 handcrafted levels, twelve in each experiment, all free and retryable.
• A field manual for each experiment, played on the real gel rather than explained in a wall of text.
• Three stars on every level: finish it, stay within the action par, then also beat the time and the mode’s own constraint.
• The specimen shelf: 8 jars, from the Sea Glass Cube to the Observatory Heart.
• Eight medal-tray achievements with real unlock conditions.
• A daily experiment with a modifier, plus a streak across the week.
• Assisted controls for one-finger play, and Reduce Motion when the wobble should calm down.

name: Jellyfish Social
description:
Her sayfanın bir sesi var.

Jellyfish, web'de gezinirken o sayfayı okuyan insanlarla konuşmanı sağlayan bir tarayıcıdır. Bir ürün sayfası, bir haber, bir makale, bir film ya da dizi sayfası: hangisinde olursan ol, sağ alttaki yorum balonuna dokun ve o sayfa hakkında yazılanları anında gör.

Yorumlar sayfanın sahibine değil, Jellyfish kullanıcılarına aittir. Aynı sayfayı açan herkes aynı sohbeti görür.

NELER YAPABİLİRSİN
• Her web sayfasının kendi yorum akışı var: "En iyi" ve "Yeni" sıralamasıyla oku.
• Yorum yaz, yanıtla, beğen. Spoiler içeren yorumları işaretle.
• Yorumunu herkese açık ya da yalnızca arkadaşlarının göreceği şekilde paylaş.
• Henüz kimse yazmadıysa sohbeti sen başlat.
• Arkadaş ekle, bildirimlerini takip et.
• Sık kullandığın siteleri ana sayfana ekle.
• Sekmeler, adres çubuğu, arama önerileri: hızlı ve sade bir tarayıcı.
• Yorumları okumak için giriş gerekmez; yazmak için Apple veya Google ile giriş yaparsın.

GİZLİLİK VE GÜVENLİK
• Reklam yok. Seni uygulamalar ve siteler arasında izlemeyiz.
• Gezinme geçmişin cihazında kalır; hesabına bağlı bir geçmiş tutmayız.
• Giriş, e-posta, bankacılık gibi özel sayfalar yorum sistemine hiç gönderilmez.
• Bir kullanıcıyı engelleyebilir, yorumu bildirebilir, hesabını ve verilerini istediğin an uygulamadan silebilirsin.
• Topluluk Kuralları'na aykırı içerik kaldırılır.

Jellyfish, gezdiğin sitelerle bağlantılı değildir; yorumlar o sitelerin değil, kullanıcıların ifadesidir.

name: Jen Mini by GSR
description:
Jen Mini helps small businesses and creators prepare social media posts in minutes, right on the iPhone.

CREATE YOUR IMAGE
• Pick a photo, crop it to 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9 and rotate it
• Write on it: 18 fonts, colors, size, position and an optional background band
• Export a JPEG and share it, or save it to Photos

CREATE YOUR VIDEO
• Combine up to 50 photos and clips into one MP4
• Set duration, cut and text per scene
• Add licensed background music (CC BY 4.0 / CC0); the credit is added automatically
• One → Four: create 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9 versions one after another

PLAN AND REMIND
• Plan a post and get a local reminder at the time you choose
• Jen Mini never posts for you: you share through the iOS share sheet and confirm with “I posted it”

IDEAS
• Make three text variants from your own words. Templates on the device: no AI, nothing is sent
• Topic Finder suggests current topics by country and sector

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no tracking, no ads
• Photos, videos, projects and plans stay on your iPhone

Jen Mini is made by GSR ANALYTIX.

name: Jingle Squish
description:
Jingle Squish is a cozy Christmas advent calendar full of squishies!

A NEW PRESENT EVERY DAY
From December 1 to December 25, a new present unlocks each day. Tap it, shake it… and pop it open to find a squishy inside. Missed a day? No worries: presents wait for you until January 6. And present 25, on Christmas Day, is always something extra special.

25 PRESENTS, 25 DIFFERENT SQUISHIES
Every calendar holds 25 different squishies, so each day is a brand-new surprise.

COLLECT ALL 66
Soft squishies, stretchy blobs, glittery drops, sweet treats, cute animals, glowing snowmen and more. Each one has a rarity:
• Common
• Uncommon
• Rare
• Legendary
• Mythical
• Celestial
• Godly
Can you find a Godly one? Only 1 present in 100 has one!

SQUISH THEM, STRETCH THEM
Press a squishy to squash it flat with a squelchy sound. Pull it to stretch it, then watch it wobble back into shape.

TRADE WITH FRIENDS
Got two of the same? Swap with a friend!
• Offer a squishy and show your code.
• Your friend scans it and picks a squishy to give back.
• Their squishy pops onto your phone by itself.
Trade side by side, or send your code by message: it still works when you're apart. Every trade is listed in My Trades, so you always know what you gave and what you got.

FRIENDS
Add friends by scanning their friend code, and peek at their collections to see which squishies they've found. Anyone you trade with becomes a friend too. You choose whether friends can see your collection.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• No accounts or sign-up
• No chat

Merry Christmas and happy squishing!

name: JLPT Map: Japanese Grammar
description:
See the entire Japanese language structure at a glance, then break it down piece by piece.

JLPT Map lays out Japanese grammar like a board of cards. Columns hold sentences, phrases, words, writing and politeness. Tap a card to zoom into it: Words opens into verbs, adjectives, nouns and particles, and Verbs opens into groups, forms and patterns.

SEE HOW IT CONNECTS
Every example sentence is split into its pieces. Each piece shows its reading, its romaji and what it is: the topic, the object, a verb form. Tap a piece to jump to the card that explains it.

STUDY AT YOUR LEVEL
Every card is tagged N5 to N4, N3, N2 or N1. Pick a level and the board shows that level and everything easier, so a beginner sees only what they need and an advanced learner sees it all.

VERB FORMS, ORGANISED
Verb forms are grouped by how a godan verb changes: あ段, い段, う段, え段, お段 and the て-form sound changes. Each form has a table of ichidan, godan and irregular examples.

ZOOM OUT
Pinch or tap the magnifying glass to fit a whole board on screen and take it in at once.

- About 125 grammar cards, from です and は to formal written patterns
- Furigana and romaji on every example
- Works offline, no account, no ads

name: Job Noodle
seller_name: Wilde Spire Integrative Coaching Solutions LLC
description:
Job Noodle — The Other Side of the Interview

They’re interviewing you. Interview them back.

A job offer is more than a paycheck. It’s an invitation into an environment that can influence your time, relationships, well-being, and personal development.

Job Noodle helps you evaluate potential employers before accepting an offer.

EVALUATE THE EMPLOYER

Explore 43 guided questions covering workplace culture, leadership, wages, employee treatment, advancement opportunities, and organizational practices.

Record what employers actually say, identify potential concerns, and determine which questions deserve further investigation.

EXPLORE YOUR PERSONAL VALUES

Your Values Compass features 15 reflective questions designed to help you identify what matters most.

Use it independently for personal development or alongside an employer evaluation to explore how well a workplace aligns with your priorities.

COMPARE YOUR OPTIONS

Save employer evaluations and compare opportunities side by side. Examine compensation, workplace expectations, employee experiences, and personal compatibility.

RESEARCH PUBLIC REPUTATION

Record customer and employee review ratings separately, including recurring complaints and concerns.

TAKE JOB NOODLE INTO THE INTERVIEW

Access a printable five-question interview checklist designed to help you ask meaningful questions and document the answers.

Print, save, or share your checklist and assessment results.

THOUGHTFUL DECISIONS START WITH BETTER QUESTIONS.

Job Noodle does not automatically investigate employers or make decisions for you. It helps organize your observations, research, and personal priorities so you can make informed choices.

Developed by Wilde Spire Integrative Coaching Solutions LLC.

name: JobLens
description:
JobLens es la app de fotos y seguimiento de obras para contratistas y compañías de construcción.

Toma fotos desde la obra y quedan guardadas en el proyecto correcto, con fecha, hora y ubicación. Tu equipo ve todo al instante, desde cualquier teléfono.

LO QUE PUEDES HACER
• Proyectos por dirección, con un mapa de todas tus obras
• Fotos con fecha, hora y ubicación, organizadas por etapa: antes, durante y después
• Descripciones, etiquetas y comentarios en cada foto
• Tareas por proyecto con responsable y fecha
• Comparte un proyecto con tu cliente con un enlace: ve las fotos sin descargar nada
• Reportes en PDF para clientes o aseguradoras
• Funciona sin señal: las fotos se suben solas cuando vuelve la conexión
• Invita a tu equipo con su correo y define permisos: administrador, gerente o equipo

HECHA PARA LA OBRA
Botones grandes, pocos pasos y entrada con un código por correo: sin contraseñas que olvidar.

JobLens es una herramienta de trabajo para compañías. Cada compañía tiene su propio espacio privado: solo las personas que invitas ven tus proyectos y fotos.

name: JobsiteHQ: Punch List & Quotes
description:
Walk the job and talk. JobsiteHQ writes the punch list.

Built for contractors, remodelers and handymen who'd rather be working than typing. Record a walkthrough room by room ("Okay, master bath: recaulk the tub, the toilet keeps running...") and JobsiteHQ turns it into a clean punch list you check over before anything is saved.

From there, the rest of the job is a few taps:
• Estimates: turn the punch list into a priced estimate, with suggested starting prices if you want them
• Client approval: send a link and your client approves from their phone
• Change orders when the scope changes
• "On my way" texts to your client
• Invoices in one tap, with materials and your markup
• Get paid online: clients pay by card, straight to your own Stripe account
• Before and after photos, receipts and plan sets, kept with the job
• Client summaries and job reports when the work is done
• A tax-time export of paid invoices and material receipts

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
Basements, new builds, rural jobs: everything saves on your phone and catches up when you're back online.

SPEAKS SPANISH
Record in Spanish, and send each estimate or invoice in English or Spanish.

YOUR RECORDS, BACKED UP
Jobs sync to your account, so a lost or broken phone doesn't take your records with it. Download everything any time.

name: Joyvine: Good News & Quotes
description:
What if scrolling left you feeling better?

Joyvine is an endless feed of small good things, made by hand and laid out on warm cut paper. No strangers, no arguments, no comments. Just swipe up for the next nice thing.

IN THE FEED
• Uplifting quotes and kind little notes, all original
• Actually good news, with real numbers and the source named on every card
• Delightful facts that have been checked
• Clean jokes that make you groan and grin
• Tiny three-line poems about small good moments
• Lovely words from around the world
• Gentle prompts for one small nice thing to do today

LITTLE THINGS TO PLAY WITH
• Unscramble a happy word
• Match the pairs, spot the odd one out, finish the pattern
• Grow a paper flower with a tap
• Take a slow breath with a flower that opens and closes
• Say a kind sentence out loud and watch the card light up

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• A good mix every time you open it, with thousands of cards before anything repeats
• Tap the heart to keep anything that makes you smile, and find it again in Keepsakes
• Share any card as a picture
• Beautiful paper textures, soft colors and playful animation

NO CATCH
• Free
• No ads
• No account, no sign-up
• Nothing is collected. Your keepsakes stay on your phone, and speech is recognized on your device
• Nobody else can post. Everything is written or chosen by us, and we keep it free of politics

Joyvine is for a little joy. It is not therapy or medical advice, and it is not a replacement for professional care.

name: JSPS Danışman: Mülakat & Soru
description:
Jandarma ve Sahil Güvenlik Personel Sınavına (JSPS) hazırlanan uzman erbaş, uzman jandarma, sözleşmeli subay ve astsubaylar için hazırlandı. Konudan mülakata kadar her adım tek uygulamada.

YAPAY ZEKÂ MÜLAKAT ROBOTU
• Komisyon gibi soru sorar; cevabını yaz ya da klavyedeki mikrofonla söyle.
• Cevabını resmî mülakat ölçütlerine göre puanlar: konu hakkında bilgi düzeyi, kendisinden istenileni kavrama, özgüven, ifade etme yeteneği.
• Güçlü yanını ve geliştirmen gereken noktayı söyler, örnek cevap verir.
• Gerçek komisyon gibi cevabına göre takip sorusu sorar.
• Mülakat sonunda rapor ve gelişim grafiği.

RESMÎ KONU LİSTESİ, MADDE MADDE
• Ek-1 konu listesindeki her başlık; kanunlarda listede sayılan her madde özetlendi.
• Özetler mevzuat.gov.tr'deki resmî metinden hazırlandı; sesli dinleyebilirsin.
• Hedef sınavını seç: uzman erbaş, uzman jandarma, sözleşmeli astsubay ya da subay. Subay ve astsubaylar için branş konuları da var.

ZİHİN HARİTALARI
• Her konunun ve her başlığın zihin haritası; konuyu tek bakışta kavra.

SORU BANKASI
• 1.600'ü aşkın soru; her açıklamada dayandığı kanun maddesi yazar.
• Akıllı tekrar: unutmak üzere olduğun soruyu doğru zamanda yeniden sorar.
• Yanlışlarım, favoriler, bilgi kartları ve hap bilgi.

DENEMELER
• Gerçek sınav düzeninde 100 soru, 120 dakika.
• Haftalık Türkiye geneli deneme ve sıralama.
• Meydan oku: arkadaşınla aynı soruları çöz, kim önde görün.

MESLEK BİLGİSİ
• Tutanak ve resmî yazı örnekleri.
• Adli kolluk el kitabı ve meslek rehberleri.
• 2026 trafik idari para cezaları (302 ihlal), aranabilir.

MEVZUAT KÜTÜPHANESİ
• Sınavda sorumlu olduğun kanun ve yönetmeliklerin tam metni: tüm maddelerde ara, oku, dinle.

ANALİZ VE PLAN
• Sınav geri sayımı, günlük plan, çalışma serisi, konu konu ustalık ve deneme başarı eğrisi.
• Açık, koyu ya da otomatik tema.

Önemli: JSPS Danışman bağımsız bir hazırlık uygulamasıdır; Jandarma Genel Komutanlığı, Sahil Güvenlik Komutanlığı ya da herhangi bir kamu kurumuyla bağlantısı yoktur. Resmî duyuru ve güncel mevzuat için ilgili kurumların ve mevzuat.gov.tr'nin sayfalarına bakın. Yapay zekâ puanları tahminidir; gerçek komisyonun değerlendirmesi farklı olabilir.

Destek: support.gepgo@gmail.com

name: Jusber
description:
O Jusber é o sistema de gestão do escritório de advocacia. Com o app, o que você acompanha no computador fica também no celular.

PAINEL DO DIA
Suas demandas abertas, as atrasadas, as publicações a tratar e os processos ativos, logo ao entrar. Logo abaixo, a sua agenda dos próximos 7 dias.

PROCESSOS
Busca pelo número, pela parte ou pelo cliente. Na ficha do processo: as partes, as demandas em aberto, as publicações e os andamentos.

PUBLICAÇÕES
As intimações do escritório, uma linha por intimação, com o texto completo. Marque como lida direto no celular.

DEMANDAS
Prazos, audiências, sessões, reuniões e tarefas: as suas e as do escritório, abertas ou concluídas. Inicie e conclua a demanda pelo app, com uma observação, pelas mesmas regras do escritório: só o responsável conclui.

CLIENTES
A ficha do cliente com os processos dele e o contato à mão: toque para ligar, para abrir o WhatsApp ou para mandar um e-mail.

AVISOS NO CELULAR
Publicação nova nos seus processos, publicação atribuída a você e, de manhã, o que vence hoje. O aviso não mostra o conteúdo da intimação na tela bloqueada: o texto se lê dentro do app, depois da entrada.

SEGURANÇA
Entrada com a mesma conta do Jusber e a mesma verificação em duas etapas. Cada um vê no app só o que já vê no computador, inclusive nos processos sigilosos. A sessão fica guardada no armazenamento seguro do aparelho, e você pode desconectar cada celular em Minha conta.

O app é para quem já usa o Jusber no escritório: a conta é criada pelo escritório, e não pelo app.

name: JustDropped.tv
description:
Just Dropped shows you what's new to stream today, without opening a dozen apps.

• New Anywhere: the season premieres and new movies that just arrived across major streaming services, newest first.
• Upcoming: what's dropping in the next 30 days, so you know what's coming.
• New from shows you love: love a show and Just Dropped surfaces its new episodes the day they land.
• Watchlist: keep track of what you want to watch next.
• Filter by service to see only what's on the services you have.
• Where to watch: see which service carries each title and jump straight to it.
• Pair your TV: link Just Dropped on your TV with a 6-character code.

Browse right away without an account. Sign in to sync your loved shows and watchlist across your phone, TV and the web.

Just Dropped is an independent guide and is not affiliated with any streaming service. A subscription to the relevant service may be required to watch.

name: K-WAVE · KOREA WAVE NEWS
description:
K-pop부터 K-드라마, K-뷰티, K-푸드, 한국 여행까지. 전 세계 한류 팬을 위한 뉴스 KOREA WAVE NEWS를 앱으로 만나세요.

컴백, 공연, 새 드라마와 화제작 소식을 매일 전해 드려요.

회원가입이나 로그인 없이 모든 기사를 볼 수 있어요.

name: K&P - Kraepelin & Pauli Test
description:
K&P is a practice app for the Kraepelin and Pauli tests, the timed column-addition tests used in many aptitude and recruitment assessments.

HOW IT WORKS
• Each column is a list of single digits. Add each pair of neighboring numbers and tap the last digit of the sum: 7 + 8 = 15, so you tap 5.
• Work down the column against a timer. When time runs out, you move to the next column, just like the paper test.
• Keep going until the last column is done.

SEE HOW YOU DID
• Speed in calculations per minute (CPM), for the whole test and for every column.
• Accuracy for the whole test and for every column, so you can see where you slowed down or slipped.
• An overview of each test, and a history of your past games.

MAKE IT YOUR TEST
• 10 to 99 columns and 10 to 99 rows.
• 5 to 99 seconds per column.
• Zoom from 3 to 9 columns on screen.
• Animations on or off.

BUILT FOR FOCUS
• A large keypad made for fast, accurate taps.
• The test pauses by itself if you leave the app, so a phone call doesn't cost you a column.
• Smooth on ProMotion displays, and sized to fit every supported iPhone, including iPhone SE.
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your device.
K&P is a practice tool. It isn't an official psychological assessment and doesn't give a diagnosis or a score from any testing provider.

name: Kacha: Film Camera Sounds
description:
Take the mechanical rituals of film photography with you. Wind the film, feel the detent, and press the shutter. At slow speeds you can listen to the shutter open, pause, and close.

• Try 14 interactive camera bodies, from a two-step twin-lens crank and a motor-drive SLR to a folding instant camera and a large-format field camera.
• Cameras with recorded slow speeds start at their slowest setting. The Focal TLR has five live recordings from 1 second to 1/15 second. A Hasselblad Bulb recording captures one roughly two-second exposure.
• Open Slow Shutter Sounds to compare recordings with a tap. Recording credits are available in the app, and simulated sounds are labeled.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese. Sounds and controls work offline, with no accounts or ads. Kacha simulates camera sounds and controls and does not take photos.

name: Kalender-Widget von Marschner
description:
DEIN PERSÖNLICHER KALENDER
Plane Termine, Geburtstage und Notizen übersichtlich – mit Google-Maps-Routen, Spracheingabe als Text, Systemwecker ab iOS 26 und einem farbigen Home-Bildschirm-Widget.

TERMINE UND GOOGLE-NAVIGATION
Lege Termine mit Datum, Uhrzeit, Namen und Adresse an. Öffne zu einer gespeicherten Adresse die Route in Google Maps und starte dort die Navigation. Farbige Kategorien helfen dir, berufliche und private Einträge auseinanderzuhalten. Für externe Dienste wie Google Maps kann eine Internetverbindung erforderlich sein.

SPRACHEINGABE UND TERMINÜBERNAHME
Diktiere einen Termin oder eine Notiz, statt alles von Hand einzugeben. Deine gesprochenen Worte erscheinen als lesbarer Text. Erkannte Datums- und Zeitangaben können in den Kalendereintrag übernommen werden. Prüfe und bearbeite den Text sowie Datum und Uhrzeit vor dem Speichern. Die direkte Spracheingabe benötigt Mikrofon- und Spracherkennungsberechtigungen sowie ein Gerät mit unterstützter deutscher Spracherkennung auf dem Gerät.

TERMINWECKER UND ERINNERUNGEN
Stelle Erinnerungen vor einem Termin oder einen täglichen Wecker ein. Ab iOS 26 klingeln bestätigte Systemwecker auch bei geschlossener App und gesperrtem iPhone. Erlaube dafür den Weckerzugriff und prüfe die Planungsbestätigung in der App. Terminerinnerungen werden für bis zu 365 Tage vorausgeplant, insgesamt maximal 31 Wecker einschließlich des täglichen Weckers. Öffne den Kalender regelmäßig, um weitere Termine abzugleichen. Der tägliche Wecker wiederholt sich automatisch. Auf älteren iOS-Versionen steht dieser Systemwecker nicht zur Verfügung.

GEBURTSTAGE UND GEBURTSTAGSTON
Geburtstage werden im Kalender hervorgehoben. Die Geburtstags-Hupe kannst du in den Einstellungen anhören. Eine automatische Geburtstagsankündigung bei geschlossener App ist nicht enthalten.

WIDGET MIT FARBWECHSEL
Das Widget zeigt die aktuelle Tageszahl und das Datum. Die Tageszahl wechselt ihre Farbe passend zu den Ereignissen: Rot für Geburtstage, Blau für Immobilien, Gelb für Malerarbeiten und Grün für private Termine. Bei mehreren Kategorien zeigt sie mehrere Farbbänder. Ein Tipp auf das Widget öffnet den Kalender.

NOTIZEN UND PRIVATER TRESOR
Halte wichtige Informationen als Notizen fest. Für persönliche Termine und Notizen gibt es zusätzlich einen separaten, PIN-geschützten und verschlüsselten Tresor.

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN AUF DEINEM GERÄT
Termine, Notizen und Tresorinhalte werden lokal auf deinem Gerät gespeichert. Ein Benutzerkonto, ein Speicherabo oder ein Kalenderserver des Anbieters sind nicht erforderlich. Der Kalender selbst funktioniert ohne Internetverbindung.

SICHERUNG UND WIEDERHERSTELLUNG
Exportiere deine normalen Kalendereinträge und Notizen als Sicherungsdatei an einen Ort deiner Wahl. Mit dieser Datei kannst du die gesicherten Einträge später wiederherstellen. Der private Tresor ist in der normalen Kalender-Sicherung nicht enthalten.

Kalender und iPhone-Widget sind im Kauf enthalten. App-Oberfläche und Spracheingabe sind auf Deutsch.

name: Kamus Bergambar
description:
Kamus Bergambar is a Malay picture dictionary for learners of all ages, with 99 words across ten themes, pictures, English translations and pronunciation.

Choose a theme on Utama (Home), or search for a word. Tap a picture to open its word page. With sound on, an available recording plays once when the page opens. Tap Dengar (Listen) to hear it again, or use Bunyi / Senyap to turn sound on or off.

Four games: Teka gambar (find the picture), Teka nama (name the picture), Susun suku kata (build the word) and Padan (match the pairs). Games bring back words due for review alongside new and less-practised words. Koleksi (Collection) shows earned stickers by theme.

Stars never decrease. There are no timed quizzes, leaderboards or locked lessons. A gated parent area offers settings, detailed progress, activities to do together, privacy information and an optional rest reminder.

Pictures are AI-generated illustrations. Pronunciation uses a computer-generated Malay voice.

name: Kandely Deutsch: Goethe
description:
Your plan for Germany depends on one certificate: A1 to join your family, B1 for an Ausbildung, B2 or C1 to study or work.

You pass the Goethe-Zertifikat with 60%. From B1 upwards you also need 60% in each module: Lesen, Hören, Schreiben, Sprechen. Fail one module and you sit it again, with the fees and the weeks of waiting that come with it.

Kandely Deutsch is a practice app for French-speaking and English-speaking candidates preparing the Goethe-Zertifikat, from A1 to C1.

WHAT YOU DO IN THE APP

• A 12-question placement test that shows where you stand in the four modules, the first time you open the app.

• Sprechen exercises: you record your answer as you would on exam day. It is transcribed, then analysed. You get a score, what works, what costs you points and a rewrite of your own answer.

• Schreiben exercises corrected the same way: score, strengths, recurring mistakes and a corrected example built from your text.

• Lesen and Hören in the exam format, against the clock.

• Mock exams under exam conditions, with a detailed report.

• A learning lock: after a failed mock exam, you first work on your weak module before starting another one.

• A Germany pathway: studies, Ausbildung, Chancenkarte, family reunification, au pair, with the level each project requires.

WHO IT IS FOR

For you if you live in French-speaking or English-speaking Africa and you are preparing a move to Germany. Instructions and explanations are in French or English, your choice. The exercises are in German, as in the exam.

WHAT THE APP DOES NOT DO

Kandely Deutsch is not an exam centre and does not issue certificates. The app is not affiliated with the Goethe-Institut. The exercises are original papers written on the model of the exam.

Your recordings are used to correct your answer. You can delete your account and your data from the profile screen.

name: Karaar
description:
Karaar is India’s premier AI-powered legal technology and smart contract management platform. Whether you are a business owner, freelancer, landlord, contractor, or individual, Karaar empowers you to draft legally compliant contracts, sign agreements with bank-grade security, and resolve disputes effortlessly from your iPhone.

KEY FEATURES:

THREE MEASUREMENT METHODS When the iPhone supports it, Kevlux takes a RAW photo and computes the color from the sensor’s raw data. Two other methods act as cross-checks, and Kevlux warns you when they disagree. Without a gray card, Scene mode estimates the light from the whole image.

BUILT FOR CAMERA AND LIGHTING CREWS • A catalog of more than 90 cameras: ARRI, RED, Sony, Canon, Blackmagic Design, Panasonic, Nikon, DJI, PTZOptics… with ranges and steps taken from the manufacturers’ documentation. • Check which way a camera’s tint goes when the manufacturer doesn’t publish it. • Mixed lighting: compare several sources and find the LEE or Rosco gels that match them. • Measurement history, with notes.

AN HONEST MEASUREMENT The iPhone is not a calibrated colorimeter: Kevlux gives an indicative measurement and never claims false precision. The margin shown (± 80 K, for example) is the spread of the frames, not a guaranteed accuracy.

PRIVACY FIRST No data collected, no account, no ads. Images are analyzed on the iPhone and are never saved or sent.

Kevlux is not affiliated with any of the manufacturers mentioned.

name: Kolumi Player
seller_name: Anastasia Ishchenko & Elias Muller GbR FlyStart Solutions
description:
Kolumi plays what already lives on your own server: audiobooks, audio dramas and podcasts from Audiobookshelf, music from Navidrome or another Subsonic server. Kolumi brings no content of its own, so without your own server there's nothing to play.

We're a small team from Dresden, Germany, and we made Kolumi for our own family first.

For audiobooks and audio dramas
Chapters, a speed that each book remembers, bookmarks and a sleep timer that fades out gently. Fell asleep halfway through? "Where was I?" remembers your place before jumps, chapter changes and pauses, so one tap takes you back. Series play in the right order, and for each series you can set how much of the intro and end credits Kolumi skips. Your progress is saved on your server, so you can pick up on any device.

For music
A few new mixes from your own collection every day, a radio that can start from any song, and your playlists. Lyrics scroll along when your server has them.

On the go and at home
Download episodes and albums for offline listening, and your progress syncs later on its own. The lock screen and Dynamic Island show what's playing. Ask Siri to "continue listening in Kolumi" or to "play a bedtime story in Kolumi".
At home you can play through AirPlay, on Sonos or on Kolumi Connect, which turns a Raspberry Pi or an old Linux computer into a speaker that fetches the audio straight from your server. Chromecast can be switched on in the settings.

For families, with Kolumi Server
Kolumi Server is a Docker container you run next to Audiobookshelf and Navidrome. With it, everyone gets their own profile and kids get a view of their own: big covers and no menus to get lost in. Press and hold a cover and Kolumi reads the title out loud. Printed story cards start a story when held up to the camera.
You decide what's on the shelf, when it's bedtime, how much listening time there is each day and how loud it can get. The rules live on the server and apply on every device, and leaving the kids view takes a PIN.
You also choose what stays downloaded on your child's devices: the shelf, the series they're listening to with the next episodes, or series you pick. The child's device downloads them while Kolumi is open, normally only on Wi-Fi, and your app shows how far along it is. Whatever is downloaded keeps playing in the car or on a trip without a connection.
At night the screen goes dark while the story keeps playing. With one big button your child picks whether it plays from the tablet or from the speaker. You can turn that button off.
Several parents can manage the household together. You can also reach a child's settings on their own device, behind your PIN. On iPad, Guided Access keeps Kolumi on screen.
Also included: wishes (if a title is missing, note it in the app and whoever looks after your server gets a message), listening together with one shared queue, shared playlists and single sign-on.

What you need
Audiobookshelf, Navidrome or another Subsonic server, or both. For the family features, add Kolumi Server, which works with Audiobookshelf and Navidrome. Setup guides are on kolumi.app.

What Kolumi doesn't do
No ads, no tracking, no account with us. The app only talks to the servers you add. Online lyrics and Chromecast stay off until you turn them on.

Kolumi is an unofficial app, not affiliated with Audiobookshelf, Navidrome or Subsonic.

Missing something, or something's off? Tell us in the app under Settings → Feedback & problems, or write to hello@kolumi.app. A person reads every message.
