- Send rent reminders by email in one tap
- Collect rent online by card or bank transfer, paid straight into the bank account of the LLC that owns the property
- Record checks, cash and transfers so every payment is in one record

MULTIPLE LLCs, ONE ACCOUNT
- Keep each LLC's properties, tenants and money separate
- Each LLC gets its own payout account and its own tenant portal
- Reconciliation by entity shows billed, received and outstanding

LEASES AND UNITS
- Track every unit, tenant, lease term, deposit and due date
- Change rent or lease dates without starting over
- See vacancies and leases ending soon

REPAIRS AND VENDORS
- Tenants send repair requests from their phone
- Assign a vendor, track status and record the cost
- Keep your plumber, electrician and handyman one tap away

REPORTS
- Income, expenses and net by property
- Record taxes, insurance, utilities and other expenses
- A permanent transaction record for every payment

TENANT PORTAL
- Tenants see their lease, rent due and payment history
- Pay rent online where the landlord has turned it on
- Request repairs and follow progress
- Invite tenants by email or text. Tenant accounts are free.

PLANS
New landlord accounts start with a 7-day free trial. After that, plans start at $39 per month and are based on the number of units you manage.

Privacy Policy: https://landlordiq.org/privacy
Terms of Service: https://landlordiq.org/terms

name: Landslide: UK Election Game
description:
You're the Prime Minister. It's autumn 2026, the polls are a three-way fight, and the next election
is due by summer 2029. Every seat counts.

Landslide is a strategy game about winning Britain seat by seat, built on the real country: all 650
constituencies, the 2024 result, who holds each seat today, the latest polling average and the census behind every seat.

START WHERE YOU LIKE
Any party, in power or in opposition, on Easy, Normal or Hard, from today's polls or your own. Choose your own constituency and stand there.

A MONTH IN DOWNING STREET
A short list of orders each month: one decision worth real seats, Prime Minister's Questions when it matters, the Budget when it's due, and your move. Do each yourself or leave it to your office. Every decision names the seats it wins and loses. Then the report: every party's seats and polls, the
economy and the money.

SEATS, NOT SPREADSHEETS
The Seats tab lists the marginals you could lose and could take, lit on the map. Each month you go to one, and it shows. Voters change their minds too: opinion drifts away from whoever governs, so where the voters were isn't where they'll be.

YOUR CABINET
Each minister runs a department: their budget, their policies and their bills on one page. Every MP
weighs a bill against their own seat, and a defeat shows exactly what won't now happen. Lose the
backbenchers and the letters go in.

FIGHT THE CAMPAIGN
Six weeks, three days a week on the trail: a day on the doorstep in the seats that decide it, TV
interviews, adverts and attack ads from a war chest. Choose the message, face two leaders' debates, and read each week's poll. Then the exit poll at ten, your own seat, recounts, the swingometer and every seat declaring through the night on a live map you can explore when it's over.

LEAD THE OPPOSITION
Lose, and the other side governs. Spend your days in the news on the government's worst moments,
fight by-elections, launch flagship policies and change where the party stands, one stance at a time, without losing your members. Win, and you inherit the country they leave.

A CAREER, SCORED
Years in No 10, elections won and lost, majorities and comebacks, and history's verdict on every
leader you've been. Beat the records for each party and difficulty.

WHAT IF THERE WERE AN ELECTION TOMORROW?
Simulation starts from the latest polls. Try a Reform surge, a Labour collapse or a three-way tie,
drag each party's share, then hold the election and watch the night unfold.

IPHONE AND IPAD
On iPad, Downing Street is a desk across the screen, around the map.

PAY ONCE
Everything is included. No adverts, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no account, no timers.

Landslide is not affiliated with or endorsed by any political party, pollster or Parliament. Party
positions are simplified for the game, and no real people appear in it.

name: Lanemark: Permit Test Prep
description:
Lanemark helps you get ready for the written knowledge test for a car learner's permit or driver's license in the United States.

Start by choosing your state. California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Michigan, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania and Texas each have their own set of questions on that state's laws: permit age and holding period, supervised driving hours, night and passenger limits for new drivers, alcohol limits, parking distances, default speed limits, school bus and move-over rules. Every other state gets the rules that apply nationwide plus the road signs.

Mock tests are built to your state's format: the number of questions and the pass mark the state describes, and separately scored parts where a state has them (Georgia's road signs and road rules, for example). You see your score only at the end, with every missed question explained. A time limit is optional.

Practice by topic when you want to work on one area: right of way, signals and pavement markings, speed and following distance, turns and passing, parking, alcohol and distraction, hazards and emergencies, and sharing the road with pedestrians, cyclists, trucks and school buses. Each answer is followed by a short explanation.

Questions you miss come back on a schedule: about 10 minutes later, then after one day, three days, a week and roughly two weeks, as long as you keep getting them right. A Mistakes list shows everything whose last answer was wrong, and Marathon mode takes you through every question for your state once, in an order you can pause and resume.

The Signs section has 54 road signs drawn from the federal sign standard, grouped by shape and color, each with what it means and what it asks you to do, plus a sign drill.

The readiness score combines your recent mock test results with how many questions you have right, and the Progress screen shows your test history against the pass mark and how each topic is going.

Lanemark has no account, no ads, no in-app purchases and no analytics, and it works without an internet connection. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

About the content: every question was written for Lanemark in its own words from the facts in each state's public driver handbook and checked a second time against those sources. The handbook used for each state is listed in the app. Laws change, so always check your state's current handbook.

Lanemark is an independent study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any DMV, state licensing agency or other government body.

name: Lastball
description:
Beş topun var. Pota her turda biraz daha uzaklaşıyor. Ve son top çift sayıyor.

Lastball, tek parmakla oynanan sade bir basket atışı oyunu. Sürükle, nişan al, bırak. Sürüklemenin eğimi açıyı, uzunluğu gücü belirler; topun izleyeceği yolu noktalarla görürsün.

SON TOP ANI
Sehpada tek top kaldığında ekran kararır ve atış ağır çekime geçer. Girerse çift sayar ve tur devam eder. Kaçarsa oyun biter.

BEŞ OYUN MODU
• Klasik: Her atışı izle, sonucu bekle.
• Seri Atış: Beklemeden art arda at.
• 60 Saniye: Bir dakikada en çok basket.
• Ani Ölüm: İlk kaçan top oyunu bitirir.
• Günün Meydan Okuması: Her gün yeni koşullar, sayılan tek deneme.

HER TUR BİRAZ DAHA ZOR
Mesafe uzar, rüzgâr çıkar, hedef basket sayısı artar. Temiz basketler (çembere değmeden) daha çok puan getirir.

GARDIROP
Oynadıkça Alican için şapka, ayakkabı, bileklik ve forma açılır. Dört renk teması: Krem, Gece, Asfalt, Saha.

SENİN TARZIN
• İki kontrol şekli: Sapan ve Ayrık
• Türkçe ve İngilizce
• Ses ve titreşim ayarı
• iPhone Duo'nun iç ve dış ekranına uyumlu

Reklam yok. Hesap yok. Uygulama içi satın alma yok. İnternet gerekmez; hiçbir veri toplanmaz.

name: LaterON: Saved Reels
description:
"I'll watch it later on." That's you, every time you hit save.

Gym routines, biryani recipes, Goa itineraries, "learn this or regret it" reels… all saved. None watched. Your saved folder is a Bermuda Triangle: reels go in, they never come out.

LaterON: because "later on" never comes. Now it's ON.

SHARE IT
On any Instagram reel, tap Share > LaterON. Done. It lands in your pile. No Instagram login. No account.

DECKS
Reels sort themselves into decks: Gym, Food, Money, Travel, Big-brain. Only want to clear Food today? Pick the deck and swipe.

SWIPE IT
Right = Watched. Left = Trash. Tap = opens straight in Instagram.
Oops? There's undo. And a "Roast me now" button for when you need a push.

DAILY 3
Just 3 reels a day, oldest first. Clear all 3 = streak +1
Not done by evening? Rostu guilt-trips you harder than a certain green owl.

ACTION MODE
Recipe, workout or money reel? AI turns it into a 3-step checklist. Watch it, do it, tick it off. Saving isn't the goal, using it is.

GET ROASTED
"Han bhai gym wali reel save ki thi, kya hua uska??"
Pick your spice: Mild (mom energy), Medium (best-friend roast), Spicy (older-sibling roast). You choose how often and when.

THE RECEIPTS
• Roast Meter: "You're a collector, not a viewer."
• Reel Debt, watched vs saved, streaks, Shame Score
• Weekly Wrapped: "This week you saved 23 reels and watched 2" – post it to your story

ENGLISH OR HINGLISH
English by default. Prefer desi mode? Switch to Hinglish in Settings.

PRIVACY
• No login, no account, no ads, no tracking
• Your pile stays on your iPhone
• AI is off until you turn it on. Then the reel link, caption, optional note and language go to Google Gemini (via lateron-proxy.vercel.app) for a summary, tag, reminder lines and steps
• AI off uses built-in offline roasts. Cover thumbnails can still be requested from the link's website
• Questions: hello@techosite.com

Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta. We just add a little emotional pressure to your saved reels.

name: Lauf Doch
description:
Ich bin Marco, der Entwickler der App und ich laufe gerne in meiner Freizeit. Wenn ich dabei Musik höre, möchte ich mir zwischendurch mein Tempo sowie meine Strecke und Laufzeit ansagen lassen. So weiß ich, wie ich zurzeit unterwegs bin, ohne ständig auf meinen Handybildschirm schauen zu müssen. Inzwischen wollen auch meine Freunde die App nutzen, also gibt’s "Lauf Doch" jetzt für alle, die beim Laufen gern ihren Zwischenstand hören oder sich zwischendurch anfeuern lassen wollen.

Lauf Doch kann dir also unterwegs Laufzeit, Distanz und Durchschnittstempo ansagen. Du bestimmst aber welche Infos genau du hören möchtest und in welchen Abständen.

Die App bietet aber noch weitaus mehr:

• Motiviere dich mit eigenen Audios. Nimm eine Nachricht direkt in der App auf oder importiere eine Audiodatei. Lass dich zur Halbzeit an dein Ziel erinnern oder bei 90 % der Strecke für die letzten 10 % anfeuern.
• Lauf auf deine Zielzeit hin. Setz dir zum Beispiel 5 km in 30 Minuten als Ziel. Unterwegs hörst du, wie viele Sekunden du vor oder hinter deinem geplanten Tempo liegst.
• Speichere deine Lieblingsläufe. Wähle eine Dauer, eine Strecke oder eine Strecke mit Zielzeit. Speichere das Ziel samt Audio-Einstellungen für dein nächstes Training oder lauf einfach ohne Ziel los.
• Schau dir deine Laufstatistiken an. Im Verlauf findest du Zeit, Distanz, Schritte, Abschnittszeiten und deine Tempokurve. Vergleiche deine Zeit mit einem früheren Lauf über dieselbe Zielstrecke. Wenn du dein Gewicht angibst, siehst du auch deinen geschätzten Kalorienverbrauch.
• Teile deinen Lauf: Erstelle eine Lauf-Zusammenfassung als Video für Social Media oder speichere deine GPS-Strecke als GPX-Datei.

Kostenlos, ohne Konto und auch im Flugmodus möglich. Deine Läufe und Audios werden ausschließlich auf deinem Gerät gespeichert. Die App sendet sie nicht an mich. Wenn du etwas teilst, entscheidest du selbst, wohin es geht.

name: LAVNAV
description:
LAVNAV shows your flight on a map, even in airplane mode.

Before you board, pick your flight: where you're flying from, where you're going, your airline, then your flight from the list. LAVNAV saves the map along your route on your phone.

In the air, even with airplane mode on, it shows:
• Where your plane is, from your iPhone's GPS
• Cities, rivers, mountains and parks out each window, with short stories, plus your own places
• Turbulence forecasts and pilot reports along the route
• A bathroom check: when the seatbelt sign is likely on (climbing, bumps, coming down to land) and when it's a good time to get up, with countdowns

With internet, it also shows rain radar and other planes nearby.

The bathroom and turbulence information are estimates from public forecasts and pilot reports. The crew and the seatbelt sign always come first.

Your location stays on your phone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Built and hosted by Baumeister.

name: Lead Matrix
description:
Lead Matrix finds business leaders who are interested in your offer and brings them to you. The app puts them in your pocket: as soon as a prospect replies that they are interested, you get a notification and can call them back while the conversation is hot.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Get an alert for every new interested prospect
• See your pipeline: prospects to follow, meetings, quotes, deals won and revenue signed
• Open a lead: their reply, the full conversation, phone number and email
• Call or reply in one tap; your reply is sent from your campaign address, in the same thread
• Move each lead through your stages and add notes for your team
• Send a lead to your CRM or forward it to your sales team
• Sort every reply received: interested, to qualify, not interested, out of office
• Follow your campaigns: emails sent, replies, response rate, interested prospects
• Check who is targeted for you, and pause or restart a campaign

MADE FOR THE ROAD
• Lock with Face ID or fingerprint
• Quiet hours at night: alerts wait until the morning
• Dark mode and large text support
• Available in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish and Dutch

PRIVACY FIRST
Notifications only show the name of the prospect's company: the details appear once you are signed in. The app contains no ads and no trackers.

An active Lead Matrix account is required. Sign in with your email and password, or with a sign-in link sent by email.

name: Learn Carrom Game
description:
Learn Carrom Game teaches the classic board game the way it is played at clubs and at home, then lets you practise straight away on a full board sized for your phone.

LEARN THE RULES
• Six short lessons: Basics, Setup, Queen & cover, Scoring, Fouls, Singles vs Doubles
• A setup diagram of the board markings: baselines, baseline circles, diagonal arrows and the centre
• Worked examples, such as how a board score of 4 + 3 = 7 is reached

PLAY ON A REAL-FEELING BOARD
• 9 white coins, 9 black coins and the bright pink Queen, set up in the standard pattern
• Singles: you (White) against Ravi, a computer opponent
• Doubles: you and your partner Priya (White) against Ravi and Arjun, with turns rotating around all four sides of the board
• Drag the striker along your baseline, pull back to set angle and power, and release to shoot, or use the position, angle and power sliders

AN AIM GUIDE THAT TEACHES
• A red dashed line shows the striker's path and where it will touch a coin
• A teal line shows where that coin will travel, with a ring when it will drop into a pocket
• A dashed line shows where the striker goes after contact

RULES THAT ARE ENFORCED
• Pocket one of your own coins and you shoot again
• The Queen may only be pocketed after one of your own coins, and must be covered on the same or the next shot, or she returns to the centre
• Fouls for pocketing the striker, an opponent's coin, or your last coin before the Queen is covered
• The winner scores 1 point for each opponent coin left, plus 3 for covering the Queen

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• No account and no ads
• Nothing you do is collected or sent anywhere

Made by Eugene Seow, a retired Singapore teacher, for families, students and anyone who wants to learn carrom properly.

name: Learn the City App
description:
Learn the City is a guide to the places worth your time, with tours that tell you the story as you go.

TOURS THAT TALK
Walking and driving tours of Nashville, Huntsville, Prague and Antigua, Guatemala. Each stop is read aloud. Turn on Follow along and the next story starts when you arrive, even with your phone locked in your pocket, and the lock screen shows the stop with play, pause and next. Driving tours are made to be heard, so your eyes stay on the road. Save a tour before you go and it works without signal.

A GUIDE YOU CAN CHECK OFF
Coffee shops, music venues, parks, museums, history and hidden gems, with hours, tips, cost and directions. Check places off as you go and watch your progress fill in.

PLAN A DAY IN ONE SENTENCE
Type what you feel like doing, like "coffee, a walk, lunch and some history," and Plan my day picks real places from the guide, in an order that makes sense, with the walking or driving time between them.

EVERYTHING ON ONE MAP
See every spot at once, filter by what you are in the mood for, and open directions in Google Maps.

WHAT'S ON
Concerts, markets, classes and festivals pulled from local calendars, so you can see what is happening tonight.

TRAVEL TOGETHER
Make a Trip, invite friends with a link, and share photos and check-offs in a feed only the people on the Trip can see. When the Trip is over, it becomes a journal: a map of where you went, day by day.

FOOD WORTH THE TRIP
In Prague and Antigua, a short list of dishes to try, what they are, and where to get them.

No ads and no tracking. Browse the guide, the map, Events and tours without an account. Sign in with Apple, Google or email to check places off, plan days and go on Trips.

name: Ledgerr
description:
Ledgerr brings every trade from every account into one clear view, so you always know where you stand and what's working.
Connect your MT5 and cTrader accounts once on the Ledgerr website, and every position syncs to the app automatically. No spreadsheets and no manual entry.

name: Lens & Go
description: Lens & Go is a peer-to-peer marketplace for camera gear. Renters can browse cameras, lenses, flashes, and lighting listed by photographers in their area, book the days they need, and manage the rental in one place. Owners can list gear they already own, set their price, and rent it out instead of letting it sit on a shelf. Built for photographers who need a specific lens for one shoot, and for owners whose kit can pay for itself.

name: Lensify
description:
Lensify is an all-in-one visual search, price comparison, and document scanning application designed to give you instant information from any image. Powered by advanced on-device vision intelligence and global search engines, Lensify allows you to search by photo, compare marketplace prices, identify subjects, and extract text from documents in seconds.

Whether you need to find where to buy an item, verify a photo source, extract text from receipts and contracts, or isolate an object in a photo, Lensify delivers fast and accurate results.


MULTI-ENGINE REVERSE IMAGE SEARCH
Search any photo or screenshot across the world leading reverse image search engines in a single interface:
• Google Lens
• Bing Visual Search
• Yandex Images
• TinEye
Switch between engines seamlessly to discover original sources, find higher resolution copies, identify landmarks, search artwork, and uncover duplicate profiles.


DEDICATED SHOPPING AND PRICE FINDER
Find products online and compare deals across major retail platforms. Take a picture of clothing, shoes, home goods, or electronics to compare prices instantly on:
• Amazon
• eBay
• AliExpress
• Walmart
• Google Shopping
Intelligent product recognition detects brand names, models, and product categories to provide exact product matches and help you find the best available prices.


SMART SUBJECT SELECTION AND OBJECT CROPPING
When a photo contains multiple objects, on-device vision intelligence automatically outlines each subject:
• Tap interactive object dots to isolate and search specific items within a crowded photo
• Use manual crop, rotation, and aspect ratio tools for customized search framing
• Search individual items without cropping manually


FACE DETECTION AND MULTI-FACE SELECTION
Search portraits, group photos, and headshots with precision:
• Automatic single-face framing for quick individual searches
• Interactive multi-face picker allows you to select a specific person from a group photo or search the entire image


DOCUMENT SCANNER AND OCR TEXT EXTRACTION
Convert documents, receipts, business cards, and notes into digital text:
• Automatic edge detection and perspective correction for clean document scans
• Apple Vision OCR extracts printed and handwritten text accurately
• Copy extracted text directly to your clipboard, share with other apps, or search keywords online


LOCAL PRIVACY AND SEARCH HISTORY
• All search history and scanned documents are stored securely on your local device
• Quick search history lookup to review past queries and documents anytime
• No account registration or login required
• Full support for Light Mode and Dark Mode with native system design


HOW TO USE LENSIFY:
1. Snap a photo with your camera, choose an image from your photo library, or enter an image web URL.
2. Select your desired search mode: Visual Search, Shopping, Face Search, or Document Scanner.
3. Tap on any detected subject to isolate it, or search the complete photo.
4. Review matching results, compare prices, or export extracted text.

Download Lensify to experience fast, accurate visual discovery and document intelligence on your iPhone.

name: Les mounes
description:
Les mounes est un jeu de cartes traditionnel des Alpes, et des Hautes-Alpes en particulier, qui se joue à quatre, en deux équipes, et dont les règles ne s'étaient jamais écrites : elles se transmettaient autour d'une table.

Deux équipes de deux, partenaires face à face. Trente-deux cartes. La partie se joue en 51 points. Toute la subtilité tient à une règle : seules les cartes d'une même couleur s'additionnent. Ta main vaut le total de sa meilleure couleur, et rien d'autre.

Le reste est affaire de bluff. On annonce « oui » pour passer, « non » pour miser, « buffe » pour miser sans avoir regardé ses cartes. On relance de deux en deux. Et on dit « tout » quand on décide que la partie se joue maintenant. Mouner, ici, c'est bluffer.

L'application ne t'aide pas à jouer. Elle compte la valeur de ta main, et c'est tout : pas de probabilités, pas de conseil, pas de jauge de force. Et ce que les autres cachent reste caché — une main gagnée sans être montrée ne s'affiche jamais, sauf si tu choisis de la montrer pour frimer.

Jeu en ligne avec un code à six lettres, ou en solo contre des adversaires qui savent mouner.

Gratuit, sans publicité, sans compte.

name: LestoranOS İşletme
description:
LestoranOS İşletme, Lestoran QR menü sistemini kullanan restoran ve kafelerin işletme uygulamasıdır. Masadan gelen her sipariş ve çağrı, telefonunuz cebinizdeyken bile anında önünüze düşer.

YENİ SİPARİŞ CEBİNİZDE
Müşteri masadaki QR'ı okutup sipariş verdiği anda telefonunuza sesli bildirim gelir: "Yeni sipariş · Masa 12 · 905 ₺". Bildirime dokunun, sipariş ekranı açılsın.

TEK DOKUNUŞLA ONAY
Masa, ürünler, adetler, müşteri notu ve toplam tutar tek kartta. Siparişi onaylayın, hazırlanıyor ve hazır olarak ilerletin. Ekran kendiliğinden yenilenir.

GARSON VE HESAP ÇAĞRISI
"Garson çağır" ve "Hesap iste" istekleri ekranın en üstünde, sesli uyarıyla görünür. İşiniz bitince "Tamam"a basın.

MENÜNÜZ HER ZAMAN GÜNCEL
Tükenen ürünü tek düğmeyle kapatın, fiyatı değiştirin, yeni ürün ve kategori ekleyin. Değişiklikler müşteri menüsüne anında yansır.

MASALAR VE QR
Masa ekleyin, her masanın güvenli QR'ını indirin veya hepsini tek seferde yazdırın.

EKİBİNİZLE BİRLİKTE
Kasadaki tablet, garsonların ve işletme sahibinin telefonu aynı anda kullanılabilir; bildirimler hepsine gider. Oturum 60 gün açık kalır, her seferinde şifre sorulmaz.

Not: Uygulamayı kullanmak için bir Lestoran işletme hesabı gerekir. Hesap ve demo talebi için: lestoran.com

name: Linea – Mezzi di Milano
description:
Linea tells you what's coming near you, when to leave and how to get around Milan by metro, tram and bus. Clear, fast, free and ad-free.
The official timetables for the whole network live on your phone, so Linea answers instantly, even underground with no signal.
NEAR YOU
• The stops around you and their next departures, as soon as you open the app • Full timetables for any stop, saved and one tap away
ROUTES AND STEP-BY-STEP GUIDANCE
• The best route by metro, tram and bus, step-free if you need it • When to leave, where to board, when to get off: on the Dynamic Island, the Lock Screen and your wrist • During the trip Linea notices delays and updates the next steps • Share your arrival time with whoever is waiting for you
WHEN TO LEAVE
• A widget tells you when to leave for Home or Work • A reminder before the last ride of the night, with night lines • The right time to leave for your calendar appointments
APPLE WATCH
• Your trip, nearby departures and Home/Work on your wrist, with a watch-face complication • It keeps its own copy of the timetables, so it works with your phone in your pocket
AND MORE
• A metro map that updates itself when the network changes • Siri, Shortcuts, the Action button and Spotlight • How to reach Linate, Malpensa and Bergamo airports • In English, Italian, French, Spanish, German and Chinese • Timetables update by themselves, even when new lines open
PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your location stays on your phone.
Linea uses the scheduled timetables published by the City of Milan (CC BY 4.0 licence): they are not live waiting times. Linea is an independent app, not affiliated with ATM or the City of Milan, and it doesn't sell tickets.

name: Linear Transform: y = Ax
description:
Linear Transform turns y = Ax into something you can see, touch and animate. Built for linear algebra classes at university and high school, it makes eigenvalues and eigenvectors intuitive.

■ 2D AND 3D
• Enter any 2×2 or 3×3 matrix in math notation (3-decimal precision).
• The original orthonormal grid (gray) and the transformed grid (green) are drawn together, so "before" and "after" are clear at a glance.
• Transformed basis vectors Ae₁, Ae₂, Ae₃ — the columns of A.
• Unit square / cube → parallelogram / parallelepiped, with det A as the area / volume factor.

■ EIGENVALUES & EIGENVECTORS
• All eigenvalues listed as λ₁, λ₂, λ₃ — including repeated and complex ones.
• Eigenvector lines and eigenplanes drawn in the space.
• A banner tells you when x is an eigenvector (y = λx).
• Sweep x around a circle (2D) or a whole sphere (3D): a heat map reveals the eigen-directions.

■ ANIMATE THE TRANSFORMATION
• Morph space from I to A and watch eigenvectors stay on their own line.

■ SHAPES AND 3D MODELS
• 2D: square, circle, heart, star, letter F, house, cat, fish, apple, person, tree and more.
• 3D: cube, sphere, airplane, desk, chair, bottle, house, rocket, car, tree.
• Show the original, the transformed version, or both.

■ EASY TO EXPLORE
• Presets: rotation, shear, reflection, projection, scaling, symmetric matrices…
• Input x in Cartesian, polar (2D) or spherical (3D) coordinates.
• 3D camera: drag to orbit, pinch to zoom, ±rotation about x₁/x₂/x₃, and one-tap Top / Bottom / Front / Rear / Left / Right views with smooth animation.

■ PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no data collection. Works fully offline.

Designed by H. Zhang, Gunma University, Japan.

name: Link Budget
description:
Link Budget figures one hop between two sites you record.

Place each end on the plan, or read this iPhone's location once. The link shows distance, both azimuths, free-space loss, and the fade margin in each direction. The weaker direction is the one on the board.

The budget draws every gain and loss down to the received level. The profile shows the ground, the line of sight, and the first Fresnel zone. A point on the path can be clear, partial, or blocked. Suggest a mast height when the path is tight.

Compare keeps the link on the left and a trial on the right. Apply the trial when the margin or the clearance is better. Radios and antennas stay on this iPhone.

There is no account and nothing to buy. The result is a calculation for the path you entered. It does not replace a site survey.

name: Litma: Malayalam Writing
description:
Litma is a writing desk for Malayalam literature. Write novels, short stories, poems, songs, screenplays, plays, essays, features and diaries, each with its own layout, on pages that look like the printed book.

TYPE THE WAY YOU THINK
• Type in Manglish and watch it turn into Malayalam script, with a row of spellings to pick from.
• Or type straight in Malayalam with your phone's keyboard, or in English.
• Works without a connection. Your writing is kept on the phone and syncs when you are back online.

A HOME FOR EVERY WRITING TYPE
• Novels and stories with chapters, drop caps and book-style paragraphs.
• Poems and songs with stanzas, refrain and metre marks (വൃത്തം).
• Screenplays and plays with scenes, acts, dialogue and a cast list.
• Essays and features with footnotes and references.
• A diary that adds today's date for each new entry.

WORDS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
• A built-in Malayalam dictionary and thesaurus, with English meanings.
• നാട്ടറിവ്: Malayalam words from Kerala's life, food, festivals, arts and seasons, gathered by theme.
• Rhymes (പ്രാസം) for poets and lyricists.
• A spelling check that knows how Malayalam words join.
• Save the words you love and use them later.

PLAN YOUR STORY
• Story World (കഥാലോകം): characters, places, objects, a plot board and a timeline beside your text.
• Version history, so you can go back to an earlier draft.
• Writing goals, a daily reminder, a writing timer and your streak.

FROM DRAFT TO BOOK
• Gather works into a book with contents, details and a cover designed in the app.
• Export to PDF or Word, or share a link so others can read your work.

AN AI COMPANION, ON YOUR TERMS
Ask for feedback, a grammar check or ideas using your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini key. Your writing goes to the AI only when you ask.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your writing stays private unless you share a link. No ads. You can switch off usage statistics, back up your works, or delete your account at any time from Settings.

One account works on your phone, at getlitma.in and in the desktop apps for Mac, Windows and Linux.

എഴുതൂ, മലയാളത്തിൽ.

name: Littera — Korean Keyboard
description:
Type Korean with familiar layouts and colors of your choice. Existing Naratgeul, SKY, Flick, Danmoum and QWERTY layouts remain alongside Cheonjiin. Adjust key height, use one-handed mode, choose twelve free themes, search emoji in Korean and copy twenty-four original Hangul stickers.

Basic typing and in-keyboard settings work without Full Access. Copying stickers requires Full Access; paste a chosen image in your messaging app. Without Full Access, choose themes in the keyboard quick settings.

Online GIF, external translation and external speech services are not offered in this release. The app guides you to iOS dictation rather than providing custom dictation. The settings interface is primarily Korean.

name: Lives on a Timeline
description:
Put figures from Chinese and world history on the same timeline to see who lived or was active in the same era.

• Same Year and Timeline: Pick a year to see recorded lives and activity, or zoom out to explore a wider period.
• Search and compare: Find people by name, alias, or work. Compare two lives or documented periods of activity on the same scale.
• Dating and sources: Open a profile to read dates, works, dating notes, and links to the original references. Approximate and disputed dates are identified.

Explore 8,060 records in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Browse, search, and compare offline with no account. External source links require an internet connection.

name: Livrux
description:
Turn every book into an adventure worth continuing.

Livrux is a reading log for families. Young readers read real books (paper, library or e-reader) and log their pages in seconds. Livrux turns those pages into progress they can see and celebrate.

FOR YOUNG READERS
• A reading companion that grows with every page, all the way to Master
• A reading calendar that lights up every day they read
• Badges for real milestones, like books finished and pages read
• Insights: how much they've read since they started and this year, and their last 4 weeks in one chart
• Friends: see what friends are reading and cheer them on with ready-made encouragements

FOR PARENTS
• A parent area protected by a Guardian PIN
• Several readers in one family, and co-guardians to share it
• Book search hides titles meant for adults from readers under 18
• Optional family rewards: you decide if and how reading earns coins
• An optional weekly reading summary by e-mail
• Optional reading reminders for each reader

Accounts are created and managed by a parent or guardian. Sign in with Apple, Google or e-mail.

Read what you love, at your own pace. Every story counts.

name: LocalFlow: Private Dictation
description:
LocalFlow is voice typing that stays on your iPhone. Speak, and the words appear in whatever app you are typing in. Nothing is sent anywhere: the speech model runs on the phone, with the network off if you like.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add the LocalFlow keyboard once. Tap its mic key, talk, tap the check: the text is inserted where your cursor is, in messages, email, notes, anywhere.
• A preview shows the words as they are recognised; the field is only touched when you tap the check.
• English and Greek (and 23 more European languages) are recognised automatically, no switching.
• Styles: keep your words exactly as spoken, or let Apple's on-device model rewrite the final text as Formal, Casual, Very casual or Excited (requires Apple Intelligence).
• The app itself is a dictation pad too: speak, edit, copy or share.
• A personal dictionary fixes names and terms the model mishears; add a word straight from the keyboard.
• Works with the Action button: "Turn On Keyboard Dictation".
• Shows in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen while it listens, with a Turn off button.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no analytics, no servers. Audio and text never leave the phone.
• The only download is the speech model, once (about 670 MB).
• Dictated text is forgotten two minutes after you use it.
• The keyboard contains no networking code. Full Access is needed only to hand the text from the app to the keyboard.

ABOUT THE MICROPHONE INDICATOR
iOS does not let a keyboard use the microphone, and only lets an app continue a recording it started in the foreground. So while "Listening for the keyboard" is on, LocalFlow keeps the microphone open in the background (orange indicator) and discards the audio until you tap the mic key. You can turn this off or set it to switch off after 5 or 15 minutes, an hour, or immediately after each dictation.

Requires iOS 18 or later. Recommended: iPhone 15 or newer.

name: Locklang
description:
Every glance at your phone can teach you something. Locklang puts a word or a sentence from the language you are learning right on your lock screen, then helps you remember it for good.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
• A lock screen widget that shows a new word or sentence through the day
• Choose words, sentences or both, and how often they change
• Quiz mode: see the word first, the translation a little later
• Home screen widgets and a streak widget too

SIX LANGUAGES, ANY DIRECTION
Learn English, German, Turkish, Italian, Spanish or French — from any of the other five. The whole app speaks your language.

FROM A1 TO C1
Words with example sentences and ready-to-use phrases, organised by CEFR level. Start where you are; the next level opens as you progress.

MADE TO BE REMEMBERED
• Spaced repetition brings each item back just before you would forget it
• Exercises get harder as your memory gets stronger: recognise, translate, fill the gap, build the sentence, recall
• Short sessions that fit into a few minutes
• Pronunciation for every word and sentence

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Daily goal, streak, level progress, upcoming reviews and how much has moved into long-term memory.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Locklang works offline and your data never leaves your device.

name: Locutores Nuevo León Radio
description: Locutores Nuevo León Radio es la estación en línea de los locutores de Nuevo León, transmitiendo en vivo las 24 horas, los 7 días de la semana. Con esta app puedes: • Escuchar la transmisión en vivo en cualquier momento, estés donde estés. • Reproducir los episodios de nuestro podcast, Temporada 1, directamente en la app. • Leer las noticias más recientes del medio de la locución en México, publicadas en nuestro sitio. • Llegar en un toque a nuestras redes sociales y a nuestra página web. EN VIVO, SIN COMPLICACIONES. Sin registro, sin cuenta y sin costo. Abres la app, tocas play y ya estás escuchando la estación. NUESTRO PODCAST. La Temporada 1 reúne episodios dedicados a Bruno Mars, Coldplay, Heart, Prince, Def Leppard y Maroon 5, además de «Encuentros» con Aide Cavazos y con Octavio Carrillo, The Podcast de Adrián Peña y un episodio sobre la Asociación de Zacatecas. Todos se reproducen dentro de la app. NOTICIAS DE LA LOCUCIÓN. Consulta las publicaciones más recientes de locutoresnuevoleon.org sobre el medio de la locución en México, sin salir de la app. SÍGUENOS. Facebook: locutoresnuevoleonoficial. Instagram: locutoresnuevoleon. X: locutores_nl. Web: https://locutoresnuevoleon.org. Locutores Nuevo León Radio — la voz de los locutores de Nuevo León, en vivo para ti.

name: Loglike
description:
One square is hidden. Swipe toward the half it is in. Right: the board shrinks. Wrong: you lose a life, and that half is removed anyway. Cut until one cell is left.

Warmer cells are closer to the square. When the heat is unclear, use the radar.

RUNS
• Boards grow from 8×8 to 32×32.
• After each level, pick one of three cards. 24 cards, some of them cursed.
• From level 3, pick a path: quiet, or cursed for more shards.
• Every 5th level is a boss.
• Relics after bosses. Items and a shop inside the run.
• 9 curses: fog, decoys, a square that moves, mirrored heat, a timer and more.

HEROES
• 7 heroes. Each has its own heat, lives and starting card.
• Ranks, new looks and an alternate ability for every hero.
• 15 Ascension steps.

MODES
• Cube: the same idea in 3D. Opens after your first boss.
• Daily: one board for everyone, one try. Share the result as a grid.
• Weekly: a new challenge every week, with its own hero and curse.
• Sprint: 60 seconds. Find as many squares as you can.
• Puzzles: 48 puzzles with number clues instead of heat.
• Zen: no lives, curses or cards.

PROGRESS
• Shards stay after every run. Spend them on upgrades, rare cards, heroes and heat colors.
• 33 awards.
• Game Center leaderboard. Progress syncs through iCloud.

FOR EVERYONE
• Colorblind mode with its own heat colors.
• Light and dark themes. English and Russian.
• Pay once. No ads, no in-app purchases.

name: Loopkin
description:
Loopkin is a cosy row counter and project basket for knitters and crocheters. Tap anywhere on the screen to count a row, let Loopkin remember where the decreases go, and keep your yarn stash and finished pieces in one warm, wool-pink place.

A COUNTER YOU CAN HIT WITHOUT LOOKING
Every project gets its own huge row counter. Tap anywhere on it to add a row; a strand of yarn stitches a new loop with every count and a soft wooden needle click confirms it. Took one row too many? Take it back, or undo the last change. A second repeat counter follows your pattern repeat on its own – set "every 8 rows" and it moves on when a repeat is done.

ROW REMINDERS AND GOALS
Pin notes to rows: "place waist markers at 72", "start decreases at 90", "switch needles at 120". When your counter reaches that row, Loopkin chimes and shows the note. Set a row goal and it glows mustard on the counter, counting down the rows to go.

PROJECTS THAT KEEP THE DETAILS
Store the pattern, needle or hook size, gauge, start date, status and notes for each project. Start the session timer while you work and Loopkin adds the minutes to the project and to your day. Mark a piece finished and it hangs in your gallery as a colour card with its rows, time and yarn.

A STASH THAT ADDS UP
List your skeins with brand, colourway, weight, fibre, metres per skein and quantity. Link yarn to projects with the metres used, and every skein shows how much is left to knit. Filter the basket by weight and see your total skeins and metres at a glance.

TIME AND STATS
See the minutes you spent with yarn this week, the rows you counted each day, and how your time splits between projects, all drawn as soft yarn-strand charts.

MADE TO FEEL LIKE A CRAFT TABLE
Bubbly headings, knitted V-stitch textures, yarn-ball navigation in a wicker basket and three palettes: Wool Pink, Fisherman Grey and Moss Stitch. Sounds and haptics can be switched off, and the screen can stay awake while you count.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Create an account with email and password to keep your basket in sync, or tap "Cast on as guest" and start counting straight away. Guests can save their stitches to an email account later from the Workbasket without losing anything. Everything works offline and syncs when you are back online.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CALL
Your projects are private to your account. No ads, no tracking, no analytics. You can delete your account and every project, counter, reminder and skein from the Workbasket at any time.

name: Ltsmex
description:
Thank you for choosing our app; every piece of feedback helps guide our ongoing improvements.

Ltsmex tells you when the everyday things in your home have quietly passed their best, so you swap them on time instead of guessing. Toothbrush heads, razor blades, water and air filters, contact lenses, pillows, running shoes, smoke-alarm batteries or anything you add yourself: each one gets a lifespan and a clear due date.

SEE WEAR AT A GLANCE
Every item carries a little row of bristles that thin and bend as the days go by. As something nears its due date the bristles glow ember orange against the crisp royal-blue and white look. Mark it replaced and they stand up straight again.

KNOW WHAT TO SWAP FIRST
The Due page orders everything from most worn to freshest: Needs swapping, Wearing in and Fresh. Mark an item replaced straight from its card. For things counted by uses, such as blades or runs in a pair of shoes, the same key logs one more use.

SET IT UP IN SECONDS
Pick from around 25 ready-made presets across the bathroom, kitchen, bedroom, hallway, car and gym bag, or choose Something else and build your own. Set the name, icon, room, lifespan in days, weeks, months or uses, last replaced date, cost and the shop you buy it from.

LEARN WHAT THINGS REALLY COST
Each swap is saved to History with its date and price. The Spend view totals your outlay per year and per item, and compares how long each thing was meant to last with how long it actually did.

GENTLE NUDGES, IF YOU WANT THEM
Switch on due reminders, choose how many days ahead each item should warn you and the hour the reminder arrives. Reminders are scheduled on your own phone.

ORGANISED BY ROOM
Group items into rooms and add or remove rooms whenever you like. Pick the currency symbol used for every amount.

A KEY RING FOR NAVIGATION
Four keys open the app's pages: Due, Items, History and Toolbox.

START WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Create an account with email and password, or tap "Look before signing in" to try everything as a guest. When you are ready, Toolbox > Save my data turns your guest cabinet into an email account without losing anything. Your data syncs privately and keeps working offline.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No ads, no tracking, no analytics and no in-app purchases. Delete your account and every item and record from inside the app at any time: Toolbox > Delete account.

name: Lucky Me: Family Card Game
description:
Match the suit. Or the number. Then say "Lucky me!" before anyone catches you.

Lucky Me is a card game of pure luck for two to six players, invented by Charles Labianco. Now it's in your pocket: play against friendly computer players, or pass one phone or iPad round the table.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Everyone gets seven cards. One card goes face up to start the pile.
• On your turn, play a card of the top card's suit. Higher or lower doesn't matter.
• No card of that suit? Play one with the same number. That changes the suit.
• Can't do either? Draw a card, and your turn is over.
• Change the suit and you must say "Lucky me!" before the next player goes. Forget, and whoever catches you makes you draw two.
• First to empty their hand wins. No points, no second place.

If you win, it was the luck of the draw. If you lose, same thing.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Just you: take on one to five computer players. They follow the rules, pick any card they're allowed to, and sometimes forget to say "Lucky me!". Tap Catch! and they draw two. Forget your own call and they'll catch you too.
• Two of you, one device: pass and play, with computer players filling the other seats. A hand-off screen keeps every hand private, and whoever takes the device can catch the last player out.
• Big table: with five or six players, shuffle in a second deck and deal ten each.

GAME NIGHT
Keep a running tally of who won what over the evening, and crown the luckiest of the night. Start a new game night whenever you like.

MADE FOR THE FAMILY TABLE
• Big, clear cards drawn just for this game, with the cards you can't play dimmed so nobody gets stuck.
• The rules are built in, so there are no arguments about what counts.
• Choose a paper, green felt, navy or burgundy table and your favourite card backs.
• Works on iPhone and iPad, in portrait or landscape on iPad, with large text and VoiceOver.
• Haptics on every play and an optional sound toggle.

FREE, AND PRIVATE
Lucky Me is free, with no ads, no accounts and nothing to buy. It needs no internet connection. Your game in progress and tonight's tally are saved on the device and nothing is collected: everything stays on your device.

name: Lunio Baby: Formula Feeding
description:
Lunio Baby is a simple helper for parents who feed their baby formula

How many milliliters your baby drank, when the next bottle is due and whether today’s target is met — all at a glance. No complicated setup, no sign-up, no subscriptions.

FEEDINGS
• Log every bottle: how much you offered and how much your baby drank.
• Feeding timer — start, pause and stop in one tap.
• Countdown to the next feeding right on the home screen.
• Your baby’s formula and the history of formula changes.
• Notes for any feeding.
• Ounces or milliliters — your choice.
• Add or fix an entry if you forgot to log it on time.

REMINDERS
• Your own interval between feedings and your own portion.
• A heads-up 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes before the next feeding.
• Quiet nights: vibration only at night.

STATS
• How much your baby drank today — compared with the daily target.
• Charts by week and by month.
• Your full feeding history, day by day.

PDF REPORT FOR YOUR PEDIATRICIAN
A report for any period: feeding plan, formula, daily amounts, duration and notes. Save it or send it to your doctor.

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Invite dad, grandma or the nanny with a code — everyone sees and logs feedings.
• Several children, each with their own history and target.
• Twins? Feed them together — each with their own timer.
• Entries sync through iCloud.

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Home Screen widgets.
• The timer on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

SIMPLE AND HONEST
• No sign-up, no ads, no subscriptions — completely free.
• Your data stays on your phone and in your iCloud.

Lunio Baby does not give medical advice — your pediatrician sets the feeding plan.

Lunio Baby — less counting, more time for what matters.

name: Lunvex
description: Lunvex is an offline gear ratio book. Using the number of teeth of the driving gear, the number of teeth of the driven gear, and the speed of the driving gear that you input, calculate the speed of the driven gear, then multiply the second pair of gears into the total ratio. Example 'Mill head': driving 20 teeth, driven 60 teeth, 180 rpm. Driven speed 180 × 20 ÷ 60 = 60 rpm. When the driving gear turns 9 times, the driven gear turns 9 × 20 ÷ 60 = 3 times. Gear ratio 60 ÷ 20 = 3. The second pair, 18 teeth and 36 teeth, gives 3 × (36 ÷ 18) = 6. Output speed 180 ÷ 6 = 30 rpm. Use full consecutive multiplication and division for the speed, don’t multiply by the rounded 0.333. Data exists on this machine.

name: Lymune
description:
Lymune is a small, quiet ritual around the light you already walk through every day.
Your body reads light before it reads anything else. Bright light in the morning says the day has started; dim light in the evening says it is over. Lymune turns that into three short windows you can actually keep.

name: Makerlens: STL & 3MF Viewer
description:
The STL viewer for iPhone and iPad.

Someone sent you an STL? Downloaded a 3D model? Open it and look at it properly: spin it with a finger, zoom into the details, measure it, cut it open and stand it on your desk in AR.

Makerlens opens STL, 3MF and OBJ files. It is for anyone who needs to see what is in one: designers, engineers, students, hobbyists and makers. No account, no ads, and your files stay on your device unless you share them.

VIEW
• Fast, smooth 3D viewer that handles models with a million triangles
• Orbit, pinch to zoom, two-finger pan, double-tap to fit
• Front, back, left, right, top, bottom and perspective views, plus auto-rotate
• Twenty colours with matte, satin, glossy and metal finishes
• Four studio backgrounds, a millimetre grid and smooth shading

MEASURE AND INSPECT
• Width, depth and height shown right on the model
• Tap two points to measure any distance
• A cross-section slider along height, width or depth to look inside
• Volume, surface area, triangle count and a watertight check

SEE IT IN AR
• Place the model on a table or the floor at its real size
• Drag to move it, use two fingers to turn it

RESIZE AND ORIENT
• Type an exact width, depth or height, or a percentage
• Keep proportions, or stretch each axis on its own
• One tap converts a model that was saved in inches
• Turn in 90° steps and mirror on any axis
• Your original file is never changed

SHARE
• Share a picture of the current view
• Export a 3MF or STL with the size and orientation you set, or share the untouched original

IF YOU 3D PRINT
• Add your printer: nearly sixty presets, with every Bambu Lab printer and models from Prusa, Creality, Anycubic, Elegoo, QIDI, Sovol and Voron, or enter your own build volume
• See the build volume drawn around the model, and by how many millimetres it misses when it does not fit. One tap resizes it to fit
• Overhangs past 45° painted on the model, so you can pick the orientation that needs the fewest supports
• Weight, filament length and cost for seven materials at your infill
• Send the 3MF to Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer or Cura

FITS HOW YOU WORK
• Opens files straight from the Files app, AirDrop, Mail and other apps
• A library with thumbnails, search and sorting
• iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collected

Good to know: Makerlens is a viewer. It does not edit the shape of a model, and it does not slice: printing goes through a slicer on a computer. The print estimate is a guide, and printer sizes are the makers' published build volumes. The AR preview needs a device that supports ARKit.

name: Makkuro's Guide to RouteVN
description:
This is a Visual Novel made by our RouteVN team for anyone who want to create their own stories. Thus, a Visual Novel made for Creators.
This VN is a work in progress, we will keep adding more scenes and releasing small updates as needed.

You wake up in a strange place in a dream-like state and encounter a mysterious girl who creates.
The girl says she will guide you on your journey to 'Bring Your Visual Novel to Life'.
Are you ready for this journey?
Regardless of whether you are starting to write your first story or have published a Visual Novel before, this journey will break down everything it takes to create your own Visual Novel and explore the storytelling features that are unique to Visual Novels.

Makkuro's Guide to RouteVN will cover a range of different topics from brainstorming ideas to introducing a breakdown of many Visual Novel features- focusing on your role as a Visual Novel 'Creator'.

- Programming: Made with RouteVN

name: Mal und Geteilt
description:
Mal und Geteilt zeigt Kindern, warum die schriftliche Multiplikation und die schriftliche Division funktionieren. Jede Aufgabe erscheint gleichzeitig in drei Darstellungen, die Schritt für Schritt miteinander verbunden sind: im Material, im halbschriftlichen Rechenweg und in der schriftlichen Rechnung.

MULTIPLIKATION
• Fläche: Das Rechteck zeigt, dass jede Stelle des einen Faktors mit jeder Stelle des anderen malgenommen wird. Bei kleinen Zahlen mit Hunderterplatten, Zehnerstreifen und Einerplättchen.
• Malkreuz: Die Teilprodukte stehen geordnet in der Tabelle und werden am Ende addiert.
• Schriftlich: Die Ziffernrechnung im Rechenkästchen, mit Merkzahlen und blass mitgeschriebenen Nullen der Teilprodukte.
Wahlweise mit den Einern des zweiten Faktors beginnen.

DIVISION
• Verteilen: Hunderter, Zehner und Einer werden in der Stellentafel gerecht verteilt. Was übrig bleibt, wird in die nächstkleinere Stelle getauscht.
• Schritt für Schritt: „Wie oft passt der Teiler hinein?“ mit Teilprodukt und Rest in jeder Zeile.
• Schriftlich: Das Normalverfahren mit Subtrahieren und Herunterholen, am Ende mit Probe.
Auch mit Rest, mit Null im Ergebnis und mit zweistelligem Teiler.

SCHRITT FÜR SCHRITT
Jeder Schritt wird in allen Darstellungen gleichzeitig hervorgehoben und in einem Satz erklärt. Vor- und zurückblättern, zum Anfang oder zum Ergebnis springen. Auf Wunsch liest die App die Schritte vor. Jede Darstellung lässt sich zudecken: erst vorhersagen, dann aufdecken.

ZWISCHENFRAGEN
Im Fragemodus fragt die App vor einem Schritt nach: Kinder tippen das passende Stück in der Fläche oder im Malkreuz an oder tippen ein Zwischenergebnis ein. So verbinden sie die Darstellungen selbst.

SELBST EINTRAGEN
Im Eintragemodus schreiben Kinder selbst: Vor jedem Schritt erscheinen Lücken im Malkreuz oder in der Schrittliste und in den Kästchen der schriftlichen Rechnung, für Ziffern, Überträge, Teilprodukte und Reste. Richtig eingetragen, führt die App den Schritt aus. Bei einem Fehler gibt es einen Hinweis ohne Lösung, und was zusammengehört, leuchtet in allen Darstellungen auf.

AUFGABEN
Eigene Aufgaben eintippen oder Zufallsaufgaben aus aufbauenden Stufen wählen, von „HZE · E ohne Übertrag“ bis „HZE · HZE“ und von „Jede Stelle ohne Rest teilbar“ bis „Zweistelliger Divisor“.

FÜR SCHULE, FÖRDERUNG UND ZU HAUSE
Für Klasse 4 und den Übergang in die weiterführende Schule, im Unterricht am Beamer, in der Förderung und bei den Hausaufgaben. Besonders hilfreich für Kinder, die das Verfahren auswendig gelernt haben, es aber noch nicht verstehen. Die Schwester-App „Schriftlich Rechnen“ behandelt Addition und Subtraktion.

DATENSCHUTZ
• Keine Werbung
• Kein Tracking
• Keine In-App-Käufe
• Keine Registrierung
• Keine Internetverbindung nötig
• Alle Einstellungen bleiben auf dem Gerät

Entwickelt von Christian Urff, Juniorprofessor für Mathematikdidaktik, Sonder-/Inklusionspädagogik und Entwickler zahlreicher Apps für den (Mathematik-)Unterricht der Grund- und Förderschule. Infos unter www.urff.app

name: Mando TV: Control Remoto TV
description:
Mando TV convierte tu celular en el control remoto de tu televisor, por el WiFi de tu casa. Sin cables, sin anuncios y sin crear cuentas.

FUNCIONA CON
• TV LG con webOS
• Samsung Smart TV con Tizen (2016 en adelante)
• Roku TV y reproductores Roku
• Android TV y Google TV (Sony, TCL, Philips, Xiaomi, Chromecast con Google TV y más)

TODO LO QUE NECESITAS
• Encender y apagar: la app sabe al instante si tu TV está encendido y lo enciende por WiFi.
• Botones grandes y claros: flechas, OK, volver, inicio, volumen, canales y silencio.
• Touchpad: desliza el dedo para moverte rápido por los menús, o usa el puntero en TV LG.
• Teclado: escribe en YouTube, Netflix o el buscador del TV con el teclado de tu celular.
• Apps y entradas: abre tus apps y cambia a HDMI con un toque.
• Control moderno o clásico, tema claro u oscuro y el color que prefieras.

PRIVADA DE VERDAD
Mando TV habla solo con tu televisor, dentro de tu red. No recoge tus datos, no tiene anuncios ni rastreadores.

SIMPLE DESDE EL PRIMER MINUTO
1. Conecta el celular y el TV al mismo WiFi.
2. Abre Mando TV y toca tu televisor.
3. Acepta el aviso en la pantalla del TV (solo la primera vez).

GRATIS Y MANDO TV PRO
Gratis para siempre: el control (flechas, OK, volumen, canales, inicio y atrás), el teclado, encender y apagar el TV y el modo fácil con botones grandes. Con un pago único, sin suscripción, desbloqueas Mando TV Pro: voz, touchpad, apps y entradas, favoritas, rutinas, temporizador, control clásico, colores y más.

¿Dudas o ideas? Escríbenos a hola@mandotv.app. Respondemos en español.

Mando TV no está afiliado a LG, Samsung, Roku ni Google. Las marcas se mencionan solo para indicar compatibilidad.

name: Marginalia Idle RPG
description:
The margins of an old book have come alive. Strange creatures – the Glyphs – crawl out of the ink, and you set out to collect them, raise them and lead them through ten regions full of bosses.

Marginalia is an idle RPG with real decisions: your team fights on its own, even while you are away, but how far it gets depends on who you bring, how you build them and when you step in.

52 Glyph families to discover
Every Glyph has its own element, role and look, drawn in pixel art. Find them on the trail, in dungeons or hatched from eggs – and evolve them into stronger forms with stars and mastery.

A team that fits together
Seven elements, reactions between them and team bonds: a water Glyph soaks a foe, a storm Glyph then sets off an overload that stuns it. Find the combinations that carry your team further.

Bosses you can read
Bosses telegraph their big attacks. Interrupt, shield or burst at the right moment – or let your rules do it for you.

A campaign and an endless Rift
300 stages across ten regions with their own bosses, five world tiers above that, and the Infinite Rift for when the campaign is not enough.

Progress that lasts
Ascend for lasting power, research the Astral tree, choose doctrines, forge relics in dungeons and fill your collection. Plenty to discover after days, weeks and months.

Plays while you are away
Your team keeps fighting offline; collect what it found when you come back.

Global leaderboards
Compare your power, your furthest stage and your deepest Rift with players everywhere.

Free to play. No ads, no in-app purchases. In English and German.

Made by Marginalia Games, an independent developer.

name: Masar Work | مسار
description:
Masar is a Saudi work management platform for companies, built for teams that want everything in one place and to know who is working on what and when it will be done.

Home
• Your focus today: your tasks in the best order to get them done
• What's late, urgent and new for you at a glance

Tasks and lists
• Spaces and lists for every department and project
• List and board views
• Priorities, due dates, assignees and subtasks
• Rich descriptions with checklists and tables
• Comments, @mentions, attachments and a full history of changes

Requests and approvals
• Request forms employees fill in from the app
• Multi-step approval chains
• A time limit per status with alerts when it is late

Communication
• Direct and group chats between colleagues
• Voice and video calls
• Instant notifications for tasks, comments and mentions, and you choose which ones reach you

Built for Arabic
• A fully Arabic interface, with a complete English interface
• Works on phone and web with the same account
• Light and dark modes

Requires a Masar account created by your company.

name: Mathetafel
description:
Die Mathetafel ist eine digitale Tafel für den Mathematikunterricht. Du zeichnest, konstruierst und erklärst Mathematik mit Stift, Geodreieck und Zirkel, so wie im Heft, nur groß vor der Klasse oder auf dem eigenen iPad.

DAS GEHT AN DER TAFEL

• Geodreieck: anlegen, am Griff drehen und an der Kante entlangzeichnen.
• Zirkel: Öffnung einstellen, Nadel setzen, Kreis schlagen. Schnittpunkte rasten ein, der Radius steht in cm dabei.
• Funktionsgraphen: Funktionsterm eintippen, der Graph steht sofort im Koordinatensystem. Schnittpunkte, Nullstellen und Scheitelpunkt zeigt die Tafel mit Koordinaten an. Dazu gibt es eine Wertetabelle.
• Körper: Würfel, Quader, Pyramide, Kegel und Zylinder mit dem Finger drehen, Maße ändern, Volumen und Oberfläche ablesen und zum Netz aufklappen.
• Export: Tafelbild als Bild für die Präsentation oder als PDF im Format A4, maßstabsgetreu zum Ausdrucken fürs Heft.

FÜR DEN UNTERRICHT GEMACHT

• Ohne Anmeldung: öffnen und loslegen, kein Konto nötig.
• Bleibt auf deinem Gerät: Zeichnungen werden nur lokal gespeichert.
• Läuft auch offline: Die Tafel funktioniert ohne Internet.
• Stift oder Finger: Die Bedienung passt sich an.
• Keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

Die Mathetafel wird von einem Mathematiklehrer entwickelt und im eigenen Unterricht eingesetzt.

name: mavra. retro camcorder
description:
A Time Machine in Your Pocket: Stop Over-Editing, Start Reliving Your Days.

Modern smartphone cameras capture everything in clinical, ultra-sharp perfection—yet often miss the soul of the moment. Metro Camcorder brings back the warmth, tactile joy, and authentic imperfections of 90s handheld camcorders and analog cinema, purpose-built for the next-generation iPhone Duo experience.
Capture your daily moments across 24 authentic film presets, and watch your day unfold tonight as one seamless, unedited home movie.

 24 AUTHENTIC FILM FILTERS (Beyond Basic VHS)
Unlike flat, artificial overlays, Metro Camcorder offers a curated vault of 24 handcrafted film looks inspired by iconic analog hardware and cinema eras:
90s VHS & Crisp MiniDV: Authentic color bleeding, subtle tracking wobble, magnetic tape noise, and classic camcorder date stamps.
70s & 80s Cinema Stocks: Warm Super 8mm palettes, organic silver-halide film grain, and natural analog light leaks.
Classic Camcorder Effects: High-contrast Noir B&W, warm Sepia, faded archival tones, and low-light night aesthetics.
Non-Destructive Magic: Your original footage is never altered. Switch between any of the 24 film looks on your tape anytime, even after filming.

 PURPOSE-BUILT FOR iPHONE DUO
Foldable hardware meets true camcorder ergonomics:
Hinge-Activated Power: Unfold your iPhone Duo to wake the camcorder with a nostalgic CRT warm-up and tactile mechanical clicks. Fold it shut to instantly save your clip and stay present in the moment.
Dual-Screen Handycam Grip: Hold your device half-folded in classic waist-level camcorder stance—the upper display becomes a crystal-clear viewfinder while the lower half turns into a dedicated tactile control deck.
Outer Cover Preview: When filming friends, the cover screen displays a live retro preview with a glowing red REC indicator.

 DAILY TAPES & UNEDITED HOME MOVIES
One Tape Per Day: Every clip you record lands sequentially on today’s dated cassette, turning fragmented moments into a cohesive daily video diary.
True Aspect Ratios & Full-Screen Playback: No tiny, heavily cropped viewfinders in landscape mode. Shoot and export in authentic 4:3 vintage framing or full-screen 1080p cinematic clarity without giant borders.
Tactile Tape Scrubbing: Wind the cassette reels directly with your finger to jump between moments from your day.

 PURE OWNERSHIP & PRIVACY
One-Time Purchase: No subscriptions, no ads, no locked filters, and zero watermarks on your memories.
100% On-Device Privacy: Your tapes never leave your iPhone unless you choose to save or share them. No accounts required.

Fold your screen, flip the lens cap, and start filming your life like a classic home movie today.

name: MazeBall: Retro 3D
description:
The classic wooden tilt maze, rebuilt for iPhone.

Roll a steel marble through concentric brushed-brass rings, find the gaps, and drop it into the center pocket — steered only by the way you tilt your phone. Thirty levels across three worlds plus a fresh Daily Labyrinth every day, each with a par time and star rating to chase.

Tilt it, don't tap it. The whole board answers to your wrist, calibrated to how you actually hold your phone.

- 30 levels across 3 worlds, each verified solvable with a clear corridor for the marble
- Daily Labyrinth with streak tracking
- Star-unlocked marble finishes (Chrome, Rose Gold, Obsidian, Heirloom Gold)
- Tactile Core Haptics and synthesized brass/wood collision audio you can toggle any time
- Recalibrate your neutral holding angle any time from Settings
- No tracking

name: MD Studio: Markdown Notes
description:
MD Studio is a Markdown notebook that does more than text. Everything lives in one plain .md file, so you can hand it to any AI and ask for a report, a deck or a spreadsheet.

WRITE
• Live preview with tables, task lists and math (KaTeX)
• Split long notes into chunks and jump between sections
• Find and replace, quick insert menu, adjustable text size
• Open and save .md files in your own folder

RUN PYTHON, OFFLINE
• Write a python code block and tap Run
• numpy, scipy, pandas, matplotlib, statsmodels and more run on your device
• Add sliders to explore a model and watch the chart change

DRAW
• Flowcharts and decision trees: build them with cards or paste Mermaid code
• Molecular structures from a SMILES string
• HTML blocks with a safe, sandboxed preview

PRESENT AND PRINT
• Every heading becomes a slide, with charts and diagrams included
• Print or save to PDF

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no tracking
• Your notes stay on your device
• Works without an internet connection

ASK AI, YOUR WAY
• Share a selection, a chunk or the whole note to the AI app you already use

Made for students, researchers, analysts and anyone who thinks in plain text.

name: MealForge
description:
MealForge is your kitchen, organized. Write and refine your own recipes, plan the week ahead, turn plans into shopping lists that respect what you already have, cook step by step with real timers, and keep an honest record of what you actually ate — all stored privately on your device.
Your Recipe Library
Build structured recipes with ingredients, quantities, notes, and numbered steps. Add photos, reorder steps, attach timers, save drafts, and preview before publishing. Prior versions are kept intact, so you can duplicate, archive, or safely delete recipes without breaking the plans and history that reference them. Search by name, filter by category, difficulty, time, or tag, and filter by what your pantry can already cover.
Meal Planning
Lay out weekly and 28-day meal plans with dates, times, and meal types. Copy last week's plan in one step, clear a day, or jump straight from a planned meal into cooking mode.
Pantry & Shopping
Track pantry stock in purchase batches with expiry dates, storage locations, and purchase prices. Record stock-ins, usage, waste, and adjustments. Generate shopping lists from your plans, automatically subtracting what's already in stock and merging compatible units. Shop with a checklist, edit actual quantities, and explicitly receive purchases into a new pantry batch.
Cook Mode
Cooking starts from a snapshot of the recipe, so edits never disturb a session in progress. Complete or skip steps with a reason, run multiple independent timers with pause and resume, and schedule local notifications so nothing overcooks.
Track What You Eat
When you finish cooking, confirm actual portions, consumed quantities, and which pantry batches to draw from — the app saves history and deducts stock in one atomic step. Prefer earliest-expiry batches by default, and block the change entirely if stock is insufficient. Manual intake records let you log meals without touching stock. Voiding a cooking record creates compensating stock entries, so your audit trail stays honest.
Nutrition
See nutrition totals based on source-labelled ingredient values per 100 g and the portions you actually ate. When data is missing or a conversion isn't compatible, MealForge says so instead of guessing.
Insights
Review cooking frequency, active cooking time, ingredient usage, purchases, and waste across periods, with comparisons against your own earlier records.
Private by Design
No account, no cloud, no tracking, no ads. Everything lives locally, with full JSON backup including photos, CSV export, and a paginated PDF cooking journal. Photos are chosen through the system document picker — no camera or photo-library permission required.
Whether you cook for one or for a family, MealForge keeps your recipes, your pantry, and your week in sync.

name: MeetHead Companion
description:
Is it safe to knock?

MeetHead Companion tells you, in real time, whether someone is on a call — before you knock, phone them, or wander into frame. It’s the pocket-sized partner to MeetHead for Mac, the menu-bar app that knows the moment a microphone or camera goes live.

HOW IT WORKS
1. On the Mac, open MeetHead and choose Mobile Sharing → Show QR code.
2. On your iPhone, scan the code and give the person a name — “Anna”, “Mom”, “Office”.
3. That’s it. Their status follows you everywhere.

WHAT YOU SEE
- On a video call — their camera is on
- On an audio call — just the microphone
- Not on a call — go ahead, knock
- Offline — their Mac isn’t sharing right now

EVERYWHERE YOU LOOK
- iPhone and iPad app with live status for everyone you follow
- Home Screen widgets in small, medium and large sizes
- Apple Watch app, Smart Stack widget and watch-face complications
- Follow several people at once: family, roommates, teammates

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No accounts, no passwords, no ads, no analytics
- Only a simple “busy” signal is shared — never audio, video, or which app is in use
- The names you give people stay on your device
- The Mac’s owner decides who can see their status and can disconnect any phone at any time

WHAT YOU NEED
The person you follow needs MeetHead for Mac with Mobile Sharing turned on. MeetHead Companion shows their status; it doesn’t detect calls on your iPhone itself.

Questions or ideas? Write to siarhei.hromau@icloud.com — we read everything.

name: Meeting Notes Recorder
description:
Meeting Notes Recorder turns a meeting into a clean, readable record — without sending your audio anywhere you do not control.

WHAT IT DOES
- One tap to record, with the transcript appearing while you speak.
- When you stop, the recording becomes a segmented transcript plus a bilingual summary (Chinese + English).
- A searchable library of every meeting, with timestamps you can tap to jump to a line.
- A live waveform on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, so you can tell recording is still running with the screen off.

HOW YOUR AUDIO IS HANDLED
- Audio is stored on this iPhone by default.
- Speech recognition uses Apple's on-device engine by default.
- Only if you add your own third-party transcription key in Settings does audio go to that service — your account, your terms.
- No sign-in, no analytics SDK, no advertising.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Designed for iOS 18 or later.
- On-device recognition depends on the language pack installed under iOS Settings > General > Keyboard > Dictation.
- Long meetings are saved incrementally, so a low battery or accidental swipe will not lose what you already recorded.

name: Meltemi Weather
description:
Meltemi Weather shows the forecast where you are and for up to 15 places you choose: home, family abroad, your next trip.

Switch between places with a tap on the city tabs, or swipe. Each place opens on today's conditions, with a 24-hour temperature chart, the chance of rain hour by hour, and the week ahead.

Each place has its own landscape illustration that changes with the weather and the time of day, and a flag for its country.

Wind gets its own panel. A compass shows the direction, with speed and gusts in knots too, and the Beaufort force, so you know at a glance whether it is a gentle breeze or a day to stay off the water.

By the sea, a Sea section adds the tide for the next 24 hours with high and low water times, waves, swell, sea temperature and surface current. Sea data is for general information only and is not for navigation.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Feels-like temperature, humidity, UV index, sunrise and sunset
• Moon phase, how much is lit, and the next full and new moon
• Barometer with three-hour tendency, visibility in nautical miles, and nautical dawn and dusk
• Local time at every place you save
• °C and °F
• Search any town or city worldwide, and reorder your list

WORKS OFFLINE
The app keeps the last forecast for each place on your phone and shows it from the current hour when you have no signal.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no advertising and no tracking. Your location is used at about 1 km accuracy only to fetch the forecast, and your list of places stays on your phone.

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com. Sea data generated using E.U. Copernicus Marine Service information.

Not for navigation. Always use official tide tables, charts and forecasts.

name: Memovexa
description:
Clips from a home project, trip, recipe, or skill usually sit in the camera roll mixed with everything else. The moment you wanted later is hard to find. Notes live somewhere else. Progress is easy to forget.

Memovexa is a private video project journal. You keep related clips in named project folders, write notes at exact seconds, mark milestones, and compare an earlier clip with a later one. There is no account and no public feed. Your media stays on this device unless you choose to share it.

How to use Memovexa
Open the app and create a project for the work you are documenting. Import a video from Photos or Files, record a new clip with the camera, or add a direct video file address. Play it in the in-app player. While you watch, add a title and a short note at the current time. Later, tap that note to jump straight back to that second. Add milestones for stages such as materials ready, first pass done, or final result. Open before and after to place two of your own clips side by side, then save the comparison and open it later from that project. Insights show counts from the projects and videos stored on this device, not sample numbers.

A labeled sample clip is included so you can try playback, notes, and background audio right away. You can delete it at any time. Audio can continue when you leave the app, with lock screen play, pause, and skip. Video can continue in a small floating player on supported devices. Full screen background video is not available. Photos import uses the system picker. Direct addresses play from the host you enter. Website pages are not extracted.

Who it is for
Memovexa is for people who document long personal work such as home renovation, DIY, cooking, travel, learning, gardening, creative practice, and product development. It is for anyone who wants a quiet place to keep project video, timestamp notes, and progress, without a social feed. Camera and microphone are used only when you record. There is no advertising and no analytics.

name: Mesh Paint
description:
Mesh Paint keeps the drive mark and the coast mark on one ring gear. Tap the cell where the blue sits. Toe against heel moves the pinion. Both toes open the backlash. Both centers mean the mesh is centered.

Dana 44 is centered. Ford 9 says to move the pinion in. Toyota 8 says to open the backlash. Each axle stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This is the face-hobbed reading, not every tooth form.

name: Meshvirt Agent Console
description:
Meshvirt Agent Console is a client for the coding-agent servers you run yourself. Pair your iPhone or iPad with an Agent Console server on a Mac, Linux box or home server, then follow and steer your agents from anywhere you can reach it.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Follow live agent threads, send follow-up prompts and approve or stop work.
- Review diffs and browse files and code the agent changed.
- Watch terminal and browser previews streamed from your server.
- Get notified when an agent finishes or needs you, with Live Activities and Home Screen widgets for agent activity and subscription usage.
- Dictate prompts with on-device voice input.
- Pair several servers and switch between them.

YOURS, NOT OURS
The app has no accounts, no advertising, no analytics and no tracking. Pairing tokens stay in the iOS Keychain. Your code and conversations go only to the servers you pair with.

REQUIRES
An Agent Console server that you run. The app does not host servers or provide agents by itself. See the support page for how pairing works.

name: Meu Gabinete App
description:
O Meu Gabinete App é o canal oficial entre o mandato do vereador e a população.

O cidadão envia pedidos, sugestões e reclamações pelo link na bio do Instagram, recebe um número de protocolo e acompanha o andamento. O gabinete recebe tudo organizado no app, com aviso no celular e por e-mail a cada nova demanda.

PARA O GABINETE
• Demandas organizadas por status, bairro, categoria e prioridade
• Notificação na hora em que chega um pedido novo
• Resposta ao cidadão e histórico de cada atendimento
• Equipe de assessores com responsáveis por demanda
• Proposições: indicações, requerimentos, moções e projetos, com situação, prazos e PDF na folha timbrada do gabinete
• Notícias do mandato publicadas na página pública
• Relatório mensal e card pronto para o Instagram

PARA O CIDADÃO
• Página pública com o logo e as cores do gabinete
• Envio de pedido com fotos e localização
• Protocolo para acompanhar a resposta

Transparência que aproxima o vereador de quem ele representa.

name: Migrasence: Migraine Diary
description:
Migrasence is a migraine and headache diary for keeping track of your days and reviewing your notes before a doctor's appointment.

At the end of the day, you can talk about what happened: whether you had a headache, when it started and how bad it was. Migrasence fills in the questionnaire from what you say. You can also enter everything yourself.

You can:
• see pain intensity by colour on a calendar
• review statistics for 30 days, 90 days or a year
• see which of your logged factors, such as stress, food or activity, most often coincided with pain
• log several attacks on the same day separately
• add or remove questions
• set an evening reminder
• export a PDF for your doctor with a calendar and a table of attacks

Voice entry and creating a questionnaire from a photo of questions require Sign in with Apple. That data is sent through a server to a cloud model for processing. The rest of the diary works without signing in.

Migrasence is not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. Consult a healthcare professional for medical advice.
