name: Mil: Learn Spanish Words
description:
84% of conversational Spanish is just 1000 words: of every 100 words said in Spanish films and TV, 84 come from the same 1000. Mil teaches you those 1000, most useful first, in sittings of about five minutes.

READ SPANISH ON DAY ONE
Your first six words take about three minutes and end on a sentence you can read: Mi casa es tu casa.

MADE TO STICK
• Every word is a card you can read and hear, with example sentences and a memory tip.
• Words come back just before you would forget them, so they stay with little time.
• Pick your pace, and Today shows the day you will finish.

TRAIN YOUR EAR
• Reviews by ear teach you to catch Spanish when it is spoken, not only to read it.
• Short conversations, made only of words you know, open up as you learn.

MAKE SENSE OF VERBS
• Who and when: short lessons on how the end of a verb tells you who did something, and when.

NO GUILT
• No streaks to break. Miss a day and nothing is lost.
• One optional reminder a day, at a time you pick. It stops if you stop.

NO ACCOUNT. NO ADS.
• Your progress stays on your phone. Save a backup file whenever you like.
• Nothing leaves your phone unless you send it.
• Spanish is spoken by your phone's own voice. Mil never uses the microphone.

Free, with no purchases.

name: Mimisbrunnr
description:
Odin gave an eye for a drink from Mímir's well. All you have to do is answer fifteen questions.

Mimisbrunnr is a quiz about Norse mythology. Each right answer takes you one step up Yggdrasil, from Thrall at the roots to Mímir's Sage at the top. One wrong answer and the tree shakes you down.

CLIMB THE TREE
• Fifteen steps, each harder than the last.
• Two ranks are secured once you reach them: Skald and King. You can't fall below them.
• Walk away before you answer and keep the rank you have.

THREE LIFELINES, ONCE EACH
• Huginn and Muninn: the ravens remove two wrong answers.
• Ask the thing: see how the assembly votes.
• Mímir's head: a whispered hint.

LEARN SOMETHING EVERY TIME
Every answer is followed by a short explanation and its source. All 300 questions are checked against the Poetic Edda, Snorri's Edda or the sagas. They cover eight subjects: Æsir and Vanir, giants and beings, the nine worlds, creation and Ragnarök, objects and animals, heroes and sagas, the sources and how they reached us, and traces of the myths today.

MIMISBRUNNR PRO
The classic game and every category are free. One purchase unlocks the rest, with no ads and no subscription:
• Daily walk: the same fifteen questions for every player, one try a day.
• Ragnarok: fifteen seconds a question and no lifelines.
• Your round history, and how often you reach each rank.
• All badges.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your statistics stay on your device.

In English and Norwegian, for iPhone and iPad.

name: Min bolig – fra EIVO
description:
Min bolig er appen for deg som leier en bolig der utleieren bruker EIVO.

I appen finner du:
• Info om boligen og leiligheten din
• Wifi-navn og passord, klare til å kopiere
• Hjelp når noe skjer: strømbrudd, tett sluk, vannlekkasje, brann og mer
• Praktisk info om søppel, postkasser, vaskemaskin og annet utleieren har lagt inn
• Meldinger direkte til utleieren, gjerne med bilde
• Fellesmeldinger fra utleieren, for eksempel om vannstopp eller vedlikehold
• Nødnumre med ett trykk

SLIK LOGGER DU INN
Utleieren din legger inn e-postadressen din. Du skriver den inn i appen og får en engangskode på e-post. Du trenger ikke noe passord.

Appen er gratis for leietakere. Tilgangen gjelder så lenge du bor i boligen, og du kan slette kontoen din når du vil under Profil.

Hjelp: eivo.no/min-bolig
Personvern: eivo.no/min-bolig/personvern

name: Mind Clash: Party Games
description:
Mind Clash brings your favorite party, card and board games together in one app. Create a room, invite friends with a code and play in real time — or jump into a public match.

GAMES
• Quiz Duel — fast trivia battles, head to head
• Mafia and Spy — bluff, accuse and find the impostor
• Who Am I? and Explain It — party word games
• Draw & Guess — sketch and let others guess
• Chess — full rules with bullet, blitz, rapid and classical clocks
• Durak and Belka — classic card games
• Battleship and Tanks — battle your friends

PLAY TOGETHER
• Private rooms with a join code or public rooms
• Group chats, friends and gifts
• Notifications when friends invite you or send gifts

GROW
• Earn coins and XP in every match
• Climb the rating, XP and weekly wins leaderboards
• Unlock avatar frames and gifts in the shop
• Star your favorite games so they always come first

MADE FOR YOU
• English, Russian and Kazakh interface
• Show your country flag next to your name
• Try 3 games as a guest, then sign in with Apple, Google or phone

Questions or ideas? Reach us through the Support page.

name: MineOrbit: Sphere Minesweeper
description:
A familiar puzzle. A whole new dimension.

Explore a rotating 3D planet or enjoy a classic square board. MineOrbit brings a fresh perspective to Minesweeper—with puzzles verified to be solvable by logic, a progressive Logic Coach, and a richly detailed world.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Sphere: explore connected clues across a rotating 3D globe.
• Classic: solve familiar square boards with eight-direction adjacency. Fit the whole board on screen or zoom in for precise play.

Both modes share intuitive gestures and save their progress separately.

A PLANET OF CONNECTED CLUES
Play across a globe made of hexagons and pentagons. Rotate and zoom to follow clues around its surface. This is a spherical puzzle, not simply a flat board with a 3D appearance.

SIMPLE, SHARED CONTROLS
• Tap to reveal.
• Double-tap to add or remove a flag.
• Hold and release to add or remove a question mark.
• Double-tap a revealed clue to clear unmarked neighbors when the flag count matches.

Flags are your deductions—incorrect flags can still trigger a mine.

THINK, DON’T GUESS
Every newly generated puzzle is verified to have a complete logical solution from its safe opening. Mines stay fixed throughout play. Combine neighboring clues and the total mine count to work out your next move.

LEARN THE REASONING
Need a little help? The Logic Coach offers guidance in stages: relevant clues, an explanation of the deduction, and then a proven move. Choose how much help to reveal.

A WORLD THAT COMES ALIVE
Uncover recessed earth beneath rounded green tiles. Read dimensional clue numbers, plant waving red flags, and watch reveal animations spread across the globe. Detailed materials and particle effects bring every game to life.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Choose from several difficulty levels, try a Daily Globe, learn through guided practice, and review your moves after a loss. Track your achievements with local records.

name: Minha Paróquia: Igreja e Fiéis
description:
Minha Paróquia reúne a vida da sua comunidade em um só aplicativo: avisos, eventos, pastorais, catequese, Bíblia, liturgia do dia e oração.

PARA TODA A COMUNIDADE
• Avisos e notícias da paróquia
• Agenda de missas e eventos, com inscrição pelo app (e pagamento por Pix, quando o evento for pago)
• Liturgia do dia e Bíblia em vários idiomas, com latim e grego
• Fé e oração: orações em vários idiomas, Santo Terço guiado, Liturgia das Horas, preparação para a confissão, exame de consciência, catecismo e lembretes de oração
• Vídeos, áudios e materiais para baixar
• Quizzes sobre a fé
• Dízimo e ofertas, com relatório anual das suas contribuições
• Pedidos de oração e intenções de missa
• Pedido de batismo, casamento, crisma e confissão, com a lista de documentos de cada um
• Chamadas para voluntários

PARA PASTORAIS E MINISTÉRIOS
• Mural, materiais por escrito e tarefas de cada pastoral
• Escalas de leitores, coroinhas, ministros e canto, com confirmação de presença
• Catequese: turmas, catequizandos, chamada a cada encontro e materiais de aula

PARA A SECRETARIA E A EQUIPE
• Quermesse: barracas, produtos, vendas, maquininhas, despesas e prestação de contas
• Inscrições e lista de presença em eventos
• Ação social: famílias assistidas, entradas e saídas de cestas básicas
• Aniversários e datas especiais da comunidade

Os dados de cada paróquia ficam separados e protegidos: cada pessoa só acessa o que a sua função permite. Os dados de crianças da catequese só aparecem para a secretaria e para os catequistas da turma.

Para entrar, crie sua conta e escolha a sua paróquia. O aplicativo é gratuito para os fiéis.

Aplicativo independente, sem vínculo oficial com a CNBB ou a Santa Sé.

name: Mini Chant for Friends
description:
Turn your friends, chants and match day moments into one place. Mini Chant for Friends is a creative iPhone app for building group chants, rehearsing them with a rhythm guide, recording performances, and saving every take alongside photos and memories. No account needed, no sign in, just start creating on one device.

Whether you are getting ready for a game, planning a trip, or capturing a night with mates, this app helps you organise the whole experience from first line to final recording.

Key features
- Build custom chants - create a title, choose a cover photo, pick a crew, and shape each line your way.
- Assign parts to friends - give lines to one person, several people, or everyone for easy group delivery.
- Rehearse with confidence - use Manual or Auto mode, a simple metronome, tempo controls, and countdown start.
- Record and refine takes - capture audio from the microphone or import a file, then trim the start and end, rename it, and mark the best take.
- Save chants with events - link recordings to matches, trips and get-togethers, plus keep photos, notes and participants together.
- Create photo memories - browse images in an event, tag friends by hand, and revisit a moment while the linked audio keeps playing.
- Keep everything local - works offline, stores your media on the device, and supports export and restore of your full archive.

Perfect for
- Footy days, club nights and other loud moments with mates
- Planning chants before a match, then saving the best performance afterwards
- Turning group photos and audio into a private memory album
- Anyone who wants a simple chant builder and voice record app without sign up

Why choose us
Mini Chant for Friends is designed as a proper chant builder, not a chat app or a music studio. It focuses on the full cycle: create a chant, rehearse it, record it, and connect it to the people and events that matter. With local storage, offline access, flexible roles for each line, and memory-friendly event albums, it gives you a private way to keep your crew's best moments in one organised place.

Start building your first chant, record a take, and save the memories that go with it.

name: Minute Bay-Focus Timer
description:
Make your next focus session a little voyage.

Choose a route, set your time, and let your boat sail while you study, work, read, or write. Minute Bay pairs a flexible focus timer with ocean scenery, gentle sounds, and wildlife to discover along the way.

FOCUS AT YOUR OWN PACE
Set a countdown from 1 to 180 minutes, or use open-ended timing and finish when you are ready. Try a 25-minute study session, then take a break before your next voyage. A sound marks the end of your countdown.

THREE ROUTES TO EXPLORE
Sail sunlit Golden Bay, explore the luminous waters of Jade Garden, or venture into Misty Abyss with its ghostly ship and mysterious islands. Change the weather and time of day to suit your mood.

YOUR OWN OCEAN SOUNDS
Mix waves and rain. Adjust their volume and intensity independently to find a soundscape that feels right for you.

A JOURNAL OF SMALL DISCOVERIES
Watch for birds, fish, and passing islands. Keep wildlife sightings in your illustrated voyage journal, with rarer creatures to look out for over time.

ROOM TO CONCENTRATE
Hide the controls for an uncluttered sea view. Your session continues when you lock your device or switch apps. Enjoy portrait or landscape on iPhone and iPad.

ONE PURCHASE
No subscriptions, no ads, and no account required.

A little time. A little voyage.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: MinuteMeld
description:
Turn a meeting into a useful record of what was discussed, what was decided and who will do the next step.

BUILD THE AGENDA
Create a meeting with a date and participant aliases. Add topics, arrange their order and write discussion notes. Keep each decision connected to its original meeting and topic.

FOLLOW THE ACTION
Record an action with an owner alias, optional due date and progress note. Open, Done and Cancelled are separate states. The action board filters each state and identifies overdue open items.

CARRY CONTEXT FORWARD
In the next meeting, explicitly select open actions from another meeting. The new meeting links to the same original action instead of creating a second task. Updating that action updates its current state wherever it is referenced.

SAVE MINUTES THAT STAY PUT
Capture an independent version of a meeting, including its topics, discussion, decisions and action states at that moment. Later edits do not rewrite captured minutes. Generate complete PDF or CSV files and share them with the system share sheet.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR RECORDS
Archive meetings without automatically completing their actions. Make JSON backups, restore a validated library or erase local data. Records are stored on the device, with no account, advertising or subscription. System backups may contain app data, and shared files are separate copies.

MinuteMeld is for manually entered notes and aliases. It does not record audio, transcribe speech, invite participants, send reminders or verify an owner's identity.

name: Mirror: How others see you
description:
How do people really see you?

Mirror lets you ask the people you know — friends, colleagues, anyone — to rate you anonymously on a few simple qualities. No sign-up for them, no names, no pressure.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose your questions: kindness, trust, charm — or a full Personal or Professional feedback set.
2. Send the link. People answer on a simple web page with a 1–10 scale. It takes under a minute.
3. Rate yourself, privately. Only you see it.
4. After 3 answers, see your results and compare them with your own view.

WHAT YOU GET
• Average score for every question
• Each answer on its own, without names or times
• Your hidden strength — where people rate you higher than you rate yourself
• Your blind spot — where they rate you lower
• Separate question sets for different people: friends, team, anyone

ANONYMOUS BY DESIGN
Answers are never linked to who gave them. Results open only after at least 3 answers, and answer times are never shown.

name: Mirthvale Circus
description: Relight a travelling circus through five acts. Knock over figures topped with bells, catch lanterns at the right moment and guide an aerialist toward a safety net. Strike the bell tower and pick out the right toys in the gallery. Earn Applause for costumes, follow the troupe through the story and try a daily challenge. Several acts offer a step by step mode, and the game works offline.

name: Mixtape Builder
description:
Mixtape Builder turns a sentence into a playlist.

Type or say what you want to hear: "Eminem, MIA, and artists with a similar vibe," "upbeat campfire songs with acoustic guitar, no country," or "a summer playlist with a Caribbean vibe, mixing my library with new music." Mixtape finds the songs, saves the playlist to your library, and starts playing.

• Speak or type your request
• Mixes songs you love with music that's new to you
• Every mixtape is saved so you can replay it anytime
• Hey Siri, Make Mixtape — hands-free
• Mixtapes and settings sync across your devices with iCloud
• A retro cassette deck you'll actually want to look at

Requires an Apple Music subscription.

name: Mobile Darts Scorer
description:
Mobile Darts Scorer from Lets Play Dartz turns your phone into a simple, clear darts scoreboard.

PLAY A FRIEND
• 301, 501 and 701 games – first to or best of any number of legs
• Big, easy-to-hit keypad plus one-tap scores (26, 45, 60, 100, 140, 180)
• Checkout suggestions when you're on a finish
• Asks how many darts you used on a checkout, so your averages are right
• Undo any mistake
• Live 3-dart averages, 100+, 140+, 180s, best leg and highest checkout
• Keeps your screen awake during a match

PRACTICE
• Play the computer – six opponents from beginner (about 40 average) to expert (about 90 average)
• Ageless Accuracy – throw at treble 20, enter your scores and get instant tips on grouping and consistency

PLAY AS A GUEST OR SIGN IN
Play straight away as a guest – nothing is saved. Or sign in with your free Lets Play Dartz account and your matches and practice sessions are saved to your stats on the Lets Play Dartz website.

Leagues, tournaments and online play are on the Lets Play Dartz website.

name: Mobile Massage - Home Spa
description:
Mobile Massage connects you with verified, independent massage therapists near you. Book a relaxing session at home, or visit the therapist at their own place, all from one app.
 
FOR CLIENTS
• Find massage therapists near you and see who's online now
• Choose a home visit or a session at the therapist's place
• Filter by massage type and by therapist gender
• Compare treatments, durations and prices before you book
• Read reviews from other clients
• Ask a therapist a question before you book
• Pay securely by card. Your card is only charged when the therapist accepts
• Chat, share photos and your location, and call your therapist in the app, without sharing your phone number
 
VERIFIED THERAPISTS
Every therapist goes through identity checks before they can take bookings: a photo of their ID, a live selfie check that matches their ID, and proof of training or a business licence. Our team reviews each application.
 
FOR MASSAGE THERAPISTS
• Apply in a few minutes and get verified
• Create listings with your treatments, prices and service area
• Offer home visits, sessions at your place, or both
• Go online when you're ready to take bookings
• Accept or decline each request
• Chat and call clients in the app, without sharing your number
• Track your earnings and request payouts to your bank account, mobile money or a US dollar account
 
SAFETY AND PRIVACY
• Phone numbers and emails stay private between clients and therapists
• In-app calls are not recorded
• Sign in with Face ID, auto-lock, and 2-step verification
• Therapist accounts get an extra sign-in check and can use an authenticator app
• Help is one tap away: chat with our support team in the app
 
Mobile Massage is for professional, non-medical massage only, for people aged 18 and over. Massage is not a substitute for medical advice; if you have a health condition or are pregnant, check with your doctor first.
 
Questions? Chat with us in the app (Account → Help & support).

name: Modzen
description:
Modzen keeps your modelling profile in one place and always up to date, so you are ready the moment a casting replies.

BUILD IT ONCE
• Photos and digitals, with your best shots picked out
• Measurements, saved with the date you recorded them
• Headline, bio, city, categories and languages
• Social links and custom buttons for your portfolio or anything else

SHARE IN ONE TAP
• A living link that always shows your latest profile
• A public page at modzen.vercel.app/your-name that casting teams can open with no login
• Your own QR code to scan
• Your details, formatted and ready to paste into any message
• A comp card you can flip and send as an image

STAY ORGANISED
• Track each casting from applied to shortlisted, booked and shot
• A safety checklist for spotting common casting scams

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your public page never shows your phone number, email or measurements
• No ads and no tracking
• Delete your account and everything in it, including your public page, from inside the app at any time

Sign in with Apple, Google or email. Free to use.

Privacy Policy: https://modzen.vercel.app/privacy
Support: https://modzen.vercel.app/support

name: Mojicopi
description:
Mojicopi lets you copy the text on your screen with one button. Text in another language can be translated right where it is.

■ Freeze the screen with one button
• Launch it with a shortcut from the Action Button or Back Tap (set up once in the Shortcuts app; steps are in the app).
• Works on apps that won't let you select text and on playing videos — the moment is frozen and read.

■ Select and copy
• Select text with your finger and copy it.
• Copy all the text on the screen at once.
• Links, emails, phone numbers, and dates on the screen can be copied with one button.
• Draw around an area to copy it as an image.

■ Translate in place (iOS 18 or later)
• Tap Translate and the translation appears right where the text was. Hold the screen to peek at the original.
• Select text first to translate just that part and copy it.
• Translate into your device language, or choose Japanese, English, Chinese, Korean, French, German, or Spanish.

■ Privacy
• Text recognition and translation run on your device. Nothing is sent to any server.
• The frozen screen is never saved, so screenshots don't pile up in Photos.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no account.
• One-time purchase. No subscription.

name: Momo: Math
description:
Pick a topic, start a 60-second round and answer as many questions as you can. Beat your best, earn medals and level up Momo. No ads. No subscriptions.

WHAT YOU CAN PRACTICE
- Basics: add, subtract, multiply and divide
- Number sense: greatest common factor, least common multiple and squares
- Fractions: simplify fractions and find common denominators
- Percents and ratios: percent of a number, percents and fractions, and ratios

Every topic has Easy, Medium and Hard. Adding and subtracting also have a Starter level for beginners. Each non-basic topic has a short How to solve lesson with a worked example, so you can learn the method before you play.

MIX IT UP
Every group has its own mix, and there is a mix of everything when you want a bit of it all.

MAKE IT YOURS
Earn medals from Bronze to Platinum, keep a daily streak and unlock new colors, faces and rings for Momo as you level up.

ON EVERY DEVICE
Momo Math works on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, and your progress syncs through iCloud.

name: Montréal·Life
description:
Montréal is an island, a French-speaking metropolis and four different cities, one for each season. Montréal·Life tells you why it looks, sounds and eats the way it does, then helps you go and see it.

One app, three parts, each with its own look.

HISTORY: THE FILM
• Nine scenes, from Tiohtià:ke to today, each with where to see it now
• The city in six numbers: 2 languages, 1 island, 4 true seasons, 68 Métro stations, 100+ festivals a year and a 233-metre mountain

DISCOVER: THE LINE
• Nine neighbourhoods laid out as stops on one Métro line: Vieux-Montréal, Centre-ville, Le Plateau, Mile End, Petite-Italie, Mont Royal, the Lachine Canal, Parc Jean-Drapeau and the Olympic Park
• At every stop: what happened there, what to see and where to eat, with the Métro station to get off at
• A heritage stop with three houses that have been welcoming people for generations

PLAN: THE TRIP
• When to come: the four seasons, month by month
• See and do, what to eat, and the practical side: getting in, getting around, language, money
• My trip: tap + on any place to keep a shortlist for your stay

MADE TO TRAVEL WITH
• Works offline: the stories and every photo are saved on your device after the first launch
• English and French, light and dark
• Free. No account, no ads, no tracking. Your shortlist never leaves your device

Photographs are from Wikimedia Commons and credited inside the app.

Comments, corrections or requests: support@montreal-life.app

A ThinkAhead Corporation initiative.
Privacy Policy: https://thinkahead.tech/legal/privacy.html

name: Moonbridge: RAW Photo Import
description:
Moonbridge brings RAW photos from your camera to your iPhone, quickly and safely, without a computer.

Plug in a USB-C card reader or connect your camera with a cable. Moonbridge shows every photo on the card, grouped by day, using the preview the camera saved inside each RAW, so even a big card is ready to browse in seconds. Pick the shots you want, or drag across a row to select many at once, and import.

SAFE COPIES
• Every file is checked after copying, so what lands on your iPhone matches the card byte for byte
• Photos you've already imported are recognised and never copied twice
• Pull the card out mid-import, put it back, and Moonbridge picks up where it left off
• Imports keep going while you switch to another app
• RAW+JPEG pairs stay together as one photo
• Originals are never changed, and you can see them in the Files app

YOUR LIBRARY
• A grid by capture day, in each photo's own time zone
• Full-screen viewer with pinch to zoom; zoom in and the full-resolution RAW loads
• Switch between the RAW and the camera's JPEG of a pair
• Info panel with camera, lens, aperture, shutter, ISO, focal length and a map for photos with location
• Star ratings, pick and reject flags, and the color labels Lightroom uses
• Filter by date range, camera, lens, rating, flag and color label
• Sort by date or rating, then by the other

SHARE AND EXPORT
• Save to Photos, with a RAW+JPEG pair kept as one photo
• Save the originals to Files, or share them to other apps

RAW FILES
Moonbridge reads RAW files from Sony, Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Leica, Hasselblad, OM System, Pentax, Ricoh and DNG, along with JPEG and HEIF. Previews are developed with Apple's RAW engine; for a camera it doesn't support yet, Moonbridge shows the JPEG the camera saved inside the file.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Moonbridge has no account, no tracking and no servers. It never uploads your photos anywhere; they leave your device only when you share them.

Free, with no ads. Everything Moonbridge does today stays free.

name: Mossdoku
description:
A little garden for your mind.

Mossdoku is a relaxing logic puzzle game filled with cheerful moss creatures, illustrated landscapes and gentle music. Find the right home for every moss, one thoughtful move at a time.

A SIMPLE RULE, A GROWING CHALLENGE
Place one moss in each row, column and coloured region. Mosses cannot touch, even diagonally. An interactive tutorial helps you learn directly on the board.

250 GARDENS TO EXPLORE
Discover a mixed trail of Easy, Tricky and Hard puzzles, with grids from 6 × 6 to 10 × 10. Every fifth garden brings a Hard challenge, with a friendly introduction and a special celebration when you finish.

MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME
Play in portrait or landscape on iPhone and iPad. Enjoy three gentle ambient music themes and adjust music, sound effects and vibration separately. Your progress saves on your device between visits.

A LITTLE HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Earn stars, revisit favourite gardens and improve your best scores. Your first three-star finish in each Tricky or Hard garden earns one hint. Hints highlight a useful square without placing the moss for you.

PLAY OFFLINE
All gardens, artwork and music are included. No account or internet connection is needed to play.

Free to download, with no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases in this version.

Support: mossdoku@upprov.com

name: Motion VMS Guard
description:
Motion VMS Guard is the gatehouse app for security officers at estates and complexes that use Motion VMS visitor management by Motion Kulca. It is for estate security staff only: your supervisor gives you a sign-in.

SIGN IN
• Sign in with the email registered for your post — we send a one-time sign-in code — or with your username and password
• Built for phones and handhelds used at the gate

VISITORS AND VEHICLES
• Scan a resident's QR pass or key in the visitor PIN
• Scan a licence disc to fill in plate, make, model and colour
• Scan a driver's licence barcode to check the visitor's details
• Record entry and exit, number of passengers, and open the boom
• Walk-in visitors: ask the resident to approve from their app

PATROLS, PARCELS AND INCIDENTS
• Patrols with checkpoint scans; missed checkpoints are flagged to the supervisor
• Receive parcels for residents, who are told straight away and get a collection code
• Log incidents with photos
• Radio between guards on the estate

PANIC ALARMS
• Resident SOS alerts sound a loud alarm on the guard device until a guard acknowledges it

KEEPS WORKING OFFLINE
• Signed QR passes still verify when the network drops, and check-ins sync when it is back

Privacy policy: https://motionkulca.co.za/motion-vms/privacy/
Made in South Africa by Motion Kulca (Pty) Ltd. Help: info@motionkulca.co.za or 087 711 0020.

name: Movilidad Burgos
description:
¿Cuánto le falta a tu autobús? Movilidad Burgos te lo dice al momento, con los datos en directo del servicio de autobuses urbanos de Burgos.

LLEGADAS EN TIEMPO REAL
Consulta cualquier parada y ve cuántos minutos faltan para cada autobús, con una cuenta atrás que se actualiza sola. Los colores te avisan cuando el bus está a punto de llegar.

MAPA EN DIRECTO
Sigue la posición de los autobuses sobre el mapa, con la dirección en la que circulan. Elige qué líneas ver, consulta su recorrido y toca cualquier parada para ver sus próximas llegadas.

PARADAS CERCANAS
Encuentra las paradas más próximas a tu ubicación o búscalas por nombre o número.

HORARIOS
Consulta los horarios programados de cada línea por fecha y sentido, y mira a qué hora pasa por cada parada.

FAVORITOS
Guarda tus paradas y líneas habituales y ve de un vistazo sus próximos autobuses.

WIDGET PARA LA PANTALLA DE INICIO
Ten tus paradas favoritas siempre a mano sin abrir la app. El widget se adapta al tamaño que elijas y se actualiza solo.

Y ADEMÁS
• Tema claro y oscuro automático
• Sin registro ni cuentas
• Sin anuncios
• Tus favoritos se guardan solo en tu móvil

Aviso: Movilidad Burgos es una aplicación independiente y no oficial. No está vinculada al Ayuntamiento de Burgos ni a ninguna entidad pública. Los datos proceden de las fuentes públicas del Ayuntamiento de Burgos (https://www.aytoburgos.es/web/movilidad/rutas-en-directo) y su exactitud depende de ellas.

Mapa © colaboradores de OpenStreetMap.

name: Mr Shankerton: Golf Side Games
description:
The golf app for your mates, your society and your golf trips. Mr Shankerton keeps the score for the whole group, settles the side games, gives you the yardages on your phone and your Apple Watch, and has something to say about every bad hole.

Pay once. No subscription, no adverts, no accounts.

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
Most golf apps are about you and your handicap. Mr Shankerton is about the group. Everyone's phone shows the same live leaderboard, Skins, Nassau and Wolf settle themselves, and the commentator makes sure nobody forgets the shank on the 7th. His lines pop up as the scores go in and land on everyone's lock screen and Watch, so the banter reaches the other fourball before they reach the clubhouse.

SCORE THE WHOLE GROUP
• One phone scores the fourball. Eight of you? One round, two groups, one leaderboard.
• Handicap shots on every hole, worked out the World Handicap System way.
• Stableford, net and gross leaderboards, plus optional putts, fairways, bunkers and penalties.
• Works without signal and catches up when you are back in range.

27 SIDE GAMES, SETTLED FOR YOU
Skins, Nassau with auto-presses, Wolf (with Lone and Blind Wolf), Vegas, Sixes, Nines, Bingo Bango Bongo, Snake, Rabbit, Banker, Hammer, Quota, Match Play, Fourball Better Ball, Team Stableford, Yellow Ball, Nearest the Pin, Longest Drive and more, with Scramble, Foursomes, Greensomes and Chapman for team days.
• Stack several games on one round.
• Plain-English rules and a worked example for every game.
• A points tally shows who is up and who is down once everything is added together.

APPLE WATCH
• Front, middle and back of the green and the next hazard, on your wrist.
• The hole moves on as you walk to the next tee.
• Enter your group's scores from the Watch.
• Your round is recorded as a golf workout in the Health app, so it counts towards your activity.

GPS ON THE PHONE
• Satellite view of every hole with distances to the green, hazards to reach and carry, and tap-to-measure lay-ups.
• Mark your shots to see how far you really hit each club.
• 17 UAE courses mapped hole by hole, from Dubai and Abu Dhabi to Sharjah, Ajman and Ras Al Khaimah. Add any other course from its scorecard and pin each green.

GOLF TRIPS AND SEASONS
• Ryder Cup between two teams, with a point for every match.
• Total Stableford, total net or eclectic across the whole trip.
• A season-long Order of Merit for your society.
• Belong to several societies, such as your regulars and the lads back home, and switch with a tap.

MR SHANKERTON HIMSELF
• Commentary on birdies, snowmen, three-putts and collapses, popping up as it happens.
• Awards after every round, from Champion Golfer of the Day to the Wooden Spoon.
• Dares between holes, and a scouting report on every player.
• Three settings for his tongue: Gentle, Cheeky and Savage.

PLAY AGAINST A PRO
On courses that host tour events, add a professional's real tournament scorecard to your round and see how far behind you are, hole by hole.

STATS AND HANDICAPS, IF YOU WANT THEM
Fairways, greens, putts and up-and-downs, club distances, a report card against golfers of your handicap, and an app handicap worked out from your rounds.

Good to know: handicap figures in the app are unofficial. Mr Shankerton keeps a tally of points for your games; he does not take bets, hold stakes or move money.

name: Mutt Dog Against the World
description:
Paçoca is small. He blames his brother. But small does not mean tame.

Every night, at 9 o'clock sharp, a possum crosses the backyard and the cookie is gone. Paçoca has had enough. The plan is simple: save up and buy the cookie factory, once and for all.

Mutt Dog Against the World is a pixel art platformer in the spirit of the 16-bit classics, made for iPhone and set in Granja Viana, Brazil.

WHAT IS IN THE GAME

• 16 acts in Granja Viana: the backyard, the street, the dark woods of Possum Valley, the marmosets' trees and power lines, garbage day, the landfill, the cookie factory and a temple where biting is not allowed.
• TRIP TO PIRASSUNUNGA, free and already included: 3 more acts in the countryside, with a sugarcane juice mill, a cane field and a jaguar loose in the supermarket.
• TWO PLAYABLE DOGS: Paçoca, the caramel mutt, and Bongo, a country dog. Switch whenever you like.
• RUN, JUMP AND BITE. Downhill he picks up speed. In the air he knocks down whatever flies. On the ground, a bite settles it.
• ZOOMIES. Turn into a ball of fur, roll and smash through crates.
• TORNADO. A mid-air spin that hits both sides.
• STRATEGIC PEE. Mark a tree and it is his. Mark a lamp post and it becomes a checkpoint.
• 6 BOSSES, EACH WITH A TRICK. A possum who plays dead. A marmoset king who only falls if you shake the tree. A garbage truck that does not like walls. A jaguar you never face head-on.
• RESCUE ANA CATARINA. He even forgets to growl when she shows up.
• A COLLECTION OF 19 WEARABLE ITEMS. A crown, a raincoat, a straw hat, a factory owner's suit. All of them are earned by playing.
• SHORT SCENES IN THE MIDDLE OF THE LEVELS, with close-ups and angry-dog humor.
• AN 8-BIT SOUNDTRACK THAT CHANGES WITH THE SCENE. Tense in a fight, dark in the woods, sweet at the reunion.
• EASY MODE (5 hearts) and checkpoints along the way.

AN HONEST GAME

• No ads.
• No in-app purchases.
• Works offline.
• Collects no data. Your progress is saved only on your device.
• In Portuguese and English. You can change the language in the game's settings.

A game by Lucas and Vinícius. Dedicated to Paçoca.

name: N-Mate
description:
N-Mate is NMDC Group's work assistant, in your pocket. Sign in with your NMDC Group account — the same as the AI Hub — and carry on the conversations you started on the web.

• Ask in your own words and get answers with the references they came from — open a reference to see the page it quotes.
• Send photos and files: a drawing, a nameplate, a delivery note, a report. N-Mate reads them for your question.
• Speak instead of typing — the microphone turns your words into text as you talk.
• Call N-Mate and talk, in English or Arabic.
• MeetingMate records a meeting, even with the screen locked, and gives you who said what, the minutes and the actions.
• Get files back: Word, Excel and PowerPoint made for you, saved in your files.
• Your agents, tools, schedules and memory, as on the web — a scheduled task tells you when it is done.
• Notifications when an answer is ready, so you can put the phone away while N-Mate works.
• Read your recent conversations offline, and lock the app with Face ID.

N-Mate is for NMDC Group staff: you need an NMDC Group account to sign in. Everything it does for you runs on NMDC Group's own servers.

name: Naadamy
description:
Naadamy is a family game where children, parents and friends learn Mongolian heritage together.

Step into Nutag, a pixel-art Mongolian village. Your companion Basar, a friendly Mongolian bankhar dog, follows you everywhere. Ask Basar anything about Mongolian history, customs and The Secret History of the Mongols, and play quizzes together.

LEARN BY PLAYING
• Build a traditional Mongolian ger, piece by piece
• Make white foods (tsagaan idee) from fresh milk
• Learn the customs and etiquette of the ger
• Hear stories from The Secret History of the Mongols
• Practice the traditional Mongol script

PLAY TOGETHER
• Play in the same village with family and friends
• Race horses, go fishing and dress up your character
• Earn badges, stamps and XP, and climb the family board

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• A parent dashboard protected by a parent PIN
• A family code lets each child continue on another device
• A voice memory book to record and replay family moments
• Optional weekly progress email for parents

Then take what you learned off the screen: build, cook and celebrate together in real life.

Available in Mongolian and English.

name: Naena Draw AI
description:
Always wanted to draw? Naena Draw AI turns drawing into short, friendly lessons that anyone can follow — no talent or experience needed.

WATCH IT, THEN DRAW IT
Every lesson is split into a few simple steps. Watch the step being drawn in pink, then draw it yourself. Replay it, slow it down, or have the steps read out loud.

DRAW ON SCREEN OR ON PAPER
Use your finger or Apple Pencil with pencil, pen, marker and eraser tools, and turn on the tracing guide while you learn. Prefer a real pencil? Choose paper mode, follow along, then add a photo of your drawing.

GET A SCORE AND TIPS
When you finish a drawing on screen, the app compares your lines with the lesson's shapes and shows how much you covered, how accurate your lines were, and which step to practise next. Earn up to three stars.

A PATH MADE FOR YOU
Pick what you love — animals, nature, cartoons or everyday things — and get a personal learning path, from easy first lines to full scenes.

KEEP EVERY DRAWING
Your journal saves every finished drawing. Add stickers and notes, add photos of drawings you made anywhere, and share your favourites.

BUILD A HABIT
Set a daily goal, keep your streak alive, level up and collect badges as you improve.

FREE PLAYGROUND
Draw anything you like, with fun ideas when you need inspiration.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your drawings and progress stay on your device.

Lessons include a friendly fish, sleepy cat, wise owl, spiral snail, fluffy tree, sunflower, mountain sunset, rocket, ghost, cupcake, little house and coffee cup.

name: Nalsae - Remote PC Control
description:
Nalsae is a remote desktop app that lets you control your Windows PC or Mac from your iPhone or iPad. Use the screen like a trackpad: move the cursor, tap to click, and swipe with two fingers to scroll.

Before you start
• Install Nalsae on the PC you want to control (Windows or Mac). You can get it at nalsae.com.
• The PC needs to be turned on and connected to the internet.
• Sign in with a Google, Apple, or Kakao account, or with your email.
• The first time, you’ll finish a tutorial on a practice PC screen. Watch a demo of each gesture, then try it yourself. You don’t need a PC for this, and nothing is sent to any PC.
• Once you register your iPhone or iPad as one of your devices, just tap a PC on the home screen to connect.

Touch controls that come naturally
• Trackpad: move the cursor with one finger. Tap to click, double-tap to double-click.
• Long-press and drag to move files and windows. Tap with two fingers to right-click, tap with three fingers to middle-click, and swipe with two fingers to scroll.
• Pinch to zoom in. The cursor stays in the center and the view moves with it, so even small text is easy to read.
• Direct touch: clicks right where you touch. Handy for large buttons.
• Open the gesture card anytime to see all gestures at a glance. You can also adjust the cursor speed.

Two keyboards
• Text bar: type with your usual keyboard and send the whole text to the PC at once. Since you finish typing before you send, text in your own language arrives exactly as you typed it, whatever input method the PC uses.
• PC keyboard: an on-screen keyboard that sends each key to the PC the moment you press it. It switches to a Windows or Mac layout to match the PC and includes F1–F12, arrow keys, and a number pad.
• Frequently used keys, such as switching windows or taking a screenshot, are one tap away in the menu.

Monitors and screen
• If the PC has more than one monitor, jump to the next one or view all monitors on one screen, and keep working right there.
• Switch between landscape and portrait, fit the view to the screen, pick the picture quality, and hear the PC’s sound.
• Get text copied on the PC on your iPhone or iPad, and paste text copied on your iPhone or iPad into the PC.

Peace of mind
• Only devices you’ve registered as your devices can connect to your PC.
• The screen and your input are encrypted and travel only between your iPhone or iPad and your PC.
• Turn on App lock to confirm it’s you with Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode each time you open or return to the app.
• Helping family or friends? Use One-time connection. It opens only after the person at the PC accepts it, and it doesn’t stay in your device list afterward.

Questions? Send them from the Support tab in the app.

name: Namaz Takip - Kaza ve Vakit
description:
Namaz Takip brings qada (missed prayer) tracking, prayer times, a Qibla compass and Quran recitation together in one app. It is completely free, has no ads and needs no account.

QADA TRACKING
• Mark the five daily prayers and witr on a calendar
• See your total missed prayers and what is left at a glance
• Mark excused days separately
• Back up your records and move them to a new phone

PRAYER TIMES
• Times calculated with the Diyanet (Turkey) method
• Choose a city or use your current location
• Reminders when a prayer time begins and before it ends
• Monthly prayer timetable

WIDGET
• Time left to the next prayer on the Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Red warning 15 minutes before the prayer time ends
• All of today's prayer times on the medium widget

QIBLA COMPASS
• Qibla direction based on true north and distance to the Kaaba
• Compass accuracy indicator and calibration help
• Check with the sun: the times when the sun and shadows point to the Qibla

THE HOLY QURAN
• Uthmani text from the Tanzil Project
• Recitation by Mishary Rashid Alafasy; the current verse is highlighted
• Keeps playing with the screen locked and continues to the next surah
• Download surahs to listen offline
• Separate khatm (hatim) tracking and juz progress

This app was made as a charity in loving memory of the late Hüsniye Balcı. If it benefits you, please recite a Fatiha for her.

name: Navalix
description:
Navalix is the classic naval battle game for iPhone and iPad. Challenge a friend on a second device nearby, or play against your iPhone or iPad.

TWO PLAYERS, ANYWHERE
• One player creates a game, the other picks it from the list of nearby games
• Works on the same Wi-Fi, with a Personal Hotspot, or with no network at all: just keep Wi-Fi and Bluetooth turned on
• If the connection drops, or one of you switches to another app for a moment, the game picks up exactly where it left off
• After each game, ask for a rematch: the score is kept

AGAINST THE IPHONE OR IPAD
• Easy, for a relaxed game
• Hard, an opponent that reasons on where your ships can still be hiding

AIM WITH THE CROSSHAIR
• A magnifier on the enemy grid shows the target square and its name, such as D8
• Drag a finger anywhere on the screen to move it, then press the round red button attached to it
• Extra-large crosshair: a bigger magnifier that shows more squares around the target, for those who see poorly
• Prefer the classic way? Turn the crosshair off and fire by tapping the square

CLASSIC RULES
• A 10 × 10 grid and a fleet of five ships: aircraft carrier, battleship, cruiser, submarine and destroyer
• Ships may not touch, not even at a corner
• Drag a ship to move it, tap it to turn it, or let Shuffle place the whole fleet for you
• Squares around a sunk ship are shaded: by the rules they can only be water

SOUNDS AND EFFECTS
• Real recordings: a splash for a miss, an explosion for a hit, and for a sunk ship an explosion with bubbles and a siren
• On screen: drops on the glass, clouds of smoke, thick smoke when a ship goes down
• Vibration with every shot; sounds, vibration and effects can each be turned off

IN ADDITION
• The list of games played: opponent, date, duration, result, shots and accuracy
• Large text and high contrast, designed to be easy to read

FREE AND RESPECTFUL
Navalix is free, has no ads, needs no account and collects no data. The two devices talk only to each other, never to a server.

Available in English, Italian, French, German and Spanish.

name: Nayab Farm
description:
Nayab Farm keeps the day's work on the phone that does it.

Record eggs coop by coop, weigh an animal, give a dose, open a health case, move a group, enter a death — and do it with no signal. Everything is saved on the phone first and sent when the signal returns, exactly once, however many times the connection drops in between.

WHAT IT COVERS
• Animals — every bird and beast, by code, tag, breed, place and life stage
• Eggs — collections per coop, cracked and dirty counted apart
• Health — doses owed against the farm's own plans, cases, treatments, and the withdrawal periods that keep treated meat and eggs out of a sale
• Breeding — mating to delivery for goats and cattle
• Incubation — lots, batches, hatch rates and what each supplier's eggs cost per live chick
• Money — what was spent, what came in, cash in hand, sales
• Tasks — built from the records, not typed by hand
• Insights and reports — where the losses are, over a window you choose

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
Urdu alongside English. Large targets for gloved hands. Figures that say when they could not be loaded instead of showing a confident zero.

Roles decide what each person sees: a worker records the day without seeing what anything cost.

This app is for Nayab Farm's own staff and needs an account on the farm's system.

name: NextTimeNote
description:
Some places you revisit with a blank mind. NextTimeNote pins what you wished you’d remembered — so next time isn’t starting over.

Every spot or situation becomes a scene. You attach short tips: the side door that skips the queue, the form the kiosk won’t replace, the shaded parking row. Must tips rise first; nice tips wait underneath. When you open a scene again, the lines you need are already there.

When you’re heading back, a local reminder can wake the tip before you go.

PIN A SCENE
• Add a scene in seconds: name it, choose a realm — Dining, Travel, Health, Visit, Work, Home or Other
• Leave a place note for the quirk that doesn’t fit a tip yet
• Pin scenes you return to often so they stay close on Hub
• Open a scene desk to read Must Know first, then every tip in one place

WRITE THE TIP
• Capture what to remember next time in plain words
• Mark weight as Must or Nice so the important lines lead
• Tag tips — queue, timing, parking, process, allergy, host, and more — so Lookup finds them fast
• Share a scene’s tip list as plain text when you want a copy outside the app

FIND IT NEXT TIME
• Hub shows scene and tip counts, likely scenes, Must rails, and a full scene ledger
• Browse by realm when you only remember the kind of place
• Lookup searches scenes and tip bodies when the name escapes you
• Tip stream lists every line across scenes when you want the whole fabric

GENTLE NUDGES
• Optional morning digest with a must-tip or a scene to revisit
• Per-scene local reminders at the hour you set

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed — everything stays on your iPhone
• Scenes, tips, tags, and preferences never upload to a NextTimeNote server
• Clear the starter pack or wipe all local data anytime in Cabin
• No ads. No selling of data.

name: Ngôn Ngữ
description:
Ngôn Ngữ là app học ngoại ngữ cho người Việt, chia bài thành từng chặng ngắn để học đều mỗi ngày.

MƯỜI THỨ TIẾNG, MỘT TÀI KHOẢN
Tiếng Anh, Trung, Nhật, Hàn, Pháp, Đức, Nga, Thái, Ý, và tiếng Việt cho người nước ngoài. Chuỗi ngày học và điểm tích luỹ cộng dồn giữa các thứ tiếng.

HỌC THEO CÂY CHẶNG
Mỗi thứ tiếng là một cây chặng đi từ chào hỏi tới chủ đề chuyên sâu. Tiếng Anh hiện có hơn 1.900 chặng với hơn 7.000 từ vựng; tiếng Hàn, Trung, Nhật mỗi thứ trên 1.200 chặng.

ÔN ĐÚNG LÚC SẮP QUÊN
Mục Ôn tập dùng thẻ lật: chọn Quên thì gặp lại sau 10 phút, Nhớ rõ thì thẻ được giãn xa dần, để từ đã học không trôi mất.

LUYỆN NÓI CÓ CHẤM PHÁT ÂM
Đọc to câu mẫu, app nghe và chỉ ra chỗ phát âm chưa chuẩn. Micro chỉ bật khi bạn bấm nút ghi âm.

THI THỬ CÓ CHẤM ĐIỂM
Đề tính giờ, chấm xong chỉ chỗ sai từng câu. Tiếng Anh có đề IELTS đủ bốn kỹ năng quy ra band điểm; các thứ tiếng khác có đề ôn theo cấp, bốc từ chính những chủ đề bạn đã học.

DÙNG NGAY, KHÔNG BẮT ĐĂNG KÝ
Có thể học ngay khi mở app. Tạo tài khoản miễn phí để giữ tiến độ trên nhiều máy. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong app, ở mục Tài khoản.

name: NOCgenie
description:
NOCgenie pages your on-call team when something breaks, and makes sure someone owns it. This app is the on-call side of NOCgenie: it needs a NOCgenie account from your organisation.

Respond to alerts:
- Get paged for new alerts, with priority P1 to P5.
- Acknowledge from the lock screen, or resolve once unlocked, straight from the notification.
- See open, acknowledged and closed alerts, with service, host and who acted.

Know who is on call:
- See who is on call now and next on every schedule, and call, text or email them.
- See your own upcoming shifts.
- Roster managers can cover a shift or add, edit and remove overrides.

Be notified your way:
- Choose which events reach you, on which channel and after what delay.
- Set quiet hours: alerts arrive silently, and P1 always gets through.

Sign in with your NOCgenie email and password, or your organisation's Microsoft single sign-on.

name: Notan: Minimalist Nonograms
description:
Fill the squares each row and column asks for, and a small picture appears.

Notan is a nonogram in black and white. The numbers beside each row and above each column give the runs of filled squares in that line. Work them out line by line, and the picture shows itself when the last square is right.

WHAT'S IN IT

• 53 levels, from a 2×2 square up to 15×15. Every level has exactly one solution, and you can reach it line by line without guessing.
• New Game+: 20 harder, asymmetric pictures that unlock after level 53.
• Quick play: random boards at 5, 8, 10, 12 or 15 squares a side. Each one has a single solution you can find line by line.
• How to play walks through a few small examples; the first levels teach the rest.
• A hint for when you are stuck. It rings one wrong square, or a square you can work out and the numbers that settle it.
• Hold a row's or column's numbers to lock a finished line.

HOW IT PLAYS

Tap to fill or clear a square. Drag to fill a line. Double-tap or hold to mark a square empty. Undo takes back the last move.

QUIET BY DESIGN

• Entirely offline. No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Light and dark themes, or follow the system. Zoom makes the numbers larger.
• Progress stays on your device. Close the app mid-puzzle and pick up where you left off.

name: NOULAN – Livraison à Labé
description:
NOULAN, c'est la livraison de colis à moto partout à Labé.
En pular, NOULAN veut dire « Envoie-moi ». Vous avez un colis à faire livrer ? Commandez depuis votre téléphone et un motard NOULAN s'en occupe.
 
COMMENT ÇA MARCHE
- Choisissez le quartier de départ et le quartier d'arrivée, et le secteur si vous le connaissez.
- Le prix s'affiche avant de commander. Fini la négociation.
- Un motard NOULAN vient récupérer le colis.
- Suivez la livraison en direct.
- Le destinataire donne son code de livraison et reçoit le colis en main propre.
- Payez en espèces à la livraison.
 
POUR LES COMMERÇANTS
Créez un compte Commerçant et faites livrer vos clients sans quitter votre boutique.
 
EN TOUTE CONFIANCE
- Numéro vérifié par SMS à la création du compte
- Un code de livraison pour chaque colis
- Suppression du compte possible à tout moment dans l'appli
 
NOULAN est une entreprise de Labé, avec des motards partenaires de Labé.
Contact : contact@noulan.org

name: NOULAN Motard
description:
NOULAN Motard est l'appli des motards partenaires de NOULAN, le service de livraison de colis à moto à Labé.
 
VOUS AVEZ UNE MOTO ? ROULEZ AVEC NOULAN
- Envoyez votre candidature directement dans l'appli, avec la photo de votre pièce d'identité et de votre moto.
- Après un entretien avec un gérant NOULAN, votre compte est activé.
 
CHAQUE JOUR
- Passez « En service » quand vous voulez travailler.
- Les courses arrivent sur votre téléphone, avec le trajet et le prix.
- Acceptez, récupérez le colis, livrez-le et confirmez avec le code du destinataire.
- Vous gardez 85 % du prix de chaque course.
 
VOTRE CAISSE
Suivez vos courses, vos gains et vos versements à NOULAN directement dans l'appli.
 
Cette appli est réservée aux motards partenaires de NOULAN. Pour envoyer un colis, téléchargez l'appli NOULAN.
Contact : contact@noulan.org

name: NSKKHD Max
description: NSKKHD Maxは、家庭用電化製品で繰り返し発生する不具合を追跡・記録するシステムです。具体的には、問題の発生箇所、実施した対処、実際の金銭的支出、そして最終的な結果を記録します。 ユーザーは不具合の症状を記録し、再テストの基準を定め、診断や修理の予定を立て、それにかかった費用や費やした時間を記録した上で、各段階の状況を観察によって確認します。 対処がうまくいかなかった場合には、当初の支出を計上し、返金があれば元の支出と照合して追跡します。これにより、支払いが「問題の解決」と誤認されることを防ぎます。 また、製品が必要とされる期間と使用できない期間（ダウンタイム）を照らし合わせて製品への影響を評価し、これに費用、所要時間、修理予約の信頼性といった分析を組み合わせることで、次にとるべき行動を決定します。 対処前後の製品の状態を捉えた写真と、手動テストの記録を組み合わせることで、将来的な監査や、さらなる投資の是非を判断するための明確な根拠が確保されます。

name: Nuclear Kitty Island Passport
description:
Deal a table of illustrated island postcards and find the matching pairs. Choose three, six or nine pairs, learn the regions as you turn over each card, and try to beat your best number of turns. Your deal resumes when you come back. Play offline on iPhone or iPad.

Bring your character along in My passport. Export a copy from the browser where you play the island, then open it in the app to see your character, companion, paw coins, satchel, wardrobe, cottage furniture and earned island stamps. Import a fresh copy after playing to update it.

Browse the nine illustrated regions in the island atlas. Sign in with Apple if you want to bookmark places for a trip on this device.

name: Nur Prayer
description:
Nur keeps prayer times and the Qibla close, then stays out of the way.

Open it and you see one thing: how long until the next prayer. Your day's times sit quietly below, with the current prayer highlighted. Tap once for focus mode and only the countdown remains.

PRAYER TIMES, CALCULATED ON YOUR IPHONE
Nur works out your prayer times on the device, so they are ready instantly and work offline. Choose from eleven calculation methods: Muslim World League, ISNA, Moonsighting Committee, Egyptian Authority, Karachi, Umm al-Qura, Dubai, Kuwait, Qatar, Singapore (MUIS) and Turkey (Diyanet). Asr can follow the standard or Hanafi method.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Turn on a reminder for each prayer you choose. When one arrives and you need a moment, snooze it for 5 or 15 minutes. Reminders keep up with the changing length of the day and with daylight saving time.

FIND THE QIBLA
Hold your iPhone flat and turn slowly. When you face the Kaaba, the screen glows green and you feel a gentle tap. It works even with Location Services off: Nur corrects the compass for your chosen city using the World Magnetic Model.

YOUR LOCATION, YOUR CHOICE
Use your current location, or pick a city instead. Suggestions come from a list of more than 34,000 cities built into the app, so your search stays on your iPhone. For smaller towns, an optional online search uses Apple Maps. Nur remembers your recent cities.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. The developer never receives your location or settings.

ALSO
• 12- or 24-hour time
• Supports larger text sizes
• Dark, quiet design

name: NurseryGrow
description:
NurseryGrow is a field data-collection app for nursery and farm teams. It helps workers record daily irrigation and crop data quickly — right at the plant row — and gives owners a clear, real-time view of every zone.

Built for the field: NurseryGrow works fully offline and syncs automatically once you're back online, so weak network in the polyhouse or out in the field is never a problem.

KEY FEATURES

• Fast data entry — Log EC, pH, drip and drain volumes, and spray/fertilizer applications for each zone and irrigation cycle.

• Voice input — Speak your readings instead of typing. Voice is processed on your device and supports English and Marathi.

• Offline-first — Record anywhere; your data syncs securely as soon as you have a connection.

• Plant videos — Capture videos of plant rows organized by zone, row, and growth stage for agronomy monitoring.

• Dashboards & alerts — Supervisors and managers get a live view of activity and trends, with automatic red-flag alerts when readings fall outside target ranges.

• Reports — Export detailed Excel reports and receive automated daily summaries by email.

• Multi-farm & multi-crop — Manage multiple farms and crops (Blueberry, Strawberry, Apple, Etc..) from a single app.

• Role-based access — Tailored views and permissions for owners, managers, and supervisors.

WHO IT'S FOR

NurseryGrow is designed for nursery and farm staff who collect and review irrigation and crop-health data. Access requires an account provided by your organization.

name: Nuvoria
description:
Nuvoria – Skin & Wellness Monitor
Your Skin. Your Wellness. Your Daily Care.
Discover a more thoughtful way to care for yourself with Nuvoria, an elegant skin and wellness tracking app designed to help you organize your skincare routines, monitor personal wellness habits, and understand your progress over time.
Inspired by modern aesthetic and wellness clinics, Nuvoria combines a beautiful, intuitive interface with practical tools for everyday self-care.
Whether you're following a skincare routine, keeping track of cosmetic care sessions, or building healthier daily habits, Nuvoria brings everything together in one organized space.
Your Personal Wellness Dashboard
Stay connected to your daily self-care journey with a beautifully designed dashboard featuring wellness indicators, visual progress charts, and personalized tracking summaries.
	•	View your personal care index and wellness trends
	•	Track self-reported skin hydration and comfort
	•	Record sleep duration and stress levels
	•	Monitor daily water intake
	•	Review your skincare observations and progress
Skin Health & Facial Care Journal
Understand your skin's changing needs by maintaining detailed personal observation records.
	•	Record daily skin condition check-ins
	•	Explore a nine-zone facial observation map
	•	Track dryness, redness, and other visible concerns
	•	Compare observations over time
	•	Maintain a history of your skincare experiences
Skincare Routines & Daily Rituals
Create a more consistent self-care experience with organized skincare routines.
	•	Plan morning and evening care activities
	•	Keep track of skincare products and routines
	•	Record completed care activities
	•	Organize personalized skincare schedules
	•	Review your routine consistency
Aesthetic Care & Wellness Sessions
Keep your cosmetic care and wellness experiences organized in one convenient place.
	•	Maintain personal care session records
	•	Organize appointment and consultation notes
	•	Document treatment-related observations
	•	Track completed sessions and personal feedback
	•	Review previous care experiences
Wellness Insights & Progress
Turn everyday observations into meaningful personal insights.
	•	Explore visual wellness summaries
	•	Review historical tracking information
	•	Compare skincare routines and experiences
	•	Monitor self-reported changes over time
	•	Identify patterns in your daily self-care habits
Designed for a Beautiful Self-Care Experience
Nuvoria features a refined, clinic-inspired interface with calming colors, elegant visualizations, smooth navigation, and thoughtfully designed tracking tools.
Every feature is created to make personal wellness journaling feel simple, organized, and enjoyable.
Begin Your Personal Wellness Journey
Build better self-care habits, stay organized, and discover a more mindful approach to your everyday skincare and wellness routine.
Download Nuvoria and make every day a little more intentional.
Disclaimer: Nuvoria is a personal skincare and wellness journaling application. All monitoring indicators are based on manually entered information and personal observations. The app does not provide medical diagnoses, clinical measurements, or professional treatment recommendations.

name: O Jogo do Krug
description:
Leve o Krug, um cachorro de verdade, até a tigela de papá!

O Jogo do Krug é um jogo de labirinto feito em casa e estrelado pelo Krug. Deslize o dedo e a tampinha rola reto até bater na parede: escolha bem a hora de virar, coma "popocas" e "pães do queijo" e fuja do "má banho", que dá um medo danado.

• Fases sem fim, geradas na hora e cada vez maiores
• Uma novidade a cada poucas fases, apresentada antes de aparecer
• Até 3 estrelas por fase
• A cada 5 fases o Krug muda de cômodo e ganha um intervalo animado
• Músicas originais e latidos do próprio Krug
• Funciona sem internet
• Sem anúncios, sem compras e sem coleta de dados

name: Odomoto: Driving Dashboard
description:
Odomoto turns an iPhone in a dashboard mount into a big-type driving display, and keeps a few useful car tools in one place: a trip log, a parking spot saver with a meter timer, and a step-by-step guide for fixing a phone that won't connect to the car.

DASHBOARD
• Large GPS speed in mph or km/h, readable at a glance
• Heading, altitude, trip time and distance
• Your own speed alert: choose a number and the display turns red, with an optional chime, when you go above it. Odomoto doesn't know posted speed limits; you set the threshold.
• Big buttons to open Maps, Music, Messages, Waze, Google Maps or Spotify, or to call a number you save. Buttons for apps you don't have installed are hidden.
• The screen stays awake while the dashboard is open
• Night colors: dim red on black, automatic or manual
• Works in portrait and landscape

TRIP LOG
Trips are recorded while the dashboard is on screen. Each trip shows distance, duration, average and top speed, and the route on a map. GPS jitter while you're parked is filtered out so it doesn't add distance. Export all trips as a CSV file.

PARKING
Save where you parked, add a note and a photo of the level or bay, start a meter timer with a reminder 10 minutes before it runs out, and get walking directions back in Maps.

FIX A CONNECTION
An interactive checklist for in-car phone connection problems over a cable, wirelessly or by Bluetooth: settings on the phone, cables and ports, Screen Time restrictions, Siri, re-pairing the car and software updates. The guide covers common Apple CarPlay connection issues and links to the official support pages. Each run is saved on your phone, so you know what fixed it last time.

GET-IN-CAR SHORTCUT
Step-by-step instructions for creating your own personal automation in the Shortcuts app that opens Odomoto's dashboard when your phone connects to the car. You create the automation yourself in Shortcuts; Odomoto adds a Start Dashboard action for it.

WHAT ODOMOTO IS NOT
Odomoto runs only on your iPhone. It doesn't connect to or control your car or its screen, and it doesn't make any in-car system connect or sync. Speed comes from GPS and can differ from your car's speedometer.

SAFETY
Don't use your phone while driving. Set up the dashboard before you set off, use a mount that doesn't block your view, and follow local laws.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no in-app purchases and no analytics. Location is used only while the app is open, and your trips, parking spot and photos stay on your iPhone.

CarPlay is a trademark of Apple Inc. This app is not affiliated with Apple.

name: Offline Karaoke:Song Studio
description:
Capture ideas, separate backing tracks, and sing your own version. songstudio is an on-device audio workspace for karaoke practice and music creation.

OFFLINE PROCESSING
Powered by Spleeter, vocal and backing track separation runs locally on your iPhone or iPad. Recording, separation and karaoke mixing do not require uploading audio to a server. Manage your files and export or back up the recordings you want to keep.

RECORD & IMPORT AUDIO
Record songs directly or import standard, unencrypted audio through the Files app. Read embedded song information and artwork to organize your library. Metadata and artwork availability depend on the source file.

SEPARATE VOCALS & BACKING TRACKS
Split audio into vocal and instrumental stems for karaoke, cover practice and vocal training. Separation results vary with the source audio.

PRACTISE WITH LRC LYRICS
Import LRC lyrics and sing along. Pause, seek using lyrics or skip the intro. During playback, independently adjust the backing track, original vocals and your own recorded voice.

EXPORT & MANAGE YOUR WORK
Organize, rename or delete audio in your library and clear caches in storage management. Export recordings and mixes through the system share sheet to a location or app you choose.

IMPORTANT NOTICE
This app does not provide music downloads or include a built-in music library. Users must supply unencrypted audio files they are legally authorized to use and import them through the Files app for audio processing and cover-singing practice.

For cover singers, vocal learners, music fans and independent creators.
Make every song your own.

name: Oikiaccglobal
description:
Oikia Christian Centre is a global church family helping people connect with God, grow in faith and purpose, and serve humanity in the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Jesus in Everyone, Jesus in Every City.
Connecting • Growing • Serving Humanity

WATCH AND LISTEN

• Join our livestreams every Sunday & Wednesday. If you can't be in the room, you can still be a part of what God is doing.

CAMPUSES

EVENTS

GIVE

• Send a prayer request to the Oikia CC team. You can ask for your request to stay private within the pastoral team. Requests are never shown publicly in the app.

CONNECT AND GROW

Whether you're seeking, struggling, or soaring, there's a place for you here.

name: Okrly: Your Personal OKRs
description:
Pick the few things you want to move forward on. Decide how you’ll know each one is done. Then take 30 seconds a week to note where you stand, and Okrly shows you at a glance whether you’re on track.

It’s the idea behind OKRs (objectives and key results), made for one person, not a team. An objective is what you want; its key results are how you’ll know you’ve made it. One purchase: no subscription, no in-app purchases, no account.

YOUR FOOTPRINT
Each objective in progress takes a slice of one drawing, and each of its key results an arc that fills as you advance. The score sits in the center. Home brings it all together: your vision in your own words, your footprint, and each objective’s score. Save your footprint as an image to share.

START SIMPLE
A few short screens: choose up to three areas, then up to three objectives, suggested or your own. Their measures come ready, with numbers you adjust with a tap. An “i” explains the method in a few lines. Rather look around first? Load the examples, then remove them whenever you like.

NUMBERS, NOT GUESSWORK
• A key result is a Number or a Percentage, with a start, a target, and today’s value, or a Milestone, done or not.
• Targets can go down, too: screen time from 4 hours a day to 2.
• Each objective is weighed against the time elapsed: On track, Slightly behind, or Behind.
• An objective you haven’t measured yet reads “Not measured yet,” never “Behind.”

THE WEEKLY UPDATE
Update All My Objectives puts every value on one screen. Review every week on the day you choose, every two weeks, or every month. Each review extends the objective’s curve, with a diamond where a target is reached. Missed one? Date the review in the past. A reminder at 9 AM on review day, if you want one: one notification, nothing else.

PLAN WHAT’S NEXT
Objectives run in cycles: three months by default, or one, two, four, or six months, or a year. On the Timeline, plan the cycles ahead: drag an objective to a later one, or set it to start after another, and a line links the two. When a cycle ends, close an objective where it stands or carry it over with the same key results.

YOUR HISTORY, AS A TREE
Achievements draws what you’ve done: your vision is the trunk, your areas the branches, a twig for each objective, a leaf for each key result reached. Prefer rows? Switch to List.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Turn on sync in Settings › Data, and your objectives, reviews, and settings are the same on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It goes through your private iCloud, which Okrly can’t access. On the Mac, Okrly is a separate app, sold separately.

WIDGETS
Your footprint on the Home Screen in three sizes (four on iPad), and on the Lock Screen. A tap opens Okrly.

ON IPAD
The sidebar, several windows side by side, and the keyboard: ⌘N starts a new objective, ⌘R opens the weekly update, and ⌘F starts a search.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking: Okrly collects no data. Without sync, everything stays on your device. Export a backup as a single .okrly file to Files whenever you like, and restore it in one step. Before restoring or erasing, Okrly keeps a safety copy of what was there.

THE DETAILS
• Light and dark appearance, or follow your device.
• Respects Reduce Motion.
• In English and French.

name: OneLine Mahjong -clear
description:
Trace, Match & Clear — A Fresh Mahjong Puzzle Adventure!
Welcome to One Line Mahjong, a colorful and relaxing tile-matching puzzle game that combines classic Mahjong-inspired tiles with clever challenges, strategic thinking, and delightful visuals.
Step into a charming world filled with beautiful flowers, cheerful characters, and exciting tile puzzles. Every level brings a new opportunity to test your observation skills, sharpen your mind, and enjoy the satisfaction of clearing the board.
Whether you're looking for a quick brain-training break or a relaxing puzzle experience, One Line Mahjong offers an enjoyable challenge at your own pace.
A Fresh Take on Mahjong Puzzles
Discover a playful twist on traditional Mahjong-inspired gameplay!
Explore carefully designed boards filled with colorful tiles, including classic dot patterns and special symbols. Observe the layout, identify matching opportunities, and make thoughtful moves to progress through increasingly interesting challenges.
Some tiles overlap or cover others, adding an extra layer of strategy. Pay attention to their positions, uncover hidden tiles, and work toward clearing each puzzle.
Every successful move brings you closer to completing the level!
Easy to Learn, Fun to Master
One Line Mahjong welcomes both new players and experienced puzzle enthusiasts.
The simple, intuitive gameplay makes it easy to get started, while the evolving tile arrangements encourage you to think ahead and develop your own puzzle-solving strategies.
Take your time, examine the board, and discover the best way to complete each challenge.
Helpful Tools for Tricky Puzzles
Need a little assistance? Use helpful puzzle tools to keep your adventure moving.
	•	Peek: Take a closer look when you need additional information.
	•	Undo: Reconsider your previous move and try another approach.
	•	Hint: Get a helpful suggestion when you're unsure what to do next.
These tools add flexibility to your puzzle-solving experience and help make challenging levels more approachable.
Explore a Charming Mahjong World
Enjoy a bright, welcoming environment inspired by peaceful gardens and colorful countryside scenery.
From blooming cherry blossom trees to cheerful Mahjong tile characters, every visual detail brings warmth and personality to your puzzle adventure.
The soft colors, friendly illustrations, and polished tile designs create a delightful atmosphere for casual play.
Discover More Along the Way
Your Mahjong adventure goes beyond individual puzzles.
Visit the Daily Table for an additional way to enjoy the game, and explore the Flower Album as part of your journey through its charming world.
Continue progressing through levels, discover new tile arrangements, and enjoy the rewarding feeling of solving each puzzle.
Game Features
	•	Classic Mahjong-inspired tiles with a fresh puzzle twist.
	•	Simple and intuitive tile-matching gameplay.
	•	Interesting tile layouts with overlapping pieces.
	•	Progressively engaging puzzle challenges.
	•	Helpful Peek, Undo, and Hint tools.
	•	Bright, colorful graphics and charming animations.
	•	Adorable Mahjong-inspired characters.
	•	Beautiful garden-themed environments.
	•	Daily Table and Flower Album features.
	•	Relaxing gameplay that encourages observation and logical thinking.
	•	Short puzzle sessions perfect for playing at your own pace.
Relax, Think, and Enjoy Every Match!
One Line Mahjong brings together the familiar charm of Mahjong tiles and the satisfaction of solving clever puzzles.
Explore colorful boards, uncover hidden possibilities, and challenge yourself with every new level.
Trace the possibilities. Match the tiles. Clear the board!
Start your One Line Mahjong adventure today!

name: OneList: Packing List
description:
OneList is the packing list that learns from every trip.

Tell it where you're going, when, and what kind of trip it is. OneList builds a list from 230+ travel essentials, sized to the number of nights. Pack, repack on the way home so nothing gets left in the hotel, then take 30 seconds to review what you actually used. Your next list gets smarter.

PLAN IN UNDER A MINUTE
• Pick a destination and dates. OneList counts the nights and sets clothing quantities for you.
• Choose the occasion: vacation, wedding, business, conference, festival, ski trip, camping, honeymoon, theme park and more.
• Add the place (beach, city, cold, mountains, international), how you're getting there (plane, car, train, bus, cruise) and who's coming (kids, baby, pet).
• Start fresh or copy a past trip.

PACK
• Check items off as they go in the bag.
• Essentials for your trip are pre-selected, so the passport and charger never get missed.
• Add your own items, notes and a photo of anything.

REPACK FOR THE TRIP HOME
• A separate checklist for the return trip, so chargers, adapters and that one sweater make it back.

REVIEW AND IMPROVE
• After the trip, mark what you used and what you didn't.
• Answer "Next time?" for each item: Must-have, Fine, or Leave it home.
• Your next list for a similar trip reflects what you learned.

SHOPPING LIST
• Mark anything you need to buy before you leave and keep it all in one list.
• Optional product links for items you can buy.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Use it without an account. Your trips stay on your phone.
• Create a free account (Sign in with Apple or email code) to sync across devices.
• Photos never leave your phone.
• No ads. No tracking. No selling your data.

OneList works offline, supports Light and Dark mode, and is free.

As an Amazon Associate, OneList earns from qualifying purchases. Product links may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you.

Questions or ideas: support@getonelist.app

name: OneMove Compressors
description:
Two compressors for synths, keys, buses and voice, as AUv3 plug-ins for iPad and iPhone.

FET COMP: FAST, WITH BITE
A 76-style FET compressor. It grabs transients on synth leads, drums and bass, from gentle glue to all-buttons grit.
• One Drive knob does the job. Input, Output, Attack, Release and Ratio (4:1 to 20:1, and All) refine it.
• Dark or Clean character, and Colour for how much of the circuit's harmonics you hear.
• HQ processes at four times the sample rate for clean highs. With HQ off, FET Comp adds no latency.

OPTO COMP: SMOOTH, EVEN LEVELLING
A 2A-style optical leveller. It evens out synth bass, pads, keys and voices, and it adds no latency.
• One Peak Reduction knob does the job. Compress or Limit, HF Emphasis, Memory, Tube and Air Lift shape it.
• Voice and Instrument detectors.

BOTH
• Mix for parallel compression, and Auto Gain to keep the level steady as you push harder.
• A detector high-pass (60 to 150 Hz), so bass stops pumping a bus.
• A VU-style gain reduction meter, and input and output meters.
• Seven factory presets each, for leads, bass, keys, drum buses and vocals.

KEY LINK: NO ROUTING NEEDED
Set Key Input to a Link letter and the compressor listens to another OneMove plug-in on the same device, for example a music bus that dips when the vocal comes in. OneMove Air ("Send vocal key") and OneMove Vocal Console can send. Hosts with side-chain routing can feed the side-chain input directly.

TRY IT IN THE APP
The app has its own player: two band demos, with A/B bypass. No host needed.

FREE TO TRY, THEN UNLOCK ONCE
Every feature works in any host. Each time a plug-in loads, it processes for 5 minutes, then passes your audio through untouched until you reload it. Bounces and exports pass through unprocessed until you unlock. Unlock FET Comp, Opto Comp or both, once. No subscription. Family Sharing supported. Your settings carry over.

WORKS WITH
AUv3 hosts on iPad and iPhone. Mono and stereo. Every control is a host parameter for automation.

HELP
The app and the plug-in settings have a Help & feedback section: the manual, and a form to report a bug, suggest an idea or ask a question.

PRIVACY
Everything runs on your device. No account, no tracking, no data collected. Help links open onemove.audio in Safari; the form sends nothing unless you press Send.

Demo music by OneMove Audio.

name: OpenCue: Social Skills
seller_name: GPT LLM ORAGLE Ltd. Liability Co.
description:
Make a little room for better conversations.

OpenCue helps you practice everyday social skills through short lessons, realistic situations, and thoughtful reflection. Start with a small hello, listen with care, explain an idea clearly, or find the words for a difficult moment.

LEARN IN SMALL STEPS
