Explore 12 original interactive lessons across four paths: everyday connection, listening, speaking with confidence, and handling hard moments. Each lesson includes a practical idea, an example, a quick check, and a small real-life challenge.

PRACTICE THE MOMENTS THAT MATTER
Try eight conversation situations: small talk, job interviews, supporting a friend, setting boundaries, networking, resolving conflict, a friendly first meeting, and public speaking. Guided mode uses prewritten prompts and works offline. Optional AI mode responds to your text using our self-hosted service and requires internet.

REFLECT WITHOUT THE PRESSURE
Save a practice and write down what you want to try next time. Simple text-based reflection prompts offer ideas about response length, questions, and acknowledgment. They do not measure your personality, emotions, or tone.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Choose a personal focus and daily intention, revisit lessons, and track your practice days. Your latest 30 conversations and reflections stay on your device.

FREE, WITH SPACE TO BE YOURSELF
No account, ads, subscriptions, or purchases. Camera and microphone access are not required. AI is optional; avoid sharing sensitive details and use the in-app report option for unwanted replies.

OpenCue is an educational practice tool, not therapy or a clinical assessment. AI can make mistakes. There is no single right way to communicate—use the ideas that work for you.

name: Opening Insights
description:
Memorizing a line is only the beginning. Understand why you play it.

Opening Insights by Silicon Chess turns opening study into decisions on the board. Choose an opening, think about your move, explain your idea and follow the resulting play.

BUILD YOUR REPERTOIRE IN ORDER
6,573 exercises across 35 openings and systems, adapted from 292 classes on openings and current opening theory. Create a local profile and start from the opening index. Choose what you want to prepare or follow the suggested order, with each opening's lessons grouped together.

UNDERSTAND THE IDEA BEHIND THE MOVE
• My move: play on the board by dragging a piece or tapping its starting and destination squares.
• My idea: answer a specific question about the position in front of you.
• The moves: replay the continuation step by step and connect the plan with its consequences.
• For my next game: take away an idea you can recognize in your own play.

PREPARE WITH UNDERSTANDING
Study development, coordination, pawn structures, pawn breaks, king safety, exchanges and initiative. Understand what each side is trying to achieve and why move order matters. Examples and comparisons connect opening ideas with the middlegame.

KEEP THE BOARD IN VIEW
Layouts for iPhone and iPad let you read, answer and follow variations without losing sight of the position. Move controls sit beside the board, and explanations accompany the moves. Guided study asks you to follow the required continuations before completing an exercise.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS AND REVIEW
Your training rating develops from your first attempt at each position. Revisit mistakes and strengthen the ideas you need to practice. This is an in-app scale, not a FIDE or online rating. Time does not affect your score.

TRAIN AT YOUR OWN PACE
• One level, recommended for players rated above 1500 FIDE or online.
• For players aged 13 and over who already know chess.
• Up to five local profiles with independent progress.
• Manual progress backup and restore.
• The included catalog works offline after installation.
• No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.
• English and Spanish interface, questions and explanations follow the app language in iOS Settings.

Continuations end where the study example ends, which may be before the end of the game. The catalog does not cover every variation in a complete repertoire and does not update automatically. The purchase does not include academy membership or full class videos.

Silicon Chess. Understand the ideas. Build your repertoire.

name: OpticFrame: Telescope Planner
description:
Compare two telescope and camera setups before an imaging session. OpticFrame places two camera fields around the same custom angular target, with independent relative rotations and regular mosaic grids.

Compare the optical train
• Enter telescope aperture, focal length and reducer/Barlow factor.
• Set active sensor width/height and pixel size for each setup.
• Calculate effective focal length, f-ratio, rectangular field of view and approximate arcseconds per pixel.
• Compare eyepiece magnification, exit pupil and approximate visual field.

Plan an angular frame
• Enter your own target label, full angular width/height and relative orientation.
• Overlay two camera fields and rotate each from 0–180°.
• Explore 1–5 rows and columns with 0–70% overlap.
• See whether the rotated target’s bounding rectangle fits each mosaic’s outer rectangle.
• Export a PDF with diagram, numerical comparison and notes.

Know the model
This is a flat angular planning tool, not a sky map. It has no sky imagery, object catalog, coordinates, weather, mount control, exposure prediction or plate solving. Rotations are relative to the diagram, not calibrated sky position angles. Mosaic coverage is a rectangular estimate and does not model sky curvature, distortion or optical quality. Visual field is approximated from apparent eyepiece field divided by magnification. Verify plans in your actual imaging software.

Local and private
No account, advertising, analytics, tracking, developer server, subscription or in-app purchase. Paid download includes all current features. English and Simplified Chinese follow system language. Native iPhone and iPad layout, light/dark appearance and Dynamic Type. Export a complete JSON backup; restore validates and previews before confirming full-library replacement, retaining a pre-restore sandbox copy. Maximum 100 saved records and 10 MB backups. Files you intentionally export follow your chosen provider’s policy.

name: Orbit Flip: Tap Reflex
description:
Orbit Flip is a one-touch arcade game built for quick sessions, big high scores and calm moments.

Your ball circles endlessly. Swipe up to hop to an outer orbit, swipe down to drop to an inner one. Collect gems, dodge the spikes and survive as the speed keeps climbing. The better you do, the more orbits open up: start with two and unlock up to five.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: dodge the spikes, grab the gems, it keeps getting faster
• Zen: no spikes, no pressure, just flow with the music
• Rush: 45 seconds on the clock, every gem adds time
• Hardcore: faster orbit, more spikes, double coins

FEATURES
• Simple swipe controls: anyone can play in seconds
• New orbits open as your score grows
• Relaxing original soundtrack and soft chimes
• Spikes blink before they turn deadly, so read them and react
• Earn coins and unlock 8 glowing skins
• Separate high score for every mode
• No ads, works offline

Can you reach the fifth orbit?

name: Orbit: Star Pilot
description:
A quiet space adventure, one perfectly timed launch at a time.

Orbit is a quiet, one-thumb space arcade game about timing, momentum and the pleasure of one more flight. Hold to follow your orbit, choose your moment, and release to launch toward the next world.

YOUR NEXT DESTINATION
Start with Comet Harbour, just three successful landings away. Build a passport across eight destinations, earn career XP and unlock new trails. Each stop takes you a little further; deep-space milestones continue beyond the chart. Progress carries across flights.

SOMETHING NEW EACH DAY
Return for daily objectives, a shared daily route and a short, surprising space fact with a NASA source link. Practice a course without changing your records. Missing a day never removes your career progress.

FIND YOUR PACE
Start in Learner with half-speed spins and three extra safe laps, or choose Relaxed for a gentler challenge. Easier skills earn fewer points and career XP. Standard keeps the original challenge; Adaptive changes pace as you learn. Daily routes keep fixed rules, and practice preserves the original route pace.

A QUIET UNIVERSE
Fly among miniature worlds inspired by the Moon, Saturn, Jupiter and other solar-system neighbours. Named constellations shine behind the action. Gentle music and soft sound cues keep you company, with separate controls for music and effects.

A LITTLE CHRISTMAS MAGIC
Santa's Star Run is included: swap the ship for Santa's sleigh and the planets for ribbon-wrapped presents. It changes the look, never the flight rules.

• Simple hold-and-release controls
• Moving worlds and swirling wormholes
• Gravity Bloom pickups on fresh flights
• Persistent passport progress and cosmetic rewards
• Optional Game Center leaderboards
• Core play and daily facts work offline
• No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases

Local progress is saved on your device. Game Center and opening fact-source links require an internet connection.

Support: support@orbitstarpilot.app
Privacy: https://orbitstarpilot.app/privacy/

name: Orvaden Collision
description:
Orvaden Collision is a digital crash field notebook for iPhone and iPad. Built for law enforcement and public safety personnel, it keeps vehicle details, driver and passenger information, scene photos, and notes together in one record you can refer to when completing your official report.

• Scan driver’s licenses, license plates, and VINs with your camera. Review and correct the captured information before adding it to your record.
• Organize each vehicle with its driver, passengers, insurance, and ownership details. Record seating positions, restraints, injuries, and transport information.
• Capture scene coordinates, add photos, and write notes as you work.
• Record commercial vehicle details, including carrier, trailer, and cargo information.
• Save a record in progress, return to it later, and share selected photos when needed.

Collision stores your records on your device and requires no account. Camera scanning runs on-device. VIN lookup uses an internet connection to retrieve vehicle details.

Practical tools. Serious standards.

name: Orvo: Life Potential Machine
description:
Press your finger on the brass plate of a 1926 machine. It hums, it warms up, and it prints a single card: your life potential.

ONE CARD. FOR LIFE.
Your card is tied to your iCloud account. Reinstall the app or move to a new phone and the machine still remembers you; your card stays the same. There are 40 potentials, from Dancer to Diplomat, each with a line of its own.

A SEALED VISION EVERY MONTH
On the 1st of every month a new envelope arrives. Break the wax seal and watch a short 8-bit dream: people, pets and wild animals, ski slopes, campfires, balloons drifting over the fields. Each vision is drawn on your phone from your own signature, so no one else will ever see the same one.

AN OMEN FOR THE MONTH
Every vision ends with an omen: a symbol and one sentence for the month ahead, written for your card.

YOUR ARCHIVE
Every vision you open is kept in your deck. Pull the envelopes down to go back in time and replay any month.

• One card per iCloud account, no sign-up
• 40 life potentials
• A new 8-bit vision on the 1st of every month
• Monthly omens written for each card
• A deck that keeps every vision you've had
• Available in 16 languages

Orvo is made for fun and reflection. It doesn't read your fingerprint and it doesn't predict the future.

name: OurSize: Family Clothing Sizes
description:
Never guess a size again.

OurSize keeps the clothing and shoe sizes of you and your family in one simple list. When grandma asks what shoe size Emma wears now, send her a link. She sees every size, with no app or account needed.

• Add a person in seconds: just a name.
• Pick a clothing type and write the size: shoes, jeans, T-shirts, jackets, dresses, hats, gloves, rings and more.
• Sizes per brand: EU 31 usually, but 32 in Adidas? Save both.
• Shoe sizes in EU, US, UK or cm.
• Share one person or the whole family with a link that opens in any browser.
• Ready for gifts: the shared page has shop links for every size.
• A reminder when sizes get old, so you check them as the kids grow.
• In English, Spanish, German, French and Icelandic.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your sizes stay on your phone. No account, no login, no tracking. We only get your email address if you choose to sign up for our emails.

FREE
OurSize is free, with no subscriptions. It is supported by shop links and at most one clearly marked sponsored card per screen. Some shop links are affiliate links, which never cost you extra.

name: Outed - Imposter Game
description:
One phone. One secret word. Who's pretending?

Imposter is a pass-and-play party game for 3 to 12 players. Pass one phone around the group and secretly check your cards. Most players see the same word. The imposters don't, so they'll have to blend in. Choose whether they get a hint or have to bluff with no help at all.

HOW A ROUND WORKS
- Pass the phone. Hold your card to peek, then release to hide it.
- Talk it out. Give clues and ask questions without saying the word.
- Vote. Each player secretly picks their suspect on the phone.
- Take a last guess. A caught imposter can still steal the round by guessing the word.
- Rematch. Keep the crew and scores, with a fresh word and new roles.

MAKE IT YOUR GAME
- 10 categories and 400 words: Everyday Objects, Pop Culture, Places, Food & Drink, Animals, Sports, School, Music, Internet & Tech, and Travel
- Create and save custom decks with your own categories and words
- Keep words out of rotation until the selected deck has been played through
- Add a second imposter with 6 or more players
- Choose from four hint levels: None, Small, Medium, or Big
- Set an optional discussion timer with haptic warnings
- Track scores and per-player stats
- Turn sounds and haptics on or off
- Save your crew's names for the next game
- Learn the rules with a How to Play walkthrough
- Includes an iPad layout

Free. Offline. No accounts. No ads. Just your friends, one phone, and a secret to keep.

name: OVX CL03 Reader
description:
OVX checks documents that carry a CL03 code: a signed QR code printed on certificates, cards and other documents issued through the CL03 system.

Point the camera at the code and OVX tells you whether the document is genuine, unchanged and still valid. The check happens on your phone, offline. The document you scan is never sent anywhere.

FOR ORGANIZATIONS
OVX is used by organizations that issue or accept CL03 documents. An administrator pairs each phone with the organization's server by showing it a pairing code. Once paired, the phone keeps the organization's keys up to date, and can show the details a document carries for that organization, such as the holder's name and photo, so you can compare them with the person in front of you. One phone can work for more than one organization.

WHAT YOU SEE
• Verified: the issuer's signature checks out, the document is unchanged, and it is within its validity dates.
• Not genuine: the code was not signed by an issuer this phone trusts.
• Altered: what the code says was changed after it was signed.
• Expired: the document was genuine but is past its validity dates.

OVX also reads the QR codes on Philippine National ID cards and digital IDs, and says whether the issuer's signature on the code could be checked.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
• Codes are checked on the phone. Scans are never uploaded.
• Personal details are encrypted inside the code, and only phones paired with an organization allowed to see them can open them.
• The phone's keys are kept in its Secure Enclave and unlocked with Face ID.
• The phone's activity log is sealed on the phone, and only the organization it works for can read it.

OVX needs a pairing with an organization that uses CL03.

name: P1 XL
description:
Volg je favoriete coureur tijdens elke race-sessie in één oogopslag. Geen drukke
timingschermen, maar alleen wat telt: positie, band en de gaten.
GEMAAKT VOOR SLECHTZIENDEN
P1 XL is gemaakt voor mensen die slecht zien. Daar staat de XL in de naam voor.
• Extra grote positie, met hoog contrast op een zwarte achtergrond
• Niet alleen kleur: de band staat er ook als letter en naam bij
• Je iPhone trilt bij een positiewissel, een vlag of de snelste ronde
• Een Philips Hue-lamp kleurt mee met vlaggen, de snelste ronde en het podium
• VoiceOver leest positie, gaten en band voor en kondigt de startlichten één voor één aan
• Het scherm blijft aan zolang de app open is
TIJDENS DE RACE
• De positie van jouw coureur, groot in beeld, in de kleur van zijn huidige band
• De achterstand op de auto ervoor en de voorsprong op de auto erachter
• Trillen bij inhaalacties, vlaggen en een snelste ronde (per onderdeel in te stellen)
TIJDENS DE KWALIFICATIE
• Q-deel, positie, beste tijd en achterstand op P1
• Drie grote sectorvlakken: geel, groen of paars. De sector waar hij nu rijdt, pulseert
• Direct zien of je coureur veilig is, op de grens staat of in de eliminatiezone zit, met de
marge in seconden
GELIJK MET DE TV
Live data is vaak sneller dan de tv-uitzending. Tik op "Nu!" op het moment dat op tv een
nieuwe ronde begint en de app stelt de vertraging zelf in. Daarna stel je fijn af per seconde.
STARTLICHTEN
Vijf minuten voor een race, sprint of kwalificatie verschijnen de startlichten. Elke minuut
gaat er één rood licht aan, tot LIGHTS OUT.
PHILIPS HUE
Laat een Hue-lamp meekleuren met de race: geel bij een gele vlag of safety car, rood bij een
rode vlag, paars bij een snelste ronde en een kleurenfeest bij een podium of pole. Na afloop
gaat je lamp terug naar zoals hij was.
OOK BUITEN DE RACE
• De uitslag van de laatste race van jouw coureur
• De WK-stand van coureurs en teams
• Een demo-modus om alles te bekijken zonder dat er een sessie bezig is
PRIVACY
Geen account, geen advertenties, geen tracking. Je instellingen blijven op je iPhone.
P1 XL is een onofficiële app voor fans en is niet verbonden aan, goedgekeurd door of gelieerd
aan Formula 1, de FIA of een team. F1, FORMULA 1 en aanverwante merken zijn eigendom van
Formula One Licensing B.V. Philips Hue is een merk van Signify.

name: PackHarbor
description:
Leave lighter and arrive ready with PackHarbor, your personal travel packing planner.

• Keep separate packing lists for every trip, with departure and return dates.
• Build reusable templates and copy a fresh, independent list for your next journey.
• Assign items to travelers and bags so everything has a place.
• Plan quantities and estimated weight per unit, then see totals by person and bag.
• Mark items packed, inspect missing essentials, and use a separate travel check along the way.
• Share a CSV packing list, export or restore a validated JSON backup, and manage local data.

Free, with no account, ads or analytics. Packing lists stay on your iPhone until you choose to export them. An editable example trip and an independent starter template help you begin. Weights are planning estimates; verify airline and destination rules yourself.

name: PackShepherd
description:
PackShepherd lets you monitor and configure Seplos BMS 10E battery packs directly over Bluetooth, on iPhone and iPad. It's made for home storage and off-grid systems with one or several packs.

MONITOR
• Finds all Seplos BMS units nearby; give each pack its own name
• State of charge, voltage, current, power, temperatures, cycles and SOH at a glance
• Every cell voltage, with the lowest and highest cell and the drift
• Model and firmware of each pack
• Warnings and protection messages from the BMS by name
• Overview of all packs with total state of charge and power

CONFIGURE
• Read all parameters and switches, hide the ones you don't need
• Protected change mode: values are checked against the firmware's rules, written and then read back to compare
• Optional password before change mode
• Compare two or more packs and apply chosen values to them
• Print parameters and switches or save them as a PDF

BACKUPS
• Save backups of all parameters and switches whenever you like
• Compare a backup with the BMS and restore only the values you choose
• Restore to another pack of the same model
• Share and import backup files

TRY IT WITHOUT A BATTERY
Demo mode shows sample data, so you can explore the app first.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. The app doesn't send anything over the internet. Everything stays on your device.

SAFETY
PackShepherd can change the protection settings of a live battery. Wrong settings can damage the battery or become dangerous. Only change what you understand, back up first, and use the app at your own risk. Only two BMS warnings have been verified on a device so far; if in doubt, check with the manufacturer's software.

Languages: English and German.

PackShepherd is an independent app. It is not a Seplos product and isn't affiliated with Seplos.

name: PagePrint
description:
PagePrint turns the books you finish into short 9:16 videos for Instagram Reels and Stories.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan the barcode on the back of the book to fill in the title, author, publisher, page count and cover — or type them in.
2. Photograph a page and swipe across the lines you loved, like a highlighter. (Optional)
3. Add a rating and a line or two about the book. (Optional)
4. Pick a background color and tap Make video. Save it to Photos or share it straight to Instagram.

FEATURES
• Find the cover by ISBN, or use your own photo — PagePrint polishes it so the book stands out.
• Line picking reads the text on your page photo; just swipe to select. Lines that continue onto the next page are joined into one.
• Each scene stays on screen just long enough to read, and everything stays clear of the areas Instagram covers.
• Five background colors: Library, Midnight, Wine, Walnut, Ink.
• Your library shows the books and pages you read by year and month.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up. Your photos, lines, reviews and videos stay on your iPhone. Only a book's ISBN is sent to the National Library of Korea and Kakao to look up book details.

Videos have no music — add your favorite song when you post on Instagram.

name: PAL Star
description:
PAL Star is a quiet place to remember a pet who has passed away.

Add their photo, their name, the day they left, and where you lived together. PAL Star gives them one real star of the northern sky, chosen from the sky over your home on the night they left. It is theirs from then on, and it never changes.

A STARRY SKY AT ANY HOUR
Open the app any time, day or night. Stars and constellations follow the sky above your horizon, and your pet's photo glows softly at their star. Move the phone to look around, or drag and pinch the sky with your fingers. If you like, turn on a quiet evening reminder to visit.

A CERTIFICATE TO KEEP
Make a star certificate with your pet's photo, their star's constellation and its place in the sky, and save or share it.

YOU ARE NOT ALONE
Other guardians' pets shine in the same sky. Tap a photo to see a name. There are no comments, likes or messages: only the sky, shared.

GENTLE BY DESIGN
• Free, with no ads.
• No streaks, badges or rankings.
• Your current location is used only on your phone to turn the sky the right way. It is never sent anywhere.
• Photos are checked before other people can see them, and you can report a photo or block a guardian at any time.
• You can make a pet private, remove it, or delete your account from Settings whenever you wish.

ABOUT THE STARS
The stars in PAL Star are real stars from a public star catalog, shown where they are in the sky. Giving a pet a star in PAL Star is a personal remembrance inside the app. It is not an official star name and does not give ownership of a star; only the International Astronomical Union names stars.

PAL Star is part of PAL (Pet Afterlife), with PAL Park.

Terms of Use: https://petafterlife.co/star/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://petafterlife.co/star/privacy/

name: PanTally: Baking Pan Converter
description:
The right recipe for any pan.

Have a cake recipe for a 9-inch round pan and a 9 × 13-inch pan on hand? PanTally compares their top areas and shows how much to scale the recipe. In that example, you’d use about 1.84 times the original ingredients.

- Choose a round, square, rectangular, or loaf pan. Use a common size or enter your own dimensions in inches or centimeters.
- See how much more or less batter you’ll need, and open Conversion Details to see how the estimate was calculated.
- Scale ingredients entered as decimals or fractions. See practical kitchen fractions and suggestions for measuring part of a beaten egg.
- Save recipes with their pan sizes and original ingredient amounts, then reopen and adjust them on your iPhone.

PanTally works offline and keeps your saved recipes on your device.

The estimate assumes comparable usable pan depths and side shapes. Pan material and shape can affect baking time. Use the recipe’s cues to check for doneness.

name: Papa Pizza: Cooking Simulator
description:
Build your own cozy pixel pizzeria from scratch.

The town lives its life outside the window. The oven hums. The smell of fresh dough drifts down a quiet street.

This is your pizzeria. Right now it's just an empty room with a single dream.

PAPA PIZZA is a cozy pixel art game about building a little place people love coming back to.

START FROM NOTHING
Fire up your first oven and serve your very first slice to a curious neighbour.

GROW YOUR MENU
From a simple Margherita to house specials. Discover new recipes and ingredients, and watch your residents find their favorites.

BUILD YOUR TEAM
Hire cooks and waiters. Each new hand makes the kitchen run a little smoother.

MAKE IT FEEL LIKE HOME
Plants, cozy tables, little details everywhere. Every corner is yours to decorate.

UPGRADE AND STREAMLINE
More ovens, smarter workflow, more happy guests. Watch the evening crowd grow, one table at a time.

AND THEN... JUST RELAX
Once everything runs on its own, there's nothing left to rush. Look around, watch the lights glow and the customers come and go, and enjoy the warm little world you've built.

• Every pixel drawn by hand
• Calm, cozy atmosphere
• Play at your own pace, no pressure

With love, Team 23%

name: Papelista: Spanish paperwork
description:
Spanish bureaucracy has a catchphrase: "come back tomorrow". Papelista exists so you don't have to.

TELL ME WHAT HAPPENED
"I've moved." "My TIE is about to expire." "I want Spanish nationality." I tell you which procedure applies, what to bring and where to go. 71 procedures, step by step, each with its official source: residence and nationality, padrón, ID and passport, unemployment benefits, fines, taxes and Social Security.

I'LL WRESTLE THE WEBSITE
I go into the official website with you and fill in whatever can be filled in. You only do what only you can do: the CAPTCHA, your Cl@ve sign-in, your Face ID. Nothing is confirmed, paid or signed without you.

A HEADS-UP BEFORE EVERY DEADLINE
Appointments, expiring documents and appeal deadlines: worked out for you, with reminders in time.

THAT OFFICIAL LETTER, EXPLAINED
Take a photo: I point out the deadlines it mentions and explain the odd words. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence I also tell you, in your language, what it is, what they want and what happens if you do nothing. All on your iPhone.

AN ASSISTANT THAT KNOWS YOUR PAPERS
Ask anything. It answers from your procedures, your deadlines and your documents.

YOUR PAPERS ARE YOURS
Your documents stay on your iPhone, encrypted. No account, no sign-up. The online assistant is optional, and you decide whether it may use your data.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Spanish, French, Romanian, Ukrainian, Arabic and Chinese. Immigration, nationality and padrón procedures are fully translated; the rest of the catalogue is in Spanish for now, and the assistant explains it in your language.

IF THINGS GET COMPLICATED
I put you in touch with a real professional. It's free for you: the professional pays us a commission.

Papelista is not a government website or app. We help you complete your procedures on the official websites.

name: PaperPleat
description:
Paper & Pleat is a pocket origami studio for turning a single square of paper into something you can hold. Start with a Woodland Fox, fold a tiny house for a gift card, or make a paper cup for the little things on your desk.

Each pattern guides you through one fold at a time. Follow the arrows and crease lines, switch to the result to check the shape in your hands, and go back whenever you need to see an earlier move. If you put the paper down halfway through, your place is saved for next time.

Explore six patterns for animals and everyday objects. Bookmark the ones you want to make again, or visit the Techniques tab to practice a valley fold, a mountain fold, a pre-crease, or separating paper layers. Each technique links to a pattern where you can put it to use.

When a piece is finished, give it a name in your fold journal, choose the paper color, and jot down what helped. Revisit your notes before making another version, or simply look back at the pieces you have made.

All lessons work offline, and your journal is stored locally. Set out a square, pick a pattern, and fold at your own pace.

name: ParkGlas
description:
ParkGlas finds you somewhere to park in Ireland.

Open the app and the map shows the car parks around you: more than 6,000 across the Republic of Ireland, from multi-storeys in the city to the car park beside the beach. Where a council publishes live numbers, a ring on the pin shows how many spaces are free right now.

PARK ME NOW
Tap the green P and ParkGlas picks one car park for you. It looks within 2 km, skips any that are closed or full, prefers one with free spaces on a live count, and hands you to Waze, Apple Maps or Google Maps for directions.

SEE BEFORE YOU GO
• Free spaces live, where available (Cork city today)
• Price, opening hours and height limit
• Who runs the car park, where known
• Street-level view of the area

SEARCH AND FILTER
• Search any address and see the car parks around it
• Show only open, free, multi-storey or accessible parking
• Customer car parks at shops and shopping centres, with their conditions
• Fuel stations and EV chargers on the same map
• Tell ParkGlas your car's connector and it marks the chargers that fit

REMEMBER WHERE YOU PARKED
• Save your spot with a note and a photo
• Set your ticket time and get a reminder before it runs out
• The countdown shows on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Where a car park has a time limit or a closing time, ParkGlas offers it as a timer

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Folded, the controls sit in the dock strip so the map stays clear. Unfolded, the map and the list sit side by side.

YOURS, AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your location, favourites and saved spot stay on your iPhone
• Supports Dark Mode, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion

GOOD TO KNOW
ParkGlas covers the Republic of Ireland. Live free-space counts are available for Cork city car parks; elsewhere you see price and opening hours where they are known. Parking details come from OpenStreetMap volunteers and Irish councils and can be out of date, so always follow the signs at the car park.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Contains data from Dublin City Council and Cork City Council. ParkGlas is not affiliated with any car park operator.

name: Parlo: Dictation Keyboard
description:
Parlo turns what you say into text, on your iPhone.

DICTATE IN ANY APP
The Parlo keyboard types like any keyboard and adds a Parlo key. Tap it, speak, tap stop, and your words appear where you were typing: Messages, Mail, Notes, WhatsApp, Telegram, anywhere you can type.
- A live waveform shows Parlo is hearing you, and which microphone it is using
- Filler words like "um" are removed
- English and Spanish layouts, in QWERTY or Dvorak
- Typing works without Full Access; only dictation needs it

RECORD MEETINGS
Tap record, put the phone down, and Parlo writes the transcript when you stop.
- Keeps recording with the screen locked
- Pause and stop from the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island
- Works with AirPods and other microphones, and lets you switch mid-recording
- Search, play back and share your recordings

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Speech is turned into text by a model that runs on your iPhone. Your recordings, transcripts and dictations stay on this iPhone. No account is needed to use Parlo.

WORKS WITH PARLO FOR MAC
If you use Parlo on your Mac, sign in with your Parlo account to sync. Recordings and dictations go to your Mac, and the notes it writes come back. Sync goes directly between your devices, never through a Parlo server.

The speech model is a one-time download of about 485 MB and covers 25 European languages.

name: Parsifal
description:
Parsifal brings your workplace schedule, tasks and team conversations together.

View your shifts and assigned tasks. Record completed work and add a photo when one is requested.

Keep in touch through individual chats, group conversations and manager announcements. Share pictures and see message read status. Choose a conversation language to show automatic translations alongside the original text. Translations may contain mistakes, so the original remains available.

Keep personal appointments in your own agenda, separate from the workplace schedule.

Where a mailbox is provided, read and send plain-text email from your own Inbox and Sent views.

Access your employee information and workplace documents according to the permissions assigned to your account.

Parsifal is for employees of participating workplaces. An account provided by your employer and an internet connection are required. Available features depend on your account permissions.

name: Pass Open
description:
PassOpen é o jeito mais fácil de curtir eventos: você encontra a festa, compra o ingresso em poucos toques, entra com o QR Code e ainda acompanha tudo com os seus amigos.

SEUS INGRESSOS SEMPRE À MÃO
- Todos os ingressos organizados no app, no estilo carteira
- QR Code pronto para a entrada, sem precisar imprimir nada
- Histórico de compras e detalhes de cada evento

PARA ORGANIZADORES
O mesmo app vira o seu painel de controle:
- Vendas, faturamento e gráficos do evento em tempo real
- Criação e publicação de eventos, lotes e cortesias
- PDV e bar para vender na porta, com controle de estoque
- Leitura dos ingressos na entrada pela câmera do celular
- Financeiro, repasses e resultados de cada evento
- Equipe e parceiros com acesso só ao que precisam

Baixe o PassOpen e não perca o próximo evento.

name: Pastime: Classic Games
description:
Pastime is a quiet collection of eight classic games, made for the spare minutes in your day. It opens straight onto a calm home screen with a soft, paper-like palette (and a gentle dark mode), so you can pick a game and start playing. There is nothing to sign up for and nothing to wait for.

Sudoku
Four difficulties (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert) with 100 levels each. Every puzzle has a single solution, with notes, undo, erase, and highlighting of matching digits and rule conflicts.

Minesweeper
Three board sizes: Beginner (9 x 9, 10 mines), Intermediate (16 x 16, 40 mines) and Expert (30 x 16, 99 mines). Your first move is always safe, and your best times are kept for each size.

Snake
Guide the snake around a 20 x 20 field, eat, grow, and try to beat your own high score. On iPhone and iPad you can swipe or use the on-screen direction pad.

Gomoku
Place stones on a 15 x 15 board and be the first to line up five. You play against the computer, with five levels that unlock as you win, and you can take back a move.

Blocks
An original falling-pieces game on a 9 x 18 board, with twelve pieces of three, four and five cells. Move, rotate and drop them to complete rows. A preview shows the next piece.

Merge
Our own take on a Fibonacci merging puzzle, on a 5 x 5 board. Slide the board in any direction; neighbouring numbers from the Fibonacci sequence (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 ...) join into the next one. Keep making room for as long as you can.

Pairs
Find two matching picture tiles that can be joined by a line with no more than two turns, and clear the board. 100 levels, from a small 4 x 4 board to 8 x 11, with 32 hand-drawn smiling tiles. Every level can be solved, and the tiles reshuffle by themselves if you get stuck.

Trios
Swap two neighbouring pieces to line up three or more of the same kind. 100 levels, each with a target score and a set number of moves, and up to three stars to earn. No lives, no timers, no boosters to buy.

Every game has a How to Play page and saves where you left off. The app has a Sound switch, an Appearance setting (System, Light or Dark) and, on iPhone, a Haptics switch. On Mac it is a native app with keyboard controls and menu shortcuts.

No ads. No tracking. No account. Works offline.

If you use iCloud, the app uses it for one thing only: keeping your scores and progress (high scores, best times, unlocked levels, stars and win counts) in step across your own devices. Games in progress stay on the device where you started them. The developer never sees any of it, and the app works the same without iCloud.

name: Path Pop
description:
Path Pop is a calm, satisfying puzzle game.

Start from the glowing square and draw a path exactly as long as the number. Fill rows and columns to pop them. Every path is final, so where you go changes everything.

• Learn in one touch: slide your finger, let go.
• Fill a line with one color to double its points.
• Pass over stars for bonus points.
• Number doesn't fit? Swap it with the Hold box.
• Three new goals every day, plus a day streak.
• Daily Game: the same board for everyone, every day.
• No ads, no account, no internet needed.
• Large, readable screens; optional color-blind mode and reduced motion.

Note: the game's interface is in Turkish.

name: Peacho Piles
description:
Peacho Piles is a co-op puzzle platformer for 2, 4 or 6 friends. The rule is simple: grab the key, open the door, and everyone walks through. But you can't do it alone.

• Pile up into towers: high keys are only reachable together.
• Push heavy boxes: a box marked "2" needs two of you pushing the same way.
• Play roped together: if someone slips, the others hold on — or you all go down.
• Plates, buttons, elevators, presses, crumbling bridges: every stage has a new twist.
• Online: create a room, send the code, friends join. No accounts, no sign-up.
• One-thumb controls: a joystick and a JUMP button.
• Play in English or Turkish.
• No ads, no in-app purchases.

Pack 1 · Garden: 10 stages, easy to hard. More packs on the way!

name: Pediu!
description:
O Pediu! é o aplicativo de quem faz o restaurante, a adega ou o delivery acontecer:
gestão da loja, garçom e entregador num app só. Ao entrar, o app reconhece quem
é você e abre a sua área.

GESTÃO DA LOJA
• Visão geral do dia: faturamento, pedidos, ticket médio e tempo de entrega
• Pedidos ao vivo: aceitar, preparar, despachar e concluir
• Produção (cozinha e bar), entregas, caixa e atendimento das mesas
• Cardápio, estoque, financeiro, clientes e configurações da loja
• Venda manual a um toque, de qualquer tela

GARÇOM
• Abre e fecha mesas e lança itens direto do cardápio da casa
• Vê o que já saiu da cozinha e está pronto para levar
• Conferência e fechamento de conta na própria mesa

ENTREGADOR
• Lista de entregas do turno com endereço e forma de pagamento
• Marca a entrega como concluída na hora, sem passar na loja

COMO FUNCIONA
O acesso é criado pelo próprio estabelecimento, no Pediu!. O dono entra com o
e-mail da conta; a equipe entra com CPF e senha. É uma ferramenta de trabalho:
quem não faz parte do estabelecimento não tem o que fazer aqui.

Dúvidas: suporte@247flow.com.br

name: peek – Screen Sharing
description:
peek is a native Screen Sharing client for iPhone and iPad. See your Mac's screen and control it by touch, the way macOS Screen Sharing does, without a server, an account, or a subscription.

Find your Mac automatically
Macs with Screen Sharing turned on appear in Nearby the moment you open the app. Tap one, sign in with your Mac user name and password, and you are in. Any VNC server works too: enter an address and port.

Touch that feels right
Tap to click, double-tap to double-click, two fingers to scroll, pinch to zoom and pan around a big display. Three-finger flicks switch Spaces and open Mission Control. Optional touchpad mode moves the Mac's pointer like a trackpad.

A keyboard built for a Mac
The system keyboard, plus a bar riding on top of it with sticky ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧, esc, tab, forward delete, arrows, F1–F12 and a Mac menu for Spotlight, app switching, screenshots, Lock Screen and more. Hardware keyboards on iPad send shortcuts straight through.

Shared clipboard
Copy on the Mac and paste on your phone. Paste from your phone into the Mac with one tap.

Stays connected
Reconnects after a dropped connection, remembers passwords in the iOS Keychain, keeps your place when you switch apps, and shows a thumbnail of each computer's last screen.

Made for Macs, works everywhere
Speaks Apple Remote Desktop and standard VNC authentication with Tight, ZRLE, Zlib and Hextile encodings, so it connects to macOS Screen Sharing, Linux desktops and any RFB server.

Private by design
No backend, no analytics, no accounts. Nothing leaves your device except the connection to the computer you chose.

name: Peekhand for Duo: Card Games
description:
Unfold your iPhone Duo — and the whole screen turns into a card table.

Peekhand is a card-game collection made for the iPhone Duo. On the large inner display, every game is played on a real 3D felt table: cards fly in from the player who throws them, tilt and bend under your finger and land on the pile with a little skid. Fold it shut and keep playing on the cover display — Peekhand adapts instantly. It also runs beautifully on every other iPhone.

11 CLASSICS, PLAYED PROPERLY
• Mau-Mau, Thirty-One (Schwimmen), Durak, Hearts, Old Maid
• Canasta, Rummy (Rommé), Skat
• Doppelkopf and Schafkopf — with real Bavarian card faces
• Solitaire: Klondike (draw 1 or 3) and FreeCell with the classic numbered deals
Official rules by default — and every house rule you know switchable in the setup screen: Ramsch, Bock rounds, Kontra and Re, Armut, Schweinchen, passing in Durak, 2 or 1 cards in Canasta and many more.

YOU AGAINST THE TABLE
Play against a cast of charming computer opponents who blink, glance at your cards, yawn when you take your time, fan themselves, tip their hats and react to every move. Design your own avatar — face, hair, glasses, crowns and more.

FEELS LIKE A BIG GAME
• Your hand as a real fan of cards, same size as the cards on the table
• Magical effects for strong moves, points and painful penalties
• A staged victory reveal with a golden 3D crown you can spin with your finger
• Four card designs: Royal Salon, Gatsby, Nebula Foil and Heritage with historic court cards
• And somewhere in the app there's a secret to discover…

LEARN EVERY GAME
Each game has a Training mode: hints that explain the best move, unlimited undo and the option to see everyone's cards. Game assistance can be switched off when you're ready.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
Free. No ads. No subscription. No in-app purchases. No account, no tracking, no data collected — and it works completely offline.

Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean and Portuguese.

name: Pet Reacts: Funny Sound Cam
description:
Make your dog or cat tilt their head — and get a funny, edited video ready to post in 10 seconds.

Pick a sound, aim at your pet, tap the paw: Pet Reacts plays the sound AND films at the same instant. It even keeps the 2 seconds BEFORE you tap, so you never miss the reaction.

YOUR VIDEO EDITS ITSELF
• The funniest moment is found and replayed in slow motion
• Sound label, funny caption, stickers and music added for you
• Vertical 9:16, ready for your favorite social apps
• Share in one tap or save to Photos

150+ ORIGINAL SOUNDS
• Meows, squeaky toys, doorbells, birds, silly voices
• Your own voice in Helium, Giant, Robot or Echo mode
• Christmas, Halloween, New Year and Valentine's packs

A GAME THAT KEEPS YOU COMING BACK
• Playful head-tilt score from 0 to 100 with funny titles
• Profiles for all your pets, with records and favorite sounds

HONEST BY DESIGN
Pet Reacts is an entertainment app. It doesn't pretend to translate animals: the score is a game, not science. Sounds are volume-limited and never meant to scare.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Analysis happens on your device and your videos stay there unless you share them.

FREE OR PREMIUM
Free: 10 sounds and 1 kept video per day.
Premium: all sounds, unlimited videos, no watermark and the Christmas pack. Weekly subscription with a 3-day free trial, or yearly.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://schmittutility.fr/confidentialite/
Support: https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/

name: Petals – Flower Reminder
description:
Petals reminds you to buy flowers for the one you love.

Some of the best gestures are the small, unexpected ones. Petals makes sure they don't slip your mind – with quiet reminders on a schedule that suits you, and a heads-up before the days that really count.

A GENTLE ROUTINE
Choose how often you'd like to bring home flowers – every week, every other week, or your own rhythm – and which day suits you best. Tap "I bought flowers" and the countdown starts again.

THE DAYS THAT MATTER
Add birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, International Women's Day or any date of your own. Get reminded on the day, or up to a week ahead, so there's always time to find something lovely.

A LITTLE HISTORY
Every bouquet you log is saved with an optional note – "pink peonies, just because" or "sunflowers for her new job" – so you can look back on all of them.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account or sign-in
• No ads, no tracking
• Everything stays on your iPhone
• Reminders work offline

Clean, calm and made for one thing: helping you show you care, more often.

name: PhotoNAS TV: NAS Photo Viewer
description:
PhotoNAS TV brings the photos and videos on your Synology NAS to the big screen. Browse your Synology Photos library with the Siri Remote and enjoy your memories together on the couch – nothing to install on the NAS.

• Timeline with all your photos and videos, sorted by date
• Favorites, videos, albums, people and places
• Search your library
• Full-screen viewer with slideshow: time per photo, shuffle and a slow zoom
• Swipe down for photo details
• Plays your videos, with a choice of video quality
• Sharp photos on a 4K TV with "Load Originals"
• Personal space and shared space
• Sign in with the IP address of your NAS or a QuickConnect ID, also with a self-signed certificate

One purchase, everything included. No subscription, no in-app purchases.

Your photos and passwords only travel between your Apple TV and your own NAS. No account, no tracking, no ads.

Try it without a NAS: choose "Try the Demo".

PhotoNAS is an independent app and is not affiliated with Synology Inc. Synology and Synology Photos are trademarks of Synology Inc.

name: Pişti: Klasik Kâğıt Oyunu
description:
Klasik pişti, olması gerektiği gibi: sade, adil ve kesintisiz.

Reklam yok, internet gerekmez, uygulama içi satın alma yok, hesap açmak yok. Uygulamayı aç ve oyna.

NEDEN BU PİŞTİ?
• Reklamsız: oyunun ortasında hiçbir şey araya girmez.
• İnternetsiz: uçakta, metroda, her yerde oynanır.
• Satın alma yok: her şey ilk günden açık.
• Veri toplamaz: ayarların, istatistiklerin ve yarım kalan oyunun yalnızca cihazında saklanır.

ÜÇ OYUN MODU
• 1'e 1: bilgisayara karşı tek başına.
• 2'ye 2 eşli: bilgisayar ortağın karşında oturur; aldığınız kartlar ve puanlar ortak sayılır.
• 4 kişi tekli: herkes kendi için oynar, karşında üç bilgisayar rakip var.
Oyunu tek elde bitirebilir ya da 51, 101, 151 veya 201 puana kadar oynayabilirsin.

ÜÇ ZORLUK SEVİYESİ
• Kolay: çoğunlukla rastgele oynar, alabileceği masayı bazen kaçırır.
• Orta: alabildiğinde alır, Vale'yi değerli masalar için saklar.
• Zor: çıkan kartları aklında tutar, pişti ve puanlı kart fırsatlarını kollar.
Bilgisayar hile yapmaz: senin elini ve desteyi göremez; yalnızca kendi elini ve masada açık olan kartları bilir.

AYARLANABİLİR KURALLAR
Varsayılan kurallar klasik piştidir. İstersen Ayarlar'dan dört kuralı değiştirebilirsin:
• Açılışta üst kart Vale çıkarsa ne yapılacağı
• Masadaki tek kartı (Vale değilse) Vale ile almanın pişti sayılıp sayılmayacağı
• Vale üzerine Vale piştinin 20 mi 10 puan mı olacağı
• Destenin son kartıyla yapılan piştinin sayılıp sayılmayacağı
Tek dokunuşla varsayılan kurallara dönebilirsin. Oyun sırasında geçerli kuralları her an açıp okuyabilirsin.

İSTATİSTİKLER
Oynadığın oyunlar, galibiyet, beraberlik ve yenilgilerin, kazanma oranın, pişti ve Vale pişti sayıların ve bir elde aldığın en yüksek puan. Mod ve zorluğa göre ayrı ayrı bakabilirsin.

YARIM KALAN OYUN KAYBOLMAZ
Oyun her hamlede kaydedilir. Uygulamayı kapatsan bile "Devam et" ile kaldığın yerden sürer.

KLASİK GÖRÜNÜM
Yeşil çuha masa, iki başlı resimli kartlar, akıcı animasyonlar ve pişti anında kısa bir kutlama. Masa rengini, kart arkasını ve animasyon hızını seçebilirsin.

iPhone ve iPad için tasarlandı. Tamamen Türkçe.

PUANLAR
Pişti 10 · Vale üzerine Vale pişti 20 · Her As 1 · Her Vale 1 · Sinek 2'li 2 · Karo 10'lu 3 · En çok kart 3

name: Pit Pace
description:
Pit Pace là sổ quản lý các mẻ hun khói dành cho những người yêu thích BBQ tại nhà. Theo dõi từng lần nấu, hiểu hiệu suất của từng loại thịt và biết chính xác khi nào nên nhóm lò để món ăn sẵn sàng đúng giờ.

KHÔNG CẦN THIẾT BỊ ĐO THÔNG MINH

Pit Pace hoạt động độc lập, không yêu cầu kết nối với nhiệt kế Bluetooth hay thiết bị chuyên dụng. Bạn chỉ cần ghi lại thông tin từ những lần hun khói của mình để xây dựng dữ liệu và cải thiện các mẻ nấu tiếp theo.

QUẢN LÝ MẺ HUN KHÓI

- Ghi lại từng mẻ với tên phần thịt và cân nặng.
- Lưu nhiệt độ lò, loại gỗ sử dụng, thời gian bắt đầu và hoàn thành.
- Chấm điểm chất lượng thành phẩm từ 1 đến 5 sao.
- Chỉnh sửa hoặc xoá các mẻ nấu bất cứ lúc nào.

THEO DÕI NHIỆT ĐỘ VÀ GIAI ĐOẠN STALL

- Ghi lại các mốc nhiệt độ thịt theo thời gian.
- Theo dõi quá trình tăng nhiệt trong suốt thời gian hun khói.
- Biểu đồ nhiệt độ trực quan giúp bạn hiểu diễn biến của từng mẻ.
- Tự động nhận diện giai đoạn stall khi nhiệt độ tăng dưới 3°C trong 60 phút.
- Xem thời điểm bắt đầu, thời gian kéo dài và kết thúc stall.

LẬP KẾ HOẠCH GIỜ NHÓM LÒ

Đây là tính năng giúp bạn chủ động chuẩn bị cho bữa BBQ tiếp theo.

- Chọn loại thịt muốn hun khói.
- Nhập cân nặng dự kiến.
- Chọn giờ ăn mong muốn.
- Tính toán thời gian nấu dựa trên hiệu suất giờ/kg từ các mẻ trước.
- Cộng thêm thời gian nghỉ thịt và tính ngược để đề xuất giờ nhóm lò.
- Hiển thị khoảng dao động dự kiến dựa trên dữ liệu thực tế của bạn.

CÀNG SỬ DỤNG, KẾ HOẠCH CÀNG PHÙ HỢP

Pit Pace tổng hợp dữ liệu từ những mẻ nấu đã ghi nhận để giúp bạn hiểu rõ hơn về thói quen hun khói của mình.

- Biểu đồ thời gian nấu trung bình theo từng phần thịt.
- Thống kê hiệu suất giờ/kg.
- Thời gian stall trung bình.
- So sánh điểm chất lượng theo từng loại gỗ.
- Theo dõi lịch sử và kết quả các mẻ nấu.

XUẤT DỮ LIỆU

Xuất toàn bộ lịch sử mẻ nấu và các mốc nhiệt độ thành tệp CSV để lưu trữ, phân tích hoặc sử dụng trong các công cụ bảng tính.

RIÊNG TƯ VÀ ĐƠN GIẢN

- Không cần tài khoản hoặc đăng nhập.
- Không cần kết nối Internet.
- Dữ liệu được lưu trực tiếp trên thiết bị.
- Hỗ trợ sử dụng ngoại tuyến.
- Có thể xoá toàn bộ dữ liệu khi cần.

Pit Pace không thay thế nhiệt kế thực phẩm hoặc hướng dẫn an toàn thực phẩm. Các kết quả dự đoán dựa trên dữ liệu lịch sử do bạn ghi lại và chỉ mang tính tham khảo.

Pit Pace. Nhóm lò đúng giờ. Thưởng thức đúng lúc.

name: PiVolley
description:
PiVolley is the playbook for volleyball coaches and players.

• Set your six rotations for serve receive (K1), transition (K2) and serve (K3) on a real court.
• Drag players, draw arrows, mark zones and add notes to each formation.
• Animate a movement so players see where to go.
• Invite your players and co-trainers: they follow the team's playbook on their own phone.
• Scout your opponents live, set by set, with lineups, substitutions and every player's lines, together with your co-trainers.
• Export the whole playbook as a PDF.
• Works offline in the hall; your work saves itself when you are back online.

Made in Austria by Piathletics, led by a volleyball coach. In English, German and French. Players join through their coach's invitation.

name: PixelCrush: Cannon Puzzle
description:
A puzzle game about timing and colour.

Each level is a pixel-art picture: a clownfish, a space shuttle, a lighthouse, a dragon and more. Around it runs a conveyor belt. Tap a cannon to roll it onto the belt, and as it travels round the picture it fires at the nearest block of its own colour in its line of sight. Clear every block to win the level.

Every cannon carries a limited amount of ammo. One that finishes a lap with ammo left rolls into the dock, ready to send round again. But the dock only has five spaces. If it's full when a cannon comes back, the level is lost. So choose your cannons, and the order you send them, carefully.

FEATURES
• 19 hand-made pixel-art pictures in a shuffled order, some mirrored, so no two runs are the same
• Up to five cannons on the belt at once
• Three boosters each level: Slot adds a dock space, Pick takes any cannon from the supply, Shuffle deals the supply again
• Three hearts per run. Lose a level and it costs one; clear a level and you win one back
• Mystery cannons from level 2: their colour stays hidden until they reach the front
• Play at 1×, 2× or 4× speed
• Chunky 3D blocks, a walled conveyor belt and cannons that roll from the dock onto the belt
• Your best score is kept, so there's always something to beat

NO ADS. NO ACCOUNT. NO TRACKING.
PixelCrush doesn't connect to the internet and asks for no permissions. It stores only your best score and speed setting, on your device.

Made by SMF Technologies.

name: PLANS
description:
PLANS（Personal-device Local Assessment of Nutrients System）は、食事の写真から栄養値を推定する、栄養学研究のための研究用ソフトウェアです。

■ できること
・食事を撮影するか、写真ライブラリから選ぶと、エネルギー・たんぱく質・脂質・炭水化物・食塩相当量の推定値を表示します。
・研究プロトコルのモードでは、料理だけの重さを入力して推定することもできます。
・食事の記録を端末内に保存し、CSV などで書き出せます。
・フォルダ内の写真をまとめて解析できます。
・日本食品標準成分表（八訂）増補2023年から、食品を選んで栄養値を計算できます。

■ 端末の中で完結します
・解析には公開されている視覚言語モデル（Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct の 4bit 版）を使い、すべて端末の中で計算します。
・写真や結果を外部に送信しません。通信は、初回にモデル（約 3.1GB）をダウンロードするときだけです。ダウンロードしたモデルは照合値（SHA-256）で確認してから使います。

■ ご利用にあたって
本アプリは栄養学研究のために開発された研究用ソフトウェアです。表示される栄養値は写真からの推定値で、推定方法は研究の進展に合わせて改良を続けています。数値を利用・参考にする場合はご自身の責任でお願いします。開発者は表示される数値について責任を負いません。診断・治療など医療上の判断には使用しないでください。

■ 動作環境
メモリ 8GB 以上の iPhone・iPad を推奨します。初回のダウンロードには約 3.5GB の空き容量が必要です。

■ ソースコード
ソースコードは GitHub で公開しています（非商用利用に限り無償、PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0）。
https://github.com/shnkgw-rincom/PLANS-iOS

name: PlanWithArchie
description:
Make your wedding seating plan effortless with PlanWithArchie.

Planning your wedding should be exciting, not stressful. PlanWithArchie makes organising your guests and creating the perfect seating arrangement simple, intuitive and enjoyable.

Whether you're planning an intimate celebration or a big wedding, everything you need to organise your seating plan is in one place.

ORGANISE YOUR GUESTS

Easily add and manage your wedding guests.
Keep track of who's attending.

DESIGN YOUR SEATING PLAN

Create and customise your tables.
Arrange guests with ease.
Move guests between tables until everything feels just right.
Visualise your entire wedding reception layout.

MAKE EVERY DETAIL COUNT

Keep your guest list and seating arrangements organised.
Make adjustments as your plans evolve.
Spend less time worrying about logistics and more time enjoying the journey.
Your wedding, your guests, your perfect seating plan.

Plan smarter. Seat better. Celebrate together.

PlanWithArchie – making wedding seating a little easier.

name: Playora: Offline Party Games
description:
Playora turns one phone or tablet into a party game console for friends and family. No internet, no accounts, no ads: just pick a game, choose your players and play.

MEMORY MATCH
Flip two cards at a time and find every matching pair. It's quick to learn, fun for all ages and great for training your memory.

• Solo: race the clock and beat your personal best time and moves for every board size.
• Pass & play: 2 to 4 players take turns on one device. A match scores a point and earns another turn; a miss passes the phone to the next player. Ties are shared wins!
• Your board, your rules: play anything from a quick 6-card round to an epic 70-card challenge. Card size adapts to your screen so every card stays easy to tap.
• 7 colourful card themes: Animals, Fruits, Veggies, Treats, Vehicles, Emojis and Mixed.
• Personalise each player with a name and a fun avatar.
• Live scoreboard, turn indicator, timer, accuracy stats and a results screen with rankings.
• Pause, resume or restart any time. The game auto-pauses if you leave the app.

DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE
• Works 100% offline, perfect for trips, flights and family nights.
• Bright, modern design with light and dark themes.
• Big touch targets, clear player colours plus names and avatars, and screen reader labels.
• Built for iPhone and iPad.

PRIVACY FIRST
Playora has no ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking and no sign-up. Player names stay on your device.

More party games are on the way. Gather your friends and start playing!

name: Plocky
description:
One purchase. 62 games. No ads or subscriptions.

Make room for a little play. Plocky brings 62 puzzles, card games and board games together in one native collection for iPhone and iPad.

Pick a familiar favorite or discover something new: Sudoku, Solitaire, Minesweeper, Nonogram, Word Search, checkers, dominoes and more.

PLAY OFFLINE
All 62 games are included in the app. No account or internet connection is needed to play. This version has no advertising or in-app purchases.

FIND YOUR NEXT FAVORITE
Explore number puzzles, logic grids, tile games, cards and traditional board games. Selected games offer computer opponents or two players sharing one device.

TAKE A LITTLE HELP
Read the rules inside each game. Use undo, hints or reveal where available. Keep playing in light or dark appearance, with sound effects and celebrations you can turn on or off.

RETURN WHEN YOU LIKE
Progress stays on your device so you can return to your games later. No account-based synchronization or online leaderboards are included.

Plocky includes original games and native adaptations of MIT-licensed puzzle engines, with acknowledgments in the app.

name: Pocket Ball Social
description:
Pocket Ball Social    is a landscape-only entertainment pool game with a Beijing billiards-club vibe—polished UI, SpriteKit physics, and full 8-ball rules.

Four game modes

VS Computer: Easy, Medium, Hard AI
Puzzle: Clear pot goals and earn stars
Quick Match: Jump into 8-ball
Pass & Play: Two players, one device
Table & shots
Rack, solids/stripes, black-8 win/loss, foul & scratch rules; aim guides, power bar, and cue-ball English; combo callouts in match.

Meta progression
Earn coins; cue skins and table themes apply instantly; daily tasks, gift boxes, badges & collection; in-app rules guide.

Audio & haptics
Music, SFX, optional voice lines (follows system Chinese/English), and haptics—all toggleable in Settings.

Landscape everywhere
Optimized for iPhone and iPad in landscape from compact phones to Pro Max.

Drag power, aim on the cloth, release to shoot—your break starts now.

name: Pocket Guitar - Chill Room
description:
Pocket Guitarist is a small, quiet place for anyone who loves the guitar.

Hang your favorite guitars on the wall, set up an amp, and build your own pedalboard one pedal at a time.
Drop by the live club to watch a show while soft music plays, or wander through the music shop at your own pace.
You can also say hi with emojis to people playing in the same region.

Take a little break in your busy day.

name: PocketDesk: Remote for Mac
description:
PocketDesk turns your iPhone into a window to your Mac. See your Mac's screen and control it with natural touch — from the couch, the office or anywhere.

NATURAL TOUCH CONTROLS
• Tap to click, double-tap to double-click
• Swipe with one finger to scroll, with smooth momentum
• Long-press to right-click, or long-press and move to drag
• Tap a text field on your Mac and the keyboard appears
• Prefer a pointer? Switch to trackpad mode anytime
• Pinch to zoom; three-finger swipes for Mission Control and spaces

MADE FOR EVERYDAY USE
• One tap to connect to the Macs you've paired
• Tells you exactly why it can't connect — your Mac is asleep, PocketDesk Host isn't running, you're on a different Wi-Fi — and reconnects on its own when your Mac is back
• Stays connected when you briefly switch apps
• Multiple displays, app switcher, shortcuts, clipboard sharing and adaptive quality

PRIVATE AND SECURE
• End-to-end encrypted and mutually authenticated with per-device keys (Noise protocol)
• New devices must be approved at the Mac with a QR code or a matching 6-digit code
• Your screen never passes through our servers — there are none. No accounts, no tracking, no data collection
• Lock the app with Face ID

GETTING STARTED
1. Install the free PocketDesk Host on the Mac you want to control: shosuke24.github.io/pocketdesk
2. Allow Screen Recording and Accessibility for PocketDesk Host
3. Scan the QR code from the PocketDesk menu bar icon

Away from home? Install the free Tailscale app on your Mac and iPhone, and PocketDesk connects through it.

Requires a Mac running macOS 14 or later with PocketDesk Host.

name: Pool Racing: Raft Time Trial
description:
Pool Racing is an arcade time trial where you ride an inflatable kiddie pool like a raft. The water track hangs high above the clouds and has no walls at the edges: one push too many and you're over the side.

There's no steering wheel. A tiny jet engine rides on a rail around the raft. Move the engine with the joystick, hold the gas button, and the thrust pushes the raft the opposite way. The raft glides almost like on ice, so every bend has to be planned: swing the engine around early and brake with thrust before the turn.

HOW TO PLAY
• Touch anywhere on the left half of the screen and the joystick appears under your thumb
• Hold the big gas button to fire the engine; let go and the raft coasts
• Watch the heat gauge: hold the gas too long and the engine overheats and cuts out for a few seconds. A warning sound comes first

THE TRACK
• One handcrafted track, about a minute from start to finish
• Tight bends and narrow sections
• Buoys that bounce the raft away
• Holes in the middle of the water
• Currents that push the raft sideways
• Slow-moving spiked beams of different shapes: one touch and the raft pops
• Fall off or pop, and you're back at the last checkpoint while the clock keeps running

BEAT THE CLOCK
• 3-2-1 countdown, race timer and medal times always on screen
• Finish within the time limit for bronze; go faster for silver and gold
• Every beam moves the same way in every race, so the timing can be learned
• Your best time and best medal are saved on your iPhone

ALSO
• Pause at any moment
• Sound and vibration, each with its own switch
• 12 languages
• Plays offline
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up. The game collects no data.

name: PoonPoon: Thai Alphabet Train
description:
Drive a clay toy train along each Thai letter from ก to ฮ, and the track your child lays becomes their very own clay letter, stuck on a carriage of a 44-carriage train.

How it plays
• Tap the next station and the train rolls there, then pulls in.
• Drag the engine along the letter's track with a finger, from its start to the end of each line.
• When the letter is done, a little duck brings its word sticker and the game says the letter's name, “กอ ไก่”.
• Stick the clay letter and the sticker on the carriage, and the new carriage joins the train.
• Tap the engine and the train calls out every letter written so far, one carriage at a time.
• The line runs past rice fields and orchards, through a hill tunnel, over a river bridge, all the way to the sea.

Made for young children
• No reading needed. A cartoon hand and the little duck show the way when your child is unsure.
• No “wrong”, no stars, no scores, no timers.
• Write any letter again as often as they like, or skip a station for now.

For parents
• Portfolio: See your child's first and latest writing of each letter side by side.
• No ads, no accounts, no data collected about your child.
• Plays without an internet connection.
• Purchases and settings sit behind a question for parents.

The first 5 letters are free (ก ข ฃ ค ฅ).
Pay once to play all 44, with no subscription. Family Sharing is supported.

PoonPoon lets children practice tracing and get to know the shapes and names of the Thai consonants through play. It works best when you play together.

name: Pop A Ball 2: Color Rush
description:
Your eyes read the word. Your brain has to see the color.

Every balloon has a color and a word written on it, and they don't always agree. Pop the one balloon that follows the rule before it floats off the screen. Sounds easy, until the word RED shows up on a blue balloon.

THE RULES KEEP CHANGING
- Pop the match: color and word are the same.
- Pop the odd one: color and word are different.
- Pop by color: look at the color, ignore the word.
- Pop by word: read the word, ignore the color.
From level 4 the rule switches as you play. The game always stops to show you the new rule, so you never have to guess.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- Classic: three hearts, endless levels, faster and trickier as you go.
- Daily Challenge: the same balloons for everyone, every day. Keep your streak alive and share your result.
- Rush: 60 seconds, every mistake costs time.

MORE TO POP
- Power-up balloons: slow motion, a shield that forgives a mistake, and an extra heart.
- Bombs you must never pop, whatever the rule says.
- Combos up to x5 and Fever mode for double points.
- A sky that turns from morning to a starry night as you level up.
- Trophies and stats: accuracy, reaction time, best combo.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
- Color symbols option for color blind players, with an on-screen key and slower balloons.
- No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone.
- Works offline.

Based on the Stroop effect, a classic psychology test of focus and attention. How fast can your brain beat your eyes?

name: PopIn: Meet Up Nearby
description:
PopIn helps you find people nearby who are free right now, for a coffee or a game.

When you have some time, tell PopIn you are free for 30 minutes, 1, 2 or 4 hours. While you are visible, other people who have done the same can see you on the map, and you can see them. Send someone a one-line ping. If they accept, a chat opens so the two of you can agree on a cafe and a time. If they do not, nothing else happens.

HUDDLES: GAMES AND OUTINGS NEARBY
- Join a padel doubles, a five-a-side, a run, a hike, a board-games night and more, at a public place near you.
- Host your own in seconds: pick the activity, the time, the place and how many people.
- Every Huddle has its own group chat, a waitlist when it is full, and a "still in?" check before it starts.

HOW IT WORKS
- Sign in with Apple, with Google, or with your email address.
- Enter your date of birth. PopIn is for adults aged 18 and over. Only your age is shown to others, never your date of birth.
- Set up a short profile: a display name, an optional photo, a one-line bio and up to three interests from a fixed list.
- Go visible when you are free. Your visibility ends on its own when the time you chose runs out.
- Ping someone on the map with a short hello.
- Chat only after a ping is accepted. Either of you can suggest a cafe and a time, and the other confirms it.
- Optional nearby alerts tell you when someone close by goes free, without saying who.

YOUR LOCATION STAYS ROUGH
Your exact position stays on your phone, unless you switch on "Find each other" (below). Before anything is shared, PopIn moves it by a fixed 150 to 350 metres in a direction chosen once for your account, then rounds it to a 250 metre grid. People see a soft circle on the map, not a dot, and distances are shown in rough bands such as "about 1.2 km away". Your location is only shared while you have chosen to be visible. You can also show yourself around an area you pick, or blur it to a wider area.

ON THE DAY OF YOUR COFFEE
- "I'm here" tells the other person you have arrived at the cafe.
- "Find each other" is a two-way, opt-in share of your position with the one person you are meeting. It only works near the agreed cafe, from 15 minutes before to 30 minutes after the agreed time, and stops when you leave the screen.
- A Safety button on the meetup card gives you a one-tap call to the local emergency number and a quick way to tell a friend where you are.

SAFETY
- You can report or block someone from their profile, a ping, a chat or a Huddle.
- Reports are reviewed within 24 hours, and accounts are removed when warranted.
- Profile photos are checked automatically, and names, bios and messages are filtered for abuse.
- Blocking closes the chat for both of you and hides you from each other's map. The other person is not told they were blocked.
- Safety tips are in the app: meet in a busy public place, tell a friend where you are going, and arrange your own transport.

YOUR ACCOUNT
- You can delete your account at any time from Me > Delete account.
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Turn on notifications and PopIn tells you when someone pings you, says yes, writes to you, or when a Huddle you are in changes.
- PopIn works best where other people in your area use it too.

PopIn is for people aged 18 and over.

Privacy policy: https://popin-app.web.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://popin-app.web.app/terms
Support: https://popin-app.web.app/support

name: Posture Check: Desk Stretches
description:
Posture Check nudges you to sit straight and move a little during your work day. No nagging, no account, no ads.

REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR DAY
Set your work hours and work days, pick an interval (30, 45, 60 or 90 minutes) and reminders only arrive when you are actually at your desk. They are time-sensitive, so a Work Focus lets them through. Pause for an hour, until tomorrow, or switch them off in one tap.

20-SECOND GUIDED STRETCHES
Every reminder comes with a quick stretch: neck tilts, chin tucks, shoulder rolls, chest openers, wrist stretches, seated spinal twists, upper-back stretches, eye palming and more. Each has an animated guide, clear instructions, a safety note and a countdown that lives in the Dynamic Island while you stretch.

POSTURE MIRROR
A 10-second check with the front camera scores how far your head sits forward and whether your shoulders are level, with a tip to fix it. Everything runs on your iPhone; no video is saved or sent.

ONE-TAP RESPONSE
Mark a reminder done straight from the notification, snooze it for 10 minutes, or open the stretch.

SCORE, STREAKS AND WIDGETS
See today's score (done / done + missed), a weekly chart, a 30-day view and your streak. Put the score ring on your Home Screen or Lock Screen, and ask Siri "What's my posture score in Posture Check?"

APPLE HEALTH
Optionally save each stretch session to Health as mindful minutes.

100% PRIVATE
No tracking, no account, no internet use. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Posture Check offers general wellness reminders and is not medical advice.

name: Pour Realms: Bottle Puzzle
description:
Bring every color home — but these bottles have rules of their own.

Pour Realms is a world-by-world liquid sorting puzzle. The basics take seconds: tap a bottle, tap another, and pour the matching top color across until each color fills its own bottle. The real challenge is that every world rewrites the rules.

TEN WORLDS, FIVE NEW RULES • Lagoon — learn the basics • Misty Woods — Hidden Colors: segments marked "?" stay secret until the liquid above is poured away • Glassworks — Mixed Sizes: bottles hold anywhere from 3 to 6 segments • Glacier — Frozen Bottles: iced bottles thaw only after a set number of moves • Golden Vault — Locked Bottles: collect the color on the lock to open it • Cascade — One-Way Bottles: ↓ bottles only take liquid, ↑ bottles only give it • Twilight, Aurora, Abyss, Nebula — rules combine for the toughest boards

MASTER LEVELS The last 10 levels of every world are master puzzles: more colors, fewer empty bottles, and boards picked by simulation to reward planning ahead.

FAIR BY DESIGN • Every level is verified by a solver, so it is always solvable • Stars are measured against the shortest solution • Unlimited undo and restart, plus one extra bottle when you're stuck

50 ACHIEVEMENTS AND TITLES Progress, worlds, stars, skill, dedication, collection — and a few secrets to discover. Unlocked achievements grant titles you can show on the main menu.

UNLOCK LOOKS WITH STARS 4 bottle shapes, 9 backgrounds, 4 liquid styles (juice, lava, galaxy…) and 3 celebration effects. All earned by playing — there is no shop.

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS • Color blind mode adds a unique symbol to every color • VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion support • iPhone and iPad, with landscape on iPad • Combo sounds and haptics, each can be turned off • English and Traditional Chinese

PLAY WITH PEACE OF MIND Fully offline. No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected. Your progress stays on your device.

name: Power Yummy
description:
Power Yummy shows how much power your devices use, what it costs, and how your batteries are doing.

YOUR MACS ON IPHONE
With Power Yummy on your Mac, each Mac appears here as a card: live watts, battery level, time left, health, temperature, the last 24 hours and the last 7 days. Everything travels through your own iCloud. There are no accounts and no servers.

TOP APPS
The 10 apps that used the most energy today, this month and this year, for all your Macs or one, with energy and CO2.

COST BY DEVICE
Today's energy and an estimated monthly cost for every device, at your own electricity price and grid CO2 factor.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE
A two-sentence summary of your day's energy, written on device.

ALERTS, WIDGETS AND APPLE WATCH
Low battery, charge target and heat alerts from your Mac. Home and Lock Screen widgets. A Watch app and complications.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No data collection, analytics, ads or tracking. Your readings stay on your devices and in your iCloud.

name: PractiX: AI Practice
description:
PractiX is a practice app that shows how an AI-driven strategy works — safely, with virtual coins.

CALIBRATE YOUR AI
Start with a one-minute calibration: the AI scans Gold, Oil and Silver, picks an asset for your strategy and runs a practice session in front of you.

PRACTICE STEP BY STEP
Every step of a session is visible: the practice value, the result of each step and how the next step changes. Sessions can end with a plus or a minus — that is part of learning.

CHOOSE YOUR STRATEGY
Pick Balanced, Conservative or Dynamic, or tune your own: scale, number of steps, sessions per run and pace.

WATCH YOUR AI LEARN
Your AI Learning Level grows with every completed session.

TRACK YOUR PRACTICE
History of sessions, daily energy and your progress in one place.

IMPORTANT
PractiX is for practice and education only. It uses virtual coins with no monetary value. There are no deposits, no withdrawals, no real trading and no purchases inside the app. Results in the app do not predict or guarantee any real-world results. 18+.

name: Praddle - Word Guessing Game
description:
Praddle is the word game you play together. Guess the hidden word letter by letter, taking turns with a friend. Whoever cracks the word first scores the points. A word puzzle that turns every guess into a duel.

CLASSIC: CHALLENGE SOMEONE
• Take turns on the same board, each in your own time
• Fewer guesses means more points, and the last word counts double
• One joker per game reveals a letter, only for you
• Hidden bonus tiles give extra points
• Play a friend, a random opponent or a new player
• Chat, rematch and keep your head-to-head record

ROBO: ALWAYS SOMEONE TO PLAY
Nobody online? Challenge Robo, the Praddle bot, at three levels: Robo Junior, Robo and Robo Max.

WORD OF THE DAY
A new daily word, the same for everyone. How fast can you solve it? Compare your time on the leaderboard, share your result and keep your streak alive.

TURBO: 2 TO 6 PLAYERS
Five quick 2-minute rounds, everyone plays when it suits them. Guess as many words as you can: the highest total wins.

SOLO
Three rounds against the clock. How high can you go?

AND MORE
• Weekly leaderboard: who is this week's best word guesser?
• Statistics: wins, streaks, best scores and your record against every friend
• Clear rules with animated examples
• 50 animal avatars. Be honest: you're not a lion.
• English, Dutch and Spanish editions, each with their own words and games
• No account, email or password needed
• Free to play, no ads

Questions, ideas or a word that should be accepted? Email info@majuko.nl.

name: Premier Gameday HQ
description:
Premier Gameday HQ is a schedule companion for ECNL families.

Follow one club and up to four teams. See the next game, kickoff, and field, then open directions in Maps. Check the full schedule, conference standings, predicted standings, club pages, and a head-to-head matchup.

Favorites stay on your phone. There is no account and no sign-in.

Schedules and scores follow the published league data. Pull to refresh for the latest.

Premier Gameday HQ is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Elite Clubs National League (ECNL), Athlete One, Total Global Sports, or any member club.

name: Prende.ai
description:
Prende is an assistant you talk to, or txt to. Open the line, say "Prende", and ask for what you need. She answers out loud, on your AirPods, the speaker or the handset.

What she can do:
• Answer questions and talk things through
• Set reminders, and call you when it is time
• Read your calendar and add events
• Check your email and files through your own Claude account, if you connect one
• Call a restaurant, a shop or an office for you and report back
• Keep working on longer jobs in the background and tell you when they are done

How it works:
• Listening mode keeps the line open quietly. She answers only when you say her name first.
• A single line on the screen shows what she is working on and what is waiting for you.
• You can also call or text her from your phone, without opening the app.

Your privacy:
• The microphone is on only while the line is open, and iOS shows the indicator the whole time.
• Voice is turned into text; recordings are not kept.
• Work with your email and calendar runs inside your own Claude account.
• You can delete your account and everything in it from Settings.

Prende uses Anthropic's Claude to understand and answer you. You are asked to agree to this before you start.

Terms: https://prende.ai/terms

name: Princewood Press
description:
Make room for a good book.

Princewood Press brings Intertwined and the Intertwined Companion Guide by Rhonda Krill to your iPhone and iPad. Explore friendship, belonging, and the relationships that carry us through life.

TRY BEFORE YOU SIGN IN
