Read a free sample of either book without an account.

READ YOUR WAY
• Enjoy the illustrated editions of both books.
• Choose adjustable text for Intertwined.
• Read in full screen.
• Return to your reading place, saved on this device.
• Explore the collection by title or author.

FOR PRINCEWOOD PRESS MEMBERS
Sign in securely through the Princewood Press website using your existing account. An active Digital Reading Pass is required to open the books. Downloading the app does not include a reading pass.

An internet connection is required to sign in and open books. App sessions last up to eight hours; sign in again after restarting the app. Books are provided for online reading.

Questions? Contact princewoodpress@gmail.com.

name: PrintThere Mobile
description:
PrintThere Mobile ist die kostenlose Begleitapp zu PrintThere für Mac. Sende PDFs, Fotos und Webseiten an einen Drucker, den du mit PrintThere auf deinem Mac freigegeben hast. Verbinde deine Geräte mit einem Verbindungscode und prüfe die Vorschau vor dem Senden.

Für die Druckerfreigabe brauchst du die kostenpflichtige Mac-App. Der Mac beim Drucker muss eingeschaltet und online sein und PrintThere ausführen.

name: Prism Duel
description:
Prism Duel is a fast, tactical card duel in a glowing isometric arena.

Build a deck from 80 original cards — dragons, golems, knights, spells and traps — then summon them as living holograms and battle for the last Life Point.

FEATURES
• Every monster has its own summon, attack and defeat animation, and its own sound
• Duel the CPU, or pass the phone and play a friend on the same screen
• Deck builder with presets, auto-fill and a level curve — drag cards in, drag them out
• Spells, traps, tributes, direct attacks and comebacks in short, readable turns
• Hand-drawn pixel art with soft real-time lighting that fills the whole screen on modern iPhones

ONE PURCHASE, THE WHOLE GAME
• All 80 cards and every mode are included — nothing to unlock, nothing to buy later
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts
• Plays fully offline
• No data collected — your decks stay on your iPhone

name: Pro-ANTH
description:
Trail Load Studio auttaa retkeilijöitä ja kevyesti retkeileviä suunnittelemaan kantamuksensa varusteiden todellisten painojen perusteella.

Hyödynnä aiemmin tallentamaasi varustekokoelmaa, lisää tuotteita retkisuunnitelmaan ja seuraa, kuinka pakattujen varusteiden, kulutustarvikkeiden ja päällä pidettävien varusteiden painot päivittyvät muutosten mukana. Jos jonkin varusteen painoa ei tunneta, se merkitään tuntemattomaksi eikä sitä lasketa virheellisesti nollaksi.

Vertaa enintään viittä varustevaihtoehtoa rinnakkain ennen lopullista valintaa. Kun suunnitelma on valmis, tarkista pakkauslista, merkitse välttämättömät varusteet, viimeistele pakkaus ja jaa selkeä tekstimuotoinen lista.

Laajemmilla näytöillä voit vaihtaa kolmen paneelin työskentelynäkymään. Luonnokset säilyvät tallentamiseen asti, ja voit kumota muutoksia nykyisen suunnittelukerran aikana. Painoyksiköiksi voit vaihtaa g, kg, oz tai lb muuttamatta tallennettuja grammapainoja.

name: Producer: Creator Planner
description:
Give your next video a place to start.

Producer is a free pocket producer for content creators. Turn a blank page into a daily brief, keep your ideas together, and build a posting rhythm that leaves room for days off.

A CLEAR BRIEF, EVERY DAY
Get a hook, shot list, caption, and a reason the format works. Briefs adapt to your niche, experience, and comfort on camera. Prefer voiceover or faceless videos? Plan those too. Swipe to try a different brief or pin an idea you want to make today.

FIND YOUR NEXT ANGLE
Radar brings together upcoming calendar moments and the patterns you spot in your own feed. Optional Live pulse adds public lists of trending searches, popular songs, and widely read topics when you are online. Turn a trend into an angle that fits your work.

KEEP THE GOOD IDEAS
Bank sparks in Studio and move them through scripted, shot, and posted stages. Use the idea machine when you need a fresh prompt.

GET READY TO SHOOT
Work through your shot list with a timer. Rehearse with an editable teleprompter, adjustable speed and text size, and a mirror option. Producer helps you plan and rehearse; record and publish using your camera and social apps.

BUILD A RHYTHM YOU CAN KEEP
Choose your shoot days, set an optional call time reminder, and track your posts, progress, badges, and posting history in Reel. Scheduled days off protect your run.

FREE AND YOURS
No subscriptions, in-app purchases, ads, or account. Your profile, ideas, and posting history stay in local app storage. Daily briefs, calendar moments, sightings, and your idea bank work offline. Optional Live pulse needs an internet connection and can be switched off.

Made for iPhone. Requires iOS 26 or later.

Privacy policy: https://producer-creator.pages.dev/privacy/
Support: https://producer-creator.pages.dev/support/

name: Prompter - Script Teleprompter
description:
Prompter is a teleprompter for people who film themselves. Put your iPhone next to your camera's lens, read your script, and keep your eyes where they belong.

PASTE ONCE, GET CARDS
Paste the whole script. Prompter splits it into short cards by paragraph, by sentence, or by a word limit, and shows you the cards before you start. A line with --- always starts a new card. Text in [brackets] becomes a cue — "smile", "show the product" — that you see but don't read aloud.

TWO WAYS TO READ
• Cards: one idea at a time, in big type. Tap, swipe, or press a Bluetooth page-turner to go to the next card. A timer shows how you're doing against the estimate.
• Scroll: the whole script rolls past a reading line at a speed you set in words per minute. Change speed on the fly, drag to nudge, or turn on Follow voice so the text keeps up with you and waits when you pause.

MADE FOR A REAL SETUP
• Text on the top, center or bottom edge — whichever sits closest to your lens
• Mirror text for beam-splitter prompter glass
• Countdown before scrolling starts
• Screen stays awake and bright while you read
• Controls fade away so only your words are on screen
• Works with Bluetooth page-turners and keyboards

LEARN YOUR PACE
After each run, see your total time, words per minute, and how long every card took. Prompter points out the card that ran long so you can split it or trim it.

EDIT IN SECONDS
Reorder, merge and split cards, add cues, or re-split the whole script with a different method. Every project keeps its run history.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no ads. Your scripts never leave your iPhone.

name: ProofBench
description:
Keep the recipe behind each loaf, alongside what you observed. ProofBench connects sourdough starter feeds, scaled recipes and a journal of your bakes.

• Log starter feeds with seed, flour, water, time, room temperature and notes; see the seed-to-flour-to-water ratio.
• Save flour, water, starter and salt weights. View dough weight and hydration, calculated with equal flour and water in the starter.
• Choose a base-flour weight to scale the other ingredients.
• Start a batch from the scaled recipe. Update Planned, Mixing, Proofing and Baked stages, add a 1–5 rating and reflect on the result. Each batch keeps its recipe snapshot after the original recipe changes or is deleted.
• Search starters and recipes, export JSON backups and restore records after confirmation.

Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Core records work offline on your device. You update stages yourself; the app does not predict fermentation or determine food safety.

name: ProTranscript
description:
ProTranscript turns your meetings into clean, readable transcripts, right on your iPhone.

Tap Start when the meeting begins and Stop when it ends. ProTranscript transcribes the recording on your device and labels who said what, so you can focus on the conversation instead of taking notes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Transcription runs entirely on your iPhone. Your audio is never uploaded.
• Works offline. No account, no sign-in, no cloud.
• Recordings and transcripts stay in the app, on your device.

BUILT FOR HOW YOU SPEAK
• Understands English, Hindi and mixed Hinglish conversations.
• Speaker labels show who said what.

CLEAN OUTPUT
• Each recording becomes a single, well-formatted transcript with the date, duration and participants.
• The compressed audio is kept next to the transcript so you can listen back.

SIMPLE
• One button to start, one to stop. Nothing else to learn.

ProTranscript is free.

name: PS Speak: Voice Interpreter
description:
PS Speak helps two people who don't share a language talk to each other. Speak normally and your iPhone says your words in the other person's language, with captions for both of you.

THREE WAYS TO TRANSLATE

• Conversation – Put the phone between you. Each person speaks in their own language; PS Speak works out who is talking and translates out loud. The screen is split so the person opposite can read their side.
• Listen – Translate a talk, announcement or video into your language as large captions, with speech if you want it.
• Type – Type in either language and PS Speak translates and speaks it. Or switch translation off and it simply reads your text aloud. Show the result full-screen to the other person.

78 LANGUAGES
Translate between any two of 78 languages, including Burmese, English, Thai, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, Filipino, Arabic, Spanish, French and German.

YOU PAY GOOGLE DIRECTLY, ONLY FOR WHAT YOU USE
PS Speak uses Google's Gemini API with your own API key, created free in Google AI Studio in a few minutes; the app guides you. Most people can start on Google's free tier with no card. If you turn on billing with Google, Google charges you directly; PS Speak shows an estimate of your usage and can warn you at a monthly budget you choose.
Note: a Gemini app subscription (Google AI Pro or Ultra) does not include API use.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The developer collects nothing: no account, no analytics, no ads.
• Your key stays in the iPhone Keychain. Speech and text go only to Google's Gemini API.
• History stays on your iPhone, with delete and auto-delete.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Requires an internet connection and a Gemini API key.
• On Google's free tier, Gemini is sometimes busy; a key with billing turned on is more reliable.
• Available only where Google offers the Gemini API.
• Translation quality depends on Google's Gemini models; check important information, such as medical instructions, with a qualified person.

PS Speak is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Gemini is a trademark of Google LLC.

name: publik kneecap
description:
publik kneecap is a video editor for iPhone. Import videos and photos from Photos, edit them on a timeline, and save the finished video back to Photos. Everything runs on your iPhone. The app never uploads your videos or photos.

EDIT
• Trim, split, duplicate and delete clips.
• Change the speed (keep the pitch if you want), set the volume or mute a clip.
• Remove silent gaps automatically.
• Add transitions: fade, slide or zoom.
• Change the aspect ratio: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 or 3:4.
• Set a background color.

TEXT AND CAPTIONS
• Add text with size, bold, italic, alignment, color, background and border.
• Make English captions from the speech in your clip. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone. You can highlight each spoken word.

LOOK AND SOUND
• Filters: Vivid, Mono, Vintage, Cool, Warm and Cinematic, with intensity.
• Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, temperature, tint and vignette.
• Blur effect, and overlays with opacity and blend modes.
• Stickers: 254 country and region flags, and shapes.
• Add one of 4 built-in sounds, or import audio from the Files app.

EXPORT
• Choose 480p, 720p, 1080p or 4K, 24 to 60 frames per second, and the quality.
• The finished video is saved to your Photos library. You can also share it from the export screen.

PUBLIK ACCOUNT
publik kneecap is part of publik, a catalog of free apps. You sign in once with a free publik account. When you are signed in, the app tells publik when it opens and every 30 minutes while it stays open, so that publik can count app use. It sends no videos, photos, audio or project data. You can turn this off in Settings. You can also delete your publik account in Settings.

FREE
publik kneecap is free. It has no ads and no in-app purchases.

name: publik NoScroll
description:
publik NoScroll opens the social sites that you already use, without the parts that keep you scrolling.

Each site opens inside the app as its normal mobile web page. publik NoScroll then hides the page parts that you turn off. You choose with simple on/off switches, for example the short-video feed, the explore page, stories or suggested posts. The changes happen only on your iPhone, only inside this app.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Open each site from one home screen.
• Turn each block on or off, site by site.
• On supported sites, keep only direct messages, or show the site in grayscale.
• Add widgets to your Home Screen that open a site in publik NoScroll.
• Sign out of each site from Settings. This removes that site's login and data from the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• You sign in to each site on the site's own page. publik NoScroll does not read, store or send your passwords.
• Each site keeps its own data in the app, on this iPhone.
• publik NoScroll does not collect what you look at.
• The block rules are inside the app and are signed. The app checks each rule file before it uses it.

PUBLIK ACCOUNT
publik NoScroll is part of publik, a catalog of free apps. You sign in once with a free publik account. When you are signed in, the app tells publik when it opens and every 30 minutes while it stays open, so that publik can count app use. It sends nothing about what you look at. You can turn this off in Settings. You can also delete your publik account in Settings.

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
publik NoScroll is free. It has no ads of its own and no in-app purchases. The source code is public under the AGPL-3.0 license.

publik NoScroll is not affiliated with any of the sites that it opens.

name: Puleite
description:
Thanks for downloading and trying out our app—we truly value your support and feedback.

Shared adventures are fun until someone asks, "So who owes what?" Puleite keeps a fair, running tally on one phone, so the group can stop digging through receipts and start planning the next outing.

A KITTY FOR EVERY GROUP
Start a kitty for a holiday, a festival, a house share or a weekend away. Name it, add everyone and pick its currency. Kitties can be renamed, archived once everyone is square, reopened later or deleted. Curious first? "Show me a starter example" builds a four-person sample to explore.

SPENDS THAT SPLIT THE WAY YOU DO
Enter the amount, who paid and who took part, then a category and the day. Divide it equally, by shares when one person should cover more, or by exact amounts for uneven bills. Leave someone out of a spend with a single toggle. Every spend becomes a ticket you can reopen to correct or delete.

BALANCES IN PLAIN SIGHT
Trip home shows the kitty total and a balance for each person, with a seesaw that tips toward whoever is owed. Tap a name to see what they paid out, their fair share and "What moved the plank": the spends and payments behind their figure.

THE SHORTEST WAY TO SQUARE UP
Settle works out the fewest payments needed to bring everyone to zero. Tap Mark paid as money changes hands and the plan updates instantly, with a payment history underneath. Tapped too soon? Undo payment puts it back.

SEE WHERE THE MONEY WENT
Switch Spends to Tally for totals per category and per person, then use "Share summary as text" to send the totals and the settle plan to your group chat.

CALM, CLEAR DESIGN
Deep navy text on pale sail-blue cards stays readable outdoors. Four coin stacks take you around: Trip, Spends, Settle and Purse. Gentle coin sounds and haptics can each be switched off, and a default currency is set in Purse.

NO SIGN-UP REQUIRED
Tap "Split without signing in" and every feature is yours as a guest. Prefer an account? Sign up with email and password, and guests can move everything across later with "Save my kitties to an account". Kitties work offline and sync when you are back online.

PRIVATE AND AD-FREE
No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Only your own sign-in can see your kitties, and Purse > Delete account & data removes every kitty, person, spend and payment together with your account.

Puleite only does the arithmetic. It never holds, sends or requests money.

name: Pulse Rest Timer
description:
Pulse is a wrist-first timer for rest between sets, stretches and physio exercises. Pick a timer, tap Start, lower your wrist and keep moving: Pulse taps your wrist at 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 and buzzes when rest is over, so you never have to look.

FEEL THE COUNTDOWN
• Five strong taps in the last five seconds, then a double buzz at zero
• Works with your wrist down, mid-set
• A Time Sensitive alert gets through Focus modes as a backup

SIMPLE BY DESIGN
• Swipe or turn the Digital Crown to pick a timer, then tap Start
• Pause, resume, restart or reset at any time, or tap the ring to pause
• Comes with Stretch, Short rest, Rest and Long rest timers
• Add your own with New Timer; touch and hold a timer to edit, reorder or delete it

AT A GLANCE
• Watch face complications show the live countdown
• Keeps counting on the Always-On display

FOR EVERYONE
• VoiceOver and Larger Text support

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• A standalone Apple Watch app: no iPhone app, no account, no data collected

Also handy in the kitchen, or for anything that needs a quick countdown.

name: PulseLoom: Polyrhythm Practice
description:
Hear three rhythms meet in one shared cycle.

PulseLoom is an offline polyrhythm practice instrument for musicians. Start with 3:4, add a third voice, isolate each part in stereo, then carry your pulse through silent cycles or a changing-tempo session.

SHAPE THE CYCLE
• Two or three voices, each with 1–12 equal divisions.
• Normal, accented or silent pulses at every position.
• Three locally synthesized timbres: Wood, Bell and Click.
• Per-voice level and left/right pan for stereo headphones.
• Clear reference-beat timing: cycle seconds = reference beats × 60 ÷ BPM.
• 30–240 BPM, 1–8 reference beats per cycle, and tap tempo.

PRACTICE IN LAYERS
• Continuous playback with a shared-cycle pulse diagram.
• Mute or solo voices while the pattern keeps playing.
• Repeat a chosen number of sounding and silent cycles.
• A finite tempo ladder: choose the tempo change, stage count and cycles per stage.
• Up to eight stages, within 30–240 BPM, with a five-minute limit.
• Background audio while the screen is locked or another app is open.

KEEP YOUR EXERCISES
• Save up to 100 local rhythm presets.
• Export the full library as JSON for backup or sharing.
• Restore only after validation, a count preview and replacement confirmation.
• A local pre-restore copy protects the file you replaced.

ONE PAID DOWNLOAD
All current features included. No subscription, in-app purchase, account, ads, analytics, tracking or third-party SDK. No microphone permission or developer cloud. English and Simplified Chinese; native iPhone/iPad interface; light/dark appearance, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion.

A FEW PRACTICAL DETAILS
Audio is rendered locally at 44.1 kHz before playback; voices share a scheduled start. Screen animation is an approximate guide. Bluetooth audio may add latency. Start at a low listening level. The playback audio category allows sound even when the Ring/Silent switch is set to silent.

Stop, system pause controls, calls, audio interruptions or disconnected headphones stop the pattern. Starting again restarts from the beginning. There is no resumable pause, performance grading, recording, song import, MIDI output or synchronization between devices. Patterns are edited while stopped. JSON backups are limited to 2 MB; restoring replaces the whole library, without merging.

name: Punto Lector
description:
Punto Lector es una herramienta de campo para técnicos e instaladores de control de acceso. Verifica lectores Bluetooth (BLE) desde el iPhone, mide su señal y prueba credenciales, sin equipo extra.

Qué puedes hacer:
- Detectar lectores compatibles cercanos y ver su señal en tiempo real, con un medidor y estadísticas de promedio, mejor, peor y número de muestras.
- Revisar los anuncios BLE de dispositivos cercanos: servicios anunciados, identificador y origen inferido (por ejemplo, Apple).
- Guardar BLE IDs por usuario, marcarlos como validados o pendientes y llevar el control de cuáles faltan por validar.
- Probar el acceso enviando la credencial del perfil al lector seleccionado y confirmar el resultado.
- Compartir la lista de BLE IDs en texto o CSV para que el administrador la importe, o compartir un diagnóstico de señal.

Privacidad: la información se procesa en tu iPhone. Los perfiles se guardan en el llavero del dispositivo. La app no usa tu ubicación, no crea cuentas, no integra publicidad ni analítica, y no envía datos a servidores propios.

Nota: las pruebas físicas requieren un lector de control de acceso compatible. Los resultados dependen del equipo y de los anuncios BLE que iOS recibe en tu ubicación.

name: Puntoazv
description:
Welcome! We hope this app helps you work more efficiently, and we look forward to your suggestions.

Exams creep up fast. Puntoazv shows how many days each one is away and decides which topics deserve your attention today, so every study session counts.

ALL YOUR PAPERS IN ONE COUNTDOWN
Add an exam with its subject, day, start time and room. The closest paper takes the top of the Countdown screen with a big days-left figure, later exams line up underneath, and papers you have already sat move to their own list.

BREAK SUBJECTS INTO TOPICS
Open an exam and quick-add the topics it covers. The Topics screen groups them by exam with confidence bars, and the All, Shaky and Unrated filters bring the weak spots forward in seconds.

RATE IT, THEN LET IT RETURN
After revising, tap a number from 1 to 5 for how sure you feel, set the minutes, jot a note and Tick it off. Steady ratings move a topic along a 1, 3, 7 and 14 day ladder; a low rating brings it back sooner, and no review is ever set after the exam day.

A PLAN SIZED TO YOUR DAY
Choose your minutes per day in Study Desk. Review today fills with overdue topics, papers that are close and shaky areas until that time is used, and shows how much you have done and how much is still planned. Anything that does not fit waits its turn.

A LOG AND STATS THAT KEEP YOU HONEST
Every session lands in the Log, where it can be edited or deleted. Stats show confidence by subject, hours per week and the topics you have never reviewed.

TURN THE DIAL
Navigation is a half dial at the foot of the screen. Drag it or tap a notch to reach Countdown, Topics, Review and Study Desk. Lavender graph paper, indigo ink, and optional pencil sounds and haptics keep things calm.

TRY IT WITHOUT SIGNING UP
Tap "Revise without an account" to begin as a guest, or create an account with email and password. Guests can keep everything later with "Save my notebook". Want to see it filled in first? "Load starter examples" adds sample exams and topics. Your plan works offline and syncs when you reconnect.

NO ADS, NO TRACKING
Puntoazv has no ads, no analytics and no tracking tools. Your exams, topics and notes are visible only to you, and Study Desk > Delete account removes all of them together with your sign-in.

From school tests to university finals and professional exams, Puntoazv keeps the countdown honest and your revision on schedule.

name: PVC: Pa tus previos
description:
PVC convierte cualquier reunión en una previa de verdad. Siete juegos rápidos para jugar en grupo con un solo celular que pasa de mano en mano. Sin cuentas, sin anuncios y sin internet.

SIETE JUEGOS
• PVC: una frase y una apuesta. ¿Cuántos del grupo lo han hecho?
• ¿Quién es más probable?: todos señalan a la vez y el más votado pierde.
• A cuál le vas?: uno o lo otro. La minoría pierde.
• Seas sapo: todos conocen la palabra secreta menos uno. Descúbranlo.
• Bombasa: di algo de la categoría y pasa el celular antes de que explote la bomba.
• Suelta la sopa: por turnos, te toca una pregunta. Respondes o cumples el castigo.
• Paga pato: nada de votos, aquí mandan los hechos.

HECHO PARA LA FIESTA
• Más de 2,500 preguntas, palabras y categorías.
• Nada se repite hasta que haya salido todo.
• Agrega a tus amigos una vez y la app recuerda la lista.
• La pantalla no se apaga mientras juegan.

MODO PVC
Un nivel aparte con preguntas más atrevidas, solo para mayores de 18. Viene apagado y pide confirmar la edad antes de activarse.

name: Qboostio
description:
Thanks for downloading! We are committed to continuous improvement and would love to hear your honest thoughts.

Lost in a multi-storey again? Qboostio stores exactly where you left the car and how long your ticket lasts, so you walk back to the right bay before the time runs out.

SAVE THE BAY IN SECONDS
Tap "Save a spot" on the way to the lift. Enter the car park, level, row and bay, choose the zone colour and the entrance you used, and add a note such as "near the pay machine". Tick Keep as favourite for places you visit often. Your spot then waits on the Spot lane as a big ticket you can read at arm's length.

A METER THAT WATCHES THE CLOCK
After saving, tap "Start the meter" and pick a preset, adjust in 15-minute steps, or count down to the time printed on your ticket. The numerals turn amber in the last 15 minutes, a buzzer sounds in the app as time runs short, and optional reminders arrive 15 and 5 minutes before expiry. Need longer? Add 15 min, 30 min or 1 h with one tap.

DRIVE OUT, LOG THE COST
When you leave, tap "Drive out", enter what you paid and Log the stay. History groups stays by month with totals, and any past stay can be edited. Switch to Spend for this month's total, six months of bars, your average stay and price, and your regular car park.

FAVOURITE CAR PARKS
Station, office, hospital or shopping centre: keep them as favourites with their usual level, zone and entrance, then tap "Park here" to open a ticket that is already filled in.

NO GPS NEEDED
Qboostio does not use your location, the camera or maps. It keeps working deep underground with no signal and syncs once you are back in range.

DESIGNED FOR DIM CAR PARKS
Deep teal backgrounds, mint text and bright green numerals stay readable under poor lighting. A striped barrier bar takes you between Spot, Meter, History and Booth. Sounds and haptics can each be switched off, and the currency symbol is yours to choose in Booth.

SIGN IN HOWEVER YOU LIKE
Use email and password, Continue with Apple or Continue with Google. Or tap "Park without an account" to start as a guest, then use "Keep my stays" in Booth to move everything to an account later.

PRIVACY FIRST
No ads, no analytics, no tracking and no location access. Your stays are private to your account, and Booth > Delete account removes every stay, favourite and setting together with your sign-in.

name: QesphaniDrovik
description: Hot-dip galvanising calculator: steel surface area, zinc bath, coating thickness, zinc consumption, reactive steel and cost.

name: QR Code Lab
description:
Create QR codes for menus, posters, business cards and everyday links. Save PNG or SVG files in a native workspace on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

START WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Enter a name and a URL to create a device-only QR code. Keep codes in a searchable library, share a PNG, or save a PNG or SVG for print. Device-only creation works offline and does not record scans.

CHANGE A DYNAMIC DESTINATION
Connect your own Google Sheet through Google Apps Script to create dynamic codes. Change a destination while keeping the same printed QR code. Rename or delete codes as your project changes. Dynamic features require an internet connection and a configured Google Sheet.

SEE SCAN ACTIVITY
View the last 30 Melbourne calendar days in a line chart, inspect daily counts and recent scans, and open your Google scan log or activity tab. Scan delivery can be delayed. Older Apps Script deployments show partial history until updated.

USE YOUR EXISTING ACCOUNT
Sign in through the secure system window using a passkey, or use your Site ID with an authenticator or recovery code. Manage passkey devices through the linked account page. Remembered app sessions use Keychain.

BUILT FOR YOUR DEVICES
Use compact tabs on iPhone and a resizable sidebar on iPad and Mac. Your device-only library stays in the app on that device; optional cloud codes belong to your connected account.

Device-only codes contain their destination directly, so changing one requires exporting and printing its new image. Dynamic codes use the QR Code Lab online redirect service. No QR camera scanner is included.

Published by Harvey Steele. Support: Harveysteele@outlook.com.au.

name: Quanbufang Calendar
description:
Make time something you can read and explore.

Quanbufang Calendar is a free, offline companion for studying traditional Chinese calendars, seasonal rhythms, classical texts and cultural timekeeping. It also offers Four Pillars chart tools and a private space for long-term research notes.

CALENDARS AND SOLAR TERMS
• Browse Gregorian and Chinese lunar dates, leap months, the 24 solar terms, festivals and Four Pillars at a chosen date and time.
• Civil Gregorian dates change at local midnight (00:00). Lunar and sexagenary day boundaries follow the beginning of the Zi hour at 23:00.
• Calendar date labels support astronomical years −1999 through 2999, including year 0, with a hybrid calendar transition in 1582. Lunar, solar-term and almanac coverage depends on their respective offline datasets.

NORTHERN AND SOUTHERN HEMISPHERE RULES
• The northern year pillar changes at northern Lichun (Start of Spring). The southern year pillar changes at southern Lichun, the same exact seasonal instant as northern Liqiu (Start of Autumn).
• Birthplace coordinates suggest a hemisphere rule, but you may override it for research. The saved chart label identifies the calculation rule used, not simply the birthplace.
• Four Pillars calculations support valid birth inputs from CE 1800 through 2199, including Gregorian, lunar (with leap months) and reference-time reverse-search modes. Available options include true solar time and solar-term boundary settings.
• Study core and professional chart views, traditional symbolic stars, major luck periods, yearly and monthly cycles, and minor periods.

ALMANAC, CLASSICS AND NOTES
• Daily and monthly traditional almanac pages provide suitable and avoid activities for cultural reference.
• Save, categorize and revisit charts, calculation history, linked research notes and standalone notes.
• Read five classical works offline, with edition and source information.

PRIVATE, LOCAL AND PORTABLE
• Core calculations, saved records and classical reading work without an account or internet connection. Personal chart data and research notes are stored locally on your device.
• Exchange chart archives and research records with the Android edition of Quanbufang Calendar using files you choose. Certain older or specialized records may need confirmation of original birth details before recalculation; retained history follows the supported archive rules.
• Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English interfaces are included; classical source texts remain in their original language.

This app is free. Traditional almanac and chart content is for cultural study and reference, not professional decision-making. Exported backup files are unencrypted; please store them securely. Optional external links and file providers may require internet access.

name: Quick QR by Jodu
description:
Quick QR by Jodu is a simple QR scanner and generator.

SCAN WITH YOUR CAMERA OR PHOTOS
Read QR codes with your camera or choose an image from Photos. Copy results, or open web links in your browser when you choose.

MAKE IT YOURS
Turn text or links into QR codes and add a custom center image. View your code in a clean pop-up, save it to Photos, or share it through the system share sheet.

KEEP YOUR HISTORY
Scan and creation records stay on your device. Copy, revisit or delete records, with confirmation before deletion.

TWO LANGUAGES
Switch between English and Simplified Chinese. Your language preference is remembered.

No account required.

name: QuickSend: One-Tap Messages
description:
Stop retyping “On my way.” Save the messages you send again and again, put them on your Home Screen, and send each one with a single tap.

QuickSend turns your repeat messages into a list on your Home Screen. Tap a row: that message goes to the person or group you chose, and you see right away whether it was sent.

WHAT YOU GET
• A widget with all your quick messages, where every row sends its own message
• A second widget for the one message you send most
• Presets for any chat, contact or Saved Messages
• A clear result on every send: sent, or what went wrong
• Light and dark theme, 11 languages

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add your Telegram API keys once. The built-in guide shows where to get them.
2. Sign in with your phone number.
3. Pick a recipient, write the message, save it.
4. Add the widget: touch and hold the Home Screen, tap +, choose QuickSend.
5. Tap a row. QuickSend opens, sends that message and shows the result on its row in the list.

GOOD TO KNOW
• QuickSend is an unofficial app. It works through the Telegram API and is not affiliated with Telegram.
• You need a Telegram account and your own API ID and API hash from my.telegram.org. Setup takes a few minutes, and the guide in the app walks you through it.
• Your keys and your Telegram session stay on your iPhone. QuickSend has no server and no account of its own.
• A message is sent only when you tap it. Check the text and the recipient when you create a preset.

name: Quran Kitab
description:
Quran Kitab is a calm, beautiful Quran app, made to be read. Choose the Mushaf style you grew up with, read with the translations you choose, find any ayah in seconds, and keep your prayer times and Qibla in the same place. It reads fully offline. There are no ads, no accounts and no tracking.

THE LIGHT OF GUIDANCE
Read the complete Quran, surah by surah, in clear Arabic with ayah numbers, sajdah marks and the traditional divisions.

TWO MUSHAF STYLES
- Indo-Pak style: Para (پارہ) names and numbers, ع at the end of each ruku with a ruku count, and ربع · نصف · ثلاثہ marks at the quarter, half and three-quarter points of each Para. Indo-Pak script in the Al Qalam font, with the ayah-end circles in the text, and Surah Al-Fatiha laid out as in Pakistan's standard Mushaf.
- Madani style: Juz, hizb and quarter-hizb marks (۞), manzil, and the page numbers of the 604-page Madinah Mushaf, in the KFGQPC Hafs font.
- Switch between them at any time. The font follows the style.

30+ TRANSLATIONS, TAFSIR AND TRANSLITERATION
- Urdu (Nastaliq): Jalandhry, Maududi, Ahmed Raza Khan and more.
- English: Saheeh International, Yusuf Ali, Pickthall and more.
- Hindi, Bengali, Sindhi and Pashto translations, Arabic tafsir (Jalalayn, Muyassar) and an English transliteration.
- Show one or several under each ayah, or none. Urdu (Jalandhry) and English (Saheeh International) are built in. Any other translation downloads once, about 1 MB, then works offline and stays on your phone through app updates.

FIND ANYTHING FAST
- Jump to any surah, para or ayah: type a name, a number, or "2:255".
- Search any word in Arabic and in the translations you use, with or without harakat.
- All 30 Paras listed with their traditional names.

PICK UP WHERE YOU STOPPED
- The app remembers your last ayah and opens right there.
- Bookmark any ayah with one tap.
- Copy or share an ayah with its translation.

PRAYER TIMES WITH START AND END
- Start and end time of every prayer for your location, calculated on your device.
- Twelve calculation methods, with Hanafi or standard Asr.
- Optional reminders at the start of a prayer, or shortly before it ends, with a soft chime or text only. Reminders work with the screen locked.

QIBLA COMPASS
- A clear compass that points to the Kaaba, shows the distance to Makkah, and gently confirms when you are facing the Qibla.

MADE WITH CARE
- Light, sepia and dark themes. Adjustable text size. Works on iPhone and iPad.
- The Quran text is shown unaltered. We have taken great care to avoid mistakes; if you find one, you can report it from the flag icon on any ayah or from Settings.
- Your location stays on your phone and is never uploaded.
- No ads. No sign-up. No tracking.

Quran Kitab is an initiative of QuranKitab, founded by Gulfam Mustafa. If this app benefits you, please remember the founder and everyone who helped build it in your prayers.

name: RackMaker
description:
RackMaker works out your conduit bending marks and shows you exactly where each one goes.

RACK CHARTS
Enter a rack once and get the marks for every conduit, staggered so parallel offsets, kicks and 90s keep their spacing through the bend. Mix conduit sizes, space by center to center or by gap, see the total rack width, and check it against the space you have to fit in. The chart warns you when conduits would touch or run into each other in the bend.

EVERY COMMON BEND
90° stubs, offsets, rolling offsets, kicks and kicked 90s, 3-point saddles (10-20-10, 15-30-15, 22½-45-22½ and 30-60-30), 4-point saddles, back-to-back 90s, two 45s around something in a corner, and segmented and concentric bends.

RUN BUILDER
Put several bends on one stick. Get every mark measured from one end, the cut length, and the order to bend them in. Hold and drag a bend to change the order.

DRAWINGS YOU CAN READ
Every bend shows the finished shape with its bends numbered, and the straight conduit with each mark and a bender under it, so you can see which way the hook faces and whether the arrow, notch or star goes on the mark. Zoom in on any drawing.

ANGLE LEVEL
Hold your phone on the bender handle and it reads the angle as you pull. It ticks through the last few degrees, then beeps and buzzes when you are on the angle.

MADE FOR THE JOB SITE
• Big keypad with fraction keys, so there are no decimals to type
• Inches, feet and inches, or centimeters, rounded to 1/8, 1/16 or 1/32
• Handbook multipliers, or centerline radius math for bigger conduit and steeper bends
• EMT and Rigid/IMC from 1/2" to 4", with your own bender's deduct, gain and radius
• Share any bend as text or a PDF, or print it
• Works with no signal. Nothing you enter leaves your phone. No account, no ads, no subscription.

name: Radial Rhythm: Tilt Arcade
description:
Turn your phone like a steering wheel and catch every beat.

Radial Rhythm is a rhythm game you play with motion. Pucks fly toward a four-color ring and land exactly on the beat. Turn your phone until the matching color meets each one—no buttons, no tapping: just you, the music, and the turn.

A run takes a minute or two: five lives, one more go.

Why you'll keep playing
• Feel every catch. Each puck you catch plays a note in the song, and a pulse of haptics lands in your hands.
• The music moves with you. Four sound styles (Neon, Night Drive, Sunrise and Deep), a new key every stage, and a tempo that climbs from 92 to 148 BPM.
• Build a combo, fill Overdrive, and score double points.
• Follow sweeps around the ring and catch pairs that land from opposite sides at once.
• String ten Perfects together to win back a life.
• Every run ends with a grade from D to S. Chase the S.

A new challenge every day
One Daily Challenge, the same for everyone, with its own sound. Set your best and keep your streak alive.

Made for your phone
• Tilt controls use the gyroscope and accelerometer. Hold the phone upright, at an angle, or almost flat.
• A built-in sensor test checks that your phone is ready.
• Stuck on a bus? Touch mode lets you drag the ring instead.
Vibration on settings, reduced motion, audio latency, and turn direction.

Plays offline. No account, no sign-in.
Best with headphones.

name: Radio Libre 93.9
description:
Radio Libre 93.9 es tu emisora en vivo, ahora en tu iPhone.

• Transmisión en vivo las 24 horas
• Reproducción en segundo plano, incluso con la pantalla bloqueada
• Programación y noticias de la emisora
• Envía notas de voz a la cabina
• Comunidad de oyentes

Descarga la app y lleva Radio Libre contigo.

name: Rainbed Carryover
description:
Rain 2 does not wait for the flower bed to empty.

Rainbed Carryover is for campus garden clubs and neighborhood crews who share a chain of rain gardens. Connect the roofs and paths, then see the water the first storm left behind still sitting there when the second storm arrives. The home screen asks one question: how much room is left?

The beds are drawn as a side section, in the order the water actually flows. Lake-blue water rises and falls with the real volume. A dashed line is the brim. Hatch marks and a word mark what spills. Three moments sit on the edge: Rain 1 ends, Rain 2 starts, and Rain 2 ends. Switch them and any bed whose level changed lights up. Tap a bed for its ponding curve. Tap a spill to see which roof it came from.

Water Routes is where you draw the chain. Pick a start and an end, on the board or from a list, and set that link’s share. Shares leaving one place can add up to 100 percent. Rain you do not assign skips the beds. Overflow you do not assign leaves the system. The chain cannot loop. If it does, the bad link is named on the spot.

Storm Replay draws every bed’s stored water through the first rain, the dry gap, and the second rain. Drag the time marker and the room left before Rain 2 moves with it. Tap a spill and the curve stays put while that hour opens: local rain, water from upstream, which catchment, what drained, what was passed on, and what left the system. A stacked chart checks the books. Still stored, drained, overflow, and bypass add up to the runoff from that storm.

Gap & Capacity puts the dry hours on a slider between the two storms. Drag it and the second storm’s spill updates immediately. A deeper downstream bed and a partial split stay on the same clock, so you can see which idea actually holds the water. Ask for the shortest gap that keeps Rain 2’s overflow and bypass under a target. The usual target is 0 L. If nothing in the range is low enough, you get the smallest spill and where it came from.

A worked pair is already saved on the phone. Two beds, 100 L each, start empty. The upper bed does not drain. The lower bed drains at 10 L/h. Rain 1 delivers 180 L to the upper bed. The lower bed then holds 70 L, and 50 L after a 2 hour gap. Rain 2 adds 65 L upstream and 5 L spills from the lower bed. Wait 2 hours 30 minutes instead and the lower bed fills exactly. Nothing spills.

Areas are square meters. Rain is millimeters. Storage is liters. Drains are liters per hour. The runoff coefficient is your estimate, from 0 to 1. Projects, scenarios, and feedback notes stay on the device. There is no account and nothing is uploaded.

name: RallyFair: Doubles Rotation
description:
Run the next doubles roundwithout paper slips or a spreadsheet. RallyFair is an offline courtside board for the organizer of a casual badminton, pickleball or tennis group.

Enter 4–24 players and up to 6 real court labels. Preview the next round, see the resting players, and try another partner arrangement before starting. When every assigned match is finished, complete the round to update attendance.

Fairness is visible. Each player has a played count, rest count, available-round count, distinct partner count and attendance credit. Higher credit gets priority for the next round. Paused players stop accruing credit; late arrivals start at zero. Pairings use a weighted search to reduce repeated partners and opponents.

Add late arrivals, pause players, and adjust court labels for the next round. Preserve completed history, share a text snapshot, and export or restore a full JSON backup using Files.

No account, advertising, analytics or server. English and Simplified Chinese. Native iPhone and iPad interface with system light and dark appearance.

Limits: 24 players, 6 courts, 500 rounds per session, 100 sessions and 10 MB backup. Doubles only; no scores, individual-match completion, skill balancing, fixed pairs or live collaboration. An abandoned partial round contributes no attendance. Pairing is a heuristic, not a guarantee of a full round robin or zero repeats.

name: Rasd - راصد
description:
راصد — النظام الذكي لإدارة وفحص وصيانة طفايات الحريق

تطبيق "راصد" هو الحل المتكامل لشركات وفنيي الأمن والسلامة لإدارة عمليات فحص وتسجيل وتجديد طفايات الحريق ميدانياً بكل سهولة ودقة عبر الهاتف الذكي.

أهم مميزات التطبيق:
• مسح سريع للباركود (QR Code): قراءة رمز الباركود الملصق على الطفاية فوراً لعرض سجلها الكامل وحالتها، أو إدخال رقم الباركود يدوياً.
• تسجيل الطفايات الجديدة: ربط الباركود بطفاية جديدة مع تحديد النوع (بودرة، CO2، رغوة، ماء)، الوزن، اسم المبنى، الطابق، ورقم هاتف المالك.
• توثيق عمليات التجديد والصيانة: تحديث تاريخ التجديد القادم مع إمكانية التقاط صور ميدانية للطفاية قبل وبعد الصيانة لضمان الجودة.
• تحديد الموقع الجغرافي (GPS): حفظ إحداثيات موقع كل طفاية بدقة لسهولة الوصول إليها عبر الخرائط.
• البحث ومتابعة الصلاحية: استعراض الطفايات المنتهية أو التي اقترب موعد صيانتها حسب التاريخ.
• نظام فواتير ضريبية إلكتروني (PDF): إمكانية مسح عدة طفايات لعميل واحد في فاتورة مجمّعة واحدة، مع حساب الضريبة تلقائياً ومشاركة الفاتورة مباشرة كملف PDF جاهز للطباعة.
• دعم اللغتين: واجهة سهلة وسريعة تدعم اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية.

name: RatioDock
description: RatioDock plans image sizes using pixel dimensions. Enter the original size and the target frame, then compare the scaled image, total padding or crop, and a centered diagram. Save plans and rank them by how much of the image stays visible in fill mode. Use the results in your image editor.

name: Razmjena Sličica
description:
Prestani nositi popise duplikata u džepu — Razmjena Sličica sama pronađe s kim se najviše isplati mijenjati.

Označi koje sličice albuma Životinjsko carstvo imaš i koliko duplikata. Aplikacija usporedi tvoj album s albumima ostalih skupljača i poreda ih prema tome koliko razmjena možete napraviti, tako da oboje dobijete što više.

MOJ ALBUM
Svih 250 sličica na jednom zaslonu. Jednim dodirom označi sličicu, a duplikate brojiš bez papira. Filtriraj prikaz na Imam, Fali ili Duplikati i prati koliki dio albuma je gotov.

NAJBOLJE RAZMJENE
Na vrhu je uvijek najbolja podudarnost: koliko sličica dobivaš, koliko daješ i koliko je razmjena uravnotežena. Otvori detalje i vidi točno koje brojeve mijenjate.

PORUKE
Dogovori razmjenu porukom, uz gotov prijedlog s brojevima sličica. Neprimjerene korisnike možeš blokirati i prijaviti jednim dodirom.

BEZ E-MAILA
Odabereš korisničko ime i PIN od 4 znamenke — to je sve. Isti račun koristiš na mobitelu i tabletu, a možeš ga obrisati u bilo kojem trenutku.

Bez oglasa, bez praćenja i bez kupnji. Ispuni album brže — preuzmi Razmjenu Sličica i pronađi svoju prvu razmjenu.

name: rdev
description:
rdev turns a server you own into a complete remote development environment: projects, databases, PHP and Node versions, previews, backups and AI coding agents, with your code staying on your own machine.

The rdev app brings your rdev.cloud panel to your iPhone:

• Get a push notification when an AI agent session finishes, fails or is waiting for your answer.
• See your servers' health at a glance: CPU, memory, disk, load and pending updates.
• Follow your projects, deploys, backups and checkpoints.
• Open rdev.cloud links straight in the app.
• Manage your team and support requests on the go.

You need an rdev account and a server running rdev to use the app. Learn more at https://rdev.cloud.

Privacy: rdev never accesses your code, project files or AI agent conversations.

name: ReedLedger
description:
ReedLedger is a reed management and practice-tracking tool designed for saxophone players. It helps you organize your reeds, document your experiences, and build a comprehensive personal reed archive over time.

From pre-playing preparation to post-practice maintenance, you can keep all your observations and usage details in one place—making it easier to select the right reed for your next session.

Key Features:

• Reed Organization: Manage your reeds by case and slot; track brand, model, strength, and current status.
• Pre-Playing Preparation: Use a preparation timer, custom routines, and checklists to document your setup process.
• Practice Logging: Record practice duration, rate reed response and tone quality, and add personal performance notes.
• Setup Profiles: Save your equipment configurations to easily review how different setups affect your playing experience.
• Trend Analysis: Track changes in your practice data and ratings, and save your own conclusions.
• Photo Archive: Store photos of your reeds, along with observations and maintenance notes.
• Backup & Export: Back up and restore your data, or export reports in PDF and CSV formats.

When you first open an empty ledger, it will be pre-populated with clearly labeled sample data to help you get familiar with all the features.

No account registration is required; all your data is stored locally on your device. You choose where to save or share your backups and exported reports.

All ratings and conclusions are based on your own personal records, allowing you to review and compare your own playing experiences.

name: ReelSafe Offload Remote
description:
ReelSafe Remote is the free iPhone companion for ReelSafe, the card-offload app for Mac. It requires ReelSafe running on your Mac.

LIVE ON SET
Open the app on the same Wi‑Fi as your Mac — or connect the Mac to your iPhone’s hotspot — and ReelSafe Remote finds it automatically. You see the running offload live:
• Overall progress, speed, time left and the current file
• Every drive’s copy and verification progress, in copy order
• Errors the moment they happen
• Which cards are already offloaded, changed, or safe to format
The screen stays on while an offload runs, so you can keep an eye on it from across the set.

NOTIFIED ANYWHERE
When an offload finishes, you get a notification — “every copy verified” or what went wrong — through your own iCloud, even when you’re away from the set network. The History tab keeps the results.

READ-ONLY AND PRIVATE
The phone can watch, never change anything on the Mac. No account and no tracking; results are stored only in your private iCloud.

name: Reflection Of Feelings
description:
The familiar scent of damp earth and the fresh morning breeze off the lake greeted Alex as if he had never left for the big city. This quiet provincial town, where time seemed to stand still, reminded him that past grudges, deep friendships, and true love never truly fade or vanish without a trace. All of it had been waiting for him for years.

He had tried to convince himself that he was finally happy in a glass-and-steel world of offices, endless coffee, and starched collars. Yet, a sudden accident, a forced return to his roots, and a sequence of mystical events forced him to re-evaluate his path in life.

This is a classic visual novel where you'll immerse yourself in the story and make decisions that shape the plot. 

This is a story of love, friendship, and the difficult quest for self-discovery.

A Rich Narrative 

This game will keep you engaged for several captivating evenings, about 4-5 hours of reading. The narrative picks up pace quickly, moving from the mundane urban routine to complex emotional conflicts and tangled romantic storylines. There are no "good" or "bad" endings here; each of the eight finales carries its own moral weight, shaped entirely by the choices you make.

A Variety of Locations 

The story stretches far beyond a handful of cramped rooms. It leads the player through a wide variety of locales: from the cold walls of an office and cozy cafes, to trains, rustic country houses, and enigmatic mystical realms. The game has over 100 unique backgrounds.

Western Visual Style 

The visual style moves away from traditional anime and manga aesthetics, drawing instead on the principles of contemporary Western graphic novels and bespoke illustration. Leveraging AI technology, we have crafted expressive character designs that reveal their complex and ambiguous natures.

name: Reglady Serveur
description:
Reglady Serveur est l'application des équipes de salle des restaurants qui utilisent Reglady, le paiement de l'addition par QR code.

Connectez-vous avec le code de votre restaurant et votre code PIN personnel, fourni par votre responsable.

SUIVEZ VOS TABLES EN DIRECT
Le plan de salle montre d'un coup d'œil les tables libres, en cours, payées en partie ou payées. Le téléphone vibre dès qu'une table est réglée par les clients.

OUVREZ L'ADDITION EN UNE PHOTO
Photographiez le ticket de caisse : les articles et le total sont lus automatiquement. Vous relisez, corrigez si besoin, puis validez. Vous pouvez aussi saisir l'addition à la main.

LE CLIENT RÈGLE DEPUIS SA TABLE
Montrez le QR code de la table : le client paie l'addition depuis son téléphone, en entier ou en la partageant avec les autres convives.

ESPÈCES ET TERMINAL AUSSI
Un client paie en espèces ou au terminal de carte ? Enregistrez-le en un geste, puis libérez la table pour les clients suivants.

L'application est réservée aux restaurants qui utilisent Reglady. Vous êtes restaurateur ? Découvrez Reglady sur reglady.com.

name: Remindful: Routine & Notes
description:
Remindful is designed to bring peace, mindfulness, and clarity to your everyday life. Combining cyclical reminders, quick voice notes, habit tracking, and a visual agenda in a warm, minimalist interface, Remindful helps you stay effortlessly organized without the digital noise.

KEY FEATURES:

• SMART CYCLICAL & RECURRING REMINDERS
Set up personalized recurring intervals for hydration, medicine, posture breaks, work sprints, and routine habits. Choose active waking hours so you're never disturbed at night.

• INSTANT VOICE NOTES & CHECKLISTS
Capture ideas and thoughts on the fly. Record crystal-clear voice notes with a single tap, organize your to-do lists, and play back recordings anytime.

• VISUAL AGENDA & DAILY FLOW
See your day's schedule at a glance. Switch seamlessly between weekly and monthly calendar views, track your busyness balance, and schedule priority tasks.

• MINDFUL WELLNESS & HYDRATION
Track your daily water intake with visual progress bars and quick one-tap logging. Never forget your essential vitamins, supplements, or evening pills.

• SERENE SOUNDS & TACTILE HAPTICS
Gentle chimes (Bird Chirp, Warm Gong, Gentle Bell) and subtle haptic feedback make every notification feel calm and non-intrusive. Critical alert support ensures vital medications are never missed.

• PRIVACY-FIRST & REAL-TIME CLOUD SYNC
Sign in securely with Apple or Google, or use the app completely offline as a guest. All your data is encrypted and synced in real-time across your devices via Cloud Firestore. No ads, no tracking.

Bring tranquility to your routine today with Remindful.

name: Remolom
description:
Remolom es la red social de los planes que pasan cerca de ti. Conciertos, teatro, cine, museos y exposiciones, partidos y carreras, mercados gastronómicos, ferias, monólogos y fiestas: todo en un mismo sitio y ordenado por distancia.

DESCUBRE QUÉ HAY CERCA
• Explora los eventos de tu zona en lista o en el mapa.
• Filtra por categoría (música, cultura, deporte, gastronomía, humor, ocio…) y por fecha: hoy, este fin de semana o este mes.
• Busca por nombre, lugar u organizador.

VIVE EL PLAN CON TU GENTE
• Un feed con lo que se publica en los eventos de tu zona y de la gente que sigues.
• Historias con fotos y vídeos de los planes.
• Comenta y sigue a personas, lugares y organizadores.
• Guarda los eventos que te interesan para no perderte ninguno.

ENTRADAS EN EL MÓVIL
• Consigue tus entradas y llévalas en la app con su código QR.
• El QR se renueva solo para evitar copias y puedes transferir una entrada a otra persona.

LUGARES Y ORGANIZADORES
• Cada sala, teatro, museo o estadio tiene su ficha con sus próximos eventos.
• Las empresas y organizadores tienen su perfil con todo lo que programan.

PARA ORGANIZADORES
• Publica tus eventos con precios, aforo y zonas.
• Controla el acceso con la taquilla: escanea el QR de las entradas en la puerta, incluso sin conexión.
• Consulta ventas y asistencia desde el panel.

AVISOS
• Recibe notificaciones cuando alguien te sigue o te etiqueta, y recordatorios antes de tus eventos.

Remolom es gratis. Para usarla necesitas tener al menos 14 años.

Privacidad: https://remolom.com/privacidad
Términos: https://remolom.com/terminos

name: Repsio: Workout Tracker
description:
Repsio is a workout log for lifting. Log sets, loads and reps; the app works out your next session with the progression rule you pick.

AUTOMATIC PROGRESSION
• Linear, double (reps first, then load), reps only or none.
• Stall, and the load drops by the percentage you set.
• Deloads on demand, every N sessions or every N weeks.
• After each workout you see what changes next time.

AT THE GYM
• Every set shows last time's load and reps.
• Automatic rest timer, ±15 s on the fly, vibration and an alert when rest is up, also on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Automatic warm-up for barbell lifts: empty bar, then 40, 60 and 80% of the working load.
• Plate calculator with your bar and the plates you actually own.

READY-MADE PROGRAMS
Seven programs from beginner to advanced: Full Body 3 Days, Linear Strength 5×5, Upper/Lower 4 Days, Push/Pull/Legs 3 and 6 Days, Strength + Hypertrophy 4 Days, Bodyweight 3 Days. Or build your own routine, exercise by exercise.

840+ EXERCISE LIBRARY
Steps, technique cues, common mistakes and a muscle map. 229 exercises have an animated demo drawn for Repsio.

NUMBERS THAT MATTER
Personal records, estimated 1RM, weekly volume, muscles trained over 7 or 30 days, week streak. Body weight and 14 circumferences with charts.

APPLE WATCH
Follows the workout started on iPhone: exercise, set, rest timer and heart rate. Mark a set done from your wrist.

AND ALSO
• Apple Health is optional: finished workouts go to Health.
• Widgets on the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• Works offline, no account needed.
• Export all your workouts to CSV any time.
• English and Italian, kg or lb, light or dark theme.

Your data stays on your phone: Repsio collects no data.

name: Resalla
description:
رسالة منصة رقمية تربط الشركات بعملائها عبر الإنترنت. تتيح للشركة قناة تواصل مباشرة ومنظمة مع العملاء الذين يتابعونها، فتستطيع الرد على استفساراتهم عبر فريق موظفيها، وإرسال العروض والرسائل العامة إليهم. ويستطيع العميل متابعة الشركات التي تهمه ومراسلتها واستقبال عروضها في مكان واحد.

كل محادثة على المنصة تكون بين عميل واحد وشركة واحدة. ولا تتيح المنصة للعملاء مراسلة بعضهم، ولا إنشاء مجموعات، ولا نشر محتوى عام كما في وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي.

name: RETRO — Games & Metal
description:
RETRO is a monthly magazine about today's games, metal records, hardware and AI, written in the voice of 1990s Turkish computer magazines.

In every issue:
• Game reviews with scores, and the news
• Metal records and shows
• Pieces on hardware and AI
• The editorial and the editor's corner

In the app:
• The issues as covers, and each issue's contents by section
• Every piece in reading order: swipe to the next one
• Switch between Turkish and English with one tap
• Text size, night and day themes
• An issue you have opened reads offline too; download a whole issue with its pictures if you like
• The PDF and EPUB editions of each issue

No account, no ads, no tracking: the app collects no data about you.

Everything outside the editorial and the editor's corner is written by AI under the magazine's house bylines, and the editor reads and approves every piece. No image is generated: pictures come from press kits, our own captures or free-licensed sources, each with its credit in the piece.

name: Retro Rig 48: Skyline League
description:
Under the rusted cranes of Port Meridian, an underground league races on tracks bolted into the sky. You drive Rig No. 48. Fall off and the crane puts you back, but it costs time and cracks your chassis. Crack it all the way across and you're out.

Retro Rig 48 is an arcade stunt racer about bounce, jumps and nerve. Ease off before the crests, line up before every ramp and hit the boost at the right moment.

CAREER
- 4 cups and 12 tracks, each with a named rival and prize money
- A story told between races, with a full announcer
- Garage upgrades: engine, suspension, tyres and boost tank, plus paint jobs

TRACKS BUILT FOR AIR
- Huge jumps, sky gaps, drawbridges, floating slabs and coaster dips
- Day, dusk and night skylines, from the docks to the rooftops and the Moon

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Six camera views: cockpit, chase, far chase, bumper, TV trackside and helicopter
- Easy, Normal and Hard, plus an adjustable driving assist
- Drag or button steering, and a left-handed layout
- Taptic feedback on landings, crashes and boosts
- Low graphics option for older iPhones

KEEP COMING BACK
- A daily challenge with a new twist every day
- Style points for air time, perfect landings and near misses
- The Lucky 48 bonus: finish with 48 in your lap time or 48% boost left
- Game Center leaderboards for every track

FAIR AND SIMPLE
One price unlocks everything. No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no tracking. Everything is on your iPhone, so it plays fully offline.

Original rock soundtrack.

name: ReturnBell: Return Window
description:
Bought something you might take back? ReturnBell tells you exactly how many days you have left — based on the store's ACTUAL return policy, not a guess.

Most return apps make you type in the deadline yourself. ReturnBell is different: we maintain a policy database verified from 37 major US retailers' official pages — Walmart, Target, Best Buy, Costco, Apple Store, Amazon and more. Scan your receipt and get the real window for what you actually bought, including the rules that catch people out: phones at Walmart (14 days, not 90), electronics at Sam's Club (90 days), activatable devices at Best Buy ($45 restocking fee).

WHAT YOU GET
• Scan a paper receipt — OCR reads the store, date and total, then applies the store's verified policy
• Or choose a photo from your library — great for online order screenshots
• A deadline you can trust, with a "Why this date?" section showing the policy behind it
• Not right? Correct it in one tap — you can always change it back
• Reminders at 9:00 AM before your window closes, including a same-day alert if you add an item on its last day
• Home Screen widget showing your most urgent return at a glance
• Color-coded urgency: red (last day), orange (this week), blue (relax)

HOLIDAY PROOF
Buying gifts in November? We track holiday extended-return windows for major retailers, so a December purchase doesn't sneak up on you in January.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No sign-up. No tracking.
• Your receipts and items never leave your phone
• On-device text recognition — receipts aren't uploaded anywhere
• Delete everything anytime

WHY TRUST THE DATES?
Every policy in our database was verified against the retailer's official return policy page, with the verification date recorded. Conservative by default: when a store's rules are ambiguous, we show you the safer deadline. And if we ever get one wrong, the "Not right?" button lets you fix it and helps us improve.

Returns are money you already spent. ReturnBell makes sure you get it back.

Note: ReturnBell is a reminder tool, not legal advice. Always confirm with the store's official policy — your deadline card links straight to it.

name: Reverie: Picture Stories
description:
Every picture. Another story.

Take a seat with Mira, Theo and Nora in a game of images, clues and conversation. Choose a secret picture, give a clue with room for interpretation, and discover what the others see.

SPEAK YOUR MIND
Talk about the cards, ask the characters questions, challenge their interpretations and try to persuade them. A voiced narrator guides the table and decides when it is time to vote. Clear spoken commands and touch controls handle your choices; text play is available too.

SIXTY ORIGINAL ILLUSTRATIONS
Explore a surreal deck filled with unexpected connections. Eight rounds give everyone a turn as storyteller. A good clue reaches some of the table, without making the answer obvious to everyone.

FIVE LANGUAGES
Play in English, Italian, French, German or Spanish. The interface, narrator, characters and voice commands follow your choice.

MADE FOR YOUR IPHONE
Cards and controls fit on one screen. Switch spoken captions on or off to give the artwork more room, and open table status whenever you want to see scores. Tap a card for a closer look. Speech recognition and generated voices run on your iPhone; each language downloads its voice model the first time you use it.

Reverie is a solo game with AI characters, not multiplayer chat. An internet connection and permission to process gameplay text and relevant card images through third-party AI are required. Microphone recordings stay on your device. AI replies may be inaccurate or inappropriate. You can decline processing and still explore the deck and rules.

Free with daily usage and service capacity limits. No ads or purchases. Limits reset at midnight UTC; reaching a limit can pause a game. Closing the app ends the current game. Requires iOS 26.2 or later.

name: Reverse AU: Phone Lookup
description:
Got a call from a number you don't recognise? Reverse AU shows what other Australians have said about it, so you can decide whether to answer, call back or ignore it.

CALLER ID LABELS, EVEN OFFLINE
Turn on Reverse AU once in Settings, and calls from numbers reported as scam or spam show a label such as "Likely scam · 42 reports" while your phone rings. The list is stored on your iPhone and refreshed in the background, so labels work without internet. Incoming calls are matched on your device: the app never sees who calls you, your contacts or your call history.

LOOK UP ANY AUSTRALIAN NUMBER
Mobiles, landlines, 13, 1300 and 1800 numbers. Type or paste a number to see:
• the community verdict and how many people reported it
• the breakdown of reports: scam, spam, suspicious, uncertain or legitimate
• the number type and the area or carrier it was allocated to
• what people say happened on the call

STAY AHEAD OF SCAMS
• Trending: the latest reports from the community and the numbers people are looking up right now
• Learn: short guides to the scams doing the rounds in Australia and how to spot them

WARN OTHERS
Had a scam call or text? Report the number in a few taps, with no account and no name required. Every report is checked before it is published, and any review can be flagged if it breaks the community rules.

OPTIONAL BLOCKING
Choose to block numbers rated scam by several people. Blocking is off until you turn it on, and you pick how many reports it takes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Recent lookups are stored on your iPhone only
• Free, with no in-app purchases

Reports are people's own accounts of calls and are not verified by Reverse AU. Caller ID can be faked, so a label is a warning, not proof. If a number is yours and you think a report is wrong, contact us through the app or www.reverseau.com.

name: Reverse Dial
description:
Reverse Dial turns two indicator sweeps into offset, angularity, foot moves, and shim stacks.

Open a machine and read the latest pass beside as found. Vertical and horizontal plates show the offset and the angularity. The next line says how far to move the front and back feet.

Moves draws the shaft and names a foot that is bolt-bound or base-bound. Two ways to clear it sit side by side. Shims lists what to pull and what to add at each foot. Tolerance plots each pass against the band for this speed.

Soft foot marks a rocking foot. The sweep uses motion only to confirm 12, 3, 6, and 9. Records stay on this iPhone until you share a machine name.

There is no account and nothing to buy. The result is a calculation for the readings you entered. It does not replace the machine builder's alignment standard. The dial cards are vintage.

name: Rik Draw Path
description: Rik Draw Path is a puzzle seen from above. Men and women keep arriving at a restroom building, each with a patience bar that never stops filling. You drag a path from a visitor, square by square, to the right door. The wrong door, a passage too narrow for a heavy visitor or a square somebody stands on stops them where they are. When the bar is full there is an accident, and three accidents end the level.

name: Ripen: Tasks & Reminders
description:
Most to-do apps treat a task as a calendar entry and buzz at a clock time. Ripen is built around the moment a task actually becomes doable, and lets each reminder decide how hard it should nudge you.

RIGHT NOW
Open Ripen and the one task that matters at this moment is at the top, with Done and Snooze beside it. The rest of today is grouped into morning, afternoon and evening, so you see a day and not a wall of items.

JUST TYPE IT
Write "Call the plumber tomorrow at 9am every month #home !high" and Ripen picks out the date, time, repeat, tag and priority as you type. It shows what it understood, and you can change anything before adding.

REMINDERS THAT FIT THE TASK
• Gentle: one notification, then it waits quietly in Today.
• Persistent: nudges again every 10 minutes until you finish or snooze it.
• Urgent: a Time Sensitive notification that breaks through Focus.
Finish or snooze straight from the notification, without opening the app.

A TIME, OR JUST A PART OF THE DAY
Not everything needs a clock time. Give a task a morning, an afternoon or an evening and Ripen brings it up then.

REPEATS THAT MAKE SENSE
Every day, every weekday, chosen days of the week, every month, every year, or every few of any of them. Repeat from the due date or from the day you actually finished.

ORGANISED WITHOUT EFFORT
Lists with colours, tags, steps inside a task, priorities, an Upcoming view of the next seven days, an Overdue view, search across everything, and a Logbook of what you have done.

EASY TO UNDO
Completing or deleting a task can be undone for a few seconds, so a slip of the thumb costs nothing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No tracking. Your tasks stay on your iPhone, and reminders work with no connection.

name: Riqzorabid
description:
Welcome! We’ve put great care into building this product and look forward to your valuable suggestions.

Healthy fish start with stable water. Riqzorabid turns the numbers from your test kit into a clear answer: which values are fine, which need attention, and when the next water change is due.

KNOW YOUR WATER AT A GLANCE
The Tank screen fills a water gauge as more readings land inside your targets, tells you how many parameters are in range, and pulls anything off target into its own chip so you see it first. Every parameter also shows its latest value on a slim range bar.

RECORD READINGS THE EASY WAY
Open "Log a test", type or nudge each value, and watch the dot beside it confirm whether it fits your target. Cover pH, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, GH, KH, temperature and salinity, back-date a test you took earlier, add a note and save. Made a typo? Open the test again to correct it or remove it.

TARGETS THAT FIT EACH TANK
Freshwater and marine setups begin with sensible bands. Fine-tune any band under Ranges, hide the parameters you never measure, or reset to the defaults whenever you like. Work in °C or °F, litres or US gallons.

SPOT TRENDS BEFORE THEY BECOME PROBLEMS
Tap a parameter to plot it over 30 days, 90 days or all time against its shaded target band, with the latest reading, the average, the direction it is heading and the share of readings in range.

WATER CHANGES ON SCHEDULE
Log a change by dragging the bucket's water line or tapping a quick percentage. Each tank keeps its own rhythm, so Riqzorabid counts down to the next change, sums up the last 30 days and, if you switch on "Change-day nudge", reminds you on the morning it is due.

CHORES WITHOUT THE STICKY NOTES
Filter rinses, glass cleaning, plant trims, heater checks. Give each chore an interval and tick it off when done; the list sorts itself into overdue, due this week and later.

A CALM, WATERY FEEL
Four bubbles on the right edge take you between Tank, Tests, Changes and the Pump room. Gentle sounds and haptics can each be turned off.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Use email and password or Sign in with Apple, or choose "Dip in as guest" to start without an account. Guests can attach an email or Apple ID later from Pump room > "Keep my tanks safe" without losing anything. Logs work offline and sync once you reconnect.

YOUR DATA, NOBODY ELSE'S
No ads, no tracking and no analytics. Only your account can see your logs, and Pump room > "Delete account" erases every tank, test, water change and chore together with the account itself.

name: Rock ID: Identifier & Test Kit
description:
Test a rock the way geologists do. Rock ID is a pocket field kit for rockhounds and rock collectors: it walks you through the scratch, streak, vinegar and magnet tests with things you already carry, ranks the minerals that fit your answers, and keeps a notebook of your finds.

FOUR FIELD TESTS
• Scratch test: fingernail, copper coin, pocket knife, steel file, quartz point or masonry bit, each placed on the Mohs hardness scale.
• Streak test: the colour of the powder a stone leaves on unglazed tile.
• Acid test: does it fizz in vinegar?
• Magnet test: does a magnet pull on it?
Answer one test or all four: every answer re-ranks the likely minerals, with honest percentages.

REAL OR FAKE
Side-by-side guides for the classic look-alikes and the quick tests that tell them apart: real gold vs. pyrite (fool’s gold), meteorite vs. industrial slag, rough diamond vs. quartz and moissanite, jade vs. serpentine and dyed quartz.

UV LIGHT
See which stones glow under a 365 nm UV torch at night, with daylight and UV photos of the same stones: yooperlite, willemite and calcite, hyalite opal, fluorite and ruby.

MAGNET FINDER
Uses your iPhone's magnetometer to show the magnetic field next to a stone, so iron-rich minerals such as magnetite and lodestone stand out.

CAMERA MATCH
Take a photo and Rock ID compares its colour and texture with the minerals in the app, shows the closest matches with honest percentages, and points you to the test that settles it. It is a starting point, not a lab result. No rock at hand? Try one of the sample photos.

FIELD NOTEBOOK
Save finds with a photo, locality and notes, each with a museum-style specimen label you can share as text.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything works offline and stays on your iPhone.

Specimen photos by Wikimedia Commons contributors, credited in the app.

name: Rockfish Runner
description:
Rockfish Runner puts you at the helm of a center console on the Chesapeake Bay, trolling for striped bass the way the charter captains do.

RIG YOUR SPREAD 
Open the tackle box and pick a ready-made spread (Chesapeake classic, Deep channel edge, Shallow flats, Bluefish run), or rig each rod yourself: umbrella rigs, tandems, bucktails, spoons and diving plugs, with sinker weight, diver setting, line out and lure color. See how deep each lure will run before you put it out.

FIND THE FISH 
Watch the fish finder for bait clouds and rockfish arches. Follow the chartplotter to the shipping channel edges, where the bottom drops from 30 to 60 feet. Tide, time of day, speed and lure depth all decide the bite.

FIGHT THEM TO THE BOAT
Hear the drag scream, grab the rod, and reel against a tension dial. Back off when it runs, keep the line tight, and bring it alongside.

PLAY BY THE REAL 
REGS Every rockfish goes on the measuring board against the Virginia slot. Keep the legal ones in the livewell and release the rest.

A DAY ON THE WATER 
First light to dark in about an hour, with crab pots, jet skis, other boats and a ship in the channel. Head in for a trip summary; your catch log keeps every fish: size, weight, lure, time and where you caught it.

NEW TO TROLLING? 
Take a trip with Captain Loy, a charter captain who shows you the ropes from rigging to the livewell.

No ads. No account. Your catch log stays on your phone. Fishing regulations shown as of 2026. Always check VMRC before you fish.

name: Roll Recap: Year in Photos
description:
Your year in photos, in numbers and stories, then gigabytes set free in a few swipes. Everything stays on your iPhone.

YOUR YEAR IN 10 CARDS
• How many photos and videos you took
• Your record month and most photographed day
• Your selfies, pets, countries and cities
• Your favorite time of day to shoot
• Your photo personality: Golden Hour Hunter, Pet Paparazzo, Globetrotter…
• Your Top 9 of the year, picked automatically and editable in one tap
• Any year you like: 2026, 2025 or further back

MADE TO BE SHARED
• Every card exports as a vertical story, ready for your socials and chats
• Turn your whole recap into a video with counting numbers
• Hide personal photos before you share

FREE UP SPACE IN A FEW SWIPES
• Duplicates, similar shots, blurry photos, screenshots and heavy videos, sorted by space saved
• Swipe left to delete, right to keep, undo anytime
• For duplicates, the best shot is suggested for you
• A counter tracks the gigabytes you've freed
• Nothing is deleted without your iPhone's confirmation, and everything stays 30 days in Recently Deleted

ALSO INCLUDED
• Stats: photos per month, a 365-day calendar, a map of your places
• "One year ago" widget: a memory from this day last year
• Analysis keeps going in the background when you leave the app
• An optional reminder on December 1 when your recap is ready

100% ON YOUR IPHONE
No account, no server, no ads, no tracking. Your photos are analyzed by your iPhone's built-in intelligence and are never uploaded.

FREE TO START
The first 3 cards and your reclaimable-space estimate are free. Roll Recap Premium unlocks the full recap, video export, watermark removal, stats and cleanup. Weekly or yearly subscription with a 3-day free trial.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://schmittutility.fr/confidentialite/
Support: https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/

name: Rolling ability
description:
Step into a cozy workshop and prove you know your hardware. Drag the right bolts, washers, and nuts into the vise, match diameter, pitch, and thread direction, then spin to torque and lock each install.

How to play

Pick the correct parts from a mixed tray
Follow the build order: bolt → washer → nut
Rotate to seat the threads, then tap LOCK
Clear jobs across Vise, Assembly, and Work Order modes
Features

100 levels with rising difficulty and clever distractors
Multiple play modes that keep every session fresh
Part collection and achievements to track your progress
Smooth haptics and workshop-themed visuals
Clean, focused English UI — no clutter, just craft
Whether you’re a casual puzzle fan or a hardware nerd at heart, Nut & Bolt Master turns everyday fasteners into a satisfying skill challenge.

Match. Twist. Master the bench.

name: RotorBalancePro
