description: RotorBalancePro on työpajasovellus roottorin tasapainotukseen. Sovellus laskee sallitun epätasapainon, keskipakoisvoiman, tarvittavan korjausmassan ja jäännösepätasapainon. Syötä massa, pyörimisnopeus ja mittaus, niin saat korjausohjeen. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta, ja kaikki toimii offline-tilassa.

name: RouteFlex Ops
description:
RouteFlex Ops is the phone app for the managers and shop mechanics of delivery contractor companies that run on RouteFlex. It opens the screens you reach for between the desk and the yard.

Managers get:
- Today: what needs attention right now.
- Board: the daily board, routes and who is on them.
- Schedule: the week's schedule at a glance.
- People: look up an employee and their details.
- Approvals: approve a finished repair job, or send it back with a note.

Shop mechanics get:
- My jobs: your open jobs, the clock and the checklist.
- Tickets: open repairs by truck.
- Trucks: VIN, plate, mileage and registration for every vehicle.
- Shift clock: clock in and out with your FedEx ID and PIN, the same as the driver portal.
- Photos: take a photo or pick one from your library and attach it to a repair job.

Everything else you can do on the RouteFlex website is one tap away under More, and what you can see always follows the permissions your company gave you.

Sign in with your RouteFlex email account. RouteFlex Ops is for employees of companies that use RouteFlex; your company sets up your access. Drivers use the separate RouteFlex Driver app.

name: RuckUp
description:
RuckUp — приложение для бильярдистов и бильярдных клубов. Записывайтесь на турниры, играйте дуэли с друзьями, следите за своей статистикой и поднимайтесь в рейтинге.

ТУРНИРЫ
• Турниры бильярдных клубов в одном списке
• Заявка на участие в одно касание — ответ клуба приходит уведомлением
• Турнирная сетка в реальном времени: каждый результат виден сразу
• Итоги завершённых турниров: победитель, второе и третье места

ДУЭЛИ С ДРУЗЬЯМИ
• Свободная игра или матч до 2, 3 или 7 побед
• Счёт подтверждают оба игрока — без споров
• PTS-дуэли в клубе влияют на ваш рейтинг
• История личных встреч с каждым другом

РЕЙТИНГ И ПРОГРЕСС
• Общий рейтинг игроков и рейтинг каждого клуба
• Уровень, XP и PTS за дуэли и турниры
• Статистика: победы, поражения, процент побед

ОБЩЕНИЕ
• Друзья и чаты с игроками и клубами
• Ответы на сообщения, реакции, редактирование
• Отключение уведомлений чата, блокировка и жалоба на нарушителя
• Уведомления о турнирах, дуэлях и сообщениях

ДЛЯ КЛУБОВ
• Создавайте турниры: формат, число участников, взнос и призы
• Принимайте или отклоняйте заявки — когда места заканчиваются, приём закрывается сам
• Ведите сетку с телефона — победители и места считаются автоматически
• Подтверждайте PTS-игры в клубе и ведите рейтинг клуба
• Профиль клуба с фото, адресом и контактами

А ТАКЖЕ
• Правила бильярдных игр и новости
• Техническая поддержка прямо в приложении — можно приложить скриншот
• Вход через Google или по коду на e-mail
• Языки: узбекский, русский, английский

RuckUp не принимает платежи: взнос и призы турнира клуб решает с игроками напрямую.

name: RUFREE
description:
RUFREE 是给大学生用的共享课表 App。导入你的课表，和同学互相看到谁在上课、谁有空，不再为了约一次自习来回问时间。

【共享课表，一眼看到谁有空】
· 导入课表后，「今天」页会告诉你现在上到哪、还有多久下课、下课后空多久
· 「大家的今天」显示好友正在上课、有空还是状态未知
· 你可以决定课表对好友和群组共享到什么程度，自己添加的日程可以单独设为「私密」或「忙碌」

【约时间，不再来回问】
· 选几个同学，找出共同空闲的时段
· 发起邀请，好友一键回应「去」或「不去」

【聊天和群组】
· 好友私聊、课程群聊、自建小组，支持图片、表情、回复和表情回应
· 内置举报和拉黑，不想看到的人可以随时屏蔽

【课程和学期工具】
· 考试与截止日期日历
· 课程资料：上传课程大纲，整理出关键日期和要求
· 助手：用自然语言问课表、课程和空闲时间
· 学期回顾：回看这个学期的上课轨迹
· 课表版本：导入和切换不同版本的课表

【随时在手边】
· 桌面小组件、实时活动和 Apple Watch 显示下一节课
· iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 通用

【隐私】
· 可以在 App 内随时删除账号和全部数据
· 助手、课程资料解析等 AI 功能会在第一次使用前征得你的同意，并说明数据发送给谁

RUFREE 是独立开发的学生工具，与任何学校没有官方关系。

name: Rumora
description:
Rumora is a chat app for the people around you. It finds everyone on the same Wi-Fi or local network and connects you directly — phone to phone, with no server in the middle.

NO INTERNET REQUIRED
Rumora works entirely on your local network. Perfect for offices, classrooms, events, homes, or anywhere the internet is slow, expensive, or simply not there.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts, no phone number, no sign-up
• No cloud storage — your messages live only on your devices
• Nothing passes through a server we control, because there isn't one

EVERYTHING YOU NEED
• One-to-one chats and group chats
• Share files and send voice notes
• Replies, reactions, @mentions and read receipts
• Star important messages and search across all chats
• Lock individual chats with a PIN
• Back up and restore your chats

LOOKS GREAT, YOUR WAY
A clean, modern design with light and dark themes — or let Rumora follow your phone's setting.

HOW IT WORKS
Open Rumora on two or more devices connected to the same Wi-Fi network. They'll find each other automatically — just pick a name and start talking.

name: RustGIS
description:
RustGIS is a free and open-source GIS for mapping and collecting geospatial data in the field. It opens the same projects as RustGIS on the desktop, so a map prepared on your computer goes to your iPhone or iPad, gets edited outdoors, and comes back.

CAPTURE IN THE FIELD
• Add points, lines and polygons at the cross in the middle of the map, or at your position
• Average your position over several readings for a more precise point
• Forms built from your data's design: value lists, ranges, required fields, defaults and templates
• Take photos with the camera and attach them to features
• Snap to vertices and edges, move and delete vertices, undo any change

YOUR POSITION AND TRACKS
• See where you are with a ring showing the position's accuracy
• Record a track as you walk or drive, even with the screen off, and keep it as a line

WORK OFFLINE
• Field packages carry a map, its data and its MBTiles or PMTiles basemaps from the desktop to your device
• Bring your edits and photos back into the project on your computer, with changes made on both sides reconciled feature by feature

OPEN YOUR DATA
• GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML and KMZ, GPX, CSV, GeoParquet, FlatGeobuf, GeoTIFF and more, from Files, iCloud Drive or other apps
• Web basemaps and tile layers, and PostGIS, MySQL and SQL Server databases
• The full desktop interface, with its ribbon and tools, is one tap away

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
RustGIS collects no analytics, telemetry or usage data. Your files and projects stay on your device. Your location is used on the device only and is never sent anywhere by RustGIS. Online features, such as web basemaps, request only what you ask for.

RustGIS is open source under the Apache 2.0 license: https://github.com/opengeos/RustGIS

name: RuxmeloVantir
description: Pressure die casting calculator: ratio, part mass, projected area, clamping force, fill time, runner system, vacuum and part price.

name: SAN ANDRES formación vial
description:
La app oficial de los alumnos de SAN ANDRES formación vial.

Con ella llevas tu carnet de conducir en el bolsillo:

• Reserva tus clases prácticas en los huecos libres de tu formador.
• Consulta tus próximas clases y el historial de las que ya has dado.
• Compra bonos de clases y revisa tu saldo y tus pagos.
• Sigue tu expediente: permisos, simulacros y fechas de examen.
• Recibe avisos al momento: clase confirmada, hueco libre, cambios de horario y examen.
• Pregunta tus dudas a Andrea, la asistente virtual de la autoescuela.
• Sube tu foto y tu DNI con la cámara, sin pasar por la oficina.

Para entrar tienes que ser alumno de SAN ANDRES formación vial. Tu usuario es tu DNI; si es tu primera vez, entra solo con tu DNI y te enviamos la clave.

name: SAN ANDRES formadores
description:
La app de trabajo de los formadores de SAN ANDRES formación vial.

• Agenda del día, la semana y el mes con tus clases prácticas.
• Huecos libres: apunta clases y bloquea tiempo para otros trabajos.
• Tu horario semanal, editable desde el móvil.
• Fichaje de jornada.
• Firma de clases por el alumno en la propia pantalla.
• Tus vehículos: ITV, repostajes con foto del ticket y documentación.
• Avisos al momento: nuevas reservas, cambios, exámenes e ITV.
• Andrea, la asistente virtual, te ayuda y te recuerda lo pendiente.

Uso exclusivo para el personal de SAN ANDRES formación vial. El acceso lo da la autoescuela.

name: Santo Dia: Bíblia e Liturgia
description:
Santo Dia é um app católico gratuito, sem anúncios e sem cadastro, para acompanhar a sua vida de oração todos os dias.

• LITURGIA DIÁRIA — leituras, salmo e evangelho do dia, com a cor litúrgica. Leia em português e veja o mesmo texto em latim e em grego, ou na tradução literal do grego.
• BÍBLIA — 73 livros em português, latim (Vulgata), inglês e francês, mais o Novo Testamento em grego. Busca por palavra e letra ajustável.
• GREGO LITERAL — todo o Novo Testamento traduzido palavra por palavra a partir do grego original, para estudar o texto de perto.
• COMENTÁRIOS DOS PADRES DA IGREJA — trechos de São João Crisóstomo, Santo Agostinho, São Vitorino, Clemente de Alexandria e São Jerônimo, ao lado do texto, com a obra e o link da edição em domínio público.
• SANTO DO DIA — o santo ou a festa do dia no calendário da Igreja.
• PÍLULA — um pensamento curto de santos e Doutores da Igreja para o dia, com uma prática.
• MILAGRES — milagres eucarísticos, aparições marianas e milagres dos santos, com a situação oficial reconhecida pela Igreja.
• SANTO TERÇO — reze passo a passo, com os mistérios do dia, inclusive em latim.
• ORAÇÕES — as principais orações católicas em português, latim, grego, inglês, espanhol, francês, italiano e alemão.
• LEMBRETES DE ORAÇÃO — Angelus, terço, liturgia e mais, nos horários que você escolher.
• FAVORITOS — guarde versículos, orações e leituras com uma anotação sua.
• LITURGIA DAS HORAS — Laudes, Vésperas e Completas, em forma simplificada.
• CONFISSÃO — preparação para a confissão e exame de consciência pelos Dez Mandamentos (as marcações não são salvas).
• VIDA DE ORAÇÃO — rastreador de hábitos com sequência de dias.
• CATECISMO, ENCÍCLICAS E DOUTRINA SOCIAL — os textos oficiais do Vaticano, lidos dentro do app.
• IGREJAS PERTO DE VOCÊ — encontre igrejas católicas perto de você.
• SEU CATEQUISTA DE BOLSO — tire dúvidas sobre a fé; a resposta cita o Catecismo e a Bíblia. Usa inteligência artificial e pode errar: confirme com o seu padre ou com o Catecismo.

Idiomas da interface: português, inglês, espanhol, francês, italiano, alemão, latim, polonês, russo, chinês, coreano, japonês, filipino, hindi e árabe.

Seus favoritos, hábitos e lembretes ficam só no seu aparelho. Sem anúncios, sem conta.

Aviso: app independente, sem vínculo oficial com a CNBB nem com a Santa Sé. Os comentários dos Padres são traduções de edições antigas em domínio público; a tradução literal do grego é feita neste app e serve para estudo, não substitui as Bíblias aprovadas para a liturgia.

name: Şaxmat
description:
Şaxmat is a clean, fast chess app for every level: play live games online, practise against a bot, solve puzzles, learn tactics and review your games.

PLAY ONLINE
• Live games against real opponents: bullet, blitz, rapid and classical (1+0 to 30+0)
• Elo rating for every time control
• Play friends by invite and see when they are online
• Start a game on your phone and continue it on your iPad or Mac

PLAY THE BOT
• 9 levels from complete beginner (400) to full strength (3500)
• Take back moves, flip the board, play with or without a clock

THE LEAGUE
• Climb from Pawn to King: beat 10 different opponents to reach each new rank
• Leaderboards for everyone and for your friends

PUZZLES AND LESSONS
• 1,400 puzzles from the open Lichess database, matched to your level
• A daily puzzle and a daily streak
• 12 lessons on tactics (mate in one, fork, pin, back-rank mate and more) with 224 practice positions

ANALYSIS
• Opening explorer with over 3,800 named openings
• Game review with the Stockfish engine: Best, Excellent, Brilliant, Mistake and Miss moves
• Move arrows and an evaluation of every position

YOUR STYLE
• 13 board themes and 9 piece sets
• Light and dark mode
• Uzbek, Russian and English

Play as a guest with no account, or sign in with Apple, Google, Telegram or email to keep your rating, league and progress on all your devices.

No ads. No tracking.

name: Scatterfall: Aim, Break, Drop
description:
Pull back, aim through the narrow gate and let go: one stone breaks the whole pile and sends it tumbling into the wells. Plan your shots, because the next wave is already on its way.

Scatterfall is a single-player aim-and-scatter puzzle set in a night garden. Every level gives you one set of shots for all of its waves. Sink enough amber stones before the shots run out and the level is yours.

HOW IT PLAYS
● Drag your white stone back and release. The guide line shows the way up to the gate.
● Your stone flies through the gate and scatters the amber stones on the other side.
● Every amber stone that drops into a well fills the counter.
● When the far side is almost clear, a new wave lands on top of whatever you left behind.
● All waves share the same shots, so a shot wasted early is a stone you miss at the end.

SIX NEW THINGS, ONE AT A TIME
Each new element gets a level of its own before it mixes with the rest:
● Sand: it slows your stone down, so choose a soft or a full pull.
● Grey stones: they don't count, and they get in the way.
● Two gates: the middle is closed, so come in at an angle.
● Moving well: leave a stone on its track and let the well come to collect it.
● Bumpers: bounce a stone off them into a side well.
● Bombs: hit one hard and it blasts the stones around it.
Later levels bring new table layouts and mix three elements at once.

50 LEVELS
● A short tutorial teaches the basics in three moves.
● From two-wave warm-ups to six-wave challenges.
● After level 50, levels 11 to 50 come back for another round.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
● No timer: the table waits for your next shot.
● Out of shots? Take +3 shots once per try, or retry the level.
● Every pile breaks a little differently, so no two shots play alike.

NOTHING IN YOUR WAY
● No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.
● Plays in English or Turkish, following your device language.
● Sound and vibration can each be turned off.

name: Scout Photo
description:
Stop scrolling through thousands of screenshots, bursts, and old receipts just to find one photo.

Scout turns your entire camera roll into an instant, offline search engine with zero ads, zero subscriptions, and no account required. Your photos never leave your iPhone or iPad.

FIND ANY PHOTO BY DESCRIPTION OR TEXT
• Describe What You Remember: Search naturally with phrases like "beach sunset", "receipt", "dog on sofa", or "whiteboard notes".
• On-Device Text Recognition (OCR): Find any screenshot, invoice, tracking number, password slip, or handwritten note by the words written inside it.
• Smart One-Tap Actions: Automatically detect receipts, notes, recipes, and text-heavy shots so you can copy totals, copy snippets, or switch to a distraction-free Cook Mode in one tap.
• Search in English & Portuguese: Type queries naturally in either language across your library.

SEARCH BY PHOTO OR CAMERA
• Pick a reference photo from your library or snap one with your camera to surface visually similar images, matching products, outfits, places, or near-identical frames.

CLEAN DUPLICATES & RECLAIM STORAGE
• Duplicate & Burst Finder: Automatically clusters exact duplicates, burst shots, and look-alikes while marking the sharpest keeper—so you can clear gigabytes in minutes.
• Auto-Expiring Trash & Swipe Deck: Quarantines clutter like 2FA verification codes, temporary QR tickets, and guest Wi-Fi slips. Swipe to keep or queue junk onto a 7-Day Auto-Burn fuse so it clears out automatically.

PRIVATE & OFFLINE BY DESIGN
• Powered by local on-device AI running through your device's Neural Engine and stored inside a private local SQLite vector index on your phone.
• Works everywhere—on flights, underground, or in Airplane Mode.
• No cloud photo uploads. No accounts or sign-ins. No ads.
• Optional crash and usage diagnostics are OFF by default and strip file paths automatically.
• Designed cleanly for both Light Mode and Dark Mode across iPhone and iPad.

Download Scout today no ads, no paywalls, just your photo library made searchable and clutter-free.

name: SeatTrellis
description:
Plan a small gathering with clear table capacities, named guests and numbered seats.

Build an event, add tables and keep a guest directory. The seating view shows each available and occupied position. Assign a guest manually, move them to an empty seat, or explicitly swap two seated guests. An unseated guest can take an occupied place only after you confirm what happens to the previous occupant.

Add your own Together or Separate rules for pairs of guests. Checks show Pass, Violation or Pending when someone is unassigned. They explain your arrangement and leave you in control of the final plan.

Create a table-plan PDF, printable place cards for seated guests, or a CSV snapshot. Saved reports keep the names and assignments captured at that time, even after the event changes. Review PDFs in the app and share the files using the system share sheet.

Your library stays on this device. Export and restore a JSON backup when needed. Clear local data removes the app's records and owned export files; copies you already shared remain wherever you saved them.

SeatTrellis is a manual planning tool. It does not automatically find an optimal seating plan or verify that your chosen rules suit an event. No login is required.

name: Second Guess - Jellyfish Labs
description:
Second Guess is a timing game from Jellyfish Labs for anyone who swears they can “feel” five seconds.

You’ll see a target, then the clock disappears. Count in your head. Tap Stop when you think you’ve landed it. Miss by a hair or nail it exactly. Either way, you’ll want one more round.

Single Player
Pick your range, get a random target, and chase that perfect stop. History keeps your last 100 attempts so you can brag later (or quietly improve).

Multiplayer (same Wi‑Fi)
Gather up to 8 friends on the same network. Host a room, share a code or QR, and see who gets closest. No accounts. No cloud lobby. Just phones, timing, and friendly trash talk.

name: Secret Spot Sounds
description:
Secret Spot Sounds is free to everyone. We stand for free speech and we support small creators.

FIND SOUNDS
Free samples, drum kits, loops and sound packs made by the people who use the app. Play anything with one tap, like it, and save it.

MAKE MUSIC
Open Secret Sauce and record, overdub and mix right on your phone: saturator, overdrive, multiband, delay, tune and one-knob mastering. Your songs and tracklists save to your account, so you can pick them up again later.

SHARE YOURS
Record a sound, upload a pack or a song, post updates and go live. Follow the creators you like and see their posts on your own home feed.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CALL
Block anyone, report anything, and delete your account whenever you want.

name: Seeking for Pro
description:
Keep every hunt, signal and find in one elegant private field journal. Seeking for Pro helps detectorists plan outings, record discoveries, review signals and build a personal collection, all in a dark, photo-first space designed for the field and for later research.

Whether you are logging a quick dig or analysing a promising signal at home, the app keeps your notes organised and easy to revisit. Save finds, connect them to outings and sites, and track what you have already searched without sharing your exact locations.

Key features
- Discovery gallery - browse your finds in a polished photo grid with favourites, filters and quick access to details
- Find records - store photos, date, category, depth, ground, weight, size, material notes and related signal data
- Map and areas - mark sites, boundaries, routes and status such as Planned, Partly Searched, Searched or Revisit
- Outing planner - prepare a session with goals, duration, detector profile, kit checklist and access notes
- Signal journal - log Target ID or VDI, expected item, actual result, conditions and your own conclusion
- Research notebook - save theories, references, marks, inscriptions and open questions for later study
- Equipment profiles - keep detector and coil settings separate so earlier records stay accurate
- History and insights - review outings, time spent, categories found and comparisons across sessions

Perfect for
- Detectorists who want a private, offline friendly logbook for finds and signals
- Users who like to research items, compare outings and build a personal collection over time
- Anyone who needs a clear way to track sites, permissions, access notes and revisit plans

Why choose us
Seeking for Pro is built as a private working tool, not a social feed. It focuses on real field use, with fast entry, flexible records and a clean visual layout that puts your photos first. Unknown values stay unknown, exact coordinates are never shared automatically, and every section is made to support careful, repeatable logging from first signal to final research note.

Download Seeking for Pro and turn every outing into a well organised record you can trust.

name: Şehzade - Roguelike Card RPG
description:
Şehzade is a card battler inspired by Ottoman tales. Lead the young prince Şehzade Mustafa out of Manisa, choose your road on the map and win every fight with the cards in your hand.

A road full of legends
Pickpockets and bandits, jackals, wolves and wild boars, Deli Kasım and his men, and the creatures of old stories: Hortlak, Alkarısı, Karakoncolos, Karabasan, Gulyabani and the one-eyed giant Tepegöz. The meddah, the old storyteller, tells the tale as you go.

Card battles
Strike, raise your armor, parry and poison. Every turn is a small puzzle: which card now, which enemy first, and what to keep for the next blow. Fill the gauge and unleash a Surge, a special strike with its own close-up.

Build your deck
Over 100 cards. Pick new cards after battles, buy and upgrade them at the card stall in Manisa, and shape your deck at the lectern before every expedition.

Charms and steles
Fit charms into your Tughra, Armlet, Prayer Beads and Amulet, read the old steles along the road for blessings, and choose your path: fierce battles, chests, lodges to rest in and villagers who ask for your help.

Manisa, your home
Between expeditions, rest in Manisa. Visit the peddler for items, earn renown, level up and fill your Book of Wonders with every creature you defeat.

Pay once, play in peace
• One-time purchase: the whole game is yours.
• No ads and no in-app purchases. Coins are earned by playing, never sold.
• No internet needed. Play anywhere, even offline.
• No account and no tracking. Your progress is saved on your device and in your own iCloud, so it comes back on a new iPhone or iPad.
• iPhone and iPad, played in landscape.
• English and Turkish.

Found a bug or have an idea? Write to us from the Support page, we are happy to help.

name: Seller
description:
Seller, c'est votre boutique préférée dans votre poche. Découvrez les articles, commandez en quelques gestes et faites-vous livrer chez vous, sans vous déplacer.

DÉCOUVREZ
• Le catalogue complet, classé par catégories
• La recherche pour trouver un article en un instant
• Les sélections et nouveautés mises en avant
• Des fiches détaillées avec photos, prix et avis des clientes

GARDEZ VOS COUPS DE CŒUR
• Ajoutez vos articles préférés en favoris
• Partagez un article avec vos proches en un lien

COMMANDEZ SIMPLEMENT
• Un panier clair, avec le total et les frais de livraison avant de valider
• Votre adresse placée directement sur la carte, pour que le livreur vous trouve facilement
• Plusieurs adresses enregistrées : maison, bureau, famille

PAYEZ PAR MOBILE MONEY
• Paiement sécurisé par Flooz ou Mixx, depuis votre téléphone

SUIVEZ VOS COMMANDES
• L'historique et le statut de chacune de vos commandes
• Des notifications quand votre commande avance

PROFITEZ DE LA FIDÉLITÉ
• Cumulez des points à chaque commande et échangez-les

VOTRE COMPTE, À VOTRE FAÇON
• Connexion avec votre numéro de téléphone, Google ou Apple
• Thème clair ou sombre

Le catalogue reste libre d'accès : un compte n'est nécessaire que pour commander et suivre vos commandes.

Une question ? Rendez-vous sur seller.kevram.tech/support.

name: Sénégalais près de moi
description:
Just moved to Paris, Brussels, Montreal, New York or London and don't know anyone? Living abroad for years and want to meet more Senegalese people nearby?

Sénégalais près de moi shows you, at a glance, the Senegalese community living near you.

DISCOVER
• A map and a list of members around you, sorted by distance
• Newcomers highlighted: welcome them, or let people know you just arrived
• Simple filters: distance, gender, age, newcomers, members online
• Search by name, city or home region in Senegal

CONNECT
• Message members directly, or send a request to those who prefer to be asked first
• You choose who can message you: everyone, on request only, or nobody
• See who's online, and hide your own presence if you prefer
• A notification bell so you never miss a request or a reply

CHAT
• Messages, emojis and voice messages
• Replies, reactions, edit and delete your messages

A PROFILE THAT LOOKS LIKE YOU
• Up to 3 photos, a cover photo and a short intro video
• Introduce yourself in writing or out loud, with a short audio introduction
• Your home city, the year you arrived, a few words about you

YOUR SAFETY FIRST
• Your location is blurred (about 500 m): your address is never shown or stored
• Choose who can see you: everyone, your country, your city, or within 10 to 50 km
• Pause your profile whenever you want
• Block and report in one tap; every report is reviewed by our team
• Delete your account and data anytime, right from the app

This is not a dating app: it is a community tool to connect, help each other and feel at home anywhere in the world.

Free and ad-free. For people aged 18 and over.

name: Sentiwatt
description:
entiwatt is the maintenance technician's app for predictive monitoring of electric generators.

Connected sensors continuously measure machine vibration and sound. An AI model analyzes this data to detect anomalies before they turn into breakdowns.

Features:
• Health dashboard for every machine
• Real-time alerts via push notifications
• Work order tracking and reporting, with photos
• AI assistant to ask questions about your machines
• Offline mode: access your data even without network

Sentiwatt is designed for maintenance teams at sites equipped with the Sentiwatt system. An account provided by your organization is required to sign in.

name: ServiceSync Teams
description:
ServiceSync Teams brings cleaning operations together in one place. Coordinate managers, employees, and clients across accounts and locations with clear schedules, shared communication, and organized service requests.

PLAN THE WORK
View scheduled shifts, coordinate recurring work, and keep assignments connected to the right account and location.

SUPPORT YOUR TEAM
Give employees a clear view of their workday, assigned checklists, and requests. Keep conversations organized with team chat.

MANAGE SERVICE REQUESTS
Track client tickets, discuss what needs attention, and keep updates and supporting photos with the request.

CHECK QUALITY
Complete inspections, record findings, assign follow-up work, and share published reports with authorized clients.

KEEP OPERATIONS ORGANIZED
Manage forms, supply requests, and inventory information in the same workspace.

BUILT FOR EVERY ROLE
Management, Employee, and Client views help each person focus on the information and actions available to them. Switch between English and Spanish interface text.

ServiceSync Teams is free to download. Sign-in is required. Access to workspace data and features depends on your organization membership, role, and assigned accounts. An internet connection is required.

name: Shapka
description:
Shapka is the hat game: the classic party word game, now on everyone's phone.

HOW IT WORKS
• One person creates a game and shares the code. Everyone joins from their own phone.
• Everyone secretly adds the same number of words to the hat.
• Shapka splits you into random teams of two.
• Take turns explaining words to your teammate before the timer runs out. Every word guessed scores a point for your team.

THREE ROUNDS, SAME WORDS
1. Describe: say anything except the word itself.
2. One word: give a single-word clue.
3. Act it out: no words at all, just gestures.
By the last round everyone knows the words, and the inside jokes write themselves.

MADE FOR PLAYING IN THE SAME ROOM
The explaining and guessing happen out loud, around the table. Shapka just looks after the hat, the teams, the timer and the score, so nobody has to.

• 2 to 20 players, in teams of two
• The host chooses the turn length and which rounds to play
• Stuck on a word? Draw a second one
• Undo a word that was marked by mistake
• See the winners and every team's words at the end

Completely free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no tracking. Just a game for friends.

name: Sheep Loop!
description:
A little planning brings the whole flock home.

Sheep Loop is a color sorting and matching puzzle set in a sunny pasture. Tap a sheep at the front of the waiting queue to send it around the loop. Guide matching colors into the pens, complete groups, and watch them head for the barn.

THINK BEFORE YOU TAP
Space on the loop is limited. Choose which sheep to send next, watch the colors in each pen, and keep enough room for the next group.

A FLOCK WITH PERSONALITY
Little steps, soft wool, a gentle push from the queue, and a happy trip home make every move feel alive.

A HELPING HOOF
Unlock tools as you progress. Add a space to the loop, send a sheep out of a pen, or lift a waiting sheep from farther back in the queue.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
No account is needed. Progress and settings stay on your device. Sound, music, and vibration have separate controls.

Free to play. No in-app purchases.

Some levels have a timer. Plan your dispatches and bring the flock home before time runs out.

Support: https://playcalmgame.com/sheep-loop/support/
Privacy: https://playcalmgame.com/sheep-loop/privacy/

name: Shop One: Shopping Lists
description:
Make everyday shopping easier. Shop One brings your lists, regular items, and receipts together in an experience designed for iPhone.

• Create, rename, and archive shopping lists.
• Organize products by category with colorful icons.
• Prepare your next shopping trip and check off items as you go.
• Search your purchase history and give receipts a name.
• Keep receipt photos and PDFs, or photograph a receipt in the app.
• Share receipts using the standard iPhone share menu, including email.
• Export and restore backups with attachments.
• Use your lists offline. An internet connection is required to sign in with Apple and sync.
• Connect an optional Apple account to sync your data, with an optional profile name and photo.

Available in Brazilian Portuguese, Latin American Spanish, and U.S. English. No banking or financial integrations and no advertising tracking.

name: ShopLine AI Receptionist
description:
ShopLine is the companion app for auto repair shops that use the ShopLine AI phone receptionist.

Your AI receptionist answers your shop's phone day and night, books appointments, and takes messages. This app puts all of it in your pocket.

CALLS
• Every call the AI answered, with a short summary, the vehicle, and what the customer needs
• Play the call recording
• See who still needs a call back and call them with one tap

APPOINTMENTS
• See booked jobs on a calendar
• Block off time when the shop is closed or busy, so the AI won't book it

ANALYTICS
• Calls answered, booking rate, after-hours calls, and returning callers
• Minutes used this billing period

KNOWLEDGE BASE
• Tell the AI what it can and can't say: prices, booking rules, services you do or don't offer, hours, and warranties

REVIEW GENERATOR (add-on)
• Text happy customers your Google review link in seconds

Also: push notifications for new calls, support tickets, and settings for your shop.

ShopLine requires a ShopLine account. New shops can create an account in the app.

name: Shosai: Reading Journal
description:
Shosai turns the books you read into a study of your own.

Finish a book, photograph the cover or scan its barcode, and it is on the shelf in seconds. Write what you learned, how you will use it and the book in one line — or just one line. Your notes stay with the book.

• Walk your study: swipe along lit oak bookcases, one for each subject
• My Book: every book you record adds a page to a book of your own that never ends, with a chapter for each year to page through
• Snap the cover or scan the ISBN barcode, or type it in
• Three short notes: what I learned, how I will use it, in one line
• Every Sunday, one note from your past self comes back
• Search everything you wrote and find the book again
• Make your own bookcases and choose their colour
• Export your whole study to one file when you change phones

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your books and notes stay on your device.

name: Siddur JMO
description:
Siddur JMO is an offline Jewish prayer reader with 129 prayers and sections.

Read Hebrew text alongside transliteration and translation, aligned word by word where the content supports it. Choose French or English independently for translation and transliteration.

• Browse prayers in an organized table of contents.
• Show or hide Hebrew, transliteration, and translation.
• Adjust text size.
• Use a layout adapted to your screen or follow printed rows.
• Choose paper, sepia, or night themes.
• Read in portrait or landscape.
• Return to your last prayer with your saved preferences.

Prayer texts and fonts are included in the app. No account or internet connection is needed to read.

name: Sill: Appliance Age & Upkeep
description:
How old is your water heater? Your furnace? Your AC?

Snap the label. Sill reads the model and serial number, estimates when the unit was made, and shows where it sits in its typical service life — so you can plan a replacement before it fails, not after.

SCAN A LABEL
• Point your camera at the sticker on a water heater, furnace, AC, heat pump or appliance
• Text is read on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded
• Check and fix the details before saving; the age updates as you type

KNOW THE AGE
• Decodes manufacture dates from serial numbers for major brands, including Rheem, Ruud, A. O. Smith, State, Bradford White, Lennox, Goodman, Amana, Trane, American Standard and Carrier
• Every estimate shows where it came from: printed on the label, the maker's published format, or a common decoding guide
• Typical service life from public sources (DOE, ENERGY STAR, NAHB) and a clear "plan ahead" signal

UPKEEP ON AUTOPILOT
• Filters, tank flushes, tune-ups, dryer vents, smoke alarm tests and more, created for each item
• Seasonal timing for your climate (cold, mixed or hot)
• One quiet reminder on the morning a task is due
• Mark tasks done with cost and notes, snooze, or change how often they repeat
• Clear "best left to a pro" notes for gas, refrigerant and electrical work

YOUR HOME'S RECORDS
• Track warranties and get a heads-up before they end
• Keep receipts, manuals and photos with each item
• Share a home report (PDF) with a buyer, renter, insurer or contractor
• Back up to a file in iCloud Drive and restore anytime

ON-DEVICE HELP
On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, get step-by-step help tailored to your unit, generated on your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No address. No ads. No tracking. No contractor sales calls. Your home's data stays on your iPhone.

Ages are estimates, not professional inspections.

name: Simmerly
description:
Simmerly turns your phone into a row of kitchen burners. Lay it on its side, and every timer you have going sits side by side across the screen in numbers big enough to read from the sink.

EVERY BURNER, AT A GLANCE
Run up to eight named timers at once: Rice 18m, Roast 1h 20m, Eggs 7m. Each one lives on its own white-enamel tile with a huge countdown, a progress bar and a little flame that flickers while it cooks. Pause, add a minute, reset or turn a burner off with one tap.

CHAIN THE STEPS
Some dishes are more than one timer. Build a chain like Sear 3m, Flip 3m, Rest 5m, and Simmerly moves to the next step on its own with a soft gas-ring whoomp. The tile shows which step you're on and how much is left.

FINISHED MEANS FINISHED
When a burner is done its tile flashes herb green, the flame turns into a puff of steam and a kitchen-timer ring sounds. If Simmerly is in the background, a local notification tells you which pan needs you. Choose whether the ring sounds once, three times or until you turn it off.

PRESETS AND MEAL SETS
Save the timers you use all the time and light them again in one tap. Group several presets into a meal set, such as "Sunday roast" with chicken, potatoes, gravy and greens, and light the whole meal at once. Everything is editable and deletable, and starter examples are one tap away if you want a head start.

HISTORY
Every timer that finishes, or that you turn off early, is kept in History with the time of day. Add a note ("one minute less next time"), rename it, time it again or delete it. You also see how many timers you ran this week and what you time most.

MADE FOR THE KITCHEN
- Landscape layout built for a phone propped against the backsplash
- Stove-knob navigation: Range, Presets, History and Hood
- Keeps the screen awake while a burner is lit (optional)
- Three cooker finishes: Enamel White, Cast Iron Night and Copper Pot
- Sound and haptics toggles; sounds respect the silent switch and never stop your music
- Works offline and syncs when you're back online

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Tap "Start cooking now" to use Simmerly as a guest straight away, or create an account with email and password to keep your presets and History on any phone. Guests can save their kitchen to an email account later from Hood. You can delete your account and all of its data at any time from Hood.

No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your data is private to your account.

name: SimpleFlare - Support Inbox
description:
SimpleFlare brings your support inbox to your iPhone: the live chat from your website and the email your customers send, for every brand you run, in one place.

NEVER MISS A CUSTOMER
- New chats and emails arrive as notifications, one thread per conversation.
- Reply or mark a conversation as read right from the notification.
- The app icon shows how many conversations are waiting for you.

LIVE CHAT ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
- While a visitor is chatting on your site, the conversation stays on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island: who is writing, their last message and how long they have been waiting.
- Tap it to open the chat and answer.

ONE INBOX FOR THE WHOLE TEAM
- Chat and email from all your brands in one list, with unread, assigned and snoozed conversations.
- Assign conversations, add labels, answer with saved replies and see who on the team is online.
- Search every conversation by name, address or text.

AT A GLANCE
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your unread conversations by brand.

A SimpleFlare account is required.

name: Sir Ladderton’s Unfair Tower
description:
Sir Ladderton is a knight with a ladder on his back and one goal, which is the cake at the top of the tower. Baron Vexington owns the tower. He is a crab, he wears a monocle, and he has spent his savings on saws, pits and falling blocks.

Tap anywhere to jump. Hold a little longer to jump higher. When a pit is too wide or a wall is too tall, tap the LADDER button and Sir Ladderton lays a ladder across it.

Every run builds a different map, so memorizing the course will not help. The game saves a checkpoint every 10 traps, and the title screen lets a player start from any checkpoint already reached. The scenery changes every 100 traps, from Meadow Gate through the Clockwork Foundry to the Baron’s Keep. The traps get faster the further the knight goes.

The Baron comments on the whole thing from the top of his tower. He complains about the cost of his own traps, and every 50 traps he stops the run for a short scene with his butler.

There are no ads and nothing to buy inside the game. It works without an internet connection and collects no data.

This is a companion to Baron Vexington, the tower defense game where the player builds the traps. Here the player has to run through them.

name: SKIP AU
description:
Made for the Aplico collection. 

You’ll need a family account or a guest code from the owners

The app can be used for a tour with a updated guest code

name: Sky Conference Officials
description:
Sky Conference Officials is a companion for Kentucky high school football officials.

Prepare with purpose
Build your own game-day checklist, track your preparation and keep personal notes on your device.

Stay connected
Open the association website and existing member portal for association information. Website membership and sign-in remain managed by Sky Conference.

Find your resources
Access links to officiating and football resources, including KHSAA, NFHS and Arbiter. Open the official Arbiter sign-in or find its iPhone app. External services manage their own accounts and availability.

Follow football scores
Open the Sky Conference website scoreboard. Scores are reported by third-party sources and may be delayed or unavailable for some games. The app does not supply its own live score feed.

This app is not endorsed by KHSAA, NFHS or Arbiter.

name: Sky Shield: Defense Command
description:
Every blip on your radar is a decision.

SKY SHIELD puts you in command of a national air defense center. Airliners, friendly patrols, unknown aircraft, drones and missiles fill your screen – and only you decide what is a threat. Identify fast, engage carefully, and keep your cities and critical infrastructure standing.

IDENTIFY BEFORE YOU ENGAGE
• Track every contact on a live radar with bearing, range, speed and heading
• Run priority scans, make radio calls and check transponders
• Classify contacts as civil, friendly or threat – one wrong call has consequences

BUILD YOUR DEFENSE
• Buy and place radars and interceptor batteries on the map
• Manage your credits and keep your launchers supplied with ammunition
• Cover blind spots before the next wave arrives

10-MISSION CAMPAIGN
• Defend ten fictional regions – from coastlines and river deltas to mountains, islands, fog and a final last stand
• Three difficulty levels with separate star ratings
• A guided tutorial teaches you everything in about three minutes

SURVIVAL & CHALLENGES
• Survival: the pressure keeps rising – how long can you hold?
• Four challenges: tight budget, radar interference, busy civil airspace and a damaged command center

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Completely offline – no account needed
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collection
• Available in English, German, French, Spanish and Portuguese

name: SkyTape
description:
SkyTape is a small, quiet weather app from Orca Pod Productions. It shows the conditions for one place, the next day laid out like a measuring tape you can scroll, a week ahead, and a plain-language reading of the air.

What you see

- Current temperature, conditions, feels-like, wind, and humidity
- A horizontal tape of about the next 24 hours
- A seven-day outlook
- Air quality as US AQI when Open-Meteo provides it, otherwise European AQI, plus PM2.5, with a sentence that says what the number means
- Celsius or Fahrenheit. Fahrenheit also shows wind in miles per hour. The conversion happens on your device.

Location, on your terms

Approximate location is optional. SkyTape explains the request before the system dialog, and it asks only for a coarse, city-level fix while the app is open — not precise GPS, and not background location. If you say no, search for a city by name. Coordinates and city searches are sent to Open-Meteo so it can return a forecast. SkyTape has no account and no server of its own.

Offline

The last successful reading is saved on the device. Pull to refresh when you want a new one. If the network is down, that saved reading stays on screen and is labeled as such.

A free portfolio app

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No tracking.

Data credit

Weather, air quality, and city search come from Open-Meteo (https://open-meteo.com/), under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Open-Meteo aggregates open data from national weather services, including NOAA, DWD, ECMWF, Météo-France, JMA, MET Norway, and the Canadian Meteorological Centre. SkyTape does not edit the source readings.

Orca Pod Productions, LLC is a solo mobile studio.

name: Skytilt Town
description:
Build a town on a floating island that tilts with every move. Place buildings on the tray, then merge matching buildings into larger ones. Each building changes the balance, so check the preview before you confirm.

Fill the harbor order and keep your tray steady to dock. Drag to look around the 3D board and use Undo to rethink your last move.

Explore 24 harbors across four chapters and unlock buildings for your collection. How to Play is available from the home and pause menus. Play in English or Chinese. Your progress stays on your device.

name: SkyVoxel
description:
See storms from the inside.

SkyVoxel turns NEXRAD Level II Doppler radar into a live 3D volume you can spin, tilt, and slice through. Instead of a flat map of colored pixels, you see the whole storm: how tall it is, where the strongest echoes sit, and how its structure changes with height.

Built for weather geeks, storm chasers, and anyone who has ever stared at a radar loop and wondered what was really going on up there.

THREE WAYS TO LOOK AT A STORM

• Volume
The full radar scan rendered as a 3D voxel cloud. Rotate it, zoom in, and look at a supercell from any angle.

• Isosurface
Pulls out solid 3D shells at the reflectivity levels you pick. Great for spotting towering cores, overshooting tops, and possible hail shafts at a glance.

• Cross-Section
Draw a line through any storm and get a vertical slice from the ground to the top of the scan. See what is happening at every altitude at once.

MADE FOR THE WAY YOU WATCH WEATHER

• Pick any NEXRAD site and pull the latest volume scan
• Target panel puts the data for your selected storm first
• Layers panel controls what you see and how it is drawn
• Built-in explanations for radar terms, so "isosurface" and "reflectivity" never leave you guessing
• Times in local or UTC, 12 or 24 hour

EVERY SCREEN

• iPhone, with a layout designed for one-handed storm tracking
• iPhone Duo, with a layout built around the dual-screen design
• iPad, with full Split View support so radar can sit next to your other weather tools

ONE PRICE. NO SUBSCRIPTION.

Buy it once and it is yours. No subscription, no tiers, no features held back behind a paywall.

SkyVoxel uses free, publicly available NEXRAD Level II data from NOAA's National Weather Service radar network. It is a visualization tool for enthusiasts and is not a substitute for official warnings. Always follow guidance from the National Weather Service and local authorities during severe weather.

Questions or ideas? support@skyvoxel.app

name: Slant: Line Puzzle
description:
Draw one diagonal in every square. Each number tells you how many lines touch that corner, and the lines can't close a loop. Get it right and the whole board fills with color.

Slant (you might know it as Gokigen Naname) is a quiet little logic puzzle. You work it out from the numbers, one square at a time, until everything settles into place.

What's in it

• 54 boards, from tiny 2×2 warm-ups to 9×9, in three stages: Intro, Developing and Advanced. Every one can be solved step by step, no guessing.
• Four short opening boards show you the rules before the numbered boards start.
• New Game+ opens up after all 54: fresh boards at Easy, Normal or Hard, each with a seed you can come back to or send to a friend.
• Free draw is a blank board up to 16×16 with no numbers. Every closed section fills with color, so you can just doodle.
• Stuck? A hint outlines a diagonal and the numbers or path that force it. Tap again to place it.
• Two modes. Standard colors a section once it's right. Hard colors it when its numbers match, and gives you a lock tool for the diagonals you're sure about.

How it plays

Tap a square to turn or clear its diagonal, or drag to paint a whole line. Undo takes back your last move. Want just one direction? Pick Slash or Backslash in Settings. A keyboard works too.

When you finish

Download saves a picture of your colored board to keep or share. Copy link sends the same puzzle to a friend, who can play it in a browser.

Quiet by design

• Works offline. No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Light or dark, or follow your system. Reduced motion. Enlarge the board and pan around if you want bigger squares.
• One-switch scanning in Settings > Access.
• Your progress stays on your device. Close the app mid-board and pick up right where you left off.

name: SmartTeam HR
description:
SmartTeam is your all-in-one HR and workforce management app.

Key features:

• Smart attendance — clock in and out with GPS location, face verification, QR codes or NFC cards
• Leave & requests — submit leave and permission requests and track their status in real time
• Live dashboard — a clear overview of team attendance, absence and daily activity
• Instant notifications — alerts for approvals, rejections and company announcements
• Biometric security — protect sensitive actions with fingerprint or face
• Fully bilingual — a complete experience in Arabic and English

SmartTeam is built for companies that want accurate, trustworthy attendance records and smooth HR operations: it gives managers a live view of their teams, and gives employees a fast, easy way to manage their workday.

name: Snake Crash
description: A turn-based Snake game featuring a boss fight at the end, where you can gobble up numerous other snakes and various items along your winding path. If you manage to grow larger than the boss, you will unlock new skins after a few rounds.

name: Snakes & Dragons
description:
Every board is full of snakes and dragons. Tap one and it slides out the way it is facing, as long as nothing is in its path. Tap one that is blocked and you lose a shield. Clear the whole board to win.

It starts simple. Then each world adds a new rule:

• Corner shields that turn a moving snake 90 degrees • Ice dragons that stay frozen until others have left • Gold keys that open locked gates • Two-headed dragons that can leave either way • Tunnels that carry a snake across the board • Twin dragons that move together

What is in the game:

• 64 levels in 8 worlds. Every level is checked by a solver, so it can always be finished. • A new daily puzzle every day, open from level 11. • An endless tower after level 64. • Timed boss levels along the way. • Hints that light up a safe move, and fireballs that burn one piece off the board. You earn both by playing. • Three stars for a level with no mistakes. • Four board themes, including a dark one. • Relax Mode with no shield loss, and an optional Speed Timer for every level. • Pinch to zoom on big boards.

No ads. It works offline.

name: Sniped It!
description:
Take your shot. Call your result. Track your accuracy without stopping to pick up your device.

Sniped It! is a voice-controlled hockey shooting tracker that gives every practice session a purpose. Shoot at a target, say "hit" or "miss," and keep firing. The app records what you report so you can see your progress, find the corners that need work, and make every puck count.


FOUR WAYS TO TRAIN
------------------------------------------------
1)   BUCKETS
Have a bucket of pucks? Set your puck count and number of rounds. Sniped It! calls a target for each shot. Say "hit" or "miss," finish your bucket, collect your pucks, and go again. Your results are tracked across rounds.

2)  CALL OUT TRAINING
Listen for the target, take your shot, and call "hit" or "miss." Train in rounds or keep shooting nonstop. Challenge your aim, focus, and ability to react to a new target.

3)  OPEN TRAINING
You call the shots. Pick where to aim, shoot, and say where the puck went or that you missed. Sniped It! logs each result without a preset target sequence.

4)  4 IN 4 CHALLENGE
Four corners. One challenge. Hit them all in as few shots and as little time as you can, then try to beat your personal best.


TURN PRACTICE INTO PROGRESS
------------------------------------------------
• Track total shots, hits, misses, accuracy, and session duration.
• See your shot results for top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right, and five-hole.
• Review past sessions and accuracy trends over time.
• Follow your Sniper Score and personal bests where available.
• Spot the targets that need more practice.


UP TO FOUR PLAYERS, ONE DEVICE
------------------------------------------------
Give each player a name and hockey animal avatar. Everyone keeps their own shooting stats, with no account or sign-in.


TEN VOICES. YOUR CHOICE.
------------------------------------------------
Choose from ten recorded voices to call your targets and keep practice moving.


TRACK SHOTS BY VOICE
------------------------------------------------
Enable microphone and speech recognition access to report your shots by voice. Sniped It! tracks the results you report; it does not use a camera or puck sensor to detect shots automatically. Prefer not to talk? We got you covered there, too.  Switch to Tap Only and log shots on screen.


Free. No ads. No account or signup needed.  


Practice at home, at the rink, or with teammates. 
Make every shot count with Sniped It!

name: Snow Removal Is Power
description:
Snow Removal Is Power is a satisfying snow-clearing game where you melt a snowed-in yard with a flamethrower.
No shovel needed. Just drag your finger, and a roaring flame melts the snow away. 

HOW TO PLAY
- Hold and drag your finger to aim the flame.
- Melt all the snow in the yard to clear the level.
- Run out of gas and you fail. Dig up buried gas cans to refill.
- Careful: don't melt the snowmen, and don't overheat the car...

SO SATISFYING
- Deep snow melts away in big chunks when you take your time.
- Dig up coins and presents hidden under the snow.
- Melt the last few patches and everything clears in one big whoosh.

THE SHOP
Spend the coins you dig up on gear and looks.
- Nozzles: Wide, Jet, and Twin with two flames.
- Flame colors: the 7 flame-test colors (lithium, sodium, copper and more), plus a Rainbow Flame for collecting all 7.
- Outfits and costumes: bear, panda, penguin, a fire-breathing dragon and more. 17 in all.
- Power and Tank upgrades.

OUTFITS THAT MAKE NO SENSE
- Firefighter: isn't your job putting fires OUT?
- Snow Woman: weren't you on the snow's side?
- Snowman: please don't melt your friends.
- Fire extinguisher: fire comes out. That's not how it works.
- Kotatsu: clear snow without ever leaving your heated table. Mandarins included.

DAILY MISSION
A new goal every day (clear 3 levels, dig up coins, or use your flame).
Complete it and your next clear pays triple coins.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Free to play. No in-app purchases.
- Ads appear between levels and when the app opens. You choose whether to watch video ads.
- Available in English and Japanese (follows your device language).

name: SoCal Lights
description:
SoCal Lights puts holiday and seasonal fun across Southern California on one map.

• Places: events, parks, shows, nativity scenes, markets and real neighbor-decorated homes in one list and one map
• Tap a dot for hours, price and photos, or swipe through a home's photos
• Heart places to save them, then see your night in driving order
• Open the route in Apple Maps or Google Maps
• Filter by tonight, this Saturday, free, county, city or type
• Seasons: Halloween, Thanksgiving & Christmas, New Year, Spring and Summer
• Add your event or showcase your house, free

Free, no ads. Sign in to create a listing or enter a contest.

name: Son Düdük: Hakem Kariyeri
description:
Futbolu hiç bu açıdan oynamadın: düdük sende.

Son Düdük, futbol hakemliğini tüm ayrıntısıyla yaşatan bir kariyer simülatörü. Bölgesel amatör ligde ilk maçına çıkarsın; doğru kararlarla klasman atlar, ülkenin en üst ligine yükselir, uluslararası kokartı alır ve dünyanın en büyük maçlarına atanırsın.

SAHADAN YÖNET
• Canlı 3D maç: oyuncular koşar, pas verir, şut çeker; sen pozisyon alırsın.
• Temasları yakın plan, hakem gözü ve taktik kameradan izle, ağır çekimde tekrar et.
• Görüş açın kararını etkiler: doğru yerde durmak da işin parçası.

HER POZİSYONU SEN YORUMLA
• 13 farklı pozisyon türü: ceza sahası teması, elle oynama, ofsayt, dirsek, gol şansını engelleme, kaleci müdahalesi ve daha fazlası.
• Kural kitabına bak, yardımcı hakeme sor, video incelemesine git ya da kararının arkasında dur.
• Kart gösterme animasyonu, itirazlar, maç yönetimi ve uzatma kararları.

KARİYERİNİ İNŞA ET
• 8 ülke, her ülkede 5 klasman; yurt dışından gelen teklifler.
• Her maçtan sonra gözlemci notu, karar dökümü ve basının yorumu.
• Hakem Kurulu seni izliyor: başarılı ol, büyük maçlara atan; hata yap, kurula çağrıl.
• Haftalık antrenman programı: kondisyon, video analiz, kural semineri, zihinsel hazırlık.

DÜNYA SENİ KONUŞUYOR
• Kadraj sosyal medyasında taraftarlar, eski hakemler ve gazeteciler kararlarını tartışır.
• Haber akışı, puan durumları ve takvim.
• Kural Akademisi'nde zor pozisyonlarla kendini sına.

3 kariyer slotu, hakem tipi ve ülke seçimi. İnternet bağlantısı gerekmez; reklam yok, veri toplanmaz.

Not: Oyundaki tüm takımlar, oyuncular ve hakemler kurgusaldır.

name: sona - Sound for Music Videos
description:
Make your performance videos sound better.
sona finishes the audio of music videos you shoot on iPhone.

- Reduce noise
Cut room noise, air conditioner hiss and power hum.

- Shape the sound
5-band EQ you can drag on a graph
Compressor with presets: Vocal, Acoustic, Punch and more
14 reverbs across Room, Chamber, Hall, Plate and Cathedral
Delay

- Prevent clipping
Peaks are kept under control automatically.

- Add separately recorded audio
Add up to 3 WAV, M4A or MP3 files and line them up automatically by waveform.

- Video looks
13 filters such as Vivid, Cinema and Stage, plus color adjustments.

- Export for where you post
Exports at loudness suited to YouTube, Instagram and TikTok.

- Privacy
Everything is processed on your device. Your videos and audio are never uploaded.

name: SoreScore
description:
SoreScore predicts how sore each muscle will be over the next few days, so you can plan training and recovery instead of guessing.

Log a workout or import from Apple Health, and SoreScore gives every muscle a score from 0 to 69. A body map lights up where you'll feel it, from mild to high. Each morning, check in with how you actually feel and the app learns how your body responds.

WHAT YOU GET
• A soreness score for today and a forecast for the next 3 days
• Front and back body map, tinted muscle by muscle
• Your most affected muscles, ranked
• Import from Apple Health, including workouts synced from Strava, Peloton, Garmin and Apple Fitness
• Strength, running, hiking, road cycling, mountain biking, rowing and swimming
• Morning check-ins that tune predictions to you
• A progress page showing how accurate the predictions have been

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Health data is read only and never leaves your device.

LOUD ON PURPOSE
Pink, checkerboard and chunky type, straight out of the 2000s. It hurts so good.

SoreScore gives training guidance only and is not medical advice.

name: sovo.
description:
listen. is a personal audiobook player for your own DRM-free books. Import audio files, folders and ZIP archives, organize your library, and keep listening across your devices with iCloud.

Find your place with chapters, bookmarks and notes. Adjust playback speed, set your preferred skip intervals, use smart rewind after a pause, or fall asleep with a custom timer. An explicit play queue and nested folders help keep a large library organized.

Bring in books from Files, iCloud Drive, direct HTTPS downloads, a temporary local browser transfer, or your own Audiobookshelf or Jellyfin server. Optional metadata matching adds book information and covers. MP3 tracks can be combined into an M4B audiobook while retaining the imported originals.

Connect Goodreads to view Want to Read, Currently Reading and Read shelves in a session independent of Safari, or import a Goodreads CSV export. Goodreads authentication and refresh availability depend on Goodreads.

iCloud features require a signed-in Apple account. The app does not include an audiobook catalogue or supply audiobook downloads.

name: Spade: Real Life Quests
description:
Add a little adventure to everyday quests.

Spade turns real-life activities into side quests. Take on daily, weekly, and monthly challenges, earn XP, and dig up gear for your own little hero. A short walk, a creative break, or a task you've been putting off can become part of the journey.

A QUEST BOARD THAT KEEPS MOVING
Find three daily quests, three weekly quests, and two monthly quests drawn from a built-in deck. Choose the kinds of quests you want to receive, then press and hold to seal the ones you've completed.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Write custom quests for your own routines and goals. Pin a quest so it always appears, or shuffle it into the deck for a little variety.

SMALL WINS, SOMETHING TO SHOW FOR THEM
Earn XP, gain levels, unlock feats, and unearth items. Dress your digger in the gear you find and customize their appearance as your collection grows.

A LITTLE WORLD THAT REFLECTS YOUR PROGRESS
Your lantern burns brighter as you finish today's quests. Runes mark your week, and the moon follows your month. Enjoy atmospheric 3D scenery with retro pixels, or switch to a smoother look.

MADE FOR YOUR OWN PACE
Use optional daily reminders, sound, and haptics. Play offline without creating an account. Your progress is saved on your iPhone, with manual backup and restore when you want to keep a copy or move to another device.

One small quest. One more reason to begin.

name: Spaidoo: Universal Favorites
description:
Everything you like, from every shop, in one place.

Every shop wants you to make a list inside its own site. So you end up with a dozen lists you never open again, one per shop, and the thing you liked last month is somewhere you cannot remember.

Spaidoo gives you one library instead. Save a product or a shop with one tap and it lands next to everything else you like. And it is yours, not the shop's.

BROWSE AND SAVE WITHOUT LEAVING THE APP
• Open any shop inside Spaidoo. The bar with the heart is always at the bottom.
• On a product page, the heart saves the product with its name, photo and price. Anywhere else in the shop, it saves the shop.
• You buy as usual: the cart and the checkout are the shop's own.

ORGANIZE IT YOUR WAY
• Lists for anything: a trip, a present, the new home.
• Keep them to yourself or share them with a link.
• In a ListIx your friends add products too, and you all vote for your favorite.
• When you save, pick the list it goes to, or create a new one right there.

FIND SHOPS AND PRODUCTS
• One search that looks into every shop at once.
• Discover the shops people save the most, by category.
• Follow what your shops post on the Board.

ALWAYS WITH YOU
• Your library is the same on your iPhone and on my.spaidoo.com on your computer.
• Start without an account and create one whenever you want, with your email, with Apple or with Google.
• Notifications from the shops and lists you care about, only if you turn them on.

Spaidoo is free to save and organize everything you like.

Terms: https://www.spaidoo.com/en/legal/terms
Privacy: https://www.spaidoo.com/en/legal/privacy

name: Spectre – Analyseur audio
description:
Vous vous souvenez des chaînes Hi-Fi d'autrefois, et de leurs égaliseurs dont les LED montaient et descendaient avec la musique ? Spectre les fait revivre.

Lancez de la musique, chantez, jouez d'un instrument : Spectre écoute par le micro et dessine en temps réel le spectre du son, des basses à gauche aux aigus à droite. Chaque bande est une capsule lumineuse qui s'élève avec le volume, puis retombe en douceur.

DES COULEURS À CHOISIR
• Plusieurs palettes : Spectre, Mimosa, Océan, Aurore…
• Apparence claire, sombre ou automatique.

POUR LES CURIEUX
• Les fréquences affichées sous les barres.
• Les niveaux en décibels au-dessus, à titre indicatif.

SUR MAC, EN PLUS
• Le mode Bureau : Spectre se pose sur votre bureau, derrière vos fenêtres, sur tous les espaces, et laisse passer les clics.
• De 3 à 48 barres, au sol ou en symétrie verticale, avec ou sans reflet.
• Les palettes Perle et Perle miroir.
• La transparence des barres et du fond, réglable : à 0 %, le fond disparaît.

RESPECT DE VOTRE VIE PRIVÉE
Le son est analysé sur votre appareil, en temps réel, uniquement pour dessiner le spectre. Rien n'est enregistré, rien n'est envoyé. Pas de compte, pas de publicité, pas de suivi.

Spectre est né d'un rêve d'enfant : celui d'un gamin fasciné par les LED des égaliseurs. J'espère qu'il vous plaira autant qu'à moi.

name: Spin the Spoon
description:
Dinner, decided.

Tap the spoon and the reels land on a dish, a cuisine and a twist. Spin the Spoon shows three recipes you can cook tonight, so "what do you want for dinner?" ends in seconds.

• One-tap spin: three real recipes every time
• Shop ingredients: send the grocery list to Instacart in one tap
• Ingredient scanner: snap your fridge and get recipes from what you have
• Daily Spin: one optional dinnertime nudge a day, never more
• Share recipe cards with friends and family
• Save favorites and keep a pantry so recipes use what's on hand

No account needed to spin. Free, no ads, no subscriptions.

name: Spin: Shared Laundry
description:
Spin is a shared laundry schedule for people who live together.

Open it and you know straight away: is the washer free, who is using it, and how long is left. Start a load in one tap, or book a slot for later.

SEE IT AT A GLANCE
• A live countdown for the load in the machine
• A day timeline with everyone's loads and bookings, one colour per person
• Works with several machines: washers, dryers, and washer-dryers that show whether they are washing or drying

BOOK WITHOUT THE BACK-AND-FORTH
• Start a load now, or book a slot for later
• Drag a booking to move it, pull its edge to make it longer or shorter
• Spin warns you before you clash with someone else

NEVER FORGET A LOAD
• Alerts when your load is nearly done and when it finishes
• A countdown on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Tap "Taken out" from the Lock Screen, without opening the app
• Get told when someone else's load finishes, so you know the machine is free

MADE FOR SHARED HOMES
• No sign-up, no email, no password
• Invite people with a six-character code; someone already in the household lets them in
• Remove someone who moved out, or change the code, in two taps

Spin is free. No ads, no tracking.

name: Spirit Box: Soul Board
description:
Spirit Box: Soul Board is a candle-lit séance game for spooky nights with friends. Light three candles, rest a finger on the planchette and ask your question: the planchette glides across an antique talking board and spells the answer letter by letter.

Easy to start and hard to forget, it turns sleepovers, Halloween parties and ghost-story evenings into a ritual everyone talks about the next day.

A Real Séance Ritual
• Light the candles to open the séance
• Keep your finger on the planchette; lift it and the connection weakens
• End every séance with GOODBYE, or the spirit may linger

Answers That Fit Your Question
• Ask "where" and it points to a place
• Ask "how many" and it moves to a number
• Ask "who" and it names a stranger, a traveler, the keeper
• Yes or no, when or why: short, cryptic replies that keep the room guessing

Scares You Can Feel
• A candle goes out in a draft, and a whisper follows
• The planchette drifts when nobody touches it
• Restless spirits spell backwards, more often after midnight
• Pick Calm, Eerie or Terrifying to set the mood for your group

A Spirit That Remembers
• Ask its name, its age or where it lived: it keeps the same story all night

Your Language, Your Alphabet
• 34 languages, each printed in its own script: Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Japanese kana, Korean Hangul, and a writing ring for Chinese, Thai, Hindi and Bengali

Four Spirit Boards
• Classic Walnut, Bone, Pencil Sketch and Victorian Gold, each with its own planchette, flickering candlelight, real wood sounds and eerie ambient music

Share the Night
• Every séance is saved on your phone; share any of them as text or as an image card

One Price, Private by Design
• No ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases, no account
• Sessions stay on your device, and questions sent to find a reply are never stored

For Entertainment Only
What the board spells is yours to interpret. Best played in the dark, candles lit, door closed.

Made for Halloween parties, sleepovers, horror fans, paranormal fans and anyone curious about the classic spirit board.

name: Sprout: Habit & Mood Tracker
description:
Sprout is a simple, private habit tracker. Check off your habits, log how you feel and focus with a built-in timer, all in one calm app.

    There's no account to create and no ads. Everything you enter stays on your device.

    HABITS
    • Yes/no habits or counts, like 8 glasses of water or 10 pages
    • Every day, weekdays, weekends or only the days you choose
    • One tap to check off. Long-press a count to set it exactly
    • Starter habits to get going in seconds: drink water, read, walk, meditate, pray on time, work out and more

    STREAKS AND HISTORY
    • Current and best streak for every habit
    • A 12-month heatmap and a monthly calendar
    • Tap any past day to fix a missed check-in

    MOOD
    • Log your day with five moods, tags and a short note
    • See your month at a glance on the mood calendar
    • Mood boosters show which habits line up with your better days

    FOCUS
    • Pomodoro-style timer with 15, 25, 45 or 60-minute sessions and short breaks
    • Label what you're working on. Finished sessions count toward your Insights

    INSIGHTS
    • Completion for the last 7 days, perfect days and focus time
    • A streak board for all your habits

    MAKE IT YOURS
    • Light and dark mode and 10 accent colours
    • Start your week on Saturday, Sunday or Monday
    • Copy a backup of your data and restore it on another device

    PRIVATE BY DESIGN
    Sprout has no sign-up, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. It doesn't collect any data. Your habits, moods and notes are stored only on your device.

name: Spudz: The Boring Social App
description:
Spudz is the boring social media: a small, private place for your spud buds, the friends you've met in real life. Mash phones together when you're in the same place to connect, then share photo updates, messages, voice notes, plans, and yearbook-style notes with your circle. Find places to hang nearby, see where friends like to go, and save a plan to your calendar.

No algorithm, no influencers, no ads, no public follower counts, and no purchases. Just your people.

name: Squish Paint: Fold & Print Art
description:
Remember fold-and-print painting from art class? Squish Paint brings decalcomania to your iPhone. Drop blobs of paint on the paper, fold it in half, rub the back, and open it. The paint squishes, spreads and mixes with its neighbors into a pattern that is the same on both sides. No real paint, no mess.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Pick a color and touch the paper to drop a blob of paint. Hold to make it bigger, or drag to leave a trail
2. Tap Fold to fold the paper in half
3. Rub the back of the folded paper. The paint spreads more where you rub
4. Tap Open to find the same pattern on both sides of the crease

LIKE THE REAL THING
• Overlapping colors mix (yellow + blue = green)
• Paint gathers along the crease and gets darker
• Squished paint shows fine veins, uneven patches and tiny holes where the paper shows through
• After opening, add more paint and fold again to layer
• Eight colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink and black

ON A FOLDABLE IPHONE
On iPhone Duo, the crease of the paper sits on the fold of the phone. Drop your paint, then really close the phone. The outer display becomes the back of the paper, so rub it, open the phone, and your print is there. Folding the paper and folding the phone become one motion. On regular iPhones, the Fold and Open buttons play the same way.

A TITLE, A SCORE AND AN IMPRESSION
On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, each picture is looked at as a work of art and gets a title, a score and a short impression. It runs entirely on your iPhone, so your picture is never sent anywhere. On other iPhones, the picture is simply kept.

YOUR ARTWORKS ARE KEPT
Finished pictures are kept with their scores and impressions. Look back at them later, share the picture, score and impression as one image, or save the picture to Photos.

FOR LITTLE KIDS AND GROWN-UPS
• Touch to drop paint, fold, open. There is no way to get it wrong
• Short words, and colors are picked from paint pots
• Undo takes back the last stroke
• Just as satisfying for adults making patterns alone

MADE TO BE SAFE
• One-time purchase with no ads and no in-app purchases
• No login and no account
• Your pictures stay on your iPhone and are never sent to the developer
• Available in English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese

name: SquishX Rivali
description:
Take a corner, find room to pass, and collect gems along the way. In SquishX Rivali, the music changes as you drive.

Race against rivals or get to know the circuit in free drive. Switch between a chase view, a hood view, and a bumper view to get closer to the road.

Choose how you drive. Tilt your iPhone or use touch controls, switch between right- and left-handed layouts, and choose standard or inverted steering.

name: StaffLink
description:
StaffLink este o platformă pentru gestionarea turelor temporare și conectarea companiilor cu lucrătorii disponibili din Moldova.

Aplicația oferă funcționalități separate pentru companii și lucrători.

Pentru lucrători

Lucrătorii își pot crea un cont, completa profilul personal și transmite datele pentru verificare. După aprobarea contului, utilizatorul poate consulta turele disponibile, vizualiza informațiile despre fiecare tură și aplica direct din aplicație.

Pentru fiecare tură pot fi consultate informații precum locația, perioada, programul de lucru, cerințele, responsabilitățile și alte detalii relevante.

Lucrătorul poate urmări statusul aplicațiilor transmise. Dacă este selectat pentru o tură, acesta primește o notificare și poate confirma sau refuza participarea în termenul stabilit.

Turele confirmate sunt disponibile în secțiunea personală a utilizatorului.

Pentru companii

Companiile își pot crea un cont și completa informațiile necesare pentru verificare. După aprobarea contului, compania poate crea solicitări pentru personal și le poate transmite spre verificare.

Compania poate urmări statusul solicitărilor, numărul de persoane necesare, numărul de lucrători confirmați și numărul de locuri rămase disponibile.

După formarea echipei, compania poate consulta lista lucrătorilor confirmați și eventualele înlocuiri efectuate.

Gestionarea turelor

Solicitările create de companii sunt verificate înainte de publicare. Lucrătorii pot aplica doar la turele disponibile.

Selectarea lucrătorilor și confirmarea participării sunt gestionate printr-un proces transparent, cu actualizarea statusurilor și notificări pentru acțiunile importante.

După finalizarea unei ture, compania și lucrătorul pot transmite feedback în cadrul platformei.

StaffLink simplifică gestionarea personalului temporar și oferă companiilor și lucrătorilor un proces clar pentru organizarea și participarea la ture.

name: Stagelyre
description:
Stagelyre keeps your chord charts, setlists and gig history in one place, and turns your iPhone into a hands-free music stand when it's time to play.

CHORD CHARTS THAT LINE UP
Type lyrics with chords in brackets, like [G]Salt on the [D]window. Stagelyre sets every chord in green right above the syllable it belongs to, with section labels for verses and choruses. Each song keeps its key, tempo, capo and running time, and the editor offers one-tap chord buttons for the song's key.

TRANSPOSE IN ONE TAP
Move any chart up or down by semitones and choose sharps or flats. The sounding key updates as you go, and the setting is saved with the song so stage mode plays it the way you rehearsed it.

BUILD THE SET, SEE THE CLOCK
Book a gig with its venue, date and notes. Pick songs for it, touch and hold to drag them into order, and drop in set breaks. The set clock adds up every minute, both for the whole night and for each set.

STAGE MODE
One song fills the landscape screen in big type. After a short count-in it scrolls by itself at a pace worked out from the song's length. Tap to hold, nudge the speed up or down, and swipe for the next song. Breaks show you what's coming in the next set.

GIG HISTORY
At the end of the set, log the gig and it moves into your history with the songs you actually reached. You can still tick or untick songs afterwards.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR WAY
Sign in with Apple or with email and password, or tap "Soundcheck first" to use the app as a guest. Guests can link an email or Apple ID later from AMP without losing anything. Your library syncs through your private account and still works offline. AMP > Delete account erases all your songs, gigs and setlists and removes your login.

MADE FOR THE STAGE
Pink and green LEDs on amp-black tolex, a guitar headstock for navigation, and small plucked-string sounds and haptics you can switch off. Eight original example songs are included so you can try every feature straight away.

No ads. No tracking. No subscriptions.

name: StagePatch: Stage & Input Plan
description:
Give your venue and sound engineer one readable stage plan with its input patch. StagePatch combines numbered musician positions, technical requirements and linked audio inputs in an offline native workspace.

Place the band
• Create a stage from 1–100 metres wide/deep.
• Add up to 40 named stations with instrument category, numeric X/Y position and rotation.
• Specify monitor mix, power outlet request and station notes.
• View from the audience, with upstage clearly labelled.

Build the input patch
• Add up to 64 inputs, sorted by channel number.
• Link each input to a station or leave it explicitly unassigned.
• Describe source, Mic/DI/Line, microphone/DI model, 48V request and notes.
• See duplicate channel warnings before sharing.
• Removing a station preserves its inputs as unassigned.

Send a complete advance
• PDF includes a white stage diagram, sorted input patch, station details and all notes, with pagination.
• Export UTF-8 CSV for the input list.
• Duplicate a plan independently for another show.

Planning scope
