Station symbols are schematic, not measured equipment footprints. Coordinates are percentages from the audience-left/upstage corner. Stage dimensions control the outline ratio. The app does not assess safety, clearance or electrical load. Confirm phantom power and every requirement with your engineer. No audio playback, mixer/MIDI control or live collaboration.

Local and private
No account, advertising, analytics, tracking, developer server, subscription or in-app purchase. Paid download includes all current features. English and Simplified Chinese follow system language. Native iPhone and iPad layout, light/dark appearance and Dynamic Type. Export a complete JSON backup; restore validates and previews before confirming full-library replacement, retaining a pre-restore sandbox copy. Maximum 100 saved records and 10 MB backups. Files you intentionally export follow your chosen provider’s policy.

name: Stampd Business
description:
Stampd Business is the counter app for shops on Stampd, the loyalty app for The Bahamas.

Your customers carry your loyalty card in the Stampd app. You run it from here.

STAMP IN SECONDS
Ask for the customer's 6-digit PIN, tap it in, done. New customers join your loyalty program on their first stamp.

REWARDS
See when a customer has earned a reward and redeem it at the counter.

GIFT CARDS
Sell digital gift cards and take money off them when they're used. No plastic, no printing.

KNOW YOUR REGULARS
See who's on your loyalty program, who's close to a reward, and who hasn't been in for a while.

YOUR TEAM
Invite staff with a link. They stamp from their own phone, and every stamp shows who gave it.

SPECIALS
Post a sale or deal and your customers hear about it first.

Stampd Business is for shops that already have a Stampd account. To set up your shop, visit stampdbahamas.com.

name: STANDORA
description:
STANDORA is a visitor-lead capture app built for exhibitions, trade shows and business events.

• Scan a business card or add visitor details in seconds
• Rate every lead as Hot, Warm or Cold and set follow-up reminders
• Show your company profile and brochure through QR codes
• Manage your company, events and branch offices
• Export leads to Excel or share them with your team
• Works fully offline; your data stays on your device
• Available in 14 languages, with light and dark modes

No account required. Your leads are never sent to any server.

name: Star siege
description:
STAR SIEGE — THE LAST LINE OF DEFENCE

One blaster. An invading army. A galaxy worth defending.

The Dominion has launched its assault, and the survival of your outpost rests in your hands.

Star Siege is an immersive first-person sci-fi survival shooter combining fast-paced combat, strategic base defence and epic boss encounters.

SURVIVE THE ONSLAUGHT

Battle increasingly difficult waves of enemy troopers, deadly droids, airborne attackers and heavily armoured shieldbearers. Manage your blaster heat, protect your shield generator and stand your ground.

BUILD YOUR DEFENCES

Earn credits in battle and spend them in the Armoury. Upgrade your blaster, improve your shields and construct powerful Blaster, Rocket and Flak turrets to defend your outpost.

EXPLORE THREE BATTLEFIELDS

• Kryos Outpost — A frozen frontier.
• Dune Canyon — A hostile desert landscape.
• Endra Forest Moon — A dangerous forest world.

FACE LEGENDARY BOSSES

Challenge four formidable enemies, each equipped with unique abilities and devastating attacks.

• Lord Vexar
• GOR-7 Siege Walker
• Warden Kryll
• Huntress Syla

PROVE YOURSELF

• Three difficulty levels: Recruit, Veteran and Legend.
• Daily missions and streak rewards.
• Weekly battlefield challenges.
• High scores and leaderboards.
• Strategic upgrades and increasingly challenging enemy waves.

How long can you withstand the Dominion assault?

DEFEND. FIGHT. SURVIVE.

Welcome to Star Siege.

name: Starfloat
description:
Let a little balloon carry you into a sky full of sunshine.

Starfloat is a cheerful 3D toy physics game. Stretch your spring, aim a glowing star ball and watch colorful cloud towers wobble, bounce and tumble. Bring every golden star parcel home before your basket runs out of shots.

A LITTLE SPRING, LOTS OF POSSIBILITIES
Find a low seam for a chain tumble, try a gentle touch beside a sleeping moon, or turn the camera to uncover parcels hiding behind the front row. Golden trajectory dots help you read gravity and the breeze.

YOUR OWN CLOUD ADVENTURE
Explore five floating islands and thirty reproducible pocket skies. Sunshine steps, butterfly stacks, cloud courtyards and playful zigzags give each flight a different shape. Heavy anchors, spring pods, protected moon parcels and crosswinds add new tricks along the way.

A BASKET THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Earn ribbons for homecoming, spring saving and careful cargo. Build three different launchers, choose a little breeze gift for your next flight, gather constellations and keep a postcard of your balloon.

QUIET MOMENTS, MADE YOUR WAY
Practice in Flight School, study your launches in the Spring Notebook, or experiment freely in the Arc Laboratory. Choose gentle haptics, music volume, larger text, reduced motion and an optional golden aim trail.

EVERYTHING LIVES IN YOUR LITTLE SKY
Enjoy a local date-seeded weather flight and your own records. No ads, purchases, accounts, tracking or online competition. 

Take your time. Stretch a little spring. Bring the sunshine home.

name: StarPoint: Padel Score
description:
StarPoint is the simple padel scorekeeper for iPhone and Apple Watch. Tap the team that won the point and StarPoint keeps the score by the rules, so you can focus on the game.

BUILT FOR THE NEW RULES
• Star Point (FIP 2026): advantage up to two times, then the next point decides the game
• Golden point (punto de oro) and classic advantage
• Tiebreak at 6-6, and an optional super tiebreak to 10 as the deciding set

MADE FOR THE COURT
• Apple Watch app that works without your iPhone
• Stays on screen for the whole match and saves it to Health as a workout
• Shows who serves, including the tiebreak serve rotation
• Tells you when to change ends
• Big buttons and haptic feedback
• Unlimited undo
• The match is saved after every point

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your devices.

name: Steep Count
description:
Steep Count là sổ pha trà gongfu dành cho những người yêu trà, thích khám phá từng nước pha và muốn hiểu rõ hơn về từng loại trà trong bộ sưu tập của mình.

Không chỉ là đồng hồ đếm giờ, Steep Count giúp bạn lưu lại toàn bộ hành trình của một buổi pha trà, từ lượng lá, nhiệt độ nước đến thời gian và điểm đánh giá của từng nước.

QUẢN LÝ KHO TRÀ
- Lưu tên trà, loại trà, năm thu hoạch hoặc sản xuất, khối lượng mua và ghi chú riêng.
- Theo dõi lượng trà còn lại theo gram sau mỗi buổi pha.
- Quản lý nhiều loại trà trong cùng một thư viện cá nhân.
- Lọc trà theo từng loại và xem nhanh lượng trà còn lại.

GHI CHÉP BUỔI PHA
- Chọn loại trà từ kho cá nhân.
- Nhập lượng lá trà, dung tích ấm và nhiệt độ nước.
- Ghi lại từng nước pha với thời gian riêng biệt.
- Sử dụng đồng hồ tích hợp để theo dõi thời gian pha hoặc nhập thời gian thủ công.
- Chấm điểm từng nước theo thang điểm từ 1 đến 5.
- Chỉnh sửa hoặc xoá buổi pha khi cần thiết.

KHÁM PHÁ NƯỚC TRÀ NGON NHẤT
- Xem biểu đồ điểm trung bình theo thứ tự nước của từng loại trà.
- Xác định nước pha có điểm cao nhất.
- Biết một loại trà thường giữ được bao nhiêu nước.
- Tìm tỷ lệ lá và nước phù hợp nhất dựa trên điểm đánh giá.
- So sánh trải nghiệm giữa các buổi pha khác nhau.

THEO DÕI KHO TRÀ VÀ CHI PHÍ
- Tự động trừ lượng gram trà sau mỗi buổi pha.
- Tính chi phí trung bình cho mỗi buổi và mỗi nước.
- Dự báo ngày hết trà dựa trên tốc độ sử dụng trong 30 ngày gần nhất.
- Nhận biết những loại trà sắp hết để chủ động bổ sung.

THỐNG KÊ VÀ XUẤT DỮ LIỆU
- Theo dõi số buổi pha mỗi tuần trong 8 tuần gần nhất.
- Xếp hạng các loại trà theo điểm đánh giá và chi phí sử dụng.
- Xem tổng lượng trà đã sử dụng theo từng loại.
- Xuất dữ liệu dưới định dạng CSV để lưu trữ và phân tích.

CÁ NHÂN HOÁ TRẢI NGHIỆM
- Tuỳ chỉnh đơn vị tiền tệ.
- Chọn đơn vị nhiệt độ Celsius hoặc Fahrenheit.
- Tuỳ chỉnh ngày bắt đầu tuần.
- Chọn giao diện sáng hoặc tối.
- Xoá toàn bộ dữ liệu cá nhân khi cần thiết.

RIÊNG TƯ VÀ NGOẠI TUYẾN
Steep Count không yêu cầu tài khoản hoặc đăng nhập. Toàn bộ dữ liệu được lưu trực tiếp trên thiết bị. Bạn có thể sử dụng các tính năng của ứng dụng mà không cần kết nối Internet.

Mỗi loại trà có một câu chuyện. Mỗi nước pha có một hương vị. Hãy để Steep Count giúp bạn ghi nhớ và khám phá tất cả.

name: SteepAtlas
description:
Make room for a better cup with SteepAtlas, a personal tea shelf, infusion timer and tasting journal.

• Keep tea recipes with origin, leaf weight, water volume and temperature.
• Search your shelf and filter by tea category.
• Pause and resume your timer, restore an active brew after reopening, and tune each next infusion.
• Save ratings, flavor impressions and tasting notes; revisit and edit your journal.
• See your tea spectrum, seven-day rhythm and water used in saved infusions.
• Export a JSON backup, validate and restore a backup, or erase local data.

Free, with no account, ads or analytics. Your journal stays on your iPhone until you choose to export it. Editable examples help you begin. The timer has no background alarm; return to the app to check your brew. Handle hot water with care.

name: Steepwise
description:
Brew better tea, one steep at a time — and remember every cup.

Steepwise is a calm companion for loose-leaf tea. It guides each infusion with a steep timer, keeps a journal of what you tasted, tracks the teas in your caddy, and plays gentle soundscapes while you brew.

GUIDED STEEPS
• Pick a tea and a vessel (gaiwan, clay pot, glass pot or mug) and get suggested leaf, water, temperature and a full steep schedule.
• A big ring timer counts down each infusion and rings a soft bell when it's time to pour.
• Pour early, add or remove 5 seconds, or adjust the plan mid-session.

TASTE EVERY CUP
Tag each steep with what you taste — floral, honey, roasty, mineral and more — and add a short note. Rate the session with one to five leaves.

A JOURNAL THAT REMEMBERS
• Every saved session keeps its leaf, water, temperature, ratio, steep times and tasting notes.
• Attach your own photos of the leaves, liquor or tea table (optional).
• Search by tea, style, flavor or notes, and brew any session again with the same settings.
• See sessions this month, leaf brewed, your daily streak, favorite styles and the flavors you notice most.
• Share a tasting card or save it to Photos.

YOUR TEA CADDY
Keep the teas you own with origin, vendor and harvest year. Steepwise takes brewed leaf out of the caddy so you know when a tea is running low.

SOUNDSCAPES
Rain on the eaves, kettle simmer, bamboo stream, mountain wind, hearth embers and wind chimes — generated live on your iPhone. Choose a blend, mix the layers and set a fade-out timer. Sound keeps playing when your iPhone is locked.

INTRO FILM
Watch "Tea in Five Breaths", a 70-second guide to better brewing, and cast it to an Apple TV or AirPlay TV.

TEA TABLE
Brewing for friends? Open a Tea Table and share the 4-digit code. Guests on the same Wi-Fi see your steep timer live and send back what they taste in each cup.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account or login. No ads, no analytics. Your teas, sessions and photos stay on your iPhone.

name: StockCut: Length Cut Planner
description:
Plan straight cuts for wood, tube and other linear stock—right at the bench, even without a connection.

StockCut turns finite stock lengths and required pieces into a numbered cutting plan. Account for blade kerf and trim at both ends, use suitable offcuts before opening new stock, and see every piece that could not be placed.

BUILD YOUR LIST
• One material and cross-section per project.
• Multiple stock lengths with quantities and reusable-offcut labels.
• Required finished lengths and quantities.
• Millimetres or inches, with decimal and fractional entry such as 12 3/8.
• Switching units converts saved lengths.

WORK THROUGH THE CUTS
• Proportional stock diagrams and numbered pieces.
• A visible placed/requested count and separate unplaced list.
• Remaining length and kerf loss on each opened stock.
• Check off individual cuts; progress survives closing the app.
• Changing cutting inputs asks before clearing existing checkmarks.

TAKE THE PLAN WITH YOU
• Share a PDF containing inputs, stock diagrams, cut checklists and unplaced pieces.
• Export the full project library as JSON.
• Restore a validated backup after a preview and replacement confirmation.

OFFLINE BY DESIGN
No account, ads, analytics, developer cloud, subscription or in-app purchase. The paid download includes all current tools. Projects remain on your device until you choose to export or share. English and Simplified Chinese; iPhone and iPad; light/dark appearance and Dynamic Type.

PLEASE CHECK THE SCOPE
StockCut uses a fast best-fit heuristic. It does not guarantee the fewest stock lengths or minimum waste. Open stock is filled first; when more stock is needed, suitable offcuts have priority. Every non-terminal piece reserves a full kerf; an exact end fit reserves none. Each end loses the configured trim, including offcuts. Inputs round to 0.001 mm; inches display up to 5 decimals. Verify actual measurements and blade width before cutting.

Straight 1D lengths only. No sheet nesting, mitres, joint allowances, grain/defect matching, structural calculations or machine control. Remaining stock may be too short to reuse. Limits: 100 projects; per project, 100 stock rows and 100 piece rows, 200 stock lengths and 400 pieces. JSON backups up to 10 MB. PDF is a snapshot, not live collaboration.

name: Strike Radar: Paris Plan B
description:
Paris is wonderful - until your metro line is on strike, your station is closed or the queue at the Louvre wraps around the Pyramid. Strike Radar keeps your trip on track.

LIVE RADAR • Live metro, RER, train and tram disruptions from Île-de-France Mobilités open data, refreshed every 10 minutes • Lines shown in their official colours, right on the stations that are closed or not served • Social Weather: green, orange or red at a glance

PLAN B • Search a landmark (Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Sainte-Chapelle…) • If it is disrupted, get a calm alternative nearby with time saved and one-tap directions • Track your Plan B on the map until you arrive

ONE-TAP REPORTS • Station closed, 2h+ queue, protest or hidden gem — share it with other travelers in one tap • Pick the nearest station automatically, no typing needed • Anonymous: no sign-up, no ads, no tracking

WHAT'S ON •  hundreds of exhibitions, concerts, shows and markets around you — with a live warning when a strike hits the venue.

PASSPORT • Earn badges as you dodge strikes and use Plan Bs • Share your Survival Card to your Stories

Strike Radar is an independent app and is not affiliated with RATP, SNCF or Île-de-France Mobilités. Always check official sources before travelling.

name: Su Me Do
description:
Su Me Do is a salon of number games: complete Sudoku, complete Kakuro and a preview table of Dokusu, all dressed in Art Deco black and brass.

Take a seat at any table. Every puzzle is dealt fresh, your game in progress is kept for you, and the house keeps a ledger of what you have solved and your best times.

SUDOKU
The classic nine-by-nine, in four difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert. Pencil in notes, erase, undo, or ask for a hint when a square will not give. Mistakes are marked in ruby and counted, or switch that off and play unassisted.

KAKURO
Crossed sums in three sizes: Petite (5×5), Classic (7×7) and Grand (9×9). Fill each run to its total without repeating a digit. The run you are working on shows its total as you play, and broken sums are flagged. Any fill that obeys the rules counts as solved.

DOKUSU PREVIEW
Not a puzzle but a duel. Place a higher tile beside a rival's tile and capture it. Play one short 18-square game against the Maestro, a house opponent that adjusts to how you play. The full game, Dokusu: The Grand Salon Edition, is a separate app.

HOUSE RULES
- Show or hide mistakes
- Show or hide the timer
- Haptics on or off
- A ledger of puzzles solved and best times for every level

MADE TO BE QUIET
- No ads
- No accounts or sign-in
- No in-app purchases
- Your games and records stay on your device
- Designed for both iPhone and iPad

More tables are being set. Pull up a chair.

name: Sumi – Eki Stamps
description:
Almost every train station in Japan has its own rubber stamp – a little piece of art waiting for you there. Sumi helps you find them, collect them and keep them in a beautiful digital stamp book.

FIND STAMPS
• A map with hundreds of official stamp spots from JR (Japan Railways) East and West, Seibu, Keihan, Odakyu and more
• Where exactly in the station the stamp is – confirmed by fellow collectors
• Search by station, line or city, in your language

STAMP RADAR
• A gentle notification when you’re close to a stamp you haven’t collected yet
• Works in the background – your location stays on your phone

YOUR STAMP BOOK
• Organised city by city or by metro and rail line, from north to south
• Mark stamps as collected and keep photos of your own imprints
• Levels, badges and progress for every city and line
• Pin the places you’re visiting to the top

MADE FOR TRAVELLERS
• Station, line and city names in 11 languages
• Japanese phrases read aloud – ask the staff where the stamp is
• Stamp etiquette tips and ready-made stamp tours

COMMUNITY
• Report new stamps and confirm whether a stamp is still there
• Share photos of stamp spots – reviewed by our team before they go public
• Share your progress as a pretty card

Sumi is an independent app and not affiliated with JR (Japan Railways) or any other railway company. Stamp designs belong to the railway companies; Sumi shows its own illustrations.

name: Sundice
description:
Sundice is een dobbeltafel voor de keukentafel, de trein en de laatste ronde.

Gooi vier tot twintigzijdige stenen, één tot zes tegelijk. Schud de telefoon of tik op Gooien. Bovenin staat elke dag een andere worp met drie pogingen.

Spellen:
• Varken — één steen, doel 50, 100 of 150. Alleen, tegen de tafel, of samen.
• Tienduizend — zes stenen, doel 10.000. Kies wat telt en zet vast.
• Vijfstenen — vijf stenen, dertien vakken, drie worpen per beurt.

Het blok slaat avonden en eindstanden op. Eigen tellingen voor andere spellen kan ook. In de kast staan statistieken, geluid, trillen en de volledige spelregels.

Gratis. iOS 15 of hoger. Alleen staand op iPhone.

name: Sunny Puzzle Garden
description:
SUNNY PUZZLE GARDEN
————————
A bright glasshouse full of short, cheerful puzzles.
﻿
﻿
• Ink & Cream — a sunny disc-flipping board where you outflank the other color
• Crate Nook — push fruit crates onto mint rugs, one nudge at a time
• Sunburst Match — swap neighboring tiles and burst lines of three
﻿
AROUND THE GROVE
A spinning glass cloche on the front step, story pages in the Chronicle, companions to invite along, and Field Notes for petal tallies. Thirty panes, star ratings, and a warm skylight mood.
﻿
Settle in when you want a bright puzzle without a gloomy corridor.

name: Sunset Lasso
description:
Lähde kulkemaan hämärän hehkuville poluille lempeässä, tarinavetoisessa vuoropohjaisessa seikkailussa.

Heitä valoköysi jokaisella vuorolla, tarkkaile vastustajien aikeita ja valitse sopiva köysitaito. Seuraa, kuinka taistelun tilanne muuttuu vastustajien kestävyyden heikentyessä. Vedä vastustajia lähemmäs, yhdistä vierekkäisiin kohteisiin osuvia liikkeitä, heikennä suojausta tai käytä pelastusköyttä vapauttaaksesi häkeissä olevia eläimiä.

Taistelujen välissä voit levähtää leirissä, valmistaa aterioita ja vahvistaa hattua, liiviä, köyttä ja merkkiä. Jatka matkaa karjatilojen, kanjonien, pensasaroiden, kaivosten, rautateiden ja ylänköjen halki. Vaihtelevat tehtävät kutsuvat selvittämään reittejä, pelastamaan eläimiä, saattamaan kulkijoita, puolustamaan alueita ja kohtaamaan vahvoja loppuvastustajia – kiirehtimättä.

Lämpimänsävyiset paperipaneelit, nahkaiset painikkeet ja auringonlaskun värittämät maisemat luovat viihtyisän lännen tunnelman. Seikkailu etenee rauhalliseen tahtiin ja palkitsee harkitut ratkaisut nopeiden napautusten sijaan.

name: Superhero Comic Books Tycoon
description:
Run a comic book publisher from 1933 to 2000.
Launch titles in thirteen genres as each one comes into fashion. Hire writers and artists, and decide what they are paid and what they get to keep. Answer to distributors, censors, conglomerates and the people who created your heroes.
Every year brings a decision taken from real comics history, told with invented names. More than a hundred events cover the newsstand years, the Comics Code, the comics shop and the collector boom.
Pixel art covers change with the decade. Rival publishers sell beside you. Lawsuits arrive whether you start them or not.
Based on the book Understanding Superhero Comic Books by Alex Grand. No ads, no purchases, no data collected. Plays offline.

name: Supomp: Pumps & Booster Sets
description:
Supomp is the mobile app of İkra Hidropomp's online store for pumps, pressure booster sets and water installation supplies in Türkiye. Browse thousands of products, order securely by card, request a quote for products without a listed price and message our support team from the app.

Product range
• Circulation, submersible, centrifugal, multistage and vertical pumps
• Domestic and building booster sets, pressure and expansion tanks
• Water filters and water treatment products
• Solar energy systems, electric motors, fans and blowers
• Caravan and boat pumps, pool equipment, magnetic radiator flushing machines
• Hardware and plumbing supplies, installation packages

Easy shopping
• Search by product, category or brand; filter and sort results
• Technical specifications, product photos, reviews and Q&A
• Favorites, cart and guest checkout
• Secure credit and debit card payments through the PayTR payment infrastructure, with installment options on credit cards
• Light, dark or system theme

Quotes
For products without a listed price, tap "Teklif Al" (Get a quote). We send your personal price through the support chat, and you can buy the quoted cart directly in the app. Depending on the quote, installment or down payment options may be offered.

Support chat
After signing in, you can message the Supomp support team from the app. Describe your question by sharing photos, videos, documents, voice messages or your location.

Order tracking and notifications
• Follow your order status and shipment tracking number in your account. Guest orders can be looked up with the order number and email address.
• Get a push notification when your order is being prepared, shipped or delivered, or when the support team replies to you. Choose which notifications you receive under Hesabım > Ayarlar > Bildirimler (Account > Settings > Notifications). The app does not send advertising or marketing notifications.

Business (B2B) accounts
Dealers, wholesalers and plumbing professionals can apply for a business account with their company details. Once approved, business prices are shown on the same account.

Permissions
Camera, microphone and location permissions are requested only when you use the related feature (taking a photo, recording a voice message, sending your location). The notification permission is requested when you turn on notifications. Your location is never collected in the background.

Account and privacy
You can delete your account at any time under Hesabım > Ayarlar > Hesabımı sil (Account > Settings > Delete my account).
Privacy policy: https://supomp.com/en/privacy/

Contact
Phone: +90 531 565 11 25
Email: ikrahidropomp@gmail.com
Web: https://supomp.com

name: Surveyor's Fieldbook
description:
Surveyor's Fieldbook is the field book for land surveying: site notes, instrument setups and a level book in one app, in place of the paper notebook. It's the independent record of what you did on site: how each height was measured, which instrument and prism you used, and what changed and when.

It's free, with no adverts, no account and no tracking, and it works with no signal: everything stays on your phone until you share it.

SITE NOTES
• Notes with photos from the in-app camera or your gallery, with the phone's position and its accuracy
• Text added on a later day is dated; photos are kept as taken
• Projects, shifts (date, start time, crew, conditions) and quick notes for when there's no project yet

SETUPS
• Total station: method (known point or resection), station, instrument height and how it was measured, backsight, foresights or resected points, each with its target, prism constant and target height
• GNSS base: RTK base or static, receiver, antenna height and what it was measured to, logging periods
• Laser scanner: scan position, scanner height, targets
• Level: BS, IS and FS staff readings in a levelling run, Next setup on the change point
• The job's control points and earlier stations offered as you type a point name

LEVEL BOOK AND TRAVERSES
• Book levelling runs as in a level book, reduced by rise and fall: reduced levels, the arithmetic check, and the misclosure against ± k·√n
• Apply the misclosure for corrected levels, with the readings kept as booked
• Traverses: stations in order, the control at each end, forced centring, and the closure as entered from your software

RECORDS YOU CAN TRUST
• Strike through, never erase: a corrected value stays visible, struck through with when it changed and why
• My instruments: your own instruments, prisms and staffs, from a built-in catalogue of models and prism constants
• Survey control per project, typed in or imported from CSV, kept exactly as given; open a point in your map app

REPORTS AND BACKUP
• PDF reports for a project, a shift, chosen notes, a setup, a traverse or a levelling run, with photos and the full change history
• Levelling to Excel or CSV
• Back up everything on the phone, or chosen projects, to one file, and restore it on another phone

In English, French and Spanish, in metric or imperial (international feet), with your region's date and number formats.

Made by a land surveyor, for surveyors. Questions and ideas: support@surveyor.dev

name: Survival OS Kit
seller_name: METAQUANTICS CONSULTORIA E TECNOLOGIA EMPRESARIAL LTDA
description:
Survival OS Kit helps you prepare, calmly, for what can happen where you live: heavy rain, power cuts, cold, heat, landslides, floods. After the first sync, what matters works in airplane mode.

PREPARE YOUR HOME
• Family plan: who to call, where to meet, who does what. It stays only on your phone, encrypted.
• Go bag and home kit lists made for your place, with expiry reminders.
• Agreements with your family and neighbours.

KNOW YOUR PLACE
• The app recognises your area (municipality and landscape) without sending your location to anyone: your exact position never leaves the phone.
• An offline library for your area, when the pack for your place is available. Safety content only appears with a source, an expert review and an expiry date.
• Alerts from official sources, always with the source and the time. The app never creates its own alerts.

OFFLINE TOOLS
• Compass, altimeter, flashlight and signals.
• Emergency service numbers for your country, with the source and a notice when they are not verified yet.

COMMUNITY (where available)
• Neighbourhood groups to share useful information, with a scam filter, reporting and blocking.

PRIVACY
• No ads and no tracking. Your household profile, family plan and health data never leave the phone.
• An account is only needed for the community. You can export or delete your data in the app.

IMPORTANT
Survival OS Kit is a preparedness guide. It is not an emergency service, it does not call for help and it does not replace civil defence, firefighters, police or medical care. If you are in danger, call your country's emergency number. Survival OS Kit is not a government app; alerts come from official agencies and show their source.

name: Swing Rush: Rooftop Trials
description:
Hold to grab a rope, then release to fly. Catch the next anchor while you are in range, and land from above to finish the course. Timing is everything.

Try 24 courses across four chapters. Earn Clean Line and Efficient Line medals, and unlock new colors with coins earned in play. Switch between the soft gel ball and the robot in Settings. Both use the same physics.

Play with one finger, pick a course from the stage list, or open How to Play from the home and pause menus. Progress and settings stay on your device.

name: Swyron Access
description:
Swyron Access is your key to the applications of Swyron GmbH, starting with Swissdigicard.

• Confirm sign-ins: A number appears in your browser. Tap the same number in the app and confirm with Face ID.
• Sign in without a password: Scan the QR code on the sign-in page and confirm with Face ID.
• Support only with your approval: If support wants to access your account, you see who it is, which case it concerns and how long access lasts. The support code helps you check on the phone.
• Sign-in codes: Swyron Access also creates the 6-digit codes for two-factor sign-in. A single scan sets up both.
• Protection against fraud: If you are on a call, the app reminds you not to share any details about the sign-in.

Built to be secure: The key is created in the security chip of your iPhone and never leaves it. Face ID is checked by the iPhone itself. No advertising, no analytics, no tracking.

Swyron Access works with an account at an application of Swyron GmbH. Without an account, the demo shows you how it works.

name: TactiBoard Atemschutz
description:
TactiBoard Atemschutz ist die Atemschutztafel aus der App "TactiBoard Einsatzleiter" als eigenständige kostenfreie App. Sie unterstützt die Atemschutzüberwachung an der Einsatzstelle.

• Verwalten von Trupps, Anschlusszeit, Druckkontrollen an Kontrollpunkten, Rückzug, NOTFALL und Trupp zurück.
• Rückzugsdruck nach FwDV 7.
• Prognose der Rückzugszeit aus den bisherigen Ablesungen, als grobe Orientierung.
• Fällige Kontrollen und Grenzwerte melden sich mit Ton, Ansage und Banner.
• Synchronisation zwischen allen Tablets der gleichen Organisation.
• Geräteträger lassen sich per NFC-Chip einchecken.
• automatische Dokumentation und Export als PDF-Bericht.
• Gerätetypen, Kontrollpunkte, Alarme und die Rückzugsregel pflegt die Wehr im Admin-Werkzeug im Browser.

WICHTIGER HINWEIS
Die App ist ein Hilfsmittel und entbindet nicht den Einsatzleiter zur Verantwortlichkeit gegenüber der eingesetzten Kräfte. Rechenwerte wie Rückzugsdruck und Prognose dienen der Orientierung.

name: TALADSIM
description:
TALADSIM (ตลาดซิม) แหล่งรวมเบอร์สวยและเบอร์มงคลจากร้านค้าในลาว ครบทุกเครือข่ายในแอปเดียว

ค้นหาเบอร์
- ค้นหาตามตัวเลขที่ชอบ ตำแหน่งตัวเลข เครือข่าย ราคา และผลรวม
- เบอร์มงคล เบอร์สวย เบอร์มงคลตามวันเกิด และกลุ่มตัวเลขยอดนิยม
- เปรียบเทียบราคาจากหลายร้านค้า

ทำนายเบอร์
- วิเคราะห์ความหมายของเบอร์ทีละคู่ตัวเลข ด้านบุคลิก การงาน การเงิน และความรัก
- ดูความหมายของคู่เลขทั้งหมด 00 ถึง 99

จองเบอร์
- จองเบอร์ที่ต้องการได้ทันทีในแอป ร้านค้าจะติดต่อกลับเพื่อยืนยัน
- วางมัดจำด้วยการสแกน QR ของร้าน แล้วส่งสลิปในแอป
- ติดต่อร้านค้าได้โดยตรงทางโทรศัพท์ WhatsApp หรือ Messenger

เครื่องมืออื่นๆ
- ตรวจเบอร์ว่าง: วางรายการเบอร์เพื่อเช็คว่าเบอร์ไหนยังว่าง
- แจ้งเตือนเมื่อมีเบอร์ตรงกับที่ต้องการ
- บันทึกเบอร์ที่ชอบ และขอให้ร้านค้าช่วยหาเบอร์
- รองรับภาษาลาว ไทย อังกฤษ เวียดนาม และจีน

แอปไม่มีการชำระเงินในแอป การโอนมัดจำทำผ่านแอปธนาคารของคุณโดยตรงกับร้านค้า

name: Talkjai
description:
Talkjai รวมติวเตอร์ภาษาอังกฤษสำหรับคนไทยทุกวัย ตั้งแต่เด็กเล็กจนถึงวัยทำงาน

• เลือกครูที่ชอบ ดูวิดีโอแนะนำตัว ราคา และรีวิว
• ทดลองเรียนก่อนตัดสินใจ
• เรียนสดตัวต่อตัวผ่านวิดีโอ พร้อมกระดานออนไลน์ที่เขียนด้วยกันได้
• กระดานทุกคาบถูกบันทึกไว้ ทบทวนได้ทุกเมื่อ
• จองเวลาเรียนเองได้ทุกสัปดาห์ เลื่อนคาบได้
• แพ็กเกจรายเดือน เลือกจำนวนคาบต่อสัปดาห์ได้เอง
• คำชมและความคืบหน้าจากครูหลังเรียนทุกคาบ

Talkjai connects Thai students of all ages with friendly English tutors for live one-on-one video lessons, with a shared whiteboard that is saved for review.

name: Talviro
description:
See what changed. Keep the whole story.

Talviro turns before-and-after photos into clear visual records. Compare two moments, mark the details, and create reports you can keep or share.

From a room renovation to a furniture repair, a product inspection or a design revision, bring your photos and observations together in one workspace.

COMPARE YOUR WAY
Reveal changes with a draggable split, blend two photos with an adjustable overlay, compare them side by side, or switch between before and after with a tap. Zoom and move both images together for a closer look.

ALIGN THE DETAILS
Adjust each photo's position, scale and rotation with precise controls and gestures. Use a reference grid, save your alignment, and inspect matching areas with synchronized detail views.

MARK WHAT MATTERS
Highlight changes with rectangles, circles, arrows, freehand strokes and text labels. Add numbered annotations, choose colors, and connect your observations to change notes.

KEEP EVERY CHAPTER
Build a timeline with dated photo versions and compare any two stages. Record what changed, add supporting photos, and track each note's status. Organize projects with categories, favorites, search and archives.

TURN PROGRESS INTO A REPORT
Create a PDF report with your chosen photos and change notes. Export comparison views and annotated images as PNG or JPEG, then share them through your device's sharing options.

START WITH A LITTLE STRUCTURE
Choose templates for renovations, repairs, product inspections, organization and design revisions, or start a general comparison project and make it your own.

WORK OFFLINE
No account required. No ads. Photo comparison, annotations, difference previews and report creation run on your device. Talviro does not upload your library. Export local backups and restore them when needed.

Difference previews help you find areas to inspect. Lighting, exposure and camera position can also produce visible differences.

Every change, beautifully clear.

name: Tamtam-event
description:
TAMTAM Event — vos billets, en un battement.

Découvrez et achetez vos billets pour les concerts, festivals, soirées, spectacles, conférences et événements en Côte d’Ivoire et en Afrique francophone. Une billetterie simple, sécurisée, pensée pour le Mobile Money.

POURQUOI TAMTAM EVENT ?
• Catalogue d’événements à jour, avec affiches et infos claires
• Achat en quelques minutes, depuis votre téléphone
• Paiement Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Wave ou carte
• Billet numérique avec QR Code sécurisé, toujours accessible dans l’app
• Rappels et suivi de vos sorties au même endroit

COMMENT ÇA MARCHE ?
1. Parcourez les événements près de chez vous ou par catégorie
2. Choisissez votre place et le nombre de billets
3. Payez avec le moyen qui vous convient
4. Retrouvez votre billet dans « Mes billets » et présentez le QR Code à l’entrée

FONCTIONNALITÉS
• Explorer par ville, date, catégorie (concerts, festivals, humour, soirées, galas…)
• Fiches événements détaillées : programme, lieu, organisateur, sponsors
• Événements « Bientôt » : soyez notifié à l’ouverture des ventes
• Boutique événementielle quand l’organisateur propose des produits
• Connexion sécurisée par SMS — sans mot de passe
• Mode invité pour découvrir le catalogue avant de créer un compte
• Apparence claire ou sombre selon votre préférence

POUR LES FANS DE SORTIES
Que vous cherchiez un concert live, une soirée coupé-décalé, un festival de quartier ou une conférence, TAMTAM Event rassemble les événements qui comptent — avec un parcours d’achat fluide et un billet toujours sous la main.

SUPPORT
Besoin d’aide ? Contactez-nous via l’application ou sur tamtamevent.com.

Conditions d’utilisation et politique de confidentialité disponibles dans l’app et sur le site.

name: Tangram Harbor
description:
Build a sailboat, a sitting cat, or a water bird from the same seven pieces. Tangram Harbor brings the classic tangram puzzle to iPhone and iPad with 30 designs to solve.

Start in Learn mode, where piece outlines show you how the shapes fit together. When you’re ready, try Challenge mode and work from the silhouette alone. Drag, rotate, and flip the pieces into place. Use a hint if you get stuck, or solve a Challenge puzzle without hints to earn a gold star.

In Free Play, arrange the seven pieces however you like. Export your creation as an image and share it. The in-app guide shows all 30 completed designs if you’d like a starting point.

Your progress and current board are saved on your device, so you can pick up where you left off. Play at your own pace with no timer. Tangram Harbor supports English and Greek, with adjustable music volume and System, Light, and Dark themes.

name: Tanlovim для сада
description:
Tanlovim for kindergartens is the app for a kindergarten's staff — the head, the administrator, teachers, the nurse and the accountant. It is the same cabinet as crm.tanlovim.uz, on a phone.

• Children and groups: the child's card, documents, parents' contacts, transfers and leaving.
• The day: «Arrived» and «Left» in one tap, the morning check.
• Applications from parents in the Tanlovim catalogue, answered from the app.
• Attendance, the day's routine, posts for a group's parents.
• Payments: invoices, payments, reminders.
• Everyone sees only what the head allowed in «Roles and access».

Sign in with the phone number and password of a Tanlovim account. A new kindergarten can be registered right in the app.

name: Tardy Bus
description: The school bus is running late, and the morning bell won’t wait. Pick up the kids, dodge traffic, and race to school before time runs out!

name: TARS Remote
description:
TARS Remote is the phone companion to TARS, an open-source AI agent that runs on your own Mac or PC. TARS works through a task in stages (plan, build, review, pull request, merge) and stops at each gate until you answer. This app lets you answer from wherever you are.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Waiting: one list of everything that waits on you, across all your desktops.
• Approve or change a plan before any code is written.
• Decide each review finding: fix it or dismiss it. Ask a question about it first.
• Approve the pull request draft, then the merge, with the CI results in front of you.
• Answer a tool call that waits for permission.
• Ideas: write an idea down any time. It stays on your phone until you send it to a desktop as a task.

HOW IT CONNECTS
The app talks only to desktops you pair yourself, over your own private network (Tailscale). Pair by scanning a QR code shown by TARS on the desktop. There is no account and no cloud service in between: your code and your conversations never pass through anyone else's server.

TRY IT FIRST
No desktop set up yet? Tap "Try the demo desk" to walk through sample tasks inside the app. Nothing is sent anywhere.

REQUIREMENTS
To use it with your own work you need TARS running on a Mac or Windows PC (free, https://tars.marvin-42.com) and Tailscale on both the desktop and this phone.

name: Tearday: Tear-Off Calendar
description:
User guide: https://franky5440-afk.github.io/tearday-site/guide/

Tearday turns your iPhone into an old-fashioned tear-off desk calendar. Stand it on your desk, tear off one page a day, and see today's date, the lunar date and the solar term at a glance.

ONE PAGE A DAY
• Drag the page down to tear it off, with a paper sound and a tap you can feel.
• Today's page stays until tomorrow. Miss a few days and the old pages wait for you to tear them, one by one.

LUNAR DATES AND SOLAR TERMS
• Every page shows the lunar month and day and the zodiac year.
• The 24 solar terms are marked with a red stamp. On other days you see how many days are left until the next one.
• Sundays are printed in red and Saturdays in green, like a traditional paper calendar.

A MONTH AT A GLANCE
• Open the month view to see lunar dates and solar terms for the whole month.
• Tap any day for its full details.

MADE TO SIT ON A DESK
• Two paper styles: Classic Red and Ink Green.
• An optional daily reminder to tear today's page.
• On a foldable iPhone, the page and the month view are shown together when the phone is unfolded.

NOTHING ELSE
• No ads, no account, no subscription, no in-app purchases.
• Works without an internet connection.
• Collects no data. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Lunar dates follow the traditional Chinese lunisolar calendar, calculated for the Taipei time zone (UTC+8). Solar terms are included for 2026 through 2040. Tearday does not show public holidays, lucky days or fortunes.

name: TeLedger-Gate Flow Puzzle
description:
Tasapainota rannikon vesialtaiden ja puisten sulkuporttien muodostama verkosto.

Avaa ja sulje altaiden välisiä vesikanavia, seuraa vedenpinnan tasaantumista jokaisen vuoron aikana ja ohjaa kaikki altaat saavuttamaan omat tavoitetasonsa samanaikaisesti.

Suunnittele usean vaiheen sulkuaikatauluja, huomioi toisiinsa kytkeytyvät vesireitit ja tarkkaile ajastettuja mahdollisuuksia ennen seuraavaa siirtoa. Leveät ja kapeat altaat muuttavat vedenpintaansa eri tavoin, joten veden määrää on arvioitava huolellisesti.

Kuusi rannikkoaluetta ja 48 haastetta palkitsevat rauhallisen päättelykyvyn ja huolellisen suunnittelun. Tutki vesikirjaa, kehitä reittejäsi ja auta satamaa saavuttamaan tasainen vuorovesi.

name: Telefoncu: İkinci El Dükkanı
description:
Telefoncu, ikinci el telefon alım-satımı üzerine kurulu bir dükkan simülasyonu.

• İncele: Ekranı, bataryayı, IMEI kaydını, hesap kilidini kontrol et. Satıcı "hiç açılmadı" diyorsa doğru mu?
• Pazarlık et: Teklif ver, delil göster, gerekirse kalkıp git. Her satıcının kendi sabrı ve hileleri var.
• Tamir et: Atölyede orijinal ya da yan sanayi parça seç; risk ve kâr senin elinde.
• Sat: İlan aç, alıcılarla pazarlık et, tezgaha gelen müşteriye aksesuar sat.
• Mezat: Toplu lotlara teklif ver, nadir cihazları kap.
• Banka ve takvim: Ciroya göre kredi çek, taksitleri takvimden izle, ay sonu raporuyla işini oku.
• Şubeler ve müdürler: Farklı semtlerde şube aç, başına müdür koy, işletmeni büyüt.
• Ses ve müzik: Dükkana özel müzik ve efektler; ayrı ayrı açılıp kısılabilir.
• Bildirimler: Onarım bitince, mezat bitmek üzereyken haber al (isteğe bağlı, gece sessiz).

Tamamen çevrimdışı oynanır. Hesap gerekmez, veri toplanmaz. Reklam ve uygulama içi satın alma yoktur. Gerçek para ile kumar ya da şans oyunu yoktur.

name: Tempo Flow: Metronome & Tuner
description:
Tempo Flow is a metronome and tuner for iPhone and iPad. Set 10 to 400 BPM, shape the beat with accents, subdivisions and swing, and tune up before you play.

One price, everything included. No account, ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.

• Dial in 10–400 BPM with tap tempo, a keypad, or quick adjustments.
• Shape your rhythm with accents, subdivisions, swing, and custom meter grouping.
• Practice Indian classical rhythms with six built-in taals.
• Build confidence with a speed builder, silent-bar trainer, and count-in.
• Save complete setups as songs and arrange them into unlimited setlists.
• Back up your library to a file and import it with a preview.
• Play alongside your music, or use Metronome only mode for lock-screen controls.
• Choose from ten click sounds and optional visual and haptic feedback.
• Pause a speed ramp to hold your tempo, then resume toward your target or restart it. The beat keeps going.
• Resume after a call or dictation when iOS says audio is available again, or cancel the wait.
• Tune with a chromatic tuner that shows the note, flat or sharp, and a gauge. Set A4 from 400 to 480 Hz, show notes for B-flat, E-flat or F instruments, and play reference tones from C2 to B5.

Your songs and settings stay on your device. Export your library to keep a backup or move it to another device. The tuner asks for the microphone only when you open it, analyzes sound on your device, and never records, saves or uploads it. Reference tones work without microphone access.

Requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. Bluetooth output can introduce delay; the visual delay setting helps align the beat light with what you hear. Haptics work while the app is in the foreground on supported devices.

name: Tên Miền Đẳng Cấp
description:
Tên Miền Đẳng Cấp là kho tên miền ngắn, dễ nhớ cho thương hiệu Việt, kèm công cụ tra cứu và quản lý tên miền ngay trên điện thoại.

KHO HƠN 2.300 TÊN MIỀN
Các đuôi .com .net .org .vn .ai và nhiều đuôi khác, xếp theo ngành để chọn nhanh. Mỗi tên có trang riêng giải thích ý nghĩa, định giá tham khảo và các tên liên quan.

KIỂM TRA TÊN CÒN TRỐNG
Gõ tên bạn nghĩ ra để biết đã có người đăng ký chưa, xem thông tin Whois và đăng ký tên còn trống.

ĐỊNH GIÁ MIỄN PHÍ
Ước lượng giá trị một tên miền theo độ dài, từ khoá và đuôi.

RA GIÁ, ĐẤU GIÁ
Đưa ra mức giá của bạn cho tên đang bán, hoặc tham gia đấu giá. Lưu tên yêu thích để theo dõi.

QUẢN LÝ TÊN MIỀN CỦA BẠN
Sau khi mua, trỏ DNS, chuyển tiếp email và theo dõi đơn hàng trong mục Tài khoản.

Tên miền là tài sản dùng bên ngoài app (cho website, email của bạn). Thanh toán bằng chuyển khoản ngân hàng, có hoàn tiền 7 ngày theo chính sách. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong app, ở mục Tài khoản.

name: Tend: Houseplant Care
description:
Tend your plants. Not your subscriptions.

Tend remembers when each of your plants needs water, and how much, so you don't have to. No account to make, no ads, no subscription. Just your plants.

KNOW WHO'S THIRSTY
Today shows exactly which plants need water and how much to give them. When everyone's had a drink, Tend tells you to go enjoy your day.

WATERING THAT FITS EACH PLANT
Tell Tend what the plant is, how big its pot is, what it's made of, and how far it sits from a window. Tend works out how often to water and how much: a cup and a half every 16 days, not "water when dry." It knows about 200 common houseplants, and it eases off in winter when most plants slow down.

YOUR SCHEDULE WINS
Already know your plant? Change the interval or the amount and Tend keeps your numbers. "Reset to Tend's guidance" is always one tap away.

A NUDGE, NOT A NAG
Tend sends one notification when plants are due. Tap "Watered it" right from the banner, and Tend logs it and plans the next one.

EVERY PLANT, AT A GLANCE
Your whole jungle in one grid, with photos you take yourself and each plant's next watering. Open one to see its history, its care details, and why Tend suggests what it does.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your plants stay on your phone and sync through your own iCloud. No sign-up, no tracking, no server of ours to leak anything.

AND THE REST
• Watering history for every plant
• Undo for the "oops, wrong plant" tap
• Dark mode
• Tendy, a small leaf who's very proud of you

Tend is free, with no account and no ads. And no subscription, ever.

name: Terminess
description:
Terminess runs AI coding agents on your own machines from your your pocket.

Start Claude Code, Codex, an agent on your own Anthropic API key, or a local model through Ollama, in any project on your Mac, Linux PC or server. Run as many as you like, across as many machines as you like, and follow them all from one list on your iPhone.

AGENTS THAT WORK TOGETHER
Have Claude build a feature and Codex review it, or hand a task from one agent to the other, and watch it happen from wherever you are. Each agent is the real tool running in a real terminal, signed in with your own plan.

APPROVE AND ANSWER ON THE GO
When an agent wants to run a command or change a file, Allow and Deny appear on your phone, and right on the lock screen. When it has a question, tap an answer and it carries on.

ALL YOUR MACHINES IN ONE APP
Pair a Mac by scanning a code. Add a Linux PC or server with terminessd. Every running session shows which machine it's on, and New chat starts work on any of them.

A CHAT OR THE REAL TERMINAL
Read any session as a clean conversation, with tool steps folded away. Switch to the full terminal when you need it, with keys for Escape, Tab, Control-C and the arrows.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Past conversations are grouped by project. Open one to resume it. Dictate a message, or send a photo or file straight to the machine.

KNOW WHEN YOU'RE NEEDED
Get a notification when an agent finishes, hits an error or needs you. Notifications never include anything from your sessions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no analytics, no tracking.
- Your iPhone connects straight to your own machines over SSH, with a key made in the Secure Enclave that never leaves the device.
- Face ID locks the app, on by default.

WHAT YOU NEED
Terminess for Mac, or terminessd on a Linux machine. Claude Code and Codex use your own subscriptions; Terminess never sees your sign-in.

No machine yet? Turn on the demo in Settings to try everything first.

name: TEUmatic Driver
description:
TEUmatic Driver is the app for truck drivers of container haulage companies that use TEUmatic.

See your jobs
- Today's jobs with every stop, address, time window and instruction from the dispatcher.
- Container number, seal, weight and reference for the terminal at a glance.

Less paperwork
- Photograph the container doors and the container and trailer numbers are read for you.
- Scan CMRs and other documents straight into the order. No more photos lost in chat apps.

Arrivals marked automatically
- During an active job, the app shares the truck's location with your dispatcher and marks stops as reached when you arrive.
- Location sharing stops when you have no active job.

Works in poor coverage
- Actions are saved on the phone and sent once you are back online.

In English, Estonian and Polish.

Try the demo
Tap "Try the demo" on the sign-in screen to see the app with sample jobs. No account needed.

How to get access
Your carrier adds you in TEUmatic and gives you a PIN. You sign in with your phone number and that PIN.

For carriers
TEUmatic is container haulage software for carriers: from the email order to planning, the driver app, the customer's tracking and the invoice. Book a walkthrough at teumatic.com.

Privacy: https://teumatic.com/app-privacy/

name: TextRill
description: TextRill tidies copied lists, labels and other line-based text. Save a draft, trim spaces at the edges of lines, remove empty lines or duplicates, and optionally sort. View the original and resulting line counts, search saved drafts, then copy or share the cleaned text. Drafts and settings are stored on the device.

name: Thaloryne
description:
A current changes at minute 90. Would you hold your heading, correct it, slow down or wait? Thaloryne lets you test those choices in a repeatable passage experiment.

Create a scenario and place current, course, slowdown or sea-state events on its timeline. Move the cursor to inspect heading, ground speed and budget at the same moment. Fork the passage into separate strategies, compare time, burn and drift, and write one strategy back only after confirming your choice. Each branch keeps its own inputs.

Use the drift workbench to adjust current and solve a heading. Inspect protected reserve and uncertainty buffer in the ledger. Edit hourly wind and wave bands, then open Why to see formulas, units, limitations and a comparison with individual events removed.

Six short trials cover foundation and intermediate topics. Predict an outcome, identify a variable, apply an action and save your reflection. You can also start a trial from one of your branches. Scenarios, snapshots and reviews stay on your device. Copy scenarios or branches, restore snapshots, and import or export scenario JSON.

No account is required. Conditions are manual inputs or marked teaching samples, never live forecasts or official charts. Results use a simplified educational model. Speeds outside the fuel curve require an endpoint-estimate confirmation; waiting assumes a stationary boat with its engine off. Ranges are heuristic, not statistical confidence intervals. Not for real navigation or a substitute for official information and professional judgment.

THE MAP

THE GUIDE

- Producers, regions and crus, north to south

REVIEWS

VINTAGES

JOURNAL

WHO IT'S FOR
Wine lovers planning a trip to Italy, students preparing for wine exams, sommeliers and trade professionals who need a fast reference, and anyone curious about where their favorite Italian bottle comes from.

More at theitalianwinemap.com.

name: The Ministry
description:
The Ministry is a government building that takes complete nonsense completely seriously.

Take a ticket and join a queue with a mind of its own. Sit the General Examination while the invigilator copes with one interruption after another. Lodge an objection with a panel whose third member is fast asleep. Nobody has ever seen the Head of Department. His parrot does most of the talking.

Everything you do goes on file. Records keeps a dossier on you, works out what sort of visitor you are, and tells you, whether you ask or not.

TEN DEPARTMENTS
- The Queue: take a ticket and see how far you get before closing time
- Records: your personal file, classified and cross-referenced
- Examinations: twenty real questions, eight per sitting, plus one on the back
- Objections: object to anything, and have it heard by a panel of three
- Quests: five pointless errands for people you will never meet
- Certificates: twenty-seven of them, for almost anything
- The Lift: some floors are on the buttons, some are not
- Patents: combine two things that should never be combined, and try to patent it
- Health and Safety: have something perfectly ordinary reassessed until it becomes unthinkable
- Lost Property: report something missing, and leave with something else

There may be another door.

THINGS THAT HAPPEN
- Programmes cut in without warning. Sometimes another programme interrupts them.
- A pigeon files reports on you.
- Things go along the corridor: a filing cabinet migrating south, six clerks carrying one pencil, a man carrying a piano upstairs on a corridor with no stairs.
- The Ministry has a silliness allowance. When it's spent, the Silliness Auditor comes to collect.

PRIVATE AND FREE
No account, no adverts and no internet needed. Your file stays on your phone, and you can shred it whenever you like. Records will not be pleased.

name: The Wrong Man
description:
A detective game about one decision: who do you charge?

Every case starts with a file and three days. Read the coroner's report, the phone logs and the camera stills. Call suspects into the interview room. Each interview gives you only three questions, so choose what you ask, and when.

People lie. Their stories change when you show them the right piece of evidence, and the wrong piece costs you a question. Request records from the prosecutor, but only ones you can justify. Some lab results take a day to come back, and the clock doesn't wait.

Pin evidence and notes to your board and tie them together with string: place, motive, means, contradiction. When you are ready, make your accusation. You only get one.

Then the newspaper tells you what you did.

At the end of each week you go home. Your salary and your results decide what you can pay for: rent, food, heating, your mother's medicine. Put the wrong man away and the real one is still out there, closer to your family than you think.

• 5 complete murder cases, each with four suspects
• Interviews where questions unlock as you learn
• Present evidence to break a story
• A cork board that ties related clues for you (or leave it to your own hands), with typed strings that can fill your accusation
• A timeline that lines up every time you find, and a suspect table of place, motive and means

• One detective's hunch a day when you are stuck, and the full truth after every verdict

name: tix: Tasks for Humans & Agents
description:
tix is task management for humans and AI agents: a self-hosted server with a CLI, a terminal board, an HTTP API and a web UI. This app is a native client for it. It talks to the same API the CLI uses, so a task an agent claims from a terminal is the task you read on your phone a second later.

You can use it in two ways:
- Connect to a tix server you run (https://github.com/heliopsy/tix) with an API token, or sign in with email and password (second factor included). You can add several servers and switch between them and their tenants from any screen.
- Open a local tix database on the device. The tix engine is built into the app and serves a .db file with no server anywhere. You import a copy into the app and export it back through the share sheet.

What it does:
- Projects with their colours and open task counts
- Task lists with pull to refresh, sorting, grouping by status or project, swipe to complete or snooze, and bulk changes with a single Undo
- Task detail where you edit everything in place: title, Markdown description with checklists, workflow, priority, assignee, due date, tags, custom fields and repeat rule, plus subtasks, dependencies, comments with @ mentions, history and attached files
- Board view with drag and drop between workflow columns, or one lane per project
- Filters and search in tix's filter language, one-tap chips and saved filters
- My work: your open tasks under Overdue, Today, This week, Later and No date
- Quick add in tix's one-line syntax, for example "Fix login !high #auth @raj due:fri", with a live preview of what the server makes of the line. The server parses it, so the app understands exactly what the CLI and the browser understand.
- Task templates
- Share to tix: shared text and links open quick add as a draft. Launcher shortcuts for Quick add, Inbox and My work.
- Inbox for mentions, assignments, comments and status changes, with an unread badge
- Notifications for new inbox items while the app is running
- System, light, dark or OLED black theme
- English, Bulgarian, French and German
- Phone and tablet layouts, with a two-pane list and detail on wide screens

Privacy:
The server stays the source of truth. The app keeps no data of its own beyond the servers you added and a few preferences. API tokens and sign-in sessions are kept in the Android Keystore and are never written to logs or preferences. Passwords are not stored at all. The app contains no analytics, advertising or crash-reporting libraries.

Getting started:
On the machine running tix, mint a token with "tix token create phone --scope task:read --scope task:write --scope project:read", then add the server's URL and the token in the app. A phone cannot reach a server bound to localhost on another machine, so serve tix over HTTPS, either directly or behind a reverse proxy.

The app is early and pre-release. It covers part of what the tix API offers, and you should expect rough edges and changes before 1.0.

tix-mobile is free software under the AGPL-3.0-or-later licence. Source code, issue tracker and roadmap: https://github.com/heliopsy/tix-mobile

name: Tolerance Stack
description:
Tolerance Stack closes a one-dimensional chain.

Enter each part's nominal size and its plus and minus. Mark whether that part adds to the gap or takes from it. Set the gap the assembly is allowed to have. The loop shows the nominal gap, the worst-case span, and the RSS span on one screen.

Worst case adds every half tolerance. RSS combines the standard deviations, and a uniform distribution is divided by the square root of three. A part that pushes the worst case outside the gap can still leave RSS inside it.

Tighten one half and watch both spans move. Allocation spreads a remaining budget across the parts that are still open. Eight measured builds show which assemblies fell outside the gap.

The records stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. The result is a calculation. It does not replace a design review.
