Vom Kellerraum an die Weltspitze: In Top Fragger gründest du deine eigene e-Sport-Organisation und führst sie zu Titeln – auch wenn du gerade nicht spielst.

ZEHN DISZIPLINEN
Starte im Taktik-Shooter und schalte nach und nach MOBA, Battle Royale, Fußball-Game, Kampfspiel, Rennspiel, Kartenspiel, Echtzeit-Strategie, Basketball und Speedrun frei. Jede Disziplin hat eigene Ligen, Rollen und Live-Matches.

SCOUTING & AKADEMIE
Finde Talente in Amateur-Ligen, entdecke epische und legendäre Spieler, bilde Nachwuchs in deiner Akademie aus und stelle das perfekte Line-up zusammen.

GAMING-HOUSE & SPIELSTÄTTE
Vom Kellerraum übers Gaming-Café bis zur großen Arena: Baue Trainingsraum, Streaming-Studio und Sponsoren-Lounge aus und steigere deine Einnahmen.

LIVE-MATCHES
Verfolge jedes Spiel live mit Kommentator, Spielstand und Siegchance – Aufstiege, Pokale und Wochenend-Turniere inklusive.

ECHTE RANGLISTEN
Miss dich weltweit, in deinem Land und in deiner Stadt mit anderen Spielern. Fair dank Server-Prüfung.

IDLE-PRINZIP
Dein Team spielt und verdient weiter, auch wenn die App geschlossen ist. Tägliche Belohnungen, Missionen, Erfolge und ein monatlicher Pass mit Gratis-Belohnungen halten dich bei Laune.

Ohne Werbung, ohne In-App-Käufe, in 11 Sprachen.

name: Topex App
description:
Topex App is the official delegate companion for TOPEX 2026, the Top Executive Conference hosted by the Fiji Commerce & Employers Federation (FCEF) at Sofitel Fiji Resort & Spa, Denarau Island, from 19 to 21 November 2026.

This year's theme is Building Forward: Capitalising on Opportunity, Partnering for Growth.

Everything a delegate needs, in one place:

Programme
See the full three-day programme with session times, speakers and locations, kept up to date by the organisers.

Speakers
Read the bios of the keynote speakers, panellists and hosts.

Networking
Browse the delegate directory, scan another delegate's badge to connect, send messages and request meetings.

Panels and Polls
Send questions to panel sessions and take part in live polls from your seat.

Announcements
Get updates from the organisers by push notification, so you never miss a programme change.

Digital Badge
Your QR badge for check-in and connecting with other delegates, always in the app.

Sponsors
See the partners who make TOPEX 2026 possible.

Evaluation
Share your feedback on the conference through the in-app evaluation.

This app is for registered TOPEX 2026 delegates only. Sign in with the details FCEF sent to your registered email.

Built by Vodafone Fiji for FCEF.

name: Torklet
description:
Torklet, Bluetooth LE OBD-II adaptörüne bağlanıp arabanın canlı verilerini telefonunda gösterir. Hesap yok, reklam yok, izleme yok; verilerin telefonunda kalır.

• Canlı gösterge: devir, hız, motor yükü, soğutma suyu ve benzeri değerler
• Manuel şanzıman için vites tahmini ve vites yükseltme uyarısı (her geçiş için ayrı ses seçebilirsin)
• Motor yükü uyarısı: eşiği sen belirlersin, sesi sen seçersin
• Yolculuk kaydı: süre, mesafe, ortalama hız, hıza göre renklendirilmiş harita izi (Apple Haritalar)
• Yakıt takibi: yakıt kayıtları, tüketim hesabı, fiş fotoğrafından bilgi okuma (telefonunda)
• Birden çok araç, plaka ve şasi numarasından (VIN) araç tanıma
• Navigasyon: adres arama, rota seçenekleri, sesli yönlendirme
• Demo modu: adaptör olmadan uygulamayı örnek verilerle dene

Gizlilik: Uygulama verilerini bize göndermez. Yalnızca dış hava sıcaklığı için yaklaşık konumun (yaklaşık 1 km'ye yuvarlanmış) açık hava servisi Open-Meteo'ya gider; konum izni vermezsen gitmez. Dışa aktardığın dosyaları kime vereceğine sen karar verirsin.

Önemli: Torklet bir OBD-II adaptörü gerektirir ve verileri okur; arıza kodlarını yalnızca sen onaylarsan siler. Vites ve tüketim değerleri tahmin ya da hesaplamadır. Sürüş sırasında telefonu elinde tutma; yalnızca sabitlenmiş telefonla kullan ve trafik kurallarına uy. Torklet, araç markalarıyla bağlantılı değildir; her araç her değeri vermeyebilir.

name: Tourmate
description:
TourMate, otel ve turizm çalışanlarının yabancı misafirlerle iletişimini kolaylaştıran hazır cümle rehberidir.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER

• Hazır Kalıplar: Resepsiyon, restoran, kat hizmetleri, minibar, teknik servis, spa ve güvenlik için hazırlanmış yüzlerce cümle.
• Sesli Okuma: Çevrilmiş cümleyi misafire sesli dinletin.
• Çok Dilli: İngilizce, Almanca, Rusça, Fransızca ve Korece.
• Döviz Çevirici: Ödeme ve fatura konuşmalarında hızlı kur hesaplama.
• Favoriler: En çok kullandığınız cümlelere hızlı erişin.

Resepsiyon, restoran, kat hizmetleri, teknik servis ve spa personeli başta olmak üzere turizm sektöründe çalışan herkes için.

name: TRAIL Calc - Creasing Matrix
description:
TRAIL Calc is the shop-floor tool from Industrias TRAIL to choose the right creasing matrix in seconds, right at the machine.

CALCULATOR
Choose the substrate (paperboard or micro-flute corrugated), enter the measured material thickness and the scoring-rule thickness, and get the recommended creasing matrix size (channel width X depth), with the reference cross-section and the a, b, c and d values for your job. Send the result to our technical team on WhatsApp with a single tap.

ALSO INCLUDES
• Available sizes: continuous stock across the entire product line, with the locator colour of each size.
• How to use: step-by-step installation and recommendations.
• Advantages of the patented monolithic system: a single piece, no weak points.
• Technical data and downloads: technical data sheet and usage and sizing guide in PDF.
• Technical support: on-site assistance, technical enquiries, in-house laboratory and free training.
• Free sample: request it from the app in the size of your choice.

Works offline. Available in Spanish and English.

TRAIL creasing matrix: more than 20 years developing and manufacturing creasing matrices for the die-cutting industry, backed by over 60 years of industrial experience. Made in Argentina.

Calculator results are a guidance suggestion, not a definitive value. For critical jobs, we recommend a prior test or consulting our technical team.

name: Trail Pilot
description:
Trail Pilot is a GPS track recorder and route planner for walking, hiking, cycling and driving. Record where you go, plan where you're going, and follow it on a clear map. No account, no ads, no tracking.

RECORD • Walks, hikes, rides, drives, train journeys, flights and boat trips • Distance, speed, moving and stopped time, and an elevation profile for every track • Keeps recording with the screen locked or another app in front • Stops are marked on the track, with clock times along it • Deleted tracks go to a Bin first, so a slip of the thumb isn't a loss

PLAN AND NAVIGATE • Walk, Hike, Bike and Car routes (fastest or shortest by car), with stops along the way • Distance and time to the end of the route, your arrival time, and distance to your next stop • Search for a place, or long-press the map to route there • Follow a saved track or route, or reverse it to walk it back • Bring in a route from a GPX, KML or KMZ file, or send a place or map link to Trail Pilot from the share sheet • Direct line: straight-line distance, bearing and time to any point • Measure distances on the map; sunrise, sunset and daylight left

WHEN YOU LOSE MOBILE SIGNAL • Recording keeps going: it uses GPS, not the network • A planned route stays on the map, even after a restart, and keeps counting down • Direct lines need only GPS • The map, new routes and search need a connection, so plan before you lose coverage

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE • Tracks, waypoints and routes are kept on your phone. We have no copy • No account, no sign-in, no ads • Back up everything to one file and restore it, or share tracks as GPX or KML • Route requests and searches carry no name or account, and we don't keep the routes you ask for

Metric, imperial or nautical units. Light or dark map. Maps and routes are built from OpenStreetMap data.

Trail Pilot is a navigation aid, not a safety device. In remote country, carry a paper map and tell someone your plans.

Questions: tim@timwestonapps.com Privacy: https://www.timwestonapps.com/privacy/trailpilot/

name: Train&Sync
description: Plan your workouts, record sets and review your training with Train&Sync. Build a weekly schedule or a repeating training cycle, log weights and reps, and use a rest timer between sets. Review your workout history and compare sessions for the same exercise. Your training records are saved on your device, and you can export a backup from the app. Train&Sync supports English and Arabic.

name: Travelum
description:
「Travelum（みんなで旅しおり）」は、面倒な会員登録やログインなしで、合言葉（ルームコード）を共有するだけで家族や友人とリアルタイムに旅行計画を作れるグループ旅行アプリです。

【主な機能】
■ みんなの「行きたい！」リスト
「ごはん」「観光地」「その他（自由記述タグ）」のカテゴリー付きで行きたい場所や食べたいものを気軽に投稿。「行きたい！（いいね）」投票でみんなの希望がひと目で分かります。

■ 日程別の旅程表（タイムライン）
「行きたい！」リストからワンタップで1日目・2日目…とスケジュールに割り振り可能。旅行日数に合わせて日数の追加や整理も自由自在です。

■ 現地でそのまま見せられる「タクシー提示カード」
登録した目的地の現地名称や住所を、黄色い背景に特大フォントで全画面表示。言葉が通じない海外旅行先でも、運転手さんに画面を見せるだけでスムーズに目的地を伝えられます。

■ 安心・安全なリーダー権限管理（荒らし対策）
ルームを作成した1人目が「リーダー」となり、後から合言葉で参加したメンバーの編集権限（編集メンバー / 閲覧のみ）を管理できます。メンバー全員が揃ったら「新規参加ロック」をONにすることで、第三者の侵入を完全に防ぎます。

■ グループ連絡チャット ＆ 完全オフライン閲覧対応
旅行専用のチャットボードで集合場所や持ち物を相談可能。さらに一度読み込んだ旅程表やタクシーカードは端末内に自動キャッシュされるため、地下鉄や海外の圏外エリアでも安心して確認できます。

name: Treasure Topple
description:
Topple the wonders of the world, one coin at a time.

Every level is a famous landmark built from hundreds of shiny coins: the Pyramids, Stonehenge, the Leaning Tower of Pisa, the Arc de Triomphe, the Colosseum, Big Ben, the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, Tower Bridge, the Taj Mahal, the Temple of Heaven, the Great Wall and the Eiffel Tower.

Tap a coloured bag and it pulls every exposed coin of its colour. Find the coin with the golden key, pull it out, and watch the whole structure come crashing down in a slow-motion chain of gold.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap the front bag in a column to collect matching coins
- Plan ahead: bags you cannot fill wait in the slots, and full slots end the run
- Pull a golden-key coin to trigger a big collapse
- Clear the landmark to open its treasure chest

FEATURES
- 12 hand-built landmarks in their own local art style, from Chinese ink painting to French impressionism
- Real 3D physics: every coin tumbles, bounces and rings
- A fresh layout every time you play, so no two runs are the same
- Relax levels to unwind, hell levels to test you, and an endless mode after the world tour
- Collect 12 treasures in your Treasure Vault and turn them in 3D
- A daily challenge with its own star record
- Shuffle and Super Magnet boosters for tricky moments
- Original music for every region and rich haptic feedback
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected
- Plays offline

Pull. Topple. Collect. Travel the world in coins.

name: Trend Food Lab
description:
Welcome to Trend Food Lab! Make delightful desserts, follow each cooking step, and collect the results in your own food collection.

• Make chocolate strawberry mochi and dalgona coffee.
• Try the weekly food challenge once a day and compete on the leaderboard.
• Suggest foods to the lab and check your request status and replies.

The game interface is currently available in Korean.

name: Treść
description:
Treść to codzienna gra w słowa. Każdego dnia jedno ukryte słowo, takie samo dla wszystkich.

Jak grać
Wpisuj rzeczowniki. Przy każdym pojawi się numer miejsca: im mniejszy, tym bliżej znaczeniem. Miejsce 1 to odpowiedź.
Numer i pasek pokazują, jak blisko jesteś.
Nowe słowo pojawia się codziennie o północy czasu polskiego.

Kiedy nie wychodzi
• Podpowiedź pokazuje słowo bliższe niż twoje najlepsze dotąd. Gra liczy podpowiedzi w twoim wyniku.
• Możesz się poddać: zobaczysz ukryte słowo i sto najbliższych mu słów.
• Dotknij słowa na liście, żeby zobaczyć, co znaczy.

Co jeszcze
• Archiwum: słowa z minionych dni możesz odgadnąć później.
• „Losowe słowo”: gra bez czekania, kiedy tylko zechcesz.
• „Szalona gra” (włączysz ją w ustawieniach): ukryte może być dowolne słowo ze słownika.
• Statystyki, serie i osiągnięcia.
• Wynikiem możesz się podzielić bez ukrytego słowa, więc nikomu nie zepsujesz zabawy.
• Opcja „Bez polskich znaków” dla tych, którzy piszą bez ą, ę czy ł.
• Codzienne przypomnienie, jeśli chcesz.
• Wyniki słowa dnia i archiwum synchronizują się przez iCloud między twoimi urządzeniami.
• Samouczek na start, jasny i ciemny motyw, VoiceOver.
• iPhone i iPad.

Uczciwie i prosto
• Za darmo, bez reklam i zakupów w aplikacji.
• Bez kont i rejestracji.
• Działa bez internetu.
• Nie zbieramy żadnych danych o tobie.

Bliskość słów liczy komputer, więc czasem myśli inaczej niż ty.

Słownik i odmiana słów pochodzą z PoliMorfu (Instytut Podstaw Informatyki PAN, licencja BSD). Dziękujemy jego autorom!
Pełne podziękowania i licencje znajdziesz w aplikacji, w części „O grze”.

name: TriSplit: Triathlon Splits
description:
Your Apple Watch records a triathlon as one workout. Strava wants three. TriSplit fixes that.

Pick your race from Apple Health and TriSplit splits it into its swim, bike and run legs, then uploads each one to Strava as its own activity. Every leg keeps its heart rate, distance and GPS route, and each description shows your T1, T2 and total race time.

HOW IT WORKS
• Record your race with the Apple Watch multisport workout
• Open TriSplit and choose the race
• Check the legs and their names
• Tap Upload to Strava

WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• Proper swim, ride and run activities, so your Strava stats and segments make sense
• Transition times you can actually see, without doing the maths
• Duplicate warnings, so a race never goes up twice

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
TriSplit has no account, no ads and no tracking. Your workouts stay on your iPhone until you tap Upload, and then go straight to Strava. Disconnect at any time to remove TriSplit's access and its data.

WHAT YOU NEED
• An Apple Watch multisport workout (Swim Bike Run) in Apple Health
• iOS 17 or later
• A Strava account

Compatible with Strava. TriSplit is an independent app and is not affiliated with Strava, Inc.

name: Trodd: Steps & Share Cards
description:
Trodd turns the steps and workouts already in Apple Health into something you will want to open, and want to show off.

YOUR DAY, AS A RING
A glowing goal ring fills with every step. See how far ahead of yesterday you are, your distance, and your current streak at a glance. The ring updates by itself while you walk.

TRENDS THAT MAKE SENSE
Look back over days, weeks and the whole year. A 13-week consistency grid shows how steady you have been, and Trodd tells you which weekday is your strongest.

EVERY WORKOUT, COUNTED
Runs, walks, hikes, rides, swims, yoga and strength sessions from Apple Health, with duration, distance and energy. Your longest distance is highlighted.

24 BADGES TO CHASE
From 10K Day to Marathon, Week Warrior to Habit Machine. Streaks, big weeks and distance milestones, each with progress so you know what is next.

SHARE CARDS MADE TO BE POSTED
Pick the stat that tells your story: steps, distance, duration, pace or calories. Choose a theme, add your handle, and share a story-sized card with a labelled chart. Your year in steps gets its own Wrapped recap.

WIDGETS
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your ring and streak without opening the app.

YOUR GOAL, YOUR UNITS
Set your own daily step goal and switch between kilometres and miles.

NO HEALTH DATA? NO PROBLEM
Prefer not to connect Apple Health? Skip it and add your steps by hand.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No servers. No analytics, ads or third-party SDKs. Trodd reads Apple Health on your iPhone, only with your permission, and never writes to it. Your data stays on your device.

Step, distance and energy figures come from your iPhone, Apple Watch or other sources in Apple Health. Trodd is a fitness and lifestyle app, not a medical device.

Questions or feedback: trodd@ezee.li
Privacy Policy: https://trodd.ezee.li/#privacy
Terms of Service: https://trodd.ezee.li/#terms

name: Trouva237
description: Trouva237 vous aide à trouver au Cameroun des logements à louer, des outils et matériaux, des magasins, des restaurants, des services locaux et des pharmacies. Recherchez par catégorie ou par ville, consultez les annonces et enregistrez vos favoris pour les retrouver facilement. L’application est disponible en français et en anglais.

name: Truco Score Pad
description:
The simplest truco score keeper: open the app and start adding points.

• Tap a team's score to add a point.
• Press and hold, then drag to pick +2, +3, +4 or falta envido.
• Hold the minus button to subtract a point if you slip up.
• Undo and redo any change from the menu.

YOUR WAY
• Traditional tally squares or big numbers.
• Games to 15 or 30 points, with the option to extend to 30.
• With flor, without flor, or random.
• Falta envido to the game limit or by stage.
• Editable team names with history.
• Safe mode to avoid accidental points.

BUILT FOR THE TABLE
• The screen splits into two halves, one per team, with huge numbers you can read from any seat.
• Your game saves itself: close the app and pick up whenever you like.
• Available in English and Spanish.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no analytics and no internet connection. Everything stays on your device.

name: Trustela
description:
Trustela warns you about fake shops, phishing and scam sites – before you order. Right in Safari on iPhone and iPad.

HOW TRUSTELA WORKS
• Trustela loads public warning lists against fake shops, phishing, fraud and malware onto your device and keeps them up to date.
• When you open a page in Safari, your iPhone or iPad itself checks whether the address is on one of these lists.
• Only when there is real danger do we double-check, to be safe.

EVERY NOTICE TELLS YOU AT ONCE WHERE YOU STAND
Always with a symbol and a word:
• Danger – The site is on warning lists for fraud. Trustela shows a warning instead of the site.
• Caution – The site is on a list of suspected cases. A bar advises you not to pay in advance.
• Safe – On shops from the Trustela list of trusted shops, a short note appears and disappears by itself.
• Unknown – If a site is on none of the lists, tap the Trustela icon in Safari to see it.

CHECK A SHOP OR LINK
Not sure about a link from WhatsApp, a text message or an email? Paste it into the app or send it to Trustela via “Share” – you will see at once where you stand.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• The app guides you step by step through switching it on in Safari and finishes with a test warning.
• The home screen shows at a glance whether the protection is running – and helps if something is missing.
• Choose when Trustela speaks up: always or only when there is danger.
• Extra-large text in all notices, if you like.
• Already ordered or paid? “I’ve been scammed – what now?” shows the next steps.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
We never learn which sites you visit. The check happens on your device. Trustela needs no account, shows no advertising and is free.

SOMETHING NOT RIGHT?
Report a scam site or a false alarm at www.trustela.app/en/report.

Note: “Safe” is not a guarantee. Stay alert when paying.

Trustela is provided by Mind63 GmbH, Heilbronn, Germany.
Website: www.trustela.app · Privacy: www.trustela.app/en/privacy/

name: Trylet: Fitness Challenges
description:
Trylet gives you one small fitness challenge at a time: a minute of squats, a plank, a 1 km run. You do it, write down your number, and see how it compares with last time.

There is no plan to follow and nothing to sign up for. Open the app, see today's suggestion, and try it if you feel like it.

HOW IT WORKS
• Open. One suggestion is waiting. Skip it or swap it if you like.
• Start. A short animated demo shows the movement and what counts as one rep.
• Do it. A beat ticks every second and speeds up near the end.
• Save. Enter your number. Trylet keeps your record and your trend.

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
Every challenge has three levels: Basic, Healthy and Excellent. They give your number a meaning and point at a next goal within reach. You can choose an age range and a sex reference group to adjust them. The levels are Trylet's own goals, not a medical assessment.

WHAT YOU CAN TRY
• Strength: standard, knee and wall push-ups, bodyweight squats, crunches, calf raises, forearm plank
• Cardio: high knees, jumping jacks, an easy continuous run, 1 km, 5 km and a 12-minute run
• Flexibility: sit and reach
• Balance: single-leg stand, heel-to-toe stand
No equipment needed. Runs use GPS; everything else you count yourself.

WHAT TRYLET LEAVES OUT
• No account. Open it and start.
• No subscription. Every challenge and every chart is free.
• No streaks. Nothing breaks if you skip a day, or a month.
• No ads and no trackers.
• No servers. Your results stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud.

ALSO
• Results sync across your devices through your own iCloud
• Optional reminders, as gentle as you want them
• Optionally save completed challenges to Apple Health as workouts
• Export all your results as CSV or JSON
• Metric or imperial units, English or Simplified Chinese

Trylet is a tool for logging exercise and challenging yourself. It is not a medical or diagnostic tool. Stop if you feel chest pain, dizziness, unusual shortness of breath or sharp pain.

name: tsuchi: calm pottery studio
description:
tsuchi is a small pottery studio for your iPhone. A wheel is turning, there is clay on it, and nothing needs your attention.

Press into the clay and it opens. Pull the wall up and it thins. Every pot comes out a little uneven, and that is part of it. Stay for two minutes or for an evening.

• Throw: begin with stoneware, porcelain, terracotta or iron earth, and shape the clay on the turning wheel with your fingers.
• Carve: hold still to cut a ring, move to cut a spiral, or stop the wheel and draw by hand.
• Glaze: brush on one of five glazes, or dip the whole piece. It stays pale chalk until the kiln.
• Fire: the room goes dark, the piece glows, and it comes back changed.

Your pieces save as you work and wait on a shelf. Give them names, come back to unfinished ones, or let one go when you want to.

There are no scores, streaks, timers or reminders, and nothing to win or lose.

Everything you make stays on your iPhone. tsuchi has no accounts, no ads and no tracking, and it never needs the internet.

name: TulkkiRakonen
description: TulkkiRakonen mittaa raot ja venttiilivalykset lehtipaksuuksilla, toistotarkastuksella ja selkealla raportilla.

name: Tunvia Client
description:
Tunvia Client is an offline password manager for iPhone and iPad. Save logins in an encrypted vault on your device and unlock it with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode.

Transfer entries with Beam
Open Tunvia Client on both devices and place them side by side. On the receiving device, open Beam and tap Receive instead to show an invitation QR code. On the sending device, select the entries, tap Show frames and scan the invitation. The receiver then taps Scan frames and reads the animated QR codes on the sender's screen.

After scanning, the receiving device shows a preview so you can choose which entries to add. The app adds new entries and flags likely duplicates in the preview. The camera reads QR codes during Beam. It does not record photos or video. The transfer works without an internet connection.

Use your vault
- Save a title, website, login, password and note for each entry.
- Search your entries and generate passwords from 8 to 64 characters.
- Copy a password to this device's clipboard. The copy expires after 45 seconds.
- Choose when the vault locks after you leave the app.

Before you start
Set a device passcode to use the vault. Beam needs two devices with cameras running Tunvia Client. The vault is excluded from device backups, and there is no recovery service. If you delete the app or lose your device, you can only recover entries you already transferred to another device.

name: TurkSail
description:
TurkSail web sitesinin resmî iPhone uygulaması.

Yelken ve deniz dünyasından haberler, yarış sonuçları, söyleşiler ve köşe yazıları cebinizde:
• Haberler, Bodoslama, Dümen Suyu, SeArt / Deniz ve Sanat, Amatör Denizci Köşesi, Denizde Haberleşme, Yelkenli Yarış Sınıfları
• Görselli haber kartları; yazıları uygulama içinde rahatça okuyun
• Aşağı çekerek yenileyin; internet yokken son indirilen yazılar okunabilir
• Yazıyı paylaşın ya da sitede açın
• Açık ve koyu tema

Reklam yok, üyelik yok. Uygulamanın içeriği Türkçedir.

Rüzgârınız kolayına essin, pruvanız neta olsun!

name: Turn Pass
description:
Turn Pass follows one blank between centers.

Mount the length and the radius. Drag along the wood to take a pass. The profile shows what is left. A wall under 0.12 in is about to show the bore. The first inch has to stay thick enough for the chuck.

The speed line uses the current diameter. It shows the surface feet at the rpm you set, and the rpm that holds about 1000 surface feet.

The blank and its passes stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Turni – Orari del negozio
description:
NOVITÀ DELLA VERSIONE 5.3
• Nuovo nome: Turni – Orari del negozio
• Arriva Turni per Apple Watch: il turno di oggi, la settimana e le aperture e chiusure, sempre al polso
• Aperture e chiusure del negozio e dell'ufficio in due schermate distinte
• Complicazioni per il quadrante con il prossimo turno
• L'app sull'orologio riprende il colore dell'icona scelta sull'iPhone

Turni è l'app per pianificare e consultare i turni di lavoro in negozi e piccole e medie attività. I collaboratori consultano i propri orari, inviano richieste e ricevono le comunicazioni aziendali; la direzione pianifica la settimana e la pubblica a tutto il personale in un solo passaggio.

Turni si appoggia al server installato presso la propria azienda: i dati restano all'interno dell'attività, senza passare da cloud di terze parti. Per accedere servono l'indirizzo del server, fornito dalla direzione tramite link o codice QR, e le proprie credenziali.

PER I COLLABORATORI
• Il turno di oggi e di domani, la settimana completa, il reparto e le ore svolte, settimana per settimana e mese per mese
• Indicazione immediata di quando tocca a te aprire o chiudere il negozio o l'ufficio
• Richieste di giorni liberi e permessi in pochi tocchi, con il calendario del reparto per vedere chi li ha già richiesti
• Modifiche e scambi di turno con i colleghi
• Bacheca aziendale con comunicazioni, allegati e conferma di lettura
• Notifiche alla pubblicazione dei turni, a ogni variazione e alla risposta alle richieste
• Widget per la schermata Home e la schermata di blocco
• Turni sincronizzati con il Calendario dell'iPhone
• Consultazione anche senza connessione, con l'ultima copia salvata

APPLE WATCH
• Il turno di oggi e di domani al polso
• La settimana completa scorrendo verso il basso
• Aperture e chiusure del negozio e dell'ufficio scorrendo verso destra
• Complicazioni per il quadrante
• Notifiche con vibrazione direttamente sull'orologio
• Nessun accesso da effettuare: i dati arrivano dall'iPhone abbinato

PER LA DIREZIONE
• Griglia settimanale per reparto, a mezz'ore, con il confronto tra ore pianificate e ore da contratto
• Pubblicazione dei turni con notifica a tutto il personale
• Gestione delle richieste con il calendario del reparto a portata di mano
• Assegnazione di aperture e chiusure di negozio e ufficio
• Bacheca con scelta dei destinatari, allegati e verifica delle letture
• Esportazione in Excel e PDF

PRIVACY E SICUREZZA
• I dati restano sul server dell'azienda
• Ogni collaboratore vede solo le informazioni che la direzione decide di rendere visibili
• Accesso protetto con Face ID
• Nessuna pubblicità e nessun tracciamento

PERSONALIZZAZIONE
• Temi chiari e scuri ed effetti visivi
• Testo più grande e contrasto elevato
• Icona dell'app in otto colori

Turni richiede il server Turni attivo presso la propria azienda: senza le credenziali fornite dalla direzione l'app non è utilizzabile.

name: Tutanak: 2. El & Teslim Delili
description:
Noter satışı olmayan elden teslimlerde sonradan çıkan "bozuktu", "çiziği yoktu" ya da "kutusu eksikti" tartışmalarına son verin. Tutanak; 2. el telefon, bilgisayar ve ekipman alım-satımından teknik servise, eşyalı kiralık evden rent a car teslimine kadar her teslim anını fotoğraf, video, dijital imza ve kriptografik mühürle kayda alır.

NE ZAMAN KULLANILIR?
• 2. El Telefon, Laptop & Elektronik Alım-Satım: IMEI ve seri no OCR ile okutun; pil sağlığı, ekran/kasa çizikleri, kutu-fatura-aksesuarları fotoğraflayın ve çalışma/test videosu ekleyin.
• Kiralık Ev Eşya, Depozito & Sayaç Teslimi: Oda oda eşya durumunu ve elektrik/su/doğalgaz sayaçlarını kaydedin, çıkışta fark raporuyla depozitoyu şeffafça uzlaştırın.
• Teknik Servis & Ekipman Zimmeti: Cihaz kabul fişini ve fiyat teklifini müşteriyle paylaşın; kamera, iş makinesi veya şirket ekipmanını seri numarasıyla zimmetleyin.
• Araç Kiralama (Rent a Car) & Filo Teslimi: 2B hasar şeması üzerinde çizik/göçük işaretleyin, kilometre ve yakıt seviyesini kaydedin.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR?
1. Fotoğraf çekin, fotoğraf üstüne halka ile çizik/hasar işaretleyin ve 45 sn test/yürüyüş videosu ekleyin.
2. AI OCR ve sesli dikte ile IMEI, seri no, plaka ve sayaçları hızlıca işleyin.
3. Alıcı veya karşı taraf uygulama kurmadan bağlantı üzerinden 6 haneli SMS/E-posta OTP ve el yazısı dijital imza ile onaylasın.
4. TRSquare FAST QR ile elden ödeme/kapora karekodunu oluşturun ve dekontu tutanağa bağlayın.
5. Kayıt kilitlendiğinde SHA-256 + Ed25519 dijital mührü ve RFC 3161 zaman damgası basılır; karekodlu PDF ve mahkeme/arabulucu uyumlu .ZIP delil paketi saniyeler içinde hazırdır.

GÜVENLİK VE DOĞRULAMA
• Çevrimdışı saha modu: İnternet yokken taslak açar, bağlantı gelince eşitler.
• WhatsApp ve e-posta ile tek dokunuşta tebligat, açılma ve okundu takibi.
• Herkes karekodu okutarak veya fotoğrafı sürükle-bırak doğrulama sayfasına (/v/…) atarak belgenin değiştirilmediğini teyit edebilir.

Önemli Not: Tutanak noter satışı veya 5070 sayılı kanun kapsamında resmî Nitelikli Elektronik İmza (NES) yerine geçmez; teslim anındaki fiilî durumu ve karşılıklı mutabakatı teknik olarak delillendirmeye yardımcı olur.

name: TuvmexaJorqil
description: Underfloor heating design calculator for HVAC engineers. Enter room area and specific heat loss to estimate W/m2 output and check the floor surface temperature limit, size pipe spacing, total loop length and number of balanced circuits, compute flow per loop from heat output and dT with head loss for manifold balancing, model screed thickness, pipe embedment, thermal resistance and heat-up response, compare fixed, weather-compensated and heat-pump supply temperatures, compare thermostat zoning, actuators and cooling mode controls, and sum pipe length, manifold stations and pump energy against radiator heating. Review a one-line heating spec and export PDF, CSV or DXF. Built for underfloor heating, pipework, floor and pump work.

name: TV Remote — Pult
description:
Pult turns your iPhone into a handy TV remote. No account, no ads and no internet — just your phone and your TV on the same Wi-Fi network.

TVS
• LG webOS and Android TV / Google TV (including Mi TV Stick) — tested on real TVs.
• Samsung Tizen and Sony BRAVIA — experimental: built from the protocol documentation, not yet tested on real TVs.
• The app finds your TV on the home network, or add it by IP address.

A REMOTE THAT FITS YOU
• D-pad, touchpad and number pad.
• Volume, channels, power and media keys.
• Three ready-made layouts — or arrange the buttons your way on a grid.
• Turn the TV on over Wi-Fi, if your TV supports it.

TEXT AND VOICE
• Type on your iPhone straight into the TV's text field.
• Search YouTube by keyboard or voice. Speech is recognised on your iPhone.
• Voice search on Android TV through your phone's microphone.

QUICK ACTIONS
• Save a sequence of commands with pauses and run it with one tap.

PRIVACY
• No account, server, analytics or ads.
• The app talks only to TVs on your local network.
• Pairing keys are kept in the iPhone Keychain.
• Typed text is never stored.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The iPhone and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
• TVs do not confirm button presses: "Command sent" means your phone sent it.

• The app's interface is in Russian.

Pult is an independent app and is not affiliated with LG, Samsung, Sony or Google. Names are used only to describe compatibility.

name: Tvanta | TV Mouse & Keyboard
description:
Tvanta turns your iPhone into a mouse, keyboard and remote for your smart TV.

Typing a search or a Wi‑Fi password with a TV remote is slow. With Tvanta you type on a real keyboard, move the pointer with a wide trackpad and control everything from one premium app — no extra hardware, just your home Wi‑Fi.

TRACKPAD & MOUSE
• Move the on‑screen pointer with one finger, tap to click
• Scroll with two fingers, two‑finger tap to go back
• Adjustable trackpad speed

KEYBOARD
• Type directly into search boxes, logins and apps on your TV
• Built‑in keyboard with letters, numbers and symbols

FULL REMOTE
• Direction pad and OK, Back, Home, Menu
• Volume, channel, mute, power, input
• Play, pause, rewind, fast forward and number pad

TV APPS
• See your TV's apps and open Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+ and more with one tap

WORKS WITH POPULAR TVS
• LG webOS (2014+)
• Samsung Tizen (2016+)
• Google TV and Android TV: Sony, TCL, Philips, Xiaomi, Hisense, Toshiba, Sharp, Nvidia Shield, Chromecast
• Roku TV: TCL, Hisense, Sharp, Philips and Roku devices

EASY SETUP
• Finds TVs on your Wi‑Fi automatically, or add one by IP

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Everything stays between your phone and your TV on your home network

Available in English, Türkçe, العربية and Deutsch.

Requirements: your iPhone and TV must be on the same Wi‑Fi network. Some features depend on your TV model. Tvanta is not affiliated with LG, Samsung, Sony, Google, Roku, Vizio, Philips or Panasonic.

name: Ufivo Business

Ufivo Business — робоче місце квіткового магазину в телефоні.

Ви збираєте букети зранку — і одразу показуєте їх покупцям: фото або відео, ціна, кількість. Вітрина живе день у день, тож покупець бачить те, що справді стоїть у вас у магазині.

name: Uni Browzer
description:
O Uni é um navegador rápido e sem distrações, em preto e branco, feito pra quem passa o dia na web.

ESPAÇOS E ABAS
Separe o trabalho do resto em espaços, cada um com as suas abas e fixadas. No iPhone, deslize a barra de baixo pra trocar de espaço; no iPad, a barra lateral mostra tudo de uma vez.

Um bloqueador de verdade (EasyList e EasyPrivacy) vem ligado. As páginas carregam mais rápido e gastam menos bateria.

name: Untilt: Reverse Tilt Puzzle
description:
Untilt is a puzzle about working backwards. You see two boards, Before and After, and a set number of moves. Enter the tilts that turn Before into After, then press Run to watch them play out.

HOW IT PLAYS
Every tilt slides all the stones on the board in one direction. A stone keeps going until it hits a wall, the edge of the board or another stone. Pick the tilts in order, fill every move slot, and run the sequence. If the result matches After, the level is solved. If not, change a slot and try again.

FOUR TIERS
Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert each hold 100 levels. Later tiers add crates that move one cell per tilt, gates that open and close on alternate moves, and a rotate move that turns the whole board a quarter turn. A tier opens once you have solved 30 levels in the one before it.

STARS AND HINTS
Each level earns up to three stars: three for a first try, two for two or three tries, one after that. A hint fills in one move for you and caps that level at two stars. You start with five hints and earn another for every five perfect solves.

DAILY PUZZLE
A new puzzle each day. When you finish it, share the result as text. The Daily unlocks once you have solved ten Easy levels.

DETAILS
- Runs on iPhone (portrait) and iPad
- Tap a filled slot to change that move, or use Undo and Reset
- Fast replay speeds up the run animation
- A rules screen explains the mechanics for the level you are on
- VoiceOver descriptions for boards and moves
- Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases
- No account to create and no data collected; your progress stays on your device

UPCATCH — NEVER GO ALONE.

name: Uptime
description:
Tus equipos bajo control, estés donde estés.

Uptime te permite consultar el estado de tus computadoras y servidores desde tu teléfono. Revisá recursos, recibí alertas y ejecutá acciones remotas específicas desde un solo lugar.

MONITOREO DE EQUIPOS

• Consultá qué equipos están en línea y su tiempo encendido.
• Revisá el uso de CPU, memoria, almacenamiento y red.
• Accedé al inventario de hardware y sistema operativo.
• Consultá procesos, servicios, sesiones y eventos.
• Revisá información SMART y salud de discos cuando el hardware lo permite.
• Identificá actualizaciones pendientes y la necesidad de reinicio.

ALERTAS Y NOTIFICACIONES

Seguí los incidentes y sus recuperaciones. Configurá notificaciones push en dispositivos compatibles y avisos por correo, inmediatos o agrupados, según tus preferencias.

ACCIONES REMOTAS

Con los permisos correspondientes, podés:

• Solicitar una nueva búsqueda de actualizaciones.
• Seleccionar e instalar actualizaciones, incluidos controladores y opcionales.
• Iniciar, detener y reiniciar servicios permitidos.
• Cerrar sesiones de usuario.
• Solicitar el reinicio de un equipo.

El portal muestra el progreso y el resultado de las acciones, y las operaciones quedan registradas para auditoría. El agente se comunica mediante HTTPS, sin necesidad de abrir puertos entrantes en los equipos.

ORGANIZÁ TU OPERACIÓN

Agrupá equipos y compartí el acceso con otros usuarios según sus roles y permisos. Uptime está orientado a empresas, responsables de TI y proveedores de soporte.

COMENZÁ GRATIS

Creá tu cuenta y comenzá con el plan gratuito de hasta 3 equipos. Para operaciones de mayor tamaño, consultá los planes disponibles.

También podés conocer el entorno de demostración con equipos y datos simulados, sin ingresar usuario ni contraseña. En la pantalla de acceso, elegí “Explorá el demo”.

REQUISITOS Y CONSIDERACIONES

Cada equipo que quieras monitorear necesita el agente Uptime instalado y vinculado a tu cuenta. La disponibilidad de información y acciones depende del sistema operativo, el hardware, los permisos y la versión del agente.

Las acciones remotas requieren un equipo conectado, un agente compatible y rol de Administrador dentro de su alcance de acceso. Las operaciones que modifican el equipo solicitan confirmación.

La instalación de actualizaciones no reinicia automáticamente el equipo. Los controladores y las actualizaciones opcionales requieren selección explícita. No se instalan cambios de versión ni paquetes que puedan solicitar interacción del usuario.

El reinicio remoto avisa con 60 segundos de anticipación y no fuerza el cierre de aplicaciones. Cerrar una sesión puede provocar pérdida de trabajo sin guardar.

Uptime no incluye escritorio remoto, acceso a la pantalla ni terminal remota. El entorno Demo es de solo lectura.

name: URControl Lite
description:
URControl Lite turns your iPhone into a remote for your TVs. It talks to your TV directly over your home Wi-Fi: no account, no server, no ads.

SUPPORTED TVs
• Samsung Smart TV (2016 and later)
• LG webOS

• Sony Bravia
• Android TV and Google TV (pair with the code on the TV)

• Finds the TVs on your Wi-Fi and shows their real names

name: USR: Uniformed Safe Rides
description:
Uniformed Safe Rides (USR) is a free ride program for military communities. Service members and their families get a ride from a verified volunteer at their own base, any time, for any reason.

Just arrived and need groceries? Visiting a base without a car? Out for the evening and want a safe way home? Open USR, choose where you are going, and your base's volunteer team is notified.

FOR RIDERS
• Request a ride in a few taps. It is always free.
• Your location connects you to the right base team and its closest volunteers.
• See your volunteer's name, photo and vehicle before they arrive.
• Follow your ride on the map and message your driver.
• Schedule a ride ahead of time for an event or appointment.

FOR VOLUNTEERS
• Go online when you have time and take ride requests near you.
• Turn-by-turn directions to the pickup and the destination.
• Drive with a partner for safety.
• See the difference you have made: rides given and days served.

FOR BASE TEAMS
• Start a ride program for your base and run it from your phone or the web.
• Your team's name, logo and colors appear throughout the app.
• Replaces the separate safe-ride phone numbers each base runs today.

USR works at U.S. military communities worldwide. It is a volunteer service, not a taxi or commercial rideshare. Volunteers are never paid and riders are never charged.

USR is an independent nonprofit and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Department of Defense or any branch of the U.S. Armed Forces.

In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

name: Valet Neuf
description:
Valet Neuf, c'est l'application de belote et coinche gratuite, pensée pour les joueurs français.

Joue contre des robots qui jouent comme de vrais joueurs : ils respectent les conventions, soutiennent leur partenaire et ne trichent jamais. Le coach te dit quoi annoncer et quoi jouer, et t'explique pourquoi.

LA SÉRIE DU JOUR
Chaque jour, tout le monde joue exactement les mêmes donnes. Pas de chance, pas d'excuse : ton score se compare à celui des autres joueurs. Classement du jour, divisions, podium du mois.

DÉFIE TES AMIS
Envoie un défi par lien ou par WhatsApp : ton ami joue les mêmes cartes que toi, et vous comparez vos scores. Mini-duels en 4 donnes, course contre la montre, clubs entre amis.

APPRENDS À JOUER
L'école de la coinche : 7 étapes courtes pour passer de « je ne sais pas jouer » à « je coinche mes amis ». Les règles de la belote, l'atout, les annonces, le compte des points, les enchères.

À TON RYTHME
Partie libre en 1000, 2000 ou 3000 points, rythme du jeu réglable, cartes en 4 couleurs, son et effets désactivables. Jouable sans compte ; un compte gratuit garde ta progression, tes badges et ton classement.

Belote classique, coinche (contrée), belote-rebelote, capot, sans atout et tout atout : toutes les règles que tu connais, comme à la maison.

Gratuit, sans publicité.

name: Vật Phẩm Phong Thủy
description:
Vật Phẩm Phong Thủy là cửa hàng của chuỗi Vật Phẩm Phong Thủy, mở tại TP.HCM từ năm 2009, nay có app để mua sắm thuận tiện hơn.

HƠN 10.000 MẪU CÒN HÀNG
Tỳ hưu, thiềm thừ, đá quý, vòng tay, trang sức, linh vật. Mỗi mẫu ghi rõ chất liệu, kích thước và số lượng còn ở từng chi nhánh.

CHỌN THEO MỆNH VÀ TUỔI
Công cụ tra cứu phong thủy miễn phí gợi ý màu, chất liệu và vật phẩm hợp với mệnh của bạn.

ĐẶT HÀNG DỄ DÀNG
Thanh toán khi nhận hàng, chuyển khoản qua mã QR, hoặc nhận tại cửa hàng. Theo dõi đơn hàng, lưu địa chỉ, lưu mẫu yêu thích trong mục Tài khoản.

ƯU ĐÃI VÀ ĐẤU GIÁ
Flash sale theo khung giờ, combo quà tặng, và phiên đấu giá các mẫu độc bản.

HỎI TRƯỚC KHI MUA
Trò chuyện với trợ lý để được gợi ý mẫu phù hợp, hoặc liên hệ cửa hàng để được tư vấn.

Giao hàng toàn quốc, đổi trả trong 7 ngày. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong app, ở mục Tài khoản.

name: Veiled Table
description:
Take a seat with five AI characters. Everyone knows the secret word except one player: the Bluffer.

Give a one-word clue that proves you belong without giving too much away. Listen to the others, question suspicious clues, and vote for the player you think is bluffing. If you are the Bluffer, blend in and work out the secret before the table catches you.

A TABLE THAT TALKS BACK
Speak naturally to a cast of AI characters with distinct personalities and voices. They respond to your clues, challenge each other, and try to read the room. All other players are AI; no multiplayer matchmaking or player account is required.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Follow along with captions and use the available tap and text controls for game actions. Play in English, Italian, French, German, or Spanish. A round takes about five minutes.

VOICE ON YOUR IPHONE
Speech recognition and character voices run on your device. With your permission, your nickname, recognized speech, and game context are sent to our server and AI providers to generate dialogue and interpret moves. Microphone recordings are not uploaded to the AI providers. You can withdraw AI permission in Privacy & support.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
An internet connection, a compatible iPhone with iOS 26 or later, and a one-time voice-model download of about 400 MB per language are required. Play is free, with daily usage and service capacity limits. AI replies can be unexpected or inappropriate; avoid sharing sensitive information. No ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.

name: VELTRIX Connect
description:
VELTRIX Connect helps merchants manage digital loyalty cards and NFC plaques from their iPhone.

Create a loyalty program and display a single sign-up QR code at checkout. Each customer can use it to get their own card in Apple Wallet. Scan a customer’s card at checkout to add a stamp, and track sign-ups, stamps, and rewards in the app.

Manage your NFC plaques, update the links they open, and see how often they’re scanned.

name: Venta Music
description:
Venta Music is the music service of the Venta ecosystem: Armenian and favourite music, radio and your own songs in one app.

• Catalogue: new releases, charts, genres (Armenian pop, folk, rabiz, pop, hip-hop, rock and more), artists, albums and playlists.
• Venta Radio: endless mixes by mood, genre and new releases — tap and listen.
• My Music: liked songs, your own playlists and followed artists — on your phone and on music.venta.am.
• Add your song: upload a track with cover art and lyrics; after review it appears in the shared catalogue.
• Player: background playback, lock-screen and headphone controls, queue, shuffle and repeat, lyrics.
• Search across songs, artists and albums.
• Armenian, Russian and English, light and dark theme.

Listening needs no account. To save favourites and upload songs, sign in with Venta ID or your phone number — the code arrives in Ventagram or by SMS. You can delete your account right in the app.

name: Verbiage
description:
Record conversations and turn them into readable transcripts on your iPhone.

Verbiage records your microphone and transcribes on device. Read transcripts in the app, identify speakers, and share or export Markdown notes. No Verbiage account or subscription is required.

• Record in-person meetings, interviews, and personal notes.
• Use Apple Speech, or download Parakeet for English transcription.
• Review and name speakers, with optional voice profiles.
• Keep transcripts in Verbiage or export to a folder you choose.
• Pair with Verbiage on your Mac to sync completed meeting transcripts over your local network.
• Choose whether to sync speaker profiles through your private iCloud database.
• Control how long recordings and voice-review clips are kept.

Speech models may need an initial download. The iPhone app records microphone audio; it does not capture other apps’ audio or phone calls. Mac pairing is optional and requires both devices to be reachable on the same network.

Requires iOS 26 or later. Obtain permission from participants before recording.

name: VIER: Vier in einer Reihe
description:
VIER ist komplett kostenlos. Und zwar wirklich: keine Werbung, keine In-App-Käufe, kein Abo, kein Konto, keine Datensammlung. Du lädst die App und spielst.

DAS SPIEL
Wirf abwechselnd Steine ins Brett und bring als Erster vier in eine Reihe. Waagerecht, senkrecht oder diagonal.

GEGEN DEN COMPUTER
Drei Stärken von Leicht bis Schwer. Leicht verzeiht Fehler, Schwer rechnet mehrere Züge voraus und bestraft jede Lücke.

ONLINE GEGEN FREUNDE
Lade Freunde über Game Center ein oder lass dir einen Gegner zuteilen. Die Partien sind rundenbasiert: Du ziehst, wann du Zeit hast, und bekommst eine Mitteilung, sobald du wieder dran bist.

FÜNF FARBWELTEN
Ein Tipp wechselt das komplette Farbschema: Klassik, Neon, Sorbet, Wald oder Mono.

ALLES FREI
Kein Feature ist gesperrt, nichts wird freigeschaltet, nichts kostet später Geld.

name: ViipaleKelkka
description: ViipaleKelkka saataa korkeusviivaimen pylvaan, neulan, puristuksen ja vaakavirheen tarkan konepajamerkinnan mukaan.

name: Vinglad
description:
Vinglad is a free wine app built by the people who use it. Scan a label, find the wine, and remember what you thought of it. There are no ads and nothing to buy.

SCAN A LABEL
Point the camera at the front label, or pick a photo. Your iPhone reads the text on the device and Vinglad shows the wines it could be. Pick the right one, or add it if nobody has yet. A photo of the back label or the barcode helps narrow it down.

RATE AND REMEMBER
Rate a wine from 1 to 5 stars in tenths, write what it tasted like and what you ate with it, and say which year it was. Ratings are kept per vintage, so a good year and a weak one don't blur together. Keep a rating to yourself if you like.

WANT TO TRY AND CELLAR
Save wines you want to try. Keep a cellar of the bottles you own, with how many you have and when to drink them. Home shows what is ready to drink, and when you open a bottle, Vinglad asks how it was.

FRIENDS
Follow friends by their username and see what they are drinking.

A CATALOGUE THE COMMUNITY BUILDS
The catalogue starts with about 185,000 wines and grows as people scan. A new wine is marked unverified until several people agree on it, so no single person can rewrite a wine, and duplicates are merged by vote.

LOOK AROUND WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Search, browse and scan without signing up. Rating, saving, following and adding wines use Sign in with Apple, and anything you did before stays with you.

YOUR DATA
Export everything Vinglad stores about you, or delete your account and data, from the Account page. Report wines, ratings, photos and profiles that break the rules, and block people you don't want to see.

The wine catalogue is seeded from LWIN by Liv-ex, used under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence.

Please enjoy wine responsibly.

name: Visit Scan
description:
Your network. All in one place.

You meet someone at a conference, exchange business cards and have a great conversation. A few days later, you find yourself trying to remember their name, where you met or what you talked about.

That's where Visit Scan comes in.

Visit Scan helps you turn business cards into digital contacts and keep track of the people you meet. Whether you're attending events, meeting clients or growing your professional network, everything stays organised and easy to find.

SCAN A CARD, SAVE A CONTACT

Simply point your iPhone camera at a business card and Visit Scan takes care of the rest.

Scan the front and back of business cards.
Automatically recognise names, job titles, companies, phone numbers, email addresses and websites.
Check and edit details before saving.
Keep the original card images with each contact.
Save a profile picture or company logo from a scanned card.

No more typing contact details or keeping stacks of business cards on your desk.

REMEMBER MORE THAN JUST A NAME

Sometimes it's not just about having someone's contact details. It's about remembering the conversation you had.

Add notes to remember important details.
Save where you met someone and at which event.
Organise your contacts with tags and custom statuses.
Search and filter your contacts whenever you need them.
Find the right person without scrolling through your entire address book.

Whether it's a potential client, a new business partner or someone you met at an event, you'll have the information you need when you want to reconnect.

KEEP YOUR CONTACTS THE WAY YOU LIKE

Everyone organises their network differently. Visit Scan gives you the flexibility to make it your own.

Switch between a contact list and a visual card view.
Import contacts from your iPhone.
Save new contacts to Apple Contacts if you want to.
Call, email or manage contacts with simple swipe actions.
Share contacts through AirDrop or messaging apps.
Export your contacts as vCard or CSV.

Everything is designed to be simple, so you can spend less time managing information and more time connecting with people.

YOUR CONTACTS STAY YOURS

We believe your contacts should remain private.
Visit Scan recognises business cards directly on your iPhone without sending the scanned information to external AI services.
You decide whether to connect your Apple Contacts or save the location where you met someone. These features are optional, and there's no continuous location tracking.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY NETWORKING

Visit Scan is built for people who meet people.

Whether you're at a conference, attending a networking event, meeting a new client or simply trying to organise the business cards you've collected over the years, Visit Scan makes it easier to keep everything together.

The app also supports multiple languages, making it useful wherever your work takes you.

PAY ONCE, USE IT FOREVER

No subscriptions or recurring payments. Just one purchase that gives you access to all features and future updates to the app.

Because staying connected shouldn't come with a monthly bill.

Visit Scan is a product of upala.dev.

name: Vitals: Phone Check-up
description:
Find out why your iPhone runs hot or drains fast, in plain words, and what to do about it. One tap checks battery, heat, storage, memory, network and software, and names anything worth a look.

SEE WHICH APPS WERE BUSY
iOS does not give apps a temperature, but it does say when the phone is warm, hot or very hot. Vitals records that every chance it gets and finds hot spells. Share the daily file iOS already keeps and Vitals matches it to each hot spell, so you can see which apps were busy at the time.

STEPS THAT ACTUALLY HELP
Every finding comes with one to three steps, the exact Settings path, and what each step costs you. Mark a step as done and Vitals checks whether it helped.

QUICK RELIEF, NO FAKE BOOSTS
Clean up duplicate photos and old screen recordings, turn on Low Power Mode in one tap, or restart. There is no "clear RAM" button, because iOS gives apps no such power, and Vitals tells you why.

HARDWARE TESTS
Touch, display, speakers, microphones, cameras, haptics, buttons, sensors, Face ID, Bluetooth, GPS, NFC and flashlight, plus both displays and the hinge on iPhone Duo. Useful for repairs and for checking a used phone.

A REPORT YOU CAN SHARE
A PDF for people and a JSON file for tools, with personal details removed by default.

HONEST AND PRIVATE
Every value says where it came from: measured, from a log, or worked out by Vitals. No account, no analytics, no ads, no server. The only network use is the speed test you start. Vitals is open source.

name: Vocabilix: Flashcard & Kelime
description:
Vocabilix, aralıklı tekrar yöntemiyle çalışan bir flashcard (bilgi kartı) uygulaması: öğrenmek istediğin her şeyi kartlara döküp kalıcı hâle getirmen için tasarlandı. İngilizce kelimeler, sınav konuları, tarih, başkentler ya da meslek terimleri: kartını yaz, gerisini Vocabilix'e bırak.

UNUTMADAN ÖNCE HATIRLAT
Aralıklı tekrar, kartları tam unutmak üzereyken karşına çıkarır. Bildiğin kart daha seyrek, bilmediğin kart daha sık gelir. Kartı sağa kaydır "biliyorum", sola kaydır "bilmiyorum"; gerisini uygulama hesaplar. Her deste kendi günlük hedefiyle ilerler.

ÇALIŞMANIN 7 YOLU
• Aralıklı tekrar: günün kartları, kendi hızında
• Kartlar: tüm desteyi çevir, işaretle, kaldığın yerden devam et
• Dinleme: kartlar sesli okunur, ekran kilitliyken de
• Test: çoktan seçmeli sorular
• Eşleştirme: kartları zamana karşı eşleştir
• Boşluk doldurma: kelimeyi cümlenin içinde hatırla
• Dikte: duyduğunu yaz

ÖRNEK CÜMLE VE NOT
Her karta iki dilde örnek cümle ve kendi notunu ekleyebilirsin. Kartı çevirdiğinde kelimeyi cümlenin içinde görürsün.

HAZIR DESTELER
Mağaza'dan İngilizce temel kelimeler, fiiller ve günlük cümle kalıpları gibi hazır desteleri tek dokunuşla ekle. Yeni desteler düzenli olarak eklenir.

PAYLAŞ VE TAŞI
Desteni WhatsApp ya da e-postayla arkadaşına gönder; o da tek dokunuşla eklesin. CSV ve Anki dosyalarını içe ve dışa aktar.

İLERLEMENİ GÖR
Her deste için ayrı istatistik: haftalık çalışma, doğruluk, kalıcı kartlar. Seri ve rozetlerle motivasyonunu koru. Günlük hatırlatma ile hiçbir günü kaçırma.

SENİN VERİN, SENİN TELEFONUNDA
Hesap açmana gerek yok. Kartların ve çalışma geçmişin yalnızca telefonunda durur; reklam, takip ve veri toplama yok. Otomatik yedek telefonunun iCloud ya da Google yedeğine dahil olur, istediğinde dosya olarak da yedekleyebilirsin.

Koyu mod, büyük yazı ve ekran okuyucu desteğiyle herkes için.

name: Voidbinder
description:
Voidbinder is the collection app for trading cards: Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Magic: The Gathering and One Piece in one app.

SCAN, DON'T TYPE
Hold a card up to the camera. Voidbinder recognises it on your device and adds it to your collection with its language, condition and finish. Work through a whole pile card by card.

WHAT YOUR COLLECTION IS WORTH
Every card shows its current market price from Europe, updated every day. See the value of your whole collection and the price history of each card.

BINDERS AND SETS
Flip through your cards like a real binder. For every set, see which cards you are still missing and what they cost together.

WISH LIST WITH PRICE ALERTS
Set a maximum price for a card. Voidbinder tells you as soon as the price reaches it.

DECKS
Build your decks, have them checked against the rules of the format, and see which cards you already own and what the missing ones cost.

FRIENDS AND TRADING
Add friends and see who has a spare copy of a card on your wish list. Show your best cards in your showcase.

SEALED AND GRADED
Displays, boxes and graded cards are part of your collection, with their value.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Prints in many languages, from German to Japanese
• Your collection works offline and syncs between phone, tablet and web
• Export your collection as CSV
• Light and dark theme

Voidbinder is made for collectors aged 16 and over.

Voidbinder is an independent product and is not affiliated with the makers or rights holders of the games named above. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

name: Volcano Smithy
description:
এক বদমেজাজি আগ্নেয়গিরির পাদদেশে কামারশালা চালান এবং হয়ে উঠুন সেই কামারশালা, যার ওপর পুরো Emberfall নির্ভর করে।

আগ্নেয়গিরিতে ট্যাপ করুন, আর সে উগরে দেবে জ্বলজ্বলে জিওড। ওয়ার্কবেঞ্চে সেগুলো ভেঙে বের করুন আকরিক: প্রথমে লোহা আর তামা, তারপর রুপা, অবসিডিয়ান, ফায়ার ওপাল, আর শেষে কিংবদন্তির স্টারস্টিল ও পৌরাণিক ফিনিক্স এম্বার। সংগ্রহ নিয়ে যান নেহাইয়ের কাছে, ব্লুপ্রিন্টের স্লটগুলো পূরণ করুন আর নিজ হাতে গরম ধাতুতে আঘাত হানুন। ভালো উপকরণে সম্ভাবনা বাড়ে, তবে প্রতিবার ধাতু গড়াই ভাগ্যের খেলা — সাধারণ থেকে শুরু করে পৌরাণিক পর্যন্ত।

আপনার দোকান, আপনার খদ্দের
• কৃষক, খনিশ্রমিক, নাইট, অ্যালকেমিস্ট, অভিজাত আর এক রহস্যময় হুডপরা আগন্তুক আসে আপনার জানালায়।
• প্রত্যেক খদ্দেরের আছে নিজস্ব কণ্ঠ, অধ্যায়ে অধ্যায়ে বলা একটি গল্প, আর বিশ্বস্ত বন্ধুদের জন্য উপহার হিসেবে একটি ব্লুপ্রিন্ট।
• আকরিকের অর্ডার পূরণ করুন, তৈরি করুন তলোয়ার, মুকুট, হ্যালবার্ড আর চেইনমেইল, আর বোনাস কয়েনের জন্য অর্ডারের ধারা অটুট রাখুন।

ভাঙুন, গড়ুন, আপগ্রেড করুন
• স্ফুলিঙ্গ, ফাটল আর ঝলমলে উন্মোচনসহ মচমচে, তৃপ্তিদায়ক জিওড ভাঙা।
• সোনালি, স্ফটিক আর দানবাকার জিওড, সঙ্গে জিওড গোলেম বস — পালিয়ে যাওয়ার আগেই যাকে ভাঙতে হবে।
• ৫টি বিরলতা স্তরে ২৫+ ব্লুপ্রিন্ট তৈরি করুন। নিখুঁত আঘাত হেনে ভাগ্যকে নিজের দিকে টানুন।
• ভেন্ট, হাতুড়ি, নেহাই আর দোকান আপগ্রেড করলেই খুলে যায় ৩০টিরও বেশি পার্ক।

সবসময় নতুন কিছু
• প্রতিটি ব্লুপ্রিন্টের জন্য মাস্টারি র‍্যাঙ্ক।
• পূরণ করার জন্য একটি কোডেক্স, সঙ্গে পুরস্কারের সিন্দুকসহ দৈনিক লক্ষ্য।
• আগ্নেয়গিরির জাগরণ: পাহাড়কে জাগিয়ে তুলুন, নতুন রান শুরু করুন আর স্থায়ী বোনাসের জন্য এম্বার অর্জন করুন।

কোনো এনার্জি বার নেই, অপেক্ষার টাইমার নেই। শুধু আপনি, আপনার হাতুড়ি আর গুপ্তধনে ভরা এক আগ্নেয়গিরি।

name: Voltday – Work Hours with Bit
description:
Work charges Bit. So does quitting time.

Voltday is the time tracker for iPhone that does the math for you. Clock in, take a break, call it a day. Voltday knows your daily target and always shows your balance and your overtime.

Along for the ride is Bit, a little office robot. Its battery fills up while you work and is full once you reach your target. Work too long without a break and Bit gets warm. Do overtime and it is overcharged. And when you are off sick, it switches to maintenance mode.

TIME CLOCK
• Clock in and out with one tap, breaks included
• Book time to projects and review it
• Timer for the full day or per block
• Part-time: set your workload, working days and daily target

BALANCE AND OVERTIME
• Battery week: every day is a battery, with the weekly balance at a glance
• Overtime account with a starting balance from before the app
• Take comp time when the account gets too full
• Monthly wrap-up and history
• Weekly limit with a warning before it gets too much

ABSENCES
• Sick, vacation, absence, public holiday, comp time and unpaid
• Enter a single day or a whole date range
• Vacation allowance shows how many vacation days you have left

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island: your working time ticks along
• Control Center controls for clocking in and taking a break
• Workplace reminder (optional): Voltday asks when you arrive and leave, or clocks you in automatically
• Reminders for cool-down, lunch break, quitting time and forgotten days

REPORTS AND EXPORT
• PDF report for your employer, featuring Bit
• CSV export for Excel or Numbers
• Import from CSV or a timesheet PDF, with preview
• Week, month and year in the statistics

BIT'S WORKSHOP
• Streaks and achievements for logged days, real breaks and leaving on time
• Collect chips and kit out Bit in the workshop shop
• Never any rewards for overtime: Bit likes quitting time
• Prefer it plain? "Numbers only" hides Bit and the game elements

YOUR HOURS BELONG TO YOU
• No sign-up, no account
• No ads
• No data collection, no tracking
• Stored on your iPhone and, if you like, in your own private iCloud, so everything is back on a new iPhone
• Your location for the workplace feature is only evaluated on the device

Voltday is available in English and German.

Questions or ideas? Write to me: appsjo@icloud.com

name: Walkies - Endless Pet Game
description:
Walk cute animals home in the most adorable arcade game on your phone! Steer your walker through the park, clip stray pets onto your leash and build a giant conga line of puppies, kittens, bunnies and pandas. Bring each pet back to its owner for big points. The longer your line, the bigger your score. Just don't tangle your own leash!

A cute twist on the classic snake game, made for quick, happy runs. Play offline, anytime, with just one finger.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag anywhere to steer your walker
• Walk into stray pets to add them to your leash
• Deliver each pet to the owner waiting for it
• Every delivery scores more the longer your line gets
• Cross your own leash and the run is over, so plan your path
• Owners won't wait forever, so keep them smiling!

24 CUTE PETS TO WALK
Dog, cat, bunny, piglet, chick, fox, panda, penguin, cow, lion, koala, tiger, monkey, elephant, giraffe, polar bear, deer, beaver, parrot, hog, bee, crab, fish and even a caterpillar. Every animal is a chunky, adorable 3D cube pet.

POWER UP YOUR WALKS

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Super cute 3D animals and colorful worlds
• Easy one-finger controls that are hard to put down

• Endless gameplay that gets more exciting the longer you play
• Catchy original music for every world

Perfect for fans of cute animal games, pet rescue games, snake games, cozy casual games and quick offline games for all ages.

name: Walking with Miles
description:
Every step you take powers up Miles.

Walking with Miles turns your daily steps into a game. Miles' body follows how much you walk: skip your walks and he's rotting, walk more and he levels up from slumped to toned to an absolute unit, and keep going to see him become the final boss.

WALK AND WATCH MILES CHANGE

• Level up mid-walk: walk enough today and he upgrades on the spot
• Your step count goes up live while the app is open
• Some secrets only show up if you walk far enough

EARN COINS
• Complete milestones, weekly and monthly challenges, and step streaks

name: WarAtlas
description:
WarAtlas is a turn-based strategy game where you compete for territory on illustrated maps. Recruit armies, capture regions, and plan your next move as the board changes.

Play at your own pace with friends, find an open game, or practice against bots. Start with the interactive tutorial, then choose a map and rules for your next game.

name: WAY Creator
description:
Turn 1–2 selected photos into a short vertical video on your iPhone.

WAY Creator is a local editor that uses non-destructive anchor-based cropping to create three scenes in a 15-second silent video. Type your own captions, preview the result and export with Apple's share sheet.

FEATURES
• Import 1–2 photos using PhotosPicker or Files
• Retain an original copy without modifying your source photos
• Browse, replay, share and delete exported MP4 files in My Videos
• Adjust the crop anchor and type captions yourself: no AI generation or automatic translation
• Export 1080×1920, 24fps H.264 MP4 video
• View dimensions, orientation, capture date and GPS only when present in source metadata

REQUIREMENTS AND LIMITS
For iPhone with iOS 17 or later. The app interface is currently Korean only; this English listing does not indicate an English UI. JPEG, HEIC, PNG and iOS-decodable RAW are supported inputs. Specific RAW files, including Sony ARW, are not guaranteed to decode. Import limits are 150 MiB per file and 120 MP per image. Memory and format limitations may prevent processing even within those limits.

An optional camera helper provides a read-only PTP/IP connection diagnostic to a manually entered, trusted private IPv4 address. Local TCP is unencrypted: use only a trusted private network. It does not provide camera authentication, shutter control, setting changes, photo downloads or Sony SSH authentication. This is not an official Sony app and claims no Sony affiliation or endorsement. Real Sony camera connectivity, physical-iPhone behavior and high-resolution performance have not yet completed real-device validation.

Processing is on-device, with no developer backend, ads, analytics SDK or developer account registration. No AI API requests, YouTube login or YouTube uploads are provided. The app does not guess locations or copy source GPS into the exported video. Receiving apps and Apple services apply their own policies.

Files stored only inside the app cannot be recovered after uninstalling it. Export important originals and videos first. Original items in Photos or Files are not deleted.

name: Welldora: Kaygı, Panik, Nefes

Kalbin hızlandığında, uçak sarsıldığında ya da uyku bir türlü gelmediğinde Welldora yanında. Klinik psikolog desteğiyle hazırlanan içeriklerle zor anı adım adım geçir, her gün kendin için küçük bir adım at.

ÇALIŞMALAR VE PROGRAMLAR

UYKU VE SESLİ İÇERİKLER

PSİKOLOJİK ÖLÇEKLER

GÜNLÜK VE APPLE SAĞLIK
Her akşam kısa bir soru; istersen sesli günlük (konuşman telefonda yazıya çevrilir, ses kaydedilmez). İstersen nefes ve egzersiz sürelerin "Farkındalık", ruh hâli kayıtların "Ruh Hâli" olarak Apple Sağlık'a yazılır. Welldora Sağlık verilerini okumaz.

Kayıtların Türkiye'deki kendi sunucumuzda tutulur, satılmaz ve reklam için kullanılmaz. Uygulamada reklam ve takip yoktur.

Welldora tıbbi tanı, tedavi ya da psikoterapi yerine geçmez ve bir kriz hizmeti değildir. Kendini güvende hissetmiyorsan lütfen en yakın sağlık kuruluşuna ya da bir ruh sağlığı uzmanına başvur.

name: Wexforda
description:
Wexforda helps you check how supplied vibration follows a rotating shaft when its speed changes. Start with tach pulses and a vibration waveform on a declared shared clock. Keep the original time strings, enter pulses per revolution and choose the indexed tooth that anchors complete turns. A moving spectral peak is evidence to inspect, rather than a fault diagnosis.

The Teeth workspace lines up indexed pulse edges, local shaft speed and the original vibration on one time axis. Zoom into a section and select an edge to read its timestamp, identity and neighbours. Removing a tooth in an editing draft interrupts the affected complete turn. Undo restores the same edge, while the supplied vibration samples remain unchanged.

Angle shuttle maps supported turns at 32, 64 or 128 points per revolution. Open an angular point to inspect the pulse pair, original waveform sample indices and both interpolation fractions. Missing teeth and uncovered turns remain gaps. A plan states its window length and rectangular or periodic Hann window, making the order spacing and peak-amplitude convention visible.

In Order ridge, compare actual spectra against shaft speed. Orders without enough original time bandwidth or angular support are masked rather than presented as zero. Hold cursor A as a reference and move B to another window. Read the same order, its corresponding hertz value and the two original time intervals. A separate frequency window uses the original uniform time samples, so it is more than a change of axis labels.

Freeze a Run-up slice to retain both windows, excluded revolutions and their complete source chain. Later edits do not rewrite the earlier comparison. Export JSON for every original input and mapping value, or share a paginated PDF with aligned channel plots and representative support rows. The labelled numerical example compares second order and a fixed sixty-hertz tone across twelve hundred and eighteen hundred rpm. Your ordinary book starts empty, and you choose whether to add it. There is no account, automatic upload or live instrument capture.

name: What Do We Do Here?
description:
Corporate life, lovingly mocked.

What Do We Do Here? is a comedy game that sends up everything ridiculous about working in an office: the meeting about the meeting, the email that just says "Thoughts?", the restructure nobody asked for and the reply-all that never ends.

You've just started. Nobody has told you what your job is, and everyone is far too busy to explain. Something lands on your desk: an email, a meeting, a colleague with a question. You pick one of two answers and live with what happens next.

Say the right things and look busy, and you'll climb the ladder. Get it wrong and you'll be found out. The higher you go, the more people are watching.

Along the way you'll:
• Sit through a "quick sync" that's three hours long and has no agenda.
• Use the milk labelled "DO NOT TOUCH. THIS MEANS YOU, DARREN."
• Present the quarterly figures by pointing at a chart. Any chart. The board approves more biscuits.
• Hunt for the latest plan among fourteen files called Plan_FINAL.
• Watch your start-up rename itself from Blipr to Blpr after letting a vowel go.
• Get replaced by a fern.

There are three places to work, each absurd in its own way: a huge company where nobody knows who's in charge, a transformation programme nobody can explain, and a start-up that has never made a penny but is somehow worth a billion. Your colleagues remember what you did to them, there are dozens of ways to get fired, and a few ways to end up running the place.

If you've ever nodded along in a meeting without a clue what anyone was talking about, this one's for you.

It's quick to pick up and easy to put down, so it's ideal for the bus, a lunch break or a meeting that could have been an email.

name: Wickward

Arrange the light. Awaken the ancient gate.

Enter Wickward's three-dimensional lantern courtyards. Exchange glowing lanterns, read the gate's carved whispers and study its echoes to find one hidden color sequence. Each question spends an ember. Every exchange is free.
